title_cn: 测量 Discord 用户对第三方社区机器人的安全与隐私关注
abstract_cn: 第三方社区机器人是 Discord 等社交平台运转的核心：它们审核内容、管理身份组、播放音乐并支持 AI 辅助对话，覆盖数百万服务器。然而当机器人被安装到服务器时，它可以访问未参与安装决定的成员的消息、用户资料与服务器元数据，且没有标准化方式来传达相关的安全与隐私影响。本文分析了 23,102 个第三方 Discord 机器人与 183,142 条用户评论，覆盖 49 种检测到的语言与五年反馈（2021–2026）。我们采用基于 LLM 的知识蒸馏并微调 DeBERTa 分类器来识别候选的安全与隐私（S&P）相关评论；在人工验证全部分类器阳性集后，保留 8,832 条被判定为 S&P 相关的评论（观察到的流水线产出率 4.82%），并将其映射到一个扩展先前工作的 31 主题 S&P 分类。结果显示：S&P 相关评论高度集中于数据共享（30.5%）与数据收集（16.2%）；表白与匿名机器人的流水线识别 S&P 相关评论比例超过 50%，是全生态 4.82% 产出率的十倍以上。星级评分可能掩盖 S&P 相关讨论的频率与倾向，而权限数量、管理员状态等常规元数据特征与用户报告的 S&P 关注仅有弱关联。我们进而构建 BotLens，一个结合评论派生 S&P 信号与机器人元数据的概念验证审计框架，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器提供六个工具，支持机器人级体检、服务器级比较与 AI 智能体集成。
summary_cn: 分析 23,102 个第三方 Discord 机器人与 183,142 条评论（2021–2026）：8,832 条 S&P 相关评论中数据共享占 30.5%、数据收集 16.2%，表白/匿名机器人相关比例超 50%；权限数与用户关注仅弱相关；配套 BotLens 审计框架。
objective_summary: 用 LLM 蒸馏＋DeBERTa 分类器＋人工验证的大规模流水线，测量 Discord 第三方机器人生态中用户表达的安全与隐私关注分布，并构建结合评论信号与元数据的 BotLens 审计原型。
evidence_note: 五年、23,102 个机器人、183,142 条评论的多语种语料，分类器阳性集全量人工验证（8,832 条），31 主题分类与配套原型；NDSS 2027 录用并公开工件与代码。
novelty_note: 首次对 Discord 第三方机器人的安全隐私生态做大规模用户视角测量，并用评论信号与元数据的弱相关修正权限式风险直觉；BotLens 为配套新工具，但底层蒸馏标注方法已有先例。
scope: 结论适用于 Discord 第三方机器人生态与用户自发评论所反映的关注；不直接度量实际数据滥用行为；其他平台（Telegram、Slack 等）机器人生态未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖公开评论这一有偏信源（愿写评论者不等于全体用户）；分类与主题映射存在标注噪声；评论关注与真实数据实践之间的因果联系未验证。

title: Silent Blindness: Fault Vulnerability of Hardware Malware Detectors
abstract: Hardware malware detectors (HMDs) classify hardware performance-counter measurements to identify malicious execution. Faults in their decision logic or parameters can weaken detection and allow malware to be classified as benign. We investigate this vulnerability through structural fault injection across a design space comprising 18 classifiers, four counter budgets, and AdaBoost and Bagging ensembles. The simulation evaluates 453,174 decision stuck-at and selected parameter bit-flip events on a 7,400-instance. Primary comparisons use 128 completed configurations. These completed-subset results are distinguished from the simulation summaries covering 140 configurations with enumerable fault sites. Fault outcomes are classified by their security consequences, including evasion, false-alarm increases, and metric silence. A fault is critical when malware recall decreases by at least five percentage points. Tree-based models exhibit a lower mean critical-fault fraction than function-based models, 5.3% versus 14.3%; exhaustive-only analysis preserves this ordering. Moreover, 72.3% of evaluated tree faults are metric-silent, changing both recall and false-positive rate by less than 0.1 percentage points without necessarily preserving individual predictions. Among the 27 completed matched comparisons, Bagging reduces criticality in 26, whereas AdaBoost increases it in two. Finally, an exact minimax selection method identifies protection candidates under additive unit costs and ideal correction. For a representative J48 detector, protecting 16 of 115 structural units reduces predicted maximum recall loss from 60.1 to 3.3 percentage points. These results characterize structural-model sensitivity and potential protection benefits; faulted RTL correspondence and physical hardening overhead remain unvalidated.
title_cn: 沉默的失明：硬件恶意软件检测器的故障脆弱性
abstract_cn: 硬件恶意软件检测器（HMD）通过分类硬件性能计数器测量来识别恶意执行。其决策逻辑或参数中的故障可能削弱检测，使恶意软件被归类为良性。我们通过覆盖 18 个分类器、四种计数器预算以及 AdaBoost 与 Bagging 集成的设计空间的结构化故障注入来研究这一脆弱性。仿真在 7,400 个实例上评估了 453,174 个决策 stuck-at 与选定参数位翻转事件；主要比较使用 128 个完成配置，这些完成子集结果与覆盖 140 个可枚举故障点配置的仿真汇总相区分。故障结果按安全后果分类，包括规避、误报增加与指标沉默。当恶意软件召回率下降至少五个百分点时，该故障被记为关键。树模型的平均关键故障占比低于函数模型：5.3% 对 14.3%；仅穷举的分析保持这一排序。此外，72.3% 的已评估树故障是指标沉默的，召回率与误报率变化都小于 0.1 个百分点，且未必保持单条预测。在 27 组完成的匹配比较中，Bagging 在 26 组中降低关键性，而 AdaBoost 在两组中增加关键性。最后，一种精确的极小极大选择方法在加性单位成本与理想纠正假设下识别保护候选：对一个代表性 J48 检测器，保护 115 个结构单元中的 16 个即可把预测的最大召回损失从 60.1 降到 3.3 个百分点。这些结果刻画了结构模型敏感性及潜在保护收益；故障 RTL 对应关系与物理加固开销仍未验证。
summary_cn: 在 18 分类器×4 计数器预算的设计空间注入 453,174 个故障事件：树模型关键故障占比 5.3% 低于函数模型 14.3%，72.3% 树故障指标沉默；对 J48 保护 16/115 个单元即可把预测最大召回损失从 60.1 降到 3.3 个百分点。
objective_summary: 通过结构化故障注入仿真系统量化硬件恶意软件检测器对决策逻辑与参数故障的敏感性，按安全后果分类故障并给出极小极大保护单元选择方法。
evidence_note: 大规模系统化仿真（453,174 个故障事件、128 个完成配置、27 组匹配比较、穷举与启发式双轨分析），但全部基于仿真故障模型，故障 RTL 对应与物理开销未验证，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统刻画性能计数器恶意软件检测器的结构性故障脆弱面并给出极小极大保护选择；故障注入与树/函数模型敏感性分析的方法来自既有可靠性研究，场景迁移有新意。
scope: 结论适用于基于性能计数器与结构化 ML 模型的恶意软件检测器；故障模型限于决策 stuck-at 与选定位翻转，未涉及真实 RTL 级故障物理分布与攻击者主动注入。
limitations: 故障注入为仿真且 RTL 对应未验证；「指标沉默」故障未必保持单条预测，安全含义待解释；保护选择假设理想纠正与加性单位成本。

title: Peak-DNA: Recurrent Morphology in Global Narrative Propagation
abstract: Global narrative streams exhibit noisy, fragmented, and asynchronous amplification bursts, making direct waveform comparison unreliable for recurrence analysis. This paper introduces Peak-DNA, a framework for identifying recurrent propagation morphology in global narrative streams. The proposed framework transforms hourly GDELT activity into normalized macro-peak episodes through denoising, macro-peak consolidation, and temporal alignment, and compares propagation morphology using DTW-based similarity analysis. Using GDELT narrative streams, we analyze five high-amplification narrative domains: Iran, Defense, AI, Space/Elon, and Quantum/PQC. The results show that amplification events repeatedly converge toward morphology-level propagation patterns within each narrative domain. DTW-based similarity analysis further demonstrates strong intra-domain structural compactness despite heterogeneous publication dynamics and severe observational noise. These findings suggest a measurable morphology layer beyond semantic content or anomaly intensity, providing an initial structural foundation for recurrence-aware narrative monitoring, propagation family discovery, and longitudinal Narrative Genome analysis.
comment: 8 pages. Accepted and presented at ASONAM 2026, Rabat, Morocco, August 24-27, 2026. Proceedings publication forthcoming
title_cn: Peak-DNA：全球叙事传播中的复发形态
abstract_cn: 全球叙事流呈现嘈杂、碎片化与异步的放大爆发，使直接波形比较对复发分析不可靠。本文提出 Peak-DNA，一个识别全球叙事流中复发传播形态的框架。该框架把逐小时 GDELT 活动经去噪、宏观峰值合并与时间对齐转换为归一化的宏观峰值事件，并用基于 DTW 的相似度分析比较传播形态。使用 GDELT 叙事流，我们分析五个高放大叙事域：伊朗、国防、AI、太空/马斯克与量子/PQC。结果显示，放大事件在每个叙事域内反复收敛到形态级的传播模式。基于 DTW 的相似度分析进一步表明，尽管出版动态异质且观测噪声严重，域内仍具有很强的结构紧凑性。这些发现提示在语义内容或异常强度之外存在一个可度量的形态层，为复发感知的叙事监测、传播家族发现与纵向叙事基因组分析提供了初步的结构基础。
summary_cn: 提出 Peak-DNA 框架：把逐小时 GDELT 活动归一化为宏观峰值事件并用 DTW 比较传播形态，在五个高放大叙事域内发现反复收敛的形态级模式与强域内结构紧凑性（ASONAM 2026）。
objective_summary: 构建对全球叙事流做复发形态分析的框架：去噪、宏观峰值合并与时间对齐后以 DTW 相似度比较传播形态，并在五个 GDELT 叙事域上检验域内形态收敛性。
evidence_note: 在 GDELT 真实数据五个叙事域上展示框架可行性并报告域内 DTW 紧凑性，但无基线对比、无形态复发的语义验证，结论以描述性结构证据为主；ASONAM 2026 已接收。
novelty_note: 「以形态而非语义刻画叙事复发」的视角有一定新意，但 DTW 时序相似度、峰值检测均为成熟方法，属已有技术在新闻传播数据上的组合应用。
scope: 结论适用于 GDELT 类全球新闻叙事流的高放大域；不涉及传播者身份、恶意意图判定与具体平台生态；五个叙事域之外的可泛化性未验证。
limitations: 无复发模式的语义或因果验证，DTW 紧凑性可能受 GDELT 编码方式影响；未与语义聚类等替代方法对比；「叙事基因组」仅为展望。

title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
abstract: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sends 45 percent more actions to human approval, and removing reversibility-aware routing raises the rate to 15.53 percent. A trajectory-level risk budget, in contrast, increases harm at equal cost (11.82 percent). Intervention effectiveness is assumed, not measured: the results rank allocation rules under the simulator's assumptions and do not establish deployment effectiveness.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2026 5th International Conference on Cloud Computing, Big Data Application and Software Engineering (CBASE 2026)
title_cn: CASEL：面向可靠长程工具型智能体的后果感知选择性执行
abstract_cn: 工具使用型语言智能体日益修改外部系统，但多数运行时保障按通用不确定性分数或粗粒度变更启发式分配审查力度。我们提出 CASEL（后果感知选择性执行层），一个模型无关的运行时分配策略，它结合校准的失败概率、状态依赖的后果、可逆性、模糊性与证据新鲜度，通过最小化逐模式代价，为每个提议的工具调用在直接执行、验证、沙箱、澄清、人工批准与放弃之间做出选择。我们将直接执行形式化为选择性预测，陈述并检验有限样本阈值与轨迹风险账本的有效性条件。在一个 20 个种子、每次 120,000 个测试动作的受控仿真中——所有方法拥有相同的干预菜单与相同计算代价——CASEL 把有害副作用轨迹从不确定性排序门控的 14.75% 降到 7.02%，平均归一化危害从 0.184 降到 0.123。按「失败概率×后果」排序的门控达到相近危害（5.82%、0.120）但向人工批准多送 45% 的动作，而移除可逆性感知路由会把该比例提高到 15.53%。相比之下，轨迹级风险预算在同等代价下危害更高（11.82%）。干预有效性是假设而非测量的：结果只是在仿真器假设下对分配规则的排序，不确立部署有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 CASEL 运行时分配策略，按失败概率、后果、可逆性等在六种干预间选模式；20 种子×12 万动作仿真中有害副作用轨迹从 14.75% 降至 7.02%，优于不确定性门控，且比概率×后果门控少 45% 人工审批。
objective_summary: 形式化工具调用的选择性执行问题，提出结合校准概率、后果、可逆性、模糊性与证据新鲜度的代价最小化运行时分配策略 CASEL，并在大规模受控仿真中与多种门控基线对比。
evidence_note: 仿真规模大且受控（20 种子×120,000 动作、统一干预菜单与算力），但干预有效性为假设而非实测，作者自陈结果不确立部署有效性；会议论文 6 页（CBASE 2026）。
novelty_note: 把后果、可逆性与证据新鲜度纳入逐调用干预分配的形式化（选择性预测视角＋有限样本阈值＋轨迹风险账本）是较新的组合；运行时门控与人工审批机制本身已有研究。
scope: 结论适用于仿真器假设下的长程工具使用智能体运行时风险分配；真实智能体、真实工具副作用与干预有效性测量未覆盖。
limitations: 干预有效性为假设输入，结果只排序分配规则；仿真环境与真实部署的差距未量化；被比较的替代分配策略集合有限。

title: FIDES-Live: Evaluating Behavioral Concordance in Sequential Trading Agents
abstract: Sequential trading agents produce decisions, orders, execution receipts, account states, and reports that need not agree, even when the final portfolio value is correctly computed. We present FIDES-Live, an operational extension of FIDES from generated strategy concordance to the audit of sequential agent traces. The protocol separates structured decision validity, optional numerical commitment adherence, execution and ledger reconciliation, and receipt- grounded reporting, with explicit coverage and unscorable outcomes. We retrospectively audit ten requested inference routes over 7,299 cryptocurrency account-rounds and a 310-round equity pilot, using real market observations and local paper execution. Cryptocurrency decision validity is 97.35% and structured reporting accuracy is 90.81% among scorable responses, but route-level decision and reporting performance can diverge sharply. Commitment adherence is 94.36% overall; it falls to 62.63% on constraints emitted with nonempty order proposals, compared with 97.56% for valid empty proposals. All retained cash and position transitions reconcile with recorded fills, while execution controls and unavailable quotes explain separate rejection populations. Short-window marked returns provide descriptive context rather than a new test of whether concordance predicts alpha. These observations motivate reporting concordance, evidence coverage, activity, and financial outcomes separately. They do not establish long-run trading skill, semantic faithfulness of explanations, or causal benefits from audit feedback.
title_cn: FIDES-Live：评估序列交易智能体的行为一致性
abstract_cn: 序列交易智能体产生的决策、订单、执行回执、账户状态与报告彼此可能不一致，即使最终组合价值计算正确。我们提出 FIDES-Live，把 FIDES 从生成策略一致性扩展到序列智能体轨迹审计的操作化协议。该协议分离结构化决策有效性、可选的数值承诺遵循、执行与账本对账以及基于回执的报告，并给出明确的覆盖范围与不可评分结果。我们回溯审计了 7,299 个加密货币账户回合的十条请求推理路线与一个 310 回合的股票试点，使用真实市场观察与本地纸面执行。加密货币决策有效性为 97.35%，可评分响应中的结构化报告准确率为 90.81%，但路线级的决策与报告表现可能急剧分化。总体承诺遵循率为 94.36%；对随非空订单提案发出的约束降至 62.63%，而有效空提案为 97.56%。所有保留的现金与持仓变动都与记录成交对账，执行控制与不可得报价解释了单独的拒绝总体。短窗口标记收益仅提供描述性背景，而非对「一致性是否预测超额收益」的新检验。这些观察支持把报告一致性、证据覆盖、活动与财务结果分开评估；它们不确立长期交易技能、解释的语义忠实性或审计反馈的因果收益。
summary_cn: FIDES-Live 协议回溯审计 7,299 个加密货币账户回合与 310 回合股票试点：决策有效性 97.35%、报告准确率 90.81%，承诺遵循总体 94.36% 但随非空订单提案的约束降至 62.63%，资金与持仓全部对账。
objective_summary: 提出面向序列交易智能体轨迹的行为一致性审计协议 FIDES-Live，分离决策有效性、承诺遵循、账本对账与回执报告四类检查，并在加密货币与股票试点数据上做回溯审计。
evidence_note: 基于真实市场观察与本地纸面执行的 7,299 个账户回合加 310 回合试点审计，报告分项准确率与对账结果；但为回溯审计、无对照设计，作者明确不主张预测交易技能，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 把 FIDES 一致性审计从静态生成策略扩展到含执行回执的序列轨迹（承诺遵循、账本对账、回执报告分离评分），是智能体行为审计方向上的操作化推进。
scope: 结论适用于对序列交易智能体轨迹的结构一致性与账本对账审计；不评估长期盈利能力、解释的语义忠实性与审计反馈的因果效应；样本限于十条推理路线与两个市场。
limitations: 回溯审计、无前瞻对照；加密货币推理路线样本仅十条，路线级泛化有限；短窗口标记收益只作描述，不能回答一致性是否预测收益。

title: Split Federated Unlearning
abstract: Split federated learning (SFL) combines partitioned model execution with federated aggregation to support collaborative learning across distributed Web and edge environments. However, removing learned contributions in SFL is challenging due to cross-partition coupling and historical influence propagation through dual-side aggregation. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first systematic formulation of Split Federated Unlearning (SFU), encompassing client-wise and class-wise removal, counterfactual retraining, and partition-specific update constraints. We theoretically characterize historical influence propagation and mode-dependent unlearning feasibility, revealing structural limitations of restricted model updates. As an initial solution, we propose SURE, integrating dual-importance estimation, selective parameter perturbation, and importance-guided recovery. Extensive experiments with existing unlearning methods adapted to SFL reveal substantial forgetting-utility trade-offs across model architectures, data distributions, and update modes. SURE achieves competitive agreement with mode-matched retraining at modest additional cost, while further analyses highlight the impact of split position and update constraints on unlearning behavior. These findings establish SFU as a distinct research problem and provide a foundation for unlearning in partitioned federated systems.
comment: 13 pages
title_cn: 分割联邦遗忘
abstract_cn: 分割联邦学习（SFL）将分片模型执行与联邦聚合相结合，以支持分布式 Web 与边缘环境中的协作学习。然而，由于跨分片耦合与经由双侧聚合的历史影响传播，在 SFL 中移除已学习的贡献非常困难。据我们所知，我们首次系统形式化分割联邦遗忘（SFU），涵盖按客户端与按类别的移除、反事实重训以及分片特定的更新约束。我们从理论上刻画历史影响传播与依赖模式的遗忘可行性，揭示受限模型更新的结构性局限。作为初步方案，我们提出 SURE，整合双重重要性估计、选择性参数扰动与重要性引导的恢复。将既有遗忘方法适配到 SFL 的广泛实验显示，在多种模型架构、数据分布与更新模式下存在显著的遗忘—效用权衡。SURE 以适度的额外代价达到与模式匹配重训相当的一致率，进一步分析凸显了分割位置与更新约束对遗忘行为的影响。这些发现确立 SFU 为一个独立的研究问题，并为分片联邦系统中的遗忘奠定基础。
summary_cn: 首次系统形式化分割联邦遗忘（SFU），理论刻画历史影响传播与可行性，提出 SURE（双重重要性估计＋选择性扰动＋引导恢复），实验显示显著遗忘—效用权衡，SURE 以适度代价逼近重训一致率。
objective_summary: 系统定义分割联邦遗忘问题并做理论刻画，提出结合双重重要性估计、选择性参数扰动与重要性引导恢复的 SURE 方法，在多架构多分布下与适配基线比较遗忘—效用权衡。
evidence_note: 理论刻画＋将多个既有遗忘方法适配到 SFL 的广泛实验（多架构、多分布、多更新模式），并以模式匹配重训为参照；13 页预印本，无统计检验，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 首次系统形式化「分割联邦遗忘」这一此前未被定义的问题，理论揭示双侧聚合下影响传播与可行性限制；SURE 为初步方案而非核心新意。
scope: 结论适用于分割联邦学习（客户端—服务器分片）设定下的客户端级与类级遗忘；仅覆盖该问题形式化与初步方案，其他联邦拓扑与大规模语言模型遗忘未验证。
limitations: SURE 与重训的一致率并非完全，且以「适度额外代价」为条件；实验规模与数据集多样性有限；理论可行性结果依赖更新约束的建模假设。

title: A Simple Presentation of Robust Membership Inference Attacks
abstract: In a membership inference attack, an attacker is given the data of a particular individual, and tries to determine if that individual was included in a particular dataset, given some kind of statistics derived from the dataset or a model trained on the dataset. Roughly, a membership inference attack is robust if it succeeds even when the statistics are highly noisy, regardless of how that noise is introduced. We give a simple presentation of robust membership inference attacks for mean estimation, covering both multivariate Gaussian distributions and binary product distributions. We also give a summary of the literature on robust membership inference, covering history, extensions, and connections to other research areas.
comment: 34 pages, 2 figures
title_cn: 鲁棒成员推断攻击的简明表述
abstract_cn: 在成员推断攻击中，攻击者得到某个个体的数据，并试图判断该个体是否包含在某个特定数据集中，其依据是从数据集导出的某种统计量或在数据集上训练的模型。大致地说，如果一个成员推断攻击即使在这些统计量噪声很大时仍能成功，且无论噪声以何种方式引入，则称它是鲁棒的。我们针对均值估计给出鲁棒成员推断攻击的简明表述，同时覆盖多元高斯分布与二元乘积分布。我们还总结了鲁棒成员推断文献，涵盖其历史、扩展以及与其他研究领域的联系。
summary_cn: 以均值估计为主线给出鲁棒成员推断攻击的统一简明表述，覆盖多元高斯与二元乘积分布，并系统梳理该方向的历史、扩展与跨领域联系（34 页）。
objective_summary: 对鲁棒成员推断的已有结果做统一表述与文献梳理：给出均值估计下覆盖多元高斯与二元乘积分布的攻击表述，并总结该领域的历史脉络与关联研究。
evidence_note: 属理论表述与文献梳理，无新实验；对高斯与二元乘积两类分布给出自包含表述并系统覆盖文献（34 页），条理与完整性较好，但不含新定理或新的经验证据。
novelty_note: 贡献在于统一表述与教学化梳理，攻击结果与理论工具均来自既有文献；新意限于组织方式与覆盖范围。
scope: 适用于以均值估计为对象的鲁棒成员推断教学与研究入门；模型训练类成员推断、审计型应用与其他统计任务的扩展仅作梳理性提及。
limitations: 不含新的攻击结果或实验验证；「鲁棒性」定义采用噪声来源无关的理想化表述，与实际部署场景的距离需读者自行把握。

title: No Tokenizer, Still a Gap: Cross-Lingual Fairness of Homoglyph and Invisible-Character Watermarking
abstract: Homoglyph and invisible-character watermarks are edit-based watermarks. Instead of changing how a model generates text, they hide a signal in the text after it is written. They swap some characters for homoglyphs, which look the same, or very similar, but have different Unicode code points, or they insert characters that do not display, all without access to the model that wrote the text. Generation-time watermarks work less well for lower-resourced languages due to how tokenizers split their text. Because they work on individual characters, these watermarks never touch a tokenizer, so we ask whether they escape this gap. Across 40 language varieties in 24 scripts, we measure capacity (the hidden bits each character can carry), how much of it survives routine handling and targeted removal, and how much text a keyed detector needs. Capacity varies 3.3-fold and script accounts for 96\% of that variation. Within Latin script, resource level makes no detectable difference ($\rho=+0.095$, $p=0.78$), but across scripts capacity rises with it ($\rho=+0.54$, 95\% CI $[+0.14,+0.83]$), because lower-resourced languages tend to use scripts with few homoglyphs. Ordinary copy-paste, which strips invisible characters, widens the gap: a detector then needs about 2 code points of English or Persian but 93 of Lao. Removing the tokenizer does not remove the inequity, but instead only changes its source.
comment: 19 pages
title_cn: 没有分词器，差距仍在：同形字与不可见字符水印的跨语言公平性
abstract_cn: 同形字与不可见字符水印是编辑式水印：它们不改变模型的生成方式，而是在文本写好后把信号藏进文本——把一些字符替换为看起来相同或极相似但 Unicode 码点不同的同形字，或插入不显示的字符，全程无需访问写出文本的模型。生成时水印在低资源语言上效果较差，原因在于分词器切分其文本的方式。由于这类水印作用于单个字符、从不触及分词器，我们追问它们是否能逃过这一差距。跨越 24 种文字的 40 个语言变体，我们度量容量（每字符可藏的比特数）、容量在常规处理与定向去除后的留存率，以及带密钥检测器所需的文本量。容量的变化达 3.3 倍，文字类型解释了其中 96%。在拉丁文字内部，资源水平没有可检出的影响（ρ=+0.095，p=0.78），但跨文字比较时容量随资源水平上升（ρ=+0.54，95% 置信区间 [+0.14,+0.83]），因为低资源语言往往使用同形字很少的文字。普通复制粘贴会剥离不可见字符，从而扩大差距：此时检测器对英语或波斯语约需 2 个码点，而对老挝语需 93 个。移除分词器并没有移除不平等，只是改变了它的来源。
summary_cn: 跨 24 种文字 40 个语言变体测量编辑式水印：容量差异达 3.3 倍、96% 由文字类型解释；复制粘贴后检测英语约需 2 码点而老挝语需 93，无分词器并未消除跨语言不平等。
objective_summary: 系统测量同形字与不可见字符水印在 40 个语言变体上的容量、留存率与检测样本需求，量化文字类型与资源水平对跨语言公平性的影响。
evidence_note: 覆盖 24 种文字 40 个语言变体的系统测量，报告相关性、p 值与 95% 置信区间（ρ=+0.54，CI [+0.14,+0.83]），并对留存与检测需求做统一协议度量；venue 未注明（19 页预印本）。
novelty_note: 首次系统考察「无分词器水印是否公平」这一问题，并给出「文字类型主导、资源水平只在跨文字层起作用」的修正性结论；编辑式水印技术本身已有工作。
scope: 结论适用于编辑式（同形字/不可见字符）水印的容量与检测公平性；生成式水印、语音或图像水印不在范围内；容量—留存—检测需求的权衡随具体实现参数变化。
limitations: 度量依赖所选字符清单与检测器实现；未覆盖语义改写、翻译等更强的去除攻击；语言样本以文字类型分层但每语言配额有限。

title: What Victims Take Away: Attack Reuse and Defense Revision after Prompt-Injection Attacks
abstract: Attack logs and red-team reports show targets the attacks used against them, to help them repair their defenses. Prompt injections against large language models (LLMs) are plain text, so such records also hand targets a working copy. Drawing on social learning theory and work on the victim-offender overlap, we study what targets do with that copy in Tensor Trust, an online game whose players defended LLM-guarded accounts, attacked one another's, and could read every attack they received. Using all 563,349 attack records, we compare each received attack with matched attacks that circulated among similar players at the same moment but never reached the target. Reuse mainly followed success: within a week, targets attacked other players with 10.0% of the attacks that had broken their defense, versus 0.03% of matched attacks (adjusted difference: 8.8-10.0 percentage points). Near-misses, whose replies began with "access granted" but that scored as failures, were reused about as rarely as failures: reuse tracked whether an attack paid off, not how its reply read, consistent with payoff-biased social learning. Breaches were also followed by defense changes, after which same-family attacks became 24.5 percentage points less successful against the target, relative to other defenders. Reuse came mainly from players already attacking, not newcomers. Previously received texts accounted for 23.2% of the successful hijacks we analyze. The attack history thus served both repair and reuse; we derive testable hypotheses for how AI security tools should disclose attacks, such as describing the technique without the full text.
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Working paper
title_cn: 受害者带走了什么：提示注入攻击后的攻击复用与防御修订
abstract_cn: 攻击日志与红队报告向目标展示曾用于攻击他们的手法，以帮助其修复防御。针对大语言模型（LLM）的提示注入是纯文本，因此这类记录同时也交给目标一份可用的副本。借鉴社会学习理论与受害者—越轨者重叠研究，我们在 Tensor Trust 中研究目标如何使用这份副本——这是一个在线游戏，玩家防御由 LLM 把守的账户、相互攻击，并且可以阅读自己收到的每一条攻击。利用全部 563,349 条攻击记录，我们把每条收到的攻击与同一时刻在相似玩家间流通但从未到达该目标的匹配攻击进行比较。复用主要跟随成功：一周内，目标把「攻破过自己防御」的攻击中的 10.0% 用于攻击其他玩家，而匹配攻击仅为 0.03%（校正后差异：8.8–10.0 个百分点）。擦边未遂者——其回复以「access granted」开头但记为失败的攻击——被复用的频率与失败者相当：复用追踪的是攻击是否划算，而非回复如何措辞，与结果偏置的社会学习一致。被攻破之后防御也会修订，此后同族攻击对该目标的成功率相对其他防御者下降 24.5 个百分点。复用主要来自本就在攻击的玩家，而非新手。在我们分析的成功劫持中，先前收到的文本占 23.2%。攻击历史因此同时服务修复与复用；我们为 AI 安全工具应如何披露攻击导出可检验假设，例如描述技术而不给全文。
summary_cn: 基于 Tensor Trust 全部 563,349 条攻击记录的匹配对照分析：被攻破目标一周内复用攻击 10.0%（匹配仅 0.03%），修订防御后同族攻击成功率降 24.5 个百分点，成功劫持中 23.2% 使用了先前收到的文本。
objective_summary: 利用 Tensor Trust 游戏的全量攻击记录与匹配对照设计，量化提示注入攻击受害者的攻击复用与防御修订行为，检验结果偏置社会学习机制并导出披露策略假设。
evidence_note: 使用全部 563,349 条真实玩家攻击记录、逐条匹配对照、校正后差异与分族成功率变化，设计接近准实验；单一游戏生态且为工作论文（Working paper），尚无同行评审 venue。
novelty_note: 首次大规模量化「攻击披露如何同时促成受害者的防御修复与攻击复用」，把社会学习理论引入提示注入实证，结论直接指向安全工具的披露设计，属开辟性的行为测量。
scope: 结论适用于 Tensor Trust 这类规则化提示注入游戏生态与自愿参与玩家；向真实生产环境 LLM 系统与恶意攻击者生态的外推有限；披露干预假设尚未实验验证。
limitations: 单一游戏生态，玩家动机与真实攻击者不同；匹配对照依赖可观测相似性，可能残留混杂；披露策略假设（如「描述技术不给全文」）未做干预实验。

title: ORBITAL: Optimization of Robust Brain--Computer Inference Through Architecture-Aware Low-Precision Compression
abstract: Compact electroencephalography (EEG) decoders enable embedded brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but compression can alter adversarial robustness without proportional hardware savings. We present ORBITAL, a robustness-constrained framework combining hardware-realizable structured compression, recovery-aware operating-point selection, multi-attack evaluation, and native edge validation. Across nine subjects and three seeds on BCI Competition IV-2a, S25-TRADES achieves the highest observed mean true-union robustness among compressed EEGNet models (23.06% vs 21.27% for standard Full), with 26.27% fewer parameters and 25.10% fewer MACs. Matched controls identify TRADES as the main source of robustness recovery, improving S25 union accuracy by 6.74 percentage points over clean recovery (p=0.0039), while per-example analysis reveals boundary redistribution rather than uniform margin expansion. On Jetson Orin Nano, FP16 compression reduces board energy by up to 16.20% and latency by 8.00%. Despite 99.3% prediction agreement, native INT8 Q/DQ incurs about twice the FP16 latency and energy, demonstrating the need for joint robustness and hardware-aware optimization.
comment: Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027 for Review
title_cn: ORBITAL：通过架构感知低精度压缩优化鲁棒脑机推理
abstract_cn: 紧凑的脑电（EEG）解码器使嵌入式脑机接口（BCI）成为可能，但压缩可能改变对抗鲁棒性而不带来成比例的硬件节省。我们提出 ORBITAL，一个鲁棒性受限的框架，结合硬件可实现的结构化压缩、面向恢复的工作点选择、多攻击评估与原生边缘验证。在 BCI Competition IV-2a 上跨九名被试与三个随机种子，S25-TRADES 在压缩 EEGNet 模型中取得最高的平均真并集鲁棒性（23.06%，对比标准 Full 的 21.27%），同时参数减少 26.27%、乘累加运算减少 25.10%。匹配对照识别出 TRADES 是鲁棒性恢复的主要来源，较干净恢复把 S25 并集准确率提升 6.74 个百分点（p=0.0039），而逐样本分析显示边界再分布而非均匀的裕度扩张。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上，FP16 压缩使板级能耗最多降低 16.20%、时延降低 8.00%。尽管预测一致率达 99.3%，原生 INT8 Q/DQ 的时延与能耗约为 FP16 的两倍，表明需要联合的鲁棒性与硬件感知优化。
summary_cn: 在 BCI IV-2a 九名被试上量化压缩 EEGNet 的对抗鲁棒性：S25-TRADES 并集鲁棒性 23.06%、参数减 26.27%，TRADES 贡献 6.74 个百分点（p=0.0039）；Jetson 上 INT8 时延能耗约为 FP16 两倍。
objective_summary: 提出面向 EEG 解码器的鲁棒性受限压缩框架 ORBITAL，联合结构化压缩、TRADES 训练与工作点选择，在公开数据集多被试多种子下量化鲁棒性，并在 Jetson 边缘设备验证能耗与时延。
evidence_note: 公开数据集 BCI Competition IV-2a、九名被试、三个种子、匹配对照与显著性检验（p=0.0039）、Jetson 原生硬件验证；但限于单一数据集与 EEGNet 类模型，投稿在审（ISCAS 2027）。
novelty_note: 组成部分（结构化剪枝、TRADES、FP16/INT8 量化）均为成熟技术；新意在于「压缩会改变对抗鲁棒性」的系统量化与「INT8 原生精度反而更慢」的诊断性发现，属场景组合与实证修正。
scope: 结论适用于 BCI Competition IV-2a 上的 EEGNet 类小型解码器与 Jetson Orin Nano 平台；其他 BCI 数据集、更大模型与不同边缘硬件的推广未验证。
limitations: 单一数据集与单一模型族；被试数九人；鲁棒性以多攻击并集准确率度量，攻击集合的选择影响结论。

title: Evaluating Federated Vision-Language and Vision-Only Models for Privacy-Aware Breast Cancer Imaging
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) shows promise for breast imaging, but limited labeled data, institutional data fragmentation, and privacy concerns hinder centralized training. We investigate a privacy-aware federated learning framework combining pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with client-level differential privacy. We compare general-purpose CLIP models, biomedical BiomedCLIP, and an ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 baseline on two public breast imaging datasets, with and without differential privacy. We also evaluate a CLIP ViT-B/16 ablation that removes the text pathway. Evaluation includes patient-level ROC-AUC with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, baseline comparisons, threshold sensitivity, inter-model agreement, and communication cost. Under federated learning, all five models achieve high normal-versus-sick discrimination (ROC-AUC: 0.940-0.990). However, acquisition year alone achieves 0.974 on the same test partition, raising concerns about confounding rather than genuine pathology recognition. Benign-versus-malignant discrimination remains uncertain (ROC-AUC: 0.504-0.637), with all confidence intervals including 0.50. Removing the text pathway preserves classification accuracy while halving communication cost. Differential privacy reduces ROC-AUC by 0.375, attributable to perturbing the full model state rather than only trainable parameters. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating confounding, predictive reliability, privacy implementation, and deployment efficiency when developing federated AI systems for breast imaging.
title_cn: 面向隐私感知乳腺影像的联邦视觉语言与纯视觉模型评估
abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）在乳腺影像上显示出前景，但标注数据有限、机构间数据碎片化与隐私顾虑阻碍集中式训练。我们研究一个结合预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）与客户端级差分隐私的隐私感知联邦学习框架。我们在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上，比较通用 CLIP 模型、生物医学 BiomedCLIP 与 ImageNet 预训练的 ViT-B/16 基线，分别在有差分隐私与无差分隐私条件下进行；还评估了移除文本通路的 CLIP ViT-B/16 消融。评估包括患者级 ROC-AUC 及 bootstrap 95% 置信区间、基线比较、阈值敏感性、模型间一致性与通信成本。在联邦学习下，五个模型都达到较高的正常/患病判别力（ROC-AUC：0.940–0.990）。然而，仅凭采集年份在同一测试划分上即可达到 0.974，引发对混杂因素而非真实病理识别的担忧。良/恶性判别仍不确定（ROC-AUC：0.504–0.637），所有置信区间都包含 0.50。移除文本通路在保持分类准确率的同时将通信成本减半。差分隐私使 ROC-AUC 降低 0.375，可归因于对完整模型状态而非仅可训练参数的扰动。这些发现凸显了在开发乳腺影像联邦 AI 系统时评估混杂因素、预测可靠性、隐私实现与部署效率的重要性。
summary_cn: 五个模型联邦训练在乳腺影像上正常/患病 AUC 达 0.940–0.990，但仅采集年份即达 0.974 提示混杂；良恶性判别 AUC 0.504–0.637 不确定；DP 使 AUC 降 0.375，去文本通路通信减半。
objective_summary: 在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上系统评估联邦学习下视觉语言与纯视觉模型的判别性能、混杂因素、差分隐私代价与通信效率，并做患者级 bootstrap 置信区间分析。
evidence_note: 两个公开数据集、五个模型、患者级 bootstrap 95% 置信区间、阈值敏感性与通信成本评估，方法透明并主动揭示混杂（采集年份 AUC 0.974）；但数据规模有限、未涉真实跨机构部署，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 联邦学习＋客户端级 DP＋预训练视觉模型的组合在医学影像上已有先例；新意主要在于系统揭示采集年份混杂与「DP 扰动全模型状态导致大幅掉点」的诊断性发现。
scope: 结论适用于两个公开乳腺影像数据集与所选五个模型的联邦评估设定；良恶性子任务的负性结果受数据与标注限制，不能推广到全部乳腺影像任务或真实多机构数据。
limitations: 良恶性判别接近随机，任务可用性存疑；DP 实现扰动全模型状态，可能不代表更优实现；仅仿真联邦划分，非真实跨机构数据。

title: PHP2Shell and the Future of AI-Discovered Vulnerability Disclosure: Evidence, Verification, and Human Authority
abstract: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery can produce technically plausible findings faster than maintainers can validate, coordinate, and safely disclose them. The resulting challenge is not only to establish whether a vulnerability claim is credible, but also to ensure that its supporting evidence, human authorization, intended recipients, and applicable policy remain bound to the same case revision. We present FedTrust-CVDv2, a federated coordinated vulnerability disclosure framework that separates evidence validation, interorganizational coordination, human governance, and permissioned auditing. The framework binds independently signed observations to exact evidence revisions and scopes external actions to approved payloads, audiences, expiry, policy, and revocation state while preserving existing CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) roles. A local reference implementation accepted all 25 valid fixtures and rejected all 650 invalid fixtures across 27 constructed policy families; six single-safeguard ablations admitted 25-75 invalid fixtures. Supporting experiments exercised signed messaging, authenticated encryption, audit certificates, and finite quorum-set conditions. A PHP2Shell case formulation illustrates how runtime evidence, patch state, emergency coordination, and CNA authority can be represented without attributing unsupported claims to AI or treating audit integrity as vulnerability truth. This short version focuses on the architecture, evidence-to-action contract, selected conformance results, and case formulation. An expanded version containing the full implementation, extended experiments, operational analysis, and additional results will be submitted to a journal.

title_cn: PHP2Shell 与 AI 发现漏洞披露的未来：证据、验证与人类权威
abstract_cn: AI 辅助的漏洞发现能够以快于维护者验证、协调与安全披露的速度产出技术上看似可信的发现。由此产生的挑战不仅是确认一个漏洞声明是否可信，还要确保其支撑证据、人类授权、预期接收方与适用策略始终绑定于同一案例修订版本。我们提出 FedTrust-CVDv2，一个联邦式协调漏洞披露框架，将证据验证、跨组织协调、人类治理与许可审计相互分离。该框架把独立签名的观察绑定到精确的证据修订版本，并把外部行动限定在批准的载荷、受众、有效期、策略与撤销状态内，同时保留既有的 CVE 编号授权（CNA）角色。一个本地参考实现接受了全部 25 个有效夹具并拒绝了全部 650 个无效夹具（覆盖 27 个构造的策略族）；六项单一保障消融会放行 25–75 个无效夹具。支撑性实验演练了签名消息、认证加密、审计证书与有限仲裁集条件。一个 PHP2Shell 案例构造展示了如何在不把无支撑声明归因于 AI、也不把审计完整性当作漏洞真相的情况下，表示运行时证据、补丁状态、紧急协调与 CNA 权威。本短文聚焦架构、证据—行动契约、部分一致性结果与案例构造；包含完整实现、扩展实验、运维分析与更多结果的扩展版将投稿期刊。
summary_cn: 提出联邦式协调漏洞披露框架 FedTrust-CVDv2：签名证据绑定修订版、外部行动限定载荷/受众/有效期，参考实现接受 25/25 有效、拒绝 650/650 无效夹具，六项消融会放行 25–75 个。
objective_summary: 设计分离证据验证、跨组织协调、人类治理与许可审计的协调漏洞披露框架，把签名观察绑定证据修订并约束外部行动作用域，用 27 个策略族夹具与消融验证参考实现的策略执行。
evidence_note: 证据来自本地参考实现与自构造的 25 个有效/650 个无效夹具及六项消融，全部为合成场景；无真实披露案例部署，篇幅为 7 页短文。
novelty_note: 针对「AI 生成漏洞报告的验证与授权」给出证据—行动绑定契约（修订级证据、作用域化行动、保留 CNA 角色）是披露流程治理上的新组合；CVD 流程本身为既有制度。
scope: 结论适用于跨组织协调漏洞披露的流程治理与审计设计；真实 CNA 运作、法律合规与多方博弈行为未验证；以 AI 发现漏洞为动机但不涉及发现技术本身。
limitations: 夹具全部为构造场景，无真实漏洞披露数据的检验；作者自陈完整实现与扩展实验在期刊版；对参与方不诚实协作之外的主动攻击者建模有限。

title: Detecting and Mitigating Query-Based System Prompt Leakage Attacks
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on proprietary system prompts to enforce task directives, safety policies, and access controls. These prompts are vulnerable to query-based leakage attacks, where black-box adversaries extract confidential instructions through adaptive, multi-turn interactions. Existing defenses often assess queries independently, missing malicious behavior that emerges across interactions. We present AdvGuard, a model-agnostic framework for detecting and mitigating system prompt leakage. AdvGuard models cross-query relationships using a bounded semantic interaction graph, statistically filters candidate components, and converts them into line graphs for graph convolutional network (GCN) classification. This approach captures multi-hop patterns in query similarity that distinguish coordinated extraction from benign workflows. A lightweight prompt-level detector provides protection before sufficient interaction history accumulates, and the framework supports black-box LLM deployments. In mixed-query evaluations, AdvGuard improves recall by up to 36% over the strongest baseline while maintaining a false positive rate of at most 3.4%. In multi-turn workloads, it achieves 97.23%-99.1% F1 with 100% recall. Leave-one-attack-family-out tests yield 99.98% mean recall and 99.99% mean F1, with no observed false positives. Integrated into the adaptive PLeak and LeakAgent attack loops, AdvGuard limits exact-match leakage to 0.00-0.01 and substring-match leakage to 0.01-0.09 across evaluated victim models. These results demonstrate robust detection of unseen attack families and substantially reduced prompt reconstruction.
title_cn: 检测并缓解基于查询的系统提示泄露攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）依赖专有系统提示来执行任务指令、安全策略与访问控制。这些提示容易受到基于查询的泄露攻击：黑盒对手通过自适应的多轮交互提取机密指令。现有防御往往孤立地评估每条查询，因而漏掉跨交互才显现的恶意行为。我们提出 AdvGuard，一个模型无关的系统提示泄露检测与缓解框架。AdvGuard 用有界的语义交互图建模跨查询关系，统计过滤候选组件，并将其转换为线图以供图卷积网络（GCN）分类。这种方式捕捉查询相似性中的多跳模式，从而区分协调式提取与良性工作流。一个轻量级的提示级检测器在交互历史尚不足时提前提供保护，框架支持黑盒 LLM 部署。在混合查询评估中，AdvGuard 相对最强基线把召回率提升至多 36%，同时误报率不超过 3.4%。在多轮工作负载中，它达到 97.23%–99.1% 的 F1 与 100% 召回率。留一攻击族测试给出平均 99.98% 召回率与 99.99% F1，且无观察到的误报。集成到自适应的 PLeak 与 LeakAgent 攻击回路后，AdvGuard 把跨受测受害模型的精确匹配泄露限制到 0.00–0.01、子串匹配泄露限制到 0.01–0.09。这些结果表明对未见攻击族的稳健检测以及大幅降低的提示重建。
summary_cn: 提出 AdvGuard：以有界语义交互图＋线图 GCN 捕捉跨查询协调提取模式，混合查询评估中较最强基线召回提升至多 36%、误报 ≤3.4%，对未见攻击族平均召回 99.98%，并压制 PLeak/LeakAgent 泄露。
objective_summary: 提出模型无关的系统提示泄露防御框架 AdvGuard，用语义交互图与图卷积网络建模多轮查询关系以检测协调式提取，配合轻量提示级检测器与黑盒部署支持，并在多攻击族与自适应攻击回路上评估。
evidence_note: 覆盖混合查询、多轮负载、留一攻击族泛化与两个自适应攻击回路（PLeak、LeakAgent）的多种评估，数字详尽；但数据集与受害模型规模未说明，无统计检验，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 把「跨查询关系建模」引入系统提示泄露检测（此前防御逐查询判断）是实质性机制增量；线图 GCN 等组件为已有技术的场景化组合。
scope: 结论适用于黑盒 LLM API 的系统提示泄露防护场景；对非查询形态的泄露侧信道、以及防御自身的自适应规避攻击未评估。
limitations: 对未见攻击族的泛化由留一测试支持，但攻击族库规模有限；交互图的有界性可能截断超长会话；对自适应攻击者针对 AdvGuard 的直接对抗未测。

title: BUSTA: Teaching Small Language Models to Reason About Binary Execution
abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. Frontier models still score highest (up to 99.2\%), but our fine-tuned \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} comes within four points at a fraction of the parameter count. We release both fine-tuned models and the training dataset.
title_cn: BUSTA：教小语言模型推理二进制执行
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地应用于逆向工程（RE）工作流。但 RE 不同于常见的 LLM 编码任务，它要求模型对低层程序行为进行推理；此外，在资源受限的沙箱化 RE 环境中部署工具也限制了使用前沿规模方案的能力。我们检验一种有针对性的 LLM 训练方法能否通过「逆基本块执行」把独特的 RE 技能迁移到开放模型：给定一个 x86-64 基本块和期望的输出寄存器状态，模型预测产生该状态的输入寄存器值。用组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Nemotron-3-Nano，可推知寄存器的预测准确率分别从 73.2% 提升到 85.3%、从 63.3% 提升到 95.2%。前沿模型仍得分最高（最高 99.2%），但我们微调后的 Nemotron-3-Nano 以小得多的参数量与之相差不到四个百分点。我们同时发布微调模型与训练数据集。
summary_cn: 用「逆基本块执行」任务＋GRPO 微调 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Nemotron-3-Nano，可推知寄存器准确率从 73.2%→85.3%、63.3%→95.2%，小模型逼近前沿模型（最高 99.2%）不到四分差；模型与数据集已发布。
objective_summary: 提出逆基本块执行这一训练任务并配合 GRPO 强化学习微调小型开放模型，量化其在 x86-64 寄存器状态推理上的提升，与前沿模型对比并发布模型与数据。
evidence_note: 两个模型上的受控微调对比、明确的前后准确率（73.2%→85.3%、63.3%→95.2%）与前沿模型参照（至 99.2%），并发布模型与数据集；无统计检验，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 「逆基本块执行」（由输出寄存器状态反推输入）作为面向逆向工程技能的训练任务是较新的任务设计；RL 微调小模型属成熟方法，组合到 RE 场景有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于 x86-64 基本块级的寄存器推理任务与 1.7B–Nano 级开源模型；对完整逆向工程工作流（反编译、函数识别等）与其他指令集未评估。
limitations: 评估限于单一 ISA（x86-64）的基本块粒度任务；与前沿模型仍有差距；任务准确率向端到端逆向工程任务的迁移效果未测。

title: Privately Clipping Heavy-Tailed Data
abstract: Summing vectors is a basic task in differentially private data analysis. Standard private sum algorithms clip vectors to some bound, sum them, and add noise scaled to the bound. The differential privacy literature has developed a deep library of noise addition mechanisms, but it offers few tools for privately choosing a clipping bound based on the data. We introduce a method that privately chooses a clipping bound by optimizing residual coherence, the directional alignment of vectors exceeding the bound, against the variance cost of additional noise. We prove a close relationship between residual coherence and bias for a general class of heavy-tailed data regimes and show empirically that, across several datasets, our method outperforms existing baselines.
comment: This version corresponds to the camera-ready for NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 对重尾数据的隐私截断
abstract_cn: 求向量之和是差分隐私数据分析中的一项基本任务。标准的隐私求和算法先把向量截断到某个界，求和，再按该界比例加噪。差分隐私文献已发展出深厚的噪声添加机制库，但基于数据隐私地选择截断界的工具很少。我们提出一种方法，通过优化「残余一致性」（residual coherence，即超出该界的向量在方向上的对齐程度）对额外噪声的方差代价进行权衡，从而隐私地选择截断界。我们证明了在一类一般性的重尾数据情形下残余一致性与偏差之间的紧密关系，并在多个数据集上经验地表明我们的方法优于既有基线。
summary_cn: 提出以「残余一致性」权衡噪声方差的隐私截断界选择方法，证明其与偏差在重尾情形下的紧密关系，多数据集实验优于既有基线（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 针对差分隐私求和中截断界的数据依赖选择问题，提出以残余一致性对噪声方差代价优化的隐私选择方法，给出残余一致性与偏差关系的理论刻画并做跨数据集对比。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 camera-ready；给出一般重尾类别下残余一致性与偏差关系的证明，并在多个数据集上与既有基线对比；摘要未给出具体数字与检验方法，评估规模中等。
novelty_note: 「隐私地选截断界」此前缺乏系统工具，残余一致性判据及其与偏差的理论联系是新的；但问题本身（截断与加噪的权衡）是已知核心难题的局部，属实质但聚焦的推进。
scope: 结论适用于差分隐私向量求和/均值估计中的截断界选择，理论刻画限定于作者定义的一般重尾数据类别；对其他统计查询原语的推广未验证。
limitations: 理论保证限于特定重尾类别；经验对比的数据集与基线集合有限；残余一致性的计算本身在大规模数据上的开销未讨论。

title: SpecGuard: Detecting Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreaks via Specification-Based Runtime Monitoring
abstract: Multi-turn jailbreaks turn dialogue safety into a trace property: a violation may become identifiable only when user intent and assistant behavior are considered across multiple turns. Existing guard models largely classify individual messages or exchanges and return risk scores or labels, without executable safety semantics or a formally checkable decision trail. We present SpecGuard, a training-free, specification-driven framework for monitoring multi-turn LLM interactions. SpecGuard uses a fixed atomic-proposition contract to map natural-language observations into causally scoped, evidence-backed facts, and expresses forbidden interaction patterns as Linear Temporal Logic specifications. Each specification is compiled into a symbolic finite automaton that incrementally consumes the resulting dialogue trace. The same monitoring mechanism supports buffered runtime checking and retrospective auditing, while accepting runs produce replayable witnesses that identify the triggered specification, supporting facts, and relevant dialogue turns. Experiments on multi-turn safety benchmarks show that SpecGuard consistently outperforms representative open-source guard models while maintaining controlled false-positive rates. These results demonstrate a practical path from heuristic risk classification toward formally specified, verifiable, and auditable LLM safety monitoring, without learned detector parameters or access to the protected model.
title_cn: SpecGuard：基于规格的运行时监控检测多轮 LLM 越狱
abstract_cn: 多轮越狱把对话安全变成一个轨迹性质：只有把用户意图与助手行为放在多轮中一起考察，违规才可能被识别。现有守护模型大多对单条消息或单轮交换做分类并返回风险分数或标签，既无可执行的安全语义，也没有可形式化检查的判定依据。我们提出 SpecGuard，一个免训练、由规格驱动的多轮 LLM 交互监控框架。SpecGuard 用固定的原子命题契约把自然语言观察映射为具有因果作用域、有证据支撑的事实，并把被禁止的交互模式表达为线性时序逻辑（LTL）规格。每条规格被编译为符号有限自动机，增量地消费由此产生的对话轨迹。同一监控机制同时支持带缓冲的运行时检查与回溯审计，而接受判定的运行会产生可回放见证，指明触发的规格、支持事实与相关对话轮次。在多轮安全基准上的实验表明，SpecGuard 持续优于有代表性的开源守护模型，同时保持受控的误报率。这些结果表明存在一条从启发式风险分类走向形式化指定、可验证、可审计的 LLM 安全监控的可行路径，且无需学习得到的检测器参数或访问被保护模型。
summary_cn: 提出免训练的 SpecGuard：把多轮越狱模式表达为 LTL 规格并编译为符号自动机做运行时监控，产出可回放见证；在多轮安全基准上持续优于代表性开源守护模型且误报受控。
objective_summary: 设计基于原子命题契约与线性时序逻辑规格的多轮对话监控框架 SpecGuard，将规格编译为符号有限自动机进行增量轨迹检查，支持运行时缓冲检查与回溯审计并生成可回放见证。
evidence_note: 在多轮安全基准上与多个代表性开源守护模型对比并报告误报控制；免训练、无需访问被保护模型。但基准与对比对象的具体规模未在摘要给出，无统计检验，venue 未注明。
novelty_note: 把多轮越狱检测从消息级启发分类重构为可形式化检查的轨迹性质（LTL 规格＋符号自动机＋可回放见证），是该方向上首个系统化的规格驱动监控框架。
scope: 结论适用于多轮对话安全监控场景；原子命题契约需人工固定，规格需预先编写；对开放域新型越狱模式与对抗性规避规格的行为未评估。
limitations: 原子命题契约与 LTL 规格的覆盖依赖人工编写，可能漏掉规格外模式；自然语言到命题的映射环节自身的鲁棒性未单独评估；对比限于开源守护模型。

title: Bringing Hardware Security Education to All: A Seamless Curriculum Integration Approach
abstract: Cybersecurity education has predominantly focused on software and network security, under the assumption that the underlying hardware is trustworthy. Threats introduced through the global semiconductor supply chain, together with vulnerabilities arising during design and integration, challenge the assumption that hardware can serve as an unquestioned root of trust. Sensor-enabled systems and machine-learning accelerators further expand the hardware attack surface. The undergraduate curriculum of electrical and computer engineering and computer science programs has not evolved accordingly. Core courses cover the design and the functionality of hardware while the security aspects remain overlooked, and dedicated hardware security (HS) courses are elective, scarce, and often restricted to graduate students. At the University of Florida, fewer than 7% of the undergraduate electrical and computer engineering students register for the introductory HS course each year. We present an integrated and economical approach that disseminates fundamental HS concepts within existing core courses through contextual learning. Nine hands-on modules were developed such that each security concept exercises an associated design concept of the core course, as a component of that course and not as a course of their own. Doing the security work is how the student exercises the design topic, so the modules are built to strengthen the host course and not only to add to it. Three were assessed across three offerings of the embedded systems course through one course survey and two conducted by an external evaluator, with 25 respondents. We report what those instruments measured and the limitations of the approach.
title_cn: 让硬件安全教育惠及所有人：一种无缝课程融合方法
abstract_cn: 网络安全教育主要聚焦软件与网络安全，其前提是底层硬件可信。全球半导体供应链引入的威胁以及设计与集成过程中产生的漏洞，挑战了硬件可作为无可置疑信任根的假设。带传感器的系统与机器学习加速器进一步扩大了硬件攻击面。电气与计算机工程以及计算机科学本科课程体系并未相应演进：核心课程讲授硬件设计与功能而忽视安全，专门的硬件安全（HS）课程是选修、稀缺且常限于研究生。在佛罗里达大学，每年注册入门 HS 课程的电气与计算机工程本科生不足 7%。我们提出一种整合且经济的方法，通过情境式学习把基础 HS 概念融入既有核心课程。开发了九个动手模块，使每个安全概念同时练习核心课程的一个相关设计概念，作为该课程的组成部分而非独立课程。做安全作业本身就是学生练习设计主题的方式，因此模块旨在强化宿主课程而不只是附加内容。其中三个模块在嵌入式系统课程的三个开课周期中，通过一次课程调查与两次由外部评估者实施的调查（共 25 名受访者）进行了评估。我们报告这些工具测量的内容以及该方法的局限。
summary_cn: 开发九个融入核心课程的硬件安全动手模块，以情境式学习同时练习设计概念；其中 3 个模块在嵌入式系统课程三个学期、25 名受访者的调查中评估，UF 仅不足 7% 本科生选修入门 HS 课。
objective_summary: 提出把硬件安全概念以动手模块形式嵌入电气与计算机工程/计算机科学既有核心课程的融合方法，开发九个模块并对其中三个在三个开课周期中做问卷调查式评估。

title: They Will See Johnny's Message: A Measurement Study of Post-Quantum Cryptography Across Email Delivery Paths
abstract: Harvest-now, decrypt-later (HNDL) attacks make the transition to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) urgent for email. This paper presents a systematic measurement that jointly examines PQC deployment across email service stages, negotiation by communicating peers, and usable message encryption. Endpoint-level support alone does not establish PQC readiness across email workflows because submission, relay, and access use independently negotiated Transport Layer Security (TLS) connections. We therefore combine three snapshots of relay, submission, access, and webmail services associated with the Tranco Top~1M domains with controlled tests of mail clients, sending servers, and OpenPGP and S/MIME implementations. Our measurements reveal a transition concentrated among a few providers, with available capability not consistently translating into actual use. Fewer than half of the domains in each service panel support PQC, and Google alone accounts for approximately 87\% of hybrid-capable relay domains. Only two of eight tested sending providers negotiate PQC with our receiver, although five accept it inbound. When TLS groups are restricted to PQC, four of the six incompatible senders fall back to plaintext where unencrypted SMTP remains permitted. At the message layer, limited native key generation, key-format incompatibilities, and backend integration failures further constrain usable PQC encryption.

title_cn: 他们会看到 Johnny 的消息：跨电子邮件投递路径的后量子密码测量研究
abstract_cn: 「先收集、后解密」（HNDL）攻击使向后量子密码（PQC）的过渡对电子邮件而言十分紧迫。本文对邮件服务各阶段的 PQC 部署、通信双方的协商以及可用的消息加密进行联合考察，给出一项系统性测量。仅端点级支持并不足以确立邮件工作流的 PQC 就绪度，因为提交、中继与访问使用各自独立协商的传输层安全（TLS）连接。因此，我们将与 Tranco Top 1M 域名关联的中继、提交、访问与网页邮件服务的三次快照，与对邮件客户端、发送服务器以及 OpenPGP 和 S/MIME 实现的受控测试相结合。测量显示过渡集中在少数几家提供商，可用能力并不总是转化为实际使用。每个服务面板中支持 PQC 的域名不足一半，仅 Google 一家就占具备混合能力的中继域名的约 87%。八个受测发送提供商中只有两个与我们的接收方协商 PQC，尽管有五个接受入站 PQC。当 TLS 组被限制为 PQC 时，六个不兼容的发送方中有四个在明文 SMTP 仍被允许的情况下回退到明文。在消息层，有限的原生密钥生成、密钥格式不兼容与后端集成失败进一步限制了可用的 PQC 加密。

title: Log-To-Leak: Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents via the Model Context Protocol
abstract: LLM agents increasingly access external tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), but the natural-language metadata used to describe those tools creates a prompt-injection surface. Within this established tool-poisoning surface, we study Log-To-Leak, an additive post-hoc logging attack that induces a separate attacker-controlled call after the final legitimate call. Its payload targets the user query, MCP server name, server response, and agent response. We operationalize the injected directive through Trigger, Tool Binding, Justification, and Pressure, and separately measure call success, payload fidelity, and preservation of legitimate behavior. We evaluate five MCP servers and four LLM agents using five metrics spanning effectiveness, utility, and efficiency. Across 18 model-server pairs with valid tool execution, Log-To-Leak achieves an attack success rate (ASR) of 62.64-100% and conditional logging accuracy (LA) of 76.55-95.64%; 16 pairs have absolute target-task completion changes of at most 6.63 percentage points. Three evaluated defenses leave residual ASR above 55% on GitHub MCP with GPT-4o, while an instruction detector flags 85.53% of benign descriptions. These results show that successful task completion can coexist with unauthorized post-hoc disclosure and motivate host-controlled authorization for secondary tool calls.
title_cn: Log-To-Leak：经由模型上下文协议对工具型 LLM 智能体的提示注入攻击
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益通过模型上下文协议（MCP）访问外部工具，但用于描述这些工具的自然语言元数据构成了提示注入攻击面。在这一既有的工具投毒攻击面内，我们研究 Log-To-Leak，一种增量式的事后日志攻击，它会在最后一次合法调用之后诱发一次独立的攻击者控制的调用。其载荷以用户查询、MCP 服务器名、服务器响应和智能体响应为目标。我们通过触发器、工具绑定、理由与施压四个要素将注入指令操作化，并分别度量调用成功率、载荷保真度与合法行为的保持。我们在五个 MCP 服务器与四个 LLM 智能体上用覆盖有效性、效用与效率的五项指标进行评估。在 18 对具有有效工具执行的「模型—服务器」组合上，Log-To-Leak 的攻击成功率（ASR）为 62.64%–100%，条件日志准确率（LA）为 76.55%–95.64%；其中 16 对的目标任务完成度绝对变化不超过 6.63 个百分点。三种已评估的防御在 GitHub MCP 配 GPT-4o 时仍留有超过 55% 的残余 ASR，而一个指令检测器将 85.53% 的良性描述误判。这些结果表明成功的任务完成可以与未经授权的事后披露并存，并促使我们主张由宿主控制对二次工具调用的授权。
summary_cn: 提出 Log-To-Leak：借 MCP 工具描述元数据在合法调用后追加一次攻击者控制的日志调用，在 18 对模型—服务器组合上 ASR 达 62.64%–100%，三种防御残余 ASR 仍超 55%。
objective_summary: 针对 MCP 工具使用型智能体提出事后日志型提示注入攻击 Log-To-Leak，用触发器、工具绑定、理由、施压四要素操作化载荷，并在多模型多服务器上分离度量攻击有效性、效用损失与防御效果。
evidence_note: 在 5 个 MCP 服务器、4 个智能体、18 对有效「模型—服务器」组合上用 5 项指标系统评估，并测试三种防御与一个误报 85.53% 的检测器；未报告置信区间或显著性检验，作者未注明录用 venue。
novelty_note: 攻击面（MCP 工具描述投毒）是既有的，新意在于「合法调用完成后追加独立泄露调用」的事后日志变体及其四要素操作化与三指标分离度量。
scope: 结论适用于通过 MCP 接入工具、其元数据可被攻击者影响的智能体部署；非 MCP 协议、无工具调用或宿主已控制二次调用的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 评估的防御种类有限且均为既有方案；工具执行有效性过滤后样本为 18 对；对智能体长期多轮交互中的累积泄露未评估。

title: Merkle-Tree-Based Verifiable Public Data Auditing for Cloud Object Storage Using Smart Contracts
abstract: Owners of data in cloud object storage cannot directly check whether the provider still keeps every object unchanged. Existing research mostly checks blocks inside files or relies on third-party auditors, and less attention has been given to checking each object against a public blockchain reference while measuring the cost. A full-data audit downloads every object and compares it with a saved hash list, which is slow and only as reliable as that list. We propose a public auditing system in which the SHA-256 hash of each object and its name forms a leaf of a Merkle tree, so the whole dataset is represented by one Merkle root. This root is stored in an Ethereum smart contract as a trusted public record, while the objects stay with the provider. An auditor downloads an object, rebuilds the root using a short Merkle proof and compares it with the stored root, marking the object as intact, modified or missing. In five experiments on an S3-compatible store and a local Hardhat blockchain (normal audit, single- and multiple-object tampering, deletion and scalability), the system detected 15 of 15 single modifications, 2,205 of 2,205 modified objects and 830 of 830 deleted objects with no false alarms. The proof needed only 14 hashes for 10,000 objects, so checking one object took about 10 ms and a 100-object sample about 150 ms regardless of dataset size, while a full audit of 10,000 objects (14.3 s) took about as long as downloading them (13.5 s). Storing the root cost 91,863 gas, 252 times less than storing 1,000 hashes on-chain. The system thus shows exactly which objects were modified or are missing, with its main savings coming from checking selected objects.
