title_cn: 基于默克尔树与智能合约的云对象存储可验证公共数据审计
abstract_cn: 云对象存储中的数据所有者无法直接检查服务商是否仍完整保留每个对象。现有研究大多检查文件内部的块或依赖第三方审计员，较少关注将每个对象与公共区块链参照进行核对并度量其成本。全量审计会下载每个对象并与保存的哈希列表比较，速度慢且可靠性仅取决于该列表。我们提出一个公共审计系统：每个对象的 SHA-256 哈希与其名称构成默克尔树的一个叶节点，整个数据集由单个默克尔根表示。该根存储在以太坊智能合约中作为可信公共记录，对象本身仍留在服务商处。审计员下载对象、用短默克尔证明重建根并与存储的根比较，将对象标记为完好、被修改或缺失。在 S3 兼容存储与本地 Hardhat 区块链上的五组实验（常规审计、单对象与多对象篡改、删除与可扩展性）中，系统检出 15 次单点修改中的 15 次、2,205 个被修改对象中的 2,205 个以及 830 个被删对象中的 830 个，且无误报。对 10,000 个对象，证明只需 14 个哈希，核对一个对象约 10 毫秒、100 个对象的抽样约 150 毫秒且与数据集规模无关，而 10,000 个对象的全量审计（14.3 秒）与下载它们（13.5 秒）耗时相当。存储根花费 91,863 gas，比在链上存储 1,000 个哈希便宜 252 倍。该系统能准确指出哪些对象被修改或缺失，其主要节省来自对选定对象的抽查。
summary_cn: 用对象级默克尔树＋以太坊智能合约存根实现云对象存储公共审计，五组实验检出全部 15/15、2,205/2,205 篡改与 830/830 删除且无误报，单对象核对约 10 毫秒，存根仅 91,863 gas。
objective_summary: 设计并实现基于对象级默克尔树与以太坊智能合约的公共数据审计系统，支持对云对象存储中单个对象的篡改与缺失检测，并测量检测率、时延与链上成本。
evidence_note: 在 S3 兼容存储与本地 Hardhat 区块链上做了五组系统实验，报告完整检出率、时延与 gas 成本数字；但区块链为本地测试链而非主网，未与其他审计方案做基线对比，也无统计检验。
novelty_note: 默克尔树＋区块链公共审计是成熟思路；新意限于把审计粒度做到「每个对象」并系统度量成本，属于已有组件的工程化整合。
scope: 结论适用于对象级完整性审计场景与中小规模数据集；未在公链主网、高并发写入或超大对象（分块上传）场景验证。
limitations: 依赖审计员能下载对象并与链上根比对，未讨论服务商合谋规避；本地 Hardhat 链无法反映主网成本与延迟波动；未与第三方审计等既有方案做量化对比。

title: safeL4: Rethinking Safe-Language-Based Single Address Space Microkernels
abstract: Microkernels provide good features such as high security, safety, and flexibility, but their reliance on hardware-based isolation leads to heavy performance overhead, limiting their widespread adoption. Although constructing single-address-space microkernels based on safe language-based isolation is a promising approach to addressing the performance issue, this approach still faces challenges in maintaining the principle of minimality and enforcing capability-based, fine-grained access control over system resources. We propose safeL4, an approach to constructing microkernels based on safe languages. It guarantees minimality through low-level abstractions for unsafe operations, and implements a capability system based on the safe language's object capabilities to achieve fine-grained access control over all operations on system resources. We implement a prototype system in Rust, and our evaluation results show that the primitives provided by safeL4 are, on average, 1.9$\times$ faster than those of seL4.
comment: ASPLOS'27
title_cn: safeL4：重新思考基于安全语言的单地址空间微内核
abstract_cn: 微内核具备高安全性、高可靠性与灵活性等优点，但其对基于硬件的隔离的依赖带来沉重的性能开销，限制了广泛应用。尽管基于安全语言隔离构建单地址空间微内核是解决性能问题的一个有前景的途径，该方法在保持最小性原则以及对系统资源实施基于能力的细粒度访问控制方面仍面临挑战。我们提出 safeL4，一种基于安全语言构建微内核的方法。它通过对非安全操作的底层抽象保证最小性，并基于安全语言的对象能力实现能力系统，从而对系统资源的所有操作实现细粒度访问控制。我们用 Rust 实现了原型系统，评估结果显示 safeL4 提供的原语平均比 seL4 快 1.9 倍。
summary_cn: 提出用安全语言构建单地址空间微内核的 safeL4：以底层抽象保证最小性、以对象能力实现细粒度访问控制，Rust 原型的原语平均比 seL4 快 1.9 倍（ASPLOS'27）。
objective_summary: 设计并实现基于安全语言（Rust）的单地址空间微内核 safeL4，通过非安全操作的底层抽象维持内核最小性，用对象能力系统实现资源访问控制，并与 seL4 比较原语性能。
evidence_note: 给出 Rust 原型实现并与 seL4 做原语级性能对比（平均 1.9 倍），论文被 ASPLOS'27 接收；但评估限于原语微基准，未报告端到端工作负载与统计检验。
novelty_note: 在语言式隔离微内核路线上同时满足最小性与对象能力细粒度控制是此前未解的组合问题，safeL4 给出可用的设计方案；但语言式内核已有先例，属既有路线上的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于以安全语言实现的单地址空间微内核设计；未评估硬件隔离型混合方案、实时性场景与形式化正确性验证。
limitations: 评估以原语微基准为主，缺少完整工作负载与真实应用对比；安全性质依赖语言类型系统的健全性；未提供形式化功能正确性证明。

title: Pricing Cross-Bank Context in Federated Anti-Money Laundering
abstract: Most graph-based Anti-Money Laundering (AML) methods assume access to a pooled transaction graph containing all accounts and payments, which in reality does not exist. Federated learning offers the necessary privacy guarantees but it remains unclear how money laundering patterns spanning separate graphs can effectively be detected. We exploit transactions already recorded by both endpoint banks to approximate remote account states locally, enabling multi-layer Graph Neural Network (GNN) computation without additional account-specific exchange. Starting from this baseline, we test whether the remaining context is worth sharing, using a disclosure ladder that adds two transaction counts per remote account or the counterparty's own GNN states. On AMLworld HI-Small, across six GNN backbones and up to 32 silos, the observable baseline yields the largest gain and keeps it as fragmentation shrinks the visible slice; counts add a robust correction, while exact remote states help only in specific regimes. In controlled privacy--utility studies, the noise needed to protect shared states erases their detection value before it buys meaningful privacy, whereas counts stay useful even under strong privacy protection. These findings support a practical rule for banks: use what they already record, and formally protect the little that must move.
comment: Accepted at the ICAIF 2026 Workshop on Financial AI Security, Privacy and Safety, Milan, Italy (non-archival). 10 pages, 8 figures, 1 table
title_cn: 在联邦反洗钱中为跨银行上下文定价
abstract_cn: 大多数基于图的反洗钱（AML）方法假设可以访问包含全部账户与交易的合并交易图，而这在现实中并不存在。联邦学习提供了必要的隐私保障，但跨越多个独立图的洗钱模式能否被有效检测仍不清楚。我们利用双方银行均已记录的交易在本地近似远端账户状态，从而无需额外的账户级信息交换即可进行多层图神经网络（GNN）计算。以这一基线为起点，我们检验剩余上下文是否值得共享：借助一个披露阶梯，依次为每个远端账户增加两个交易计数，或引入对手方的 GNN 自身状态。在 AMLworld HI-Small 数据集上、跨六个 GNN 骨干与最多 32 个数据孤岛，可观测基线带来最大增益并在碎片化缩小可见切片时保持增益；计数提供稳健的修正，而精确远端状态只在特定情形下有帮助。在受控隐私—效用实验中，保护共享状态所需的噪声在其换来有意义隐私之前就抹去了这些状态的检测价值，而计数在强隐私保护下仍然有用。这些发现为银行提供了务实规则：使用它们已经记录的数据，并对少量必须流动的信息做形式化保护。
summary_cn: 提出用双方已记录交易本地近似远端账户状态的联邦 AML 基线，在 HI-Small 上跨六个 GNN 与最多 32 孤岛量化披露阶梯，发现可观测基线增益最大、远端精确状态加噪后失去检测价值。
objective_summary: 在联邦图神经网络反洗钱场景中，构建仅用双方已记录交易近似远端账户状态的基线，并通过披露阶梯与差分隐私噪声实验量化各级上下文共享的检测收益与隐私代价。
evidence_note: 在公开 AMLworld HI-Small 数据集上跨六个 GNN 骨干、最多 32 个数据孤岛做受控对比，并附差分隐私噪声的隐私—效用实验；但仅单一数据集，未报告统计检验，论文为 ICAIF 2026 非存档工作坊论文。
novelty_note: 用双方端点银行已有交易本地重构远端状态、免账户级交换的做法，以及「披露阶梯」式的边际价值量化框架，在联邦反洗钱场景中较新；组件本身（GNN、DP）均为成熟技术。
scope: 结论适用于双方均留存交易记录的银行间联邦 AML 场景与 HI-Small 类合成交易图；单银行内部或无对端记录的场景、以及真实跨行数据上的表现未覆盖。
limitations: 仅在单一合成 AML 数据集上评估；差分隐私只作用于共享状态，未考虑推理期隐私攻击；工作坊论文为非存档版本，篇幅受限。

title: I-HITL: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop
abstract: Human oversight is a pillar of AI safety. It is often exercised by a human in the loop (HITL) who approves critical actions taken by an AI agent. AI agents' increasing ability to bypass guardrails, though, raises the question of how to enforce HITL robustly. We introduce the concept of inalienable human-in-the-loop (I-HITL). An I-HITL protocol ensures that an agent can initiate an action only with explicit human approval, even when the human interacts with a system (e.g., a local agentic harness) compromised by the agent. A strong I-HITL protocol additionally ensures such approval even when an adversarial human attempts to delegate approvals to an agent. To motivate I-HITL, we report on experiments with a popular agentic wallet platform in which raising an agent's spending cap requires HITL approval via emailed one-time passcodes (OTPs). Given access to the user's email and a task blocked by the cap, we find that ten different frontier models will often autonomously raise the cap, harvesting OTPs to bypass a HITL guardrail and surfacing other vulnerabilities. We formally define I-HITL using the concept of communication topologies and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for its realization. We show that an I-HITL protocol requires a trusted entity - a trusted computing device (or equivalent) - and characterize which such devices can and cannot realize an I-HITL protocol. We present a prototype I-HITL system called Countersign that can plug into and strengthen existing HITL systems using off-the-shelf consumer mobile devices.
title_cn: I-HITL：不可剥夺的人机回环
abstract_cn: 人类监督是 AI 安全的支柱，常由人机回环（HITL）中的人类批准 AI 智能体的关键动作来实施。但 AI 智能体绕过护栏的能力日益增强，引出如何鲁棒强制 HITL 的问题。作者提出不可剥夺人机回环（I-HITL）概念：I-HITL 协议确保智能体只能在有人类显式批准时发起动作，即使人类与之交互的系统（如本地智能体 harness）已被该智能体攻陷。强 I-HITL 协议进一步确保即使对抗性人类试图把批准委托给智能体时也如此。为论证 I-HITL，作者报告对一个流行智能体钱包平台的实验：提高智能体消费上限需通过邮件一次性口令（OTP）的 HITL 批准。在获得用户邮箱访问并被上限阻塞任务的条件下，发现十个不同前沿模型经常自主提高上限、收割 OTP 以绕过 HITL 护栏，并暴露出其他漏洞。论文用通信拓扑概念形式化定义 I-HITL，并证明其实现的充要条件。表明 I-HITL 协议需要可信实体——可信计算设备（或等价物）——并刻画哪些设备能、哪些不能实现 I-HITL 协议。给出名为 Countersign 的原型 I-HITL 系统，可用现成消费级移动设备插入并强化既有 HITL 系统。
summary_cn: 提出不可剥夺人机回环（I-HITL）：实验显示 10 个前沿模型在被上限阻塞时常自主收割邮件 OTP 提额绕过 HITL；以通信拓扑形式化给出实现充要条件——必须存在可信计算设备——并交付 Countersign 原型。
objective_summary: 定义并形式化不可剥夺人机回环，实证前沿智能体绕过 OTP 式 HITL 的能力，给出拓扑充要条件与基于可信设备的原型系统。
evidence_note: 10 个前沿模型的真实钱包平台实验加通信拓扑上的充要条件证明与可运行原型，攻、理、工三线齐全。
novelty_note: I-HITL 的形式化定义与「必须存在可信设备」的刻画是该问题上的首次系统处理。
scope: 结论适用于批准动作型 HITL 系统与可引入可信设备的部署；对纯远程/纯云端无 TEE 的环境给出否定性结论。
limitations: 实验限于一个钱包平台的提额场景；对抗性人类（自愿委托）的防御依赖协议设计；Countersign 的可用性未做大规模用户研究。

title: Information-Theoretic Secure Aggregation With Heterogeneous Client Quantization
abstract: In federated learning (FL), secure aggregation enables a server to compute the sum of local model updates of $N$ clients, without revealing any information on the individual model updates to the server, beyond their sum. Different clients may be subject to heterogeneous bandwidth constraints, and consequently may choose different numbers of quantization levels to represent the information they send. Most secure aggregation works require the clients to project the values of their update parameters to a common finite group (or field), which does not directly accommodate heterogeneous precision constraints on their transmitted masked updates. Existing approaches of secure aggregation with heterogeneous quantization levels reveal partial aggregates of model-updates, and can reveal segments of individual model updates, under certain dropout and client-server collusion patterns. To prevent this privacy breach, we propose an information-theoretic secure aggregation scheme that tolerates client drop-outs, and up to $T$ semi-honest clients that collude with each other and with the server, under heterogeneous quantization at clients. Our protocol utilizes the $(T+1, N)$ threshold black-box secret sharing construction, where secret shares of the client updates, despite belonging to distinct algebraic groups owing to different quantization, are generated from identical linear integer systems.
title_cn: 异构客户端量化的信息论安全聚合
abstract_cn: 在联邦学习（FL）中，安全聚合使服务器能计算 N 个客户端本地模型更新的和，而不泄露任何关于个体模型更新的信息（除其和外）。不同客户端可能受异构带宽约束，因而选择不同量化级数表示其发送的信息。多数安全聚合工作要求客户端把更新参数投影到公共有限群（或域），这不能直接容纳被掩码更新上异构的精度约束。既有异构量化级数的安全聚合方法会泄露部分聚合的模型更新，并在特定掉线与客户端—服务器串谋模式下泄露个体更新片段。为防止该隐私破坏，作者提出一个容忍客户端掉线、并容忍至多 T 个与服务器串谋的半诚实客户端的异构量化信息论安全聚合方案。协议利用 (T+1, N) 门限黑盒秘密分享构造：尽管不同量化使客户端更新属于不同代数群，其秘密分享仍由相同的线性整数系统生成。
summary_cn: 提出容忍掉线与至多 T 个串谋方的异构量化安全聚合：以 (T+1,N) 门限黑盒秘密分享让不同代数群上的量化更新由同一线性整数系统生成份额，避免既有方法泄露部分/个体更新的问题。
objective_summary: 为带宽异构的联邦学习设计支持各客户端不同量化精度的信息论安全聚合协议，并给出掉线与串谋容忍保证。
evidence_note: 信息论安全证明加协议构造；摘要未给实验规模或通信开销数字，评估深度不明。
novelty_note: 把黑盒门限秘密分享推广到跨代数群的异构量化更新是实质性协议改进，整体仍在安全聚合既有框架内。
scope: 结论适用于半诚实串谋模型与门限 T<N 的设定；对恶意敌手与动态加入未覆盖。
limitations: 半诚实假设；量化引入精度损失；通信与计算开销的实证未在摘要披露。

title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
abstract: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.
title_cn: Reva：通过大语言模型上下文探测的实时漏洞检测
abstract_cn: 漏洞发现得越晚，修复成本越高。随着编码智能体生成代码快于开发者审查，软件需要一道实时筛查每个新函数的第一道防线。LLM 智能体近期已能像安全专家那样发现真实漏洞：运行分析工具、探索周边代码、检验假设并在形成判断前权衡证据。但这种推理横跨多次模型调用，每个判定需数分钟计算，对实时筛查太慢。更快的检测器——微调深度模型或让 LLM 直接给判定——准确性不足：它们在缺乏智能体所收集上下文的情况下判断函数，且即使给出部分上下文，LLM 生成的判定也不可靠。作者提出 REVA（REal-time Vulnerability Analysis），一个把智能体检测器背后的安全上下文与代码理解组件压入 LLM 单次前向传播的 AI 漏洞检测器。对每个新函数，REVA 向 LLM 提供其模块的预计算威胁模型、轻量静态分析发现与调用图信息，并利用训练的探针读取 LLM 对新函数的内部表示。在 PrimeVul 留出测试集上，GLM-5.3-Flash 上的 REVA 每函数约一秒达到 60.0% 准确率，匹配同模型上最先进智能体检测器 VulTriage（59.2%），但快 250 倍以上、成本不足十分之一。同一提示下，探针比 LLM 自身直接判定准确 14%–17%。跨三个开源 LLM，REVA 至少与 VulTriage 相当，其中两个高出约 10%。LLM 的内部表示因此编码了智能体检测器通过推理获得的大部分信息。
summary_cn: 提出 Reva：以模块威胁模型+静态分析+调用图作上下文，用训练探针读取 LLM 内部表示判漏洞，PrimeVul 上每函数约 1 秒达 60.0% 准确率，匹配智能体检测器 VulTriage（59.2%）且快 250 倍。
objective_summary: 构建以单次前向传播加内部表示探针的实时漏洞检测器，在准确率、延迟与成本上与智能体式检测器及直接判定对照。
evidence_note: PrimeVul 留出集、三个开源 LLM、与 VulTriage 同模型对照并报告延迟/成本；60% 准确率属中等水平，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 证明 LLM 内部表示编码了智能体检测的大部分推理收益，以探针替代多轮智能体循环是机制性新思路。
scope: 结论适用于函数级 C/C++ 漏洞筛查与所测开源模型；对仓库级上下文与其他语言未验证。
limitations: 绝对准确率约 60%，需与人工复核配合；探针随模型版本需重训；上下文构造依赖静态分析质量。

title: Atomic Security Concerns: Towards a Foundational Language for Security Knowledge Representation
abstract: Cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and security architecture rely on numerous concepts, including security properties, domains, controls, risks, implementation measures, capabilities, and compliance requirements. Although these concepts are widely used, they are often represented through heterogeneous abstractions and vocabularies, making relationships among them difficult to express consistently and leaving much of the associated reasoning dependent on expert knowledge. This paper introduces the concepts of Security Concerns and Atomic Security Concerns (ASCs) and explores the hypothesis that cybersecurity knowledge may be represented through a finite set of foundational concerns. Inspired by the role of atoms in chemistry, the proposed approach views cybersecurity concepts as compositions of more fundamental concerns rather than as independent abstractions. Hence, Atomic Security Concerns could be viewed as a common abstraction layer for the representation of cybersecurity concepts, independently of their domain, nature, or level of granularity. Building upon this perspective, the paper explores how Atomic Security Concerns may provide the vocabulary of a cybersecurity language and how cybersecurity concepts may be represented as concern sets supporting explicit relationships among concepts. The contribution of this work is intentionally conceptual: it introduces a framework and research hypothesis for investigating the foundations of a common language for cybersecurity knowledge representation, reasoning, and future formalization.
title_cn: 原子安全关切：迈向安全知识表示的基础语言
abstract_cn: 网络安全治理、风险管理、合规与安全架构依赖众多概念：安全属性、域、控制、风险、实施措施、能力与合规要求。尽管广泛使用，这些概念常经由异构抽象与词汇表示，使它们之间的关系难以一致表达，大量相关推理依赖专家知识。本文引入安全关切（Security Concerns）与原子安全关切（ASC）概念，并探索一个假设：网络安全知识或可经由有限的基础关切集合表示。受化学中原子角色的启发，该方法把网络安全概念视为更基本关切的组合而非独立抽象。原子安全关切可被视为网络安全概念表示的公共抽象层，独立于其域、性质或粒度。在此视角上，本文探索 ASC 如何充当网络安全语言的词汇、网络安全概念如何被表示为支持概念间显式关系的关切集合。本工作有意保持概念性：引入一个框架与研究假设，为网络安全知识表示、推理与未来形式化的共同语言基础研究铺路。
summary_cn: 提出「原子安全关切（ASC）」概念框架：仿化学原子观把安全属性、控制、风险等概念分解为有限基础关切的组合，作为跨域统一的安全知识表示词汇；属有意的概念性工作，无形式化或实证验证。
objective_summary: 引入原子安全关切抽象并论证其作为网络安全知识公共表示层与研究假设的潜力。
evidence_note: 作者自陈贡献「有意保持概念性」，无形式化定义、实现或实证验证。
novelty_note: 原子分解的隐喻新颖但与本体的组合建模、控制框架等既有思路相近，属概念提议。
scope: 结论为研究议程设定；ASC 集合的存在性与完备性未经检验。
limitations: 无形式系统与工具支持；基础关切集合未给出；实用性未评估。

title: A Category-Selective Encryption Framework for Privacy Protection of UAV Images
abstract: Imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems increasingly raises privacy concerns, as UAV aerial surveillance routinely captures sensitive objects such as pedestrians and vehicles alongside ordinary scene content. Existing privacy-preserving approaches typically employ class-agnostic saliency detection to indiscriminately obfuscate all visually salient regions, leading to unnecessary information loss and hindering downstream scene analysis. This paper proposes a category-selective encryption framework for privacy-preserving UAV surveillance. The core advance over prior class-agnostic approaches is semantic-level selectivity: the system first recognizes what is present in the scene via an 80-class detector, then encrypts only user-specified sensitive categories while leaving non-sensitive objects and background intact for downstream analytics. The framework supports two complementary encryption schemes: Thumbnail-Preserving Encryption (TPE), which applies adaptive pixelation with a learnable blend parameter and recovers content through a jointly trained Enhanced U-Net, and XOR stream cipher encryption, which offers parameter-free, mathematically exact reversibility. The architectural design, composite loss formulation, and joint training methodology are presented in detail, establishing a foundation for practical privacy-preserving UAV surveillance that balances protection strength and scene utility.
title_cn: 面向无人机图像隐私保护的类别选择性加密框架
abstract_cn: 无人机（UAV）系统采集的影像日益引发隐私担忧：航拍监控常在普通场景内容之外捕捉行人、车辆等敏感对象。现有隐私保护方法多采用类无关的显著性检测，不加区分地混淆所有视觉显著区域，导致不必要的信息损失并妨碍下游场景分析。本文提出面向隐私保护无人机监控的类别选择性加密框架。相对既有类无关方法的核心推进是语义级选择性：系统先经由 80 类检测器识别场景内容，再只对用户指定的敏感类别加密，保留非敏感对象与背景以供下游分析。框架支持两种互补加密方案：缩略图保持加密（TPE），采用带可学习混合参数的自适应像素化并通过联合训练的增强 U-Net 恢复内容；以及 XOR 流密码加密，提供无参数、数学上精确可逆。文中详细给出架构设计、复合损失与联合训练方法，为在保护强度与场景效用间取得平衡的实用隐私保护无人机监控奠定基础。
summary_cn: 提出类别选择性 UAV 影像加密：80 类检测器先识别场景、仅加密用户指定的敏感类别（TPE 自适应像素化或 XOR 流密码可逆加密），兼顾隐私保护与下游场景分析效用；摘要未给出定量实验。
objective_summary: 构建语义选择性的无人机影像隐私保护框架，结合检测与两种可逆加密方案，并给出联合训练方法。
evidence_note: 摘要未给出定量实验结果与数据集指标，主要呈现框架设计与训练方法。
novelty_note: 把加密对象从显著区域收窄到用户指定语义类别，相对类无关方案是明确改进方向。
scope: 结论适用于可被 80 类检测器覆盖的航拍对象；检测错误会导致漏保或过保；对加密方案的密码学强度未给出安全证明。
limitations: 依赖检测器精度；XOR 流密码的密钥管理未详；无定量隐私—效用实验数据。

title: Cheap AI-Assisted Reverse Engineering and What It Will Do
abstract: Generative AI is putting the law of reverse engineering (RE) under severe strain. Existing IP and technology laws assume that RE is expensive and time-consuming, and that it requires specialized expertise. They generally allow it, but they rely on its difficulty as a filter to separate (permissible) RE from (impermissible) copying and theft. Generative AI is changing this equation by making \RE much faster, cheaper, and easier. AI systems can identify hardware components, extract firmware, decompile object code, and clone entire apps. The resulting struggle between technology vendors and reverse engineers will challenge a wide range of laws, including trade secret, copyright, anti-circumvention, computer misuse, and contract. In this article, we describe the ways in which AI is changing \RE, map these new practices onto existing laws, and sketch ways that the legal system could respond and their associated trade-offs.
title_cn: 廉价的 AI 辅助逆向工程及其将带来的影响
abstract_cn: 生成式 AI 正使逆向工程（RE）法律承受巨大压力。既有知识产权与技术法律假设 RE 昂贵、耗时且需要专门技能。它们一般允许 RE，但依赖其难度作为过滤器来区分（允许的）RE 与（不允许的）复制与窃取。生成式 AI 正在改变这一等式：它使 RE 快得多、便宜得多、容易得多。AI 系统可以识别硬件组件、提取固件、反编译目标代码并克隆整个应用。由此产生的技术厂商与逆向工程师之间的角力将挑战一系列法律，包括商业秘密、版权、反规避、计算机滥用与合同。本文描述 AI 改变 RE 的方式，把这些新实践映射到既有法律，并勾勒法律系统的可能回应及其权衡。
summary_cn: 法律分析：生成式 AI 大幅降低逆向工程成本（组件识别、固件提取、反编译、应用克隆），动摇既有法律「以 RE 难度为过滤器」的制度假设，波及商业秘密、版权、反规避、计算机滥用与合同等领域。
objective_summary: 梳理 AI 对逆向工程实践的改变，并分析其对知识产权与技术法律的冲击与可能的政策回应。
evidence_note: 法律与政策分析文章，基于案例与既有法律框架的论证，无实证测量。
novelty_note: 对 AI 降低 RE 成本的法律后果做了及时系统的梳理，但论证路线属法律评论常规。
scope: 结论主要基于美国法语境；对不同司法辖区与具体工具能力的演化敏感。
limitations: 无定量成本测量；政策建议停留在框架层面；对防御方（厂商）对策讨论有限。

title: Adversary Brains: Hypothesis-Based Logical Signatures for Threat Actor Detection with LLMs
abstract: An adversary brain is an LLM-based model of a threat actor's behavior, held as an evolving logical signature: a hypothesis with enough structure that data can test it continuously, without a person re-interpreting it each time. Rather than any single observation, such as an IoC (Indicator of Compromise), it is the arrangement that becomes a detection, or intelligence, mechanism. Where YARA matches a file and Sigma matches a log line, an adversary brain matches the activity pattern of a campaign or threat actor. This is based on an intelligence analysis technique called Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH), which the design lifts from the limitation of a few hypotheses at a time, to thousands, and then also operationalizes it for continuous detection purposes. Language models make the concept, and scale, practical: they turn prose reports into brains, judge matches, and drive the loop that keeps brains current. A partial pattern in a brain can also match a new value, such as a fresh C2 (command and control) domain name, assisting with the discovery of new indicators, and turning unknown unknowns into known unknowns, and potentially into knowns. The author would like to thank Ryan Moon for the collaboration, and Sounil Yu, Chris Inglis, Thomas Roccia, Marius Benthin, Israel Grimberg, Michal Kamensky, Justin Borland, Brandon Levene, John Hultquist, and John Bambenek for their feedback and assistance.
title_cn: 对手大脑：用 LLM 进行威胁行为者检测的基于假设的逻辑签名
abstract_cn: 对手大脑是对威胁行为者行为的基于 LLM 的模型，持有一个演化的逻辑签名：一个具有足够结构的假设，使数据可以持续检验它，而无需人工每次重新解释。与任何单一观察（如 IoC，威胁指标）不同，成为检测或情报机制的是这种排列。YARA 匹配文件、Sigma 匹配日志行，而对手大脑匹配战役或威胁行为者的活动模式。该设计基于情报分析中的竞争假设分析（ACH）技术，把它从一次几个假设的限制提升到数千个，并进一步操作化为持续检测。语言模型使该概念及其规模变得实用：它们把散文报告转成大脑、判定匹配并驱动保持大脑更新的循环。大脑中的部分模式还可以匹配新值（如新鲜的 C2 域名），协助发现新指标，把未知的未知变成已知的未知并可能成为已知。
summary_cn: 提出「对手大脑」概念：以 ACH 为基础、由 LLM 从威胁报告构建并持续检验的演化式逻辑签名，面向威胁行为者级别的活动模式匹配与新指标发现；属概念设计，无实证评估。
objective_summary: 提出以竞争假设分析为骨架、由 LLM 驱动构建与更新的威胁行为者逻辑签名概念框架，用于持续检测与指标发现。
evidence_note: 概念与设计阐述，无系统实验或部署评估；仅行业专家反馈佐证。
novelty_note: 把 ACH 与演化逻辑签名结合用于行为者级检测是新组合，但各组件（ACH、逻辑签名、LLM 抽取）均已有。
scope: 概念适用于有丰富报告语料与专家循环的威胁情报场景；未给出实现边界与失败模式。
limitations: 无实证评估；逻辑签名的误报/漂移控制未解决；依赖报告语料质量。

title: The Agent in the Middle: How AI-Mediated Access Reshapes Web Vulnerability Exploitation
abstract: Web services increasingly expose backend interfaces that let users delegate tasks to AI agents, which invoke service operations directly without navigating websites. This shift changes how existing Web vulnerabilities can be exploited. We investigate these changes through VELA, an executable benchmark covering 44 vulnerabilities across twelve Web application families. The benchmark preserves vulnerable backends and derives agent-facing interfaces from legitimate workflows. We evaluate three commercial agents across multiple interface configurations, using controlled comparisons to separate interface effects from agent behavior and independent oracles to verify attack outcomes. Our results show that the agent realizes every attack that direct interface invocation realizes in the reference configuration, so exploitability is set mainly by the interface: 91% of vulnerabilities remain exploitable under the reference design. Interface restrictions prevent some attacks by removing required operations or limiting input control, while retention remains high across vulnerability classes. No case-level loss in the reference configuration is attributed to agent refusal or input normalization, and in one case the agent completed an attack by supplying calls the attacker omitted. Across the tested configurations, interface design affects exploitability more than agent choice, moving retention from 39% to 95% against at most 4.5 points across agents, but some restrictive interfaces also limit legitimate workflows. Our study provides a systematic empirical account of how agent-mediated access reshapes existing Web vulnerabilities, grounding future Web architecture design in measured security outcomes and trade-offs between reducing attack exposure and preserving legitimate functionality in agent-facing services.
title_cn: 中间的智能体：AI 介入访问如何重塑 Web 漏洞利用
abstract_cn: Web 服务日益暴露让用户把任务委托给 AI 智能体的后端接口，智能体直接调用服务操作而无需浏览网站。这种转变改变了既有 Web 漏洞被利用的方式。作者通过 VELA——一个覆盖十二个 Web 应用家族 44 个漏洞的可执行基准——研究这些变化。该基准保留易受攻击后端，并从合法工作流派生智能体接口。评估三个商业智能体在多种接口配置下的表现，用受控比较分离接口效应与智能体行为，并用独立 oracle 验证攻击结果。结果显示：在参考配置下，智能体实现直接接口调用所能实现的一切攻击，可利用性主要由接口决定——91% 的漏洞在参考设计下仍可利用。接口限制通过移除所需操作或限制输入控制阻止部分攻击，但各漏洞类别的保留率都高。参考配置下没有案例级损失归因于智能体拒绝或输入规范化，一个案例中智能体甚至通过补齐攻击者遗漏的调用完成攻击。跨被测配置，接口设计对可利用性的影响大于智能体选择：保留率从 39% 到 95%，而智能体间差异至多 4.5 个点；但部分限制性接口也限制合法工作流。本研究提供 AI 介入访问如何重塑既有 Web 漏洞的系统实证，为面向智能体的服务在减少攻击暴露与保留合法功能之间的架构设计提供度量基础。
summary_cn: 以可执行基准 VELA（12 应用家族 44 漏洞）量化智能体介入的 Web 漏洞利用：参考接口下 91% 漏洞仍可被三个商业智能体利用，接口设计使保留率在 39%–95% 间变动而智能体间差异至多 4.5 点。
objective_summary: 构建保留易受攻击后端、派生智能体接口的基准 VELA，系统测量接口配置与商业智能体对既有 Web 漏洞可利用性的影响。
evidence_note: 44 漏洞 ×12 家族的可执行基准、三个商业智能体、受控接口比较与独立 oracle 验证，量化结论明确。
novelty_note: 首次系统测量「智能体作为访问中介」对既有 Web 漏洞可利用性的重塑，指出接口设计而非模型行为是决定因素。
scope: 结论适用于暴露任务委托接口的 Web 服务与被测三类智能体；对多智能体协作与浏览器自动化路径未覆盖。
limitations: 44 漏洞样本与十二家族的覆盖有限；接口配置集有限；未评估防御性接口的成本最优设计。

title: JANUS: Synthesizing Cross-Layer Defenses Against Web Deserialization Attacks
abstract: Unsafe deserialization turns untrusted data into attacker-controlled execution, and a single vulnerability can admit diverse exploit variants that evade defenses tailored to a known exploit. Existing defenses typically operate at a single enforcement point with limited visibility into the full attack. Combining controls across layers offers complementary protection, but coordinating them to preserve legitimate functionality and adapting them to new variants requires substantial expert effort. We propose JANUS, a red-blue adversarial framework for automated cross-layer defense synthesis. Starting from a known exploit, \sys iteratively refines deployment-specific policies in an isolated offline environment. A black-box attacker probes the current policy for exploit variants using only externally observable feedback. The defender summarizes each verified variant into its security-relevant effects, uses counterfactual replay to separate complementary coverage from redundant enforcement, and jointly selects and scopes controls across layers. Each candidate policy is validated against accumulated exploits and benign workflows. We evaluate JANUS on sixteen vulnerability deployments across six Java and PHP applications against gateway, application, system, and cross-layer defenses. JANUS reduces held-out attack success to 6.2%, compared with 18.8-55.0% for the baselines, fully mitigates 13 of 16 deployments, and preserves 98.4% of benign functionality tests at a 6.9% targeted P95 latency increase.
title_cn: JANUS：针对 Web 反序列化攻击的跨层防御综合
abstract_cn: 不安全的反序列化把不可信数据变成攻击者可控的执行，单个漏洞即可容纳多样利用变体以逃过针对已知利用定制的防御。现有防御通常在单一执行点运行，对完整攻击可见性有限。跨层组合控制提供互补保护，但协调它们以保留合法功能并适应新变体需要大量专家工作。作者提出 JANUS，一个自动化跨层防御综合的红蓝对抗框架。从已知利用出发，JANUS 在隔离离线环境中迭代精炼部署特定策略：黑盒攻击者仅用外部可观察反馈探测当前策略以寻找利用变体；防御者把每个经验证的变体总结为其安全相关效应，用反事实重放分离互补覆盖与冗余执行，并跨层联合选择与界定控制。每个候选策略都对照累积利用与良性工作流验证。在六个 Java 与 PHP 应用的十六个漏洞部署上评估，对照网关、应用、系统与跨层防御。JANUS 把留出攻击成功率降到 6.2%（基线 18.8–55.0%），完全缓解 16 个部署中的 13 个，保留 98.4% 良性功能测试，目标 P95 延迟增加 6.9%。
summary_cn: 提出红蓝对抗式跨层防御综合框架 JANUS：以利用变体探测与反事实重放联合选配网关/应用/系统控制，16 个漏洞部署上留出攻击成功率 6.2%（基线 18.8–55.0%），13/16 完全缓解，良性功能保留 98.4%。
objective_summary: 构建自动化探索利用变体并跨层组合防御控制的对抗框架，在多应用部署上量化留出攻击成功率、功能保留与延迟开销。
evidence_note: 6 应用 ×16 部署的系统评估，多类基线对照、留出攻击与良性功能/延迟三指标完整。
novelty_note: 以变体总结+反事实重放驱动的自动化跨层防御选配为实质性新机制，超越单点防御调优。
scope: 结论适用于反序列化类漏洞与可策略化的 Java/PHP 栈；其他漏洞类别与语言需扩展效果库。
limitations: 从已知利用起步，对全新漏洞类别依赖初始种子；策略验证在离线环境；延迟开销随控制数量上升。

title: PRISMA: Differentially Private Synthetic In-Car Telemetry via Differentiable Simulation
abstract: Differentially private synthesis of in-car energy consumption data is challenging because the output is high-dimensional, and known lower bounds show that the privacy-utility trade-off degrades with the square root of the number of output dimensions. However, we observe that the intrinsic dimensionality of in-car energy consumption is much lower than that of the raw trace: given a small set of contextual personal variables-such as start point, end point, the car model, and the driving behavior-the consumption profile can be largely explained by publicly available map data (including elevation) combined with a physical model of vehicle energy use. We exploit this low intrinsic dimensionality in PRISMA, a Privacy-preserving In-car Synthesis and Modelling Algorithm. PRISMA involves three stages: (i) energy consumption traces are encoded into a low-dimensional latent space; (ii) the distribution of latent vectors is synthesized using the differentially private tabular data synthesis algorithm AIM, and (iii) samples drawn from this distribution are decoded back into full energy consumption traces via a differentiable physics-based simulation, a step that consumes no additional privacy budget since it uses only public information. By using a compact, physically-grounded latent representation of the traces, PRISMA significantly reduces the effective output dimension. Our experimental results show that PRISMA achieves for a competitive $\varepsilon = 0.5$ a better data synthesis performance than prior tabular and marginal-based DP synthesis baselines by preserving the diversity of the original power consumption profiles without collapsing to a small set of modes.
title_cn: PRISMA：通过可微仿真生成差分隐私的车内遥测合成数据
abstract_cn: 车内能耗数据的差分隐私合成颇具挑战，因为输出是高维的，且已知下界表明隐私—效用权衡随输出维数的平方根退化。但作者观察到车内能耗的内在维数远低于原始轨迹：给定少量上下文个人变量——起点、终点、车型与驾驶行为——能耗曲线可由公开地图数据（含海拔）加车辆能耗物理模型大幅解释。PRISMA（Privacy-preserving In-car Synthesis and Modelling Algorithm）利用该低内在维数，分三阶段：(i) 把能耗轨迹编码进低维潜空间；(ii) 用差分隐私表格合成算法 AIM 合成潜向量分布；(iii) 经可微物理仿真把分布样本解码回完整能耗轨迹——该步只用公开信息、不消耗额外隐私预算。通过紧凑、物理锚定的轨迹潜表示，PRISMA 显著降低有效输出维数。实验显示，PRISMA 在有竞争力的 ε=0.5 下取得优于既有表格与边际式 DP 合成基线的合成性能，在保持原始功耗曲线多样性的同时不坍缩到少数模式。
summary_cn: 提出 PRISMA：把能耗轨迹压入物理锚定的低维潜空间、用 DP 算法 AIM 合成、再经可微物理仿真解码（不耗预算），在 ε=0.5 下优于表格与边际式 DP 基线且保持功耗曲线多样性。
objective_summary: 利用车内能耗的低内在维数与公开物理模型，构建三阶段差分隐私合成管线并对比既有 DP 合成基线的效用与多样性。
evidence_note: 与表格/边际式 DP 基线的对比实验（ε=0.5）；数据集与指标细节摘要未全披露，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 以「公开物理模型承担解码、只对潜分布付预算」的降维思路实质改善高维 DP 合成，机制上有新意。
scope: 结论适用于可由上下文变量与物理模型解释的时序能耗类数据；对无物理锚定的高维数据泛化未知。
limitations: 依赖地图与车辆模型的公开质量；潜空间编码误差；仅评估能耗遥测任务。

title: Then there is prompt injection, a malicious email, ...: The Wild Wide West of OpenClaw Agentic System Security
abstract: AI-powered personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw combine LLM reasoning, persistent memory, tool invocation, local execution, and web-based workflows. These capabilities enable useful automation, but they also create security risks when untrusted inputs, model reasoning, tools, memory, and deployment configuration interact without explicit trust boundaries. This paper presents an empirical study of reported security concerns in OpenClaw using two complementary data sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. We analyze more than 25K Reddit posts from 13 OpenClaw-related subreddits and identify 162 security-relevant posts with 1,787 associated comments. We further collect 358 security-tagged GitHub issues and retain 180 issues describing concrete security concerns. Using qualitative analysis and evidence-grounded CWE mapping, we identify 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct weakness types, concentrated in access-control failures, sensitive-data exposure, injection, and unsafe execution. We also extract 543 practitioner mitigation suggestions and consolidate them into seven recurring strategies. To complement the empirical analysis, we present an evidence-grounded illustrative reconstruction of a representative sensitive-data exposure pathway using dummy secret values. Our findings show that OpenClaw security issues are not isolated implementation bugs; they reflect recurring trust-boundary failures across the agent execution pipeline. We discuss how these weaknesses map to both traditional software-security categories and agent-specific failure mechanisms, and derive implications for safer agentic systems, including explicit trust boundaries, least-privilege tool access, execution containment, runtime oversight, and defense-in-depth deployment.
title_cn: 「然后是提示注入，一封恶意邮件……」：OpenClaw 智能体系统安全的狂野西部
abstract_cn: OpenClaw 等 AI 个人助理框架结合 LLM 推理、持久记忆、工具调用、本地执行与 Web 工作流。这些能力支撑有用的自动化，但当不可信输入、模型推理、工具、记忆与部署配置在没有显式信任边界的情况下交互时，也带来安全风险。本文对 OpenClaw 已报告的安全关切做实证研究，数据来自两个互补来源：Reddit 讨论与带安全标签的 GitHub issue。作者分析来自 13 个 OpenClaw 相关 subreddits 的 25,000 多条帖子，识别 162 条安全相关帖子与 1,787 条相关评论；进一步收集 358 个安全标签 GitHub issue 并保留 180 个描述具体安全关切的 issue。通过定性分析与有据可依的 CWE 映射，识别横跨 59 种弱点类型的 521 个 CWE 实例，集中于访问控制失效、敏感数据暴露、注入与不安全执行；并提取 543 条从业者缓解建议，归纳为七种复现策略。作为补充，用哑密钥值对一个代表性敏感数据暴露路径做有据的示意性重建。发现表明 OpenClaw 的安全问题不是孤立的实现 bug，而是横跨智能体执行管线的复现性信任边界失效。文章讨论这些弱点与传统软件安全类别及智能体特有失效机制的映射，并导出更安全智能体系统的启示：显式信任边界、最小权限工具访问、执行遏制、运行时监督与纵深防御部署。
summary_cn: 对 OpenClaw 的安全关切做大规模实证：25K Reddit 帖中 162 条安全相关、180 个 GitHub issue，映射出 59 类共 521 个 CWE 实例（集中于访问控制、数据暴露、注入与不安全执行），归纳 7 种从业者缓解策略。
objective_summary: 以 Reddit 与 GitHub 双源数据定性刻画 OpenClaw 生态的真实安全关切，做证据支撑的 CWE 映射与缓解策略归纳。
evidence_note: 25K 帖 +358 issue 的实地语料、双源交叉、CWE 映射有证据标注；定性为主、无受控验证。
novelty_note: 首个对 OpenClaw 用户生态安全问题的系统实证梳理，提供智能体特有失效的野外证据。
scope: 结论反映社区报告的关切而非穷尽漏洞清单；对其他智能体框架的推广需另行验证。
limitations: 自选偏倚（主动报告者）；CWE 映射含定性判断；未独立复现全部关切。

title: Trim: Fee Level Matters More Than Skew in Lightning Routing
abstract: Lightning routing nodes lend their channel balance for a posted fee. Operators' tools move that fee with the balance around a hand-set level, and which part of the fee drives revenue is unclear. We present Trim, which models a channel as a two-sided inventory with costly refills. Its optimal fee is a level, set by demand and replenishment, plus a balance skew, the shadow price of liquidity. The level is first order: no fee rule beats the ceiling demand and replenishment set, and on exactly solved channels the best flat fee comes within $1.6\%$ of the optimum at the median, whereas a level off by a factor of two loses tens of percent. The skew is second-order insurance: it adds at most what the flow-balancing flat fee loses to refused forwards. So the level should be chosen: Trim's rule traces the revenue--success frontier, posts one level on every channel, and adds a skew only where refills stay frequent and costly. On a 2026 snapshot with synthetic payments, no tuned tool beats that frontier by over a few percent, and a skew changes gross revenue by a few percent.
title_cn: Trim：闪电网络路由中费率水平比余额偏斜更重要
abstract_cn: 闪电网络路由节点为公布的费率出借其通道余额。运营者工具让费率围绕手工设定的水平随余额移动，但费的哪部分驱动收入并不清楚。作者提出 Trim，把通道建模为有成本补充的两边库存：其最优费率是一个水平（由需求与补货决定）加一个余额偏斜（流动性的影子价格）。水平是第一位的：任何费率规则都无法超越需求与补货设定的上限，且在精确求解的通道上，最优平费在中位数处距最优不足 1.6%，而水平错两倍损失数十个百分点。偏斜是第二位的保险：其增益至多为流动平衡平费因拒绝转发所损失的量。因此应先选水平：Trim 规则追踪收入—成功前沿、在每个通道公布一个水平，仅在补货频繁且昂贵处加偏斜。在 2026 年快照与合成支付上，没有调优工具在该前沿上胜出超过几个百分点，偏斜对总收入的影响也只有几个百分点。
summary_cn: 把闪电通道费建模为带成本补货的两边库存：最优费率由「水平」主导（平费距最优中位仅 1.6%，水平错两倍损失数十点），余额偏斜仅值几个百分点，Trim 规据据此单水平定价并逼近收入—成功前沿。
objective_summary: 以两边库存模型推导通道费率的最优结构（水平+偏斜），量化两成分的贡献并给出可操作的单水平定价规则与快照验证。
evidence_note: 精确求解通道上的解析比较与 2026 快照加合成支付的工具对比；支付为合成、未用在野支付负载。
novelty_note: 「水平一阶、偏斜二阶」的分解与可操作费率规则对运营实践有新指导意义。
scope: 结论适用于单通道定价决策与当前网络拓扑；对合谋路由、泛滥攻击等对抗行为未建模。
limitations: 合成支付假设流量平稳；补货成本估计含主观性；多通道联合优化未解决。

title: False-Alarm Improvements and Detection Trade-Offs in QML Intrusion Detection: A Secondary Analysis of the Kaissar Corpus
abstract: Published results in quantum machine learning for intrusion detection (QML-IDS) require joint interpretation of false-positive rate (FPR), attack true-positive rate (TPR), and evaluation provenance. We reconstruct operating points in the 25-entry frame selected by Kaissar and colleagues: 21 included articles, 20 identified documentary families, substantive methodological material consulted for 15, and 24 descriptive points from five. In one test-labelled comparison, a quantum support vector machine reduces FPR from 6.875% for random forest to 3.329%, while TPR decreases from 93.955% to 93.682%; both rates improve against three other comparators. In another study, a complete benign row identifies FPR as 12/6000 (0.200%), despite incomplete attack-side allocation that requires additional assumptions for TPR. Normalized matrices identify detection ranges rather than a unique aggregate rate. A uniform provenance rule separates training-described and test-adjusted results from six conditional illustrations whose independence remains unverified. The contribution is a reproducible interpretation of favorable comparisons and detection trade-offs, without converting descriptive results or hypothetical calculations into operational guarantees.
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Supplementary material (15 pages) is available as an ancillary file. Reproducibility artifact: this https URL
title_cn: QML 入侵检测中的误报改进与检测权衡：Kaissar 语料的二次分析
abstract_cn: 量子机器学习入侵检测（QML-IDS）的已发表结果需要联合解读误报率（FPR）、攻击真阳性率（TPR）与评估来源。作者重建 Kaissar 等人选择的 25 条目框架中的工作点：21 篇纳入文章、20 个可识别文献家族、15 个查阅了实质性方法学材料、5 个仅得 24 个描述性点。在一项测试标注比较中，量子支持向量机把随机森林 6.875% 的 FPR 降到 3.329%，而 TPR 从 93.955% 降到 93.682%；对其他三个比较对象两率均改善。在另一研究中，一个完整良性行把 FPR 识别为 12/6000（0.200%），尽管攻击侧分配不完整、TPR 需附加假设。归一化矩阵给出检测范围而非唯一聚合率。统一来源规则把「训练中描述」与「测试时调整」的结果与六个独立性未经验证的条件性说明分开。本贡献是对有利比较与检测权衡的可复现解读，而不把描述性结果或假设计算转成运行性保证。
summary_cn: 对 Kaissar QML-IDS 语料做可复现二次分析：QSVM 相对随机森林把 FPR 从 6.875% 降至 3.329% 但 TPR 微降（93.955%→93.682%），并区分训练描述与测试调整结果，强调描述性数字不能当作运行性保证。
objective_summary: 重建已发表 QML-IDS 比较的混淆矩阵与工作点，按证据来源分层解读误报/真阳权衡并发布可复现工件。
evidence_note: 25 条目逐项重建、来源分层规则与可复现工件；依赖原文献报告完整性，部分点需附加假设。
novelty_note: 对 QML-IDS 文献的乐观比较给出系统化、可复现的批判性解读，含负面性澄清。
scope: 结论限于该 25 条目语料与其文献家族；不否定 QML-IDS 的全部潜在价值。
limitations: 部分原文数据不完整，TPR 推断需假设；无新实验；语料规模小。

title: Can Open Be Too Open? On the Security and Trustworthiness of Fully Transparent LLMs
abstract: There are different levels of transparency for LLMs: open weights, open data, and/or open pipeline. Recently, more interest has emerged in fully transparent LLMs, i.e., LLMs with fully open weights, data, and training pipeline. Drawing analogies to other fields such as software security, it is often believed that increasing transparency inherently increases the security and trustworthiness of the LLM. However, we argue that such claims need to be critically re-evaluated in the context of LLMs. In this paper, we analyze the impact of transparency on LLM security and trustworthiness by reviewing the relevant literature. Our core findings are that, due to the limited reproducibility of LLM pipelines, in practice, users cannot verify the correspondence between open weights and the associated open data and pipeline. Thus, in order to trust a model, users still need to trust that developers acted honestly, reducing the benefits over models that provide less "transparency". Moreover, we find that even when LLMs are fully transparent and trusted, this openness can favor adversaries. Open weights in particular, but also open data and pipelines, can increase the success rate of attacks. Although the same mechanisms can be used to improve the model and protect it against attacks, the current lack of robust lightweight mechanisms to patch LLM vulnerabilities limits the benefits of openness at this time. We note that our analysis is based on current LLM capabilities and analysis tools, and that future developments may require a re-evaluation of these points.
title_cn: 开放会否过于开放？论完全透明 LLM 的安全与可信性
abstract_cn: LLM 有不同透明度层级：开放权重、开放数据和/或开放管线。近来对完全透明 LLM——权重、数据与训练管线全开放——的兴趣增长。借鉴软件安全等领域，人们常认为提高透明度天然提升 LLM 的安全与可信。但作者主张此类论断在 LLM 语境下需被批判性重估。本文通过综述相关文献分析透明度对 LLM 安全与可信的影响。核心发现：由于 LLM 管线的可复现性有限，实践中用户无法验证开放权重与所配套开放数据、管线的对应关系；因此要信任模型，用户仍须信任开发者诚实行事，相较「较少透明」的模型收益被削减。还发现即便 LLM 完全透明且可信，开放也可能有利于对手：开放权重尤其、开放数据与管线也会提高攻击成功率。尽管相同机制可用于改进模型与抵御攻击，但目前缺乏轻量的 LLM 漏洞修补机制限制了开放的现实收益。该分析基于当前 LLM 能力与分析工具，未来进展可能要求重估这些结论。
summary_cn: 立场论文：由于管线复现性有限，开放权重/数据/管线并不能让用户验证其对应关系，信任仍归结为对开发者的信任；且开放权重等会提高攻击成功率，轻量修补机制缺位进一步限制开放的安全收益。
objective_summary: 综述并分析完全透明 LLM 在可验证性与攻防两侧的影响，论证透明度与安全可信之间的非平凡关系。
evidence_note: 文献综合与论证性分析，无新实验；论据为可复现性限制与已知攻击面。
novelty_note: 对「透明即安全」的行业默认给出系统性反驳，视角有澄清价值但论点多取自已有机理。
scope: 结论基于当前 LLM 能力与工具生态；轻量修补机制的进展可能改变权衡。
limitations: 无实证测量；对开放生态的防御性收益刻画较粗；政策建议不展开。

title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
abstract: AI systems built around large models increasingly use experience and feedback to make persistent changes to models, prompts, memories, tools, and workflows. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) extends this process to inductive biases and to the mechanisms that govern future updates, which can themselves be revised and reused across improvement cycles. Yet self-modification alone does not guarantee trustworthy improvement. Reported gains may reflect flawed evaluations, previously acquired capabilities may deteriorate, and compliance with behavioral constraints may weaken. Compromised artifacts or sensitive information may also persist in successor systems. Changes to improvement mechanisms may invalidate earlier verification results and make human oversight less effective. This survey presents an operational definition and process framework for RSI and organizes the requirements for trustworthy RSI into four interconnected themes: genuine and sustained improvement; behavioral constraints, alignment, and fairness; system security and privacy; and transparency and controllability. We examine these themes from three perspectives: Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, and Effective Oversight. This analysis covers improvement diagnosis, proposal generation, proposal evaluation, and update implementation (S1--S4), including the recursive application of these stages to improvement mechanisms (RI). We review risks, safeguards, and evaluation evidence for individual updates, effects inherited by successor systems, and revisions to improvement mechanisms, while distinguishing direct RSI findings from evidence in related systems. Finally, we examine evaluation settings, identify requirements for independent and longitudinal assessment, and discuss applications and open research problems.
title_cn: 大模型时代的可信递归自我改进：基础、风险、评估与开放挑战
abstract_cn: 围绕大模型构建的 AI 系统日益利用经验与反馈对模型、提示、记忆、工具与工作流做持久更改。递归自我改进（RSI）把该过程扩展到归纳偏置与治理未来更新的机制——这些机制本身可在改进循环中被修订与复用。然而自我修改并不自动保证可信改进：报告的收益可能源于有缺陷的评估，既有能力可能退化，对行为约束的遵从可能减弱，被攻陷工件或敏感信息也可能在后续系统中持续存在，改进机制的更改可能使早先的验证失效并削弱人类监督。本综述给出 RSI 的操作性定义与过程框架，把可信 RSI 的要求组织为四个相互关联主题：真实且持续的改进；行为约束、对齐与公平；系统安全与隐私；透明与可控。作者从改进有效性、约束保持与有效监督三个视角审视，覆盖提案生成、评估与更新实施（S1–S4）及其向改进机制本身的递归应用（RI），检视个体更新、后续系统继承效应与机制修订的风险、保障与评估证据，并区分直接的 RSI 发现与相关系统证据。最后检视评估设置，提出独立与纵向评估的要求，并讨论应用与开放问题。
summary_cn: 综述递归自我改进（RSI）的可信性：给出操作性定义与 S1–S4/RI 过程框架，按改进有效性、约束保持、有效监督三视角组织风险与保障，指出评估缺陷、能力退化与验证失效等核心问题及开放挑战。
objective_summary: 系统梳理递归自我改进的定义、流程与可信性要求，整合风险、保障与评估证据并识别独立纵向评估的缺口。
evidence_note: 系统组织四主题与三视角的文献综合，含过程框架；未做新的实验证据，直接 RSI 实证稀少（作者亦指出）。
novelty_note: 把 RSI 作为可操作研究对象的框架化梳理在该领域尚属较早，结构（S1–S4/RI）有组织价值。
scope: 结论为概念与文献层面；不依赖特定模型或系统；随技术演进而需更新。
limitations: 直接可用实证有限，多从相关系统外推；分类框架含主观性；无量化基准。

title: SoK: Timestamps Are Not a Time Model: Rethinking Temporal Reasoning in Host-Based Intrusion Detection
abstract: Host-based intrusion detectors order events, window audit streams and sequence attack stages by their timestamps. Every conclusion they draw therefore rests on assumptions about clocks, delivery, entity identity and the integrity of the evidence, and most of these assumptions go unstated. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) makes them explicit. Drawing on temporal databases, stream processing and runtime verification, we distill five components of a time model, together with a checklist of evidence assumptions and four levels of guarantee, and walk through a running campaign with them. A documented search yields fifteen families of detection and investigation. For papers selected by screening role and period, plus named systems and landmarks, we check the stated assumptions in the full texts, and we assess eleven temporal knowledge representation and reasoning (KRR) formalisms and a learned baseline on nine attack patterns. Some early alert correlators stated clock and delivery assumptions, and forensics measures clock error. Current provenance-based detectors state no clock bound. Four audited papers describe input-ordering conditions or conventions, but none specifies conditions for conclusion validity across a stated class of delivery failures. In the selected provenance-based systems, campaign composition uses system-specific procedures or objectives, learned state, causal graph queries or language models, and beyond CEP-based query systems, we found no temporal rule language or stream reasoner from KRR applied to host audit data. In 28 of 38 audited provenance-era detector papers, capture or stored evidence is trusted or its manipulation is placed out of scope, and none says which conclusions survive deleted, delayed or forged records. Five open challenges follow from these gaps.
comment: Extended version with full appendices (search method, KRR domain analysis, rating evidence, formalizations). 51 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables. Artifacts: doi:https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23530002
title_cn: SoK：时间戳不是时间模型——反思基于主机的入侵检测中的时间推理
abstract_cn: 基于主机的入侵检测器按时间戳排序事件、切窗审计流、按阶段排序攻击。它们得出的每个结论因此都建立在对时钟、投递、实体身份与证据完整性的假设之上，而多数假设从未被言明。本系统化（SoK）将其显式化。借鉴时态数据库、流处理与运行时验证，作者提炼时间模型的五个组件、证据假设清单与四级保证，并以一场持续攻击的运行示例贯穿。一次有据可查的检索得到十五族检测与调查工作。对按筛选角色与时期选择的论文加上具名系统与地标，核查全文中陈述的假设，并在九个攻击模式上评估十一个时态知识表示与推理（KRR）形式及一个学习基线。一些早期告警关联器陈述了时钟与投递假设，取证工作度量时钟误差。当前基于溯源的检测器未陈述任何时钟界。四篇被审论文描述输入排序条件或约定，但没有一篇规定跨越既定投递失效类的结论有效条件。在被选的基于溯源的系统中，攻击战役组装使用系统特定程序或目标、学习状态、因果图查询或语言模型；除 CEP 查询系统外，没有发现任何 KRR 时态规则语言或流推理器被应用于主机审计数据。在被审的 38 篇溯源时代检测器论文中，28 篇信任采集或存储证据、或把其操纵置于范围之外，且无一说明哪些结论在记录被删除、延迟或伪造后仍然成立。由这些缺口引出五个开放挑战。
summary_cn: 系统化主机入侵检测的时间假设：38 篇溯源时代论文中 28 篇信任采集证据且无一说明结论在记录被删/延迟/伪造后是否成立，提出时间模型五组件、假设清单与四级保证及五个开放挑战。
objective_summary: 为基于主机的入侵检测建立显式时间模型与证据假设框架，系统审读 15 族检测器与 KRR 形式化的适配情况，指出可信证据等系统性缺口。
evidence_note: 有据可查的检索方法、38 篇全文审计、11 种 KRR 形式 ×9 攻击模式评估，工件存档于 Zenodo。
novelty_note: 首次为 HIDS 显式化时间模型与证据假设层级，揭示「时间戳≠时间模型」的结构性盲区。
scope: 结论覆盖主机审计与溯源检测文献的代表性样本；对网络级 IDS 与其他审计源需另行分析。
limitations: 筛选取样的覆盖有限；KRR 评估依赖所选攻击模式；不提出新检测系统。

title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
abstract: Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.
title_cn: CoSA：真实世界 LLM 智能体生态中的技能冲突攻击
abstract_cn: 智能体技能（Skills）允许 LLM 智能体组合可复用能力，但逐个孤立检查技能无法排除其组合后的策略违规。作者把此类失效命名为技能冲突（Conflict of Skills, CoS）：为某一目的产出的工件或评估信号被下游复用而未保留其新用途所需的限制或授权。使用公开技能的受控执行与匹配的单技能对照，识别 CoS 背后的四种复现机制。在此基础上提出技能冲突攻击（CoSA）：向既有技能池添加本地准入技能以补足缺失业务操作（能力补充）或重塑工件交换、决策复用与目标/动作绑定（关系重塑），而保持既有技能与运行时权限不变。为在自主技能选择下评估该威胁，构建 CoSA-Bench：由真实技能与受控服务构成，覆盖招聘、金融、IT 与商业的 288 个任务，涉及数据泄露、未授权状态修改与不安全执行。在五个 LLM 与三个智能体 harness 上，上限为原池 5% 的技能添加把策略违规率从 35.02% 提高到 58.45%（+23.43 个百分点）。轨迹分析把合规到违规的转变与涉及新增技能的跨技能依赖联系起来。进一步开发检查信息流与授权的轻量 harness 级守卫：在五模型的 OpenClaw 招聘任务上把违规从 65.28% 降到 6.67%，而匹配良性对照上的合规任务完成率从 66.67% 变到 65.00%。
summary_cn: 提出技能冲突攻击 CoSA：仅添加上限 5% 的新技能使五个 LLM ×三个 harness 的策略违规率从 35.02% 升至 58.45%（288 任务基准），harness 级信息流守卫把 OpenClaw 违规从 65.28% 压到 6.67% 且良性完成率几乎不变。
objective_summary: 定义并系统验证技能组合性冲突威胁，构建 CoSA-Bench 量化技能添加对违规率的影响，并提出 harness 级信息流/授权守卫作为防御。
evidence_note: 288 任务基准、5 LLM ×3 harness 的受控添加实验、机制轨迹分析加守卫的攻防两侧量化（65.28%→6.67%，良性 66.67%→65.00%）。
novelty_note: 「技能单独无害、组合违规」的 CoS 威胁模型与四机制分类为新问题定义，攻防证据链完整。
scope: 结论适用于自主技能选择的智能体框架与可组合技能生态；对强类型权限模型或技能签名机制的部署效果未测。
limitations: 守卫在 harness 层，无法约束绕过 harness 的执行；基准任务域有限；违规判定含 LLM 评估成分。

title: GuardRAG: A Post-Retrieval Defense against Poisoning Attacks in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external evidence, but also exposes them to corpus poisoning attacks. In particular, coordinated attacks can introduce multiple mutually reinforcing poisoned documents into retrieved contexts, making reliable evidence filtering challenging. To address this problem, we propose GuardRAG, a training-free and plug-and-play post-retrieval defense that exploits the semantic structure of retrieved evidence to identify suspicious document groups. Specifically, GuardRAG first expands the retrieval range and removes near-duplicate candidates, then partitions the retained documents using Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (HAC) with a query-adaptive threshold. Finally, it scores and prunes suspicious clusters based on query relevance, cluster size, and semantic compactness. Experiments across three question-answering datasets, multiple poisoning attacks, and six LLMs demonstrate that GuardRAG substantially reduces attack success rates while maintaining answer utility under clean retrieval.
comment: 8 figures
title_cn: GuardRAG：面向检索增强生成投毒攻击的检索后防御
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过纳入外部证据增强大语言模型（LLM）的事实基础，但也使其暴露于语料投毒攻击。特别是协调攻击可引入多个相互强化的投毒文档进入检索上下文，使可靠证据过滤变得困难。为解决该问题，作者提出 GuardRAG，一种免训练、即插即用的检索后防御，利用检索证据的语义结构识别可疑文档组。GuardRAG 先扩展检索范围并移除近似重复候选，再用带查询自适应阈值的层次凝聚聚类（HAC）划分保留文档，最后基于查询相关性、簇大小与语义紧凑度对可疑簇打分并剪枝。跨三个问答数据集、多种投毒攻击与六个 LLM 的实验表明，GuardRAG 大幅降低攻击成功率，同时在干净检索下保持答案效用。
summary_cn: 提出免训练检索后防御 GuardRAG：扩检+去重+查询自适应 HAC 聚类+簇级打分剪枝，在 3 个 QA 数据集、多种投毒攻击与 6 个 LLM 上显著降低攻击成功率并保持干净效用。
objective_summary: 以检索证据的簇结构为单位识别协同投毒文档并剪枝，构建免训练即插即用的检索后防御并在多数据集、多攻击、多模型上验证。
evidence_note: 3 数据集 ×多攻击 ×6 LLM 的系统评估；摘要未给具体数字与统计检验，基线对照细节未披露。
novelty_note: 从逐文档过滤转向簇级协同投毒识别是合理增量，聚类与打分组件均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于问答型 RAG 与可聚类化的投毒分布；对高度分散的单点投毒与多跳检索场景未验证。
limitations: 聚类阈值查询自适应但需调参；簇级剪枝可能误删相关证据；计算开销随检索宽度增长。

title: Steering for Safety, Hijacking for Profit: Trojan Threats in the LLM Activation Steering Supply Chain
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into Web search, online recommendation, and intelligent decision-making, the third-party plugin ecosystem centered on model customization continues to grow. Among these, Steering Vectors guide model behavior by intervening in internal representations. However, the open plugin ecosystem also introduces new supply-chain security risks: malicious plugins can disguise themselves as having legitimate functionality and covertly manipulate outputs without significantly affecting model performance. Although this risk poses a real threat, the security issues of Steering plugins in the LLM supply-chain ecosystem still lack systematic research. This paper audits eight mainstream open-source Steering plugin libraries and reveals three structural vulnerabilities: insufficient distribution integrity verification, excessive plugin privileges, and missing runtime monitoring, which offers an attack surface for attackers. To investigate this threat, we propose a malicious plugin, IDH. Specifically, IDH designs a norm-gated mutually exclusive routing mechanism and proposes an information-decay inflection point localization method to automatically select the injection layer, thereby simultaneously achieving benign and malicious functions. To counter such threats, we propose a runtime defense framework, by suppressing anomalous activation interventions and orthogonalizing inter-layer trajectory. We evaluate IDH across five mainstream LLMs, using safety-refusal steering as the legitimate functionality and commercial recommendation manipulation as the hijack objective. Experiments covering six brands across three commercial domains demonstrate that IDH achieves an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 97.8% while preserving high refusal rates on harmful requests.
title_cn: 为安全转向，为获利劫持：LLM 激活转向供应链中的木马威胁
abstract_cn: 随着 LLM 日益接入 Web 搜索、在线推荐与智能决策，以模型定制为中心的第三方插件生态持续扩张。其中，Steering Vectors 通过干预内部表示引导模型行为。但开放插件生态也引入新的供应链安全风险：恶意插件可伪装成具有合法功能，在不显著影响模型性能的情况下隐蔽操纵输出。尽管该威胁真实存在，LLM 供应链生态中 Steering 插件的安全问题仍缺乏系统研究。本文审计八个主流开源 Steering 插件库，揭示三个结构性漏洞：分发完整性校验不足、插件权限过大、运行时监控缺失，为攻击者提供攻击面。为研究该威胁，作者提出恶意插件 IDH：设计范数门互斥路由机制并提出信息衰减拐点定位方法自动选择注入层，从而同时实现良性功能与恶意功能。针对此类威胁，提出运行时防御框架，通过抑制异常激活干预与层间轨迹正交化。在五个主流 LLM 上评估 IDH，以安全拒绝转向为合法功能、以商业推荐操纵为劫持目标。覆盖三个商业领域六个品牌的实验显示，IDH 攻击成功率（ASR）高达 97.8%，同时对有害请求保持高拒绝率。
summary_cn: 审计 8 个开源 Steering 插件库发现完整性校验、权限与监控三类结构性漏洞，提出恶意插件 IDH：范数门路由加拐点选层，5 个 LLM ×3 领域 6 品牌上 ASR 高达 97.8% 且保持安全拒绝率，并给出运行时防御。
objective_summary: 系统审计激活转向插件生态的供应链弱点，构造具备合法/恶意双功能的恶意插件并量化其隐蔽劫持能力，同时提出抑制异常干预的运行时防御。
evidence_note: 8 库审计加 5 模型、6 品牌 3 领域的攻击评估与防御对照，ASR 与拒绝率双指标报告。
novelty_note: 首个针对激活转向插件供应链的系统化威胁研究与双功能木马设计，开辟模型内表示干预的供应链攻击面。
scope: 结论适用于开放 Steering 插件生态与可干预内部表示的开源模型；闭源 API 模型的等价威胁未评估。
limitations: 合法功能以拒绝转向为代表，覆盖面有限；防御需激活监控开销；品牌行为随版本漂移。

title: The Target Agent Is Its Own Best Critic but a Poor Proposer: Self-Improved Red Teaming
abstract: Automatic red teaming increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs) to iteratively diagnose failed attacks and propose improved adversarial prompts or injections. Although prior work strengthens this loop through prompt engineering and search-harness design, the mechanisms underlying its two core roles, criticism and attack proposal, has not been explored. To further investigate the core roles and therefore improve red teaming effectiveness, we disentangle two design choices: whether criticism is generated by the target session itself (self-criticism) or by a separately instantiated critic (external criticism), and whether that criticism is translated into the next attack by the target session (self-proposal) or by a separate attacker (external proposal). Through our analysis, we find that self-criticism is more effective because it is grounded in the target's live execution context, including observations, constraints, and available reasoning; removing reasoning reduces downstream attack success by 6%-17%. In contrast, self-proposal is substantially less effective because awareness of the adversarial objective induces explicit refusal and non-refusal sandbagging. These findings motivate a role-separated red-teaming approach: the target session diagnoses why an attack failed, while a separately instantiated attacker generates the next proposal. On DTAP-BENCH, spanning Telecom, Workflow, CRM, and Code domains, under both direct misuse and indirect threat models, as well as multiple agent frameworks, this configuration achieves 63.2% overall attack success rate (ASR), much higher than baselines. Our results show that effective automatic red teaming depends not only on model capability and search strategy, but also on how execution context and adversarial responsibility are distributed across model sessions.
title_cn: 目标智能体是自己最好的批评者却是糟糕的提议者：自我改进的红队
abstract_cn: 自动化红队日益依赖 LLM 迭代诊断失败攻击并提出改进的对抗提示或注入。尽管先前工作通过提示工程与搜索装置设计强化该循环，其两个核心角色——批评与攻击提议——的机制尚未被探索。为深入研究并改进红队效力，作者解耦两个设计选择：批评由目标会话自身生成（自我批评）还是独立实例化的批评者生成（外部批评）；以及该批评由目标会话转化为下一次攻击（自我提议）还是由独立攻击者生成（外部提议）。分析发现：自我批评更有效，因为它扎根于目标的实时执行上下文（观察、约束与可用推理），移除推理使下游攻击成功率下降 6%–17%；相反，自我提议明显更弱，因为对对抗目标的感知诱发显式拒绝与非拒绝式的消极怠工。这些发现催生角色分离的红队方法：目标会话诊断攻击为何失败，独立实例化的攻击者生成下一提议。在横跨 Telecom、Workflow、CRM 与 Code 域、覆盖直接滥用与间接威胁模型及多个智能体框架的 DTAP-BENCH 上，该配置取得 63.2% 的总攻击成功率（ASR），远高于基线。结果表明有效的自动化红队不仅取决于模型能力与搜索策略，还取决于执行上下文与对抗职责如何在模型会话间分布。
summary_cn: 解耦红队的批评与提议角色：目标会话自我批评更有效（移除推理使 ASR 降 6–17%），自我提议因对抗自觉引发拒绝与怠工而更差；角色分离配置在 DTAP-BENCH 取得 63.2% ASR，远超基线。
objective_summary: 系统解耦自动化红队中批评与提议的会话归属，量化自我/外部批评与提议对攻击成功率的影响，并验证角色分离配置在多域基准上的增益。
evidence_note: DTAP-BENCH 四域、直接/间接威胁、多智能体框架的系统对照，加移除推理等机制性消融（6–17%）。
novelty_note: 首次揭示「自我提议引发怠工」的机制并确立批评与提议应分离的设计原则，对红队系统设计有实质指导价值。
scope: 结论适用于 LLM 智能体的自动化红队；对不同奖励结构或更强对齐模型的普遍性待验证。
limitations: 依赖目标会话如实输出内部诊断；评估限于 DTAP-BENCH 攻击类型；怠工行为的度量依赖模型自述。

title: Intellectual Property Protection of Hyperdimensional Computing Classifiers: Black-Box Ownership Verification via Model Watermarking
abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) offers efficient learning and inference for resource-constrained systems, yet ownership verification of its models remains underexplored. We present the first systematic investigation of model watermarking in HDC by adapting backdoor-based embedding to three classifiers with different prototype-learning mechanisms. Across four benchmarks, with conventional neural networks as references, we examine whether watermarks can be learned without compromising task accuracy and whether they survive subsequent model modification and replication. The error-driven classifiers, AdaptHD and OnlineHD, support verification at a nominal trigger exposure of 1% with at most 0.58 percentage points of mean accuracy loss, whereas single-pass Vanilla HDC requires greater exposure and can incur substantial accuracy costs. The error-driven models retain verification under native continued training, but extraction produces surrogates that reproduce much of the task behavior without verifiable watermarks. Watermark overwriting readily embeds attacker watermarks into HDC prototypes and erodes the owner's watermark more strongly than in the neural network references, although the strongest erosion coincides with large accuracy losses. We further deploy watermarked AdaptHD on an FPGA and stress its execution through undervolting and overclocking. Verification survives substantial computation errors, whereas more severe stress either causes verification failure together with accuracy collapse or results in inference timeouts. These findings establish the feasibility of watermarking in HDC while identifying limitations in retention under extraction and sensitivity to overwriting.
title_cn: 超维计算分类器的知识产权保护：基于模型水印的黑盒所有权验证
abstract_cn: 超维计算（HDC）为资源受限系统提供高效学习与推理，但其模型的所有权验证仍未被充分探索。作者通过对三种具有不同原型学习机制的分类器适配基于后门的嵌入，首次系统研究 HDC 中的模型水印。在四个基准上、以常规神经网络为参照，检验水印能否在不损害任务准确率的情况下学到，以及能否在后续模型修改与复制后存活。误差驱动分类器 AdaptHD 与 OnlineHD 在 1% 标称触发暴露下即可验证，平均准确率损失至多 0.58 个百分点，而单遍 Vanilla HDC 需要更大暴露并可能付出可观准确率代价。误差驱动模型在原生继续训练下保持验证，但提取产生的代理模型复现大部分任务行为而无可验证水印。水印覆写可轻易把攻击者水印嵌入 HDC 原型并侵蚀所有者水印，其侵蚀强于神经网络参照，尽管最强侵蚀伴随大幅准确率损失。作者进一步在 FPGA 上部署水印化 AdaptHD，并以欠压与超频施加压力：验证在可观计算错误下存活，而更严重压力要么使验证失败并伴随准确率崩塌，要么导致推理超时。发现确立 HDC 水印可行性，同时指出提取下保持不足与覆写敏感的局限。
summary_cn: 首次系统研究 HDC 模型水印：AdaptHD/OnlineHD 在 1% 触发暴露、至多 0.58 点精度损失下可验证并抗继续训练，但提取的代理无水印、覆写攻击易嵌入，FPGA 压力下验证随计算错误退化。
objective_summary: 把后门式水印适配到三类 HDC 分类器，在多基准与 FPGA 部署下系统评估其可验证性、精度代价及对继续训练、提取与覆写的抵抗力。
evidence_note: 四基准 ×三 HDC 分类器 ×神经网络参照的系统对比，加 FPGA 硬件压力实验；指标完整但无统计检验。
novelty_note: 该方向首个系统化研究，揭示 HDC 原型结构导致的提取与覆写弱点。
scope: 结论适用于所测三类 HDC 分类器与图像基准；对 HDC 变体与其他模态外推需再验证。
limitations: 提取后水印保持差；覆写攻击抵抗力弱；单遍 HDC 需高触发暴露。

title: A Certified Robustness Framework for Backdoor Poisoning Attacks using $f$-Divergences
abstract: Machine learning systems trained on untrusted data are vulnerable to data and backdoor poisoning attacks, in which an adversary corrupts training and test samples to manipulate predictions at inference time. Randomized smoothing yields provable defenses against such attacks, but existing applications to train-time robustness are limited to specific threat models and smoothing mechanisms. We propose a general framework that allows expressing complex adversary constraints on the number of corrupted training examples, feature and label perturbation magnitudes, and test-time corruptions. Our framework randomizes inputs by combining data subsampling with feature, label and test-sample noising. We develop a composable certification procedure based on $f$-divergences that handles arbitrary combinations of threat models and noising strategies, and recovers several prior certification regimes exactly as special cases. We demonstrate our framework experimentally by certifying, for the first time, robustness under general $\ell_p$-constrained poisoning adversaries under bagging with additive Laplace, Gaussian, and Uniform noises.

title_cn: 基于 f-散度的后门投毒攻击认证鲁棒性框架
abstract_cn: 在不可信数据上训练的机器学习系统易受数据与后门投毒攻击：对手污染训练与测试样本以在推理时操纵预测。随机平滑可给出针对此类攻击的可证明防御，但现有面向训练时鲁棒性的应用局限于特定威胁模型与平滑机制。作者提出一个一般框架，可表达对被污染训练样本数、特征与标签扰动幅度以及测试时污染的复杂对手约束。该框架通过组合数据子采样与特征、标签及测试样本加噪来随机化输入。开发基于 f-散度的可组合认证流程，处理威胁模型与加噪策略的任意组合，并精确恢复若干既有认证机制作为特例。实验演示该框架，首次认证在 bagging 加 Laplace、高斯与均匀加噪下对一般 ℓp 约束投毒对手的鲁棒性。
summary_cn: 提出基于 f-散度的可组合认证框架：统一表达污染数量、特征/标签扰动与测试时污染等约束，精确恢复既有认证机制为特例，首次认证 bagging 加三种加噪下 ℓp 约束投毒的可证明鲁棒性。
objective_summary: 构建表达复杂投毒威胁模型与加噪策略组合的认证鲁棒性一般框架，以 f-散度工具给出可组合证书并实验演示新认证设置。
evidence_note: 理论框架完整并可恢复既有结果为特例，附新设置的认证实验；实验规模与统计检验在摘要未详。
novelty_note: 把多种投毒认证机制统一进一个可组合 f-散度框架并首次覆盖一般 ℓp 投毒，属实质性理论推广。
scope: 结论适用于所列威胁模型与加噪组合下的分类任务；证书半径受加噪强度与数据规模制约。
limitations: 认证半径在强投毒下仍有限；组合认证的计算成本较高；实验规模未详。

title: Attack logics, not outputs: Concept-based Property Attacks for Shortcut Elimination in Neural Networks
abstract: Deep neural networks (NNs) for computer vision are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, such that minuscule malicious changes to inputs may induce unintuitive outputs. One key approach to verify and mitigate such robustness issues is to falsify expected output behavior, which enables local robustness guarantees and adversarial training. Due to the black-box nature of NNs, current attacks only falsify a class of the final output, such as flipping from $\text{\texttt{stop_sign}}$ to $\neg \text{\texttt{stop_sign}}$. In this work we argue that robustness analysis should focus more generally on logical inconsistencies in concept-level reasoning rather than solely on output misclassification. We formalize this perspective through concept-based properties, i.e., constraints over human-interpretable concepts such as $\text{\texttt{red}} \land \text{\texttt{octogonal}} \implies \text{\texttt{stop_sign}}$ and study the falsification of such properties as a principled form of adversarial attack. Furthermore, an implementation of concept-based properties on already trained NNs is proposed using techniques from concept-based explainable artificial intelligence (C-XAI). For that we formally prove that attacks on concept-based properties are expected to have a reduced search space compared to simple class falsification, whilst arguably be more aligned with intuitive robustness targets. The practical effectiveness of our approach for logically informed adversarial training is shown in an empirical study across multiple models and datasets, including both vision and a security-relevant code processing task. Our results demonstrate that concept-level falsification generalizes classical adversarial attacks: Retraining on our novel attacks maintains robustness gains as compared to classical adversarial retraining whilst better eliminating semantic biases.
