title_cn: 删除、替换、修复与移植：MCP 分层提示注入网关 BARBICAN 的组件归因
abstract_cn: 一个神经分类器可能在分层防御内部完全失效，而任何端到端数字都不动。我们在 BARBICAN 上演示这一点：这是一个面向语言模型工具中介的失败关闭（fail-closed）网关，其仲裁阶段在整整一段被记录的评估中接收的是被错误配置的分词器破坏的文本。纠正该配置错误使该阶段语料级 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）从 0.392 升至 0.855，却使系统召回率从 80.67% 降至 80.34%；一个恒答「恶意」的桩得分 80.77%，比两者都高。原因在该阶段的输入分布被检查后才浮现：上游路由交给它一个 96.82% 为恶意的区段，而执行设计允许带罪判决阻断、开释判决只能经一条窄分支通过。然而删掉它损失 673 个检出；用常数替换其判决仅在 25,000 个决策中移动 12 到 140 个。把一个在该区段输入上 AUC 达 0.916 的现成分类器移植进仲裁阶段，只改变 25,000 个决策中的 16 个。与在远离测试数据处选取工作点的此类检测器相比，网关在自己的基准分布上领先，而一旦分布改变就落后。在其更早的网关中，审查模型的区段有 92.94% 为恶意，常数判决与审查模型一样准确。我们主张：任何被路由阶段的消融数字，若不附上该阶段接收区段的类别构成则不可读；删除实验需要替换实验与之并列。
summary_cn: 对 MCP 提示注入网关 BARBICAN 做组件归因：仲裁阶段 AUC 从 0.392 升到 0.855 系统召回反而降（80.67%→80.34%），恒答「恶意」的桩达 80.77%，揭示路由区段 96.82% 为恶意时消融数字不可读，主张删除实验必须配替换实验。
objective_summary: 以删除、常数替换、修复与移植四类受控实验对分层提示注入网关的仲裁阶段做组件归因，量化各组件在真实评估记录中的边际贡献并解释路由类别构成的作用。
evidence_note: 基于 25,000 条决策的记录评估，删除/替换/移植三类受控实验，附逐请求轨迹、检测器得分与验证脚本等复现工件。
novelty_note: 给出有诊断价值的实证修正：路由区段类别构成决定消融可读性、删除与替换实验必须成对解释，对分层防御评估方法学是实质性澄清。
scope: 结论基于 BARBICAN 及其前代网关在单一基准分布上的记录评估；对其他分层防御架构的适用性需按其路由构成逐例检验。
limitations: 分析限于两个网关实现与一个基准分布；替换实验用常数与现成分类器，未覆盖更丰富的反事实；对网关总体安全效果不做新主张。

title: Post-Quantum Perfect Zero-Knowledge Arguments for NP From Any One-Way Permutation
abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time that post-quantum one-way permutations are sufficient for perfect zero-knowledge classical arguments for all of NP with security guaranteed against quantum adversaries. We first establish that Naor, Ostrovsky,Venkatesen, and Yung's bit commitment scheme built from any permutation using interactive hashing, called the NOVY scheme, is sum-binding and collapse-binding against quantum polynomial-time committers provided the permutation is post-quantum one-way. We then show that the collapse-binding property of the NOVY scheme allows for Blum's perfect zero-knowledge argument for HAMCYCLE to remain so exactly as it stands against quantum adversaries.
title_cn: 从任意单向置换出发的 NP 后量子完美零知识论证
abstract_cn: 本文首次证明，后量子单向置换足以构造对所有 NP 的、安全性可抵抗量子敌手的完美零知识经典论证。我们首先证明：Naor、Ostrovsky、Venkatesan 与 Yung 基于交互式哈希由任意置换构造的 NOVY 承诺方案，只要置换是后量子单向的，则该方案对量子多项时间承诺者是和绑定（sum-binding）与坍缩绑定（collapse-binding）的。进而证明 NOVY 方案的坍缩绑定性质使 Blum 针对 HAMCYCLE 的完美零知识论证在量子敌手面前原封不动地保持完美零知识。
summary_cn: 首次证明后量子单向置换即可支撑 NP 全问题的抗量子完美零知识论证：证明 NOVY 承诺在后量子单向置换下满足和绑定与坍缩绑定，使 Blum 的 HAMCYCLE 完美 ZK 论证原样抵抗量子敌手。
objective_summary: 证明 NOVY 承诺方案在后量子单向置换下具备和绑定与坍缩绑定性质，并据此证明 Blum 型完美零知识论证在量子敌手模型下成立。
evidence_note: 理论工作：给出 NOVY 方案抗量子和绑定与坍缩绑定的完整证明，并据此得到首个从后量子单向置换到 NP 完美零知识论证的结果。
novelty_note: 首次把完美零知识论证的最小假设（单向置换）推进到后量子设定，证明路线（交互式哈希承诺的坍缩绑定）有实质新意。
scope: 结论为经典信道上对抗量子敌手的完美零知识论证；不涉及简洁性或非交互性，承诺方案依赖交互式哈希。
limitations: 论证为交互式且非简洁；结论限于完美零知识而非其他 ZK 变体；效率未讨论。

title: Spoofing the Toolbox: Optimizing Tool Descriptions to Deceive LLM Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are widely used in many applications and often rely on external tools. Tool information, such as function descriptions, helps agents determine which tools best suit a given context. However, attackers can manipulate this information to mislead LLM agents into using malicious tools. Prior attacks mainly rely on keyword-based techniques, which are easily detected, or rule-based methods, which have limited effectiveness. In this work, we introduce TSA, a stealthy tool-spoofing attack that crafts descriptions for malicious tools that are difficult to distinguish from those of existing benign tools. To achieve this, we propose an LLM-powered optimization method that iteratively refines malicious tool descriptions. Specifically, TSA begins with a variant of a benign tool description and updates it based on feedback from a surrogate LLM agent. The optimization method incorporates a feedback function and contrastive in-context learning to guide the search for descriptions that are both stealthy and effective. Experiments on both single- and multi-tool use benchmarks demonstrate that TSA achieves an attack success rate of up to 92.13\%, outperforming four state-of-the-art approaches while remaining highly stealthy. Our user study further shows that even human participants cannot distinguish descriptions generated by TSA from benign ones. Moreover, TSA remains effective against five tool-malware detectors.
title_cn: 欺骗工具箱：优化工具描述以误导 LLM 智能体
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体被广泛应用于各类场景，且常常依赖外部工具。工具信息（如函数描述）帮助智能体判断哪些工具最契合当前上下文。然而攻击者可以操纵这些信息，误导智能体使用恶意工具。已有攻击主要依赖易被检测的关键词技术，或效果有限的基于规则的方法。本文提出 TSA，一种隐蔽的工具欺骗攻击，为恶意工具构造与现有良性工具难以区分的描述。为此，我们提出一种 LLM 驱动的优化方法，迭代精炼恶意工具描述：TSA 从良性工具描述的变体出发，依据替代 LLM 智能体的反馈更新描述，优化方法结合反馈函数与对比上下文学习，引导搜索既隐蔽又有效的描述。在单工具与多工具使用基准上的实验表明，TSA 攻击成功率最高达 92.13%，优于四种最先进方法且保持高度隐蔽。用户研究进一步表明，人类参与者也无法把 TSA 生成的描述与良性描述区分开。此外，TSA 对五种工具恶意软件检测器仍然有效。
summary_cn: 提出 TSA：用 LLM 迭代优化恶意工具描述伪装成良性工具，单/多工具基准上攻击成功率最高 92.13%，优于四种现有方法，人类用户无法辨别，且绕过五种工具恶意软件检测器。
objective_summary: 提出基于 LLM 优化与对比上下文学习的工具描述欺骗攻击 TSA，迭代生成隐蔽且有效的恶意工具描述，并在基准、用户研究与检测器规避三方面量化其效果。
evidence_note: 单/多工具基准、与四种 SOTA 攻击对比、人类用户研究、五种检测器规避实验的多设置评估；未报告置信区间或显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把攻击面从关键词注入转向「工具描述语义伪装」，以替代智能体反馈驱动的对抗优化生成隐蔽描述，机制上有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于以函数/工具描述做选择依据的 LLM 智能体；依赖替代智能体与良性描述变体作为优化起点。
limitations: 优化依赖替代智能体与反馈函数质量；评估基于自建基准；对描述来源鉴权类防御未系统评估。

title: Benchmarking Classical and Quantum Machine Learning for Intrusion Detection Across Multiple Datasets
abstract: Intrusion detection is examined through a comparative benchmark of classical and quantum machine learning models on three datasets: NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, and MQTTEEB-D2025. The analysis focuses on how preprocessing decisions, feature selection strategies, and quantum encoding schemes shape model performance on data with differing levels of noise and complexity. A single unified pipeline is applied, covering normalization, class-imbalance handling, dimensionality reduction, and two feature selection methods: Random Forest importance and a quantum-aware approach that combines Quantum Kernel Alignment with Mutual Information (QKA-MI). Four classifiers are compared: Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, Quantum Support Vector Machine, and Pegasos Quantum SVM. The classical models perform consistently across all three datasets, whereas the quantum models depend more strongly on feature representation and kernel alignment. Quantum-aware feature selection yields marked gains for the quantum models, especially on cleaner datasets, while heterogeneous traffic remains difficult. Pegasos Quantum SVM offers a good trade-off between accuracy and computational cost, underscoring the role of preprocessing alignment in practical quantum intrusion detection.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. This is the author's accepted manuscript of the paper published in the 2026 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Energy Technologies (ICECET 2026), Rome, Italy. The final published version is available via IEEE Xplore at this https URL
title_cn: 跨多数据集的经典与量子机器学习入侵检测基准测试
abstract_cn: 本文在三个数据集（NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15、MQTTEEB-D2025）上，通过经典与量子机器学习模型的对比基准来考察入侵检测。分析聚焦预处理决策、特征选择策略和量子编码方案如何塑造模型在噪声与复杂度各异的数据上的表现。全流程采用单一统一管线，涵盖归一化、类不平衡处理、降维，以及两种特征选择方法：随机森林重要性和结合量子核对齐与互信息的量子感知方法（QKA-MI）。比较四种分类器：支持向量机、随机森林、量子支持向量机和 Pegasos 量子 SVM。经典模型在三个数据集上表现稳定，而量子模型更依赖特征表示与核对齐。量子感知特征选择为量子模型带来显著增益，尤其在较干净的数据集上，而异构流量仍然困难。Pegasos 量子 SVM 在精度与计算成本之间取得较好折中，凸显了预处理对齐在实用量子入侵检测中的作用。
summary_cn: 在 NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15、MQTTEEB-D2025 上以统一管线对比 4 种经典/量子分类器：经典模型跨数据集稳定，量子模型高度依赖特征选择，QKA-MI 特征选择显著提升量子模型表现，Pegasos QSVM 兼顾精度与成本。
objective_summary: 以统一预处理与两种特征选择策略在三个入侵检测数据集上系统对比经典与量子分类器，量化预处理与量子编码对性能的影响。
evidence_note: 三个公开数据集、统一管线、四种分类器与两种特征选择的系统对比，ICECET 2026 录用；数据集较老、未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 经典与量子 SVM 用于入侵检测均有先例，新增的 QKA-MI 特征选择属已有组件的组合改进。
scope: 结论适用于所测三个数据集与四种模型；量子结果依赖模拟的量子核计算，不直接代表真实量子硬件表现。
limitations: 使用 NSL-KDD 等老旧基准；未报告显著性检验；量子模型在异构流量上表现受限。

title: Hidden Backdoor Attack on Deep Contrastive Clustering
abstract: Deep contrastive clustering has become a representative paradigm for unsupervised image clustering, yet its security under training-time poisoning remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates a hidden backdoor threat against deep contrastive clustering and proposes HBDCC, a Hidden Backdoor attack for Deep Contrastive Clustering. Here, hidden does not indicate that the trigger is visually imperceptible, but rather that the malicious trigger-cluster association remains behaviorally dormant on clean inputs and is activated only when the trigger appears at inference time. HBDCC poisons only a small fraction of unlabeled training samples and exploits an inherent structural weakness of contrastive clustering: augmentation-persistent triggers can be repeatedly aligned across different views at the instance level and further reinforced by cluster-level consistency objectives. As a result, the poisoned model preserves normal clustering behavior on clean data, while producing severely distorted cluster assignments for triggered inputs. We provide a dual-level analysis of the backdoor implantation mechanism and evaluate HBDCC on ImageNet-10, ImageNet-Dogs, and STL-10 with representative contrastive clustering frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HBDCC can substantially degrade triggered clustering performance in a dataset-dependent manner while maintaining sufficient clean-data utility to evade standard evaluation protocols. We further conduct comprehensive studies on poisoning ratio, attack scope, trigger type, trigger size, and a lightweight knowledge-distillation-based mitigation strategy.
title_cn: 针对深度对比聚类的隐蔽后门攻击
abstract_cn: 深度对比聚类已成为无监督图像聚类的代表性范式，但其在训练期投毒下的安全性基本未被探索。本文研究针对深度对比聚类的隐蔽后门威胁，提出 HBDCC（Hidden Backdoor attack for Deep Contrastive Clustering）。这里「隐蔽」并非指触发器在视觉上不可察觉，而是指恶意触发器—簇关联在干净输入上保持行为休眠，仅在推理时出现触发器才被激活。HBDCC 只投毒一小部分无标签训练样本，并利用对比聚类的一个固有结构弱点：可跨增强保持的触发器能在实例层面于不同视图间被反复对齐，并进一步被簇级一致性目标强化。因此，被投毒模型在干净数据上保持正常聚类行为，而对被触发输入产生严重扭曲的簇分配。我们对后门植入机制做了双层分析，并在 ImageNet-10、ImageNet-Dogs 和 STL-10 上结合代表性对比聚类框架评估 HBDCC。大量实验表明，HBDCC 能以依赖数据集的方式显著降低被触发输入的聚类性能，同时保持足够的干净数据效用以逃过标准评估协议。我们还对投毒比例、攻击范围、触发器类型、触发器大小以及一种基于知识蒸馏的轻量缓解策略做了全面研究。
summary_cn: 提出 HBDCC：利用对比聚类跨视图对齐机制植入休眠后门，仅投毒少量无标签样本，在 ImageNet-10、ImageNet-Dogs、STL-10 上严重扭曲被触发输入的簇分配，同时保持干净效用以逃过常规评估。
objective_summary: 提出针对深度对比聚类的训练期后门攻击 HBDCC，利用增强持久触发器的实例级与簇级一致性弱点植入休眠触发—簇关联，并在三个数据集上量化攻击效果与缓解。
evidence_note: 在 ImageNet-10、ImageNet-Dogs、STL-10 三个基准与多个代表性对比聚类框架上系统评估，含投毒比例、触发器类型等消融；无统计检验，基准为学术数据集。
novelty_note: 对比聚类的训练期后门此前基本未被探索，本文首次系统刻画其利用跨视图对齐与簇级一致性的独特植入机制。
scope: 结论适用于基于对比学习的无监督图像聚类；对其他无监督范式或有强监督信号的场景外推有限。
limitations: 攻击效果依数据集而异；评估限于学术图像基准；知识蒸馏缓解仅作初步验证。

title: ToolContractGate: Versioned Trusted Contracts for Drift-Safe Agent Tool Invocation
abstract: Agent tool approval and input validation do not, by themselves, bind a request to an approved source artifact. ToolContractGate provides a deterministic runtime contract evaluator for OpenAPI-derived agent tools. Each versioned ToolContract combines a stored OpenAPI fingerprint with access, schema, and behavioral declarations. The full evaluator applies ten checks, including a cached boot-time provenance result; four execution modes and five evaluation configurations support baseline, ablation, and non-blocking shadow analysis. On a synthetic benchmark of 45 cases (35 unsafe cases across 12 drift classes and 10 safe cases), the full pipeline detects all 35 faults: 29 BLOCK, 3 REVIEW, and 3 WARN decisions, with no false blocks on the safe cases. The archived run reports a mean gate latency of 0.18 ms and a 95th percentile (p95) of 2 ms using integer-millisecond measurements. The open-source artifact includes seven OpenAPI specifications, twelve enterprise contracts, 29 unit tests, and a 900-record evaluation. Results characterize contract-decision coverage; downstream enforcement requires a host that honors the returned decision. Production traffic, semantic backend drift, and dynamic provenance refresh remain evaluation and integration opportunities.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Computer and Applications (ICCA). Author-accepted manuscript; 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
title_cn: ToolContractGate：面向漂移安全的智能体工具调用版本化可信契约
abstract_cn: 智能体的工具审批与输入校验本身并不能把请求绑定到已获批准的源工件。ToolContractGate 为由 OpenAPI 派生的智能体工具提供了确定性的运行时契约评估器。每个版本化 ToolContract 将存储的 OpenAPI 指纹与访问、模式和行为声明组合在一起。完整评估器执行十项检查，包括缓存的启动时溯源结果；四种执行模式和五种评估配置支持基线、消融与非阻断影子分析。在一个由 45 个案例（35 个横跨 12 类漂移的不安全案例和 10 个安全案例）构成的合成基准上，完整流水线检出全部 35 个缺陷：29 个 BLOCK、3 个 REVIEW、3 个 WARN 决策，且对安全案例无误阻断。归档的运行报告平均门控延迟 0.18 ms，95 分位为 2 ms（整数毫秒测量）。开源工件包含 7 份 OpenAPI 规范、12 个企业契约、29 个单元测试和一个 900 条记录的评估集。结果刻画的是契约决策覆盖率；下游执行需要宿主真正落实返回的决策。生产流量、语义后端漂移与动态溯源刷新仍是评估与集成上的待办。
summary_cn: 提出 ToolContractGate：以版本化 OpenAPI 契约在运行时确定性评估智能体工具调用，45 例合成基准上检出全部 35 个漂移缺陷且无误阻断，平均门控延迟 0.18 ms，工件开源。
objective_summary: 构建基于版本化 OpenAPI 契约的确定性运行时评估器，把工具调用请求绑定到已批准的工件版本，并在合成漂移基准上测量检测覆盖与延迟。
evidence_note: 45 例合成基准（35 不安全/10 安全）、12 类漂移、消融与影子模式、延迟分位数测量，ICCA 2026 录用；但基准为自建合成数据，无真实生产流量验证。
novelty_note: 把版本化契约指纹与确定性检查清单用于智能体工具调用属工程化整合，契约与审批机制均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于 OpenAPI 派生工具与可契约化的调用场景；决策需宿主执行才生效，不覆盖语义级后端漂移与动态溯源。
limitations: 评估基于自建合成基准；不处理语义后端漂移与生产流量；溯源结果缓存在启动时，动态刷新为后续工作。

title: TRACER: An RDC-Triggered Trajectory Recovery Framework for Cyberattack-Resilient Adaptive Cruise Control
abstract: The increasing connectivity of adaptive cruise control (ACC) systems exposes vehicle-state information to cyberattacks, potentially causing irrational car-following behavior and unsafe longitudinal dynamics. Existing trajectory recovery methods generally lack an interpretable criterion for recovery activation and remain vulnerable to attack-induced distribution shifts. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TRACER, a rational driving constraint (RDC)-triggered trajectory recovery framework for cyberattack-resilient ACC systems. TRACER employs a rationality-aware triggering (RAT) mechanism that activates recovery when the observed driving state violates the calibrated RDC bounds. It also introduces cross-branch robust imitation learning (CRIL), which combines a clean branch for learning nominal driving behavior with a noise-enhanced branch for improving robustness to corrupted observations. Cross-branch fine-tuning further aligns the robust recovery policy with the nominal driving-state distribution. Experiments across six cyberattack scenarios show that TRACER achieves reliable recovery triggering and outperforms state-of-the-art recovery baselines in terms of accuracy, stability, and safety. State-space analysis further confirms that TRACER mitigates attack-induced distribution shifts and restores coupled spacing-velocity dynamics, highlighting the effectiveness of robust policy learning for cyberattack-resilient ACC.
title_cn: TRACER：面向网络攻击韧性自适应巡航控制的 RDC 触发轨迹恢复框架
abstract_cn: 自适应巡航控制（ACC）系统日益增强的网联能力使车辆状态信息暴露于网络攻击之下，可能导致非理性的跟车行为和不安全的纵向动力学。现有轨迹恢复方法普遍缺乏可解释的恢复触发判据，并且对攻击诱发的分布偏移依然脆弱。针对这些挑战，本文提出 TRACER，一个面向网络攻击韧性 ACC 系统的、由理性驾驶约束（RDC）触发的轨迹恢复框架。TRACER 采用理性感知触发（RAT）机制，当观测到的驾驶状态违反标定的 RDC 边界时启动恢复。它还引入跨分支鲁棒模仿学习（CRIL），将学习标称驾驶行为的干净分支与增强对受损观测鲁棒性的噪声分支相结合；跨分支微调进一步使鲁棒恢复策略与标称驾驶状态分布对齐。在六种网络攻击场景下的实验表明，TRACER 实现了可靠的恢复触发，并在精度、稳定性和安全性方面优于最先进的恢复基线。状态空间分析进一步证实 TRACER 缓解了攻击诱发的分布偏移并恢复了间距—速度耦合动力学，凸显了鲁棒策略学习对网络攻击韧性 ACC 的有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 RDC 触发的 ACC 轨迹恢复框架 TRACER：理性感知触发在状态越界时启动恢复，跨分支鲁棒模仿学习兼顾标称行为与抗干扰，六种攻击场景下精度、稳定性与安全性均优于现有恢复基线。
objective_summary: 提出由理性驾驶约束触发的恢复框架 TRACER，通过理性感知触发机制与跨分支鲁棒模仿学习在 ACC 遭受攻击后恢复安全跟车轨迹，并在六种攻击场景下与现有恢复基线对比。
evidence_note: 六种网络攻击场景的仿真实验，与多个最先进恢复基线对比精度、稳定性、安全性，并有状态空间分析佐证；未报告统计检验，评估限于仿真环境。
novelty_note: 将标定的理性驾驶边界用作可解释的恢复触发判据、以双分支模仿学习应对攻击分布偏移，属已有恢复与鲁棒学习组件在新场景下的组合。
scope: 结论适用于仿真环境中的 ACC 纵向控制攻击与恢复；未涉及横向控制、真实车辆在环验证与其他攻击面。
limitations: 评估全部基于仿真，无实车或硬件在环验证；触发依赖 RDC 边界标定质量；攻击场景限定为六类预设攻击。

title: STROKE: Simple Sparse Structural Occlusions for Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
abstract: We introduce STROKE, a query-efficient score-based black-box adversarial attack that constructs perturbations from simple oriented rectangular occlusions. STROKE optimizes these perturbations through a lightweight greedy add-and-refine procedure. Across diverse image classifiers, STROKE achieves high attack success with low query counts at nominal 1--2\% area settings, showing favorable performance relative to existing patch-based attacks in several configurations. Matched comparisons further demonstrate substantial reductions in wall-clock attack time, while ablation studies examine the key design choices and effectiveness across structural primitives. These findings suggest that simple structural occlusions offer an effective and computationally efficient search space for black-box adversarial attacks.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, and 16 pages of Supplementary Information with 3 figures and 5 tables
title_cn: STROKE：用于黑盒对抗攻击的简单稀疏结构遮挡
abstract_cn: 我们提出 STROKE，一种查询高效、基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击，用简单的有向矩形遮挡构造扰动。STROKE 通过轻量的贪心添加-精炼流程优化这些扰动。在多样的图像分类器上，STROKE 在名义 1–2% 面积设置下以低查询次数实现高攻击成功率，在若干配置中相对现有基于补丁的攻击表现有利。匹配对比进一步显示攻击墙钟时间大幅降低；消融研究考察了关键设计选择与跨结构基元的有效性。这些发现表明，简单结构遮挡为黑盒对抗攻击提供了一个有效且计算高效的搜索空间。
summary_cn: 黑盒对抗攻击 STROKE 用少量有向矩形遮挡构造扰动并以贪心添加-精炼优化：在 1–2% 面积设置下低查询次数实现高成功率，较现有补丁类攻击查询更省、墙钟时间大幅降低。
objective_summary: 提出以简单有向矩形遮挡为搜索空间的分数型黑盒对抗攻击 STROKE，配合贪心添加-精炼优化实现查询高效攻击。
evidence_note: 跨多样图像分类器系统评测、与现有补丁攻击匹配对比并做消融；报告查询次数与墙钟时间；未报告统计检验，模型细节在摘要层面有限。
novelty_note: 把补丁攻击的扰动空间收敛为稀疏有向矩形并以贪心流程优化，属对既有补丁/遮挡攻击路线的增量改进，核心范式未变。
scope: 结论适用于图像分类器的分数型黑盒攻击场景；对带检测器的防御、物理世界攻击与视觉 Transformer 之外的架构未验证。
limitations: 名义面积设置与真实部署约束（可见性、物理可打印性）有差距；贪心流程对复杂纹理目标的适应性未评估；对比攻击集合的选取可能存在偏向。

title: EVSEFuzz : A Tool for Automated Testing of Protocol Implementations
abstract: The rapid adoption and development of electric vehicle (EV) networks has required the expansive deployment of EV charging infrastructure (EVCI) which relies on communication protocols such as the open charge point protocol (OCPP) to coordinate data transfer between charging network operators and the EV supply equipment. In this paper, we present EVSEFuzz, a tool for automatically building fuzzers to test the security of protocol implementations. To achieve this we make a novel use of Python datatype validation packages and tools to ``understand'' datatypes and message structures and generate both compliant and non-compliant messages. To date, EVSEFuzz has been tested successfully with several open and closed-source implementations and has found several vulnerabilities leading to the publication of two CVEs.
title_cn: EVSEFuzz：协议实现自动化测试工具
abstract_cn: 电动汽车（EV）网络的快速发展要求大规模部署电动汽车充电基础设施（EVCI），其依赖开放充电点协议（OCPP）等通信协议在充电网络运营商与电动汽车供电设备之间协调数据传输。本文提出 EVSEFuzz，一个自动构建模糊测试器以测试协议实现安全性的工具。为此我们新颖地利用 Python 数据类型验证包与工具来「理解」数据类型与消息结构，生成合规与不合规消息。迄今 EVSEFuzz 已在多个开源与闭源实现上成功测试，并发现多个漏洞，促成两个 CVE 的发布。
summary_cn: EVSEFuzz 利用 Python 类型验证包自动理解协议消息结构并生成合规/不合规消息构建模糊测试器：已在多个开源与闭源 OCPP 实现上测试并促成两个 CVE 发布。
objective_summary: 提出基于 Python 类型验证机制的协议实现模糊测试工具构建器 EVSEFuzz，面向电动汽车充电协议 OCPP。
evidence_note: 在多个开源与闭源实现上测试并产出两个 CVE，证明工具可用；无系统基准对比，漏洞数量与覆盖率数据有限。
novelty_note: 以通用 Python 类型验证包自动推导消息结构与合规/不合规变体，降低协议 fuzzer 的构建成本；协议模糊测试方向成熟，新意在于面向 EV 充电协议的自动化构建路径。
scope: 结论适用于可由 Python 类型注解描述的结构化协议实现；对二进制紧凑协议、深度有状态会话与加密通道内的模糊测试未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖类型注解的完备性，语义级漏洞发现能力有限；评估细节（实现数量、触发条件）在摘要层面未量化；两个 CVE 之外的漏洞影响未报告。

title: Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
abstract: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser's output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C/C++ that produces proof obligations and audited vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul under six evidence conditions that differ only in the notes, including fabricated assurances that a missing check exists and fabricated alarms that an added check is missing. The study covers 916 pairs in four disjoint sets, eleven model configurations from four vendors and 16,572 audits; no model is trained or fine-tuned. True evidence barely improved accuracy (+0.02). False evidence acted asymmetrically: relative to true notes about the same operations, false assurances lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 points, whereas false alarms never significantly lowered accuracy and were disputed far more often. An internally registered replication on seven new models confirmed that false assurances move verdicts towards their claim more than false alarms do (mean asymmetry +0.16, 95% CI +0.10 to +0.24). Instructions in the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference; the best one failed to replicate. Verifying each claim in a separate call and showing the refuted claims raised accuracy under false assurances by 12 points in a pre-specified test (p=0.002) without loss under true evidence; for a second model the gain was smaller and not significant. Pipelines should therefore verify a tool's guarantees before the model relies on them, and studies should measure deference in a direction-aware way.

title_cn: 信任工具：LLM 漏洞审计者对静态分析证据的不对称依赖
abstract_cn: 把大语言模型（LLM）与静态分析组合的管线让模型把分析器的输出当作证据，但模型能否区分真假证据、其审视程度是否取决于证据内容，此前未被测量。我们构建了一个 C/C++ 过程内分析器，产生证明义务，并从 PrimeVul 审计易受攻击与已修补函数，置于六种证据条件（仅注释不同，包括「声称缺失检查存在」的伪造保证与「声称新增检查缺失」的伪造告警）。研究覆盖四组互不相交集合中的 916 对、来自四家厂商的 11 个模型配置与 16,572 次审计；不训练也不微调任何模型。真实证据几乎未提升准确率（+0.02）。假证据的作用不对称：与关于相同操作的真实注释相比，伪造保证把真实漏洞的检出率最多降低 19 个百分点，而伪造告警从未显著降低准确率、且被质疑的频率高得多。在七个新模型上的内部注册复现证实，伪造保证比伪造告警更多地把判定推向其主张（平均不对称 +0.16，95% CI +0.10 到 +0.24）。审计提示中的指令未能可靠降低依赖；最佳的一条未能复现。在预先设定的测试中，把每条声明放在单独调用中验证并展示被驳斥的声明，使伪造保证下的准确率提高 12 个百分点（p=0.002）且真实证据下无损失；对第二个模型增益较小且不显著。管线因此应在模型依赖工具保证之前先行验证，研究也应以方向感知的方式测量依赖。
summary_cn: 测量 LLM 漏洞审计对静态分析证据的依赖：916 对函数、11 个模型配置、16,572 次审计显示伪造保证最多压低检出率 19 个百分点而伪造告警无显著影响；分调用验证声明使准确率提高 12 个百分点（p=0.002）。
objective_summary: 构建受控证据条件实验，测量 LLM 漏洞审计者对真实/伪造静态分析保证与告警的依赖差异及其不对称性，并评估缓解手段。
evidence_note: 916 对、11 模型配置、16,572 次审计；七模型内部注册复现并报告 95% CI；预设定检验 p=0.002；PrimeVul 真实数据；无模型训练。
novelty_note: 首次方向感知地测量 LLM 对静态分析证据的依赖并揭示「伪造保证比伪造告警更危险」的不对称规律，具有直接的诊断价值；LLM+静态分析管线本身已有大量工作。
scope: 结论适用于以文本证据形式接入 LLM 的代码审计管线与被测 11 个配置；对多模态证据、智能体型多轮审计流程不外推。
limitations: 依赖单一自建分析器的注释格式；缓解措施仅在两个模型上验证有效；伪造证据由研究者构造，与真实世界错误工具输出的分布可能有别。

title: Quantum Cadence: Post-Quantum Consensus with Multiple Concurrent Proposers
abstract: The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggregate the signatures of a whole quorum into a single short signature, which keeps these certificates small. A large-scale quantum computer would break these schemes, and no post-quantum scheme with comparable aggregate size and aggregation time is known. Without aggregation, a certificate holds one large post-quantum signature per member of the quorum, so it becomes infeasible for each validator to broadcast certificates, as modern consensus protocols often require. We present Quantum Cadence, a post-quantum consensus protocol with multiple concurrent proposers that avoids certificates altogether: every validator counts quorums among the messages it has received itself. Its safety and liveness do not even depend on signatures, although we add signatures to obtain accountability. Quantum Cadence builds on Cadence and replaces its slot consensus, Chorus, with Quantum Chorus, which keeps the optimal fast-path latency of Chorus: dissemination followed by two rounds of votes. When its fast path fails, Quantum Chorus runs Coda, our signature-free Byzantine agreement for multiple proposers. We also outline how the Conductor, which schedules the slots of Cadence, can be adapted to Quantum Cadence. In simulations with 200 validators, Quantum Chorus has a latency comparable to that of Chorus and scales better with the number of proposers.

title_cn: Quantum Cadence：多并发提议者的后量子共识
abstract_cn: 大多数高性能区块链的共识协议使用法定人数证书（quorum certificate），将一个法定人数的验证者签名打包在一起。BLS 等签名方案能把整个法定人数的签名聚合成一个短签名，使证书保持很小。大规模量子计算机会打破这些方案，而目前没有已知聚合尺寸与聚合时间相当的后量子方案。没有聚合，一张证书就要装入法定人数中每个成员的一份大后量子签名，每个验证者广播证书变得不可行，而现代共识协议常要求这一点。我们提出 Quantum Cadence，一个避免证书的多并发提议者后量子共识协议：每个验证者只统计自己收到的消息中的法定人数。其安全性与活性甚至不依赖签名，不过我们加入签名以获得问责能力。Quantum Cadence 构建于 Cadence 之上，把其槽位共识 Chorus 替换为 Quantum Chorus，后者保持 Chorus 的最优快速路径延迟：一次分发加两轮投票。当快速路径失败时，Quantum Chorus 运行 Coda——我们面向多提议者的免签名拜占庭一致。我们还概述了调度 Cadence 槽位的 Conductor 如何适配 Quantum Cadence。在 200 个验证者的仿真中，Quantum Chorus 的延迟与 Chorus 相当，且随提议者数量增加扩展性更好。
summary_cn: 免证书后量子共识 Quantum Cadence：验证者本地统计法定人数替代广播证书，含保持最优快路径延迟的 Quantum Chorus 与免签名拜占庭一致 Coda；200 验证者仿真中延迟与原 Chorus 相当且随提议者数扩展更好。
objective_summary: 设计不依赖聚合签名的后量子共识协议 Quantum Cadence，以本地法定人数计数与免签名拜占庭一致替换证书机制并仿真评估。
evidence_note: 200 验证者仿真对比原 Chorus 的延迟与扩展性；安全性/活性论证见 35 页正文；无真实网络部署。
novelty_note: 在 Cadence/Chorus 谱系上系统移除证书依赖以适配后量子签名尺寸，新组件 Coda（多提议者免签名拜占庭一致）有实质设计含量；整体属既有协议家族的后量子改造。
scope: 结论适用于采用法定人数证书的 BFT 区块链共识；对动态成员变更与真实互联网延迟环境未验证。
limitations: 免签名路径削弱即时问责（需附加签名恢复）；评估限于 200 节点仿真；与 BLS 方案在正常条件下的性能差距未量化。

title: Developing Security Metrics for Automated Compliance Checking
abstract: To automatically check for compliance with security-related standards, prose requirements must be translated to technical properties to make them measurable. A multitude of metrics have been proposed in past literature, but they are lacking a systematic methodology for their elicitation. Without such a methodology, metrics remain inconsistent in their data models and abstraction levels, they exhibit considerable overlaps and are difficult to combine to comprehensively cover a standard's requirement. In this paper, we develop a data model for security metrics based on a systematization of compliance requirements, and we propose a methodology for their elicitation. The method is based on an ontology that enables a systematic development of metrics with a comparable degree of abstraction. We also present our initial work on an open-source effort that demonstrates that our approach also supports a collaborative development of metrics.

title_cn: 为自动化合规检查开发安全度量
abstract_cn: 要自动检查与安全相关标准的合规性，必须把散文式要求翻译成可测量的技术性质。过去文献提出了大量度量，但缺乏系统化的导出方法。没有这样的方法，度量的数据模型与抽象层次不一致、重叠严重，也难以组合以全面覆盖标准要求。本文基于对合规要求的系统化整理，开发安全度量的数据模型，并提出其导出方法。该方法基于一个本体，支持以可比抽象层次系统地开发度量。我们还介绍了开源工作的初步成果，表明该方法也支持度量的协作开发。
summary_cn: 面向自动化合规检查提出基于本体的安全度量导出方法与数据模型：系统化整理合规要求，使度量具有可比抽象层次并可协作开发，弥补既有度量体系的重叠与不一致（IFIP SEC 2026）。
objective_summary: 构建安全度量数据模型与基于本体的系统化导出方法，并启动支持协作开发的开源度量工作。
evidence_note: 方法学论文：数据模型与本体方法加上开源初步实现；无对方法有效性的定量评估或覆盖度报告。IFIP SEC 2026 已发表（作者接受稿）。

scope: 结论适用于把散文式标准要求转化为可检查度量的合规自动化场景；对跨标准冲突消解与度量实现的运行时开销未覆盖。

title: Identity Amortization: Shared Resources and the Cost of Sybil Attacks
abstract: Sybil defenses commonly price identities by requiring a resource for each one. When one resource can support several identities, an adversary can pay less per identity than the defense intends. We call this identity amortization: a strict reduction in the minimum cost of provisioning identities when resources may be shared, relative to provisioning each one independently. It is a second route to the gap that a Sybil attack exploits. When influence is assigned per identity, a defense calibrated to the nominal price can overestimate the cost of a Sybil threshold by up to the number of identities one resource supports. For any resource catalogue, we give exact tests for when identity amortization occurs, where it begins, and its largest error; a sharing cap below the onset removes it. Because the tests need only prices and capacities, they apply to any defense that admits identities against a shareable resource, telling designers whether the assumed per-identity cost is paid, how wrong it can be, and which intervention restores it most cheaply for honest participants. On published phone-verification prices, per-account estimates overstate provisioning cost 1.6 to 4.3 times; Tor's raised per-address relay limit cut modeled attack cost by 8 to 72%, depending on the address-to-relay price ratio.
title_cn: 身份摊销：共享资源与女巫攻击的代价
abstract_cn: 女巫防御通常通过为每个身份要求一份资源来为身份定价。当一份资源可以支撑多个身份时，攻击者为每个身份支付的就低于防御所意图的价格。我们称之为身份摊销（identity amortization）：当资源可共享时，身份配置的最小成本相对逐个独立配置的严格下降。这是女巫攻击所利用的成本差距之外的第二条路径。当影响力按身份分配时，按名义价格校准的防御最多会高估女巫阈值的成本，高估量可达一份资源支撑的身份数量。对任意资源目录，我们给出判定身份摊销是否发生、从何处开始、以及最大误差的精确测试；把共享上限设在起点之下即可消除摊销。由于这些测试只需要价格与容量，它们适用于任何允许以可共享资源换取身份的防御，能告诉设计者假定的每身份成本是否成立、错误可能多大，以及哪种干预以对诚实参与者最低的代价恢复该成本。在已公布的电话验证价格上，按账户估算把配置成本高估 1.6 到 4.3 倍；Tor 提高每地址中继上限后，模型化的攻击成本下降 8% 到 72%，取决于地址到中继的价格比。
summary_cn: 提出「身份摊销」：一份可共享资源支撑多身份使攻击者每身份成本低于防御假设，给出仅凭价格与容量的精确判定测试；真实电话验证价格上按账户估算高估成本 1.6–4.3 倍，Tor 上调中继上限使模型化攻击成本降 8–72%。
objective_summary: 形式化资源共享下的女巫攻击成本摊销现象，给出发生条件、起始点与最大误差的精确测试，并以电话验证与 Tor 实例化。
evidence_note: 给出任意资源目录下的精确测试与误差界（理论完整），并以已公布电话验证价格与 Tor 参数做实例化分析；无受控实验。
novelty_note: 识别并形式化「身份摊销」这一此前未被单独刻画的成本缺口路径，给出与具体防御无关的通用判定测试；女巫防御文献多以单身份定价为前提。
scope: 结论适用于以可共享资源定价身份的防御机制；对行为型女巫检测与不可转移资源（如生物特征）场景不适用。
limitations: 模型以价格与容量刻画资源，忽略获取摩擦与风险成本；电话验证与 Tor 实例化依赖公开价格的时效性；干预建议的二次效应未评估。

title: Iterative Behavioral Identification for Covert Misappropriation Attacks
abstract: We present a data-driven, three-phase framework for covert misappropriation attacks on closed-loop networked control systems. A man-in-the-middle (MITM) adversary, with access only to intercepted input-output data, incrementally identifies the plant's behavioral subspace while maintaining stealth under an infinity-norm intrusion-detection system (IDS). Phase 1 collects an initial rank-deficient Hankel matrix using a low-amplitude probing signal that satisfies an analytical stealth bound. Phase 2 adapts online rank-increasing experiment design to the closed-loop setting, using causal predictor-based masking to limit IDS residuals while the Hankel rank grows from 1 to the full behavioral rank n + mL in exactly n + mL - 1 steps. We show that the identified subspaces are strictly nested and that the projection error of any desired trajectory decreases monotonically, strictly so almost surely at each rank increase. Phase 3 employs the final Hankel matrix in a DeePC-style optimization to synthesize a covert attack that tracks an arbitrary reference while respecting the IDS constraint. Simulations on a DC motor with PI control demonstrate full-rank identification and stealthy tracking. Stealth is guaranteed analytically in Phases 1 and 3 and is numerically supported in Phase 2. The method is model-free and assumes noise-free LTI dynamics.

title_cn: 面向隐蔽挪用攻击的迭代行为辨识
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个数据驱动、三阶段的闭环网络化控制系统隐蔽挪用攻击框架。仅能访问截获输入输出数据的中间人（MITM）敌手，在无穷范数入侵检测系统（IDS）下保持隐蔽的同时，增量辨识被控对象的行为子空间。阶段 1 用满足解析隐蔽界的小幅探测信号采集初始秩亏 Hankel 矩阵。阶段 2 把在线秩增实验设计适配到闭环设定，用因果预测器掩蔽限制 IDS 残差，同时 Hankel 秩在恰好 n + mL - 1 步内从 1 增长到满行为秩 n + mL。我们证明所辨识子空间严格嵌套，且任意目标轨迹的投影误差单调下降，并在几乎每次秩增时严格下降。阶段 3 用最终 Hankel 矩阵做 DeePC 风格优化，合成在满足 IDS 约束的同时追踪任意参考的隐蔽攻击。带 PI 控制的直流电机仿真演示了满秩辨识与隐蔽追踪。阶段 1 与 3 的隐蔽性有解析保证，阶段 2 为数值支持。该方法免模型且假设无噪 LTI 动态。
summary_cn: 三阶段隐蔽攻击框架：MITM 用小幅探测+因果预测器掩蔽在无穷范数 IDS 下以恰好 n+mL-1 步辨识满行为秩子空间，再以 DeePC 风格优化合成任意参考的隐蔽追踪；直流电机仿真验证，解析保证限于无噪 LTI 假设。
objective_summary: 提出闭环网络化控制系统的数据驱动隐蔽挪用攻击框架，含解析隐蔽界的探测、在线秩增辨识与 DeePC 风格攻击合成。
evidence_note: 理论结果（子空间嵌套、投影误差单调、隐蔽界）+ 单一直流电机仿真验证；假设无噪 LTI，无真实系统实验。CONTROLO 2026 会议报告。
novelty_note: 把在线秩增实验设计与因果预测器掩蔽结合到闭环隐蔽辨识，并给出步数精确的满秩辨识保证；隐蔽攻击方向已有工作，此为行为辨识路线下的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于无噪 LTI 动态与无穷范数 IDS 的闭环设定；对非线性、时变或带噪系统以及更智能的异常检测不外推。
limitations: 无噪声假设强，实际传感噪声下的隐蔽性与辨识质量未分析；仅直流电机仿真；攻击需持续中间人位置与大量交互轮次。

title: AquaSense-ICS: A Hybrid Real-Simulated Cyber-Physical Dataset and Leakage-Aware Benchmark for Smart Water Quality Monitoring and Attack Detection
abstract: Machine-learning research on water cyber-physical systems (CPS) is constrained by datasets that are either real but chemically poor, or simulated but free of sensing noise and attacks. We present AquaSense-ICS, an open dataset and benchmark that co-registers (i) a 25.4 h recording window (8.0 h of recorded data, 26% coverage) from a Raspberry Pi 5 edge node (TDS probe and BME680 ambient sensor, 1-2 s sampling, 23,688 records), with (ii) a looped network of 13 nodes (10 junctions, 2 reservoirs, 1 tank) simulated in EPANET-MSX for six water-quality species, (iii) a parameterised library of cyber-attacks (false data injection, replay, denial of service, drift) and unintentional sensor faults with sample-level ground truth, and (iv) augmented and TimeGAN-generated sequences, flagged by an origin column. The attack, fault and water-quality labels are traceable to a seeded generator, a documented rule or a simulation input. We show that the most common way of benchmarking such hybrid data, random row splits and labels computed from the input features, yields near-perfect but uninformative scores (macro-F1 = 0.9998 for Random Forest), and we replace it with a leakage-aware protocol using chronological splits and held-out attack types rather than label reconstruction. Under this protocol, no model exceeds the constant "normal" predictor for attack classification (macro-F1 = 0.465), and the best detectors reach a mean AUROC of 0.64 on attack types unseen during training (0.35-0.93 depending on the type), leaving substantial headroom. Data and simulation files are released under CC BY 4.0 at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23390541, and attack generators and benchmark code under MIT.

title_cn: AquaSense-ICS：面向智能水质监测与攻击检测的虚实混合数据集与防泄露基准
abstract_cn: 水网络信息物理系统（CPS）的机器学习研究受制于两类数据集：要么真实但化学信息贫乏，要么仿真但不含传感噪声与攻击。我们提出 AquaSense-ICS，一个开放数据集与基准，共同配准了：(i) Raspberry Pi 5 边缘节点（TDS 探头与 BME680 环境传感器，1–2 秒采样，23,688 条记录）25.4 小时记录窗口中的 8.0 小时真实数据（26% 覆盖）；(ii) 在 EPANET-MSX 中仿真、覆盖六种水质物种的 13 节点（10 交叉点、2 水库、1 水箱）环网；(iii) 带样本级真值的参数化网络攻击库（虚假数据注入、重放、拒绝服务、漂移）与无意传感故障；(iv) 以来源列标记的增强与 TimeGAN 生成序列。攻击、故障与水质标签均可追溯到种子生成器、成文规则或仿真输入。我们表明，对此类混合数据最常见的基准方式——随机行切分与从输入特征计算标签——会产生接近完美但无信息量的分数（随机森林 macro-F1=0.9998），并代之以使用按时间切分与留出攻击类型（而非标签重构）的防泄露协议。在该协议下，没有模型在攻击分类上超过恒定「正常」预测器（macro-F1=0.465），最佳检测器对训练未见的攻击类型的平均 AUROC 为 0.64（按类型 0.35–0.93），提升空间很大。数据与仿真文件以 CC BY 4.0 发布，攻击生成器与基准代码以 MIT 发布。
summary_cn: 虚实混合水质 CPS 数据集 AquaSense-ICS：8 小时真实传感+13 节点 EPANET-MSX 仿真+样本级攻击真值；揭示随机切分致 macro-F1 虚高至 0.9998，防泄露协议下最佳检测器对未见攻击 AUROC 仅 0.64，数据与代码已开放。
objective_summary: 构建共同配准真实传感与仿真的水 CPS 数据集及参数化攻击库，提出防泄露评测协议并诚实报告现有模型的检测性能上限。
evidence_note: 真实记录与仿真共同配准、攻击/故障标签可追溯、以 CC BY 4.0 与 MIT 开放；诚实暴露基线失效（AUROC 0.64）。真实数据仅 8 小时，规模有限。
novelty_note: 把真实化学传感与含攻击仿真的水质量 CPS 共同配准并以样本级真值开放，其防泄露协议修正了该领域普遍的虚高评测；CPS 攻击检测数据集已有先例。
scope: 结论适用于水网络 CPS 与所含四类攻击；对其他 CPS 域（电网、燃气）与需要长周期季节性变化的数据需求不外推。
limitations: 真实数据仅 8 小时（26% 覆盖），时间多样性不足；TimeGAN 增强序列的真实性存疑且已用来源列标记；检测器结论受限于小规模真实-仿真配准。

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Loss Exploration for Vision-Based Perception under Non-IID Data
abstract: Vision-based image classification models benefit from Federated Learning (FL) across vehicles, however learning accurate models from distributed vehicular cameras is challenging due to data heterogeneity and privacy concerns. To improve performance on non-IID data, advanced FL optimization approaches have emerged that share auxiliary insights, such as client gradient behaviors. While these gradient-guided optimized FL methods improve the model accuracy, their reliance on sharing additional gradient information introduces a previously unexplored privacy vulnerability. In our empirical privacy-leakage experiment, we show that a malicious server can infer clients' label sets from shared guidance matrices under heterogeneous client label distributions (simulated via Dirichlet-based label partitions), between 50% and 84% accuracy. To address this privacy leakage, we propose PPFLex that replaces the central server with three Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) servers to securely compute the global guidance matrix and perform federated averaging under semi-honest and malicious MPC server assumptions. We evaluate PPFLex on widely used traffic-sign classification datasets (e.g., GTSRB and BTSC) as representative autonomous vehicle perception benchmarks, comparing against baselines. Our results show that PPFLex achieves accuracy comparable to the plain-text FedLEx pipeline while preventing privacy leakage, incurring acceptable MPC overhead.
title_cn: 非 IID 数据下视觉感知的隐私保护联邦损失探索
abstract_cn: 基于视觉的图像分类模型可从车辆间的联邦学习（FL）中受益，但由于数据异构与隐私顾虑，从分布式车载相机学习精确模型颇具挑战。为提升非 IID 数据上的性能，涌现出共享辅助信息（如客户端梯度行为）的高级 FL 优化方法。这些梯度引导的优化 FL 方法虽提升模型精度，但其对共享额外梯度信息的依赖引入了此前未被探索的隐私漏洞。在我们的经验性隐私泄露实验中，我们表明恶意服务器可以在异构客户端标签分布（用基于 Dirichlet 的标签划分模拟）下以 50%–84% 的准确率从共享引导矩阵推断客户端的标签集合。为解决该泄露，我们提出 PPFLex：用三个安全多方计算（MPC）服务器替代中心服务器，在半诚实与恶意 MPC 服务器假设下安全计算全局引导矩阵并执行联邦平均。我们在广泛使用的交通标志分类数据集（GTSRB 与 BTSC）上评估 PPFLex，与基线对比。结果表明 PPFLex 达到与明文 FedLEx 管线相当的精度，同时阻止隐私泄露，MPC 开销可接受。
summary_cn: PPFLex 研究发现梯度引导联邦学习共享的引导矩阵会以 50–84% 准确率泄露客户端标签集合，改用三服务器 MPC 安全计算引导矩阵：GTSRB/BTSC 上精度与明文 FedLEx 相当且阻止泄露。
objective_summary: 实证揭示 FedLEx 类梯度引导 FL 的标签集泄露，提出基于三服务器 MPC 的 PPFLex 在半诚实与恶意假设下保护引导矩阵计算。
evidence_note: Dirichlet 模拟非 IID 分布下的泄露实验（50–84% 准确率）与 GTSRB/BTSC 上对比明文管线的精度/开销评估；数据集规模中等、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次指出并量化「共享引导矩阵泄露标签集合」这一新泄露面，并以标准三服务器 MPC 组合给出防御；MPC 化 FL 本身是成熟路线。
scope: 结论适用于梯度引导型联邦优化与车载视觉感知场景；对其他辅助信息共享型 FL 与跨设备异构算力的通信成本未系统评估。
limitations: 泄露实验以 Dirichlet 划分模拟异构性，与真实车队数据分布有差距；三服务器 MPC 引入通信与部署成本；恶意设置下未考虑合谋阈值之上的敌手。

title: On Task, Off Track: Benchmarking LLM and Agent Robustness to Near-Target Prompt Injection
abstract: Prompt injection benchmarks assess whether large language models (LLMs) and agents resist malicious instructions embedded in external content. However, a system could perform well by rejecting attacks that obviously abandon the user's request, while still accepting changes that retain most of a legitimate answer but make it incorrect or harmful. Testing more instructions for unrelated outcomes would not necessarily reveal this weakness. We call attacks seeking responses designed to resemble legitimate answers while introducing incorrect or harmful changes near-target prompt injection. We introduce NTBench, the Near-Target Benchmark, which builds on legitimate tasks from existing datasets. For each task, a legitimate reference outcome guides the generation of target--instruction pairs, with separate tracks targeting incorrect and harmful outcomes in responses or agent tool invocations. Harmful targets can also accompany otherwise correct task completion. We combine LLM-based checks with human validation of the intended deviations, then assess whether injected instructions induce them using response judgments or tool-call checks, excluding deviations already observed without injection. We evaluate seven LLMs on ten datasets for language tasks and two agent benchmarks. Under a common budget of three attack executions per sample, both tracks achieve higher overall attack success rates than the fixed-target baseline for every evaluated model in each setting. On language tasks, the increases range from 9.3 to 35.8 percentage points for incorrect targets and 1.7 to 17.3 percentage points for harmful targets. These results show that resistance to the tested fixed-target attacks does not imply resistance to related incorrect or harmful outcomes, and that reference-guided targets broaden the failures revealed by robustness evaluation.
title_cn: 在任务上、却偏离轨道：基准测试 LLM 与智能体对近目标提示注入的鲁棒性
abstract_cn: 提示注入基准评估大语言模型（LLM）与智能体抵抗外部内容中嵌入恶意指令的能力。然而，一个系统可能因为拒绝了明显放弃用户请求的攻击而表现良好，却仍会接受保留合法答案大部分内容、但使其错误或有害的修改。测试更多指向无关结果的指令未必能揭示这一弱点。我们把寻求让响应看似合法答案、却在近处引入错误或有害修改的攻击称为近目标提示注入。我们提出 NTBench（近目标基准），它以现有数据集中的合法任务为基础：每个任务由合法参考结果引导生成目标-指令对，分设错误与有害两条轨道，针对响应或智能体工具调用中的偏离；有害目标也可伴随本已正确的任务完成出现。我们结合 LLM 判定与对预期偏离的人工验证，再用响应判定或工具调用检查评估注入指令是否诱发偏离，并排除未注入时就已观测到的偏离。我们在十个语言任务数据集与两个智能体基准上评估七个 LLM。在每样本三次攻击执行的共同预算下，两条轨道在每个设置中对每个被评测模型的总体攻击成功率都高于固定目标基线：语言任务上，错误目标提升 9.3–35.8 个百分点，有害目标提升 1.7–17.3 个百分点。这些结果表明，对受测固定目标攻击的抵抗并不意味着对相关错误或有害结果的抵抗，参考引导的目标能拓宽鲁棒性评估揭示的失效面。
summary_cn: NTBench 提出「近目标」注入：保留合法答案大部分但引入错误/有害修改，7 个 LLM、10 个语言数据集与 2 个智能体基准上攻击成功率较固定目标基线提升 9.3–35.8（错误）与 1.7–17.3（有害）个百分点。
objective_summary: 构建近目标提示注入基准 NTBench，以合法参考结果引导生成错误/有害两类目标-指令对，系统测量 LLM 与智能体对隐性篡改的鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 七个 LLM、十个语言数据集与两个智能体基准，LLM 判定加人工验证，量化报告相对固定目标基线的成功率提升；无统计检验，攻击预算为每样本三次。
novelty_note: 提出近目标注入这一新攻击类别并给出参考引导的基准构建方法，纠正现有基准「只测明显弃题攻击」的系统性盲区；注入攻击与基准方法论本身已有大量工作。
scope: 结论适用于文本与工具调用型 LLM/智能体系统及所收录数据集的任务分布；对多模态注入与需要长程上下文的攻击未覆盖。
limitations: 近目标偏离由 LLM 生成并以判定模型校验，可能引入生成/判定偏差；每样本三次攻击预算低估自适应攻击者；有害轨道的偏离人工验证规模有限。

title: Beyond Copying: Lifelong Smart Contract Security Task Construction via Protocol Mutation
abstract: AI agents can inspect code and run tests to support smart contract security. SlowMist reports about $38.6 billion in losses across the broader blockchain ecosystem. Existing evaluations can reward memorized or copied answers, including attack code recovered from public blockchain transactions. Reconstructing contracts and validating tasks also require costly manual effort. To address these issues, we propose CONSTRAINTDIAL, a framework for lifelong construction of smart contract security tasks via protocol mutation. It automates local contract reconstruction and uses attack execution to select changes to the required calls or inputs. Execution checks guide revisions that make the original attack fail while preserving exploitability, the security objective, and normal functionality. New incidents and audit findings enter the same procedure. With CONSTRAINTDIAL, we construct 3,045 task inputs from 203 public cases, covering detect, exploit, and patch. Compared with reconstruction alone, protocol mutation reduces success with supplied public answers by 10.9 percentage points on average across detect, exploit, and patch. The fraction of tasks solved by copying online answers falls by 9.3 points.
title_cn: 超越复制：通过协议变异构建终身智能合约安全任务
abstract_cn: AI 智能体可以通过审查代码与运行测试来支持智能合约安全。SlowMist 统计更广区块链生态损失约 386 亿美元。现有评测可能奖励记忆或复制的答案，包括从公开区块链交易中恢复的攻击代码；重建合约与校验任务也需昂贵的人工。为解决这些问题，我们提出 CONSTRAINTDIAL，一个通过协议变异终身构建智能合约安全任务的框架：自动化本地合约重建，并以攻击执行来选择对所需调用或输入的更改；执行检查引导修订，使原攻击失败同时保持可利用性、安全目标与正常功能；新事件与审计发现进入同一流程。基于 CONSTRAINTDIAL，我们从 203 个公开案例构建了覆盖检测、利用与修复的 3,045 个任务输入。与仅重建相比，协议变异使携带公开答案的任务成功率在检测、利用与修复上平均下降 10.9 个百分点；通过复制在线答案解决的任务比例下降 9.3 个百分点。
summary_cn: 智能合约安全任务构建框架 CONSTRAINTDIAL 以协议变异+攻击执行校验防止答案记忆：203 个公开案例生成 3,045 个检测/利用/修复任务，携带公开答案的成功率平均降 10.9 个百分点、在线答案复制率降 9.3 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出基于协议变异的终身任务构建框架 CONSTRAINTDIAL，自动重建合约并以执行校验保证原攻击失效且任务保持可利用与功能正常。
evidence_note: 203 个公开案例构建 3,045 个任务，报告携带公开答案成功率与复制率的量化下降；无统计检验，任务质量依赖执行校验规则。
novelty_note: 以攻击执行反馈驱动的协议变异实现终身防记忆任务生成，是对「评测泄漏公开答案」问题的新构建路径；合约重建与任务校验此前依赖人工。
scope: 结论适用于 EVM 兼容链公开案例可重建的智能合约安全任务；对非公开攻击、链下组件与跨合约复杂经济攻击的覆盖有限。
limitations: 变异可能改变漏洞的语义本质，需人工抽查确认；依赖公开案例的可重建性，源码缺失的老案例不可用；防复制效果对更强检索型智能体的鲁棒性未测。

title: Embedding Large PQC KEMs in IKEv2
abstract: Post-quantum key encapsulation mechanisms carry public keys far larger than the established VPN handshake protocol IKEv2 was designed for. At the same time, its initial exchange comprising the public keys cannot be fragmented. In response, the IETF discusses a range of protocol adjustments, yet these proposals have never been compared in terms of their performance and stability under identical conditions. We systematically screened the IETF document corpus for such proposals, added three of our own (one using forward error correction and two using IKEv2 with QUIC, namely QUIKE and QUIKE with a composite key exchange), identified two specification gaps in existing acknowledgment drafts, and implemented all eight on the same open-source codebase. Measurements across different bandwidths, latencies, and packet loss rates, and with ML-KEM, FrodoKEM, and Classic McEliece, total 126 500 handshakes in 1296 different configurations and show that no mechanism fully compensates for the effect of the key size on performance. For Classic McEliece, no approach handles challenging conditions acceptably. The approaches either congest the link or take up to nearly two minutes per handshake on average. For ML-KEM and FrodoKEM, there are two ways forward: building on already standardized extensions or delegating the transport. The former requires the larger implementation change and needs further optimization, such as acknowledgment mechanisms or error-correcting codes, but grants continuity and compatibility. The latter can use a composite key exchange to avoid these drawbacks and achieve a faster, more resilient handshake and leaner implementation, with QUIKE-composite offering the best overall performance.
title_cn: 把大型后量子 KEM 嵌入 IKEv2
abstract_cn: 后量子密钥封装机制的公钥远超既有 VPN 握手协议 IKEv2 设计时的尺寸，而其包含公钥的初始交换无法分片。为此，IETF 正在讨论一系列协议调整，但这些提案从未在相同条件下比较过性能与稳定性。我们系统筛查了 IETF 文档库中的此类提案，加入我们自己的三个方案（一个使用前向纠错，两个使用 IKEv2 over QUIC，即 QUIKE 与带复合密钥交换的 QUIKE），识别出现有确认草案中的两个规范缺口，并在同一开源代码库上实现了全部八个方案。在不同带宽、延迟与丢包率下、配合 ML-KEM、FrodoKEM 与 Classic McEliece 的测量共计 1296 种配置中的 126,500 次握手，表明没有任何机制能完全抵消密钥尺寸对性能的影响。对 Classic McEliece，没有方案能在严苛条件下可接受地工作：各方案要么拥塞链路，要么平均每次握手耗时接近两分钟。对 ML-KEM 与 FrodoKEM，有两条可行路径：基于已标准化的扩展构建，或将传输委托出去。前者需要更大的实现改动并需进一步优化（如确认机制或纠错码），但保持连续性与兼容性；后者可用复合密钥交换规避这些缺点，实现更快、更具韧性的握手与更精简的实现，其中 QUIKE-composite 综合性能最佳。
summary_cn: 在同一代码库实现 8 种 IKEv2 后量子嵌入选案并实测 1,296 种配置共 126,500 次握手：无一能完全抵消密钥尺寸影响，Classic McEliece 在严苛条件下均不可接受，ML-KEM/FrodoKEM 下 QUIKE-composite 综合最优。
objective_summary: 系统实现并统一测量 IETF 讨论中的 IKEv2 后量子嵌入方案及自提的三个新方案（含 QUIKE-composite），覆盖三种 KEM 与 1,296 种网络配置。
evidence_note: 同一开源代码库实现全部 8 方案；三种 KEM、跨带宽/延迟/丢包 1,296 配置、126,500 次握手的受控测量；并指出两个规范缺口。
novelty_note: 首次在相同条件下系统比较 IETF 各 IKEv2-PQC 提案，自提 FEC 方案与 IKEv2-over-QUIC 的 QUIKE/QUIKE-composite 并识别草案缺口；单个机制多为已知组件的组合。
scope: 结论适用于 IKEv2 生态与所测三种 KEM 参数；对 TLS 等其他握手协议与其他 KEM 参数集不外推；测量基于特定开源实现。
limitations: 性能结论依赖所实现的代码质量；未覆盖所有 IETF 提案的参数组合；QUIC 路径的部署与防火墙穿透等运维因素未测量。

title: DeepAVR: Deep Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Vulnerability Repair
abstract: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has emerged as a critical defense against software security flaws, aiming to triage and fix bugs autonomously. Early LLM-based approaches focused on patch generation under the assumption of perfect fault localization, while recent end-to-end methods attempt to repair vulnerabilities directly from sanitizer logs. However, these methods often fail when the root cause is deeply hidden--either physically distant from the crash site or logically masked by interdependent errors--making the initial report insufficient. We propose DeepAVR, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end AVR that performs deep analysis by transforming intermediate repair outcomes into structured diagnostic feedback. DeepAVR decomposes repair into specialized roles--Fault Localization, Patch Generation, Compile Validation, Security Validation, Functionality Validation, and Patch Review--and routes feedback across these roles to iteratively refine both localization and patch hypotheses. In particular, DeepAVR introduces patch-conditioned re-localization, which treats execution results from intermediate patches as diagnostic signals to uncover hidden root causes, and a root-cause-oriented patch review stage that detects symptom-level fixes and incomplete repairs beyond execution-based validation. Evaluation on the real-world C/C++ vulnerability repair dataset VulnLoc shows that DeepAVR significantly outperforms prior methods, generating correct patches for 92.3% of vulnerabilities. Furthermore, results on SAN2VULN demonstrate strong generalization, with DeepAVR effectively repairing vulnerabilities unseen during training.
title_cn: DeepAVR：通过多智能体协作进行深度分析的自动化漏洞修复
abstract_cn: 自动化漏洞修复（AVR）已成为对抗软件安全缺陷的关键防线，旨在自主分诊并修复漏洞。早期基于 LLM 的方法在假定完美故障定位的前提下生成补丁，而近期的端到端方法尝试直接从 sanitizer 日志修复漏洞。然而当根因藏得很深——要么在物理上远离崩溃点，要么被相互依赖的错误逻辑掩盖——时，这些方法常会失败，因为初始报告已不充分。我们提出 DeepAVR，一个执行深度分析的端到端 AVR 多智能体框架，它把中间修复结果转化为结构化的诊断反馈。DeepAVR 把修复分解为专门角色——故障定位、补丁生成、编译验证、安全验证、功能验证与补丁评审——并在这些角色间路由反馈，迭代细化定位与补丁假设。特别是，DeepAVR 引入补丁条件重定位，把中间补丁的执行结果作为诊断信号以揭示隐藏根因；以及面向根因的补丁评审阶段，检测执行验证之外的症状级修复与不完整修复。在真实 C/C++ 漏洞修复数据集 VulnLoc 上，DeepAVR 显著超越先前方法，为 92.3% 的漏洞生成正确补丁；在 SAN2VULN 上的结果显示强泛化能力，能修复训练中未见过的漏洞。
summary_cn: 多智能体漏洞修复框架 DeepAVR 以补丁条件重定位把中间补丁执行结果当诊断信号深挖根因：真实 C/C++ 数据集 VulnLoc 上 92.3% 生成正确补丁，显著超越先前方法，并在 SAN2VULN 上验证对未见漏洞的泛化。
objective_summary: 提出六角色多智能体 AVR 框架 DeepAVR，通过补丁条件重定位与根因导向补丁评审迭代细化定位与补丁假设。
evidence_note: 真实 C/C++ 数据集 VulnLoc 上 92.3% 正确补丁并显著超越先前方法，SAN2VULN 上验证泛化；以单一基准族为主、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 补丁条件重定位（把中间补丁执行当诊断信号）与根因导向补丁评审是针对「根因远离崩溃点」场景的新机制；LLM 多角色协作修复的结构已有类似工作。
scope: 结论适用于带可复现 sanitizer 报告的 C/C++ 漏洞；对无崩溃报告的逻辑漏洞、非 C/C++ 语言与需大范围跨模块重构的修复未验证。
limitations: 多智能体多轮验证的调用成本显著；VulnLoc 之外的真实分布泛化证据有限；补丁评审依赖 LLM 判断，可能放过语义上有问题的症状级修复。

title: Data-Efficient Backdoor Attacks on Code Models via Trigger-Neutralized Counterfactual Scoring
abstract: Pre-trained code models are exposed to backdoor poisoning, in which crafted training samples make the model misbehave on a trigger. A capable attacker minimizes the number of such samples, since each adds cost and exposure and a lower poisoning rate leaves a smaller footprint for defenses. Which samples to poison therefore matters, but existing data-efficient selection methods target image classification, offer no scoring mechanism for autoregressive generation, and have not been studied on code. We propose Trigger-Neutralized Counterfactual Scoring (TNCS), which isolates a trigger's contribution to the target behavior by comparing the scoring model's output on a triggered input with its output on a trigger-neutralized counterfactual, covering classification and generation alike. TNCS attains higher attack success rates than the baselines at very low poisoning ratios, across three CodeXGLUE tasks and five trigger families, without degrading clean-task performance, and its margin grows as the ratio decreases. It is the only method effective on every trigger family, and its selected poison set transfers to mismatched victims.
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 14 Tables
title_cn: 基于触发中和反事实评分的代码模型数据高效后门攻击
abstract_cn: 预训练代码模型面临后门投毒风险：构造的训练样本使模型在触发器上行为异常。有能力的攻击者会最小化此类样本数量，因为每个样本都增加成本与暴露，且更低投毒率给防御留下的足迹更小。因此投毒哪些样本很重要，但现有数据高效选择方法面向图像分类、对自回归生成不提供评分机制，也未在代码上被研究。我们提出触发中和反事实评分（TNCS)：通过比较评分模型在触发输入与触发中和反事实上的输出，隔离触发器对目标行为的贡献，同时覆盖分类与生成。在三个 CodeXGLUE 任务与五个触发器家族上，TNCS 在极低投毒比下取得比基线更高的攻击成功率，且不损害干净任务性能，且其优势随投毒比下降而扩大。它是唯一在所有触发器家族上都有效的方法，其选出的投毒集可迁移到不匹配的受害者模型。
summary_cn: 投毒样本选择方法 TNCS 用「触发 vs 触发中和」反事实输出差隔离触发器贡献：三个 CodeXGLUE 任务、五个触发器家族上在极低投毒比下成功率超基线且不伤干净性能，是唯一全触发器有效的选择法并可跨受害模型迁移。
objective_summary: 提出触发中和反事实评分 TNCS，为代码模型后门投毒选择高价值样本，在分类与生成任务上以更低投毒率达成攻击。
evidence_note: 三个 CodeXGLUE 任务、五个触发器家族系统对比基线，报告随投毒比变化的优势扩大与跨受害者迁移；无统计检验，受害模型数量未完整报告。
novelty_note: 首个面向自回归代码生成的投毒样本评分机制，触发中和反事实的设计使选择同时适用分类与生成；后门攻击与数据高效投毒两个方向本身均已成熟。
scope: 结论适用于预训练/微调代码模型与所测五类触发器；对运行时触发器（非数据触发）与带投毒检测的训练管线防御未评估。
limitations: 反事实生成依赖触发器可被程序化中和，对不可逆/语义触发器可能失效；攻击评估未包含最新投毒防御；迁移实验限于代码模型家族内。

title: Automated Post-Exploitation Attack Chain Exploration Based on a Phase-guided Hybrid Planning-Monte Carlo Tree Search Algorithm
abstract: Advanced attackers in post-exploitation scenarios increasingly craft attack chains that combine benign operations, configuration errors, and vulnerability exploitation to achieve objectives like privilege escalation. While such chains pose significant threats, manually discovering them in complex modern host environments is prohibitively labor-intensive. Automating this discovery is therefore essential for proactive defense, yet existing methods still suffer from inefficiency and lack diversity when exploring these attack chains. To address these limitations, we present APEX, an Automated Post-EXploitation attack chain exploration system. This system transforms attack chain discovery into a planning problem and solves it with a novel phase-guided hybrid Planning-Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm. By organizing attack actions into semantic phases and integrating symbolic planning with MCTS, APEX enables efficient exploration of the state space while generating multiple diverse chains. Evaluations on a benchmark comprising 5 virtual machines, 30 synthetic problems and 291 cloud instances demonstrate that APEX successfully discovers both known and previously unreported attack chains--including 9 novel privilege escalation vectors--providing actionable intelligence for hardening complex production environments.
title_cn: 基于阶段引导的规划-蒙特卡洛树搜索混合算法的后渗透攻击链自动探索
abstract_cn: 后渗透场景中的高级攻击者日益把良性操作、配置错误与漏洞利用组合成攻击链，以达成权限提升等目标。此类链威胁显著，但在复杂现代主机环境中人工发现它们的人力成本高得令人望而却步。因此自动化发现对主动防御至关重要，而现有方法在探索这些攻击链时仍存在效率不足与多样性缺失。为解决这些局限，我们提出后渗透攻击链自动探索系统 APEX。该系统把攻击链发现转化为规划问题，用新颖的阶段引导混合规划-蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）算法求解。通过把攻击动作组织成语义阶段并把符号规划与 MCTS 结合，APEX 在高效探索状态空间的同时生成多条多样化攻击链。在包含 5 台虚拟机、30 个合成问题与 291 个云实例的基准上，APEX 成功发现已知与此前未报告的攻击链——包括 9 个新权限提升向量——为加固复杂生产环境提供可执行的情报。
summary_cn: 后渗透攻击链探索系统 APEX 用阶段引导的符号规划+MCTS 混合搜索：在 5 台 VM、30 个合成问题与 291 个云实例上发现已知及未报告攻击链，包括 9 个新权限提升向量。
objective_summary: 提出把攻击链发现形式化为规划问题并用阶段引导混合 Planning-MCTS 求解的系统 APEX，自动生成多样化后渗透攻击链。
evidence_note: 5 VM + 30 合成问题 + 291 云实例的基准评估，报告已知链复现与 9 个新提权向量；未与既有自动化攻击链方法定量对比，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 阶段语义组织 + 符号规划与 MCTS 混合是对既有攻击规划/图搜索方法的实质性改进，重点解决探索效率与链多样性；攻击链自动化本身已有较多工作。
scope: 结论适用于可枚举动作与状态的主机/云环境；对需要社会工程或物理访问的初始入侵阶段与真实生产网络的直接验证未覆盖。
limitations: 评估以合成问题与实验云实例为主，与真实企业环境配置存在差距；动作库覆盖面决定可发现的链空间；新提权向量未报告是否已负责任披露。

title: Autonomous Cyber Weapons as AI-Enabled Digital Harms: A Platform Accountability Framework
abstract: Governments govern AI-generated online harms from commercial platforms (EU DSA, AI Act, UK Online Safety Act), yet the most severe class remains ungoverned: autonomous cyber weapons (ACWs) deployed by nation-states against civilian infrastructure. We address this gap with three contributions: a digital-harm taxonomy (six ACW modes $\times$ five harm categories); the Meaningful Human Control (MHC) Model, a governance-compliance function with a closed-form IHL threshold and a proved weight-sensitivity bound; and a platform accountability architecture with treaty language grounded in ARSIWA state-responsibility doctrine, not Rome Statute individual responsibility. Applied to eleven documented state-attributed operations and one hypothetical defensive AI system, every documented case falls in an accountability vacuum; the threshold is target-dependent, and against wholly civilian targets no system studied clears it, including the hypothetical. Three further incidents are correctly excluded on autonomy/attribution grounds, a discriminant-validity check. The weights and threshold parameters are illustrative, not fitted.
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Presented at the 2026 IDeaS Conference (Carnegie Mellon University)
title_cn: 作为 AI 赋能数字危害的自主网络武器：一个平台问责框架
abstract_cn: 各国政府治理来自商业平台的 AI 生成在线危害（欧盟 DSA、AI 法案、英国在线安全法），但最严重的一类仍处于无治理状态：民族国家针对民用基础设施部署的自主网络武器（ACW）。我们以三项贡献填补这一空白：数字危害分类法（六种 ACW 模式 × 五类危害）；有意义人类控制（MHC）模型——一个带闭式国际人道法阈值与已证明的权重敏感性界的治理合规函数；以及以 ARSIWA 国家责任学说（而非罗马规约个人责任）为基础、附条约措辞的平台问责架构。应用于 11 次有记录的国家归因行动与一个假想的防御性 AI 系统时，每个有记录案例都落在问责真空之中；阈值是目标依赖的，对纯民用目标，所研究的系统无一达标，包括假想系统。三起进一步的事件基于自主性/归因理由被正确排除，构成判别效度检验。权重与阈值参数为示例性设定，未经拟合。
summary_cn: 提出自主网络武器的危害分类法（6 模式×5 危害）与带闭式 IHL 阈值的 MHC 治理合规函数：11 起国家归因行动全部落在问责真空，对纯民用目标无一系统（含假想防御系统）达标。
objective_summary: 构建 ACW 数字危害分类法、有意义人类控制治理模型与基于国家责任的平台问责架构，并以历史行动做判别效度检验。
evidence_note: 对 11 起公开归因行动与 1 个假想系统的规范应用及判别效度检查；作者自陈权重与阈值为示例性而非拟合数据，无经验验证。2026 IDeaS 会议（CMU）报告。
novelty_note: 把自主网络武器纳入数字危害治理框架并给出闭式 IHL 合规阈值与权重敏感性证明；以 ARSIWA 而非罗马规约构建条约语言是新的制度设计路径。
scope: 结论适用于以国家为行为主体、针对民用基础设施的 ACW 治理讨论；对非国家行为者、纯军事目标的冲突法适用与执行机制未展开。
limitations: 权重与阈值未经数据拟合，属示例性设定；历史案例的信息可得性限制了模式打分的精度；平台问责架构的可行性未与实际平台机制对接。

title: Democratic Accountability for Autonomous Systems: A Legislative Notification Framework and Comparative Institutional Design
abstract: No domestic legislature has ever reviewed a state's decision to authorise an autonomous cyber weapon before it acted. Closing the international attribution gap is necessary but not sufficient for democratic accountability. We formalise the Tripartite Attribution Framework's three attribution levels and add a fourth, non-legal Democratic Accountability level ($A_{dem}$): a 72-hour legislative notification requirement. Scoring six democratic oversight bodies against five adoptability dimensions yields a counter-intuitive result: the statutes granting these bodies privileged access to classified material are often the same statutes withholding particular ongoing operations from them, so at most one could lawfully receive such a notification today, and the carve-out Level 4 needs is required in nearly every jurisdiction rather than only the least-equipped. Retrospective analysis of Stuxnet, NotPetya, and Volt Typhoon shows one pattern: legal attribution resolvable, domestic democratic review absent.
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 2026 IDeaS Conference (Carnegie Mellon University)
title_cn: 自主系统的民主问责：立法通知框架与比较制度设计
abstract_cn: 从未有国内立法机构在自主网络武器行动之前审查过该国的授权决定。弥合国际归因差距是必要的，但对民主问责而言并不充分。我们形式化了三方归因框架的三个归因层级，并新增第四个非法律层级的民主问责（A_dem）：72 小时立法通知要求。按五个可采纳维度对六个民主监督机构打分，得到一个反直觉结果：赋予这些机构接触机密材料特权的法规，往往也正是把特定进行中行动排除在其视野之外的法规，因此今天至多只有一个机构能合法接收此类通知，且第四层级所需的豁免几乎在每个司法辖区都存在，而非仅在装备最差者那里。对 Stuxnet、NotPetya 与 Volt Typhoon 的回溯分析显示同一模式：法律归因可解，国内民主审查缺席。
summary_cn: 提出自主网络武器的 72 小时立法通知问责层级：对六个民主监督机构的比较显示，授权其接触机密的法规往往同时排除进行中行动，至多一家今天能合法接收通知；三起网络行动均呈现法律归因可解、民主审查缺席。
objective_summary: 形式化加入民主问责层级的归因框架，比较六个民主监督机构的制度能力并回溯分析三起网络行动，论证 72 小时立法通知的必要性。
evidence_note: 基于六国监督法规的文本比较与三起公开事件的回溯分析；无定量验证或受控实验，属政策论证性证据。2026 IDeaS 会议（CMU）报告。
novelty_note: 在三方归因框架上新增民主问责层级并给出 72 小时通知设计；「授权法规同时设排除条款」这一反直觉制度发现具有新意。
scope: 结论适用于民主政体的立法监督制度设计；对非民主体制、国际法层面的军控机制与私营平台角色未展开。
limitations: 机构评分维度由作者设定，权重主观；事件回溯依赖公开报道，受保密信息不可得限制；72 小时时限的选择缺乏敏感性分析。

title: Tracing Money Laundering Across DeFi, Bridges, and Mixers on Ethereum
abstract: Illicit actors exploit Ethereum's deep liquidity and diverse on-chain services to launder criminal proceeds by combining decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, cross-chain bridges, and mixers in multi-stage processes. Existing anti-money laundering tracing methods fail to disentangle the underlying asset-flow paths in complex transactions, potentially misdirecting subsequent tracing; cannot identify cross-chain intent without pre-collected bridge information; and treat mixers as generic exit services, overlooking post-mixer laundering flows. We present FPTracer, a framework for tracing illicit assets across Ethereum services. First, we propose a method based on the Context-Aware Transfer Tree (CATT) to recover intra-transaction asset-flow paths, which guide accurate tracing and service analysis. Second, we extract discriminative features from asset-flow and execution-evidence perspectives and train a classifier to identify transactions with cross-chain intent. Third, we leverage evidence from the upstream laundering network to analyze potential post-mixer laundering activities. Evaluation on 20 real-world laundering cases demonstrates FPTracer's effectiveness. It achieves the highest recall for both known laundering addresses (98.6%) and destinations (94.2%). It identifies all known uses of bridges in these cases and uncovers 30 previously unreported ones. Among 18 cases with identified Tornado Cash usage, FPTracer can identify potential withdrawal-side activities, which are corroborated by public reports where available.
title_cn: 追踪以太坊上跨 DeFi、跨链桥与混币器的洗钱
abstract_cn: 非法行为者利用以太坊的深度流动性与多样的链上服务，通过把去中心化金融（DeFi）协议、跨链桥与混币器组合进多阶段流程来清洗犯罪所得。现有反洗钱追踪方法难以在复杂交易中解开底层资产流路径、可能误导后续追踪；无法在未预收集桥信息的情况下识别跨链意图；并把混币器当作普通出口服务，忽视混币后的洗钱流。我们提出 FPTracer，一个跨以太坊服务追踪非法资产的框架。第一，提出基于上下文感知转移树（CATT）的方法恢复交易内资产流路径，为精确追踪与服务分析提供引导。第二，从资产流与执行证据两个视角提取判别特征，训练分类器识别具有跨链意图的交易。第三，利用上游洗钱网络的证据分析潜在的混币后洗钱活动。在 20 个真实洗钱案例上的评估证明 FPTracer 的有效性：对已知洗钱地址（98.6%）与去向（94.2%）均取得最高召回；识别出这些案例中所有已知的桥使用，并新发现 30 个此前未报告的桥使用；在 18 个确认使用 Tornado Cash 的案例中，FPTracer 能识别潜在的提款侧活动，在可得处与公开报告相互印证。
summary_cn: 洗钱追踪框架 FPTracer 以上下文感知转移树恢复交易内资产流、分类跨链意图并分析混币后活动：20 个真实案例中对已知地址/去向召回 98.6%/94.2%，并新发现 30 个未报告的桥使用。
objective_summary: 提出 FPTracer 框架，通过交易内资产流恢复、跨链意图识别与混币后活动分析，实现以太坊上跨 DeFi、桥与混币器的非法资金追踪。
evidence_note: 20 个真实洗钱案例评估，地址/去向召回 98.6%/94.2%，新发现 30 个桥使用并与公开报告互证；案例数有限，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 针对现有 AML 追踪的三个具体缺口（交易内资产流解缠、无先验的跨链意图识别、混币后追踪）给出系统方法，其中 CATT 资产流树是新的中间表示。
scope: 结论适用于以太坊及兼容 EVM 链上可解析的 DeFi/桥/混币器交互；对隐私链、原生跨链消息协议与新型混币设计未覆盖。
limitations: 评估限于 20 个已披露案例，可能存在选择偏差；跨链意图分类器依赖训练数据分布；提款侧推断为概率性结论，需外部证据印证。

title: The 3DS Oracle: BIN Attack via the Network
abstract: EMV 3-D Secure (3DS) requires a client-visible continuation boundary in browser-mediated flows; in some deployments, that boundary exposes a pre-authorization classification channel. This paper studies 3DS as a protocol, integration surface, and governance problem, combining standards analysis, architectural reconstruction, formal modeling, a documentation audit, disclosure history, and a bounded live evaluation. We show that client-visible integrations can reflect routing and authentication state before financial authorization, allowing 3DS to function as a profiling and screening channel for issuer controls and cardholder/account state rather than only as a defense. In the tested browser-channel Braintree/Cardinal path, the first client-visible result separated researcher-owned anchor cards from bounded adjacent same-range comparison PANs in six of seven distinct ACS/card-range cohorts; separate public evidence, including openly accessible attacker tooling, rotating-proxy support, and illicit paid 3DS card-testing services, shows that comparable signals are already operationalized in the wild. Our live study was deliberately bounded for ethical reasons, so the empirical ceiling reported here reflects researcher restraint rather than an attacker-side scalability limit, although we do not claim network-wide prevalence or candidate issuance. The deeper issue is systemic: decoupled pre-authorization authentication, weak requestor-boundary assumptions, identifier-linked routing invariants, and fragmented accountability let the exposure persist even when individual actors appear locally conformant. Meaningful remediation therefore requires consortium-level reform, including stricter minimization of client-visible pre-authorization responses, more uniform continuation behavior, and stronger client authenticity and session binding.

title_cn: 3DS 预言机：经由网络的 BIN 攻击
abstract_cn: EMV 3-D Secure（3DS）在浏览器介导的流程中要求一个客户端可见的续接边界；在某些部署中，该边界暴露了一个预授权分类信道。本文把 3DS 作为协议、集成面与治理问题来研究，综合标准分析、架构重建、形式化建模、文档审计、披露历史与有边界的真实环境评估。我们表明，客户端可见的集成可以在金融授权之前反映路由与认证状态，使 3DS 不仅是防御手段，还能充当发卡行控制与持卡人/账户状态的画像与筛查信道。在受测的浏览器通道 Braintree/Cardinal 路径上，首个客户端可见结果在七个不同的 ACS/卡段组群中的六个里，把研究者自有的锚定卡与有边界的相邻同段对比 PAN 区分开；独立的公开证据（包括公开可得的攻击工具、轮换代理支持与非法付费 3DS 卡测服务）表明类似信号已在野被实际利用。出于伦理考虑，我们的真实研究刻意设置边界，因此此处报告的经验上限反映的是研究者的克制而非攻击方的可扩展性极限；我们也不声称全网范围的普遍性或候选发卡。更深层的问题是系统性的：解耦的预授权认证、薄弱的请求方边界假设、与标识符挂钩的路由不变量以及碎片化的责任划分，使得即使单个参与方看起来都合规，这一暴露面仍持续存在。有意义的修复因此需要行业联盟层面的改革，包括更严格地最小化客户端可见的预授权响应、更统一的续接行为，以及更强的客户端真实性与会话绑定。
summary_cn: 系统性研究 EMV 3DS 的预授权暴露面：浏览器通道首个客户端可见结果在 7 个 ACS/卡段组群的 6 个中区分了锚定卡与相邻卡段，可被用作卡测/画像预言机；公开攻击工具与付费卡测服务表明该信号已在野利用，修复需联盟级改革。
objective_summary: 综合标准分析、形式化建模与有边界的真实评估，刻画 3DS 客户端可见预授权响应作为画像/筛查信道的暴露面及其系统性治理成因。
evidence_note: 多方法研究：标准分析、形式化建模、文档审计、披露历史与有边界的真实 Braintree/Cardinal 评估（7 个组群中 6 个可区分）；受伦理约束规模有限，未声称全网普遍性。
novelty_note: 系统刻画 3DS 作为预授权画像/筛查信道的暴露面，并给出形式化建模与联盟级改革建议；在野卡测信号已有公开证据，本文贡献是协议-治理层面的系统分析。
scope: 结论适用于浏览器通道的 3DS 集成与受测 Braintree/Cardinal 路径；对非浏览器通道（App、SDK 直连）与其他 ACS 实现未验证。
limitations: 真实评估受伦理约束刻意缩小规模，经验上限不代表攻击者极限；仅覆盖一个支付服务商标路径；对修复方案的代价与效果未量化。

title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
title_cn: 视觉语言模型中依赖深度的安全几何：层级定位与双向拒绝控制
abstract_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被广泛部署，但其安全行为背后的内部机制仍知之甚少。我们提出一个轻量推理时框架，用于在冻结 VLM 中定位并操纵安全敏感表示，无需重训或修改参数。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，层级激活分歧分析显示安全几何沿深度非均匀分布。因果干预表明，早期视觉层通过沿学习到的安全方向做激活转向支持强双向拒绝控制，不安全拒绝跨度为 6%–96%；而后层对激活幅值缩放响应更强，并表现出明显的安全-选择性权衡。更深层沿安全方向分离良好，却对转向基本不敏感，从而区分了表示可分性与因果可控性。InternVL2.5-4B 尽管层位置与幅值不同，也表现出质性相似的深度依赖激活几何。我们的结果暴露了 VLM 视觉编码器中的白盒表示级拒绝绕过攻击面，并促使对安全敏感表示做推理时稳定化。
summary_cn: 对冻结 VLM 的层级干预显示安全几何沿深度非均匀：早期视觉层转向可实现 6%–96% 的双向拒绝控制，深层可分却不可控，暴露白盒表示级拒绝绕过攻击面（Qwen3-VL-4B 与 InternVL2.5-4B）。
objective_summary: 通过层级激活分歧分析与因果干预，定位 VLM 安全敏感表示的深度分布并测量双向拒绝可控性，区分表示可分性与因果可控性。
evidence_note: 两个 VLM（Qwen3-VL-4B、InternVL2.5-4B）上的层级因果干预与交叉验证；给出 6%–96% 拒绝跨度等量化结果；NeurIPS 2026 workshop 录用；模型规模有限。
novelty_note: 揭示 VLM 安全几何随深度非均匀、且表示可分性与因果可控性分离这一诊断性发现，并给出视觉编码器侧的拒绝绕过攻击面刻画。
scope: 结论基于两个 4B 级 VLM 与冻结权重的推理时干预；对更大规模模型、其他架构的安全几何未验证。
limitations: 仅两个 4B 模型，外推到更大模型需谨慎；防护建议（推理时稳定化）未做系统实现与评测；攻击面分析以白盒访问为前提。

title: Curvature-Aware Clipping: Mitigating Bias in DPSGD via Approximate Second-Order Information
abstract: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DPSGD) has become the de facto standard for training deep neural networks with rigorous privacy guarantees. However, the utility of DPSGD is constrained by gradient clipping bias and DP noise. While existing work has tried to address these issues, the geometric misalignment caused by clipping bias remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework, Curvature-Aware Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (CA-DPSGD), which leverages approximate second-order information to construct an optimal, curvature-aware clipping space. CA-DPSGD integrates a rectified estimator for the curvature matrix and is coupled with an anisotropic noise mechanism to ensure privacy guarantees. Extensive empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art clipping methods.
comment: Accepted at the 18th International Workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning (OPT 2026)
title_cn: 曲率感知裁剪：用近似二阶信息缓解 DPSGD 的偏差
abstract_cn: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DPSGD）已成为以严格隐私保证训练深度神经网络的事实标准。然而 DPSGD 的效用受梯度裁剪偏差与 DP 噪声制约。尽管已有工作尝试解决这些问题，裁剪偏差导致的几何失配仍是关键挑战。为弥合该差距，我们提出曲率感知差分隐私随机梯度下降（CA-DPSGD）新框架，利用近似二阶信息构造最优的曲率感知裁剪空间。CA-DPSGD 集成了曲率矩阵的校正估计器，并耦合各向异性噪声机制以保证隐私。大量实证实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的裁剪方法。
summary_cn: CA-DPSGD 用近似二阶信息构造曲率感知裁剪空间并耦合各向异性 DP 噪声，缓解 DPSGD 梯度裁剪的几何失配偏差，实验显示优于现有最先进裁剪方法。
objective_summary: 提出曲率感知裁剪框架 CA-DPSGD，以校正的曲率矩阵估计与各向异性噪声机制降低 DPSGD 裁剪偏差。
evidence_note: 大量实证实验对比最先进裁剪方法；OPT 2026 workshop 录用；摘要未给出具体数据集、规模与显著性检验。
novelty_note: 以近似二阶曲率信息重构造裁剪空间并将噪声改为各向异性，是对 DPSGD 裁剪偏差这一已知问题的新机制；DP 噪声各向异化已有先行工作。
scope: 结论适用于基于梯度裁剪的 DPSGD 训练场景；对非裁剪类 DP 机制（如 DP-FTRL）与超大规模预训练的适用性未验证。
limitations: 曲率矩阵估计引入额外计算与内存开销；摘要未报告与逐层/自适应裁剪等最新基线的全面对比；隐私-效用权衡的理论分析深度在摘要层面不明。

title: Detecting Insecure Compositions of Clean Agent Skills via Capability-Flow Graph Analysis
abstract: AI agents increasingly extend their capabilities by invoking third-party skills, where each skill encapsulates instructions, scripts, and resources for agents to execute on demand. This paper reveals that deploying many benign skills together introduces compositional security risks: multiple individually clean skills can compose into safety-violation chains, because the agent passes an upstream skill's output to a downstream skill's input across invocations. The risk arises not from any single skill, but from the agent's runtime orchestration, and thus cannot be captured by existing malicious skill detection methods. To this end, we develop KnotScryer to detect insecure skill compositions by treating skills as typed capability flows. In particular, we abstract each skill into a capability summary, and construct the Skill Capability-Flow Graph (SCFG), where edges denote cross-skill information flow. Moreover, we design a search policy that tracks protected or untrusted data along handoff edges to locate paths reaching insecure operations. Finally, a two-layer verification method replays the insecure information flow for reachability analysis and applies a task-anchored LLM chain audit to confirm the semantic plausibility of the identified violation chains. We deploy KnotScryer to analyze 13,598 clean skills from ClawHub, and validate the detected chains across three agent frameworks and three LLMs. KnotScryer identifies 612 insecure compositions, which are consistently exploited across agent frameworks. Meanwhile, under GLM-5.1, it outperforms tag-match and graph-only baselines by improving the exploitation rate from 16.5%-18.2% to 85.6%, while reducing the search space by 85.3%. Furthermore, 13.7% of the detected chains consist entirely of skills labeled safe by a single-skill scanner, showing that KnotScryer effectively identifies insecure compositions that per-skill auditing cannot.

title_cn: 通过能力流图分析检测洁净智能体技能的不安全组合
abstract_cn: AI 智能体越来越多地通过调用第三方技能扩展能力，每个技能封装了供智能体按需执行的指令、脚本与资源。本文揭示，把多个良性技能一起部署会引入组合安全风险：多个单独洁净的技能可以组合成违背安全的链条，因为智能体会把上游技能的输出传给下游技能的输入。风险并非来自任何单个技能，而是来自智能体的运行时编排，因此现有的恶意技能检测方法无法捕捉。为此，我们开发 KnotScryer，把技能视为类型化的能力流来检测不安全技能组合：把每个技能抽象为能力摘要，构建技能能力流图（SCFG），边表示跨技能信息流；设计搜索策略沿交接边追踪受保护或不可信数据，定位到达不安全操作的路径；最后用两层验证方法——重放不安全信息流做可达性分析、并用任务锚定的 LLM 链审计确认违规链条的语义合理性——加以确认。我们将 KnotScryer 部署到 ClawHub 的 13,598 个洁净技能上，并在三个智能体框架与三个 LLM 上验证检测到的链条。KnotScryer 识别出 612 个不安全组合，它们在各智能体框架上均可被一致利用。在 GLM-5.1 下，它把可利用率从基线的 16.5%–18.2% 提升到 85.6%，同时把搜索空间缩小 85.3%。此外，13.7% 的检测链条完全由被单技能扫描器标为安全的技能组成，表明 KnotScryer 能有效发现单技能审计无法发现的不安全组合。
summary_cn: KnotScryer 以能力流图检测洁净技能的不安全组合：ClawHub 13,598 个技能中发现 612 条组合链，可利用率从 16.5–18.2% 升至 85.6%，13.7% 的链条全由单技能扫描判安全的技能组成。
objective_summary: 提出技能能力流图（SCFG）与两层验证方法，检测单独洁净但组合后违规的智能体技能链，并在真实技能市场数据上验证可利用率。
evidence_note: 13,598 个真实市场技能的大规模分析；三个智能体框架与三个 LLM 上实测可利用率（85.6% vs 16.5–18.2%）；报告搜索空间缩减与单技能扫描器对照。
novelty_note: 首次系统刻画「单独洁净技能组合成违规链」这一编排层风险，提出类型化能力流抽象与任务锚定 LLM 链审计；现有恶意技能检测均以单技能为单位。
scope: 结论适用于以技能/插件形式扩展能力、跨调用传递数据的智能体框架；对技能间不共享运行时的隔离型架构未覆盖。
limitations: 能力摘要的抽取可能遗漏隐式信息流；LLM 链审计的语义判断依赖模型能力；验证覆盖三个框架，其他生态的技能 API 形态可能不同。

title: AgentTrace: Execution-Level Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Agents
abstract: Verifying the provenance of autonomous LLM agents is a critical security challenge. Existing semantic attribution is easily obfuscated by system prompts, while active watermarking conflicts with schema-constrained tool generation. We propose AgentTrace, an active framework that identifies the foundation model behind a black-box agent via observable execution traces. AgentTrace injects structurally ambiguous probes to trigger tokenization-sensitive serialization failures at rigid tool interfaces. While these initial failures provide coarse-grained separation across model families, the temporal sequence of subsequent repair operations reveals fine-grained, model-specific recovery behaviors. By modeling these multi-step trajectories with lightweight Markov chains, AgentTrace achieves 96.0% attribution accuracy under adversarial identity spoofing. Crucially, sequential repair modeling successfully distinguishes the evaluated intra-family variants sharing identical tokenizers (e.g., Llama-3 8B/70B), substantially outperforming unordered behavioral statistics while remaining robust against prompt obfuscation and temperature scaling.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures
title_cn: AgentTrace：面向黑盒 LLM 智能体的执行级指纹识别
abstract_cn: 验证自主 LLM 智能体的来源是关键安全挑战。现有语义归因易被系统提示混淆，而主动水印与模式约束的工具生成相冲突。我们提出 AgentTrace，一个通过可观测执行踪迹识别黑盒智能体背后基础模型的主动框架。AgentTrace 注入结构歧义探针，在刚性的工具接口处触发对分词敏感的序列化失败。这些初始失败提供跨模型家族的粗粒度区分，而后续修复操作的时间序列则揭示细粒度、模型特定的恢复行为。通过用轻量马尔可夫链建模这些多步轨迹，AgentTrace 在对抗身份伪造下达到 96.0% 的归因准确率。关键的是，序贯修复建模成功区分了共享相同分词器的同家族变体（如 Llama-3 8B/70B），显著优于无序行为统计，同时对提示混淆与温度缩放保持鲁棒。
summary_cn: AgentTrace 通过歧义探针触发工具接口的序列化失败并用马尔可夫链建模后续修复轨迹来识别黑盒智能体的底层模型：对抗伪造下归因准确率 96.0%，可区分同分词器的 Llama-3 8B/70B 等家族内变体。
objective_summary: 提出执行级主动指纹框架 AgentTrace：注入结构歧义探针、建模序列化失败与修复轨迹，实现对抗伪造下的基础模型归因。
evidence_note: 对抗身份伪造下 96.0% 归因准确率，验证家族内变体区分，并对提示混淆与温度缩放做鲁棒性检查；模型覆盖规模未完整报告，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 绕开易被混淆的语义归因与难部署的主动水印，提出「结构歧义探针→分词敏感失败→修复轨迹建模」的执行级指纹路线，属智能体场景的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于暴露结构化工具调用接口的黑盒智能体；对无工具使用的纯对话智能体或可篡改执行环境的部署者不适用。
limitations: 依赖智能体保留可观测的完整执行轨迹；探针注入需要与智能体交互的渠道；跨更长期版本漂移的稳定性未验证。

title: Label-Budgeted Attribute Inference from Protected Features in Edge-Cloud Split Multimodal LLMs
abstract: Edge-cloud split inference runs the early layers of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) on a device and sends intermediate features to a server to complete the task. While keeping raw images local is often perceived as a privacy benefit, an honest-but-curious server can still infer sensitive attributes, such as age, gender, and race, from the received features. Existing protections intervene at the input, transmitted representation, or model's responses, but their native evaluations rely on final-response refusals or fixed-classifier failures, which underestimate an adaptive server's capabilities. To address this, we propose a label-budgeted attribute-inference framework that measures representation-level privacy through a recovery curve: the share of the unprotected leakage the server recovers as a function of its labeled-sample budget, from zero (a classifier trained on unprotected features) to a full labeled set. Our evaluation across two popular MLLMs reveals two critical findings. First, in unprotected pipelines, intermediate features leak all three attributes regardless of the split depth. Second, even when protection mechanisms are deployed across different stages, sensitive information remains recoverable under limited label budgets. For example, Safe-LLaVA removes biometric content from the model's responses, but from the features it transmits in split inference, 20 labeled samples per class recover 75-85% of the unprotected leakage. This work provides a label-budgeted measure of feature-level privacy for split MLLM inference and motivates defenses that act on the transmitted representation.
