title_cn: 边云分离多模态 LLM 中基于受保护特征的标签预算属性推断
abstract_cn: 边云分离推理把多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的浅层放在设备上、把中间特征发给服务器完成任务。虽然原始图像留在本地常被视为隐私收益，但诚实但好奇的服务器仍可从接收到的特征推断年龄、性别、种族等敏感属性。现有防护作用于输入、传输表示或模型响应层面，但其原生评估依赖最终响应拒绝或固定分类器失效，低估了自适应服务器的能力。为此，我们提出标签预算式属性推断框架，用恢复曲线度量表示级隐私：即服务器在标注样本预算从零（用未防护特征训练的分类器）到全量标注集之间，能恢复多少未防护泄露份额。在两个主流 MLLM 上的评估得到两个关键发现：第一，在未设防管线中，无论分离深度如何，中间特征都泄露全部三种属性；第二，即使在不同阶段部署防护机制，有限标注预算下敏感信息仍可恢复。例如 Safe-LLaVA 从模型响应中移除了生物特征内容，但在分离推理所传输的特征上，每类仅 20 个标注样本即可恢复未防护泄露的 75–85%。本工作为分离 MLLM 推理提供了标签预算式的特征级隐私度量，并促使防御作用于传输表示本身。
summary_cn: 边云分离 MLLM 隐私研究提出标签预算恢复曲线度量：两个 MLLM 的中间特征在任意分离深度都泄露年龄/性别/种族，Safe-LLaVA 等响应级防护下每类 20 个标注样本仍能恢复 75–85% 的未防护泄露。
objective_summary: 提出标签预算式属性推断框架与恢复曲线度量，系统评估边云分离 MLLM 中间特征的属性泄露及现有防护在有限标注预算下的失效。
evidence_note: 两个主流 MLLM、多分离深度与多种防护（含 Safe-LLaVA）系统实验，给出每类 20 样本恢复 75–85% 等量化结果；模型覆盖面有限、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把表示级隐私度量从固定分类器失败率改为随标注预算变化的恢复曲线，揭示响应级防护对特征级泄露的系统性低估。
scope: 结论适用于边云分离部署下的 MLLM 中间特征传输场景与所测属性（年龄/性别/种族）；对其他敏感属性与联邦类架构未验证。
limitations: 仅评估两个 MLLM；属性集合限于人口统计学三类；攻击者模型为诚实但好奇的服务器，未考虑主动篡改特征的恶意服务器。

title: SPA: Structure-Preserving Approximation of Gated Activations under FHE
abstract: Nonlinear activation evaluation remains a major bottleneck in neural inference under fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). FHE supports efficient addition and multiplication, but lacks native operations for exponential functions, reciprocals, and value-dependent selection. High-degree polynomial approximations on fixed intervals are therefore commonly used to replace nonlinear activations. They can achieve small errors but often incur substantial multiplicative depth and latency. We observe that several widely used nonlinear activations share the algebraic structure $A(x)=xg(x)$ with $g(-x)=1-g(x)$. This class includes GELU, SiLU, fixed-parameter Swish, and the scalar nonlinear branches of GEGLU/SwiGLU. We propose \SPA{} (\emph{Structure-Preserving Approximation}) to exploit this shared structure. \SPA{} retains the exact odd component $x/2$ and approximates only the even residual as a polynomial in $x^2$, yielding a comparison-free arithmetic kernel. This construction removes redundant odd degrees of freedom and enables lower-cost polynomial evaluation at a given error target. Plaintext experiments with Gemma-4-E2B and Llama-3.2-3B show that SPA largely preserves downstream task performance without weight updates. Fixed-interval CKKS benchmarks show favorable error--latency trade-offs. On $[-5,5]$, \SPA{}-balanced achieves a $3.25\times$ speedup over MOAI (ICLR'~26) for erf-GELU with comparable error. On the same interval, \SPA{}-accurate achieves $79.22\%$ lower root mean squared error (RMSE) and a $10.40\times$ speedup over Euston (S\&P'~26) for QuickGELU. For SiLU, \SPA{}-accurate achieves $19.02\%$ lower RMSE and a $2.06\times$ speedup over THOR (CCS'~25).
title_cn: SPA：FHE 下门控激活的结构保持近似
abstract_cn: 非线性激活求值是全同态加密（FHE）神经推理的主要瓶颈之一。FHE 支持高效的加法与乘法，但缺少对指数函数、倒数与依赖取值的选择操作的原生支持，因此普遍用固定区间上的高次多项式近似替代非线性激活。这些近似误差可以很小，但常带来可观的乘法深度与延迟。我们观察到多个广泛使用的非线性激活共享代数结构 A(x)=xg(x)，其中 g(-x)=1-g(x)；该类包括 GELU、SiLU、固定参数 Swish 以及 GEGLU/SwiGLU 的标量非线性分支。我们提出 SPA（Structure-Preserving Approximation）来利用这一共享结构：保留精确的奇分量 x/2，仅把偶残差近似为 x² 的多项式，得到免比较的算术内核。这一构造去除了冗余的奇次自由度，使同一误差目标下的多项式求值成本更低。Gemma-4-E2B 与 Llama-3.2-3B 的明文实验表明 SPA 在不更新权重的情况下基本保持下游任务性能；固定区间 CKKS 基准显示出良好的误差-延迟权衡。在 [-5,5] 区间，SPA-balanced 在可比误差下对 erf-GELU 较 MOAI（ICLR'26）加速 3.25 倍；SPA-accurate 对 QuickGELU 较 Euston（S&P'26）RMSE 降低 79.22%、加速 10.40 倍；对 SiLU，SPA-accurate 较 THOR（CCS'25）RMSE 降低 19.02%、加速 2.06 倍。
summary_cn: FHE 激活近似 SPA 利用门控激活共享的 A(x)=xg(x) 结构、保留奇分量只近似偶残差：[-5,5] 上较 MOAI/Euston/THOR 加速 3.25/10.40/2.06 倍，对后两者 RMSE 再降 79.22%/19.02%。
objective_summary: 提出利用门控激活代数结构的 FHE 多项式近似 SPA：保留精确奇分量、仅以 x² 多项式近似偶残差，给出免比较算术内核并做系统基准。
evidence_note: Gemma-4-E2B 与 Llama-3.2-3B 明文任务保持实验 + CKKS 固定区间基准；与 MOAI（ICLR'26）、Euston（S&P'26）、THOR（CCS'25）三个最新方案对比并报告加速与 RMSE。
novelty_note: 在活跃的 FHE 激活近似方向上提出结构保持分解这一新角度：保留奇分量、只近似偶残差，消除冗余自由度；近似范式本身仍是固定区间多项式。
scope: 结论适用于 A(x)=xg(x) 形态的门控激活与 CKKS 类方案；对非该代数结构的激活（如 ReLU、tanh）与 BFV/BGV 方案未验证。
limitations: 近似局限于固定区间，区间外的行为需另行处理；仅在两个中等规模模型上做明文任务验证；端到端 FHE 推理的延迟收益未报告。

title: Concept Acupuncturist: An Efficient and Precise Concept Erasure Method for Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept Acupuncturist (ConceptACP), a novel MU framework that integrates interpretability-guided analysis with inference-free fine-tuning for efficient and precise concept removal. By establishing mappings between semantic concepts and cross-attention blocks in the U-Net denoiser and localizing the most concept-relevant block for targeted optimization, ConceptACP avoids full diffusion trajectory optimization, thereby improving fine-tuning efficiency. To mitigate concept entanglement, we propose a feature-level correction mechanism based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where SAE-derived sparse, semantically meaningful feature activations are manipulated to construct targeted correction signals, which are then projected back to the output space of the corresponding block and used as supervision for precise concept removal. Consequently, ConceptACP eliminates the need for external inference-time modules while achieving efficient and fine-grained unlearning. Instantiated on SDXL-Turbo, ConceptACP improves the forgetting success rate by 36.34 percentage points in the standard one-step generation setting on average over the best-performing baseline, while preserving image quality and prompt fidelity, and generalizes effectively across other Stable Diffusion backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP.
title_cn: Concept Acupuncturist：基于稀疏自编码器的高效精准扩散模型概念擦除
abstract_cn: 扩散图像生成模型能产出高质量图像，但可能生成有害或违反政策的内容，促使机器遗忘（MU）被用于在保留通用能力的同时选择性移除目标概念。然而现有 MU 方法常难以应对概念表示的分布式与纠缠特性，当通过对完整扩散轨迹的大规模微调实施时，会导致优化低效与编辑不精准。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 Concept Acupuncturist（ConceptACP），一个结合可解释性引导分析与免推理微调的新颖 MU 框架，实现高效精准的概念移除。通过建立语义概念与 U-Net 去噪器中交叉注意力块的映射，并定位与目标概念最相关的块做定向优化，ConceptACP 避免了全扩散轨迹优化，从而提升微调效率。为缓解概念纠缠，我们提出基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征级校正机制：利用 SAE 导出的稀疏、语义有意义的特征激活构造定向校正信号，再投影回对应块的输出空间，作为精准概念移除的监督。由此 ConceptACP 无需外部推理时模块即可实现高效细粒度遗忘。在 SDXL-Turbo 上实例化后，ConceptACP 在标准单步生成设置下平均比最强基线的遗忘成功率提高 36.34 个百分点，同时保持图像质量与提示保真度，并有效泛化到其他 Stable Diffusion 骨干。代码已公开。
summary_cn: 概念擦除框架 ConceptACP 定位 U-Net 中最相关交叉注意力块、用 SAE 特征级校正信号定向微调：SDXL-Turbo 单步生成下遗忘成功率较最强基线平均提升 36.34 个百分点，保持画质与提示保真并泛化到其他 SD 骨干。
objective_summary: 提出结合可解释性定位与 SAE 特征级校正的扩散模型概念擦除框架 ConceptACP，对相关注意力块做定向微调实现精准遗忘。
evidence_note: SDXL-Turbo 上遗忘成功率较最强基线平均高 36.34 个百分点并跨多个 SD 骨干验证，保持图像质量与提示保真；代码公开。未报告统计检验，评测以标准遗忘设定为主。
novelty_note: 将 SAE 可解释性分析用于定位注意力块并构造特征级校正信号，是 SAE 解释技术与扩散模型遗忘的新组合，避免了全轨迹微调与推理时模块。
scope: 结论适用于 U-Net 架构扩散模型的标准概念遗忘任务；对多概念联合擦除、对抗性概念唤回攻击及文本编码器层面的遗忘未覆盖。
limitations: 概念-注意力块映射依赖数据驱动定位，可能漏掉分布式概念组分；评测集中于 SD 系列骨干；遗忘后对相关提示词绕过尝试的鲁棒性未系统评估。

title: SynMark: Semantic-Coordinate Multi-Bit Watermarking during LLM Code Generation
abstract: LLM-generated code is increasingly reused across downstream applications and often undergoes identifier renaming or structural refactoring, making robustness to functionality-preserving edits essential for generative multi-bit code watermarking. Existing methods commonly derive message routes from surface-token prefixes, so such edits can desynchronize routing and degrade watermark recovery. We propose SynMark, which replaces surface-dependent routing with learned semantic coordinates and further calibrates residual recovery errors after transformation. For watermark embedding, Scope learns semantic coordinates from aligned prefixes of functionally equivalent variants for keyed routing and applies a syntax-aware adaptive bias during generation. For watermark extraction, Traced recomputes semantic routes from transformed code and uses reliability-weighted aggregation to suppress unreliable token contributions. Under 100% identifier renaming, SynMark retains 82.27% and 83.77% BitAcc on CodeLlama and DeepSeek-Coder, respectively. Across three code LMs, it also improves clean BitAcc and Pass@1 by up to 4.53 and 11.18 percentage points over the strongest watermarked baselines.
title_cn: SynMark：LLM 代码生成中的语义坐标多比特水印
abstract_cn: LLM 生成的代码越来越多地被下游应用复用，并常经历标识符重命名或结构重构，因此对功能保持型编辑的鲁棒性成为生成式多比特代码水印的关键。现有方法通常从表层 token 前缀导出消息路由，此类编辑会使路由失同步并降低水印恢复率。我们提出 SynMark，用学习到的语义坐标取代依赖表层的路由，并在变换后对残余恢复误差进行校准。水印嵌入方面，Scope 从功能等价变体的对齐前缀中学习语义坐标用于带密钥路由，并在生成时施加语法感知的自适应偏置；水印提取方面，Traced 从变换后代码重算语义路由，并使用可靠性加权聚合抑制不可靠 token 的贡献。在 100% 标识符重命名下，SynMark 在 CodeLlama 与 DeepSeek-Coder 上分别保持 82.27% 与 83.77% 的 BitAcc。在三个代码 LM 上，它的干净 BitAcc 与 Pass@1 相比最强水印基线分别提升至多 4.53 与 11.18 个百分点。
summary_cn: 代码水印 SynMark 以语义坐标替代表层前缀路由并做可靠性加权提取：100% 重命名下保持 82.27%/83.77% BitAcc，干净 BitAcc 与 Pass@1 最高提升 4.53/11.18 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出面向功能保持变换的多比特代码水印 SynMark，包含语义坐标路由嵌入（Scope）与重路由加权提取（Traced）两个组件。
evidence_note: 三个代码 LM、100% 重命名等变换下系统对比最强水印基线，报告 BitAcc 与 Pass@1 的具体增益；无统计检验，攻击类型以功能保持编辑为主。
novelty_note: 把水印消息路由从表层 token 前缀迁移到学习式语义坐标，并加入变换后误差校准与可靠性加权提取，是对表层路由失同步问题的实质性机制改进。
scope: 结论适用于代码生成水印与功能保持编辑（重命名、重构）；对跨模型转译、大范围语义改写或主动水印清除攻击未验证。
limitations: 依赖功能等价变体训练语义坐标，泛化到未见变换类型的能力受限；水印对故意对抗性清除（非功能保持）不提供保证；评测限于三个代码 LM。

title: TRACE: Data-Free Text Reconstruction Attacks against Approximate Unlearning in LLMs
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) face growing demands for data removal driven by regulatory compliance, copyright concerns, and privacy protection, approximate unlearning has emerged as a practical alternative to expensive full retraining. In practice, pre- and post-unlearning model snapshots are often maintained for auditing and rollback, introducing a previously overlooked side channel. This paper demonstrates that approximate unlearning in LLM can leave residual traces within model snapshots, which may be recoverable and thus enable the privacy breaches that approximate unlearning is intended to prevent. Here, we propose TRACE, a framework that reconstructs unlearned training data given access to pre- and post-unlearning model snapshots, without any data-specific prior knowledge. To achieve this, TRACE identifies a compact set of candidate tokens from embedding-level parameter differences to constrain the search space, and assembles sequences via a contrastive scoring mechanism based on the perplexity gap between the two models. A two-stage exploration-then-completion strategy enables the recovery of multiple distinct samples. Extensive experiments on various datasets, including TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, across multiple LLMs and six representative unlearning methods, demonstrate that TRACE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction. This paper exposes significant privacy risks in current LLM approximate unlearning deployments and highlights the need for defenses against parameter-difference leakage and appropriate management of model snapshot access.
comment: Accepted to The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
title_cn: TRACE：针对 LLM 近似遗忘的数据免先验文本重建攻击
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型面临来自监管合规、版权与隐私保护日益增长的数据删除需求，近似遗忘（approximate unlearning）成为昂贵全量重训的实用替代。实践中，遗忘前后的模型快照常被保留用于审计与回滚，这引入了一个此前被忽视的侧信道。本文证明，LLM 的近似遗忘会在模型快照中留下残余踪迹，这些踪迹可能被恢复，从而促成近似遗忘本想防止的隐私泄露。我们提出 TRACE，一个在获得遗忘前后模型快照、且不依赖任何数据特定先验的条件下重建被遗忘训练数据的框架。为此，TRACE 从嵌入层参数差异中识别一小撮候选 token 以约束搜索空间，并通过基于两模型困惑度差距的对比评分机制组装序列；两阶段的先探索后补全策略支持恢复多个不同样本。在 TOFU、MUSE、WMDP 等多个数据集、多个 LLM 与六种代表性遗忘方法上的大量实验表明，TRACE 能实现高保真重建。本文揭示了当前 LLM 近似遗忘部署中的重大隐私风险，强调需要对参数差异泄露建立防御并妥善管理模型快照的访问。
summary_cn: TRACE 利用遗忘前后模型快照的参数差异重建被删训练数据：在 TOFU/MUSE/WMDP、六个遗忘方法、多个 LLM 上实现高保真免先验重建（NeurIPS 2026），揭示快照留存是被忽视的隐私侧信道。
objective_summary: 提出 TRACE 攻击框架：仅凭遗忘前后模型快照，通过嵌入层参数差异约束候选 token、困惑度差距对比评分与两阶段探索-补全重建被遗忘样本。
evidence_note: 在 TOFU、MUSE、WMDP 三个数据集、多个 LLM、六种代表性遗忘方法上系统实验并报告高保真重建；NeurIPS 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 首次把「遗忘前后快照差异」作为侧信道提出免先验的训练数据重建攻击，指出审计/回滚实践与近似遗忘隐私目标之间的结构性矛盾。
scope: 结论适用于维护遗忘前后快照的近似遗忘部署；对全量重训遗忘、差分隐私训练或快照访问受控的部署不适用。
limitations: 依赖攻击者能同时获得遗忘前后两份模型快照；重建质量随模型与遗忘方法而异；未提出并验证防御方案本身。

title: WADE: An LSTM-Based Anomaly Detection Engine for WebAssembly Applications
abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) enables near-native performance for web applications through a portable and sandboxed execution model. However, its limited runtime protection mechanisms (e.g., the lack of stack canaries and address space layout randomization (ASLR)) leave Wasm applications vulnerable to traditional attacks. We present WADE (WebAssembly Anomaly Detection Engine), a system that detects anomalous runtime behaviors in browser-executed WebAssembly applications. WADE monitors function-level execution traces collected under benign conditions and trains a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to learn the normal execution behavior of each application. At runtime, the model flags deviations from these learned patterns as potential attacks. Unlike signature-based approaches, WADE builds application-specific behavioral models, enabling detection of both known and previously unseen attacks without per-vulnerability signatures. We evaluate WADE on a dataset of 67 WebAssembly applications spanning ten vulnerability classes, achieving zero false negatives and a 0.42% false positive rate.
title_cn: WADE：面向 WebAssembly 应用的 LSTM 异常检测引擎
abstract_cn: WebAssembly（Wasm）通过可移植且沙箱化的执行模型为 Web 应用带来接近原生的性能。然而其有限的运行时保护机制（如缺少栈金丝雀与地址空间布局随机化 ASLR）使 Wasm 应用容易受到传统攻击。我们提出 WADE（WebAssembly Anomaly Detection Engine），一个检测浏览器执行的 Wasm 应用中异常运行时行为的系统。WADE 在良性条件下采集函数级执行踪迹，训练长短期记忆（LSTM）网络学习每个应用的正常执行行为；运行时，模型把偏离已学习模式的行为标记为潜在攻击。与基于签名的方法不同，WADE 为每个应用构建行为模型，无需按漏洞定制签名即可检测已知与未见过的攻击。我们在覆盖十类漏洞的 67 个 WebAssembly 应用数据集上评估 WADE，实现零漏报与 0.42% 的误报率。
summary_cn: Wasm 异常检测引擎 WADE 用函数级执行踪迹训练 LSTM 学习各应用正常行为：在覆盖十类漏洞的 67 个 Wasm 应用上实现零漏报、0.42% 误报率，无需按漏洞签名即可检出未见攻击。
objective_summary: 构建基于函数级执行踪迹与 LSTM 的应用级异常检测系统 WADE，监测浏览器端 Wasm 应用的运行时攻击行为。
evidence_note: 自建 67 个 Wasm 应用、十类漏洞的数据集，报告零漏报与 0.42% 误报；未与其他检测系统对比，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 LSTM 行为异常检测移植到缺少栈金丝雀/ASLR 的 Wasm 运行时这一新场景，按应用建模规避签名维护成本；检测方法本身成熟。
scope: 结论适用于浏览器执行的 Wasm 应用与所测十类漏洞；对非浏览器 Wasm 运行时（服务端、嵌入式）与模仿正常行为模型的对抗性攻击未验证。
limitations: 需要在良性条件下采集踪迹并按应用训练，部署与更新成本高；对模仿正常控制流的低频慢速攻击敏感性未知；数据集自建，覆盖面有限。

title: Agentic AI Defense: Decode-Time Provenance Binding for MCP
abstract: Agentic AI systems using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection through untrusted tool outputs. We demonstrate cross-modal trust laundering, in which instructions concealed in an email-signature image using least-significant-bit (LSB), discrete cosine transform (DCT), or metadata steganography bypass text scanners and enter a multi-agent workflow when decoded by a tool. To counter this threat, we propose decode-time provenance binding, which combines HMAC-authenticated trust labels with an MCP-maintained provenance ledger and context-taint tracking. The mechanism labels decoded content as untrusted and blocks critical tool calls influenced by that content, even when a compromised agent substitutes a valid trusted label. We evaluate the approach using a real MCP testbed with three steganographic carriers and 24 adaptive payloads. The undefended pipeline exhibits 100% attack success, while keyword and regex defenses each permit 62.5% of attacks. Our mechanism blocks all attacks (0% success), including adversarial label substitution across mediated agent boundaries. A four-component ablation validates the roles of decode marking, cryptographic authentication, lineage tracking, and sink enforcement. An audited trusted-promotion mechanism increases legitimate-task completion from 67% to 100% without compromising protection. The approach provides carrier-independent containment within fully mediated MCP execution environments. Code and data are publicly available.
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables, 2 algorithms. Code and data available at this https URL
title_cn: 智能体 AI 防御：面向 MCP 的解码时溯源绑定
abstract_cn: 使用模型上下文协议（MCP）的智能体 AI 系统容易受到来自不可信工具输出的间接提示注入。我们展示了跨模态信任洗白：藏在邮件签名图片中的指令，借助最低有效位（LSB）、离散余弦变换（DCT）或元数据隐写绕过文本扫描器，在工具解码时进入多智能体工作流。为对抗这种威胁，我们提出解码时溯源绑定：将 HMAC 认证的信任标签与 MCP 维护的溯源账本及上下文污点追踪相结合。该机制把解码内容标记为不可信，并阻止受其影响的关键工具调用，即使被攻陷的智能体替换了有效的可信标签也无济于事。我们在真实 MCP 测试床上、使用三种隐写载体与 24 个自适应载荷进行评估。未设防管线的攻击成功率 100%，关键词与正则防御各放行 62.5% 的攻击，而我们的机制阻断全部攻击（成功率 0%），包括跨中介智能体边界的对抗性标签替换。四组件消融验证了解码标记、密码学认证、谱系追踪与汇聚点强制各自的作用。经审计的可信晋升机制把合法任务完成率从 67% 提升到 100%，同时不削弱防护。该方法在完全中介化的 MCP 执行环境中提供与载体无关的遏制。代码与数据公开。
summary_cn: 针对 MCP 隐写式间接提示注入提出解码时溯源绑定（HMAC 标签+溯源账本+污点追踪）：真实测试床上 3 种载体、24 个自适应载荷的攻击成功率从 100% 降到 0%，合法任务完成率由 67% 升至 100%。
objective_summary: 提出并评估解码时溯源绑定机制：对解码内容强制不可信标记、密码学认证与污点追踪，在真实 MCP 测试床上对抗隐写载荷与标签替换攻击。
evidence_note: 真实 MCP 测试床、3 种隐写载体、24 个自适应载荷、含跨智能体边界的对抗性标签替换；四组件消融；报告关键词/正则基线对比与合法任务完成率。代码与数据公开。
novelty_note: 提出跨模态信任洗白攻击并指出解码时刻是此前缺失的强制执行点；溯源账本、HMAC 标签与污点追踪为已有组件在 MCP 场景的系统化组合，价值在于把防护锚定在载体无关的解码边界。
scope: 结论适用于完全中介化、可拦截解码与工具调用的 MCP 执行环境；对无法中介执行的自由智能体框架或非 MCP 生态不直接适用。
limitations: 需要 MCP 运行时配合改造，部署前提较强；评估限于三种隐写载体与图像类入口；可信晋升机制的审计规则可能被更复杂的载荷试探。

title: Not an Accident: Exploiting Safety Filter Inadequacy in Humanoid Robots
abstract: As humanoid robots move from research laboratories toward deployment in human-centered environments such as homes, hospitals, and warehouses, safe operation around nearby people and objects becomes a fundamental requirement. Safety filters have emerged as a promising technique to address this challenge by providing mathematical guarantees that generated control actions do not result in collisions. This paper shows that these guarantees hold only when the safety parameters are configured correctly. However, correct parameter configurations are task- and environment-specific, and no general method exists to determine them across diverse deployments. As a result, safety filters shipped with humanoid robots can fail after deployment in specific scenarios. We show that attackers can exploit these failures through only normal user interactions without any additional privileges or capabilities. To demonstrate this risk, we present goal insertion attacks and develop SIREN, an automated tool that identifies vulnerable inserting goals for a given task and environment. Experimental results show that SIREN identifies attacks in all vulnerable scenarios in the SPARK dataset. Compared with a baseline approach, SIREN discovers three times as many attacks. We also show that SIREN is able to generate attacks against a real humanoid and cause it to collide while executing tasks. These results demonstrate that current safety filters introduce exploitable vulnerabilities that can cause safety violations, which reveals that existing safety mechanisms can themselves become a source of safety risk for humanoid robots.
title_cn: 并非意外：利用人形机器人安全过滤器的不足
abstract_cn: 随着人形机器人从实验室走向家庭、医院、仓库等以人为中心的环境，在附近人员与物体周围安全运行成为基本要求。安全过滤器作为有前景的技术应运而生，为「生成的控制动作不会导致碰撞」提供数学保证。本文表明，这些保证只有在安全参数配置正确时才成立。然而正确的参数配置是任务与环境相关的，目前没有通用方法能在多样化部署中确定它们。因此随机器人出厂附带的安全过滤器可能在部署后的特定场景中失效。我们证明攻击者可以仅通过正常用户交互——无需任何额外权限或能力——来利用这些失效。为展示这一风险，我们提出目标插入攻击，并开发自动化工具 SIREN，为给定任务与环境识别易受攻击的插入目标。实验结果表明，SIREN 在 SPARK 数据集的所有易受攻击场景中都能找到攻击；与基线方法相比，SIREN 发现的攻击数量是后者的三倍。我们还证明 SIREN 能对一台真实人形机器人生成攻击，使其在执行任务时发生碰撞。这些结果表明当前安全过滤器本身会引入可被利用的漏洞、造成安全违背，揭示出现有安全机制自身可能成为人形机器人的安全风险来源。
summary_cn: 人形机器人安全过滤器的参数配置缺陷可被正常用户交互利用：目标插入攻击工具 SIREN 在 SPARK 数据集全部易受攻击场景中找到攻击、数量为基线三倍，并使真实人形机器人在任务中发生碰撞。
objective_summary: 提出目标插入攻击与自动化工具 SIREN，利用人形机器人安全过滤器参数配置的任务环境依赖性，在数据集与真实机器人上验证安全保证可被绕过。
evidence_note: 在 SPARK 数据集全部易受攻击场景中复现攻击并与基线对比（3 倍数量）；在真实人形机器人上验证碰撞效果；攻击仅依赖正常用户交互接口。
novelty_note: 首次系统指出安全过滤器本身（而非其上层策略）因参数配置的任务环境依赖性而成为可利用攻击面，给出无需特权的正常交互威胁模型与自动化攻击工具。
scope: 结论适用于依赖参数化安全过滤器（控制理论保证类）的人形/具身机器人部署；对具备在线参数自适应或形式化配置验证的过滤器未评估。
limitations: 攻击依赖安全参数配置不当这一前提，未量化实际部署中的配置失误率；实验以仿真与单台真机为主；对过滤器修复后的鲁棒性未做对抗再评估。

title: Incomparable Minima in Agent Tool Authorization
abstract: An agent that needs a tool needs authority to call it, and every proposal for governing that authority has to answer one question: of two grants that both let the agent finish a task, which one is smaller? Over-privilege benchmarks score agents against this answer, and permission solvers compute it. We check the question against the authorisation tables that Microsoft and Google publish, covering 22,305 Microsoft Graph endpoint bindings and 23,852 Google API methods, on tasks generated from each table's own resource structure. For 29.8-33.3% of Graph tasks and 3.2% of Google resource tasks the question has no answer, because the minimal sufficient grants form an antichain, a set of grants none of which authorises a subset of what another does. In its two main authorisation modes, Microsoft's shipped privilegeLevel rates 67.4-74.4% of these incomparable pairs equal. Google ships no such scale, so on Google we apply a reconstruction of the FORTIS privilege ladder, which rates 90.7-98.7% equal. Applying the same reconstruction to Graph attributes much of that difference to the scale rather than the corpus: its form based on the HTTP verb alone rates 92.0% of Google pairs and 89.0-92.0% of Graph pairs equal. Four risk measures (operations, writes, services reached, administrative surface) order 28.7% of incomparable Google pairs and 15.7-23.4% of Graph pairs in opposite directions, so for those pairs the ranking has no measure-independent answer. Offered pools of minimal and larger grants, 6 frontier models pick a minimal grant on 99.0% of 1,708 decisions, a grant smallest under all four measures on 66.7%, and on 22.1% a grant that another option matches or beats on every measure. We propose that benchmarks report which minimal grant an agent chose and that deployments show the alternatives to whoever approves the grant.
comment: Accepted as an oral at TAS 2026, AAAI Fall Symposium Series. 9 pages
title_cn: 智能体工具授权中的不可比最小授权
abstract_cn: 需要工具的智能体就需要调用它的权限，而任何权限治理方案都必须回答一个问题：在两个都能让智能体完成任务的授权中，哪一个更小？过权基准基于这个答案给智能体打分，权限求解器负责计算它。我们对照微软与谷歌发布的授权表检验了这个问题，覆盖 22,305 个 Microsoft Graph 端点绑定与 23,852 个 Google API 方法，任务由各表自身的资源结构生成。对 29.8–33.3% 的 Graph 任务与 3.2% 的 Google 资源任务，该问题没有答案，因为最小充分授权构成一个反链——一组互不包含的授权。在其两种主要授权模式下，微软实际发布的 privilegeLevel 把这些不可比对中的 67.4–74.4% 评为相等。谷歌没有发布此类量表，我们在谷歌侧使用了 FORTIS 权限阶梯的重建，它把 90.7–98.7% 评为相等。把同样的重建应用到 Graph，则大部分差异可归因于量表本身而非语料：仅基于 HTTP 动词的形式在 Google 对上评 92.0%、Graph 对上评 89.0–92.0% 为相等。四种风险度量（操作数、写操作、可达服务、管理面）对 28.7% 的不可比 Google 对与 15.7–23.4% 的 Graph 对给出相反的排序，因此对这些对而言，排序没有独立于度量的答案。在提供最小授权与更大授权池时，6 个前沿模型在 1,708 次决策中的 99.0% 选中某个最小授权，66.7% 选中在全部四种度量下都最小的授权，但也有 22.1% 选了在每种度量上都被另一选项追平或超越的授权。我们建议基准报告智能体选了哪个最小授权，部署方在审批时向审批者展示备选方案。
summary_cn: 在 4.6 万余项微软/谷歌 API 授权上证明：约三成 Graph 任务的最小充分授权构成不可比反链，现有权限量表把多数不可比对评为相等；6 个前沿模型 99.0% 选中最小授权，22.1% 却选了被全面支配的选项。
objective_summary: 系统测量两大厂商授权表中最小充分授权的不可比现象，量化现有权限量表与四种风险度量在不可比对上的分歧，并实测 6 个前沿模型的授权选择表现。
evidence_note: 覆盖 22,305 个 Microsoft Graph 端点绑定与 23,852 个 Google API 方法的真实授权数据；四种风险度量交叉验证；6 个前沿模型、1,708 次授权决策实测；TAS 2026（AAAI Fall Symposium）oral。
novelty_note: 首次在大规模真实授权表上系统揭示「最小充分授权不可比」（反链）现象，指出过权基准与权限求解器的共同盲点，并提出报告与展示备选授权的改进建议。
scope: 结论基于 Microsoft Graph 与 Google API 的授权表结构及从中生成的任务；对其他云平台、企业内部权限系统与动态权限场景未验证。
limitations: 任务由授权表资源结构自动生成，与真实用户任务分布可能有偏差；Google 侧依赖 FORTIS 阶梯的重建而非官方量表；风险度量的选取本身影响不可比对的排序结论。

title: SEMPRE: Semantic-Aware Protocol Reverse Engineering via Consistency-Driven Joint Optimization
abstract: Protocol reverse engineering (PRE) is essential for understanding undocumented or proprietary communication formats, enabling security-critical tasks such as vulnerability discovery, malware C2 analysis, and IDS signature generation. However, existing PRE techniques rely on brittle hand-written rules, under-model contextual dependencies among neighboring fields, and often fail on messages with nested sub-protocols. We present SEMPRE, a fully automated PRE framework that replaces ad-hoc heuristics with recursive LLM reasoning grounded in fine-grained dynamic program analysis. SEMPRE uses taint-flow and loop traces to guide an LLM-driven tree-of-thought search that slices messages into fields while detecting nested sub-payloads, producing a hierarchical layout. It then infers each field's type and role and iteratively refines boundaries by freezing high-confidence segments and re-running detection under semantic constraints, yielding an EM-style procedure that monotonically improves structure and semantics until convergence. Evaluated on a broad corpus of mainstream protocols against six state-of-the-art (vs. <0.4 for all baselines) and 0.72 for semantic inference (vs. 0.13 for BinPRE). Ablations confirm the contribution of each component, and a case study on a prolific real-world botnet demonstrates practical utility.
title_cn: SEMPRE：基于一致性驱动联合优化的语义感知协议逆向
abstract_cn: 协议逆向工程（PRE）对理解未公开或专有通信格式至关重要，支撑漏洞发现、恶意软件 C2 分析与 IDS 签名生成等安全关键任务。然而现有 PRE 技术依赖脆弱的手写规则、对相邻字段间的上下文依赖建模不足，且在含嵌套子协议的消息上常会失败。我们提出 SEMPRE，一个完全自动化的 PRE 框架，用建立在细粒度动态程序分析之上的递归 LLM 推理取代特设启发式规则。SEMPRE 利用污点流与循环踪迹引导 LLM 驱动的思维树搜索，在切分消息字段的同时检测嵌套子载荷，产出层次化布局；再推断各字段的类型与角色，并通过冻结高置信度片段、在语义约束下重跑检测来迭代细化边界，形成单调改进结构与语义直至收敛的 EM 式流程。在覆盖主流协议的广泛语料上与六种最先进方法对比评估：结构推断得分显著高于全部基线（均 <0.4），语义推断达 0.72（BinPRE 为 0.13）。消融实验确认了各组件的贡献，对一个多产真实僵尸网络的案例研究展示了实用价值。
summary_cn: SEMPRE 用污点流引导的 LLM 思维树搜索与 EM 式细化做协议逆向：主流协议上结构得分超全部基线（<0.4），语义推断 0.72 对 BinPRE 0.13，并在真实僵尸网络案例中验证。
objective_summary: 提出以动态程序分析打底、LLM 思维树搜索与一致性驱动迭代细化相结合的全自动协议逆向框架 SEMPRE，输出层次化字段布局与语义标注。
evidence_note: 在主流协议语料上与六种 SOTA 基线对比并做消融；结构得分对比全部基线（<0.4）、语义推断 0.72 vs 0.13；附真实僵尸网络案例。无统计检验，语料规模未明示。
novelty_note: 把递归 LLM 推理与污点流/循环踪迹等动态分析证据结合，以 EM 式「冻结-重检」一致性驱动联合优化结构与语义；PRE 已有大量工作，此为该场景下的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于可采集执行踪迹的主流二进制/文本协议；对加密或强混淆流量、私有度极高的协议未验证。
limitations: 依赖 LLM 推理的稳定性与成本；主流协议语料上的结果对长尾私有协议的代表性未知；未给出统计显著性。

title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
abstract: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits. However, it is challenging for an LLM to reliably verify its own generated exploits. In this paper, we propose Ulysses, a multi-agent security harness to synthesize verifiable vulnerability exploits for web applications. Ulysses converts candidate vulnerability findings into verified Proofs of Exploitability by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success in independently observed execution effects. We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym, a curated benchmark of exploitable instances from 25 real-world web applications that span 5 languages and 7 frameworks. Ulysses produces verified proofs for 10 of 25 real-world advisories. It also discovered 4 new proofs of exploitability that have never been previously reported.
comment: 23 pages, 6 Figures
title_cn: Ulysses：用于合成可验证 Web 漏洞利用的安全测试脚手架
abstract_cn: AI 智能体如何才能在任意软件仓库中自动发现安全漏洞？现有做法用 LLM 生成软件漏洞利用，但 LLM 难以可靠地验证自己生成的利用。本文提出 Ulysses，一个面向 Web 应用、合成可验证漏洞利用的多智能体安全脚手架。Ulysses 把候选漏洞发现转化为经过验证的「可利用性证明」：迭代地探索利用假设，并在独立观测的执行效果中确立成功。我们在 WebExploitGym 上评估 Ulysses——这是一个精选基准，收录来自 25 个真实 Web 应用、横跨 5 种语言与 7 个框架的可利用实例。Ulysses 为 25 个真实安全公告中的 10 个产出已验证的证明，并发现了 4 个此前从未被报告过的新可利用性证明。
summary_cn: 多智能体脚手架 Ulysses 把候选漏洞发现迭代验证为「可利用性证明」：在 25 个真实 Web 应用基准上为 10/25 个公告产出验证证明，并新发现 4 个从未报告的可利用性证明。
objective_summary: 提出多智能体安全脚手架 Ulysses，将 LLM 生成的候选漏洞利用经独立观测执行效果验证为可利用性证明，并构建 WebExploitGym 基准评测。

title: SILMARILS-MV: Information-Theoretically Secure Multi-Verifier Signatures with Dealer-Free Key Issuance and Linear Aggregation for Permissioned Blockchains
abstract: Permissioned blockchains authenticate transactions, votes and quorum certificates with computationally secure signatures, and post-quantum replacements inflate consensus traffic by orders of magnitude. Information-theoretic alternatives have required a trusted authority, quantum channels, per-signature interaction, or single-use keys with bounded transfer. We present SILMARILS-MV, a multi-verifier unconditionally secure signature in which a signature is the vector $\alpha = A\,e(m)$ and each verifier holds a secret functional $c_i = \Gamma^T \lambda(x_i)$ derived from virtual anchors $\Gamma$ that nobody learns. Against unbounded adversaries corrupting up to $\omega$ verifiers and any signers, and observing every decision, an honest verifier accepts a forged or invalid signature with probability at most $Q/q + 1/(q-1)$, a bound that is tight in its leading term. The scheme is strongly unforgeable, non-repudiable, transferable across unboundedly many hops, and linearly aggregatable. Keys are issued by the validators through perfectly secure MPC for $t < n/3$, without broadcast. To scale, we let the committee itself sign: in threshold notarization, finality certificates have constant size $32(\omega+1)$ bytes and per-validator issuance cost no longer depends on $n$. Arbiter-verified keys give clients 32-byte signatures, robust redistribution supports membership changes and share refresh, and verifiers can be enrolled retroactively. A certificate verifies in 2.4 microseconds. In an analytic normal-case model at 1000 validators, threshold notarization needs 71 KiB of authentication traffic per validator per block, 22x less than ML-DSA-44 for admitted verifiers. In a Rust HotStuff prototype with 100 validators, SILMARILS-MV commits 2.8x more transactions per second than ML-DSA-44 with 67x less cryptographic CPU, and Monte-Carlo attacks match the bounds.

title_cn: SILMARILS-MV：面向许可链的信息论安全多验证者签名——无 dealer 密钥发放与线性聚合
abstract_cn: 许可链用计算安全的签名认证交易、投票与法定人数证书，而后量子替代方案会把共识流量抬高几个数量级。已有的信息论替代方案要么需要可信权威、量子信道、每签名交互，要么使用带传输界限的一次性密钥。我们提出 SILMARILS-MV，一种无条件安全的多验证者签名：签名是向量 α = A e(m)，每个验证者持有由无人知晓的虚拟锚点 Γ 导出的秘密泛函 c_i = Γᵀ λ(x_i)。面对腐化至多 ω 个验证者与任意签名者、并观察每一次决策的无界敌手，诚实验证者接受伪造或无效签名的概率至多为 Q/q + 1/(q-1)，该界在主导项上是紧的。方案具有强不可伪造性、不可否认性、可跨无界多跳传输，并可线性聚合。密钥由验证者通过 t < n/3 的完美安全 MPC 发放，无需广播。为扩展规模，我们让委员会自身签名：在阈值公证下，最终性证书具有 32(ω+1) 字节的常数大小，且每验证者签发成本不再依赖 n。仲裁者验证密钥给客户端 32 字节签名；健壮的重分配支持成员变更与份额刷新，验证者可被追溯加入。一张证书 2.4 微秒即可验证。在 1000 个验证者的解析常态模型中，阈值公证每验证者每块需要 71 KiB 认证流量，仅为 ML-DSA-44 的 1/22。在 100 个验证者的 Rust HotStuff 原型中，SILMARILS-MV 比 ML-DSA-44 每秒多提交 2.8 倍交易、密码学 CPU 少 67 倍；蒙特卡洛攻击与理论界吻合。

title: The Entire Quantum Computer on a Classical Leash
abstract: We show that a classical client with no quantum hardware can use a single untrusted and potentially malicious quantum server as if it were its own trusted quantum computer. Through the server, the client can privately choose and run quantum computations, prepare quantum states, and process quantum states supplied by other parties. It can also keep quantum memory on the server, hidden from the server itself, and use that memory in later computations so its quantum state persists across rounds of interaction. Together, these capabilities let a purely classical party act as a quantum party in a variety of interactive protocols. We expect this virtual quantum computer to be a broadly useful tool. As immediate applications, we resolve two known open problems: (1) classical verification of quantum sampling with negligible computational soundness error, and (2) remote state preparation of arbitrary efficiently preparable quantum states. Underlying all of these results is a general-purpose, maliciously secure two-party computation protocol between a classical client and a quantum server, which we construct assuming only the post-quantum hardness of learning with errors.
title_cn: 把整台量子计算机拴在经典缰绳上
abstract_cn: 我们证明：一个没有任何量子硬件的经典客户端，可以把一台不可信甚至可能怀有恶意的量子服务器当作自己可信的量子计算机来使用。借助该服务器，客户端可以私密地选择并运行量子计算、制备量子态，并处理其他方提供的量子态。客户端还可以把量子内存保存在服务器上而对服务器自身隐藏，并在后续计算中使用这些内存，使其量子态在多轮交互间持续存在。这些能力合在一起，使一个纯经典参与方可以在多种交互式协议中充当量子参与方。我们预计这台虚拟量子计算机会成为广泛适用的工具。作为直接应用，我们解决了两个已知公开问题：(1) 以可忽略的计算可靠性误差实现对量子采样的经典验证；(2) 任意可有效制备量子态的远程态制备。支撑所有这些结果的，是一个经典客户端与量子服务器之间通用的恶意安全两方计算协议，其构造仅假设学习带误差问题（LWE）的后量子困难性。
summary_cn: 仅凭 LWE 假设构造经典客户端对恶意量子服务器的恶意安全两方计算，使纯经典方获得可跨轮持久的虚拟量子计算机，并以可忽略误差解决量子采样经典验证与远程态制备两个公开问题。
objective_summary: 构造经典客户端与不可信量子服务器间的恶意安全两方计算协议，使经典方获得可持久化的虚拟量子计算能力，并以此解决两个公开问题。
evidence_note: 理论工作：给出完整构造与安全性归约，仅假设 LWE 的后量子困难性；以可忽略计算可靠性误差解决两个已知公开问题，达到该方向已知最好结果。
novelty_note: 在委托量子计算方向给出恶意安全、支持跨轮持久量子内存的一般性构造，首次以可忽略计算可靠性误差解决量子采样的经典验证，并给出任意可有效制备态的远程态制备。
scope: 结论在经典计算与量子服务器交互的模型、LWE 困难性假设下成立；不涉及噪声量子设备下的容错实现细节。
limitations: 协议交互轮数与量子资源开销的实用性未给出实现评估；假设服务器具备理想量子能力，未分析噪声设备下的具体表现。

title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
abstract: Advances in Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have enabled increasingly seamless human-AI interaction, but their unified processing of heterogeneous modalities also expands the attack surface, allowing adversaries to exploit richer input compositions to circumvent safety alignment. To counter such risks, omni-modal guardrails have been proposed to detect and filter unsafe queries across arbitrary modalities. However, their capabilities and limitations remain insufficiently understood due to the absence of a comprehensive evaluation benchmark. In this paper, we present Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive framework for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating guardrail models along three critical dimensions, i.e., safety, utility, and reliability. Omni-UBench curates over 183k samples drawn from 35+ heterogeneous sources spanning text, image, audio, video, and their cross-modal combinations, annotated with safety labels under a unified risk taxonomy. Benchmarking under Omni-UBench on 15 representative OLLMs and omni-modal guardrails yields several key findings, including: (1) modern OLLMs exhibit strong content moderation potential even without guardrail-specific tuning; (2) existing guardrails still struggle to identify cross-modal queries that conceal harmful intent or involve sophisticated jailbreaks; (3) they further exhibit substantial safety hallucination and over-sensitivity to textual patterns, revealing a deficient understanding of cross-modal safety semantics. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing more trustworthy omni-modal guardrails in future research.
title_cn: Omni-UBench：面向安全、效用与可靠性的全模态 LLM 护栏基准
abstract_cn: 全模态大语言模型（OLLM）的进步使人机交互日益顺畅，但其对异构模态的统一处理也扩大了攻击面，使攻击者能利用更丰富的输入组合绕过安全对齐。为应对此类风险，全模态护栏被提出用于检测和过滤跨任意模态的不安全查询。然而，由于缺乏全面的评测基准，这些护栏的能力与局限仍不清楚。本文提出 Omni-UBench，首个全面的全模态安全评估框架，沿安全、效用与可靠性三个关键维度评测护栏模型。Omni-UBench 整合了来自 35 个以上异构数据源、横跨文本、图像、音频、视频及其跨模态组合的 18.3 万余条样本，并在统一风险分类法下标注安全标签。在该基准上对 15 个代表性 OLLM 与全模态护栏的评测得出多项关键发现：(1) 现代 OLLM 即使未做护栏定向微调也展现出较强的内容审核潜力；(2) 现有护栏仍难以识别隐藏有害意图或涉及复杂越狱的跨模态查询；(3) 它们还表现出明显的内容安全幻觉与对文本模式的过度敏感，暴露出对跨模态安全语义理解的不足。这些发现为研发更可信的全模态护栏提供了参考。
summary_cn: 首个全模态护栏评测框架：18.3 万样本、35+ 数据源覆盖五种模态及组合，对 15 个模型沿安全/效用/可靠性评测，发现现有护栏难识破跨模态隐藏意图，且存在安全幻觉与对文本模式的过敏感。
objective_summary: 构建 Omni-UBench 基准：整合 183k 样本并按统一风险分类标注，沿安全、效用、可靠性三维度系统评测 15 个 OLLM 与全模态护栏并总结发现。
evidence_note: 183k 样本、35+ 异构来源、统一风险分类标注；覆盖文本/图像/音频/视频及跨模态组合；对 15 个代表性模型系统评测并给出可复核的量化发现。
novelty_note: 首个沿安全/效用/可靠性三维度全面评测全模态护栏的框架；此前缺少针对全模态护栏的系统基准。
scope: 结论适用于被评测的 15 个 OLLM 与护栏模型及所收录的 35+ 数据源分布；对未收录的模态组合与未公开的护栏不外推。
limitations: 样本依赖既有数据源整合，标注质量受统一分类法映射误差影响；评测以离线判定为主，未覆盖部署时对抗自适应场景。

title: Fooling LLM Safety Guards into Judging the Wrong Text
abstract: Safety guards check content before an LLM application acts on it, and most paste that content into a plain-text prompt. Content that imitates the prompt can append a second task, and the guard answers that one instead. We call this target rebinding. Our explanation is that the guard grades the last complete task in its input, here a harmless decoy, so the harmful request goes through unchanged. In a pre-registered test, an appended forged query and decoy clear all 75 held-out AdvBench requests that Shieldstral-1.0-3B flags. The guard is not persuaded: a directive to ignore the text above clears none of them, and in a follow-up run a harmful decoy stops the attack. On our GuardRebind benchmark, each of five guards has an attack family, chosen per guard, that clears at least 93% of its flagged items. Rebinding explains this best on Shieldstral and gpt-oss-safeguard; on ShieldGemma and Llama Guard 3, generic evasion and trailing text respectively do part of the work, and Qwen3Guard falls mainly to a forgery of its whole task. Training the guard to score content no lower than its most harmful part cuts attack success from 75% to 0.8-1.6% on attack families, decoys and forged queries held out of training. All of these attacks append the forged structure after the request, and we added the held-out-decoy evaluation after a first round of test runs. Clean AUROC falls by at most 0.01, but our test of non-inferiority is inconclusive. A score-guided search still beats this trained guard on 47 of 50 items, usually by placing forged structure before the request. On about half of the items where the search wins, the same search also finds benign text, with no forged structure, that clears the guard.

title_cn: 诱骗 LLM 安全护栏去审查错误的文本
abstract_cn: 安全护栏在 LLM 应用处理内容之前对其进行检查，而大多数护栏会把待检内容粘贴进纯文本提示。能够模仿提示的内容可以追加第二个任务，护栏就会转而回答后者。我们把这种现象称为目标重绑定（target rebinding）。我们的解释是：护栏评判的是其输入中的最后一个完整任务——在这里是一个无害的诱饵——因此有害请求原封不动地通过。在一项预注册测试中，追加一条伪造查询与诱饵，即可让 Shieldstral-1.0-3B 所标记的全部 75 条留出 AdvBench 请求放行。护栏并未被说服：一条「忽略上文」的指令一条也放行不了，且在后续实验中加入有害诱饵即可阻止该攻击。在我们的 GuardRebind 基准上，五个护栏各自都有一个（按护栏挑选的）攻击家族，能放行其标记条目中至少 93%。重绑定对 Shieldstral 与 gpt-oss-safeguard 是最优解释；对 ShieldGemma 与 Llama Guard 3，通用规避与尾部文本分别起了一部分作用；Qwen3Guard 则主要败给对其整个任务的伪造。训练护栏使其评分不低于内容中最有害的部分，可把攻击成功率从 75% 降到 0.8–1.6%（攻击家族、诱饵与伪造查询均为训练留出）。所有这些攻击都是在请求之后追加伪造结构，而留出诱饵评估是在第一轮测试之后补充的。干净 AUROC 至多下降 0.01，但我们的非劣性检验结果不确定。在 50 个条目中，评分引导搜索仍有 47 个胜过这个训练后的护栏，通常是把伪造结构放在请求之前。在搜索获胜的约一半条目上，同一搜索还能找到不含伪造结构的良性文本来放行护栏。
summary_cn: 提出「目标重绑定」攻击：追加诱饵使护栏改判无害任务，五个护栏被按其挑选的攻击家族放行至少 93% 的已标记条目；重训护栏把成功率从 75% 压到 0.8–1.6%，但评分引导搜索仍在 47/50 上得手。
objective_summary: 提出并刻画 target rebinding 攻击：在受检内容后追加伪造任务与诱饵使安全护栏评判错误对象，构建 GuardRebind 基准评测五个护栏，并训练护栏按最坏部分打分作为防御。
evidence_note: 预注册测试并补充留出诱饵评估；75 条留出 AdvBench 请求；五个真实护栏（Shieldstral、gpt-oss-safeguard、ShieldGemma、Llama Guard 3、Qwen3Guard）；GuardRebind 基准上逐护栏挑选攻击家族；防御重训在留出攻击上验证并报告 AUROC 与非劣性检验（后者不确定）。
novelty_note: 首次把护栏失效归结为「评判输入中最后一个完整任务」的目标重绑定机制，逐护栏区分主因（重绑定/通用规避/尾部文本/任务伪造），并给出可直接训练的修复目标；攻击安全护栏已有先行研究，但这一机制刻画是新的。
scope: 结论适用于把待检文本直接拼接进提示的纯文本安全护栏与被评测的五类护栏模型；对架构不同的护栏（如非文本拼接输入）与多模态护栏未覆盖。
limitations: 非劣性检验不确定，干净性能无损的结论证据不足；评分引导搜索表明自适应攻击者仍可绕过训练后的防御；评测集中于 AdvBench 类请求与文本护栏。

title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures restart-based output-basin stability as an observable surrogate for the hidden correction process. Across diverse models and distillation schemes, all baseline attacks remain essentially at random guessing even under gray-box access, whereas OP-Print is broadly validated to be effective in both gray-box and black-box settings.
title_cn: OP-Print：追踪在策自蒸馏中的成员印记
abstract_cn: 在策（on-policy）蒸馏被广泛用于缓解离策蒸馏的分布失配。自蒸馏进一步以学生自己的输出（经额外上下文或示范增强）作为监督，免除外部教师。这种无教师设计使在策自蒸馏实用化，但其隐私风险基本未被探索。特别地，对同一训练样本使用两个耦合视图可能强化其记忆。基于此，我们提出针对在策自蒸馏的首个成员推断攻击研究。我们考察灰盒与黑盒两种威胁模型，提出统一攻击框架 OP-Print。OP-Print 建立在我们的发现之上：在策自蒸馏中的监督印记稀疏且有结构，集中在不确定敏感的修正位点而非整个 rollout。利用这一性质，我们为两种访问级别构造定制攻击信号：灰盒设定下，OP-Print 直接沿同一 rollout 聚合特权的师生残差修正；黑盒设定下，它测量基于重启的输出盆地稳定性，作为隐藏修正过程的可观测替代。跨多样模型与蒸馏方案，所有基线攻击即使在灰盒访问下也基本处于随机猜测水平，而 OP-Print 在灰盒与黑盒设定下均被广泛验证有效。
summary_cn: 首个针对在策自蒸馏的成员推断攻击：监督印记稀疏集中于不确定敏感修正位点，灰盒聚合师生残差、黑盒以重启输出盆地稳定性替代，基线灰盒下近随机而 OP-Print 均有效。
objective_summary: 系统研究在策自蒸馏的成员泄露，提出基于稀疏修正印记的统一攻击框架 OP-Print，覆盖灰盒与黑盒访问级别并跨多模型验证。
evidence_note: 跨多样模型与蒸馏方案验证、两种威胁模型、与基线的系统对比；摘要未给具体数值与统计检验，未见录用信息。
novelty_note: 在策自蒸馏这一日益主流训练范式的首个成员推断系统研究，稀疏结构化印记的发现支撑灰盒/黑盒两条攻击路径。
scope: 结论适用于在策自蒸馏训练的模型；对离策蒸馏、RLHF 等其他范式的迁移未验证。
limitations: 黑盒替代信号依赖重启采样，推理成本较高
对多轮/偏好对齐变体未覆盖
印记结构的成因理论解释有限

title: Efficient and Optimal Learning of Discrete Distributions with Person-Level Privacy
abstract: We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting. Given $n$ users, each contributing $m$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $\mu$ over $[k]$, we seek an estimate of $\mu$ with total-variation error $\alpha$. We give polynomial-time algorithms under both pure and approximate differential privacy. Under pure $(\varepsilon,0)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(\alpha^2 m)+k/(\alpha\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k/\varepsilon)$, the first polynomial-time pure-DP guarantee matching the information-theoretic optimum up to logarithmic factors. Under approximate $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(\alpha^2 m)+k/(\alpha\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k+\log(1/\delta)/\varepsilon)$. At $\delta=2^{-\Theta(k)}$, this is $\widetilde O(k)$ for fixed $\alpha,\varepsilon,m$ and failure probability. Our algorithms use a new degree-6 sum-of-squares estimator for learning from untrusted batches. Its key ingredient is a trace-bounded diagonal majorizer for the difference between the empirical covariance of the repaired batch averages and the multinomial covariance predicted by their mean. We prove that clean data admit this certificate through semidefinite-programming duality and a new application of the stronger symmetric form of Grothendieck's inequality due to Friedland and Lim. The certificate preserves the mean-dependent variance of multinomial batch averages, yielding the near-optimal robust rate $O(\eta\sqrt{\log(1/\eta)/m})$ and providing the score required by the privacy reduction. We also prove a statistical query lower bound ruling out a uniformly smaller order of error under fixed polynomial SQ resource bounds.
comment: Full version of the SODA 2027 paper
title_cn: 人级隐私下离散分布的高效最优学习
abstract_cn: 我们研究批式设定下人级差分隐私的离散分布学习。给定 n 个用户、每人贡献 m 个来自 [k] 上未知分布 μ 的 i.i.d. 样本，我们寻求总变差误差 α 的 μ 估计。我们在纯差分隐私与近似差分隐私下都给出多项式时间算法。在纯 (ε,0)-DP 下，样本复杂度达到 n = Õ(k/(α²m) + k/(α√m·ε) + k/ε)，是首个在对数因子内匹配信息论最优的多项式时间纯 DP 保证。在近似 (ε,δ)-DP 下，达到 n = Õ(k/(α²m) + k/(α√m·ε) + k + log(1/δ)/ε)；当 δ = 2 的负 k 次方量级且固定 α、ε、m 与失败概率时为 Õ(k)。我们的算法使用一个新的 6 度 sum-of-squares（SoS）估计器来从不可信批次学习，其关键成分是对「修复后批次均值的经验协方差与均值所预测的多项分布协方差之差」的迹有界对角 majorizer。我们通过半定规划对偶与 Friedland–Lim 形式的更强对称 Grothendieck 不等式的新应用，证明干净数据允许该证书。该证书保有多项分布批次均值的均值相关方差，给出近最优鲁棒率 O(η√(log(1/η)/m))，并提供隐私归约所需的评分。我们还证明一个统计查询下界，排除在固定多项式 SQ 资源界下一致更小的误差阶。
summary_cn: 人级 DP 离散分布学习：首个对数因子内匹配信息论最优的多项式时间纯 DP 算法与近似 DP 界，核心为 6 度 SoS 估计器（SDP 对偶加 Grothendieck 不等式），附 SQ 下界（SODA 2027）。
objective_summary: 设计人级差分隐私下达到最优样本复杂度的离散分布学习算法，开发 SoS 鲁棒估计新技术并证明统计查询下界。
evidence_note: 匹配信息论最优（对数因子内）的完整证明、配套 SQ 下界、SODA 2027（理论顶会）录用，理论完备性高。
novelty_note: 首个纯 DP 多项式时间最优界，新的 SoS 对角 majorizer 技术对鲁棒加隐私学习有独立价值。
scope: 结论适用于批式人级 DP 的离散分布估计；连续分布、流式设定与每用户样本数不均等情形未覆盖。
limitations: 多项式时间但未优化实际运行效率
结果限于离散分布与批式设定
常数与对数因子在实用规模下可能显著

title: Social-HUMINT: An LLM-Augmented Unified Framework for Measuring Social Media Exposure
abstract: In the post-API landscape, social-media profiling has become inexpensive and automated: Large Language Models (LLMs) can extract structured information from unstructured content and deduce attributes users never disclosed. A person's true exposure is not what they post but what can be inferred from it. As these practices become routine, exposure to social engineering attacks becomes an operational certainty, demanding a shared framework for assessment and mitigation. We make this exposure measurable by quantifying how accurately a target can be profiled, and how far that profile enables social engineering attacks. Because no existing model fully spans this continuum, we unify Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT) and Cyber Human Intelligence (Cyber-HUMINT), two individual-focused disciplines that evolved separately, into a single doctrine-grounded taxonomy of 38 capabilities across the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle, where user profiling bridges passive collection and active engagement. Domain experts validated the taxonomy (Fleiss' $\kappa$ = 0.92). We operationalize its core path (extraction, inference, and susceptibility assessment) as an LLM-augmented multi-agent pipeline, evaluated on real participants' public data. Susceptibility is assessed indirectly: the pipeline predicts how each target would rank personalized engagement options, matching their actual choices significantly above chance. This ranking capacity captures the personalization on which tailored attacks depend. The underlying profiles are accurate: extraction reaches F1 = 97.3%, and inferred attributes score 4.73/5, both far above rule-based and NER-based baselines at negligible cost. The framework augments security analysts' tradecraft rather than replacing it and enables defenders to gauge their own exposure before an adversary does.
title_cn: Social-HUMINT：度量社交媒体暴露的 LLM 增强统一框架
abstract_cn: 在后 API 时代，社交媒体画像已变得廉价且自动化：大语言模型（LLM）能从非结构化内容提取结构化信息，并推断用户从未披露的属性。一个人的真实暴露不是他发了什么，而是能从中推断出什么。随着这些做法成为常态，遭遇社交工程攻击成为操作层面的确定性，迫切需要对评估与缓解的共享框架。我们使这种暴露可度量：量化对目标画像的准确度，以及该画像能把社交工程攻击推进多远。由于没有既有模型能完整覆盖这一连续谱，我们把社交媒体情报（SOCMINT）与网络人力情报（Cyber-HUMINT）这两个各自演化的以个体为中心学科，统一为覆盖网络威胁情报生命周期、由 38 项能力构成的理论驱动分类法，其中用户画像桥接被动收集与主动接触。领域专家验证了该分类法（Fleiss' κ = 0.92）。我们将其核心路径（提取、推断、易感性评估）操作化为 LLM 增强的多智能体流水线，并在真实参与者的公开数据上评估。易感性被间接评估：流水线预测每个目标会如何为个性化接触选项排序，其与真实选择的匹配显著高于随机。这种排序能力刻画了定制攻击所依赖的个性化程度。底层画像准确：提取 F1 = 97.3%，推断属性得分 4.73/5，均远超基于规则与 NER 的基线，成本可忽略。该框架增强而非取代安全分析人员的技艺，并使防御者能在对手之前评估自身暴露。
summary_cn: 统一 SOCMINT 与 Cyber-HUMINT 为 38 项能力分类法（专家验证 κ=0.92）并操作化为 LLM 流水线：公开数据提取 F1 97.3%、推断属性 4.73/5，排序预测显著高于随机。
objective_summary: 构建 SOCMINT 与 Cyber-HUMINT 统一分类法及 LLM 增强画像流水线，量化从公开内容可推断的画像精度与社交工程易感性排序预测能力。
evidence_note: 专家验证 κ=0.92、真实参与者公开数据、与规则/NER 基线对比的量化结果；易感性以排序匹配间接度量，样本规模未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 首次把 SOCMINT 与 Cyber-HUMINT 两条情报脉络统一成可操作分类法，并把「暴露即可推断」操作化为端到端度量。
scope: 结论适用于公开社交媒体内容的画像与易感性评估；私密平台、非公开数据与防御干预效果未覆盖。
limitations: 「真实参与者」数据的伦理与同意细节未在摘要说明
排序预测的样本量与置信区间未给出
38 项能力分类法的完备性依赖专家共识

title: Homomorphic Encryption with Coset Code Construction
abstract: Homomorphic encryption enables computation on input data without decrypting it. This paper extends a construction based on scalar message codes, utilizing coset codes to pack $k$ message symbols into a ciphertext vector of length $n$. For a given field and vector length, this packing method reduces the number of ciphertext vectors required to transmit a message record. A compatible family of evaluation codes supports public addition and multiplication operations up to a predetermined degree. We prove that the scheme achieves bounded chosen-plaintext security under the coordinate-label distinguishability assumption.
comment: 28 pages
title_cn: 陪集码构造的同态加密
abstract_cn: 同态加密使无需解密即可对输入数据计算。本文扩展基于标量消息码的构造，利用陪集码把 k 个消息符号打包进长度 n 的密文向量。在给定域与向量长度下，这种打包方法减少传输一个消息记录所需的密文向量数量。一个兼容的求值码族支持到预定次数的公开加法与乘法运算。我们证明该方案在坐标标签可区分性假设下达到有界选择明文安全。
summary_cn: 陪集码打包的同态加密构造：k 个消息符号装入长度 n 密文向量，求值码族支持预定次数内公开加乘，证明坐标标签可区分性假设下的有界 CPA 安全。
objective_summary: 扩展标量消息码同态构造以陪集码打包提升带宽效率，并给出有界 CPA 安全证明。
evidence_note: 构造与安全证明基于明述假设（坐标标签可区分性），有界安全级别明确；无实现效率与参数实例化数据。
novelty_note: 在既有标量消息码路线上做陪集码打包扩展，属既有构造的增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于次数受限于预定度数的加乘同态运算；对全同态与标准模型安全不适用。
limitations: 安全依赖坐标标签可区分性假设
仅有界 CPA
打包带来的计算开销与参数规模未报

title: AgentPhishing: A Benchmark of LLM Email Agents Under Adaptive Attack
abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly handle private information and act on users' behalf across desktop and web applications, including email. Phishing therefore poses privacy and security risks that depend not only on whether agents recognize malicious messages, but also on how they respond. Existing phishing datasets were developed primarily for conventional detection, leaving agent susceptibility to persuasive malicious requests insufficiently characterized. To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests. We develop PhishOpt, which optimizes reusable email-generation skills against individual agents under fixed benchmark constraints and a realism constraint. We analyze the generated emails using Cialdini's persuasion principles to identify strategies associated with agent failures and use these findings to construct a universal generation skill. Our evaluation shows that agents can handle pre-existing phishing emails safely yet remain susceptible to attacks adapted to agent behavior, while in an AgentPhishing evaluation of nine agents, four exhibit phishing-detection rates below $10\%$ and malicious-request compliance rates above $45\%$. These results highlight the limits of inferring agent safety from conventional phishing evaluations and the need to assess how agents respond to persuasive malicious requests.
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: AgentPhishing：自适应攻击下 LLM 邮件智能体的基准
abstract_cn: 计算机使用智能体日益在桌面与 Web 应用（包括邮件）中处理私密信息并代表用户行动。钓鱼因此带来的隐私与安全风险，不仅取决于智能体能否识别恶意消息，还取决于它如何响应。既有钓鱼数据集主要为传统检测开发，对智能体对说服性恶意请求的易感性刻画不足。为暴露既有数据集可能漏掉的脆弱性，我们提出 AgentPhishing——评估说服性钓鱼攻击能否逃避检测并诱导 LLM 邮件智能体服从恶意请求的基准。我们开发 PhishOpt，在固定基准约束与真实性约束下针对单个智能体优化可复用的邮件生成技能。我们用 Cialdini 说服原理分析生成邮件，识别与智能体失败相关的策略，并据此构建通用生成技能。评估显示，智能体能安全处理既有钓鱼邮件，却对针对其行为适配的攻击保持易感：在九个智能体的 AgentPhishing 评估中，四个检出率低于 10% 且恶意请求服从率高于 45%。这些结果表明，从传统钓鱼评估推断智能体安全性存在局限，必须评估智能体对说服性恶意请求的响应。
summary_cn: 自适应钓鱼基准 AgentPhishing：PhishOpt 针对智能体优化可复用生成技能，9 个智能体中 4 个检出率<10% 且服从率>45%，而它们对既有钓鱼邮件均可安全处理。
objective_summary: 构建带真实性约束的自适应钓鱼优化器与基准，量化 LLM 邮件智能体在适应型说服攻击下的检出与服从行为，并用说服原理分析失败模式。
evidence_note: 九个智能体系统评估、优化闭环有约束控制、说服策略分析；自建基准、无统计检验，未见录用信息。
novelty_note: 把「自适应优化攻击技能」引入邮件智能体评估并区分「检出既有钓鱼」与「抵抗定向说服」，评估维度有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于邮件场景的计算机使用型智能体；其他应用域与多模态钓鱼未覆盖。
limitations: 九个智能体之外的商业产品覆盖有限
攻击优化的真实性约束主观
提示加固等防御机制的缓解效果未系统评估

title: Auditing the Hand-Written Inputs of Learned Access Control
abstract: Learned access control is typically deployed behind two hand-built artefacts: a hard-deny set enforced by a small trusted shield, and a region map that decides which requests mined rules answer and which the learner answers. Verifying the shield or measuring the learner validates neither. We audit both on the five public ABAC Lab policies. First, we formalise hard-deny soundness and check it exhaustively over relations of up to 794,250 tuples. Clauses that faithfully transcribe an explicit restriction are unsound at rates of 0.50-0.70 across four elicitors - an author and three blind language-model elicitors - because prose scopes restrictions to a section while the grant relation is a disjunction over all rules: 97% of counterexamples are granted by other rules. Shipped unchecked, these deny sets would withhold 16-78% of everything the policies grant; certified, they withhold nothing. Vacuity, a second silent failure, also occurs. Second, hybrid routing needs a two-class, abstaining rule set that ABAC miners do not emit, and ranking a mixed-effect candidate pool under a cap is one-class in all 24 cells for the two commonest ranking keys. Third, for additive losses the hybrid-versus-learner effect factorises into covered mass times a rule-learner risk contrast that must be reported on both false-non-grant and false-permit loss: on two real policies, most selection rules give opposite verdicts on the two losses, and the one favourable on both holds for one policy, one learner configuration and a band of noise levels. A released artefact regenerates and checks every reported number.
title_cn: 审计学习式访问控制的手写输入
abstract_cn: 学习式访问控制通常部署在两个人工构建物之后：由小型可信盾强制执行的硬拒绝集，以及决定挖掘规则与学习器各回答哪些请求的区域映射。验证盾或测量学习器都无助于验证二者本身。我们在五个公开 ABAC Lab 策略上审计两者。第一，我们形式化硬拒绝可靠性并在至多 794,250 元组的关系上穷尽检查。忠实转录显式限制的子句在四位撰写者——一位作者与三位盲测语言模型撰写者——下的不可靠率为 0.50–0.70，因为散文把限制限定到某一部分而授权关系是所有规则的析取：97% 的反例由其他规则授予。若不加检查就部署，这些拒绝集将扣留策略所授权的 16–78%；认证后则一无所扣。第二类静默失效「空洞性」也会发生。第二，混合路由需要 ABAC 挖掘器不产出的两类弃权规则集，而对两个最常用排序键，在全部 24 个格子里把混合效应候选池在有上限条件下排序都是单类问题。第三，对加性损失，混合对学习器的效应因子化为「覆盖质量乘规则—学习器风险对比」，且该对比必须同时在假拒绝与假授权两种损失上报告：在两个真实策略上，多数选择规则给出相反判决，唯一在两者上都有利的仅对一个策略、一个学习器配置与一段噪声带成立。已发布工件可再生并检验每个报告数字。
summary_cn: 穷尽检查（至 794,250 元组）发现忠实转录限制的硬拒绝子句不可靠率 0.50–0.70（作者与 3 个 LLM 撰写者皆然，97% 反例由其他规则授予），不检查将扣留 16–78% 合法授权。
objective_summary: 形式化并穷尽审计学习式访问控制的硬拒绝盾与区域映射两个人工构建物，量化人工与 LLM 撰写子句的不可靠率、混合路由评估缺陷与损失度量错位。
evidence_note: 五个公开策略上至 794,250 元组的穷尽检查、四位撰写者对比、工件完整可复现；但策略库限于 ABAC Lab 公开集。
novelty_note: 首个系统审计「学习式访问控制的人工输入层」，揭示散文语义与授权关系错位导致的系统性不可靠，诊断价值高。
scope: 结论适用于 ABAC Lab 类策略关系与析取式授权语义；对其他策略语言与授权语义需重新检查。
limitations: 公开策略集仅五个
LLM 撰写者样本与提示方式有限
修复建议仅部分（认证后零扣留）被验证

title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
abstract: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.
