title_cn: AfterDeleteBench：审计 LLM 智能体删除后的信息存续
abstract_cn: 许多 LLM 智能体维护外部持久记忆，并从既往交互派生额外状态（如摘要）。因此删除原始记忆记录并不必然移除其后代所携带的信息。我们提出 AfterDeleteBench——针对这一失效模式在固定权重 LLM 智能体上的受控行为审计。对每个合成秘密，我们比较「曾暴露后删除」的智能体与从未接触该秘密的匹配对照智能体，使删除后恢复可归因于原始暴露。在主设定中，单次查询即可从 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 中恢复被删秘密的比例约为三分之二，而匹配的从未暴露对照恢复为零。关键的是，恢复不需要存活的逐字副本：当完整秘密字符串已不存在、只剩公开组合规则下的分别存储组件时，跨 Qwen、Mistral 与 Phi-3 的精确重建成功率为 62–99%。我们还表明响应接口是测量系统的一部分：当请求格式与解析器错位时，含目标的回答可能被判为失败。最后我们区分重建、写回与会话内回忆：溯源感知的清除在受测阳性基线设定中消除可观测恢复，而精确字面写回过滤器能阻断再插入但无法清除已在的信息。这些结果表明，来源删除应在智能体及其记忆系统层面做行为评估，而非仅当作存储操作。
summary_cn: 受控审计「删除不等于信息消除」：单查询恢复被删秘密约 2/3（对照为 0），仅存组件加公开组合规则时跨三模型重建 62–99%；溯源感知清除可消除可观测恢复。
objective_summary: 构建「暴露后删除对比从未暴露」配对的受控基准 AfterDeleteBench，量化智能体记忆删除后经重建、写回与会话回忆的信息存续，并评估两类清除机制。
evidence_note: 配对对照设计使归因干净、跨三模型系统量化、区分重建/写回/回忆三类通路、评估两种清除机制；合成秘密设定但控制严密。
novelty_note: 首个把「删除不等于信息消除」在智能体记忆层面系统化为可测失效模式的基准，指出仅删源的治理盲区。
scope: 结论适用于带持久记忆与派生状态的固定权重 LLM 智能体；基于合成秘密与所测三个模型家族。
limitations: 合成秘密与受控会话不完全代表真实使用
记忆系统实现（RAG/摘要管线）多样性有限
清除机制的评估限于阳性基线设定

title: Practical Auditing of Differentially Private Graph Release Mechanisms: Methodology, Toolkit, and Case Study
abstract: Differential Privacy (DP) has become a prominent approach for protecting graph data releases, yet empirical auditing methodologies have largely been developed for tabular datasets and machine learning pipelines rather than graph-structured outputs. We present a methodology for empirically auditing DP graph release mechanisms, identifying two graph-specific audit design problems: canary construction and witness statistic selection. We combine these components with an established statistically certified testing procedure and implement the resulting methodology as an open-source Python toolkit. To demonstrate the approach, we audit a published state-of-the-art Node-DP graph release mechanism. Across a series of synthetic and real-world canary pairs, we obtain certified lower bounds on the privacy parameter {\varepsilon} that exceed the claimed value, yielding counterexamples sufficient to falsify the claimed guarantee for the audited implementation. The violations persist under progressively stronger restrictions on the input domain, including non-empty and connected graphs. We also show that witness selection can materially affect whether a violation is detected, highlighting the importance of evaluating a diverse battery of statistics when auditing DP graph release mechanisms.
comment: Accepted to AISC '27
title_cn: 差分隐私图发布机制实用审计：方法学、工具包与案例研究
abstract_cn: 差分隐私（DP）已成为保护图数据发布的主流方法，但经验审计方法学大多为表格数据与机器学习流水线而非图结构输出开发。我们提出审计 DP 图发布机制的方法学，识别两个图特有的审计设计问题：金丝雀构造与见证统计量选择。我们把这些组件与已确立的统计认证检验程序结合，并将该方法学实现为开源 Python 工具包。作为示范，我们审计一个已发表的 Node-DP 图发布机制。在一系列合成与真实金丝雀对上，我们得到超过所声称值的隐私参数 ε 认证下界，所得反例足以证伪被审计实现声称的保证。在输入域的逐步更强限制（含非空图与连通图）下违规持续存在。我们还表明见证选择会实质影响违规能否被检出，凸显审计 DP 图发布机制时评估多样化统计量集合的重要性。
summary_cn: DP 图发布审计方法学与开源工具包：金丝雀构造加见证选择加统计认证检验，对已发表 Node-DP 机制测得超声称值的认证 ε 下界，反例在连通图等限制下仍成立。
objective_summary: 形式化图发布机制的差分隐私经验审计设计问题，构建统计认证工具包并审计已发表 Node-DP 实现，给出证伪其隐私声明的反例。
evidence_note: 统计认证检验程序、多种金丝雀对与限制条件的系统实验、开源工具包；审计对象为单一已发表机制，AISC '27 录用（非顶会）。
novelty_note: 把 DP 审计方法学扩展到图发布并形式化金丝雀/见证两个图特有设计问题，实测发现违规，是实质性方法贡献。
scope: 结论适用于图结构输出的 DP 机制审计；审计结论针对被测实现而非 Node-DP 定义本身。
limitations: 仅深入审计一个机制
金丝雀对的构造空间无法穷尽，未检出违规不等于无违规
ε 下界与真实泄露的差距依赖见证质量

title: Weaponizing the Exit: Input Privacy Leakage via Exit Routing Manipulation in Multi-Exit Networks
abstract: Multi-exit networks improve inference efficiency by allowing inputs to terminate early at intermediate exits. We identify a privacy vulnerability in cloud deployments of these networks: a malicious Cloud Service Provider (CSP) can infer sensitive properties of individual user inputs solely from inference latency, without accessing inputs, intermediate states, or model outputs. The attack exploits the CSP's control over the model supply chain. Prior to deployment, the CSP supplies a specially crafted multi-exit network manipulated so that inputs carrying a target sensitive property are routed to a designated exit with high probability, while other inputs exit elsewhere. At serving time, the CSP infers the exit index from per-query latency, thereby determining whether each input possesses the target property without accessing inputs, outputs, or internal model states. We propose a training framework combining selective label smoothing and entropy-covariance optimization to control confidence distributions across exits and reduce premature termination. We conduct experiments on four datasets across ten target properties. The results demonstrate strong attack effectiveness and stealthiness. The attack achieves an average F1 score of 0.73, compared to 0.25 for the strongest baseline, while main task accuracy drops by less than 1.3\% and inference speedup degradation remains below 0.1 in most settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/kazefjj/Weaponizing_the_Exit.
title_cn: 武器化出口：多出口网络中经出口路由操纵的输入隐私泄露
abstract_cn: 多出口网络通过让输入在中间出口提前终止来提升推理效率。我们识别这些网络云部署中的一个隐私漏洞：恶意云服务提供商（CSP）无需访问输入、中间状态或模型输出，仅凭推理时延即可推断单个用户输入的敏感属性。该攻击利用 CSP 对模型供应链的控制。部署前，CSP 供应经特殊构造的多出口网络，使携带目标敏感属性的输入以高概率被路由到指定出口，其他输入从别处退出。服务时，CSP 从每查询时延推断出口索引，从而判定每个输入是否具有目标属性，而无需访问输入、输出或内部模型状态。我们提出结合选择性标签平滑与熵—协方差优化的训练框架，以控制各出口的置信度分布并减少过早终止。我们在四个数据集、十个目标属性上做实验，结果表明攻击强且隐蔽：平均 F1 达 0.73（最强基线 0.25），主任务准确率下降不到 1.3%，推理加速退化在多数设定下低于 0.1。代码已开源。
summary_cn: 恶意模型供应商借出口路由加时延侧信道窃取输入敏感属性：4 数据集 10 属性平均 F1 0.73（基线 0.25），主任务损失<1.3%、加速几乎不损。
objective_summary: 提出经构造多出口网络路由偏置并从时延推断出口索引的输入属性泄露攻击，配套训练框架控制出口置信分布，并量化攻击效果与隐蔽性代价。
evidence_note: 四数据集、十属性、与基线定量对比并公开代码；实验室设定，真实云部署的时延噪声未建模。
novelty_note: 「恶意供应商在模型供应链植入路由后门并以时延外泄」是新的威胁模型，攻防两端机制完整。
scope: 结论适用于云端托管多出口网络推理；对自托管、单出口或时延不可观测的部署不适用。
limitations: 假设 CSP 能控制模型分发且用户无验证手段
真实网络抖动对时延推断的影响未测
防御方案未在本文给出

title: Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering with Shuffler-Based Anonymization
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization. In federated clustering, each round reveals additional model information to the server and can increase the opportunity to infer properties of local datasets, even when raw samples are never shared. Consequently, fewer client-server exchanges and unlinkability are important, so transmitted information cannot be attributed to any single client. Data-stream clustering algorithms, which learn in a single pass over the data, align well with the one-shot federated learning paradigm, where a single communication round can be sufficient. The proposed Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering (eFDPC) method combines evolving fuzzy data-stream clustering and density peak clustering in a federated setting. Each client independently evolves micro-clusters from private data mini-batches through cluster addition and merging. To limit communication, density peak clustering is applied to the learned micro-clusters and only the selected peaks are transmitted, rather than the full local models. A shuffler-based layer is introduced between the clients and the server to anonymize contributions prior to reconstruction and global peak selection. We consider a peak-only variant, eFDPC-P, as well as eFDPC-G with server-side label propagation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets show that eFDPC outperforms recent federated clustering baselines in one-shot settings and scales to higher-dimensional, non-IID data.
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures. Published open access (CC BY 4.0) in Evolving Systems 17, 123 (2026). Code: this https URL
title_cn: 结合洗牌器匿名化的演化式联邦密度峰值聚类
abstract_cn: 我们提出一种基于演化模糊聚类与洗牌器匿名化的新颖一次性（one-shot）联邦聚类方法。在联邦聚类中，每一轮都会向服务器透露额外的模型信息，即便原始样本从不共享，也可能增加推断本地数据集属性的机会。因此更少的客户端—服务器交换与不可链接性很重要，使传输信息无法归因于任何单一客户端。在数据上单遍学习的数据流聚类算法与一次性联邦学习范式高度契合——单轮通信即可足够。所提出的演化联邦密度峰值聚类（eFDPC）把演化模糊数据流聚类与密度峰值聚类结合在联邦设定中。每个客户端从私有数据迷你批中经簇添加与合并独立演化微簇。为限制通信，对学到的微簇应用密度峰值聚类，只传输被选出的峰值而非完整本地模型。我们在客户端与服务器之间引入洗牌器层，在重构与全局峰值选择前对贡献匿名化。我们考虑仅峰值变体 eFDPC-P，以及带服务器端标签传播的 eFDPC-G。在合成与真实基准数据集上的实验表明，eFDPC 在一次性设定中超越近期的联邦聚类基线，并能扩展到更高维、非 IID 数据。
summary_cn: 一次性联邦聚类 eFDPC：本地演化微簇、只传密度峰值并以洗牌器匿名化，在合成与真实基准的一次性设定中超越近期联邦聚类基线，可扩展到高维非 IID 数据（代码公开）。
objective_summary: 提出结合演化模糊流聚类、密度峰值筛选与洗牌器匿名化的一次性联邦聚类方法 eFDPC，以减少通信轮次与可链接性，并做多数据集对比。
evidence_note: 合成与真实基准、与近期联邦聚类基线对比、期刊发表（Evolving Systems）、代码公开；无统计检验，隐私性仅以架构性匿名化论证。
novelty_note: 演化流聚类、密度峰值与洗牌匿名均为已有组件，组合到一次性联邦聚类场景属场景性整合。
scope: 结论适用于可微簇化的数据流式联邦聚类场景；强对抗服务器（主动链接攻击）下的隐私界未量化。
limitations: 匿名化无形式化隐私保证（非 DP）
峰值筛选对簇形态的适应性有限
通信量随维度增长的细节未在摘要给出

title: Structural cryptanalysis of classic McEliece: Assessment of claims, costs and evidence
abstract: For the last two years, classical structural attacks on McEliece with binary Goppa codes progressed further, at the parameters of Classic McEliece, than in the previous four decades: a subexponential and then a quasi-polynomial distinguisher, key recoveries for public challenges with brute-force labels up to $254$, and conditional key-recovery estimates of about $2^{89}$ to $2^{128}$ per run of a large sparse linear-algebra computation, depending on the parameter set and on whether and how memory access is charged. On September 2026 the German BSI advised against new deployments of the scheme. This paper gives a version-aware critical assessment of these results. It separates proved distinguishers, conditional cost estimates and actual recoveries; analyses in detail Saarinen's HOVER algorithm, his conditional cost analysis and his recovery of the TII-254 challenge, together with Weis's cost study of Holdout/Hermite key recovery; and compares the other key-recovery routes and the objections raised against them. Our own analysis finds that the cost model is now the main quantitative uncertainty, with about thirty bits between the cheapest and the most expensive model for the same computation; that for the four larger parameter sets every model considered leaves the conditional estimates far below the targeted levels, whereas for mceliece348864 the shortfall is of the order of the spread between models; that the structural estimates are lower than Grover-accelerated information-set decoding for the four larger sets in essentially every model and comparable for mceliece348864; and that none of this is a demonstrated attack, since the underlying heuristics have been tested only on instances tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of times smaller than the target. We close with open questions.
title_cn: 经典 McEliece 的结构密码分析：主张、代价与证据的评估
abstract_cn: 过去两年，针对二元 Goppa 码 McEliece 的经典结构攻击在 Classic McEliece 参数下取得的进展超过了此前四十年：先是亚指数、随后是拟多项式时间的区分器；带暴力标签至 254 的公开挑战密钥恢复；以及视参数集与内存访问计费方式而定的每轮大规模稀疏线性代数计算的条件性密钥恢复估计，约 2 的 89 次方至 2 的 128 次方。2026 年 9 月，德国 BSI 建议不要新部署该方案。本文对这些结果给出版本感知的批判性评估。它把已证明的区分器、条件性代价估计与实际密钥恢复区分开来；详细分析 Saarinen 的 HOVER 算法、其条件代价分析与对 TII-254 挑战的恢复，连同 Weis 对 Holdout/Hermite 密钥恢复的代价研究；并比较其他密钥恢复路线及针对它们的异议。我们自己的分析发现：代价模型现在是主要的定量不确定性来源，同一计算的最便宜与最昂贵模型之间相差约 30 比特；对四个较大参数集，所考虑的每个模型给出的条件估计都远低于目标安全级别，而对 mceliece348864，缺口与模型间差异同量级；结构估计在几乎所有模型下低于 Grover 加速的信息集译码（对四个较大参数集），对 mceliece348864 大致相当；且这些都不是已演示的攻击，因为底层启发式只在比目标小一万到十万倍的实例上测试过。文末给出开放问题。
summary_cn: 对 Classic McEliece 近两年结构攻击的批判性评估：代价模型相差约 30 比特是主要不确定性；四组较大参数条件估计远低于目标级，尚无已演示攻击（启发式仅在小 1–10 万倍的实例上验证）。
objective_summary: 系统梳理并批判性评估近两年针对 Classic McEliece 的结构攻击主张，分离证明、条件估计与实际恢复，比较多种代价模型并给出安全结论边界。
evidence_note: 版本感知的系统梳理加原创代价模型比较（量化 30 比特分歧），结论审慎（明确指出非已演示攻击）；无新实验。
novelty_note: 在标准化迁移决策热点期给出系统化的证据分级与代价模型敏感性分析，对社区解读近期攻击价值高。
scope: 结论覆盖 Classic McEliece 全部参数集与 2024–2026 年公开的结构攻击文献；对其他码基方案不直接适用。
limitations: 代价估计依赖启发式外推
上游新结果可能快速过时
对具体标准化决策的影响超出论文控制

title: BelT Block Cipher
abstract: BelT is a block cipher with a 128-bit block size and a 256-bit key, developed in Belarus and adopted as part of the Belarusian national standard STB 34.101.31 for encryption and integrity control. Its specification was issued as a preliminary standard in 2007, becoming a final standard in 2011. BelT employs an eight-round structure combining elements of a Feistel network and the Lai-Massey scheme. This paper presents a complete description of the cipher and explains the principles underlying its design. Software performance and possible optimizations of BelT are discussed in comparison with those of candidates in the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) competition.
title_cn: BelT 分组密码
abstract_cn: BelT 是一个 128 比特分组、256 比特密钥的分组密码，由白俄罗斯开发，并被白俄罗斯国家标准 STB 34.101.31 采纳用于加密与完整性控制。其规范于 2007 年作为预标准发布，2011 年成为正式标准。BelT 采用八轮结构，结合了 Feistel 网络与 Lai-Massey 方案的要素。本文给出该密码的完整描述，并解释其设计原则。文中还讨论了 BelT 的软件性能及其与 AES 竞选候选者相比的可能优化。
summary_cn: 给出白俄罗斯标准 STB 34.101.31 中 BelT 分组密码（128 比特分组/256 比特密钥、八轮 Feistel 与 Lai-Massey 混合结构）的完整描述与设计原则，讨论软件性能与优化。
objective_summary: 系统描述 BelT 分组密码的结构、设计原则与软件性能，将其引入国际文献。
evidence_note: 标准规范描述性文档，无新密码分析结果或安全证明，性能讨论为与 AES 候选的定性比较。
novelty_note: 密码本体 2011 年即已定标，本文为既有标准的文献化描述，无新技术。
scope: 适用于了解 BelT 设计与实现的读者；不提供新的安全评估或攻击结果。
limitations: 无新密码分析
性能比较为定性
标准文本之外的实现陷阱未讨论

title: WildFakeToolBench: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detectors with Web-Sourced Image Processing
abstract: As AI generated images are getting popular these days, discussions on such generations are widely existed in current public forums, software repositories, and photography tutorials. Moreover, with the help of LLM-assisted code translation, malicious actors can adopt such information to evade detectors without specialized knowledge or local GPU execution of the resulting tools. To evaluate such risks, we introduce \textsc{WildFakeToolBench}, a benchmark suite of $156$ executable image-processing tools derived from $220$ public sources across $142$ domains. Each tool retains its source evidence and passes syntax, execution, and output-distortion checks without using feedback from the evaluated detectors. On $105$ generated images from five generators, we evaluate six state-of-the-art detectors with images processed by the tools in our collected bench to assess their effectiveness against such in-the-wild risks. The strongest individual tools achieve attack success rates of $25.25\%$--$100\%$ across detectors, exceeding the strongest of six selected image-processing baselines for each detector. Evaluating subsets of an eight-tool pool yields worst-case coverage above $80\%$ for every detector. Effectiveness is sparse and detector-specific: high coverage across candidates does not imply reliable one-shot evasion. These findings not only highlight the potential of such web-sourced risks, but also show the potential on establishing AI-image detector robustness evaluation framework based on those in-the-wild information.
title_cn: WildFakeToolBench：用网络来源图像处理工具基准测试 AI 生成图像检测器
abstract_cn: 随着 AI 生成图像流行，相关讨论广泛存在于公共论坛、软件仓库与摄影教程。借助 LLM 辅助的代码翻译，恶意者无需专业知识或本地 GPU 执行即可利用这些信息规避检测器。为评估此类风险，我们提出 WildFakeToolBench——一个从 142 个领域的 220 个公开来源衍生、由 156 个可执行图像处理工具组成的基准套件。每个工具保留来源证据并通过语法、执行与输出失真检查，且不使用被评估检测器的反馈。在来自五个生成器的 105 张生成图像上，我们用基准中的工具处理图像，评估六个最先进检测器面对此类在野风险的有效性。最强单个工具在各检测器上取得 25.25%–100% 的攻击成功率，超过为每个检测器选取的六个图像处理基线中的最强者。对八工具池子集的评估显示每个检测器的最坏情况覆盖率均高于 80%。有效性稀疏且依赖检测器：候选工具的高覆盖并不意味可靠的一次性逃逸。这些发现不仅凸显此类网络来源风险的潜力，也展示以此类在野信息建立 AI 图像检测器鲁棒性评估框架的前景。
summary_cn: 从 220 个公开来源构建 156 个可执行图像处理工具的逃逸基准：最强工具对 6 个 SOTA 检测器 ASR 25.25%–100%，八工具池最坏覆盖均超 80%，有效性稀疏且依赖检测器。
objective_summary: 构建带来源证据与质量门控的网络来源图像处理工具基准 WildFakeToolBench，量化其对 AI 生成图像检测器的逃逸能力与工具池覆盖特性。
evidence_note: 156 工具经语法/执行/失真三重门控、6 检测器与 5 生成器 105 图的系统评估、与 6 个基线对比；无统计检验，图像规模有限。
novelty_note: 首个系统收集「在野」图像处理工具作为逃逸手段的检测器鲁棒性基准，把社区讨论变成可复现评估资源。
scope: 结论适用于 AI 生成图像检测器的鲁棒性测量；工具池为公开来源样本，恶意者的私有工具集可能更强。
limitations: 105 张图像、5 个生成器的规模有限
工具执行环境与真实攻击者的差异
未评估检测器端防御（训练时增广等）后的表现

title: Federated Differentially Private Optimization via Low-Rank Preconditioning
abstract: We consider differentially private (DP) optimization in the federated setting, where a DP estimate of the feature covariance matrix serves as a Hessian approximation for generalized linear models. Existing central DP methods for covariance estimation have communication cost that grows quadratically in the data dimension, while existing baselines with linear communication cost are only locally private and degrade as the number of clients increases. As a remedy, we propose a federated DP-PCA framework that achieves linear communication cost while providing central DP guarantees under secure aggregation. It consists of a DP rank selection step, a DP power method, and a noisy release of the covariance projected onto the selected low-dimensional subspace. We give error bounds for this covariance estimate and for the resulting low-communication preconditioned DP gradient descent. Empirically, our proposed DP optimization method matches a centralized baseline with quadratic communication cost at a fraction of the communication.
title_cn: 经低秩预条件的联邦差分隐私优化
abstract_cn: 我们研究联邦设定下的差分隐私（DP）优化，其中特征协方差矩阵的 DP 估计作为广义线性模型的 Hessian 近似。既有协方差估计的中心化 DP 方法通信成本随数据维度二次增长，而具有线性通信成本的既有基线只有本地隐私且随客户端数增加而退化。作为补救，我们提出一个联邦 DP-PCA 框架，在安全聚合下以线性通信成本提供中心化 DP 保证。它由 DP 秩选择、DP 幂迭代法以及把协方差投影到所选低维子空间的噪声释放组成。我们给出该协方差估计以及由此得到的低通信预条件 DP 梯度下降的误差界。经验上，我们提出的 DP 优化方法以一小部分通信成本匹配具有二次通信成本的集中式基线。
summary_cn: 联邦 DP-PCA 框架：DP 秩选择加 DP 幂法加低维投影噪声释放，在安全聚合下以线性通信成本给出中心化 DP 保证与误差界，实验以小部分通信匹配集中式基线。
objective_summary: 设计线性通信、中心化 DP 保证的联邦协方差估计与预条件 DP 优化方法，给出误差界并做经验对比。
evidence_note: 有误差界与集中式基线的经验匹配；但为广义线性模型设定下的理论加仿真，无真实联邦部署。
novelty_note: 在中心化 DP 保证与线性通信之间给出可行折中并配误差界，是对联邦 DP 协方差估计问题的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于广义线性模型与可低秩近似的特征协方差；深度非线性模型的适用性未验证。
limitations: 误差界依赖低秩近似质量
仅在广义线性模型设定验证
安全聚合的开销未计入通信分析

title: SecLog-Bench: A Scalable Benchmark for Cybersecurity Log Reasoning with Scaffolded Evidence
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for cybersecurity, leading to growing interest in LLM-based automated cybersecurity log analysis. However, current datasets (1) are limited in scale; (2) rely mainly on single-source evidence; and (3) have only binary or multi-class attack labels, without dense annotations of the reasoning process. To address these limitations, SecLog-Bench has three key features. First, we build an extensible simulation platform that covers 29 attack scenarios, supports repeated execution and the integration of new scenarios, and enables scalable generation of cybersecurity logs with attack-stage labels. Second, we use multi-source logs, including audit logs, application logs, and network traffic, to jointly analyze cyber attacks. Third, we annotate each sample with the essential context for cybersecurity log reasoning and a structured step-by-step evidence chain. We evaluate eight mainstream LLMs on this benchmark for post-detection attack-progress reasoning. Results show that, when provided with scaffolded evidence, current LLMs exhibit modest capability in attack-progress reasoning, with the best model achieving only 44.44% accuracy and 45.07% Macro-F1. Their reasoning remains unreliable; i.e., the highest Stage Reasoning F1 (SRF1) score is only 54.87%. Moreover, even correct predictions may be accompanied by flawed reasoning, and reasoning quality is often misaligned with prediction accuracy.
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing. Code and data: this https URL
title_cn: SecLog-Bench：带脚手架证据的可扩展网络安全日志推理基准
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）在网络安全上展现出强大潜力，带动基于 LLM 的自动化网络安全日志分析升温。但现有数据集（1）规模有限；（2）主要依赖单一来源证据；（3）只有二元或多类攻击标签，缺少推理过程的密集标注。针对这些局限，SecLog-Bench 有三个关键特性。第一，我们构建可扩展的仿真平台，覆盖 29 个攻击场景，支持重复执行与新场景集成，可持续生成带攻击阶段标签的网络安全日志。第二，我们使用多源日志——审计日志、应用日志与网络流量——联合分析网络攻击。第三，我们为每个样本标注网络安全日志推理所需的关键上下文与结构化的分步证据链。我们在该基准上评估八个主流 LLM 的检测后攻击进程推理能力。结果显示，在提供脚手架证据时，当前 LLM 在攻击进程推理上能力有限，最佳模型仅 44.44% 准确率与 45.07% Macro-F1；其推理不可靠——最高的阶段推理 F1（SRF1）仅 54.87%；且即便预测正确也可能伴随有缺陷的推理，推理质量与预测准确率常常错位。
summary_cn: 可扩展日志推理基准：29 个攻击场景仿真平台、多源日志与分步证据链标注；8 个主流 LLM 最佳仅 44.44% 准确率、SRF1≤54.87%，推理质量与准确率常错位。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖多攻击场景、多源日志与密集推理标注的安全日志基准 SecLog-Bench，并系统评估八个 LLM 的攻击进程推理能力与推理可靠性。
evidence_note: 29 场景仿真平台可重复执行、多源日志与密集标注、8 个模型系统评估、代码与数据公开；数据为仿真生成（有真值优势但与真实日志有差距），投稿 IEEE TDSC 在审。
novelty_note: 相对既有单源、粗标签日志数据集，多源加分步证据链加可扩展仿真是实质性补充，填补推理级评估空白。
scope: 结论适用于 LLM 攻击进程推理能力的对照评估；仿真日志与生产环境日志分布存在差距。
limitations: 仿真生成的日志逼真度有限
29 场景对攻击全谱系覆盖仍窄
推理质量评估依赖所定义的证据链结构

title: ReDence: A Hybrid Agentic and Decision-Model Framework for Rapid, Evidence-Grounded Detection of Modern Social Engineering Scams
abstract: Detecting online social engineering (SE) scams often requires examining website workflows, verifying claims against external sources, and connecting evidence across multiple pages. Existing detectors provide limited support for these investigations, leaving analysts to manually gather and validate evidence, which inevitably delays detection and subsequent takedown of these attacks. To address this gap, we present ReDence, an open-source hybrid framework for adaptive, evidence-grounded detection across diverse SE scam categories. ReDence combines two locally hosted models with complementary responsibilities: a fine-tuned multimodal agentic Investigator (Qwen3.5-4B) that performs investigative planning, evidence interpretation, and reporting, and a specialized Decider (Tev1) that handles binary and multiple-choice tasks, including browser-action selection, evidence assessment, and decisions about whether to continue an investigation. By delegating discrete decisions to a specialized model, ReDence reduces reliance on lengthy language-model responses, while preserving the reasoning capabilities required for complex investigations. Our evaluation demonstrates that ReDence achieves 96\% accuracy in detecting scams across twelve SE scam categories, substantially outperforming existing detectors while being at least four times faster than comparable agentic models without compromising investigative depth. ReDence also produces structured, evidence-grounded reports that document investigative actions, supporting and contradictory evidence, and collected artifacts, which allow analysts to independently audit detection decisions and utilize the collected evidence to support subsequent mitigation and takedown efforts.
title_cn: ReDence：智能体与决策模型混合的社交工程诈骗快速取证式检测框架
abstract_cn: 检测在线社交工程（SE）诈骗往往需要检查网站工作流、对照外部来源核实声明、并跨多个页面连接证据。现有检测器对这些调查支持有限，分析人员只能手工收集与验证证据，这不可避免地拖延检测与后续取缔。为填补这一缺口，我们提出 ReDence——一个开源的混合框架，覆盖多样 SE 诈骗类别的自适应、以证据为据的检测。ReDence 组合两个本地托管、职责互补的模型：微调的多模态智能体 Investigator（Qwen3.5-4B）负责调查规划、证据解读与报告；专用 Decider（Tev1）负责二元与多选任务，包括浏览器动作选择、证据评估以及是否继续调查的决策。把离散决策交给专用模型，ReDence 减少对冗长语言模型回复的依赖，同时保住复杂调查所需的推理能力。评估表明 ReDence 在 12 个 SE 诈骗类别上取得 96% 的检出准确率，大幅超越现有检测器，且比可比的智能体模型快至少四倍而不牺牲调查深度。ReDence 还产出结构化、有证据支撑的报告，记录调查动作、支持与矛盾证据及收集的工件，让分析人员可独立审计检测决策，并利用所收证据支持后续缓解与取缔。
summary_cn: Investigator（微调 Qwen3.5-4B）加 Decider 双模型混合检测 12 类社交工程诈骗：准确率 96%，比可比智能体模型快至少 4 倍，产出可审计证据报告，开源。
objective_summary: 提出以多模态调查智能体加专用决策模型的分工式诈骗检测框架 ReDence，在 12 类诈骗上评估准确率、速度与证据报告的可审计性。
evidence_note: 12 类别覆盖、96% 准确率、速度倍数与开源；但测试数据自建、基线细节与统计检验未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 「调查智能体加专用决策模型」的职责切分降低推理成本并保留证据链，是对智能体检测系统架构的实质改进。
scope: 结论适用于网页类社交工程诈骗的自动化调查；非网页载体（电话、短信）与强对抗性诈骗未覆盖。
limitations: 12 类诈骗分布由作者构造，真实占比未知
小模型（4B）的调查规划上限未探明
对反取证设计诈骗页面的鲁棒性未评估

title: Bridging Number-Theoretic Primality Testing And Algorithmic Optimization: An Adaptive Cryptographic Framework
abstract: The security of modern public-key cryptographic systems, such as RSA, Diffie-Hellman, and ECC, depends entirely on the computational intractability of the integer factorization and discrete logarithm problems. For these asymmetric algorithms to operate, a core requirement is that the system must be capable of generating, testing, and simultaneously proving the primality of extraordinarily large numbers. To meet those requirements, this study proposes a comprehensive framework, bridging clas- sical number theory with modern machine learning models and optimization algorithms. Specifically, the paper delineates an adaptive, arbitrary-precision architecture dedicated exclusively to primality testing. Concurrently, the research deeply analyzes the theoretical foundations of testing methods (both deterministic and probabilistic), hardware-level optimization techniques, and the application of quantum-secured entropy sources, while providing rigorous mathematical proofs to guarantee security even when the prime distribution is biased.
title_cn: 桥接数论素性检测与算法优化：一个自适应密码学框架
abstract_cn: 现代公钥密码系统（如 RSA、Diffie-Hellman 与 ECC）的安全性完全依赖整数分解与离散对数问题的计算难解性。为使这些非对称算法运作，系统的核心要求是能够生成、检测并同时对超大数的素性给出证明。为满足这些要求，本研究提出一个综合性框架，把经典数论与现代机器学习模型及优化算法桥接起来。具体地，本文勾勒一个专用于素性检测的自适应任意精度架构；同时深入研究检测方法（确定性与概率性）的理论基础、硬件级优化技术以及量子安全熵源的应用，并在素数分布有偏时仍以严格的数学证明保证安全性。
summary_cn: 提出桥接数论与机器学习/优化的素性检测框架：自适应任意精度架构、硬件优化与量子熵源讨论，并声称在素数分布有偏时给出安全证明，摘要无实验细节。
objective_summary: 整合素性检测的确定性与概率性方法、任意精度架构与硬件优化，讨论量子熵源应用并给出分布有偏时的安全论证。
evidence_note: 摘要未报告任何实验结果、基准对比或证明内容细节；声称框架与证明但无可核查的量化信息。
novelty_note: 素性检测为成熟领域，摘要未指明具体新机制或改进界，框架性表述新意有限。
scope: 适用于大素数生成与检测的工程整合讨论；具体性能与安全证明强度无法从摘要判断。
limitations: 摘要未给出任何实验或证明细节
「机器学习模型」在素性检测中的具体作用不明
与既有素数生成库的对比缺失

title: MIG-COW: Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Deepfake Detectors via Gradient Decomposition
abstract: Despite recent advances, deepfake detectors remain vulnerable to adversarial examples, particularly in diverse, real-world settings. We propose MIG-COW, a novel adversarial attack framework that generates highly generalizable and visually imperceptible adversarial examples. By combining momentum-integrated gradients with a consensus-orthogonal decomposition, MIG-COW captures both shared and model-specific vulnerabilities across heterogeneous CNN and ViT detectors. On the AADD-2025 Challenge benchmarks, MIG-COW achieves a 99.96% white-box attack success rate (ASR) with high perceptual similarity (SSIM), significantly outperforming existing baselines. However, its limited 7.16% ASR against official black-box targets - despite achieving the best overall score - highlights the ongoing challenge of transferability. We also demonstrate that incorporating low-performing but diverse models in the ensemble can degrade attack effectiveness, underscoring the need for careful surrogate model selection in real-world adversarial settings.
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, ACM MM '25
title_cn: MIG-COW：经梯度分解的深度伪造检测器可迁移对抗攻击
abstract_cn: 尽管近来进展显著，深度伪造检测器在多样真实场景中仍易受对抗样本攻击。我们提出 MIG-COW——一个生成高泛化、视觉不可感知对抗样本的新型对抗攻击框架。通过把动量积分梯度与共识正交分解结合，MIG-COW 同时捕获异构 CNN 与 ViT 检测器之间共享的与模型特定的脆弱性。在 AADD-2025 Challenge 基准上，MIG-COW 取得 99.96% 的白盒攻击成功率（ASR）与高感知相似度（SSIM），显著超越既有基线。然而其对官方黑盒目标仅 7.16% 的 ASR——尽管拿下最佳总评分——凸显了可迁移性仍是持续挑战。我们还证明在集成中加入低分但多样的模型会降低攻击效力，说明真实对抗设定中需要谨慎选择代理模型。
summary_cn: 动量积分梯度加共识正交分解攻击深度伪造检测器：AADD-2025 白盒 ASR 99.96% 且 SSIM 高，但黑盒仅 7.16%；集成混入低分多样模型反而降低攻击效力（ACM MM '25）。
objective_summary: 提出融合共享与模型特定脆弱性的可迁移对抗攻击框架 MIG-COW，在 AADD-2025 基准上量化白盒与黑盒成功率及代理模型选择的影响。
evidence_note: 公开挑战赛基准（AADD-2025）实测并获最佳总评分，含白盒/黑盒与集成消融；黑盒迁移性弱的结果如实报告；ACM MM '25 已发表。
novelty_note: 动量、积分梯度与分解均为既有组件，组合用于跨架构检测器攻击属增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于 CNN/ViT 深度伪造检测器的对抗鲁棒性评估；黑盒迁移率 7.16% 说明对未知检测器威胁有限。
limitations: 黑盒 ASR 仅 7.16%
仅在 AADD-2025 基准验证
对抗训练后的防御视角未报告

title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high inference efficiency using optimized GPU kernels generated by just-in-time (JIT) compilation frameworks such as Triton. Triton compiles GPU kernels through an MLIR/LLVM-based pipeline. We investigate whether a Rowhammer-induced bit-flip in the CPU's DRAM can degrade GPU-based LLM inference performance while preserving output correctness. We present LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack that causes LLM inference slowdown by inducing a bit-flip in Triton's compilation pipeline. A bit-flip in a performance-critical optimization pass causes Triton to generate a functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernel. Since Triton caches the generated kernel on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent slowdown across subsequent inference executions. Triton's target-independent stages are shared across GPU vendors, which makes our attack GPU vendor-agnostic. To identify exploitable bit-flip locations without manual inspection, we build Karnage, a tool that isolates useful bit-flip locations in Triton's target-independent compilation pipeline. We evaluate LLVMHammer across a diverse set of LLMs, including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Deepseek-llm-7B-chat, across NVIDIA RTX 4090 and AMD RX 7900 XTX GPUs. LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16\%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments. We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25\%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.
title_cn: 经 Rowhammer 放大 LLM 推理的时延与成本
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）借助 Triton 等 JIT 编译框架生成的优化 GPU 内核实现高推理效率。Triton 经由基于 MLIR/LLVM 的流水线编译 GPU 内核。我们研究 CPU DRAM 中 Rowhammer 诱导的比特翻转能否在保持输出正确性的同时降低 GPU 上的 LLM 推理性能。我们提出 LLVMhammer——首个通过在 Triton 编译流水线中诱导比特翻转造成 LLM 推理变慢的 Rowhammer 攻击。性能关键优化 pass 中的一个比特翻转使 Triton 生成功能等价但次优的 GPU 内核。由于 Triton 把生成的内核缓存到磁盘，一次成功的比特翻转就造成后续推理执行的持续变慢。Triton 的目标无关编译阶段被各 GPU 厂商共享，这使我们的攻击与 GPU 厂商无关。为在不做人工检查的情况下找到可利用的比特翻转位置，我们构建 Karnage 工具，隔离 Triton 目标无关编译流水线中有用的比特翻转位置。我们在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 与 Deepseek-llm-7B-chat 等多个 LLM、NVIDIA RTX 4090 与 AMD RX 7900 XTX 两种 GPU 上评估 LLVMhammer。LLVMhammer 使单 GPU 上运行的 LLM 推理服务器时延增加 4–16%，进而可在多 GPU 部署规模上折算为额外的年度运营成本。我们进一步表明 LLVMhammer 也能跨 GPU 厂商破坏 LLM 输出，把 BERTScore 最低降到 25%，说明 Triton 编译流水线中比特翻转的更广泛安全影响。
summary_cn: 首个针对 Triton JIT 编译流水线的 Rowhammer 攻击 LLVMhammer：一次比特翻转持久放慢 LLM 推理 4–16%（跨 NVIDIA/AMD），还可把输出 BERTScore 破坏到 25%。
objective_summary: 提出经 CPU DRAM 比特翻转污染 Triton 编译缓存的持续性降速攻击 LLVMhammer，并系统评估其在多模型、双 GPU 厂商上的时延影响与输出破坏能力。
evidence_note: 4 个 LLM 与 2 种 GPU 的实测，量化时延与输出质量；实验室受控设定，无统计检验，攻击前提依赖目标 DRAM 可被 Rowhammer 利用。
novelty_note: 把 Rowhammer 从数据破坏转向「编译器缓存投毒致性能退化」是新攻击面，持久性与厂商无关性放大其现实影响。
scope: 结论适用于使用 Triton（或共享 MLIR/LLVM 目标无关阶段）的 GPU 推理服务；对非 JIT 或预编译内核部署不适用。
limitations: 依赖目标机器 DRAM 可被 Rowhammer 利用
4–16% 的降速幅度有限，经济影响为外推估算
对内核缓存完整性校验等防御未评估

title: Can Loan Processors and Underwriters Spot AI-Edited Statements? An Empirical Study
abstract: AI-assisted editing can produce loan documents that preserve familiar issuer layouts while changing the applicant's identity. We investigated whether experienced underwriters and loan processors identify such forgeries in first-pass, document-only review. Three practitioners recruited through Upwork each received one applicant package drawn from 134 forged PDFs derived from 47 genuine financial documents supplied with full consent. The edits preserved amounts, dates and balances; identifier inconsistencies introduced by the pipeline were knowingly retained before distribution. Reviewers were not told that files had been altered and returned 132 file-level judgements. Checking their explanations against the originals yielded 14 edit-supported concerns (10.6%): 12 Suspicious judgements and two Insufficient information judgements. All supported concerns involved identifier disagreements within or across documents, and no reported visual cue identified an actual edit. Thus, approximately one in ten judgements contained evidence of the forgery, despite known inconsistencies remaining in the files. These observations motivate evaluating consistency checks and independent source verification alongside human review. With three reviewer-package pairs and no genuine-file controls, the findings describe this exploratory setting rather than population-wide detection accuracy.
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures
title_cn: 信贷审核员与核贷员能识别 AI 编辑的报表吗？一项实证研究
abstract_cn: AI 辅助编辑可以在保留发行方熟悉版式的同时更改申请人的身份，产出贷款文件。我们研究有经验的核贷员与信贷审核员在仅审文件的首轮审查中能否识别此类伪造。三名通过 Upwork 招募的从业者各自收到一份申请人材料，来自 47 份经完全同意提供的真实财务文件衍生的 134 份伪造 PDF。编辑保留了金额、日期与余额；分发前刻意保留了流水线引入的标识符不一致。审核者未被告知文件已被改动，共返回 132 个文件级判断。把他们的解释与原件核对得到 14 个有编辑依据的疑虑（10.6%）：12 个「可疑」判断与 2 个「信息不足」判断。所有有依据的疑虑都涉及文件内或跨文件的标识符不一致，没有任何报告的视觉线索识别出真实编辑。因此约十分之一的判断包含伪造证据，尽管文件中留有已知不一致。这些观察促使在人工审查之外评估一致性检查与独立来源核验。由于只有三个审核者—材料对且无真实文件对照，这些发现描述的是这一探索性设定，而非总体检出准确率。
summary_cn: 探索性人因研究：3 名从业者首轮审查 134 份 AI 编辑伪造贷款文件（132 次判断），仅 10.6% 判断含伪造证据且全部源于标识符不一致，无人凭视觉线索识破。
objective_summary: 测量信贷从业者对保留版式、保留金额并留有标识符不一致的 AI 编辑伪造文件的首轮识别能力，并分析其所依据的线索类型。
evidence_note: 样本极小（3 名审核者、132 个判断）、无真实文件对照、作者自陈仅为探索性设定；但过程透明（同意、盲测、解释核对）。
novelty_note: 针对信贷场景 AI 编辑伪造的人类检测评估较为少见，但结论受限于探索性设计。
scope: 结论仅适用于本研究的伪造流水线与 3 名从业者样本；不能外推为从业者总体检出率。
limitations: 3 名审核者、无对照组
伪造流水线单一
标识符不一致的保留方式可能影响检出率

title: AgentTriage: Replayable Security Diagnosis Across Heterogeneous Agent Runtimes
abstract: When tool-use agents write files, execute code, or send data, their final responses do not explain the resulting security events, and heterogeneous runtimes expose the relevant evidence through incompatible interfaces. We present AgentTriage, an executable contract for replayable security diagnosis across heterogeneous runtimes. The contract admits conclusions whose claims cite canonical runtime events and requires abstention when mandatory evidence is missing. Runtime overlays normalize native observations, while a deterministic pipeline joins invocation and result lifecycles, constructs a typed provenance graph, selects a policy-decisive slice, and binds claims to recorded evidence. Given the same normalized trace, overlay version, and pre-run policy oracle, the diagnosis can be recomputed and its claims re-checked without language-model judgment. Across five runtimes, one contract captures all 159 applicable executions, with an audit of native and synthesized identifiers. On 120 adjudicated cases, AgentTriage achieves 0.858 grounded joint diagnosis, 0.966 required-evidence coverage, and a 0.036 unsupported-claim rate, improving joint diagnosis by 0.175 (95% CI [0.092, 0.258]) over the strongest same-schema baseline. These results quantify the precision of replayable diagnosis and the observation boundaries that require abstention. We release an open-source implementation and selected sanitized evidence at https://github.com/AsnGs/agenttriage-open-source.
title_cn: AgentTriage：跨异构智能体运行时的可重放安全诊断
abstract_cn: 当工具使用型智能体写文件、执行代码或发送数据时，其最终回复并不能解释所产生的安全事件，而异构运行时又通过互不兼容的接口暴露相关证据。我们提出 AgentTriage——一个跨异构运行时、支持可重放安全诊断的可执行契约。该契约只接受其断言引用规范运行时事件的结论，并在关键证据缺失时要求弃权。运行时覆盖层把原生观测规范化，确定性流水线连接调用与结果生命周期、构造类型化溯源图、选出策略决定性切片并把断言绑定到记录的证据。给定同一规范化轨迹、覆盖层版本与预运行策略预言机，诊断可以复算，其断言可在无需语言模型判断的情况下复核。跨五个运行时，一个契约覆盖全部 159 个适用执行，并经原生与合成标识符审计。在 120 个经裁决的案例上，AgentTriage 取得 0.858 的接地联合诊断、0.966 的必备证据覆盖与 0.036 的无支撑断言率，联合诊断比最强同模式基线提升 0.175（95% CI [0.092, 0.258]）。这些结果量化了可重放诊断的精度与必须弃权的观测边界。我们发布开源实现与精选的脱敏证据。
summary_cn: 可执行契约加类型化溯源图实现跨五个智能体运行时的可重放安全诊断：159 个执行全覆盖，120 裁决案例联合诊断 0.858、证据覆盖 0.966、无支撑断言率 0.036，开源。
objective_summary: 设计引用规范事件、证据缺失即弃权的可重放诊断契约 AgentTriage，以确定性流水线替代模型判断，并在五个运行时与裁决案例集上量化诊断精度。
evidence_note: 五运行时 159 执行、120 裁决案例、95% CI 与基线对比、标识符审计、开源工件，评估链完整。
novelty_note: 首个把「可重放、可复算」确立为智能体安全诊断硬约束并给出跨运行时契约的系统，方向上属开拓性系统化。
scope: 结论适用于被契约覆盖的文件/代码/数据外发类事件与五个受测运行时；对未知运行时与需要模型判断的语义事件需扩展覆盖层。
limitations: 契约外事件无法诊断（按设计弃权）
覆盖层需为每个新运行时开发
脱敏公开证据与真实生产轨迹的差距未量化

title: AIRO: A Streaming-Based Machine Learning Framework for Threat Detection and Security in Industrial Internet of Things
abstract: Modern Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) im- plementations now connect edge gateways, cloud dashboards and business applications. This improves visibility and remote monitoring. However it simultaneously exposes industrial traffic to various cyber threats including scanning, web attacks and Structured Query Language (SQL) injection (SQLi), phishing- driven credential theft, and command-and-control (C2) activity. Although rule-based tools remain useful for detecting known signatures, their efficacy decreases with minimally altered attacks or when alerts require manual investigation. This paper presents AIRO (Autonomous Intelligence-Driven Cybersecurity Risk Re- duction System), an efficient framework for IIoT monitoring and response. AIRO combines Apache Kafka streaming, attack- specific feature extraction, machine learning (ML) inference, confidence-based decision logic and risk reduction measures such as Internet Protocol (IP) blocking, account suspension and traffic limiting. We developed four specialized datasets for C2 beaconing, reconnaissance, SQLi, and phishing to evaluate AIRO. These datasets include noisy and overlapping characteristic distribu- tions to minimize label leakage. The best-performing models, primarily Gradient Boosting and LightGBM, achieve F1-scores up to 0.9229 while ensuring low-latency from event input to mitigation
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: AIRO：面向工业物联网威胁检测与安全的流式机器学习框架
abstract_cn: 现代工业物联网（IIoT）实现连接边缘网关、云仪表盘与业务应用，提升了可见性与远程监控能力，但同时也把工业流量暴露给扫描、Web 攻击、SQL 注入（SQLi）、钓鱼驱动的凭证窃取以及命令与控制（C2）活动等多种网络威胁。尽管基于规则的工具对已知签名仍有用，但其效力在攻击轻微变形或告警需要人工调查时会下降。本文提出 AIRO（自主智能驱动的网络安全风险削减系统），一个高效的 IIoT 监控与响应框架。AIRO 组合 Apache Kafka 流式处理、攻击特定特征提取、机器学习推理、基于置信度的决策逻辑以及 IP 封禁、账号停用与流量限制等风险削减措施。我们为 C2 信标、侦察、SQLi 与钓鱼构建了四个专用数据集评估 AIRO；这些数据集包含噪声与重叠特征分布以减少标签泄露。表现最好的模型（主要是 Gradient Boosting 与 LightGBM）取得最高 0.9229 的 F1 分数，同时保证从事件输入到缓解的低时延。
summary_cn: Kafka 流式加 ML 推理加自动缓解（封禁/停用/限流）的 IIoT 框架 AIRO：自建 C2/侦察/SQLi/钓鱼四数据集，LightGBM 类模型 F1 最高 0.9229 且低时延。
objective_summary: 构建从流式采集到自动缓解的 IIoT 威胁检测响应系统 AIRO，配套四个含噪声的专用数据集评估检测性能与时延。
evidence_note: 有端到端系统与四数据集评估，但数据自建、摘要未报告基线对比与消融，篇幅 7 页，属原型系统验证。
novelty_note: 流式 ML 检测加自动阻断是成熟组件的系统集成，创新有限。
scope: 结论适用于四类 IIoT 攻击场景与自建数据分布；真实产线部署与对抗性逃逸未验证。
limitations: 数据集自建且未公开基线对比
误报对工业可用性的影响未量化
对变形攻击与概念漂移的鲁棒性未评估

title: Scaling Laws for Safety Probes
abstract: Safety probes trained on a model's activations are a standard tool for monitoring language models in real time. Each time a new model is released or a new harm area needs to be monitored, the probe must be retrained, which requires new labels and a choice of probe architecture. Yet neither the model nor the labels tell us in advance how well the resulting probe will perform. Finding out requires training and comparing many probe configurations. In this paper, we ask whether probe performance can instead be predicted in advance from model size and the number of labels. Existing safety datasets are insufficient for this, as they are either limited in scale or already saturated. We therefore construct six new safety datasets of sufficient size and difficulty. On these datasets, we train two probe architectures on 20 base models from five model families, with 32 to $10^{6}$ labels for each model. We measure performance using probe error, defined as 1 - AUROC, where lower values are better. We find that probe error follows two simple scaling laws. First, the lowest probe error a model can reach falls as a power law in its size. Second, probe error decreases towards its floor as the number of examples increases; the slope increases as the target model size increases. Both laws hold across tasks, model families and probe architectures, and only their fitted constants differ. When fitted on the smallest models of a family, the laws predict the error of the next larger model to within 0.02 in 72% of cases. They also identify whether more labels or a larger model is the cheaper way to reach a target error in 73% of cases. Finally, they choose the probe architecture with an extra error of only 0.006 on average when they pick the worse one. These laws allow safety researchers to determine how to create the best probe for any given model and label budget.
comment: 62 pages, 23 figures, 33 tables
title_cn: 安全探针的缩放律
abstract_cn: 训练在模型激活上的安全探针是实时监控语言模型的标准工具。每当发布新模型或需要监控新的危害领域，探针必须重训，这需要新标签和探针架构的选择。然而模型与标签都不能预先告诉我们探针的表现会如何。查明这一点需要训练并比较许多探针配置。本文追问：探针性能能否改为从模型规模与标签数量提前预测？既有安全数据集不足以回答，要么规模有限要么已饱和。我们因此构建六个足够大且足够难的新安全数据集。在这些数据集上，我们在五个模型家族的 20 个基础模型上训练两种探针架构，每个模型的标签数从 32 到 10 的 6 次方。我们用探针误差（1 − AUROC，越低越好）度量性能。我们发现探针误差服从两条简单缩放律：第一，模型能达到的最低探针误差随其规模呈幂律下降；第二，探针误差随样本数增加趋向其下限，且斜率随目标模型规模增大而增大。两条律跨任务、模型家族与探针架构成立，只有拟合常数不同。用家族中最小模型拟合时，缩放律在 72% 的情况下把下一个更大模型的误差预测到 0.02 以内；在 73% 的情况下正确识别「更多标签还是更大模型」是达到目标误差的更便宜途径；在选出较差探针架构时平均仅多 0.006 的额外误差。这些缩放律让安全研究者能为任何给定模型与标签预算决定如何打造最佳探针。
summary_cn: 5 家族 20 个基础模型、32 到百万级标签上确立安全探针误差的两条缩放律（随模型规模幂律下降、随样本数趋向下限），可预测下一档模型误差（72% 情形 ±0.02 内）并指导预算分配。
objective_summary: 系统实验确立安全探针误差关于模型规模与标签数的缩放律，并验证其在误差预测、预算决策与架构选择上的实用价值。
evidence_note: 6 个新数据集、5 家族 20 模型、两种架构、32 到百万级标签的大规模受控实验，跨任务/家族/架构验证并给出预测精度量化。
novelty_note: 首个针对安全探针的缩放律刻画，把「探针要训了才知道」变成可提前预算的规律，方向上属开创性系统化。
scope: 结论覆盖所测五个开源家族与两类探针架构；闭源模型、非线性探针与分布漂移下的监控未覆盖。
limitations: 六数据集均为安全任务，跨语言与跨模态未验证
缩放律常数依赖家族，需小模型拟合
探针误差下限受数据集饱和度影响

title: Your Token Is Gone: A Token-Consumption Countermeasure for Disrupting LLM-Based Scam Systems
abstract: LLM-based scam systems increasingly combine adaptive dialogue, persistent context, external tools, and multi-agent coordination to automate personalized fraud. These capabilities also create a resource dependency: every reasoning step, model call, and coordination round incurs inference cost. We present TokenTrap, a resource-oriented defense that redirects suspected scam systems toward benign, low-value computation while withholding credentials, payments, and other exploitable information. TokenTrap combines three components: an architecture-specific token-task library, a router that selects among single-agent, hierarchical, and flat multi-agent workflows, and a bounded anti-guardrail strategy that varies task presentation while enforcing token, round, time, and safety limits. Across 50-round traces, TokenTrap amplifies token consumption by $2{,}487.0\times$, $1{,}616.0\times$, and $567.8\times$ relative to a no-token-task baseline for the three workflows. Its router achieves 85.67% accuracy on 300 architecture-labeled prompts. These results demonstrate that short, non-sensitive requests can impose substantial context-processing and coordination costs, motivating resource-aware defense as a complement to scam detection.
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
title_cn: 你的 Token 用完了：扰乱 LLM 诈骗系统的 Token 消耗对抗措施
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的诈骗系统正组合自适应对话、持久上下文、外部工具与多智能体协调来自动化个性化欺诈。这些能力也制造了资源依赖：每个推理步骤、模型调用与协调轮次都产生推理成本。我们提出 TokenTrap——一种资源导向防御，把可疑诈骗系统引向良性、低价值的计算，同时扣住凭证、支付等可利用信息。TokenTrap 结合三个组件：架构特定的 token 任务库、在单智能体/层级/扁平多智能体工作流间选择的路由器，以及一个有界的反护栏策略（变化任务呈现同时执行 token、轮次、时间与安全限制）。在 50 轮轨迹中，TokenTrap 相对无 token 任务基线把三种工作流的 token 消耗分别放大 2,487.0 倍、1,616.0 倍与 567.8 倍。其路由器在 300 个架构标注提示上达到 85.67% 准确率。这些结果表明，简短的非敏感请求即可施加可观的上下文处理与协调成本，使资源感知防御成为诈骗检测的补充。
summary_cn: TokenTrap 用 token 任务库加工作流路由器「烧钱」扰乱 LLM 诈骗自动化：三种工作流 token 消耗放大 567.8–2,487.0 倍，路由器准确率 85.67%，同时扣住敏感信息。
objective_summary: 设计针对 LLM 诈骗系统的资源消耗型防御 TokenTrap，量化其对单智能体与多智能体工作流的 token 放大效应及路由器选型精度。
evidence_note: 三种工作流 50 轮轨迹的量化对比与 300 提示的路由器评估；无统计检验，诈骗系统为作者搭建的受控设定。
novelty_note: 把 tarpit 式「成本强加」思想移植到 LLM 诈骗自动化并配套工作流路由，是资源感知防御路线的新应用。
scope: 结论适用于依赖 LLM 推理预算的自动化诈骗系统；对人工驱动或混合人机诈骗的成本强加效果未评估。

title: FVQKD: A Formal Verification of Quantum Key Distribution Security in Rocq
abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD), whose security is derived from quantum mechanics rather than computational assumptions, is moving into standardization and commercial deployment. Yet its security guarantees rest on technically delicate proofs checked by hand. Formal verification closes this gap, establishing a two-factor assurance: unconditional security from physical principles, and machine-checked proofs against reasoning errors. We present FVQKD, a Rocq library for machine-checking QKD security proofs. Its first result is a complete, end-to-end machine-checked proof of composable, finite-key security for BB84. The mechanization reconstructs the complete proof infrastructure from first principles, including the smooth entropy framework, the entropic uncertainty relation, and the Quantum Leftover Hash Lemma. It uncovers necessary side conditions that the published argument leaves unstated, one of which reveals a missing proof branch, and it grounds the information-theoretic bound in a formal semantics of protocol execution, which the pen-and-paper analysis lacks. The proof is entirely admit-free, relying only on the Rocq kernel and standard foundational axioms. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end formal verification of a QKD security proof. Built on MathComp, MathComp-Analysis, and CoqQ, the development provides quantum-information infrastructure designed for reuse across broader QKD variants and quantum cryptography applications.

title_cn: FVQKD：量子密钥分发安全性的 Rocq 形式验证
abstract_cn: 量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全性源于量子力学而非计算假设，正在进入标准化与商业部署。但其安全保证建立在经人工核对、技术上精微的证明之上。形式验证弥补了这一缺口，确立双重保证：来自物理原理的无条件安全，以及经机器检验、免于推理错误的证明。我们提出 FVQKD——一个用于机器检验 QKD 安全证明的 Rocq 库。其首个成果是 BB84 可组合有限密钥安全的完整、端到端机器检验证明。该机械化从第一性原理重构完整证明基础设施，包括平滑熵框架、熵不确定性关系与量子剩余哈希引理。它发现了已发表论证未陈述的必要附带条件，其中一个暴露了缺失的证明分支；它把信息论界锚定在协议执行的形式语义上，而这正是纸笔分析所缺的。证明完全不含 admit，仅依赖 Rocq 内核与标准基础公理。据我们所知，这是 QKD 安全证明的首个端到端形式验证。该开发基于 MathComp、MathComp-Analysis 与 CoqQ 构建，提供可跨更广 QKD 变体与量子密码应用复用的量子信息基础设施。
summary_cn: 在 Rocq 中完成 BB84 可组合有限密钥安全的端到端机器检验证明（无 admit），发现原证明缺失分支与未陈述附带条件，为首个 QKD 安全证明完整形式验证，工件公开。
objective_summary: 构建 QKD 安全证明的 Rocq 机械化库 FVQKD，从第一性原理重建证明基础设施并完成 BB84 有限密钥安全的完整机器检验，披露原论证的缺口。

title: Model-intrinsic, Weight-level, and Training-free Spectral Fingerprinting for Large Language Models
abstract: The increasing release and reuse of Large Language Models (LLMs) as open-weight checkpoints make model fingerprinting important for ownership protection and offline auditing. Existing fingerprinting methods typically construct evidence from query responses, generated outputs, or input-induced activations. Although effective in representation-based settings, they can be affected by prompt selection, decoding configuration, inference environment, and forward-pass implementation, which may limit their applicability. Here we introduce a model-intrinsic weight-level framework that derives compact fingerprints from spectral structures encoded in LLM parameters. Specifically, the framework constructs GATE spectral scalar features from the singular-value distributions of GATE projection weights in gated feed-forward networks (FFNs), and aggregates the resulting layer-wise features through depth-wise segmented pooling to form a model-level fingerprint. Such representation preserves coarse layer-depth organization while reducing dependence on strict layer-to-layer alignment, enabling comparison across LLMs with different depths. The similarity between fingerprints is computed by linear centered kernel alignment. The entire pipeline is training-free and does not require input samples, generated outputs, forward activations, or an auxiliary verifier. Experiments on representative LLM families and post-training variants have demonstrated a clear separation between source-related models and unrelated ones, and stable similarity under instruction tuning, quantization, pruning, and distillation-related modifications, which verify that spectral features are robust evidence for LLM fingerprinting.

title_cn: 面向大语言模型的模型内在、权重级、免训练谱指纹
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）作为开放权重检查点的发布与复用增多，模型指纹识别对所有权保护与离线审计变得重要。既有指纹方法通常从问答、生成输出或输入诱发的激活中构造证据；尽管在表征类场景中有效，它们可能受提示选择、解码配置、推理环境与前向实现的影响，从而限制适用性。我们引入一个模型内在的权重级框架，从 LLM 参数编码的谱结构中提取紧凑指纹。具体地，该框架从门控前馈网络（FFN）中 GATE 投影权重的奇异值分布构造 GATE 谱标量特征，并通过深度分段池化聚合逐层特征形成模型级指纹。这种表示保留粗粒度层深组织，同时降低对严格逐层对齐的依赖，可比较不同深度的 LLM。指纹相似度用线性中心核对齐计算。整个流水线免训练，不需要输入样本、生成输出、前向激活或辅助验证器。在代表性 LLM 家族与后训练变体上的实验表明，同源模型与无关模型之间有清晰分离，且在指令微调、量化、剪枝与蒸馏相关修改下相似度稳定，验证谱特征是 LLM 指纹识别的鲁棒证据。
summary_cn: 免训练权重级 LLM 指纹：从 FFN GATE 投影权重奇异值分布提谱特征并深度分段池化，线性 CKA 度相似度，对微调/量化/剪枝/蒸馏稳定，同源与无关模型分离清晰。
objective_summary: 提出仅用权重的谱结构构造 LLM 指纹的免训练框架，评估其对后训练变换的鲁棒性与同源区分能力。
evidence_note: 代表性 LLM 家族与多种后训练变体的系统评估，报告分离性与稳定性；IEEE WIFS 2026 工作坊录用，无主动混淆权重的对抗者设定。
novelty_note: 从行为/激活类指纹转向纯权重内在谱特征并支持不同深度模型比较，是指纹获取途径上的实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于开放权重检查点的离线审计；不覆盖仅 API 访问的闭源模型与主动混淆权重的对抗者。
limitations: 权重被大幅改写时指纹稳定性未知
跨深度模型对齐依赖分段池化假设
摘要未报告跨家族误报率的量化阈值

title: HiMark: Hierarchical and Controllable Multi-bit Watermarking for Large Language Models
abstract: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) in text generation applications, it has become increasingly difficult to trace generated content and assign responsibility for its use, raising concerns about provenance, copyright protection, and accountability. Multi-bit watermarking addresses these issues by embedding multi-bit provenance information into generated text, but reliable extraction remains difficult due to sparse per-bit evidence and the trade-off between watermark-extraction accuracy and text quality. To deal with these challenges, we propose HiMark, a hierarchical and controllable multi-bit watermarking framework for LLM-generated text. During watermark embedding, HiMark uses a hierarchical candidate-control mechanism, including initial candidate sampling, layer-wise tournament elimination, support-based refinement, and support-threshold filtering. During watermark detection, a model-agnostic evidence aggregation mechanism computes multi-layer support evidence for each observed token, and then accumulates these token-level votes into the corresponding information for robust watermark extraction. Experiments show that HiMark improves watermark extraction accuracy while maintaining text quality, e.g., the watermark extraction accuracy is 90.01% under the paraphrasing attack when 32 bits were embedded within a text containing 300 tokens, demonstrating its effectiveness for provenance tracking.

title_cn: HiMark：面向大语言模型的层级化可控多比特水印
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在文本生成应用中的快速采用，追溯生成内容并为其使用分配责任日益困难，引发对来源、版权保护与问责的担忧。多比特水印通过把多比特来源信息嵌入生成文本来回应这些问题，但由于每比特证据稀疏以及水印提取精度与文本质量的权衡，可靠提取仍然困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HiMark——面向 LLM 生成文本的层级化可控多比特水印框架。在嵌入侧，HiMark 使用层级候选控制机制，包括初始候选采样、逐层锦标赛淘汰、基于支持的细化和支持阈值过滤。在检测侧，一个模型无关的证据聚合机制为每个观测 token 计算多层支持证据，再把 token 级投票累积为对应信息以实现鲁棒水印提取。实验表明 HiMark 在保持文本质量的同时提升水印提取精度，例如在 300 token 文本嵌入 32 bit 时，释义攻击下提取精度达 90.01%，证明了其在来源追踪上的有效性。
summary_cn: 层级候选控制加模型无关证据聚合的多比特 LLM 水印：300 token 嵌 32 bit 时释义攻击下提取精度 90.01%，同时保持文本质量（WIFS 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出嵌入侧层级候选控制与检测侧多层证据聚合的多比特 LLM 水印框架 HiMark，并以释义攻击下的提取精度与文本质量评估其效果。
evidence_note: 报告释义攻击下的提取精度与文本质量保持，机制消融具体；IEEE WIFS 2026 工作坊录用，摘要未列基线对比数值。
novelty_note: 多比特 LLM 水印已有多个方案，HiMark 在嵌入控制与证据聚合上的改进属既有范式的增量优化。

limitations: 90.01% 意味着该设定下仍有约 10% 提取失败
对自适应去水印攻击未评估

title: DLT Terms 100: a learner's glossary based on ISO 22739:2024
abstract: We propose ``DLT Terms 100'' aimed at improving literacy regarding blockchain (distributed ledger technology: DLT). The pace of DLT's social implementation has been slower than initially expected, partly due to a shortage of engineers and literate individuals. In particular, the discrepancy between business and technical terminology, and the confusion caused by the repurposing of existing financial terms, are barriers to understanding the concepts and technologies. Our proposed glossary is based on ISO 22739:2024, and categorizes and labels terms based on their frequency of appearance in representative domestic and international literature and their difficulty level.
title_cn: DLT Terms 100：基于 ISO 22739:2024 的学习者术语表
abstract_cn: 我们提出「DLT Terms 100」，旨在提升关于区块链（分布式账本技术：DLT）的素养。DLT 的社会落地速度慢于最初预期，部分原因是工程师与有素养者的短缺。特别是，业务与技术术语之间的错位，以及既有金融术语被挪用造成的混淆，是理解概念与技术的障碍。我们提出的术语表基于 ISO 22739:2024，并依据术语在代表性国内外文献中的出现频率与难度级别进行分类和标注。
summary_cn: 基于 ISO 22739:2024 构建 DLT 学习者术语表，按文献出现频率与难度分级标注，缓解业务/技术术语错位与金融术语挪用造成的理解障碍。
objective_summary: 依据 ISO 标准整理并分级标注 100 个 DLT 术语，形成面向学习者的教育性术语资源。
evidence_note: 教育资源整理，依据文献频率与难度分级，无经验验证或评估数据。
novelty_note: 以 ISO 标准为骨架、按频率与难度分级的教育资源整理，属对既有标准内容的再组织而非新知识。

title: Temporal Liquidity Crossing for Blockchains: An EIP-1559 Extension for Admission Below the Base Fee
abstract: Transactions differ in how their value changes with execution time and relative position. Ethereum's EIP-1559 lets them compete through fee fields, but a fee bid gives no enforceable claim to an earlier position in the block, and no way to express willingness to accept a later one. Its base fee is a hard admission floor. We introduce temporal liquidity markets (TLM), a framework for crossing complementary temporal requirements: transactions seeking early-region execution (consumers) can fund transactions that opt into exclusion from that region (providers). Selected consumers complete within the early region and are ordered among themselves by authorization density, both validator-checked. In our block-local EIP-1559 extension, providers may be admitted below the base-fee floor. Under TLM regulation, funding-conditioned and capacity-capped provider gas is excluded from the ordinary EIP-1559 controller input. Counting it there instead raises the base fee and displaces ordinary demand at a positive base-fee fixed point. Exclusion lets the controller regulate ordinary demand at its original target and preserves the no-TLM ordinary allocation by construction; in synthetic experiments it raises total utilization with funded gas. Selected consumers pay their signed authorizations, which fund provider shortfalls; the surplus is burned. We state an adversary model with strategic senders and builders and prove eight properties under it, among them validator-checked rule validity, full burn of the base fee, and no subsidy. An inserted consumer bid cannot raise any other consumer's charge. With a provider fee-cap floor, a small, capped inclusion fee and a consumer allowance tied to funded provider gas by a large enough link ratio, no finite set of consumer bids or providers that the builder inserts raises its direct fee payoff.
