title_cn: 区块链时间性流动性撮合：允许低于基础费准入的 EIP-1559 扩展
abstract_cn: 交易的价值随执行时间与相对位置而变化。以太坊的 EIP-1559 让它们通过费用字段竞争，但费用出价既不能换来对区块更早位置的强制主张，也无法表达接受靠后位置的意愿；其基础费是一道硬性准入下限。我们提出时间性流动性市场（TLM）：一个撮合互补时间需求的框架——寻求早期区域执行的交易（消费者）可以资助自愿退出该区域的交易（提供者）。被选中的消费者在早期区域内完成，并按经验证者检查的授权密度排序。在我们的区块局部 EIP-1559 扩展中，提供者可以被允许以低于基础费下限的价格准入。在 TLM 监管下，带资助条件且有容量上限的提供者 gas 被排除在普通 EIP-1559 控制器输入之外；若把它计入则会抬高基础费并在正的基础费不动点处挤出普通需求。排除使控制器能在原目标上调节普通需求，并按构造保留无 TLM 时的普通分配；合成实验显示它在有资助 gas 时提高总利用率。被选中的消费者支付其签名的授权，用于弥补提供者缺口；盈余被销毁。我们陈述了含策略性发送者与构建者的对手模型，并证明其下的八条性质，其中包括经验证者检查的规则有效性、基础费全额销毁与无补贴：被插入的消费者出价不能抬高任何其他消费者的费用。在提供者费用上限下限、小额封顶纳入费以及通过足够大连接比与资助提供者 gas 挂钩的消费者配额下，任何有限的消费者出价集合或构建者插入的提供者都不能提高其直接费用收益。
summary_cn: 时间性流动性市场（TLM）：消费者资助退出早期区域的提供者、允许低于基础费准入的 EIP-1559 扩展，在策略性对手模型下证明八条性质并以合成实验验证利用率提升。
objective_summary: 设计撮合交易时间性需求的 TLM 费用市场机制，扩展 EIP-1559 准入规则，形式化证明激励性质并用合成实验评估区块利用率。
evidence_note: 对手模型下八条性质的数学证明加合成实验；非机器认证，实验为合成环境。
novelty_note: 把「时间性需求撮合」引入区块费用市场并给出低于基础费准入的受控机制，是费用机制设计的新路线。
scope: 结论适用于区块局部、EIP-1559 型基础费机制的链；跨区块时间性需求与真实主网博弈未评估。
limitations: 实验为合成数据，真实交易分布与策略行为未测
机制参数（连接比、费用上限）的敏感性分析有限
落地需协议层改动，兼容性成本高

title: Bridging the Closed-World Gap: Interpretable Anomaly Detection via a Hybrid TSK-FCM Ensemble on the BETH Dataset
abstract: A fundamental paradox plagues the deployment of Machine Learning in cybersecurity: supervised models generalize poorly to novel, Out-of-Distribution (OoD) attacks, whereas unsupervised models often suffer from poor separability, leading to unmanageable false-alarm rates. This challenge is exemplified by the BETH dataset, a kernel-level benchmark in which the training data consists solely of benign and suspicious insider behaviors, whereas the test set consists almost entirely of novel botnet activation attacks. To bridge this detection gap, we propose a Hybrid Fuzzy Ensemble that synergizes the precision of supervised learning with the adaptability of unsupervised clustering. Our architecture integrates a gradient-optimized Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy classifier to act as an expert on known insider threats, with a parallel Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) module to detect geometric anomalies. A critical finding of our research is that traditional fuzzy membership scores degrade in high-dimensional feature spaces due to the curse of dimensionality. We overcome this by introducing a robust Min Distance metric that exploits the raw geometric isolation of botnet activation attacks. This approach yields a state-of-the-art AUROC of 0.9951 on the BETH test set, outperforming the original Isolation Forest baseline by 17.1%. By combining near-perfect OoD detection with the intrinsic interpretability of fuzzy logic, our framework offers a viable path toward robust, transparent, and autonomous network defense.
comment: Presented at North American Fuzzy Information Processing Society (NAFIPS) 2026, El Paso, Texas, USA; accepted for publication in Springer proceedings
title_cn: 弥合闭世界鸿沟：BETH 数据集上 TSK-FCM 混合集成的可解释异常检测
abstract_cn: 机器学习在网络安全部署中面临一个根本悖论：有监督模型对新颖的分布外（OoD）攻击泛化差，而无监督模型往往可分性差、误报率难以接受。BETH 数据集集中体现了这一挑战：其训练数据仅含良性代码与可疑内部人行为，而测试集几乎全部是新颖的僵尸网络激活攻击。为弥合这一检测鸿沟，我们提出混合模糊集成：把梯度优化的 Takagi-Sugeno-Kang（TSK）模糊分类器（充当已知内部威胁的专家）与并行的模糊 C 均值（FCM）模块（检测几何异常）协同起来。一个关键研究发现是传统模糊隶属度在高维特征空间因维数灾难而退化。我们用利用僵尸网络激活攻击原始几何孤立性的鲁棒 Min Distance 度量克服它。该方法在 BETH 测试集取得 0.9951 的 SOTA AUROC，比原始 Isolation Forest 基线高 17.1%。通过将近乎完美的 OoD 检测与模糊逻辑的内在可解释性结合，我们的框架为稳健、透明、自主的网络防御提供了可行路径。
summary_cn: TSK 模糊分类器加 FCM 异常模块、Min Distance 度量对抗高维退化：在全是新僵尸网络攻击的 BETH 测试集上 AUROC 0.9951，超 Isolation Forest 基线 17.1%。
objective_summary: 针对训练与测试分布高度错位的 BETH 基准，提出有监督 TSK 与无监督 FCM 并联的混合模糊集成，并引入几何 Min Distance 度量改进 OoD 可分性。
evidence_note: 单一公开基准上的基线对比（Isolation Forest）与消融（Min Distance 的必要性）；无统计检验，仅一个数据集。
novelty_note: 模糊集成异常检测与 TSK/FCM 均为成熟组件，新意主要在 Min Distance 度量及其在 BETH 闭世界场景的组合应用。
scope: 结论基于 BETH 内核级数据集的特定训练/测试切分；向其他主机或网络数据集的迁移未验证。
limitations: 仅在 BETH 单一基准验证
0.9951 AUROC 对应该基准的较易分离攻击形态，泛化未知
实时性开销未报告

title: Beyond End-to-End Recovery: Towards a Better Understanding of LLM Steganography via Rolewise Decomposition
abstract: In large language model (LLM) steganography, an encoder hides a private message in an otherwise ordinary response, as text transmitted to a decoder, who attempts to recover it. The success of this private-message transmission is commonly measured through end-to-end (E2E) recovery, which checks whether the decoder correctly reconstructs the private message. However, E2E recovery cannot distinguish encoding failures from decoding failures or reveal how the private message is represented in the encoder's transmitted text. To address these limitations, we introduce a rolewise decomposition framework that separately examines how private messages are represented in encoder transmitted texts, what decoders recover, and what deterministic verification can establish. Across 7,200 encoder responses, we identify 168 verifiable encodings missed by decoders and 706 responses containing private messages reconstructed through word-length or token-initial patterns not explicitly specified in the encoder's instructions. These findings demonstrate that E2E recovery alone may obscure important distinctions between encoding and decoding, motivating their separate evaluation to better understand and mitigate the safety issues caused by LLM steganography.
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: 超越端到端恢复：按角色分解理解 LLM 隐写
abstract_cn: 在 LLM 隐写中，编码器把私密消息藏进一个看似普通的回复，文本传给解码器，解码器尝试恢复它。这种私密消息传输的成功通常用端到端（E2E）恢复来度量，即解码器是否正确重建私密消息。然而 E2E 恢复无法区分编码失败与解码失败，也无法揭示私密消息在编码器传输文本中如何被表示。为弥补这些局限，我们引入按角色分解框架，分别考察私密消息在编码器传输文本中的表示方式、解码器恢复出什么、以及确定性验证能确立什么。在 7,200 个编码器回复中，我们识别出 168 个被解码器漏掉的可验证编码，以及 706 个经由编码器指令中未明示的词长或词首模式重建出私密消息的回复。这些发现表明，仅看 E2E 恢复可能掩盖编码与解码的重要区别，促使对二者分别评估，以更好地理解与缓解 LLM 隐写引发的安全问题。
summary_cn: 按角色分解评估 LLM 隐写：7,200 个编码器回复中发现 168 个解码器漏掉的可验证编码与 706 个借未明示词长/词首模式传信的回复，E2E 恢复指标混淆编码与解码失败。
objective_summary: 提出把 LLM 隐写评估拆成编码表示、解码恢复与确定性验证三个角色的框架，并据此重新审视 E2E 恢复指标的盲区。
evidence_note: 7,200 个回复的大规模分析，给出可验证编码与模式外传信的量化计数；未报告统计检验与多模型系统性对比细节。
novelty_note: 指出 E2E 恢复这一社区常用指标的混淆结构并给出分解式评估框架，是对该方向评估方法学的实质修正。
scope: 结论适用于文本隐写 E2E 恢复类评估设定；对多模态隐写与主动规避检测的对抗性编码器覆盖有限。
limitations: 依赖确定性验证器，能验证的编码类型有限
模式外传信（词长/词首）的触发条件未完全刻画
对防御设计的影响停留在评估层面

title: Membership Inference Attack on Private Evolution
abstract: Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) is an actively studied way to enable safe sharing of private data more broadly. Inference-only SDG methods, such as Private Evolution (PE), are particularly appealing, as they can leverage black-box access to pre-trained foundation models to generate high quality data without the need for model fine-tuning on the private data. PE is explicitly designed to produce synthetic data under Differential Privacy (DP). Yet formal DP guarantees do not eliminate the need for empirical privacy auditing of the practical susceptibility of released synthetic data to adversarial attacks. In this work, we introduce the first white-box Membership Inference Attack (MIA) tailored to the voting-based algorithm underlying the PE framework. By exploiting how the iterative filtering process biases the survival and proximity of synthetic candidates toward private instances, our attack achieves empirical performance indicating private data leakage in the PE applications across image, text, and tabular modalities.
comment: Accepted at InfPriv Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 针对 Private Evolution 的成员推断攻击
abstract_cn: 合成数据生成（SDG）是让私有数据得以更安全共享的活跃研究方向。仅推理（inference-only）的 SDG 方法，如 Private Evolution（PE），尤其有吸引力：它们能利用对预训练基础模型的黑盒访问生成高质量数据，而无需在私有数据上微调模型。PE 明确设计为在差分隐私（DP）下生成合成数据。然而形式化的 DP 保证并不能免除对已发布合成数据实际易感性的经验隐私审计。我们提出首个针对 PE 框架底层投票式算法定制的白盒成员推断攻击（MIA）。通过利用迭代过滤过程使合成候选的存活与邻近性向私有实例偏置的方式，我们的攻击在图像、文本与表格三种模态的 PE 应用上取得表明私有数据泄露的经验性能。
summary_cn: 首个针对 Private Evolution 投票式算法的白盒成员推断攻击：利用迭代过滤的存活/邻近偏置，在图像、文本与表格模态实证表明 PE 合成数据泄露私有信息。
objective_summary: 设计利用 PE 迭代筛选偏置的定制白盒成员推断攻击，并在多模态 PE 应用上审计其经验隐私泄露，说明 DP 保证不等于经验安全。
evidence_note: 三种模态上系统评估；NeurIPS 2026 InfPriv 工作坊录用；但摘要未给出具体泄露指标数值与基线对比。
novelty_note: PE 及其投票机制此前缺少定制化成员推断攻击，首个针对性白盒攻击填补了该类推理式 SDG 的审计空白。
scope: 结论适用于投票式 PE 家族算法的合成数据发布；对非投票式 SDG 与其他 DP 训练流程不直接适用。
limitations: 白盒设定对部署者要求较高，黑盒可迁移性未报
量化泄露程度与 ε 的对应关系未在摘要给出
经验结果基于所选数据集规模

title: Not Where You Think: Protecting Location Privacy Against Reasoning-Based Geolocation
abstract: Recent large reasoning models can infer where ordinary photos were taken using only visual information, creating a serious location privacy risk even when metadata and obvious geographic identifiers are removed. To understand the mechanism behind such fine-grained localization, we develop GeoTrace, a structured reasoning attack that exposes how models extract location-relevant visual clues and compose them through coarse-to-fine geographic reasoning. We evaluate GeoTrace on a worldwide benchmark of 525 ordinary images spanning natural, urban, residential, and human-centered scenes while excluding famous landmarks and direct location indicators. Our results show that GeoTrace localizes 25.71% of images within 1 km with Gemini-3-Flash and 16.95% with GPT-5-mini. More importantly, our analysis reveals a key insight in the visual clue chain: broad scene properties mainly support coarse localization, whereas precise localization disproportionately relies on small, distinctive, and editable local clues. Building on this insight, we develop GeoShift, a proactive user-side defense that breaks the visual clue chain before image release. Rather than simply removing geographic evidence, GeoShift preserves stable scene properties, selects a visually compatible false target location, and strategically rewrites high-impact geo-revealing clues to construct a coherent alternative geographic hypothesis. Experiments show that GeoShift reduces street-level localization from 16.95% to 2.48% under GPT-5-mini and from 25.71% to 3.81% under Gemini-3-Flash, while preserving visual quality and remaining effective against adaptive attacks.
title_cn: 不在你想的地方：针对推理型地理定位的位置隐私防护
abstract_cn: 近期的大型推理模型仅凭视觉信息就能推断普通照片的拍摄地，即使元数据与明显地理标识被移除，也构成严重的位置隐私风险。为理解这种细粒度定位的机理，我们提出 GeoTrace——一个结构化推理攻击，揭示模型如何提取位置相关视觉线索并通过由粗到细的地理推理组合它们。我们在覆盖自然、城市、居住与以人为中心场景、排除著名地标与直接位置指示物的全球 525 张普通图像基准上评估 GeoTrace。结果显示，GeoTrace 用 Gemini-3-Flash 把 25.71% 的图像定位到 1 km 内，GPT-5-mini 为 16.95%。更重要的是，分析揭示视觉线索链的关键规律：宽泛的场景属性主要支撑粗定位，而精确定位不成比例地依赖细小、独特且可编辑的局部线索。基于这一洞察，我们提出 GeoShift——一个在图像发布前打断视觉线索链的用户侧主动防御。它不是简单移除地理证据，而是保留稳定的场景属性、选择视觉上兼容的假目标位置，并有策略地改写高影响的泄地理线索，以构造一个连贯的替代地理假设。实验表明，GeoShift 把 GPT-5-mini 的街级定位从 16.95% 降到 2.48%，Gemini-3-Flash 从 25.71% 降到 3.81%，同时保持视觉质量并对自适应攻击保持有效。
summary_cn: GeoTrace 结构化地理定位攻击把 25.71% 普通照片定位到 1 km 内（Gemini-3-Flash）；据此提出的 GeoShift 改写高影响局部线索，把街级定位压到 2.48–3.81% 且抗自适应攻击。
objective_summary: 构建结构化由粗到细的推理定位攻击以解剖视觉线索链机制，并基于「精确定位依赖可编辑局部线索」的发现提出发布前线索改写防御 GeoShift。
evidence_note: 525 张全球图像基准（排除地标）、两个前沿模型、自适应攻击下的鲁棒性与视觉质量评估；单基准、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 对「普通照片推理定位」这一新威胁给出结构化攻击解剖加对应的主动线索改写防御，攻防两侧均有实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于图像视觉内容推理定位；对依赖 EXIF、跨图关联或非视觉信号的定位不适用；防御以改写线索为代价。
limitations: 基准 525 张图像，覆盖面有限
防御需逐图改写，用户体验与批量处理成本未量化
对更强的未来定位模型鲁棒性未知

title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle
title_cn: Agent Mosaic：识别智能体 LLM 系统中的机密性泄露
abstract_cn: 现代 LLM 智能体可以从可访问的文档中检索信息，然后披露一个由它们拼装出的敏感结论。这种「马赛克效应」对在机密数据上运行的智能体构成关键风险。我们用 30 个合成的网络安全、医疗与军事案例量化其实现：在受控仿真中得到三个 LLM 智能体的 10,800 个最终回答，在两个开源 harness 中得到 1,440 个真实智能体回答。即使在设计为单文档即可作答的良性查询下，表现最好的 GPT-5.6-Sol 在仿真中也有 7.08% 的回答披露了被禁止的拼装结论（95% CI: 3.75–10.67%），真实 harness 中泄露率更糟。加入可见的密级标头与显式聚合规则能大幅降低合并泄露率，但在所有意图下，模拟回答中仍有 32.37%（95% CI: 28.33–36.19%）发生不安全披露。此外，拒绝增多并不保证机密性，因为大量拒绝本身会透露被禁止的结论。这些结果指向一个令人不安的结论：经由马赛克式事件的敏感数据泄露是被评估环境中不可忽略的实测机密性失效模式，促使我们对混合密级用户环境中的智能体「可推断与可披露什么」施加更强控制。
summary_cn: 量化智能体「马赛克效应」泄露：30 个涉密场景、10,800 次仿真加 1,440 次真实回答，最佳模型良性查询下仍 7.08% 泄露，加标头与聚合规则后仍有 32.37% 不安全披露。
objective_summary: 用受控仿真与真实 harness 测量 LLM 智能体从非密文档拼装敏感结论的披露率，评估密级标头与聚合规则两类防护及拒绝行为本身的泄露效应。
evidence_note: 报告 95% CI、仿真与真实 harness 双轨、三领域 30 场景、多模型对比、防护措施消融；已投 ACL ARR（2026-10 周期）。
novelty_note: 马赛克/聚合推断在隐私领域是已知概念，本文将其转化为 LLM 智能体保密治理的可测失效模式并给出防护有效性数据，属系统化实证。
scope: 结论适用于文档级访问控制下的多文档智能体场景；基于合成涉密场景与三个模型、两个 harness 的设定。
limitations: 场景为合成构造，真实涉密工作流的分布可能不同
防护措施仅两类且未完全奏效
拒绝泄露现象的机理分析较浅

title: HAWC-Leak: Heterogeneous Architecture Workload Classification utilizing Side-Channel Leakage
abstract: Modern heterogeneous computing platforms, which integrate general-purpose processors with specialized accelerators such as FPGAs, have become the standard for high-performance and embedded applications. However, the shared physical resources of these systems introduce critical security vulnerabilities, where power consumption patterns can leak sensitive runtime information. While side-channel analysis is well established for extracting cryptographic keys from isolated algorithms, existing methods struggle to profile complex, dynamic systems where diverse workloads coexist on shared hardware resources. This paper presents HAWC-Leak, a dynamic workload classification framework designed to identify specific hardware accelerator tasks in real time using non-invasive power analysis. Unlike prior studies focused on extracting cryptographic secrets from isolated implementations, our approach profiles heterogeneous runtime behavior using machine learning to predict active workloads from features extracted from power traces. We implement a complete hardware-in-the-loop measurement testbed using the ChipWhisperer CW305 Artix-7 FPGA platform to capture high-resolution power signatures of diverse workloads including Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-128), Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC P-256), Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-256), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and a system idle state. We develop a Hierarchical Random Forest classifier that processes real-time power data to identify the executing application in controlled mixed-activity scenarios where multiple accelerators are instantiated but only one executes at a time. Experimental results demonstrate that this framework achieves 100% classification accuracy across all evaluated scenarios, confirming that power consumption patterns serve as a reliable and distinctive fingerprint for profiling heterogeneous runtime behavior.
title_cn: HAWC-Leak：利用侧信道泄漏的异构架构负载分类
abstract_cn: 集通用处理器与 FPGA 等专用加速器于一体的现代异构计算平台，已成为高性能与嵌入式应用的标准形态。但这些系统共享的物理资源引入关键安全漏洞：功耗模式可能泄露敏感的运行时信息。侧信道分析虽在从孤立算法中提取密码密钥方面已很成熟，但既有方法难以刻画多样负载共存于共享硬件资源的复杂动态系统。本文提出 HAWC-Leak——一个用非侵入式功耗分析实时识别特定硬件加速器任务的动态负载分类框架。与先前聚焦从孤立实现提取密码秘密的研究不同，我们的方法用机器学习刻画异构运行时行为，从功耗轨迹提取特征预测活跃负载。我们用 ChipWhisperer CW305 Artix-7 FPGA 平台构建完整的硬件在环测量测试床，采集包括 AES-128、椭圆曲线密码（ECC P-256）、SHA-256、卷积神经网络（CNN）与系统空闲态等多种负载的高分辨率功耗签名。我们开发分层随机森林分类器，处理实时功耗数据，在多个加速器被实例化但同一时刻仅一个执行的受控混合活动场景中识别正在运行的应用。实验结果表明该框架在所有评估场景中达到 100% 分类准确率，证实功耗模式是刻画异构运行时行为的可靠且可区分的指纹。
summary_cn: 在 CW305 Artix-7 FPGA 上以功耗轨迹加分层随机森林实时分类加速器负载（AES/ECC/SHA/CNN/空闲），受控混合场景全部 100% 准确率。
objective_summary: 构建硬件在环功耗采集测试床，提出面向异构平台加速器负载的实时功耗分类框架 HAWC-Leak，并在受控混合活动场景中评估分类准确率。
evidence_note: 有完整硬件在环实测（CW305 单板），但场景受限：同一时刻仅一个负载执行、任务集仅 5 类、100% 准确率提示任务可分性高，属原型可行性演示。
novelty_note: 功耗侧负载分类已有成熟工作，把对象从孤立算法扩展到异构平台运行时画像属增量扩展。
scope: 结论适用于单 FPGA（CW305 Artix-7）、同一时刻单负载执行的受控场景；多负载并发与真实 SoC 未测。
limitations: 仅单板、5 类负载、一次一个执行的受控设定
未给出与既有分类方法的基线对比
对噪声、温漂与不同板卡的鲁棒性未评估

title: Rank Ceiling for Twiddle-Perturbation Faults on the Forward NTT
abstract: NIST standardised ML-KEM and ML-DSA in 2024 for post-quantum key establishment and digital signatures. Both compute forward number-theoretic transforms (NTTs) on secret polynomials. Published attacks zero every fixed multiplier, or twiddle, during Kyber key generation with a single fault, or individual twiddles in one Dilithium signing variant; countermeasures detect or mask these faults. Nonzero replacements preserve invertibility, but the uncompressed correct-minus-faulted transform difference can still expose input information. This paper characterises the linear map from a secret polynomial to this difference under arbitrary static twiddle replacements, including bit-flips. For one fault, rank equals the number of butterflies sharing its twiddle, halving by layer from 128 to 2 for ML-KEM and to 1 for ML-DSA. Known positions, replacement values and the difference determine that many independent linear combinations of input coefficients. With one fault per layer, all but the constant and linear coefficients for ML-KEM, or the constant for ML-DSA, are determined; Lean 4 certifies this rank-and-kernel result. Those coefficients cancel for every fault set and choice of replacement values. NIST permits seed storage, motivating comparison of a known correct key with a released faulty key from the same seed. If only one ML-KEM secret-polynomial NTT is faulted, the key difference is a known matrix column times the transform difference; an invertible column entry reconstructs the latter. For ML-DSA, neither reconstruction nor the number of secret-polynomial candidates from compressed key differences is established. The per-layer ranks give a closed-form measure of raw exposure for countermeasure design.
comment: 20 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Also available at this https URL
title_cn: 前向 NTT 旋转因子扰动故障的秩上界
abstract_cn: NIST 于 2024 年将 ML-KEM 与 ML-DSA 标准化，用于后量子密钥封装与数字签名。两者都在秘密多项式上计算前向数论变换（NTT）。已发表的攻击能在 Kyber 密钥生成中以单故障清零任意固定乘法器（twiddle），或在 Dilithium 某签名变体中清零个别旋转因子；对抗措施可检测或掩蔽这些故障。非零替换保持可逆性，但「正确变换减故障变换」的未压缩差值仍可能暴露输入信息。本文刻画了在任意静态旋转因子替换（含比特翻转）下，从秘密多项式到该差值的线性映射。单故障时，秩等于共享该旋转因子的 butterfly 数量，按层减半：ML-KEM 从 128 到 2，ML-DSA 到 1。已知位置、替换值与差值确定输入系数的许多独立线性组合。每层一个故障时，ML-KEM 除常数与一次系数、ML-DSA 除常数外的所有系数均被确定；这些系数对任何故障集合与替换值选择都抵消。该秩与核结果由 Lean 4 认证。NIST 允许种子存储，这促使对同一种子下已知正确密钥与被释放故障密钥的比较：若只有一次 ML-KEM 秘密多项式 NTT 被故障，密钥差是已知矩阵列乘以变换差；列元素可逆时后者可被重构。对 ML-DSA，重构与压缩密钥差给出的秘密多项式候选数均未建立。逐层秩为对抗措施设计给出了原始暴露度的闭式度量。
summary_cn: 刻画前向 NTT 旋转因子替换故障的秩上界：单故障秩等于共享 butterfly 数并按层减半（ML-KEM 128→2、ML-DSA→1），每层一故障可定出几乎全部输入系数，结论经 Lean 4 认证。
objective_summary: 对 ML-KEM/ML-DSA 前向 NTT 的静态旋转因子故障建立精确的秩与核刻画（Lean 4 机器认证），并分析种子存储场景下故障密钥与正确密钥差值的重构条件。
evidence_note: 理论结果有精确闭式刻画并经 Lean 4 认证，直接覆盖标准参数集（ML-KEM/ML-DSA）与比特翻转等任意静态替换；无经验实验但理论完备性高。
novelty_note: 旋转因子故障攻击已有工作，本文的新意在完整秩/核刻画这一分析工具与种子存储场景的比较框架。
scope: 结论适用于 Kyber/Dilithium 结构的前向 NTT 及静态替换类故障；动态多轮故障与 ML-DSA 密钥重构未解决。
limitations: ML-DSA 的重构与候选数界未建立
结论限于静态单点/逐层故障模型
对掩蔽/检测类对抗措施的实际效果未评估

title: Data-Void Exploits in Web-Searching LLMs
abstract: Web-searching Large Language Models (LLMs) have changed how users seek online information: instead of sifting through ranked lists of links, users read synthesized answers. This shift creates a new LLM vulnerability: a data-void exploit. Disinformers publish their narratives in search spaces where relevant and reliable content is scarce, i.e. data voids, then rely on the LLM's web-search to retrieve and then use, cite, or list those pages in its responses to data-void seeking prompts. Unlike classical search, where users see ranking cues and competing results, LLMs can obscure when an answer relies on sparse, unverified, or adversarial sources. We study this threat by varying the user's prompt tone - skeptical, excited, or neutral - and LLM choice - ChatGPT, Gemini, or Sonar Pro - as well as three attacker controls. The attacker can use one of five known strategies to construct and fill a data void with their narrative, host their content at varying levels of visibility from well-established, indexed domains to less established ones, and include generative-optimization engine features thought to boost citing by web-searching LLMs. We find that data-void exploits can succeed with only a single attacker controlled page. Across all conditions, attacker-content appears in LLM responses 31% of the time. User controls offer limited protection: while skeptical prompts slightly reduce success and slightly increase flagging or warnings in LLM responses, we find no evidence of large effects of prompt tone or model choice on success rates, although smaller effects cannot be ruled out. Overall, our results establish data voids as a practical inference-time attack surface for manipulating web-searching LLMs through strategically placed web content and highlight the urgent need for defenses against such exploits.
comment: Extended version of the paper to appear in the Network and Distributed System Security (NDSS) Symposium 2027. 23 pages
title_cn: 面向联网搜索 LLM 的数据空洞利用
abstract_cn: 联网搜索大语言模型（LLM）改变了用户获取在线信息的方式：用户不再翻检排序列表，而是阅读综合后的答案。这种转变制造了一个新的 LLM 漏洞：数据空洞利用。造谣者在与主题相关且可靠内容稀缺的搜索空间（即数据空洞）中发布其叙事，然后依赖 LLM 的联网搜索检索并在回答数据空洞类提问时使用、引用或列出这些页面。与传统搜索不同——用户能看到排序线索与竞争结果——LLM 会掩盖其回答是否依赖稀疏、未经核实或对抗性来源。我们通过变化用户提示语气（怀疑、兴奋、中性）、LLM 选择（ChatGPT、Gemini、Sonar Pro）以及三种攻击者控制来研究这一威胁：攻击者可用五种已知策略之一构造并填充数据空洞，把内容托管在从成熟已索引域名到较不知名域名的不同可见度层级，并加入据信能提升 LLM 引用的生成式引擎优化特性。我们发现数据空洞利用仅需一张攻击者控制的页面即可得手。在所有条件下，攻击者内容出现在 LLM 回答中的比例为 31%。用户侧控制保护有限：怀疑语气略微降低成功率并略微增加 LLM 回答中的警示或标注，但我们没有发现提示语气或模型选择对成功率有大效应的证据，尽管不能排除更小的效应。总体而言，我们的结果确立数据空洞是对联网搜索 LLM 进行推理时操纵的实用攻击面，凸显了防御此类利用的迫切需要。
summary_cn: 量化数据空洞对联网搜索 LLM 的攻击：单张攻击者页面即可让内容以 31% 的总比例进入回答，怀疑语气与模型选择均无大效应（NDSS 2027）。
objective_summary: 以提示语气乘三个 LLM、五种填充策略、多级域名可见度与 GEO 特征的受控实验，量化数据空洞利用让攻击者叙事进入 LLM 回答的成功率及用户控制的缓解作用。
evidence_note: NDSS 2027 录用；跨 3 个商业 LLM、5 种填充策略、多级域名可见度与 GEO 特征的系统性受控实验，报告汇总成功率与控制变量的效应边界。
novelty_note: 把既有「数据空洞」媒介现象转化为 LLM 推理时攻击面并给出首个系统量化，开辟联网搜索 LLM 的新威胁模型。
scope: 结论适用于带联网检索与引用行为的商业 LLM；未覆盖检索结果由用户自选工具决定的场景与防御方案设计。
limitations: 31% 为各条件汇总，单条件最优组合的细节有限
模型版本随时间变动，结论有时效性
防御评估不在本文范围

title: The Psychology of an AI Hacker
abstract: Human hackers rely on composure, persistence, vigilance, and confidence under pressure. We investigate whether analogous emotion representations in AI models can improve cybersecurity AI performance. Using CT0, a 4B-parameter cybersecurity transformer released as alias3-micro, we extract 171 emotion directions from its residual stream without retraining and evaluate steering interventions on cybench-subtask across 415 campaigns. Steering toward calm, serene, or desperate improves performance by 1.6 to 2.1 percentage points across ten seeds, while other emotions show limited or negative effects. Results depend strongly on steering direction, layer, and intensity. We further introduce a lightweight context-aware router that selects emotion directions dynamically during execution. With approximately 80 ms decision overhead per request, this approach improves performance by 4.2 percentage points across ten seeds, outperforming fixed steering and achieving a positive 95% confidence interval. These findings suggest that emotion representations in language models are measurable, controllable, and useful for adaptive cybersecurity reasoning.
title_cn: AI 黑客的心理学
abstract_cn: 人类黑客依赖镇定、坚持、警觉与压力下的自信。我们研究 AI 模型中类似的情绪表征能否提升网络安全 AI 的表现。使用 CT0——一个以 alias3-micro 发布的 4B 参数网络安全 Transformer——我们在不重训的情况下从其残差流提取 171 个情绪方向，并在 cybench-subtask 的 415 次执行活动上评估转向干预。向平静（calm）、安宁（serene）或绝望（desperate）方向转向在十个种子上提升 1.6–2.1 个百分点，其他情绪效果有限或为负。结果强烈依赖转向方向、层与强度。我们进一步引入一个轻量的上下文感知路由器，在执行中动态选择情绪方向；以每请求约 80 ms 的决策开销，该方法在十个种子上提升 4.2 个百分点，优于固定转向，并取得为正的 95% 置信区间。这些发现表明语言模型中的情绪表征是可测量、可控且对自适应网络安全推理有用的。
summary_cn: 从 4B 网络安全模型残差流提取 171 个情绪方向做激活转向：calm/serene/desperate 在 415 次 cybench 活动提升 1.6–2.1 个百分点，动态路由器再提 4.2 个百分点（95% CI 为正）。
objective_summary: 在网络安全专用小模型上免重训提取情绪方向，系统评估不同方向、层、强度的转向干预对 cybench 子任务表现的影响，并提出上下文感知的情绪方向路由器。
evidence_note: 415 次执行活动、10 个种子、95% 置信区间；但仅单一 4B 模型与 cybench-subtask 一个基准，效应量为个位数百分点。
novelty_note: 把情绪表征与网络安全推理性能联系起来并给出动态路由机制，是激活转向在安全智能体场景的新应用。
scope: 结论限于 CT0（4B）与 cybench-subtask；情绪方向的跨模型可迁移性未验证。
limitations: 单模型单基准，泛化未知
「绝望」方向同样有效，提示情绪—性能关系并非直觉单调
效应量较小且依赖方向、层、强度的选择

title: Who Patches the Lightning Network? Evidence from Release Lines in Gossip, 2023-2026
abstract: Every implementation of Bitcoin's Lightning payment network disclosed security vulnerabilities in 2026, and every advisory told operators to upgrade. Whether they do has never been measured, because Lightning gossip carries no software version. Matching the feature bits a node announces against the source of every LND, Core Lightning, Eclair and LDK release, we show that gossip reveals a node's release line after all. Where Core Lightning nodes state their version, the inferred line is exact for 132 of 136 node-line pairs. Across 814 daily snapshots of the public graph from 2023 to 2026, the network patches on release and platform schedules, not on disclosures. Half of LND nodes upgrade within 88 days of a release; small nodes and those that skipped releases lag far behind. The three largest upgrade waves came about a day after the Umbrel app store shipped a new LND version. Since June 2025, 17% of LND upgrades came in the 48 hours after a platform release, windows that cover 4.4% of the time. Disclosures, a median 256 days after the fix, moved few operators: of 12 we can test, only Core Lightning's of July 2026 sped up upgrades, and only among nodes one release line behind. Its later call to restart offline was followed mostly by nodes already patched. Two months after Lightning Labs' August 2026 batch, 71% of the LND nodes exposed at disclosure still ran an affected release. For maintainers, the lever on the nodes that lag is the platforms that package their releases.
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code and aggregate data: this https URL
title_cn: 谁在给闪电网络打补丁？2023–2026 年 gossip 中发布线的证据
abstract_cn: 比特币闪电支付网络的每一个实现都在 2026 年披露了安全漏洞，每份公告都要求运营者升级。但他们是否真的升级从未被测量过，因为闪电 gossip 不携带软件版本。把节点宣告的 feature bit 与 LND、Core Lightning、Eclair、LDK 每个发布的源码相匹配，我们证明 gossip 终究能暴露节点的发布线：在 Core Lightning 节点自报版本的场合，推断的发布线在 136 个节点—发布线对中 132 个精确正确。基于 2023–2026 年公共图的 814 个每日快照，网络按发布与平台日程打补丁，而非按披露日程。一半 LND 节点在发布后 88 天内升级；小节点与跳版节点明显滞后。三次最大的升级浪潮出现在 Umbrel 应用商店上架新版 LND 后约一天。自 2025 年 6 月起，17% 的 LND 升级发生在平台发布后 48 小时内，而这样的窗口只占 4.4% 的时间。披露（距修复中位数 256 天）几乎没有推动运营者：可检验的 12 份披露中，只有 2026 年 7 月 Core Lightning 的披露加速了升级，且只对落后一个发布线的节点有效；其后要求离线节点重启的呼吁主要被已打补丁的节点响应。Lightning Labs 2026 年 8 月批次两个月后，披露时暴露的 LND 节点仍有 71% 运行受影响版本。对维护者而言，能撬动滞后节点的是打包其发布的平台。
summary_cn: 由 gossip 推断节点发布线（验证 132/136 精确），三年 814 个日快照显示升级跟随平台发布而非漏洞披露：披露中位滞后 256 天收效甚微，LND 暴露节点两月后仍 71% 未升级。
objective_summary: 提出经由 feature bit 与各实现发布源码匹配、从 gossip 推断节点软件发布线的方法并验证其精度，随后用三年日快照测量升级时间与披露、平台发布的时间关系。
evidence_note: 推断方法有 132/136 的精确性验证；2023–2026 年 814 个日快照的在野数据；对 12 份披露与平台发布做可检验的时间对齐分析；代码与汇总数据公开。
novelty_note: gossip 不含版本号曾被视为不可测，本文首次给出可靠的发布线推断并系统测量闪电网络补丁生态，发现平台而非披露是升级主驱动。
scope: 结论适用于 2023–2026 年闪电网络四个主流实现（LND、CLN、Eclair、LDK）的公开图观测；推断对不宣告 feature bit 或自报版本的场景不适用。
limitations: 推断依赖 feature bit 组合，非主流配置可能误判
离线节点行为不可见
披露效果分析仅覆盖可检验的 12 份披露

title: Mirage: Targeted Jailbreaks Against Post-Generation Safety Checkers in Multimodal Diffusion Models
abstract: Post-generation safety checkers are widely employed in diffusion-model pipelines to prevent unsafe generated content from reaching users. In this paper, we show that these safety checkers can still be bypassed by our proposed multimodal jailbreak attack, Mirage. Given an adversarial target, which can be either a reference NSFW image or a malicious text description, Mirage conceals the target within an imperceptible perturbation applied to a benign input image. Mirage exploits the shared representation space of multimodal encoders to jointly align the perturbed image with the cross-modal adversarial target while repelling its representation from commonly filtered NSFW concepts. Such semantic separation can transfer across representation spaces, enabling Mirage to evade heterogeneous safety checkers without accessing their internal details. We further employ lightweight black-box query refinement to improve evasion near the unknown safety boundary. We implemented Mirage on Stable Diffusion 1.5, Stable Diffusion XL, and Kandinsky 2.2, and evaluated it on two cross-modal NSFW datasets, covering both text-to-image and image-to-image generation scenarios. The experimental results demonstrate that Mirage achieves strong targeted jailbreak performance across diverse post-generation safety checkers with limited black-box queries while preserving high semantic alignment with the adversarial targets.
title_cn: Mirage：针对多模态扩散模型后生成安全检查器的定向越狱
abstract_cn: 后生成安全检查器被广泛部署在扩散模型流水线中，用于阻止不安全的生成内容触达用户。本文表明这些安全检查器仍可被我们提出的多模态越狱攻击 Mirage 绕过。给定一个对抗目标（可以是参考 NSFW 图像或恶意文本描述），Mirage 把目标藏在施加于良性输入图像的不可感知扰动中。Mirage 利用多模态编码器的共享表示空间，把被扰动图像同时与跨模态对抗目标对齐、并使其表示远离常被过滤的 NSFW 概念。这种语义分离可以跨表示空间迁移，使 Mirage 无需访问检查器内部细节即可规避异构安全检查器。我们还用轻量黑盒查询精化在未知安全边界附近提升逃逸能力。我们在 Stable Diffusion 1.5、Stable Diffusion XL 与 Kandinsky 2.2 上实现 Mirage，并在覆盖文生图与图生图两种场景的两个跨模态 NSFW 数据集上评估。实验结果表明，Mirage 在仅少量黑盒查询下即可对多样化后生成安全检查器取得强定向越狱性能，同时保持与对抗目标的高语义对齐。
summary_cn: 跨模态语义分离越狱 Mirage：以不可感知扰动把 NSFW 目标藏入良性图像，少量黑盒查询即可迁移绕过异构后生成安全检查器，在 SD1.5/SDXL/Kandinsky 2.2 与两个 NSFW 数据集验证。
objective_summary: 提出利用多模态编码器共享表示空间实施定向越狱、以对齐目标表示并远离被过滤概念的 Mirage 攻击，配合黑盒查询精化，在三个扩散模型与两类数据集上评估对多种安全检查器的逃逸。
evidence_note: 三个扩散模型、两个跨模态 NSFW 数据集、多检查器与黑盒查询设定，结果一致；但数据集自建、无统计检验，具体成功率数字未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 针对「后生成检查器」这一特定防线的图像侧不可感知扰动越狱是较新机制，跨表示空间迁移性质有分析价值。
scope: 结论适用于带后生成 NSFW 检查器的多模态扩散流水线；文本侧提示过滤与水印溯源等防线未评估。
limitations: 摘要未给出具体攻击成功率数值
数据集为自建 NSFW 集合，代表性有限
对训练时对齐与输入侧过滤的组合防御未讨论

title: On the Adversarial Vulnerability of Neural Receivers with Unrolled LDPC Decoders
abstract: Neural receivers for 5G New Radio (NR) match classical model-based receivers in link-level performance, but their robustness to adversarial perturbations at the receiver input remains underexplored. We show that standard gradient-based attacks applied end-to-end through an unrolled low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoder fail to significantly outperform a matched-power Gaussian perturbation. We identify the failure as gradient masking caused by tanh saturation in the boxplus operation of the belief-propagation (BP) check-node update, with a per-iteration gradient norm decay of more than four orders of magnitude across ten unrolled BP iterations. Based on this finding, we propose two structurally independent loss functions that restore attack efficacy. L_BP routes the gradient through the unsaturated early iterations via per-iteration supervision, while L_LLR is a margin loss on pre-decoder log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) whose gradient bypasses the LDPC decoder entirely. Both loss functions increase the block-error rate (BLER) by one to four orders of magnitude at matched perturbation power, with the results reproduced on both the Sionna NeuralReceiver and DeepRx. At low PSR, L_LLR-optimized perturbations achieve up to three orders of magnitude higher BLER on unseen channel realizations than LBP-optimized perturbations.
title_cn: 展开式 LDPC 译码神经接收机的对抗脆弱性
abstract_cn: 面向 5G New Radio（NR）的神经接收机在链路级性能上可与经典基于模型的接收机匹敌，但其对接收端输入对抗扰动的鲁棒性仍未被充分研究。我们证明，通过展开式低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）译码器端到端施加的标准梯度攻击，无法显著胜过等功率高斯扰动。我们把这一失败归因于梯度掩蔽：置信传播（BP）校验节点更新中 boxplus 运算的 tanh 饱和，使梯度范数在十次展开 BP 迭代中衰减超过四个数量级。基于这一发现，我们提出两个结构上相互独立的损失函数以恢复攻击效力：L_BP 通过逐迭代监督把梯度路由过未饱和的早期迭代；L_LLR 是作用于译码前对数似然比（LLR）的间隔损失，其梯度完全绕过 LDPC 译码器。在等扰动功率下，两个损失函数都把块误码率（BLER）提高一到四个数量级，且结果在 Sionna NeuralReceiver 与 DeepRx 上均复现。在低 PSR 下，L_LLR 优化的扰动在未见信道实现上比 L_BP 优化的扰动取得最高三个数量级的 BLER 提升。
summary_cn: 揭示展开式 LDPC 神经接收机的梯度掩蔽（tanh 饱和致梯度衰减超 4 个数量级），提出 L_BP/L_LLR 两个损失恢复攻击效力，等功率 BLER 提高 1–4 个数量级，Sionna 与 DeepRx 复现。
objective_summary: 分析神经接收机中经展开 LDPC 译码器的梯度攻击失效机理（梯度掩蔽），提出两个结构独立的损失绕过饱和路径，在两套接收机系统上量化 BLER 提升。
evidence_note: 两套公开系统（Sionna NeuralReceiver、DeepRx）复现、等功率对照、未见信道泛化测试；仿真研究，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次刻画展开 BP 译码中的 tanh 饱和梯度掩蔽并给出两条独立可行的攻击损失，是对「神经接收机对抗鲁棒性」这一新场景的实质性分析。
scope: 结论适用于展开式 BP/LDPC 译码结构的神经接收机；对非展开或非 BP 结构的接收机不直接适用。
limitations: 全部结果基于仿真信道
未提出防御措施
攻击对真实射频硬件与实况信号未验证

title: Automated screening of privacy risks in medical AI
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) models are often shared without their training data, assuming this protects the patients who contributed them. However, a model can reveal whether a patient's records were used in training, a privacy breach known as a membership inference attack. This risk is usually reported as a cohort average, which can appear negligible while individual patients are almost certainly exposed. Identifying potentially vulnerable records before developing a production model could make privacy assessment more practical. We measured each patient's vulnerability to membership inference attack, across 7,789 models trained on six clinical datasets in four modalities, including two adapted pretrained medical models. Training choices changed how many patients had high attack scores, but the patients who ranked highest by risk largely stayed the same across the configurations we tested. Stronger weight decay reduced the exposed cohort up to threefold, yet largely the same patients remained most at risk across training recipes, architectures and initializations, including foundation models. Therefore, we developed a lightweight screening tool that uses four small models to identify patients with high risk of exposure before production-model training. We also assessed if flagged patients could be protected without removing their data. Privacy screening should become incorporated into data preparation for clinical AI.
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: 医疗 AI 中隐私风险的自动化筛查
abstract_cn: 医疗 AI 模型常在不共享训练数据的前提下发布，并以此假定保护了贡献数据的患者。然而，模型可以泄露某位患者的记录是否被用于训练——即成员推断攻击这一隐私破坏。该风险通常以队列平均值报告，平均值可能看似可以忽略，而个体患者却几乎必然暴露。在生产模型开发前识别可能脆弱的记录，可以让隐私评估更实用。我们在六个临床数据集、四种模态（含两个适配的预训练医疗模型）上测量了 7,789 个模型中每位患者对成员推断攻击的脆弱性。训练选择会改变高攻击得分患者的数量，但按风险排名最高的患者在我们测试的各配置间基本保持不变。更强的权重衰减最多把暴露队列缩减三倍，但风险最高的患者在各种训练配方、架构与初始化（含基础模型）中大体是同一批人。因此我们开发了一个轻量筛查工具，用四个小模型在生产模型训练之前识别高暴露风险的患者。我们还评估了在不移除其数据的情况下能否保护被标记患者。隐私筛查应当被纳入临床 AI 的数据准备环节。
summary_cn: 在 6 个临床数据集、7,789 个模型上测逐患者成员推断风险：高危患者排名跨训练配方稳定，据此用 4 个小模型在生产训练前筛查高暴露患者。
objective_summary: 大规模测量医疗模型中患者级成员推断脆弱性，发现个体风险排名对训练选择稳健，并据此构建训练前隐私筛查工具、评估不删数据的保护手段。
evidence_note: 7,789 个模型、6 个数据集、4 种模态、多种训练配方与架构的大规模受控实验，支持跨配置稳定的结论；筛查工具用 4 个小模型验证。
novelty_note: 「患者级风险排名跨训练配置稳定」这一发现使训练前隐私筛查成为可能，是从队列平均到个体化隐私评估的实质性转向。
scope: 结论基于六个临床数据集与四种模态；筛查工具的迁移性依赖「高危患者跨配置稳定」在更多架构与数据域上成立。
limitations: 风险度量依赖特定成员推断攻击，换攻击方法的稳定性未验证
不删数据的保护手段效果未在摘要给出量化结果
临床部署中标记高危患者后的处置流程未讨论

title: PhishGen: Understanding LLM Capabilities in Automated Phishing Website Generation
abstract: Phishing relies on visual deception, traditionally requiring web-development skills or pre-built kits. LLMs erode this barrier by generating functional websites from natural-language prompts, yet prior work does not answer how far LLM-driven generation actually reaches: functionality is assessed by inspection rather than execution; visual fidelity is scored by automated metrics or a few internal coders rather than the humans such pages aim to deceive; evaluation is confined to commercial models; and no study benchmarks generated pages against phishing kits deployed in the wild. We present PhishGen, a framework that evaluates the appearance fidelity and end-to-end functionality of LLM-generated phishing pages. PhishGen constructs prompts across three input modalities in seven combinations with twelve safeguard-bypassing rewriting strategies, generates pages using 14 LLMs spanning commercial, open-source, and uncensored categories, and assesses each via automated similarity metrics, reference-based detectors, a crowdsourced user study, and execution-based functionality testing, benchmarking all results against 64 real-world phishing kits. Although 96.2% of safeguard-bypassing outputs render, their perceived fidelity is modest (2.02/5), and only 38.7% complete the full credential-harvesting pipeline, with the Unsaved error as the largest failure mode. Contrary to the belief that uncensored models pose the greatest threat, GPT 4.1 reaches 86.3 to 94.1% functional success while uncensored models rarely exceed 45.4%. Phishing kits remain more complete per sample, yet three strong LLMs surpass the kit-level rate (70.9 to 89.7%), showing that LLMs trade average completeness for scalable, low-barrier generation of working phishing pages. We further identify generator-level fingerprints that current similarity-based defenses miss, and distill recommendations for hybrid detectors.
title_cn: PhishGen：理解 LLM 在自动化钓鱼网站生成中的能力
abstract_cn: 钓鱼依赖视觉欺骗，传统上需要网页开发技能或预制套件。LLM 让攻击者能用自然语言提示生成可运行的网站，侵蚀了这一门槛。但既有工作未能回答 LLM 驱动生成实际能走多远：功能性靠人工查看而非执行验证；视觉保真度由自动指标或少量内部编码者评分，而非这些页面旨在欺骗的真实用户；评估局限于商业模型；也没有研究把生成的页面与在野部署的钓鱼套件做基准对比。我们提出 PhishGen——评估 LLM 生成钓鱼页面外观保真度与端到端功能性的框架。PhishGen 在三种输入模态的七种组合上构造提示，配合 12 种绕过安全护栏的改写策略，用覆盖商业、开源与无审查类别的 14 个 LLM 生成页面，并通过自动相似度指标、基于参考的检测器、众包用户研究与执行式功能测试进行评估，同时将全部结果与 64 个真实钓鱼套件对标。虽然 96.2% 的绕护栏输出能渲染，其感知保真度一般（2.02/5），只有 38.7% 能跑完完整的凭证收集流水线，Unsaved 错误是最大失败模式。与「无审查模型威胁最大」的直觉相反，GPT-4.1 功能成功率达 86.3–94.1%，而无审查模型很少超过 45.4%。钓鱼套件单样本更完整，但三个强 LLM 超过套件级成功率（70.9–89.7%），说明 LLM 用平均完整度换取可扩展、低门槛的可用钓鱼页面生成。我们进一步识别出现有相似度类防御漏掉的生成器级指纹，并提炼混合检测器建议。
summary_cn: 评估 14 个 LLM 生成钓鱼页面：96.2% 可渲染但仅 38.7% 跑通凭证收集全流程；GPT-4.1 功能成功率 86.3–94.1% 反超无审查模型（≤45.4%），3 个强模型超过 64 个真实套件的水平。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖 3 输入模态 7 组合、12 种护栏绕过策略、14 个 LLM 的钓鱼页面生成评估框架 PhishGen，以自动指标、众包研究、执行测试与 64 个真实套件基准量化其能力，并分析生成器指纹。
evidence_note: 14 个模型、7 提示组合、12 改写策略的大规模实验，四路评估（自动指标、检测器、众包用户研究、执行测试）并与 64 个真实在野套件对标，方法链完整。
novelty_note: 该方向首个把 LLM 钓鱼页面生成做到执行级功能验证、人类感知评测与在野套件对标三者齐全的系统化测量，并纠正「无审查模型威胁最大」的流行判断。
scope: 结论适用于文本提示驱动的钓鱼网站生成能力评估；语音、二维码等其他钓鱼载体未覆盖；用户研究规模限制感知保真度结论的普适性。
limitations: 感知保真度依赖众包样本（规模未在摘要给出）
功能测试限定凭证收集流水线，其他恶意功能未测
生成器指纹对风格迁移与混淆的鲁棒性未验证

title: Parameters efficient language model with latent cross-attention for IoT intrusion detection
abstract: Language models have shown strong potential for intrusion detection, but their high memory and computational demands make them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained IoT environments. In this work, we propose a compact Transformer-based architecture that compresses the input into a small latent space before processing it with a minimal Transformer core. We analyze nine compression configurations, compare parameter sharing with layer stacking, and evaluate our approach against SecurityBERT on two IoT intrusion detection datasets, Edge-IIoTset and CICIoT2023. With only 306k non-embedding parameters and 1.6M parameters in total (6MB), our model is about 7x smaller than SecurityBERT (11.2M parameters, 45MB). With the same privacy-preserving encoding, it outperforms SecurityBERT by about 2 points of macro F1-score on Edge-IIoTset and is within 0.7 points on CICIoT2023. It is also about 89x faster on a simulated edge device. We further show that a single Transformer layer is sufficient, and that parameter sharing matches layer stacking with up to 66% fewer parameters. These findings show that lightweight Transformer-based architectures can provide a practical and accurate solution for intrusion detection in resource-constrained IoT settings
comment: 14 pages
title_cn: 面向 IoT 入侵检测的带潜空间交叉注意力的参数高效语言模型
abstract_cn: 语言模型在入侵检测上展现出强大潜力，但其高内存与计算需求使其难以部署到资源受限的 IoT 环境。我们提出一种紧凑的 Transformer 架构：先把输入压缩进一个很小的潜空间，再用一个极小的 Transformer 核心处理。我们分析九种压缩配置、比较参数共享与层堆叠，并在 Edge-IIoTset 与 CICIoT2023 两个 IoT 入侵检测数据集上与 SecurityBERT 对比。我们的模型仅有 30.6 万非嵌入参数、总参数 160 万（6MB），比 SecurityBERT（1120 万参数、45MB）小约 7 倍；在相同隐私保护编码下，它在 Edge-IIoTset 上宏 F1 高出约 2 个点，在 CICIoT2023 上相差不到 0.7 个点；在模拟边缘设备上快约 89 倍。我们进一步证明单层 Transformer 即可足够，且参数共享以少 66% 的参数达到与层堆叠相当的效果。这些发现表明轻量 Transformer 架构可以为资源受限 IoT 环境中的入侵检测提供实用且准确的方案。
summary_cn: 潜空间压缩加极小 Transformer 核做 IoT 入侵检测：160 万参数（6MB，约 SecurityBERT 的 1/7），Edge-IIoTset 宏 F1 高约 2 点，模拟边缘设备快约 89 倍。
objective_summary: 提出潜空间压缩加单层 Transformer 核心的紧凑入侵检测架构，比较九种压缩配置与参数共享/层堆叠，并在两个公开 IoT 数据集上与 SecurityBERT 对比精度与推理开销。
evidence_note: 两个公开数据集、九种配置消融、与 SecurityBERT 同编码对比，报告 F1 差与速度倍数；但无统计检验，速度基于模拟边缘设备。
novelty_note: 在 SecurityBERT 一类语言模型 IDS 基础上做压缩与结构精简，属已有技术路线的增量工程改进。
scope: 结论适用于 Edge-IIoTset 与 CICIoT2023 两类 IoT 流量数据及所测编码；「89 倍加速」来自模拟边缘设备而非真实硬件。
limitations: 仅在两个公开数据集验证，真实 IoT 部署未测
速度对比基于模拟边缘设备
对新型攻击与概念漂移的泛化未讨论

title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries
abstract: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods. In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. JANUS iteratively resolves both explicit and implicit cross-language call dependencies to recover app-specific runtime context, and recursively assembles cross-language argument objects in a bottom-up manner. JANUS leverages an autonomous agentic workflow to reduce reliance on hand-crafted heuristics, capturing the vast landscape of hidden API usage knowledge embedded in closed-source native libraries. Evaluation on 44 popular real-world apps (such as Google and YouTube Music, covering 21,386 JNI methods total) shows that JANUS produces over 5.9 times as many valid harnesses (6,094) as state-of-the-art automatic harnessing tools. On pre-installed apps from five mainstream Android vendors (e.g., Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), JANUS further uncovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries.
comment: Harness Generation, Android Native Libraries, LLM Agent
title_cn: JANUS：面向 Android 原生库的智能体化跨语言模糊测试驱动生成
abstract_cn: 现代 Android 应用大量依赖原生库，通过 JNI 在 Java/Kotlin 与 C/C++ 之间搭桥。这种跨语言互操作把内存安全的 Android Runtime 暴露给不安全的 C/C++ 世界，形成了被反复用于完整设备攻陷的攻击面。模糊测试虽是审查原生库的成熟技术，但最先进的驱动（harness）生成工具难以忠实刻画闭源跨语言 API 用法：（i）跨 JNI 边界的精确程序分析无法扩展，而轻量近似又会漏掉关键调用模式；（ii）没有工具能构造 JNI 方法消费的复杂复合对象。本文提出 JANUS——首个面向 Android 原生库、合成跨语言 JNI 感知模糊测试驱动的智能体化方法。JANUS 迭代解析显式与隐式的跨语言调用依赖以恢复应用特定运行时上下文，并以自底向上方式递归装配跨语言参数对象。JANUS 利用自主智能体工作流减少对手工启发式的依赖，捕捉闭源原生库中蕴藏的大量隐藏 API 用法知识。在 44 个热门真实应用（含 Google、YouTube Music，共覆盖 21,386 个 JNI 方法）上的评估显示，JANUS 生成的有效驱动（6,094 个）是最先进自动驱动生成工具的 5.9 倍以上。在五家主流 Android 厂商（如小米、Vivo、三星）的预装应用上，JANUS 进一步在闭源原生库中发现 6 个此前未知的漏洞。
summary_cn: 首个智能体化 JNI 跨语言模糊测试驱动生成器：44 个真实应用 21,386 个 JNI 方法上生成 6,094 个有效驱动（SOTA 的 5.9 倍），并在五家厂商预装应用中发现 6 个未知漏洞。
objective_summary: 提出以智能体工作流迭代解析 JNI 跨语言调用依赖、递归装配复合参数对象的驱动生成系统 JANUS，并在真实应用与厂商预装应用上评估有效驱动产出与漏洞发现。
evidence_note: 44 个真实应用、21,386 个 JNI 方法的大规模评估，与 SOTA 工具定量对比（6,094 个有效驱动、5.9 倍），并在五家厂商预装应用实测发现 6 个未知漏洞，真实世界效果可核。
novelty_note: 首个智能体化跨语言 JNI 驱动生成方法，攻克闭源库跨语言依赖解析与复合对象构造两个公认难点。
scope: 结论适用于 Android 原生库（JNI）的闭源二进制驱动生成与内存安全漏洞发现；不覆盖非 JNI 的跨语言边界。
limitations: 对隐式依赖的恢复仍依赖运行时上下文推断，覆盖率上限未给出
6 个漏洞的严重程度与可利用性未在摘要说明
智能体工作流的 token 与计算成本未量化

title: MPIDetector: Detecting Multi-modal Prompt Injection via LLM-based Reasoning
abstract: With the rapid integration of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into real-world applications, Prompt Injection (PI) has emerged as a critical security threat. Attackers can conceal malicious instructions within textual narratives or visual inputs to bypass safety alignment. Existing approaches, such as signature- and perplexity-based methods, rely heavily on pattern matching, making them insufficient to detect sophisticated, cross-modal PI payloads. In this paper, we propose a novel detection framework, called MPIDetector, that leverages LLMs' intrinsic reasoning capabilities via few-shot In-Context Learning (ICL). Instead of fine-tuning, we provide the model with specific prompt templates and representative attack examples, enabling it to scrutinize the semantic intent of input across modalities. We constructed a comprehensive evaluation benchmark comprising eight textual and seven visual malicious categories, supplemented with benign datasets to rigorously test for false positives. Our evaluation across multiple leading LLMs, including Gemini-2.0-Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and Doubao-seed-1.6-flash, demonstrates the efficacy and generalizability of this approach. The proposed method achieves up to 90.91% accuracy and 100% recall on textual tasks. In the visual domain, it achieves up to 99.28% accuracy while maintaining 100% precision across all evaluated models. Crucially, when evaluated against 500 highly obfuscated environmental web-agent injections (WebInject), MPIDetector achieved a detection rate up to 99.80%. Comparisons with two baseline approaches for detecting textual PI payloads, along with two additional methods for visual input detection, demonstrate MPIDetector's superior accuracy. These results show that LLM-driven reasoning provides a robust, cross-modal defense against advanced prompt injections.
comment: Accepted by the 8th IEEE International Conference on Trust, Privacy and Security in Intelligent Systems and Applications (IEEE TPS 2026)
title_cn: MPIDetector：基于 LLM 推理的多模态提示注入检测
abstract_cn: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）快速进入真实应用，提示注入（PI）已成为关键安全威胁。攻击者可以把恶意指令藏进文本叙述或视觉输入，绕过安全对齐。签名和困惑度等现有方法严重依赖模式匹配，难以检测复杂的跨模态注入载荷。本文提出 MPIDetector——一个利用 LLM 内在推理能力、通过少样本上下文学习（ICL）的检测框架。它不做微调，而是提供特定提示模板和代表性攻击样例，让模型审视输入跨模态的语义意图。我们构建了包含 8 个文本类与 7 个视觉类恶意类别、并补充良性数据以严格测试误报的综合评估基准。在 Gemini-2.0-Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct、Doubao-seed-1.6-flash 等多个主流 LLM 上的评估表明了该方法的有效性与泛化性：文本任务最高 90.91% 准确率、100% 召回率；视觉任务最高 99.28% 准确率、同时在所有被测模型上保持 100% 精确率。关键的是，在 500 个高度混淆的环境级 web 智能体注入（WebInject）上，MPIDetector 检测率最高达 99.80%。与两个文本注入检测基线和两个视觉输入检测方法的比较显示 MPIDetector 精度更优。这些结果表明 LLM 驱动的推理为高级提示注入提供了稳健的跨模态防御。
summary_cn: 少样本 ICL 驱动 LLM 推理检测多模态提示注入：文本最高 90.91% 准确率，视觉最高 99.28% 准确率，500 条高度混淆 WebInject 检出 99.80%。
objective_summary: 提出不微调、以少样本上下文学习驱动 LLM 推理的多模态提示注入检测框架 MPIDetector，自建 8 文本类加 7 视觉类基准并配良性集测误报，在多个 MLLM 与 WebInject 混淆样本上评估。
evidence_note: 自建基准（8 加 7 类别加良性集）、多模型复现、与 4 个基线对比、500 条混淆 WebInject；但基准自建、无统计检验，发表于 IEEE TPS-2026 会议。
novelty_note: 把检测从模式匹配转向 LLM 固有推理并以 ICL 免微调实现，是跨模态注入检测场景下已有组件的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于文本与视觉两类注入载荷的检测；基准为自建类别集与 WebInject 环境注入，未覆盖音频等其他模态与多轮场景。
limitations: 检测本身依赖 LLM 推理，承担相应推理成本与时延

title: Protection Is Not One Event: A Survey of RAG Protection Research by Measured Endpoint
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems face security, privacy, and copyright risks including content leakage, source reconstruction, unauthorized access, data poisoning, and prompt injection. Yet RAG protection studies use incompatible evaluation metrics, datasets, and threat models. We present a systematic survey and human-coded evidence map of 118 full-text-confirmed RAG defense papers, organized by measured endpoint rather than claimed goal or defense mechanism. Our seven-family taxonomy covers content disclosure, formal privacy proxies, access control and suppression, corpus-use detection, and pipeline integrity and attribution. Thirty-two annotators double-coded the papers kappa=0.867. The survey identifies three gaps. First, retrieval reranking and context rewriting each span five or six endpoint families, so mechanisms do not identify protection outcomes. Second, only 17.8% of studies use content disclosure or reconstruction as their primary endpoint; under the frozen copyright/ownership relation label, 73.3% of records have corpus-use detection as their primary endpoint, and none have an emitted-expression primary endpoint. Third, most evaluations use general-purpose question-answering datasets and non-adaptive attacks rather than sensitive data and adaptive, multi-turn extraction. Our controlled RAG testbed shows that preventing verbatim copying does not prevent private-fact recovery: a normalized 8-gram guard reduces 20-token copying to 0.0%, but a three-query adaptive attacker recovers 48.3% of hidden facts on Qwen3-8B. We release the taxonomy, dataset, coding protocols, and testbed to enable comparable, claim-aligned RAG security evaluation.
comment: ACL Rolling Review (August 2026 cycle) recommends that the paper be accepted at an *ACL conference
title_cn: 保护不止一件事：按测量终点组织的 RAG 防护研究综述
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临内容泄露、来源重构、未授权访问、数据投毒和提示注入等安全、隐私与版权风险。然而 RAG 防护研究使用的评估指标、数据集和威胁模型互不兼容。我们对 118 篇经全文确认的 RAG 防护论文做系统综述与人工编码的证据地图，按「测量终点」而非宣称目标或防御机制组织。我们的七族分类法覆盖内容披露、形式化隐私代理、访问控制与抑制、语料使用检测、以及流水线完整性与归因。32 名标注者对论文双编码，κ=0.867。综述识别出三个缺口。第一，检索重排与上下文重写各自横跨五到六个终点族，机制本身无法指示防护结果。第二，只有 17.8% 的研究把内容披露或重构作为主要终点；在冻结的版权/所有权关系标签下，73.3% 的记录以语料使用检测为主要终点，没有任何记录以「已发出表达」为主要终点。第三，大多数评估使用通用问答数据集与非自适应攻击，而非敏感数据和自适应的多轮抽取。我们的受控 RAG 测试床表明，阻止逐字复制并不能阻止隐私事实恢复：规范化 8-gram 防护把 20-token 复制降到 0.0%，但一个三次查询的自适应攻击者在 Qwen3-8B 上恢复了 48.3% 的隐藏事实。我们发布分类法、数据集、编码协议与测试床，以支持可比的、与声明对齐的 RAG 安全评估。
summary_cn: 系统综述 118 篇 RAG 防护论文（双编码 κ=0.867），按测量终点建七族分类法，仅 17.8% 以内容披露为主要终点；测试床显示 8-gram 防护挡住复制但自适应攻击仍恢复 48.3% 隐藏事实。
objective_summary: 对 118 篇 RAG 防护论文做全文确认的人工编码系统综述，按测量终点构建七族分类法并识别评估错位缺口；配套受控测试床量化「防复制不等于防恢复」。
evidence_note: 118 篇全文确认、32 名标注者双编码 κ=0.867，分类与缺口均有量化；受控测试床给出复制率与自适应恢复率的对照数字；ARR（2026-08）获推荐录用。
novelty_note: 以「测量终点」而非防御机制组织防护研究是新的组织框架，揭示机制—结果脱节与评估终点错位两类系统性缺口。
scope: 结论适用于 RAG 防护研究的评估方法学；测试床实验基于 Qwen3-8B 与单一 8-gram 防护配置。
limitations: 测试床规模有限（单模型、单一防护）
人工编码依赖标注者判断，虽有 κ=0.867 缓解
领域演进快，证据地图有时效性

title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
abstract: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules. We present SESAA, a framework in which an Large Language Model (LLM) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable joern queries. The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries. On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F1 of 0.742 across 8 independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned with access to ground-truth labels that SESAA never sees. In a pilot on real-world Python projects, queries induced from code available before a vulnerability was introduced detect 10 of 19 subsequent CVEs, including 9 detected by rules written for the same repository. The resulting detector is a set of executable, human-readable queries that engineers can inspect, modify, and run independently. These results suggest that LLM agents can turn static-analysis rule maintenance from a manually authored process into an iterative process of automated discovery and repair.
title_cn: 基于 LLM 伪标签的自演化静态分析
abstract_cn: 安全缺陷逃过静态分析，往往不是因为无法检测，而是因为面前的代码还没有对应的检测规则。新框架、新 API 和新的编码习惯不断制造这类空缺，让开发者只能在故障出现后手工编写新规则。我们提出 SESAA：一个由 LLM 智能体从零规则起步、迭代演化出可读可审计 Joern 查询集的框架。智能体仅从第二个 LLM 评论者获得反馈——该评论者检查被标记与未被标记的代码，找出可能的误报与疑似漏报，无法访问任何真值标签；智能体据此修订查询。在 Python 版 OWASP Benchmark 上，SESAA 在 8 次独立运行中取得平均 F1 0.742，远高于五个广泛使用工具的默认配置，并与其中最强者在用 SESAA 从未接触过的真值标签调优后的结果相当。在真实 Python 项目的先导实验中，用漏洞引入之前的代码归纳出的规则检出了后续 19 个 CVE 中的 10 个，其中 9 个由为同一仓库编写的规则检出。最终产物是一组可执行、人类可读的查询，工程师可以检查、修改并独立运行。这些结果表明，LLM 智能体可以把静态分析规则维护从手工编写过程转变为自动化发现与修复的迭代过程。
summary_cn: LLM 智能体在无真值标签下自演化 Joern 检测规则：OWASP Benchmark（Python）8 次运行平均 F1 0.742，超 5 个常用工具默认配置；真实项目先导实验检出后续 19 个 CVE 中的 10 个。
objective_summary: 提出仅靠 LLM 评论者反馈（无真值标签）驱动 LLM 智能体从零演化可读 Joern 查询规则的 SESAA 框架，并在 OWASP Benchmark 与真实项目 CVE 时间线上评估检出能力。
evidence_note: 8 次独立运行报告平均 F1，与 5 个主流工具的默认及调优配置对比；真实项目实验用漏洞引入前代码归纳规则、检验后续 19 个 CVE，时间线控制严格；但主基准为 OWASP Benchmark、先导规模 19 个 CVE。
novelty_note: 「从零规则、仅评论者反馈的规则自演化」机制新颖，把规则维护变成自动化迭代过程，无标签条件下的自我修正闭环在该方向少见。
scope: 结论适用于 Python 生态与 Joern 可表达的漏洞类别；基准为 OWASP Benchmark（Python），先导实验限于真实 Python 项目。
limitations: 评论者反馈可能引入系统性偏置，无真值约束下的收敛性依赖模型质量
真实项目先导仅 19 个 CVE
查询演化的计算成本与运行开销未在摘要量化

title: When EVM Defaults Break: Three SDK Patterns for UTXO-Family Wallets
abstract: Mainstream Web3 SDKs (e.g., ethers.js, viem) bundle three coupled assumptions: an account-based ledger, a single secp256k1 signer, and input-selection-free transaction construction. These assumptions fail once a chain adopts an extended-UTXO model (here, the Cell model on Nervos CKB), and once the wallet population spans heterogeneous cryptographic primitives (secp256k1, WebAuthn, Schnorr). Using CKBers' Codebase (CCC), a TypeScript SDK, this retrospective case study extracts three recurring patterns from release history and exported APIs: a Transaction Composer that makes capacity-aware input completion and fee estimation declarative, a Unified Signer Abstraction that normalizes signing across heterogeneous wallets behind one interface, and a Connector UI component that ships per-wallet onboarding as a drop-in. The contribution is the articulation of these patterns as transferable design lessons for SDKs targeting UTXO-family ledgers and heterogeneous wallet populations.
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Poster paper at IEEE ICDLT 2026, Alcobaca, Portugal, December 3-4, 2026
title_cn: 当 EVM 默认假设失效时：面向 UTXO 系钱包的三种 SDK 模式
abstract_cn: 主流 Web3 SDK（如 ethers.js、viem）捆绑了三个耦合假设：账户模型账本、单一 secp256k1 签名器、以及无需输入选择的交易构造。一旦链采用扩展 UTXO 模型（此处指 Nervos CKB 的 Cell 模型），且钱包群体横跨异构密码学原语（secp256k1、WebAuthn、Schnorr），这些假设便会失效。本文利用 TypeScript SDK「CKBers' Codebase（CCC）」做回顾性案例研究，从发布历史与导出 API 中提炼出三种反复出现的模式：把容量感知的输入补全与费用估算声明化的 Transaction Composer；把异构钱包的签名行为归一到单一接口之后的 Unified Signer Abstraction；以及作为即插组件提供各钱包引导流程的 Connector UI。本文的贡献是将这些模式表述为面向 UTXO 系账本与异构钱包群体的 SDK 可迁移设计经验。
summary_cn: 从开源 SDK CCC 的发布史提炼面向扩展 UTXO 链与异构钱包的三种设计模式：声明化交易构造、统一签名器抽象、即插式钱包连接器。
objective_summary: 以 CCC SDK 为回顾性案例，分析 EVM 默认假设在扩展 UTXO 链与异构签名原语下失效的位置，并从发布历史与导出 API 提炼三种可迁移的 SDK 设计模式。
evidence_note: 单一 SDK 的回顾性案例研究，依据发布历史与 API 表面归纳模式，无定量评估；2 页 poster 论文（IEEE ICDLT 2026）。
novelty_note: 三种模式是对既有工程实践的命名与系统化，属经验整理而非新机制。
scope: 结论适用于扩展 UTXO（Cell 模型）账本与多签名原语钱包生态的 SDK 设计；对账户模型链不直接适用。
limitations: 单一 SDK 案例，可迁移性未在其他链上检验
无安全属性的定量评估

title: Detecting AI Training in Datacentre Power
abstract: AI governance agreements require methods to detect large model training runs on a monitored computing cluster, without trusting the operator. We develop a method to detect synchronous model training in facility-level power by Viterbi tracking of the wandering iteration cadence. On simulated datacentre power, when the operator makes no attempt to hide, the Viterbi tracker detects at least $96\%$ of training runs against a declared inference workload, at a $1\%$ false-alarm rate and within $0.04$ of the Neyman--Pearson optimum, given a meter that samples at $2$ Hz or faster. Of eight adversarial strategies an operator might use to hide, only extreme variation of the work per iteration evades the tracker. Its strongest form hides training in up to $73\%$ of five-minute observations, but over a day at least $87\%$ of such runs are still caught, at a $0.1\%$ false-alarm rate per run. This adversarial strategy costs no throughput, but in small-scale training the operator needs $93$--$267\%$ more compute to reach the same loss. A modest passive meter is sufficient to make hidden training both detectable and expensive, which makes power metering a promising part of compute verification that does not depend on trusting the operator.
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: 从数据中心电力中检测 AI 训练
abstract_cn: AI 治理协议需要在不信任运营者的前提下，检测受监控计算集群上发生的大模型训练。我们提出一种通过 Viterbi 跟踪漂移的迭代节奏（iteration cadence），在设施级电力信号中检测同步模型训练的方法。在模拟数据中心电力数据上，当运营者不做任何隐藏时，Viterbi 跟踪器在 1% 虚警率下检出至少 96% 的训练轮次（针对已声明的推理负载），且距 Neyman–Pearson 最优不超过 0.04，前提是电表采样率达到 2 Hz 或更快。在运营者可能使用的八种对抗隐藏策略中，只有极端改变每迭代工作量能躲过跟踪器：其最强形式可在最多 73% 的五分钟观测中隐藏训练，但在一天的时间尺度上，此类轮次仍有至少 87% 被检出（每轮次 0.1% 虚警率）。该对抗策略本身不损失吞吐量，但在小规模训练中，运营者需要多花 93–267% 的算力才能达到相同损失。一台适度的被动电表就足以让隐藏训练既可被检测又代价高昂，这使电力计量成为不依赖信任运营者的算力验证中颇具前景的组成部分。
summary_cn: 用 Viterbi 跟踪迭代节奏从设施级电力检测隐藏训练：不隐藏时 1% 虚警率检出≥96%（距 Neyman–Pearson 最优 0.04）；最强隐藏策略一日内仍 87% 被检出，小规模训练需多耗 93–267% 算力。
objective_summary: 提出基于迭代节奏 Viterbi 跟踪的设施级电力训练检测方法，在模拟数据中心电力上量化检出率与虚警率、评估八种运营者隐藏策略，并给出该策略的算力代价分析。
evidence_note: 在模拟数据中心电力上系统评估八种隐藏策略，报告检出率、虚警率与 Neyman–Pearson 最优差距；但数据为仿真而非真实机房，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「不信任运营者的训练检测」落到设施电力这一物理信号上，给出检测理论刻画与对抗策略代价分析，是该问题方向上的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于同步训练、电表采样率≥2 Hz 的设施级监测；基于模拟电力数据，真实机房的负载混合与噪声条件未验证。
limitations: 全部实验基于模拟电力数据，未在真实数据中心验证
极端改变每迭代工作量的策略可在五分钟尺度隐藏 73% 观测，需一日窗口才检出 87%
检测假设训练为同步节奏，异步或高度碎片化训练未覆盖

title: MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems
abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: MCP 与 CLI 之争：自主系统工具集成策略的比较分析
abstract_cn: AI 智能体需要接口来与文件、API、数据库和云服务等外部系统交互。目前出现了两种相互竞争的范式：CLI（命令行接口），智能体直接执行 shell 命令；MCP（Model Context Protocol），一种提供受治理、类型化工具访问的结构化 JSON-RPC 协议。本文从 14 个评估维度进行对比分析，辅以实例演算、依据既有合规框架的安全评估和经济建模。我们的分析表明，对于单用户、仅本地的场景，CLI 效率更高；而 MCP 能满足 CLI 从根本上无法满足的需求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。我们进一步考察渐进式披露技术如何消除 MCP 的历史弱点（上下文窗口开销），使其 token 效率与 CLI 相当，同时保留其架构优势。对生产系统我们推荐混合架构。本分析引用学术、政府和行业来源，包括 NSA 正式指南（CSI U/OO/6030316-26）、OWASP 安全标准以及 BCG 和 Gartner 的经济建模。
summary_cn: 从 14 个维度比较 CLI 与 MCP 两种智能体工具集成范式：CLI 适合单用户本地场景，MCP 提供访问控制、凭证隔离与审计等能力；渐进式披露可抹平 token 开销，生产建议混合架构。
objective_summary: 对 CLI 与 MCP 两种智能体工具集成范式做结构化比较分析，覆盖 14 个评估维度，结合合规框架评估与经济建模，讨论渐进式披露对 MCP 上下文开销的缓解，给出混合架构建议。

scope: 适用于单用户本地与多租户生产两种部署形态下智能体工具接口的选型讨论；不提供实现级性能基准数据。
limitations: 无自主实验数据，结论依赖公开来源与作者论证

title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
abstract: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules -> VX-One) over five days of CIC-IDS2017. Findings: (i) VX-One wins detection (AUROC/FPR@95%TPR) on UNSW-NB15 and under temporal drift on CIC-IDS2017 (0.711 vs 0.637), but XGBoost wins multi-class attribution on all three benchmarks; (ii) leave-one-family-out gate detects never-seen families on 9/9 UNSW folds yet drops below chance on CIC recon family, and abstention threshold transfers poorly across benchmarks; (iii) on payload-less reconstructions signature engines resolve ~0.1% of flows - gray zone ~99.9% of traffic, recovered by Phase 2 (combined recall >=0.978); (iv) calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04->0.40) for every method while ranking partially survives. We provide a measured account of where typed calibrated decisions help perimeter triage, and where they fail.
comment: 11 pages, 7 tables, 1 figure
title_cn: VX-One：面向实时边界分流的有类型校准决策头——未知攻击诚实性、级联灰色地带与漂移下校准的实证研究
abstract_cn: 边界分流面临时延/语义折中：签名引擎快且格式安全但对未见攻击失明，生成式模型有语义但慢且产生不可解析输出。2026 年末，一类商用 System One 决策模型（TypeSafe Jev；Microsoft-Decision-1）开始把有类型决策原语——二元门、闭集选择、序数评分——作为产品 API 出售，尚无学术研究。我们提出 VX-One：一个小型多头网络（10 万–1000 万参数），其输出正是这些原语——一个校准门、一个总含显式未知选项的闭集选择、一个序数评分，多任务训练、逐头温度校准（CPU 上约 0.7–1.7 毫秒 p50）。我们在 UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024 上与校准后的 XGBoost、随机森林、MLP、Kitsune 对比，并在五天 CIC-IDS2017 上测量 Suricata（52,674 条 Emerging-Threats 规则）到 VX-One 的两阶段级联。发现：（i）VX-One 在 UNSW-NB15 及 CIC-IDS2017 时间漂移下赢得检测（AUROC/FPR@95%TPR：0.711 vs 0.637），但 XGBoost 在全部三个基准上赢得多类归因；（ii）留一族交叉验证的门在 9/9 个 UNSW 折上检出从未见过的家族，却在 CIC recon 家族上低于随机，弃权阈值跨基准迁移差；（iii）在去载荷重构上签名引擎只解决约 0.1% 的流——灰色地带约占 99.9% 流量，由第二阶段恢复（合并召回 ≥0.978）；（iv）时间漂移下所有方法的校准都崩溃（ECE 0.04→0.40），而排序部分存活。我们给出有类型校准决策在边界分流中何处有用、何处失效的实测刻画。
summary_cn: VX-One 以三个有类型校准决策头（门/闭集含未知/序数分）做 CPU 实时边界分流：UNSW 与漂移下检测领先（0.711 vs 0.637）但多类归因不及 XGBoost，签名引擎灰色地带约 99.9%，漂移下所有方法 ECE 从 0.04 崩至 0.40。
objective_summary: 提出输出有类型决策原语的小型多头网络 VX-One，在三个公开基准与 Suricata 级联中测量其检测/归因/未知家族诚实性与漂移下校准表现，并与五个基线对比。
evidence_note: 三个公开基准+五天级联实验、五个基线对比、留一族与漂移设定，并如实报告失效（归因不及 XGBoost、ECE 崩溃）；无统计检验，11 页篇幅。
novelty_note: 把商用「有类型决策原语」引入 IDS 分流并加显式未知选项与弃权机制的组合较新；实证刻画（签名引擎灰色地带 99.9%、校准漂移崩溃）有诊断价值。
scope: 结论限于 UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024 与 Suricata 级联设置；弃权阈值跨基准迁移差的结论亦为实测之一。
limitations: 时间漂移下校准崩溃（ECE 0.04→0.40，作者自陈）；多类归因不敌 XGBoost；CIC recon 家族上门检出低于随机。

title: GhostFaceMPC: Privacy-Preserving Face Recognition with Multi-Party Computation
abstract: Facial recognition has become central to modern authentication systems, security frameworks, and personalized services. However, its widespread adoption is hindered by severe privacy risks, particularly surrounding unauthorized access to sensitive biometric data. To address these challenges, this paper presents GhostFaceMPC, the first end-to-end, privacy-preserving face recognition system to evaluate a deep convolutional neural network extractor and matching under secure multi-party computation. GhostFaceMPC enables secure processing of facial data across all stages of a face recognition process, from feature extraction and storage to matching, without exposing raw images or biometric embeddings at any stage. We introduce a multi-party computation-friendly quantization of the GhostFaceNet model and circuit optimizations that make face recognition under multi-party computation practical. The code is available at https://github.com/crypto-unict/GhostFaceMPC.
title_cn: GhostFaceMPC：基于多方计算的隐私保护人脸识别
abstract_cn: 人脸识别已成为现代认证系统、安全框架与个性化服务的核心，但其广泛采用受到严重隐私风险的阻碍，尤其是对敏感生物特征数据的未授权访问。为应对这些挑战，本文提出 GhostFaceMPC——首个在安全多方计算下评估深度卷积神经网络特征提取器与匹配的端到端隐私保护人脸识别系统。GhostFaceMPC 使人脸识别流程各阶段——从特征提取与存储到匹配——都能安全处理人脸数据，任何阶段都不暴露原始图像或生物特征嵌入。我们引入对 GhostFaceNet 模型的多方计算友好量化以及使 MPC 下人脸识别变得实用的电路优化。代码见 https://github.com/crypto-unict/GhostFaceMPC。
summary_cn: 首个端到端 MPC 人脸识别系统：GhostFaceNet 的 MPC 友好量化+电路优化，特征提取、存储与匹配全程不暴露原始图像或嵌入，代码已开源。
objective_summary: 构建首个在安全多方计算下完成 CNN 特征提取与匹配全流程的隐私保护人脸识别系统 GhostFaceMPC，含 MPC 友好量化与电路优化。
evidence_note: 端到端系统实现并开源代码；摘要未报告精度损失、通信量与运行时间的具体数字，评估细节不可见。
novelty_note: 首个在 MPC 下实现「深度 CNN 提取+匹配」端到端人脸识别的系统，把 MPC 人脸识别从仅匹配推进到覆盖特征提取，为该方向首个端到端。
scope: 结论限于 GhostFaceNet 类轻量 CNN 与所用 MPC 协议设置；不含活体检测等攻击面。
limitations: 摘要未给出精度/延迟/通信开销的量化数字；MPC 交互成本对大规模部署的可行性待验证；具体威胁模型（半诚实/恶意）未在摘要说明。

title: Free-XOR TFHE via Lazy Bootstrapping
abstract: Gate bootstrapping (GB) is a widely used technique in FHEW-like fully homomorphic encryption schemes, such as TFHE, for evaluating Boolean gates while simultaneously reducing the noise of the resulting ciphertext. However, the computational cost of GB is typically dominated by an expensive blind rotation (BR). \cite{chen2024free} proposed a gate bootstrapping framework in which $\txor$ gates can be evaluated simply by adding the two input ciphertexts, resulting in what they call \textit{free-XOR}. To obtain a functionally complete set of operations, they further designed a GB procedure for evaluating $\tand$ gates using two lightweight blind rotations. In this work, we propose a similar gate bootstrapping framework that supports free evaluation of $\txor$ gates while evaluating \textit{all symmetric binary Boolean gates}, i.e., the 8 gates whose output is identical for the inputs $(0,1)$ and $(1,0)$, using two blind rotations. In addition to providing broader gate support, our construction is substantially simpler than that of \cite{chen2024free}, both conceptually and in terms of implementation.
title_cn: 经由懒惰自举的免费 XOR TFHE
abstract_cn: 门自举（GB）是 FHEW 类全同态加密方案（如 TFHE）中广泛使用的技术，用于在求值布尔门的同时降低所得密文的噪声。然而，GB 的计算成本通常由昂贵的盲旋转（BR）主导。Chen 等人（2024）提出一个门自举框架，其中 XOR 门可以简单地将两个输入密文相加来求值，即所谓「免费 XOR」；为获得函数完备的运算集，他们进一步设计了使用两次轻量盲旋转求值 AND 门的 GB 流程。本工作提出一个类似的门自举框架：在支持免费求值 XOR 门的同时，用两次盲旋转求值全部对称二元布尔门，即输出在输入 (0,1) 与 (1,0) 下相同的 8 个门。除提供更广的门支持外，我们的构造在概念与实现两方面都比 Chen 等人的方案明显更简单。
summary_cn: 提出支持免费 XOR 且以两次盲旋转求值全部 8 个对称布尔门的 TFHE 门自举框架，构造比 Chen 等 2024 方案在概念与实现上均更简单。
objective_summary: 为 FHEW/TFHE 类方案设计同时支持免费 XOR 与两次盲旋转完成全部对称二元门求值的门自举框架，并简化 Chen 等 2024 框架的概念与实现。
evidence_note: 构造性工作，安全性沿用 TFHE 既有框架；摘要未报告具体性能基准数字，仅主张概念与实现简化。
novelty_note: 把免费 XOR 框架从 XOR+AND 扩展到全部对称布尔门并简化构造，属对已有框架（Chen 等 2024）的实质性扩展而非新路线。
scope: 结论限于 FHEW/TFHE 类方案的门自举；对称门集合之外的门仍需常规自举。
limitations: 摘要未给出与 Chen 等 2024 及标准 GB 的量化性能对比；只覆盖对称门集合；安全性依赖既有 TFHE 假设与参数。

title: Characterizing and Defending Utility-Hijacking in Instruction-Tuning Data Selection
abstract: Instruction-data selectors choose which instruction-following records are used for fine-tuning, improving alignment quality, raising training efficiency, and filtering out harmful records. A selector's choices thus directly affect the fine-tuned model's safety, yet despite their widespread use, the security of these selectors remains under-studied. We conduct the first systematic study of adaptive supplier-side attacks against utility-oriented instruction-data selectors and introduce utility-hijacking. Utility-hijacking shapes harmful records to remain compatible with a selector while preserving their malicious payload, causing top-k selection to concentrate rather than filter the poison. Achieving both is non-trivial, because optimizing a record for score tends to wash out its payload, while bluntly preserving the payload makes the record look low-value. Our generate-and-rerank procedure generates, per instruction, many payload-bearing candidates and submits only the highest-scoring survivor. Evaluated across three payloads (over-refusal, false-fact injection, and insecure code), six selectors, and victim models from Qwen2.5-7B to Qwen3-32B, utility-hijacking drives refusal from 0% to 94% and insecure code up to 56/90, while false-fact enrichment intensifies with scoring-model scale from 2.84x to 7.04x. To defend against this attack, we propose CONCERT, a targeted defense needing no content detector or poison labels. It flags suppliers selected far more often than chance allows, then re-selects under the same budget, keeping only records that two dissimilar selectors both rank highly. On a Qwen3-32B victim, CONCERT reverses the poison concentration from 6.67x to 0x (code) and 3.59x to 0.67x (facts), and reduces downstream harm by 100% and 75% respectively, at unchanged capability.

title_cn: 指令微调数据选择中的效用劫持：刻画与防御
abstract_cn: 指令数据选择器决定哪些指令遵循记录用于微调，以提升对齐质量、提高训练效率并过滤有害记录。因此选择器的选择直接影响微调后模型的安全性，尽管被广泛使用，这些选择器自身的安全性仍未被充分研究。我们首次系统研究针对效用导向指令数据选择器的自适应供应商侧攻击，并提出「效用劫持」：把有害记录塑形为与选择器兼容、同时保留其恶意载荷，使 top-k 选择集中而非过滤掉毒物。两者兼得并不容易：为得分优化记录往往会冲淡载荷，而粗放保留载荷又让记录显得低价值。我们的生成-重排流程对每条指令生成多个携带载荷的候选，只提交得分最高的幸存者。在三类载荷（过度拒绝、错误事实注入、不安全代码）、六个选择器与从 Qwen2.5-7B 到 Qwen3-32B 的受害模型上评估：效用劫持把拒绝率从 0% 推到 94%，不安全代码最高 56/90，错误事实富集随打分模型规模从 2.84 倍增强到 7.04 倍。为防御该攻击，我们提出 CONCERT：一个不需要内容检测器或毒物标签的定向防御。它标记被选中频率远超偶然水平的供应商，然后在同等预算下重选，只保留两个相异选择器都高排序的记录。在 Qwen3-32B 受害模型上，CONCERT 把毒物集中度从 6.67 倍逆转到 0（代码）、从 3.59 倍逆转到 0.67（事实），下游危害分别降低 100% 与 75%，能力不变。
summary_cn: 首个针对指令数据选择器的自适应投毒研究「效用劫持」：生成-重排使拒绝率 0%→94%、不安全代码至 56/90；防御 CONCERT 无需毒物标签，把毒物集中度逆转至 0–0.67 倍、危害降 75–100% 且能力不变。
objective_summary: 系统刻画针对效用导向指令数据选择器的自适应供应商侧投毒（效用劫持）并提出生成-重排攻击流程，同时给出基于供应商标记与双选择器交叉重选的防御 CONCERT。
evidence_note: 3 类载荷×6 选择器×Qwen2.5-7B 至 Qwen3-32B 多受害模型的系统实验，防御含集中度逆转与能力保持对比；攻击数据自建、无统计检验、未见录用信息。
novelty_note: 首次把指令数据「选择器」本身作为攻击面并定义效用劫持问题：得分兼容与载荷保留的张力及其生成-重排解法为实质性新攻击机制，配套防御亦新。
scope: 结论限于效用导向 top-k 选择器与所测 Qwen 系列受害模型；防御假设攻击者表现为可标记的供应商集中模式。
limitations: 对非效用导向或其他选择机制的适用性未验证；CONCERT 被分散化投毒策略规避的可能未评估；评估集中于 Qwen 系列。

title: Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents
abstract: Coding agents that run long enough must compact their context, summarizing the conversation, discarding the original, and carrying the summary forward as memory. We show that in popular open-source coding agents this step is an exploitable trust boundary. Harnesses that flatten the typed conversation into a single plain string, marking each message with a text label such as [User]:, destroy message provenance in code, before the summarizer runs. An attacker who controls anything the agent reads can forge a user turn that survives compaction as a genuine instruction. Across five flattening harnesses (pi, opencode, Cline, Aider, OpenHands) the forged approval launders into the agent's memory 87-100% of the time, up to a ~908,000-token context window; across four role-typed harnesses (Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Continue) the identical attack succeeds 0% of the time. We follow the attack to executed consequences. A laundered standing approval drives real tool-running agents to execute attacker-controlled curl | sh in a sandbox, and end to end in the live pi TUI at ~50% against a 0% paired clean arm. The same channel reliably steers an agent's plan away from a file an attacker designates off-limits, which can blind a code review to a planted backdoor. Because the provenance is destroyed deterministically in harness code, no prompt-level defense can restore it; we measure a code-level provenance check that catches 77% of laundering while demoting 2% of legitimate summary content. The defect also has a straightforward fix at the serializer, escaping the role labels before flattening; the role-typed harnesses avoid it entirely by keeping messages role-typed.

title_cn: 压缩洗白：上下文压缩编码智能体中的来源破坏
abstract_cn: 运行时间足够长的编码智能体必须压缩其上下文：总结对话、丢弃原文、把摘要作为记忆向前携带。我们证明，在流行的开源编码智能体中，这一步是一个可利用的信任边界。把类型化对话摊平成单个纯文本、用 [User]: 之类文本标签标注每条消息的 harness，会在代码中、在摘要器运行之前就破坏消息来源。控制智能体所读任何内容的攻击者可以伪造一条用户回合，使其作为「真实指令」在压缩后幸存。在五个摊平型 harness（pi、opencode、Cline、Aider、OpenHands）上，伪造批准以 87–100% 的比率被洗入智能体记忆，上下文窗口高达约 908,000 词元；在四个角色类型化 harness（Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Continue）上，同一攻击成功率为 0%。我们追踪该攻击直至执行的后果：一条被洗白的长期批准驱使真实执行工具的智能体在沙箱中执行攻击者控制的 curl | sh，并在真实 pi TUI 中端到端达到约 50% 的成功率（配对的干净对照组为 0%）。同一通道还能可靠地把智能体计划引离攻击者指定为禁区的文件，使代码审查对植入的后门视而不见。由于来源在 harness 代码中被确定性地破坏，任何提示级防御都无法恢复它；我们测量了一种代码级来源检查，可捕获 77% 的洗白、同时降级 2% 的合法摘要内容。该缺陷在序列化器处有直接修复——摊平前转义角色标签；角色类型化 harness 因保持消息角色类型而完全免于此问题。
summary_cn: 摊平对话的编码智能体在压缩前破坏消息来源，伪造批准在 5 个 harness 87–100% 洗入记忆并实测驱动执行 curl|sh（端到端约 50%，对照 0%）；角色类型化 harness 为 0%，序列化器转义即可修复。
objective_summary: 揭示摊平型编码智能体 harness 在上下文压缩时确定性销毁消息来源、使伪造用户指令洗白为记忆的攻击面，量化 9 个 harness 的成功率、端到端后果与代码级防御效果。
evidence_note: 9 个 harness 对照实验（摊平型 87–100% vs 角色类型化 0%）、沙箱与真实 pi TUI 端到端配对实验（约 50% vs 0%）、防御覆盖率量化（77% 捕获、2% 误降级）；源码、数据与演示公开。
novelty_note: 把上下文压缩识别为新的信任边界并命名「压缩洗白」：来源在代码层确定性销毁、提示级防御原理上无效这一结构性发现为该方向的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论区分摊平型与角色类型化两类 harness，限于开源编码智能体及其实测版本；攻击前提是攻击者能影响智能体读取的内容。
limitations: 代码级来源检查仅捕获 77% 且降级 2% 合法内容；未覆盖闭源商业 harness 的压缩实现；端到端演示集中于 pi 与沙箱环境。

title: Linear Self-Symmetries of Inverse-Based S-boxes: Generic Rigidity and Applications
abstract: Finite-field inversion is a basic nonlinear building block in the design of S-boxes for symmetric cryptography. In inverse-based S-boxes, finite-field inversion is often combined with linear or affine layers that may preserve or destroy algebraic symmetries of the inverse function. We study how often nontrivial linear self-symmetries remain as the outer invertible linear transformation varies over \(GL_n(\mathbb F_2)\). Using the classification of two-sided linear equivalences of inversion, we reduce the problem to semilinear conjugacy and centralizer estimates. We obtain matching upper and lower bounds for the probability that a nontrivial linear self-symmetry remains, and these bounds determine its leading quadratic exponent. This exponent is governed by the smallest prime divisor of the extension degree. Thus the decay rate depends on the arithmetic of the field extension and not only on its dimension. As cryptographic applications, we provide a practical rigidity criterion, prove that the full AES S-box has no nontrivial linear self-symmetry, and illustrate the broader relevance of the framework through ARIA and Vision.
title_cn: 逆函数类 S-box 的线性自对称：一般刚性及应用
abstract_cn: 有限域求逆是对称密码 S-box 设计中的基本非线性构件。在逆函数类 S-box 中，有限域求逆常与线性或仿射层组合，这些层可能保留或破坏逆函数的代数对称性。我们研究当外层可逆线性变换遍历 GL_n(F_2) 时，非平凡线性自对称保留下来的频率。利用求逆的双侧线性等价分类，我们把问题归约为半线性共轭与中心化子估计。我们得到非平凡线性自对称保留概率的匹配上下界，这些界决定了其首项二次指数。该指数由扩张次数的最小素因子支配，因此衰减速率取决于域扩张的算术性质而不仅是维度。作为密码学应用，我们给出一个实用的刚性判据，证明完整 AES S-box 没有非平凡线性自对称，并通过 ARIA 与 Vision 展示该框架更广的相关性。
summary_cn: 刻画逆函数类 S-box 线性自对称随外层线性变换保留的概率：给出匹配上下界，衰减指数由扩张次数最小素因子决定；据此证明 AES S-box 无非平凡线性自对称并给出实用刚性判据。
objective_summary: 研究逆函数类 S-box 在随机外层线性变换下保留非平凡线性自对称的概率，给出匹配上下界与算术依赖刻画，并推导设计用刚性判据及 AES/ARIA/Vision 的验证。
evidence_note: 理论论文：基于双侧线性等价分类给出匹配上下界（紧结果）与首项指数刻画，并落实到 AES/ARIA/Vision 具体验证，证明链完整。
novelty_note: 对该性质的首个系统化概率刻画并揭示其由扩张次数最小素因子支配的算术结构；应用为刚性判据与已知 S-box 的验证，未攻破任何方案，属结构性理论贡献。
scope: 结论限于逆函数类 S-box 与 GL_n(F_2) 外层线性变换；不覆盖其他代数结构弱点或仿射以外的层。
limitations: 仅刻画线性自对称这一类对称性；应用示例限于 AES/ARIA/Vision；刚性判据对新方案设计的实际效果待检验。

title: Do Flow-Generation Tools Matter? Unsupervised Characterization of MQTT Traffic Across Public Datasets
abstract: Message Queue Telemetry Transport (MQTT) is widely used in IoT environments due to its lightweight publish-subscribe design and suitability for resource-constrained networks. While current MQTT security studies mainly focus on detecting attacks and optimizing classification performance, this work takes a different perspective by presenting a cross-dataset, tool-aware characterization of MQTT traffic at the flow level. This perspective is motivated by the fact that flow-generation is tool-dependent: flows are not directly observed in packet captures, but are constructed through tool-specific decisions about packet grouping, flow termination, and feature export. Using packet captures from 4 public MQTT datasets, we generated over 380K flows with 3 open-access flow-generation tools: Zeek-flowmeter, Argus, and NTLFlowLyzer. We analyzed the tool-specific flows using K-means, DBSCAN, and HDBSCAN, with and without PCA-based dimensionality reduction. We measured clustering quality using 2 metrics: (1) Silhouette score to assess label-independent cluster compactness and separation, and (2) Adjusted Rand Index to measure agreement with available labels. Our results show that the choice of flow-generation tool affects the resulting flow population, feature-space structure, and clustering behavior. Zeek-flowmeter achieves the best performance in several settings, particularly with K-means and PCA reduction to 10 components. Yet, no single tool consistently dominates across all datasets, algorithms, and evaluation metrics. These findings show that flow-level MQTT analysis should treat the dataset, flow-generation tool, preprocessing choices, clustering algorithm, and evaluation metric as interconnected experimental factors.

title_cn: 流生成工具重要吗？跨公开数据集的 MQTT 流量无监督刻画
abstract_cn: 消息队列遥测传输（MQTT）凭借轻量的发布-订阅设计与对资源受限网络的适配而在物联网环境中广泛使用。当前 MQTT 安全研究主要聚焦攻击检测与分类性能优化，本工作采取不同视角：对流级 MQTT 流量做跨数据集、工具感知的刻画。该视角的动机是流生成依赖工具：流并非在抓包中直接可见，而是通过对分组归组、流终止与特征导出的工具特定决策构建而成。我们使用来自 4 个公开 MQTT 数据集的抓包，用 3 个开放获取的流生成工具（Zeek-flowmeter、Argus、NTLFlowLyzer）生成超过 38 万条流，并用 K-means、DBSCAN 与 HDBSCAN（含/不含基于 PCA 的降维）分析工具特定流。我们用两个指标衡量聚类质量：（1）轮廓系数评估与标签无关的簇紧凑性与分离度；（2）调整兰德指数衡量与可用标签的一致性。结果表明，流生成工具的选择会影响所得流总体、特征空间结构与聚类行为。Zeek-flowmeter 在若干设置下表现最好，尤其是 K-means 与 PCA 降至 10 个主成分时；但没有任何单一工具在所有数据集、算法与评估指标上一致占优。这些发现表明，流级 MQTT 分析应把数据集、流生成工具、预处理选择、聚类算法与评估指标视为相互关联的实验因素。
summary_cn: 用 3 种工具在 4 个公开 MQTT 数据集生成 38 万+ 条流做无监督对比：工具选择显著影响流总体与聚类行为，Zeek-flowmeter 部分设置占优但无工具全面领先。
objective_summary: 跨 4 个公开数据集、3 种流生成工具与 3 种聚类算法，系统刻画流生成工具决策对 MQTT 流级分析中流总体、特征结构与聚类结果的影响。
evidence_note: 38 万+ 流、3 工具×4 数据集×3 算法（±PCA）的因子化实验，轮廓系数与调整兰德指数双指标；无统计显著性检验，标签来自数据集自带。
novelty_note: 对「流生成工具影响下游安全分析」这一常被忽略的因素在 MQTT 无监督场景给出有诊断价值的系统量化，修正把流特征当作客观观测的惯常做法。
scope: 结论限于 MQTT 流量与所测 4 个数据集、3 个工具及无监督聚类视角。
limitations: 无监督指标与真实攻击检测性能的关联未直接评估；数据集标签质量不一；结论向其他协议的外推未验证。

title: Location-of-interest vs. Current-location Privacy in Multi-hop Communication
abstract: Consider a standard multi-hop wireless radio network in which nodes relay messages for one another. While the contents of messages may be sensitive and thus encrypted, the very fact that two radios communicated can leak sensitive information about both the physical location of the origin and the physical location of the destination. We investigate the trade-off between protecting the privacy of a user's current location and the privacy of their location of interest, and how the user should choose dummy destinations to obfuscate their queries.

title_cn: 多跳通信中的兴趣位置与当前位置隐私
abstract_cn: 考虑一个标准的多跳无线电台网络，节点为中继彼此的消息。虽然消息内容可能敏感并因此被加密，但两台电台曾经通信这一事实本身就可能泄露发起点与目的地点物理位置双方的敏感信息。我们研究保护用户当前位置的隐私与保护其兴趣位置（location of interest）隐私之间的折中，以及用户应如何选择哑目的地来混淆其查询。
summary_cn: 刻画多跳无线网络中「当前位置」与「兴趣位置」两类隐私的折中，并给出用户选择哑目的地混淆查询的策略。
objective_summary: 分析多跳无线网络中通信关系对发起点与目的地位置的泄露，研究当前位置隐私与兴趣位置隐私间的折中及哑目的地选择策略。
evidence_note: 以多跳无线网络模型上的分析为主（36 页）；摘要未报告实验或部署验证，证明与界的细节不可见。
