title_cn: NIOCIS：面向工具使用智能体的类型化决策下一跳路由与节点条件选项空间
abstract_cn: 工具使用智能体按决策付费：每一跳都要让语言模型重读状态并思考数秒，而其动作是有限的、决策是重复的。我们提出 NIOCIS，一个路由层：把执行日志折叠为环坍缩的动作图（前向转移加恢复回边），回答一个类型化问题——在某一状态下，机群下一步会选择哪个已声明的选项或停止？小模型一次前向读取校准过的选项分布，不产生任何文本。在 1,615 个生产安全运营 episode 上测量该层替代了什么、返回什么、受什么约束。替代：类型化编码器在 3,875 个留出决策的 32.2% 上匹配日志中的下一跳（在已声明选项内为 34.9%），编码耗时 10 ms（类型化选择形式 19.5 ms），而 LLM 每跳 2.2 s；两个特征读出分别达 32.8% 与 32.3%，配对检验无法分辨其排序，故选择类型化层是出于成本而非显著领先。调优：jpt-4b 零样本 9.9%、微调后 31.9%，该差距经精确配对检验不显著（p=0.68），耗时 244 ms。回报有限：7.9% 的决策实际下一跳落在已声明选项之外，9.3% 落在模型前二十之外；置信度最高的 15% 持有 91.9% 准确率。受限：跨轨迹留一测试把已发布状态的 ceiling 定在 25.6–44.9%——状态键越具体，重复状态间不一致越频繁；选项空间消融把增益归于按节点候选限制（较平坦目录 +3.5 点）而非图遍历（区间内为零）；门控自进化循环把各臂抬过锚点但低于全监督；当升级臂为零样本替身时置信门控级联失去一致性；而超过三分之一机群的一致性需要状态携带计划与观测。
summary_cn: 在 1,615 个生产安全运营 episode 上评估小模型路由层替代 LLM 跳：匹配 32.2% 下一跳、10 ms 对 2.2 s，但状态天花板仅 25.6–44.9%、7.9% 决策超出已声明选项，增益主要来自按节点候选限制。
objective_summary: 构建把执行日志折叠为动作图的路由层，用小模型输出类型化选项分布，量化其对 LLM 跳的替代率、成本与状态可预测性上限。
evidence_note: 生产级 1,615 个 episode、3,875 个留出决策、精确配对检验、多组消融与上限分析；单数据域、单小模型家族。
novelty_note: 用小模型与图先验替代 LLM 路由的思路已有，贡献为生产数据上的严格量化（含多项负面结论）。
scope: 结论适用于该安全运营 episode 分布与被测模型；其他任务域、更大状态空间与多机群部署未覆盖。
limitations: 约 32% 的匹配率远未达完全替代水平；状态表示决定上限；自进化与级联方案未达全监督水平。

title: Auditor-Assisted Summary-Channel Verification for Hosted LLM Identity Substitution
abstract: Hosted LLM services increasingly expose model identity as a product claim, but external users and auditors often cannot inspect which model configuration served a request. We study an auditor-assisted regime in which a trusted auditor enrolls claimed identities and prepares verification material before deployment, while audit-time verification uses only the claimed identity and released output, without runtime access to model internals, inference logs, routing decisions, or provider metadata. We propose SUMMARK, a summary-channel watermarking framework that uses user-visible reasoning summaries as a keyed audit surface. During setup, SUMMARK constructs identity-specific vocabulary carriers, trains lightweight summary adapters, and calibrates per-identity thresholds. At deployment time, a keyed statistical test assesses whether the released summary is consistent with the claimed identity and, when needed, attributes the most likely enrolled identity. Across model families, scales, and task domains, SUMMARK reliably detects cross-family and cross-scale substitutions at low false-positive rates while preserving task-facing answer quality. We further study FP16->INT8/INT4 precision-consistency diagnostics and robustness under bounded post-processing, rewriting stress tests, and text-only spoofing, revealing both strong performance and clear failure boundaries. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/trinitr0toluene/Summark.

title_cn: 审计者辅助的摘要信道验证：面向托管 LLM 身份替换
abstract_cn: 托管 LLM 服务日益把模型身份作为产品声明暴露，但外部用户与审计者往往无法检查哪个模型配置服务了请求。我们研究一个审计者辅助的场景：可信审计者在部署前登记声称的身份并准备验证材料，而审计时验证只使用声称身份与公开输出——不访问运行时模型内部、推理日志、路由决策或提供商元数据。我们提出 SUMMARK，一个摘要信道水印框架，把用户可见的推理摘要作为带密钥的审计面。建立阶段，SUMMARK 构造身份特定的词汇载体、训练轻量摘要适配器并校准每身份阈值；部署时，带密钥的统计检验评估公开摘要是否与声称身份一致，需要时归因最可能的已登记身份。跨模型家族、规模与任务域，SUMMARK 在低假阳性率下可靠检测跨家族与跨规模替换，同时保持面向任务的答案质量。我们进一步研究 FP16 到 INT8/INT4 的精度一致性诊断，以及在有界后处理、改写压力测试与纯文本欺骗下的鲁棒性，展示强性能与清晰的失效边界。代码公开。
summary_cn: 提出 SUMMARK：把推理摘要作为带密钥审计面做托管 LLM 身份替换检测，部署前登记+部署后仅凭输出验证；跨家族/跨规模替换可靠检出、低假阳性，并给出量化与改写压力下的失效边界（NeurIPS 2026 录用）。
objective_summary: 设计无需运行时内部访问的摘要信道水印验证框架，建立身份词汇载体与统计检验，评估替换检测、精度迁移鲁棒性与抗欺骗能力。
evidence_note: 跨家族/规模/任务系统评估、低假阳性检测、后处理/改写/欺骗多种鲁棒性压力测试、NeurIPS 2026 录用、代码公开。
novelty_note: 水印与模型指纹方向已有大量工作，「推理摘要作为审计信道+审计者辅助设定」是新的场景化机制。
scope: 结论适用于暴露推理摘要的托管服务与已登记身份集合；不输出摘要的服务、开放身份归因与强自适应对手未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖服务暴露推理摘要这一产品形态；需可信审计者参与登记；对抗性摘要伪造仅测了文本级欺骗。

title: RAGLeak: Supply-Chain Privacy Backdoors in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to access external knowledge during inference, but its reliance on external knowledge bases also introduces new attack surfaces. Existing data extraction attacks against RAG systems rely on either prompt injection, which heavily depends on the generator's instruction-following capability, or backdoors that reproduce or paraphrase retrieved documents but struggle to balance extraction fidelity and stealthiness. In this paper, we propose RAGLeak, a supply-chain privacy backdoor attack that decouples information leakage from direct textual exposure. When triggered, the generator reversibly obfuscates retrieved private documents for high-fidelity recovery by an auxiliary LLM. Across three model families and three application domains, RAGLeak achieves up to $100\%$ ASR with limited impact on benign utility and at most a $10$-percentage-point ASR drop under representative detection-based defenses. The backdoor remains effective after clean fine-tuning and across model scales and versions, revealing an underexplored supply-chain privacy risk in RAG systems. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAGLeak-4B67.
title_cn: RAGLeak：检索增强生成中的供应链隐私后门
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大语言模型能在推理时访问外部知识，但其对外部知识库的依赖也引入新攻击面。针对 RAG 系统的既有数据提取攻击依赖提示注入（高度依赖生成器的指令遵循能力）或复现与改写被检索文档的后门，难以兼顾提取保真度与隐蔽性。本文提出 RAGLeak，一个把信息泄露与直接文本暴露解耦的供应链隐私后门攻击：被触发时，生成器对检索到的私密文档做可逆混淆，供辅助 LLM 高保真恢复。在三个模型家族与三个应用领域上，RAGLeak 达到最高 100% 的攻击成功率，对良性效用影响有限，且在代表性检测类防御下 ASR 至多下降 10 个百分点；后门在干净微调后依然有效，并跨模型规模与版本保持有效，揭示了 RAG 系统中一个未被充分研究的供应链隐私风险。
summary_cn: 提出 RAGLeak 供应链隐私后门：触发后生成器可逆混淆检索到的私密文档供辅助 LLM 恢复，三家族三领域上 ASR 至 100%、检测防御下至多降 10 点、干净微调后仍有效。
objective_summary: 设计把泄露与直接暴露解耦的 RAG 隐私后门，量化其成功率、效用损失、抗检测防御与抗干净微调能力。
evidence_note: 三个模型家族、三个应用领域、检测防御与干净微调的鲁棒性测试、代码匿名公开；无统计检验、触发依赖训练管道。
novelty_note: 「可逆混淆而非复现」的泄露通道与供应链投毒场景是新的威胁向量，与既有提取后门有实质差异。
scope: 结论适用于被测 RAG 栈与三个领域；对语料完整性校验、检索隔离等非检测类防御未评估。
limitations: 需在生成器训练阶段植入后门（供应链前提）；混淆文本可能被人工巡检发现；多后门共存与更大规模部署未测。

title: Secure Agentic Coding through Counterexample-Grounded Feedback
abstract: As coding models and agent harnesses become more capable, reliable security verification is becoming a central bottleneck. Improving secure code generation requires a signal whose reported progress remains aligned with actual program behavior under optimization; otherwise, an optimizer can improve the signal's verdict without removing the underlying vulnerability. Existing model-based approaches require models to either infer program behavior from source code or specify correct outcomes for adversarial tests, placing substantial reasoning demands on the security signal. We introduce \falcon{}, a counterexample-grounded verification framework that separates attack exploration from behavioral verification and connects them through execution traces of the program under test. In test-time repair, \falcon{} yields substantially stronger held-out functional-security gains than alternative security signals across secure code generation benchmarks, while preserving or improving functionality. As an RL reward, \falcon{} also outperforms static-analysis and learned rewards on held-out functional-security, even when all policies successfully optimize their respective training rewards. Combining \falcon{} with either proxy reward further improves held-out performance, suggesting that execution-grounded feedback can mitigate reward overoptimization while preserving useful guidance from existing security signals.
title_cn: 通过反例接地反馈实现安全的智能体编码
abstract_cn: 随着编码模型与智能体框架能力增强，可靠的安全验证正成为核心瓶颈。改进安全代码生成需要一个在优化下其报告进展仍与实际程序行为保持一致的信号；否则优化器可以在不移除底层漏洞的情况下改善信号的判定。既有基于模型的方法要求模型从源码推断程序行为、或为对抗性测试指定正确结果，对安全信号施加了很重的推理负担。我们提出 FALCON，一个反例接地的验证框架：把攻击探索与行为验证分离，并通过被测程序的执行轨迹连接二者。在测试时修复中，FALCON 在多个安全代码生成基准上取得比替代安全信号强得多的留出功能-安全增益，同时保持或改善功能。作为 RL 奖励，即使所有策略都成功优化了各自的训练奖励，FALCON 在留出功能-安全上也优于静态分析与学习式奖励。把 FALCON 与任一代理奖励结合可进一步提升留出表现，表明执行接地反馈能缓解奖励过优化、同时保留既有安全信号的有用引导。
summary_cn: 提出 FALCON 反例接地验证框架：攻击探索与执行轨迹行为验证分离，作为修复信号与 RL 奖励均在留出功能-安全上显著优于静态分析与学习式奖励，并能缓解奖励过优化。
objective_summary: 设计以执行轨迹连接攻击探索与行为验证的安全验证框架，在测试时修复与 RL 训练两种用法下与替代安全信号比较留出泛化。
evidence_note: 多基准、多信号对比、留出评估与奖励过优化分析；摘要未给具体数字与模型规模、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 执行接地验证承袭动态验证方向，与 RL 奖励结合并系统比较过优化是实质性改进。
scope: 结论适用于被测代码生成基准与模型；需要复杂环境交互或不可达路径的漏洞类别未覆盖。
limitations: 执行验证依赖可运行环境与可触发测试；框架细节与数字摘要未报告；RL 训练成本高。

title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
abstract: As jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) become increasingly diverse, red-teaming has come to rely on large libraries of jailbreak prompts and attack strategies to evaluate the robustness of victim models and their defense settings. However, attack effectiveness is highly condition-dependent: an attack that succeeds under one victim-defense setting may fail under another, while exhaustively evaluating the full attack library for each setting incurs substantial token and monetary costs. This motivates studying how jailbreak attacks should be prioritized under a limited attempt budget for efficient robustness evaluation. In this work, we formalize this problem as budgeted attack scheduling over a fixed attack library and investigate three complementary signals under a fixed victim-defense condition: (1) static historical attack success rate (ASR) priors; (2) semantic guidance from LLMs; and (3) online feedback from earlier queries. Building on these signals, we design four scheduling strategies and evaluate them across three victim models and three defense settings on GPT-5.2. Extensive experiments clearly characterize the conditions under which each signal is most effective. Historical ASR provides a strong initialization, but its reliability degrades under defense-induced distribution shifts. Semantic guidance consistently improves or matches static prior-based scheduling in the cold-start regime, while online feedback becomes particularly valuable when transferred priors become stale. Semantic guidance and online feedback can also partially compensate for missing historical priors. Taken together, these findings characterize budgeted red-teaming as an attack scheduling problem in which historical priors, semantic guidance, and online feedback play complementary roles.

title_cn: LLM 红队的预算化攻击调度：静态先验、语义引导与在线反馈的角色
abstract_cn: 随着针对大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击日益多样，红队测试依赖庞大的越狱提示与攻击策略库来评估受害模型及其防御设置的鲁棒性。但攻击有效性高度依赖条件：在同一受害-防御设置下成功的攻击换一个设置可能失败，而对每个设置穷举整个攻击库会产生可观的令牌与资金成本。这引出问题：在有限尝试预算下应如何为越狱攻击排序以高效评估鲁棒性。本工作把该问题形式化为固定攻击库上的预算化攻击调度，并在固定受害-防御条件下研究三种互补信号：(1) 静态历史攻击成功率（ASR）先验；(2) 来自 LLM 的语义引导；(3) 来自先前查询的在线反馈。基于这些信号设计四种调度策略，在 GPT-5.2 上跨三个受害模型与三个防御设置评估。大量实验清晰刻画了各信号最有效的条件：历史 ASR 提供强初始化，但在防御引起的分布漂移下可靠性退化；语义引导在冷启动情形持续改进或持平基于静态先验的调度；当迁移先验过时，在线反馈价值尤为突出；语义引导与在线反馈还能部分补偿历史先验缺失。综合来看，这些发现把预算化红队刻画为一个攻击调度问题：历史先验、语义引导与在线反馈在其中扮演互补角色。
summary_cn: 把有限预算下的越狱评估形式化为攻击调度问题：历史 ASR 先验强但随防御漂移退化，语义引导改善冷启动，在线反馈在先验过时时最有价值；GPT-5.2 上三模型×三防御验证四策略。
objective_summary: 形式化预算化攻击调度，设计基于历史 ASR、语义引导与在线反馈的四种调度策略，并在多模型多防御设置下刻画各信号的适用条件。
evidence_note: 三个受害模型×三个防御设置、四种调度策略的系统比较、结论条件化明确；单平台（GPT-5.2 系）、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把红队预算分配作为调度问题系统研究是新的问题形式化；所用信号与策略本身常规。
scope: 结论适用于固定攻击库与 GPT-5.2 系被测模型及三种防御；跨模型家族泛化与自适应攻击库构建未覆盖。
limitations: 历史先验依赖可比条件的历史数据；语义引导依赖 LLM 判别质量；防御设置仅三种且静态。

title: PQC Migration of IPsec: Reliable Composite Key Sharing Mechanisms in IKEv2
abstract: The threat of quantum computers breaking classical cryptographic is accelerating the adoption of quantum- resistant cryptographic algorithms. Several government agencies have set a tight time-line for upgradation of all system to support post quantum cryptographs. We study post-quantum migration of IPSec protocols and their impact on network performance. The large key lengths in Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) cannot fit in a single IP packet leading to IP fragmentation. This can cause failure of security associations and degrade performance of IKEv2 under poor network conditions. To tackle this problem, we study a new key- sharing mechanism for IKEv2 and evaluate its performance. Unlike current hybrid key-sharing approaches, which send the classical and quantum keys sequentially over UDP or TCP (as in RFC 9370), the new approach concatenates them into a single composite key and transport them over TCP to ensure a reliable handshake. We implement and benchmark the new composite key-sharing handshake mechanism against existing hybrid algorithms that use either UDP or TCP. Extensive experiments under various network conditions demonstrate that the new approach significantly improves handshake time and energy consumption by avoiding the severe retransmission penalties of the Hybrid handshake mechanism. At 1% packet loss, the handshake time of composite key sharing mechanism is better by atleast 20% than hybrid mechanisms, and the improve- ment get better with higher packet loss reaching 30% at 10% packet loss. Energy consumption follows the same pattern achieving reduction of 29% at 10% packet loss
title_cn: IPsec 的后量子迁移：IKEv2 中的可靠复合密钥共享机制
abstract_cn: 量子计算机破解经典密码的威胁正在加速抗量子密码算法的采用。多个政府机构已为全部系统升级支持后量子密码设定紧凑时间表。我们研究 IPSec 协议的后量子迁移及其对网络性能的影响。后量子密码（PQC）的大密钥长度无法装入单个 IP 包，导致 IP 分片，可能造成安全关联失败并在恶劣网络条件下降低 IKEv2 性能。针对该问题，我们研究一种新的 IKEv2 密钥共享机制并评估其性能。不同于现有以 UDP 或 TCP 顺序发送经典与量子密钥的混合方案（如 RFC 9370），新方法把二者拼接为单一复合密钥并经 TCP 传输以保证可靠握手。我们实现新的复合密钥共享握手机制，并与使用 UDP 或 TCP 的既有混合算法基准对比。多种网络条件下的大量实验表明，新方法通过避免混合握手机制的严重重传惩罚，显著改善握手时间与能耗：1% 丢包时握手时间比混合机制至少好 20%，丢包越高改善越大，10% 丢包时达 30%；能耗呈同样趋势，10% 丢包时降低 29%。
summary_cn: 研究 IKEv2 后量子迁移：把经典与 PQC 密钥拼接为复合密钥经 TCP 传输，1% 丢包握手时间优于 RFC 9370 式混合方案至少 20%（10% 丢包达 30%），能耗降 29%。
objective_summary: 分析 PQC 大密钥导致的 IP 分片对 IKEv2 的影响，提出并实现复合密钥 TCP 握手机制，与 UDP/TCP 混合方案在不同丢包率下基准对比。
evidence_note: 实现与多种网络条件的基准对比、量化握手时间与能耗；无复合方案的独立安全证明、实验为受控环境。
novelty_note: 复合密钥与 TCP 传输属工程性改进；PQC 迁移测量有实用参考价值。
scope: 结论适用于 IKEv2/IPsec 与被测 PQC 参数集及丢包条件；其他协议（TLS/SSH）与真实广域网未覆盖。
limitations: 复合密钥方案的密码学安全论证未展开；实验网络为受控环境；更深丢包下 TCP 队头阻塞的表现未讨论。

title: Towards Architectural-Level Safety Control: Relocating Hazardous Knowledge into Removable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models
abstract: Large language models acquire broad knowledge from web-scale corpora during pretraining, including knowledge that could be hazardous if misused. Removing such knowledge from the model itself without degrading general capability is desirable but difficult, as it is deeply entangled with general capability within the same parameters. Existing safety alignment and unlearning methods typically adjust these shared parameters, tending to suppress the expression of hazardous knowledge rather than remove it. As a result, the knowledge remains in the model and is readily recoverable by subsequent fine-tuning. To address this limitation, we propose REX (Relocating into Removable EXperts), a knowledge relocation method that separates hazardous knowledge from general capability at the architectural level. Exploiting the modular structure of Mixture-of-Experts models, REX expands the model with a set of new, physically removable experts designated to hold hazardous knowledge. Through expert expansion, selective gradient masking and routing differentiation, it relocates hazardous knowledge out of the original experts and concentrates it in the new ones. Excising these new experts yields a model suitable for public release. This removal holds consistently across Intern-S2, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B; on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, for instance, excision lowers WMDP-Bio accuracy by 48.4 points while MMLU changes by less than 3 points. The excised model matches the strongest of nine unlearning baselines in removing hazardous knowledge, and it is the only one that preserves this removal under subsequent fine-tuning. After 250M tokens of standard fine-tuning on Qwen3.5, the best baseline rebounds on WMDP-Bio from 44.1% to 78.3%, whereas REX rises only from 32.4% to 42.8%.
title_cn: 迈向架构级安全控制：把有害知识迁移到 MoE 模型中可移除的专家
abstract_cn: 大语言模型在预训练中从网络级语料获得广泛知识，其中包含一旦被滥用即危险的知识。在不损害通用能力的前提下从模型本身移除此类知识是理想但困难的：它与通用能力在相同参数中深度纠缠。既有安全对齐与遗忘方法通常调整这些共享参数，倾向于抑制有害知识的表达而非移除它；结果是知识仍留在模型中，可被后续微调轻易恢复。针对这一局限，我们提出 REX（Relocating into Removable EXperts），一种在架构层面把有害知识与通用能力分离的知识迁移方法。利用混合专家（MoE）模型的模块结构，REX 以一组新的、物理可移除的专家扩展模型，专门存放有害知识；通过专家扩展、选择性梯度掩码与路由分化，把有害知识从原专家迁移并集中到新专家。切除这些新专家即得到适合公开发布的模型。该移除在 Intern-S2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 上一致成立：以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 为例，切除使 WMDP-Bio 准确率下降 48.4 个点而 MMLU 变化小于 3 个点。切除模型在移除有害知识上匹敌九个遗忘基线中最强者，并且是唯一在后续微调下保持移除效果的：在 Qwen3.5 上 2.5 亿 token 标准微调后，最佳基线在 WMDP-Bio 上从 44.1% 反弹到 78.3%，而 REX 仅从 32.4% 升到 42.8%。
summary_cn: 提出 REX：在 MoE 中新增物理可移除专家承载有害知识，经扩展/梯度掩码/路由分化迁移集中；切除后 WMDP-Bio 降 48.4 点、MMLU 变动小于 3 点，且 2.5 亿 token 微调后仅回升至 42.8%（最佳基线反弹至 78.3%）。
objective_summary: 设计利用 MoE 模块性的知识迁移方法，把有害知识集中到可移除专家，在三个 MoE 模型上量化切除的知识移除量、通用能力损失与抗微调恢复性。
evidence_note: 三个 MoE 模型、九个遗忘基线对比、2.5 亿 token 微调的鲁棒性测试、WMDP/MMLU 标准基准与具体数字。
novelty_note: 「架构级可移除专家」对参数纠缠问题提供实质新机制，唯一在微调后保持移除的结果有分量。
scope: 结论适用于 MoE 架构与 WMDP 类知识基准；稠密模型不适用；对交互式滥用能力与更强恢复攻击未评估。
limitations: 依赖 MoE 结构且需专家扩展训练；知识移除以 WMDP 类基准衡量、覆盖面有限；超出标准微调的对抗性恢复未测。

title: When Care Expands and Control Declines: Understanding Digital Privacy in End-of-Life Care
abstract: Terminally ill patients generate extensive digital health data through hospital portals, physiological monitoring devices, consumer health applications, and end-of-life care platforms. Yet their ability to control this data is systematically undermined by the structural conditions of terminal care. Through semi-structured in-depth interviews with 21 terminally ill patients, 11 family caregivers, and 8 physicians recruited from tertiary hospitals, this study examines the digital privacy circumstances and subjective attitudes of patients in end-of-life contexts. Thematic analysis reveals five structural dimensions of digital privacy challenge: continuous bodily digitization without meaningful informed consent; cognitive decline driving involuntary proxy control of accounts; inferential data generation exceeding patients' epistemic boundaries; dissolution of individual privacy boundaries amid relational network restructuring; and the absence of institutional governance over post-mortem data. Patient privacy attitudes span three profiles: fundamental absence of privacy awareness, sustained active management under severe tool constraints, and perception of problems followed by resigned abandonment. Interviews with caregivers and physicians reveal benevolent substitution in the name of care needs, expansion of access beyond the initial task, and unresolved boundaries under absent institutional guidance. These findings reveal a compounding privacy vulnerability unique to end-of-life contexts and call for privacy-by-design principles, granular permission mechanisms, and institutional governance frameworks tailored to the needs of dying patients.

title_cn: 当关怀扩展而控制萎缩：理解临终关怀中的数字隐私
abstract_cn: 终末期患者通过医院门户、生理监测设备、消费级健康应用与临终关怀平台产生大量数字健康数据，但其对这些数据的控制能力被临终关怀的结构性条件系统性削弱。本研究通过对三甲医院招募的 21 名终末期患者、11 名家庭照护者与 8 名医生的半结构化深度访谈，考察临终情境下患者的数字隐私处境与主观态度。主题分析揭示数字隐私挑战的五个结构性维度：缺乏有意义知情同意的持续身体数字化；认知衰退导致的非自愿账户代理控制；超出患者认知边界的推断性数据生成；关系网络重构中个体隐私边界的消解；以及身后数据机构治理的缺位。患者隐私态度呈三类画像：根本上缺乏隐私意识、在严重工具约束下持续主动管理、以及感知问题后无奈放弃。对照护者与医生的访谈揭示以关怀之名的善意替代、超出初始任务范围的访问扩张，以及机构指引缺位下未决的边界。这些发现揭示临终情境特有的复合性隐私脆弱性，呼吁隐私设计原则、细粒度许可机制与面向临终患者需求的机构治理框架。
summary_cn: 基于 21 名终末期患者、11 名照护者与 8 名医生的深度访谈：识别临终数字隐私的五个结构性挑战维度与三类患者态度画像，发现以关怀之名的访问扩张与身后数据治理缺位（IEEE S&P 2026 录用）。
objective_summary: 用半结构化深度访谈与主题分析刻画临终关怀情境中患者数字隐私的结构性挑战、态度画像与照护者/医生视角的实践困境。
evidence_note: 40 人深度访谈（患者/照护者/医生三方）、IEEE S&P 2026 录用、主题分析规范；定性研究固有限制。
novelty_note: 隐私边界理论已有框架，「临终情境的结构性隐私脆弱性」是新的群体与情境聚焦，政策含义具体。
scope: 结论适用于被访谈的三甲医院临终关怀情境与文化背景；其他医疗体系、儿童患者与非肿瘤类终末期疾病未覆盖。
limitations: 定性样本（40 人）不做统计推断；单一医疗体系；患者访谈受病情与情绪状态影响。

title: Fundamental Limits of Information-Theoretic Secure Aggregation with User Dropouts in Federated Learning
abstract: Secure aggregation enables a server to compute the sum of users' gradients or model updates without revealing individual values. With user dropouts, correlated random keys protect local gradients while allowing recovery of the desired gradient sum. We consider three phases: key distribution, masked-gradient upload, and mask elimination. Users establish correlated keys, upload masked gradients, and provide additional messages to eliminate residual aggregate masks. Existing information-theoretic schemes typically design mask-elimination communication for a prescribed dropout threshold and evaluate its cost under worst-case dropouts across the masked-gradient upload and mask-elimination phases. Such designs cannot adjust communication to actual dropout scenarios. Moreover, the randomness and communication costs of establishing correlated keys remain largely unexplored. To address these limitations, we formulate an adaptive secure aggregation framework under the T-colluding security constraint and construct a single scheme that supports all feasible dropout scenarios by adapting its communication to the actual number of dropouts. We establish converse bounds on four resources: key randomness, key-distribution communication, masked-gradient communication, and mask-elimination communication. The latter two bounds are characterized for each realized dropout set in the masked-gradient upload phase. The proposed scheme achieves the optimal masked-gradient communication rate for every feasible dropout scenario and the optimal mask-elimination communication rate in almost all feasible regimes. Its key rate and key-distribution communication rate are each optimal or within a factor of two of their respective information-theoretic optima. These results characterize the fundamental randomness and communication costs of secure aggregation with user dropouts.

title_cn: 用户掉线情形下信息论安全聚合的基本极限
abstract_cn: 安全聚合使服务器能计算用户梯度或模型更新之和而不泄露个体值。存在用户掉线时，相关随机密钥既保护本地梯度又允许恢复所需的梯度和。我们考虑三个阶段：密钥分发、掩码梯度上传与掩码消除。用户建立相关密钥、上传掩码梯度，并提供额外消息以消除残余聚合掩码。既有信息论方案通常按预设掉线阈值设计掩码消除通信，并在上传与消除两阶段的最坏掉线情形下评估成本；这类设计无法按实际掉线情形调整通信。此外，建立相关密钥的随机性与通信成本基本未被探索。针对这些局限，我们在 T 合谋安全约束下形式化自适应安全聚合框架，构造单一方案：通过把通信适配到实际掉线数量支持所有可行掉线场景。我们建立四种资源的逆界：密钥随机性、密钥分发通信、掩码梯度通信与掩码消除通信；后两者按上传阶段每个已实现的掉线集合刻画。所提方案对每个可行掉线场景都达到最优掩码梯度通信率，并在几乎所有可行区间达到最优掩码消除通信率；其密钥率与密钥分发通信率各自达到最优或距信息论最优不超过两倍。这些结果刻画了带用户掉线的安全聚合的基本随机性与通信成本。
summary_cn: 形式化自适应安全聚合并提出支持所有掉线场景的单一方案：四种资源建立信息论逆界，掩码梯度通信逐掉线场景最优、掩码消除几乎处处最优，密钥相关率至多距最优 2 倍。
objective_summary: 建立带用户掉线的 T 安全聚合自适应框架，构造按实际掉线调整通信的方案，并证明四种资源的信息论逆界与可达性。
evidence_note: 理论论文：逆界与可达方案匹配（多重最优速率），证明完整、达到紧界。
novelty_note: 安全聚合已有丰富文献，自适应掉线框架与密钥成本的刻画是实质性推进但非新问题开辟。
scope: 结论适用于 T 合谋、随机掉线的标准安全聚合模型；拜占庭客户端、输出正确性验证与异构系统假设未覆盖。
limitations: 模型假设理想化（诚实多数、无主动伪造）；方案的实现复杂度与工程可用性未评估。

title: Peer-Relative Trust-Guided Update Screening for Robust Semi-Decentralized Federated Learning under Label-Flipping Attacks
abstract: Trust and reputation mechanisms can reduce the influence of malicious clients in federated learning (FL), but strict update filtering is difficult under non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data because honest local updates may temporarily reduce performance on a shared validation proxy. Building on our earlier trust-based semi-decentralized FL (SDFL) framework, this paper operationalizes the trust signals and introduces peer-relative update screening that combines a robust validation-utility score with direction- and norm-based update quality. The method is evaluated with 50 MNIST clients, 20% persistent label-flip attackers, Dirichlet heterogeneity levels of 0.5 and 0.1, 100 communication rounds, and five paired random seeds. Under moderate heterogeneity, the proposed method reaches 98.37% final accuracy while rejecting 95.82% of malicious updates and retaining 90.30% of benign updates; the final benign and malicious trust distributions are completely separated (KS=1.00). Under severe heterogeneity, it reaches 95.25% accuracy, rejects 88.55% of malicious updates, and retains 76.90% of benign updates (KS=0.96). Trust weighting alone preserves slightly higher utility in the most heterogeneous condition, but accepts all malicious submis-sions. The results therefore distinguish influence mitigation from explicit containment and quantify the utility-selectivity trade-off introduced by screening. The study provides an empirically validated off-chain governance core that can feed blockchain-based audit and incentive layers in SDFL.

title_cn: 面向标签翻转攻击下鲁棒半去中心化联邦学习的同侪相对信任引导更新筛选
abstract_cn: 信任与声誉机制能降低恶意客户端对联邦学习（FL）的影响，但在非独立同分布（非 IID）数据下严格的更新筛选很困难，因为诚实的本地更新可能暂时降低共享验证代理上的性能。本文在既有基于信任的半去中心化 FL（SDFL）框架之上，把信任信号操作化并引入同侪相对更新筛选：结合稳健的验证效用分数与基于方向和范数的更新质量。评估设置：50 个 MNIST 客户端、20% 持续标签翻转攻击者、Dirichlet 异构度 0.5 与 0.1、100 通信轮、五对随机种子。中度异构下，该方法最终准确率 98.37%，拒绝 95.82% 的恶意更新、保留 90.30% 的良性更新，最终良性与恶意信任分布完全分离（KS=1.00）；重度异构下准确率 95.25%，拒绝 88.55% 恶意更新、保留 76.90% 良性更新（KS=0.96）。仅用信任加权在最高异构条件下保留略高效用，但会接受全部恶意提交。结果因此区分了「影响缓解」与「显式遏制」，并量化了筛选带来的效用-选择性权衡。研究为 SDFL 中可对接区块链审计与激励层的链下治理核心提供了实证验证。
summary_cn: 在半去中心化 FL 中引入同侪相对更新筛选：MNIST 50 客户端、20% 标签翻转攻击下，中度异构达 98.37% 准确率、拒绝 95.82% 恶意更新（KS=1.00），重度异构 95.25%/88.55%，量化效用-选择性权衡。
objective_summary: 操作化信任信号并提出结合验证效用与方向/范数质量的同侪相对筛选，在多种异构度与攻击设置的 MNIST 联邦实验中量化拒绝率、保留率与准确率。
evidence_note: 五对随机种子、两种异构度设置、明确的攻击设置与基线对比、报告效用-选择性权衡；仅 MNIST、攻击类型单一、ICBTA 2026 会议。
novelty_note: 信任/声誉过滤与同侪比较均已有，组合落地于其既有 SDFL 框架属增量。
scope: 结论适用于 MNIST 与持续标签翻转攻击设定；其他数据模态、后门与模型替换等更强攻击、大规模客户端未覆盖。
limitations: 威胁模型限于持久标签翻转；共享验证代理本身可能被操纵；区块链审计对接仅为架构设想。

title: How Effectively Do Security Skills Guide Coding Agents in Vulnerability Detection in Linux Kernel?
abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents, such as Claude Code, are increasingly used for security auditing, with task-specific skills providing reusable vulnerability-analysis procedures. However, their effectiveness in detecting real vulnerabilities and the reasons for their failures remain unclear. We conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 37 security skills using Claude Code with four underlying LLMs on 100 real Linux kernel vulnerabilities across ten classes, totaling 14800 runs. We evaluate vulnerability detection at the function, statement, and vulnerability-class levels. Results show that 24.4 percent of runs locate the correct function, 18.3 percent identify both the function and responsible statement, and 15.7 percent correctly classify the vulnerability. Our failure analysis reveals limitations in evidence acquisition, state-relation reasoning, code interpretation, candidate verification, investigation coverage, and reporting. Based on these findings, we propose SKILL-SIF, a self-improving framework that iteratively evolves security skills by learning from missed vulnerabilities and failure patterns. We evolve five top-performing skills using the original benchmark and evaluate them on 100 previously unseen vulnerabilities. SKILL-SIF improves fully correct vulnerability detection by up to eight times (from 2 percent to 16 percent) on unseen vulnerabilities, while aggregate accuracy across four LLMs increases by 1.85 times (from 6.05 percent to 11.20 percent). These findings highlight the limitations of existing security skills and demonstrate the potential of failure-driven skill evolution to improve vulnerability detection in coding agents.
title_cn: 安全技能能在多大程度上引导编码智能体检测 Linux 内核漏洞？
abstract_cn: Claude Code 等大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体日益被用于安全审计，任务专属技能（skills）提供可复用的漏洞分析流程。但它们在检测真实漏洞上的有效性及失败原因仍不清楚。我们对 37 个安全技能开展首个大规模实证研究：用 Claude Code 配四个底层 LLM，在十类共 100 个真实 Linux 内核漏洞上共执行 14,800 次运行。我们在函数、语句与漏洞类别三个层级评估漏洞检测。结果显示 24.4% 的运行定位到正确函数，18.3% 同时找到函数与责任语句，15.7% 正确分类漏洞。失败分析揭示证据获取、状态关系推理、代码解读、候选验证、调查覆盖与报告六方面局限。基于这些发现，我们提出 SKILL-SIF——通过从未检出漏洞与失败模式中学习来迭代演化安全技能的自改进框架。用原基准演化五个最佳技能后，在 100 个此前未见漏洞上评估：SKILL-SIF 把完全正确的漏洞检出最多提升八倍（2% 到 16%），四个 LLM 的聚合准确率提升 1.85 倍（6.05% 到 11.20%）。这些发现凸显既有安全技能的局限，并展示失败驱动的技能演化对提升编码智能体漏洞检测的潜力。
summary_cn: 首个安全技能大规模实证：37 技能×4 LLM×100 真实内核漏洞共 14,800 次运行，函数定位 24.4%、完全正确检出仅 15.7%；SKILL-SIF 失败驱动技能演化把未见漏洞全检出从 2% 升至 16%。
objective_summary: 大规模测量安全技能在真实 Linux 内核漏洞上的检测率与失败模式，提出从失败中迭代演化技能的 SKILL-SIF 并在留出漏洞上验证提升。
evidence_note: 14,800 次运行、100 个真实内核漏洞、三层级评估、系统失败分析、留出集验证演化收益；观测性研究但规模充分。
novelty_note: 「技能引导智能体审计」的系统性测量较新；SKILL-SIF 属自动化流程演化的已知思路在新场景的扎实落地。
scope: 结论适用于 Claude Code 框架、四个底层模型与 100 个内核漏洞样本；其他智能体框架、语言与漏洞类型未覆盖。
limitations: 完全正确检出率绝对值低（11–16%），距实用仍有距离；技能在原基准上演化可能有选择偏差（虽有留出集）；运行成本高。

title: Formalization of Rényi Differential Privacy in Isabelle/HOL (Draft version)
abstract: Differential privacy (DP) is a gold-standard definition of privacy designed to evaluate the privacy guarantee of databases. R\'{e}nyi differential privacy (RDP) is an important variant of DP that gives tight evaluations of machine learning algorithms. These formulations are easy to understand, but evaluating privacy for actual databases is complicated. Even a small change in the database can break its privacy, and evaluations of DP and RDP themselves are complicated. In particular, RDP evaluations in recent studies have become much harder. Therefore, formal verification of them has been studied for over a decade. In this paper, we propose an Isabelle/HOL library for formalizing R\'{e}nyi differential privacy in a general setting. We first formalize RDP for continuous distributions. As a technical basis, we formalize several properties of convex functions and $f$-divergences for nonnegative convex functions. We formalize basic properties of RDP, conversion laws from RDP to DP, the moment accountants in DP, and the Gaussian mechanism and its RDP. Finally, we discuss the stochastic gradient descent mechanism with Gaussian noise and formalize a rough evaluation of its RDP and DP.
title_cn: Rényi 差分隐私在 Isabelle/HOL 中的形式化（草稿版）
abstract_cn: 差分隐私（DP）是评估数据库隐私保证的黄金标准定义。Rényi 差分隐私（RDP）是 DP 的重要变体，能对机器学习算法给出更紧的评估。这些定义易于理解，但对实际数据库做隐私评估却很复杂：数据库的微小变化即可破坏其隐私，而 DP 与 RDP 的评估本身也很繁琐，近年研究中的 RDP 评估更是愈发困难。因此其形式化验证已被研究十余年。本文提出一个在一般情形下形式化 Rényi 差分隐私的 Isabelle/HOL 库。我们首先对连续分布形式化 RDP；作为技术基础，形式化凸函数与非负凸函数 f-散度的若干性质；随后形式化 RDP 基本性质、RDP 到 DP 的转换律、DP 中的矩会计，以及高斯机制及其 RDP；最后讨论带高斯噪声的随机梯度下降机制并形式化其 RDP 与 DP 的粗评估。
summary_cn: 提出 Isabelle/HOL 中一般情形的 RDP 形式化库：连续分布 RDP、f-散度性质、RDP-DP 转换、矩会计、高斯机制及带噪 SGD 的粗评估均机器验证。
objective_summary: 在 Isabelle/HOL 中系统形式化 Rényi 差分隐私及其支撑理论（凸性、f-散度、矩会计、高斯机制、带噪 SGD）。
evidence_note: 机器检查的完整形式化，正确性由证明助手保证；自称草稿版、覆盖机制集有限、无新隐私结果。
novelty_note: DP 的 Isabelle 形式化已有先例，RDP 在一般设定（连续分布、转换律）下的形式化是实质补充。
scope: 覆盖连续分布上的 RDP 基础理论与高斯/SGD 机制；子采样、完整组合与更复杂机制未包含（草稿）。
limitations: 自称草稿版本；SGD 的 RDP 评估为「粗评估」；库的可用性与文档完善度待成熟。

title: Adaptive Cyber-Defense for Evolving Attacker Capabilities using Reinforcement Learning and Behavior Trees
abstract: Autonomous cyber-defense agents trained using reinforcement learning (RL) are increasingly adopted for defending enterprise computer networks. However, existing approaches may become brittle as attacker capabilities evolve and enable new attack strategies. In this work, we study the problem of adapting defender policies learned in CAGE Challenge Scenario 2 (CC2), a benchmark enterprise network defense scenario, to an extended network scenario with new attacker capabilities represented by new attacker actions. Effective attack strategies that leverage new actions are initially unknown, and therefore attacker policies must be learned before defender adaptation can occur. To address this challenge, we develop adversarial RL (ARL) with behavior trees (ARLBT), which uses reward behavior trees (RBTs) to define progression-based reward functions and condition attacker policies on RBT execution. The proposed RBT incorporates the new attacker actions into structured attack strategies while leveraging parallel execution to generate rewards across multiple network nodes simultaneously. We evaluate ARLBT for learning attacker policies against two baseline defender policies across network scenarios with different sets of new attacker actions and compare against multiple attacker baselines. The results demonstrate that ARLBT improves attacker success compared to ARL using the original CC2 reward function and that conditioning policies on RBT execution can improve sample efficiency. We further show that defender policies can be adapted against the learned attackers, improving robustness to attacks that leverage new attacker actions.
title_cn: 面向演化攻击者能力的自适应网络防御：强化学习与行为树
abstract_cn: 用强化学习（RL）训练的自主网络防御智能体日益被用于保护企业网络。但随攻击者能力演化并启用新攻击策略，既有方法可能变得脆弱。本工作研究把在 CAGE Challenge 场景 2（CC2）这一基准企业网络防御场景中学到的防御者策略，适配到含新攻击者能力（以新攻击动作表示）的扩展网络场景。利用新动作的有效攻击策略起初未知，因此必须先学出攻击者策略才能进行防御适配。为此我们提出结合行为树的对抗 RL（ARLBT）：用奖励行为树（RBT）定义基于进程的奖励函数，并以 RBT 执行为条件化攻击者策略。所提 RBT 把新攻击动作纳入结构化攻击策略，同时利用并行执行在多个网络节点同时产生奖励。我们在含不同新攻击动作集合的网络场景上，针对两个基线防御者策略评估 ARLBT 学出的攻击者策略，并与多个攻击基线比较。结果表明 ARLBT 相比使用原 CC2 奖励函数的 ARL 提升攻击成功率，且以 RBT 执行为条件可提升样本效率；防御者策略可针对学到的攻击者进行适配，提升对利用新动作攻击的鲁棒性。
summary_cn: 提出 ARLBT：用奖励行为树结构化新攻击动作学攻击者策略，再适配 CC2 防御者；相比原奖励 ARL 提升攻击成功率与样本效率，适配后防御对新动作攻击更鲁棒。
objective_summary: 在 CC2 扩展场景中以行为树奖励学出新攻击动作下的攻击者策略，再训练防御者适配，比较攻击成功率与样本效率。
evidence_note: 基准场景（CAGE CC2）扩展、多组新攻击动作设置、多基线比较；仿真环境、无真实网络验证。
novelty_note: RL 网络防御与行为树奖励已有先例，把 RBT 用于「新攻击能力下的攻击者建模+防御适配」是组合性贡献。
scope: 结论适用于 CAGE 仿真环境与被测动作集合；真实企业网络、更大动作空间与非平稳对手未覆盖。
limitations: 仿真环境与真实防御运营差距大；先攻后守的两阶段训练成本高；行为树设计需专家先验。

title: Spectrum of Liability: Forensically Sound Acquisition of Wireless Evidence for the Reconstruction of Maritime Cyber-Physical Incidents
abstract: Modern maritime navigation depends on mandatory wireless inputs, most notably GNSS and AIS, whose reception can be spoofed or jammed. When groundings or collisions occur, liability and safety investigations often turn on whether RF interference corrupted bridge instruments, yet the artifacts typically available (VDR outputs, IBS logs, screenshots, decoded messages) are downstream, lossy, and easy to contest in adversarial proceedings. We introduce a forensically sound acquisition methodology that preserves upstream wireless evidence together with the minimal contemporaneous context needed to interpret it. Our system records coherent, multichannel IQ across relevant bands while simultaneously collecting time-aligned receiver and instrument-state metadata (e.g., decoded AIS/GNSS outputs and NMEA sentences), enabling later re-decoding and physical-layer reanalysis tied to what the onboard stack indicated at the time. To make the record independently auditable, we package samples and metadata into a single append-only forensic envelope that cryptographically binds per-stream hash chains with trusted-time anchors and periodic checkpoints, allowing third parties to detect tampering (modification, truncation, splicing, cross-case substitution) and to verify the claimed recording window. A prototype implementation shows the approach is practical: integrity mechanisms add negligible storage overhead and modest compute cost at operationally relevant multiband capture rates.
title_cn: 责任光谱：面向海事信息物理事故重建的无线取证式证据获取
abstract_cn: 现代海事导航依赖强制性无线输入，尤其是 GNSS 与 AIS，其接收可能被欺骗或干扰。当搁浅或碰撞发生时，责任与安全调查往往取决于射频干扰是否污染了驾驶台仪器，而通常可得的工件（VDR 输出、IBS 日志、截图、解码报文）是下游的、有损的，在对抗性程序中容易被质疑。我们提出一套取证级获取方法，保存上游无线证据及解读它所需的最小同时性上下文。系统在相关频段录制相干多通道 IQ，同时收集时间对齐的接收机与仪器状态元数据（如解码后的 AIS/GNSS 输出与 NMEA 语句），使后续重解码与物理层重分析能对应当时船载栈的指示。为使记录可独立审计，我们把样本与元数据打包进单一只追加的取证信封：用密码学方式绑定逐流哈希链、可信时间锚与周期检查点，第三方可检测篡改（修改、截断、拼接、跨案替换）并验证声称的录制窗口。原型实现表明该方法实用：在作战相关的多频段采集速率下，完整性机制带来可忽略的存储开销与适度的计算成本。
summary_cn: 提出海事 GNSS/AIS 无线证据的取证级获取方法：多通道 IQ 录制+时间对齐仪表元数据打包进带哈希链与可信时间锚的只追加取证信封，可第三方审计篡改，原型显示开销可忽略。
objective_summary: 设计保存上游无线证据与同时性元数据的取证获取系统，用密码学信封保证可审计性，并以原型评估存储与计算开销。
evidence_note: 原型实现与开销量化、完整性机制设计具体；无真实事故案例或实船部署评估、篡改检测以设计论证。
novelty_note: 把「上游 IQ 采集+可审计信封」系统化用于海事责任场景是新的应用系统化；SDR 采集、哈希链、时间锚等组件已有。
scope: 结论适用于原型实现的多频段采集速率与存储场景；实船长期部署、法律可采性与跨辖区证据规则未覆盖。
limitations: 未在真实事故或实船环境中验证；可信时间源本身需被信任；长期归档存储成本随采集带宽增长。

title: SEAL: Towards Persistent Tool Poisoning Attack against LLM Agents via Prefix-Eliciting Trigger
abstract: Tool poisoning has emerged as a critical security threat to LLM agents, where adversaries embed malicious instructions in tool descriptions or external resources that enter the agent's context, allowing adversaries to manipulate agent's tool selection process. However, existing tool poisoning attacks primarily rely on an idealized assumption that the attacks task effect within a single interaction round. We show that their effectiveness degrades sharply in realistic multi-round agentic settings. We further reveal that this degradation stems from the fact that agents do not consistently surface attack-relevant signals in their reasoning as the planning context evolves, thereby weakening the attack's influence across rounds. To investigate whether tool poisoning remains a practical threat in such realistic settings, we propose SEAL, a two-stage method for persistent tool poisoning. Specifically, SEAL first performs Prefix-Eliciting Trigger Optimization (PETO) to optimize context-specific triggers that elicit attack-relevant reasoning prefixes, improving effectiveness within individual contexts. It then applies Local-to-Universal Trigger Aggregation (L2U) to combine these local triggers into a single universal trigger, improving generalization across different contexts and execution rounds. Extensive experiments across seven representative multi-round scenarios and different models demonstrate the attack effectiveness of SEAL, its transferability across target models, and its resistance to potential defenses.
title_cn: SEAL：基于前缀诱发触发器的 LLM 智能体持久工具投毒攻击
abstract_cn: 工具投毒已成为 LLM 智能体的关键安全威胁：攻击者在工具描述或外部资源中嵌入进入智能体上下文的恶意指令，从而操纵智能体的工具选择过程。但现有工具投毒攻击大多依赖一个理想化假设——攻击在单轮交互内见效。我们显示其效能在现实的多轮智能体场景中急剧退化，并揭示退化根源：随着规划上下文演化，智能体并不总在其推理中呈现与攻击相关的信号，削弱了攻击跨轮的影响。为考察工具投毒在此类现实场景中是否仍是实际威胁，我们提出 SEAL，一个两阶段的持久工具投毒方法：先执行前缀诱发触发器优化（PETO），优化在特定上下文中诱发攻击相关推理前缀的触发器，提升单上下文内的有效性；再通过局部到通用触发器聚合（L2U）把局部触发器合并为单一通用触发器，提升跨上下文与执行轮次的泛化。在七个代表性多轮场景与多个模型上的大量实验证明了 SEAL 的攻击有效性、跨目标模型可迁移性与对潜在防御的抵抗力。
summary_cn: 揭示既有工具投毒在多轮智能体场景中急剧退化（推理中攻击信号不持续），提出 SEAL 两阶段持久投毒（PETO 前缀诱发 + L2U 通用聚合），在七个多轮场景与多模型上验证有效性、迁移性与抗防御性。
objective_summary: 量化单轮工具投毒在多轮设定下的退化及其原因，提出优化诱发推理前缀触发器并聚合为通用触发器的持久攻击方法，多场景多模型评估。
evidence_note: 七个代表性多轮场景、多模型、迁移与抗防御实验；摘要未给具体成功率数字、防御覆盖不明。
novelty_note: 把工具投毒从单轮推进到持久多轮是实质性威胁模型扩展；触发器优化思想承袭已有投毒与注入方法。
scope: 结论适用于被测多轮智能体框架与模型；对最强上下文净化与运行时监控组合的对抗未穷尽。
limitations: 触发器优化需要白盒访问或代理模型；未系统报告各防御下的成功率下降；真实工具生态的部署前提（描述可写）限制直接适用面。

title: GreenNIDS: A Benchmark Workflow and Analysis Dataset for NetFlow Intrusion Detection Experiments
abstract: Comparing the predictive performance and computational cost of flow-based intrusion detection experiments requires both quantities to be available for each run. GreenNIDS connects benchmark execution on public NetFlow datasets to a reusable analysis dataset. Model implementations write a common set of outputs, which are ingested into a run-level table with companion tables for model configuration, feature importance, and training history. The run-level table combines predictive metrics with timing, throughput, memory use, and energy estimates based on thermal design power. A CPU-only demonstration comprises 216 runs across four dataset families, three versions, and binary and multiclass tasks. Ingestion produces a 216 x 96 analysis table with no duplicate run identifiers and complete Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and F1 coverage. Multiclass ROC-AUC is missing for 36 PyTorch runs, making metric availability an explicit part of subsequent comparisons. The stored records support grouped performance and training-time plots, as well as resource screening after execution. Combining task-specific MCC thresholds with limits on training time, peak RAM, and estimated training energy retains 25.0% of the full run collection. These results establish compatibility within the evaluated collection and support comparisons after execution, subject to the recorded preprocessing, execution profile, and approximate energy accounting.

title_cn: GreenNIDS：面向 NetFlow 入侵检测实验的基准工作流与分析数据集
abstract_cn: 比较基于流的入侵检测实验的预测性能与计算成本，需要每次运行都同时可得这两类量。GreenNIDS 把公开 NetFlow 数据集上的基准执行连接到可复用的分析数据集：模型实现写出统一的输出集合，被摄取为运行级表，并配有模型配置、特征重要性与训练历史等伴随表。运行级表把预测指标与时间、吞吐、内存及基于热设计功耗的能耗估计结合。仅 CPU 的演示包含 216 次运行，横跨四个数据集家族、三个版本与二分类/多分类任务。摄取产出 216×96 的分析表，无重复运行标识，MCC 与 F1 完整覆盖；多分类 ROC-AUC 在 36 个 PyTorch 运行中缺失，使指标可用性成为后续比较的显式部分。存储记录支持分组性能与训练时间图以及执行后的资源筛选。把任务特定 MCC 阈值与训练时间、峰值内存、估计能耗上限组合，保留全部运行的 25.0%。这些结果确立了所评估集合内的兼容性，支持执行后的比较，但受制于所记录的预处理、执行画像与近似能耗核算。
summary_cn: GreenNIDS 把 NetFlow IDS 基准执行与统一分析表打通：216 次运行（4 数据集家族、二/多分类）统一记录指标、时间、内存与能耗估计，MCC/F1 全覆盖，组合阈值筛选后保留 25% 运行。

title: On Pearl Blockchain's Proof of Useful Work: Systematization and Flexibility
abstract: We revisit the proof-of-useful-work (PoUW) scheme in Pearl blockchain's white paper (Pearl Research Team), giving a systematic sensitivity characterization as an alternative to its Jackpot policy, along with efficient algorithm for verifying the sensitivity condition. Beyond its independent interest, our characterization yields a more flexible PoUW scheme that eenables miner autonomy: each miner can independently choose its noise magnitude to tailor the trade-off between computational accuracy and mining efficiency to its own needs.
title_cn: 论 Pearl 区块链的有用工作量证明：系统化与灵活性
abstract_cn: 我们重新审视 Pearl 区块链白皮书中的有用工作量证明（PoUW）方案，给出对其 Jackpot 策略的一个替代——系统化的敏感性刻画——以及验证敏感性条件的高效算法。除其独立价值外，我们的刻画还产生一个更灵活的 PoUW 方案，支持矿工自主：每个矿工可独立选择噪声幅度，按自身需求调节计算精度与挖矿效率的权衡。
summary_cn: 重审 Pearl 区块链 PoUW：给出替代 Jackpot 策略的敏感性刻画与高效验证算法，得到支持矿工自选噪声幅度、自主权衡精度与效率的更灵活方案。
objective_summary: 对 Pearl 白皮书的 PoUW 方案做系统化敏感性分析，设计敏感性条件的高效验证算法并导出矿工可调噪声幅度的扩展。
evidence_note: 对单一白皮书方案的再分析，无实验、无真实系统验证。
novelty_note: 对既有白皮书方案的改进性刻画，问题面较窄。
scope: 结论限于 Pearl 白皮书所述 PoUW 方案及其假设；对更广 PoUW 文献与实际区块链部署未覆盖。
limitations: 研究对象为白皮书描述而非实现；未评估矿工自主噪声选择对网络安全性的集体影响；无实验验证。

title: Equivalent Non-linear Shift Register Transformations and Espresso
abstract: The stream cipher Espresso was designed by E. Dubrova and M. Hell as a hardware-efficient candidate for 5G security. It has two components - a 256-bit binary non-linear feedback shift register (NFSR), with 14 feedback taps, and a 20-variable non-linear output function. However, the security of Espresso with regard to several standard cryptanalytic attacks are estimated using an alternate NFSR, which has only two feedback taps. The above analysis is based on the claim that this alternate NFSR is obtained using a transformation algorithm which preserves the output sequence of the original NFSR. This issue has become all the more significant in the light of recent results on hardware performance evaluations, which assume that the stated equivalence holds. This article presents the first successful attempt in settling the above question of Espresso NFSR equivalence. We arrive at our main result by a careful analysis of existing transformation methods relevant to the question. In doing so, we first identify and correct a critical flaw in the proof of a foundational result of E. Dubrova. Next, in the context of Espresso equivalence, we analyze and unify the transformation framework of Dubrova and the one proposed by Yao and Parampalli. Based on our analysis, we have succeeded in transforming the LFSR in an Espresso-equivalent design reported by Yao and Parampalli to the Espresso alternate NFSR. Further, we have obtained a corresponding non-linear output function which achieves output-equivalence with the LFSR design, and hence, with Espresso.
title_cn: 等价非线性移位寄存器变换与 Espresso
abstract_cn: 流密码 Espresso 由 E. Dubrova 与 M. Hell 设计，是面向 5G 安全的高效硬件候选。它有两个组件：带 14 个反馈抽头的 256 位二元非线性反馈移位寄存器（NFSR），与一个 20 变量非线性输出函数。然而，Espresso 针对若干标准密码分析攻击的安全性评估使用的是一个只有两个反馈抽头的替代 NFSR。上述分析基于一个断言：该替代 NFSR 由保持原 NFSR 输出序列的变换算法得到。鉴于近期硬件性能评估结果均假设所述等价成立，这一问题愈发重要。本文首次成功解决 Espresso NFSR 等价性问题。我们通过对相关变换方法的细致分析得到主要结果：首先发现并修正 E. Dubrova 一个基础结果证明中的关键缺陷；随后在 Espresso 等价的语境下分析并统一 Dubrova 的变换框架与 Yao 和 Parampalli 提出的框架。基于该分析，我们成功把 Yao 和 Parampalli 报告的 Espresso 等价设计中的 LFSR 变换为 Espresso 替代 NFSR，并进一步得到与该 LFSR 设计输出等价（从而与 Espresso 输出等价）的相应非线性输出函数。
summary_cn: 解决 Espresso 流密码 NFSR 等价性悬案：发现并修正 Dubrova 基础结果证明缺陷，统一两个变换框架，成功把 LFSR 设计变换为 Espresso 替代 NFSR 并给出输出等价的非线性函数。
objective_summary: 分析并修正既有 NFSR 变换理论的证明缺陷，统一 Dubrova 与 Yao–Parampalli 变换框架，据此解决 Espresso 替代 NFSR 与原设计的输出等价问题。
evidence_note: 理论证明修正与构造性变换结果、可验证的输出等价；密码理论论证完整、无实验。
novelty_note: 解决一个悬置且被后续硬件评估依赖的基础等价问题，并修正权威结果证明中的缺陷，修正性价值高。
scope: 结论限于 Espresso 及相关 NFSR/LFSR 变换理论；对其他流密码或安全界数值的直接更新未展开。
limitations: 结论为等价性确立而非新攻击；此前依赖该等价假设的安全与硬件评估是否需修正，本文未量化。

title: AdaFedXplain: Adaptive Federated Learning with Explainable AI for Ransomware Detection
abstract: Attacks using ransomware have developed into complex multiphase campaigns that target vital infrastructure, resulting in annual damages of billions of dollars. Conventional detection techniques are ineffective against zero-day variations, and privacy issues are raised by centralized machine learning algorithms. Federated learning allows for cooperative model training without data sharing, however current FL approaches suffer from explainability issues, high communication cost, and non-IID data heterogeneity. In this study, we present AdaFedXplain, an explainable AI-based adaptive federated learning system for ransomware detection. Our approach includes progressive XGBoost complexity to avoid overfitting, a decaying learning rate schedule for stable convergence, and dynamic client grading based on ransomware prevalence and data sufficiency. Using 62,485 real-world ransomware samples from four OS-based non-IID clients, we compare AdaFedXplain against FedAvg, FedProx, and SCAFFOLD. According to experimental data, AdaFedXplain outperforms all baselines with 99.59% detection accuracy and 99.64% F1-score while cutting energy usage by 75%, latency by 65%, and communication overhead by 75%. The ablation investigation demonstrates that every element enhances performance. Security analysts can use SHAP explainability to identify important PE header characteristics that influence detection decisions. Our system provides a collaborative ransomware detection solution that is efficient and interpretable, while reducing privacy risks through federated learnings data-local training paradigm.

title_cn: AdaFedXplain：面向勒索软件检测的自适应联邦学习与可解释 AI
abstract_cn: 勒索软件攻击已发展为针对关键基础设施的复杂多阶段活动，造成每年数十亿美元损失。传统检测技术对零日变种无效，集中式机器学习算法又引发隐私问题。联邦学习支持不共享数据的协同训练，但现有 FL 方法存在可解释性不足、通信开销高与非 IID 数据异构等问题。本研究提出 AdaFedXplain，一个基于可解释 AI 的自适应联邦勒索软件检测系统：包含避免过拟合的渐进式 XGBoost 复杂度、稳定收敛的衰减学习率调度，以及基于勒索软件流行度与数据充分性的动态客户端分级。使用来自四个按操作系统划分的非 IID 客户端的 62,485 个真实勒索软件样本，与 FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD 对比。实验显示 AdaFedXplain 以 99.59% 检测准确率与 99.64% F1 超越所有基线，同时能耗降 75%、时延降 65%、通信开销降 75%。消融实验证明每个组件都有贡献。安全分析师可用 SHAP 可解释性找出影响检测决策的重要 PE 头特征。系统借助联邦学习的数据本地训练范式降低隐私风险，提供高效可解释的协同勒索软件检测方案。
summary_cn: 提出 AdaFedXplain 自适应联邦勒索软件检测：62,485 真实样本、四个非 IID 客户端上达 99.59% 准确率/99.64% F1，超 FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD，能耗与时延各降约 75%/65%，SHAP 解释 PE 头特征。
objective_summary: 构建渐进复杂度 XGBoost、衰减学习率与动态客户端分级的自适应联邦检测系统，在真实勒索样本非 IID 划分上与三个 FL 基线对比并做消融与 SHAP 分析。
evidence_note: 62,485 个真实样本、三个 FL 基线对比、消融实验；ML4CS 2026 会议、无统计检验、单数据集来源。
novelty_note: 自适应 FL、XGBoost 与 SHAP 均为成熟组件的工程组合。
scope: 结论适用于 PE 特征勒索软件检测与被测四客户端划分；跨平台泛化、对抗样本与持续演化的家族未覆盖。
limitations: 单一数据来源可能过拟合特定家族特征；99.6% 级指标在类不平衡下的意义需谨慎解读；未测对新型勒索行为的泛化。

title: PRICE: Privacy-Preserving Image Classification in Mobile Edge-Cloud Computing with Homomorphic Encryption
abstract: Cloud-assisted image classification enables many mobile AI applications, but transmitting raw images to the cloud raises significant privacy concerns. Homomorphic encryption (HE) allows computation over encrypted data; however, existing end-to-end HE-based inference pipelines incur prohibitive latency and computational overhead, limiting their feasibility for latency-sensitive mobile systems. This paper addresses how to enable efficient encrypted image classification in mobile edge-cloud environments without sacrificing accuracy. We propose PRICE, a three-tier edge-cloud architecture that partitions deep neural network inference between a trusted edge and an untrusted cloud. The edge performs lightweight feature extraction in plaintext, while only compact embeddings are encrypted using the Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song (CKKS) scheme and offloaded to the cloud for encrypted final-layer inference. This design avoids homomorphic evaluation of deep backbone layers, significantly reducing computation depth, ciphertext size, and end-to-end latency. To further improve efficiency, we develop RowHyDiag, a row-packed hybrid diagonal encoding with hoisted-rotation-aware encrypted matrix-vector computation, which minimizes rotation operations and improves slot utilization. Extensive experiments on real devices across five datasets demonstrate that, under the evaluated 128-bit-security configurations, RowHyDiag achieves up to 31.8$\times$ faster cloud inference, 85.3$\times$ fewer rotations, and 83.0$\times$ lower setup payload than the conventional Halevi-Shoup diagonal method. RowHyDiag also outperforms the PEGASUS linear-transformation baseline, providing 1.1-4.5$\times$ faster cloud inference and 1.2-3.4$\times$ lower setup payload. The results show that PRICE enables deployment-ready, low-latency encrypted inference for mobile edge-cloud systems under a trusted-edge threat model.
title_cn: PRICE：移动端边云协同中基于同态加密的隐私保护图像分类
abstract_cn: 云辅助图像分类支撑众多移动 AI 应用，但把原始图像传到云端带来显著隐私担忧。同态加密（HE）允许对加密数据计算；然而现有端到端 HE 推理管线时延与计算开销过高，难以用于时延敏感的移动系统。本文研究如何在移动边云环境中实现高效加密图像分类而不牺牲准确率。我们提出 PRICE，一个三层边云架构，把深度神经网络推理划分在可信边缘与不可信云端之间：边缘以明文完成轻量特征提取，仅将紧凑嵌入用 CKKS 方案加密并卸载到云端做加密的末层推理。该设计避免了对深层骨干的同态求值，显著降低计算深度、密文尺寸与端到端时延。为进一步提效，我们提出 RowHyDiag——行打包的混合对角编码，配合面向提升旋转（hoisted rotation）的加密矩阵-向量计算，最小化旋转操作并提高槽利用率。在真实设备与五个数据集上的大量实验表明，在所评估的 128 位安全配置下，RowHyDiag 相比传统 Halevi-Shoup 对角方法云推理最高快 31.8 倍、旋转少 85.3 倍、设置载荷低 83.0 倍；相比 PEGASUS 线性变换基线，云推理快 1.1–4.5 倍、设置载荷低 1.2–3.4 倍。结果表明 PRICE 在可信边缘威胁模型下为移动边云系统提供可部署的低时延加密推理。
summary_cn: 提出 PRICE 边云三层架构：边缘明文提特征、仅 CKKS 加密嵌入上云做末层推理，配套 RowHyDiag 编码较 Halevi-Shoup 快至 31.8 倍、旋转少 85.3 倍，真实设备五数据集验证。
objective_summary: 设计可信边缘/不可信云的分层加密推理架构与行打包混合对角编码 RowHyDiag，在真实设备与五个数据集上量化时延、旋转次数与载荷改进。
evidence_note: 真实设备、五个数据集、两个基线（Halevi-Shoup、PEGASUS）多指标对比、128 位安全配置明确。
novelty_note: 可信边缘分割推理已有先例，RowHyDiag 编码是线性变换优化的实质性改进；整体属已有组件的强工程组合。
scope: 结论适用于可信边缘威胁模型与被测数据集/设备；恶意边缘、更大模型与多模态任务未覆盖。
limitations: 安全性依赖边缘可信假设；仅末层加密限制了威胁模型覆盖；开销在更大骨干上的外推未验证。

title: Federated Learning for Malware Image Classification under Data Heterogeneity
abstract: Malware image classification (MIC), in which binary files are converted into visual representations and deep neural networks are trained to identify malware families, has recently emerged as an effective approach for malware detection. Federated learning (FL) enables malware image classifiers to be trained collaboratively by multiple clients without sharing raw data. However, a fundamental challenge in FL is data heterogeneity (non-IID), which is particularly relevant but understudied in the malware context. In this paper, we address this gap via three contributions. First, we present an empirical study of federated MIC under varying degrees of data heterogeneity across three popular malware image datasets (MalImg, Virus-MNIST, and MalNet). We show that while FL achieves strong accuracy under IID conditions, both accuracy and training stability degrade as data becomes increasingly non-IID. Second, we introduce a set of round-level statistics that characterize the data contributed by participating clients in each FL round, and demonstrate that class entropy (diversity of class labels present in a given round) exhibits strong positive correlation with global model accuracy. Third, leveraging this insight, we propose an entropy-aware client selection strategy that filters candidate client subsets based on class entropy, and show that our strategy outperforms standard random selection. Our results highlight the role of client composition in federated MIC and underscore the importance of distribution-aware classifier training under data heterogeneity.
title_cn: 数据异构下恶意软件图像分类的联邦学习
abstract_cn: 恶意软件图像分类（MIC）将二进制文件转为视觉表示并训练深度神经网络识别恶意软件家族，近来已成为恶意软件检测的有效方法。联邦学习（FL）使多个客户端能在不共享原始数据的情况下协同训练恶意软件图像分类器。但 FL 的根本挑战是数据异构（非 IID），这在恶意软件场景中尤为相关却缺乏研究。本文以三项贡献填补该空白：第一，在三个流行的恶意软件图像数据集（MalImg、Virus-MNIST、MalNet）上实证研究不同程度数据异构下的联邦 MIC，表明 FL 在 IID 条件下准确率高，而随数据非 IID 程度上升，准确率与训练稳定性都退化。第二，引入一组刻画每轮参与客户端贡献数据的轮级统计量，证明类熵（一轮中出现的类标签多样性）与全局模型准确率呈强正相关。第三，据此提出熵感知的客户端选择策略，按类熵过滤候选客户端子集，并显示其优于标准随机选择。结果凸显了客户端组成在联邦 MIC 中的作用，以及数据异构下分布感知分类器训练的重要性。
summary_cn: 在 MalImg/Virus-MNIST/MalNet 上实证联邦恶意软件图像分类的非 IID 退化，发现类熵与全局准确率强正相关，提出熵感知客户端选择策略优于随机选择。
objective_summary: 在三个恶意软件图像数据集上量化联邦学习的非 IID 影响，构造轮级统计量分析客户端组成与准确率的关系，提出并验证熵感知客户端选择策略。
evidence_note: 三个数据集、多级异构设置、相关性分析与策略对比；无统计检验、基线限于随机选择。
novelty_note: 非 IID 联邦学习与客户端选择已有大量工作，贡献是恶意软件场景的实证与类熵统计量。
scope: 结论适用于三个图像化恶意软件数据集与所测 FL 设置；真实跨机构部署、投毒攻击与通信约束未覆盖。
limitations: 恶意软件图像表示丢失语义信息；类熵与准确率的相关为观察性结论；未与更多先进选择策略比较。

title: SemVideoSte: Agentic AI for Cross-Modal Semantic Video Steganography Communication
abstract: We propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI)-driven cross-modal semantic video steganography communication (SemVideoSte) scheme for secure cross-modal information transmission. Agentic AI interprets the service context to determine a semantically matched public prompt and coordinates video generation, message embedding, semantic transmission, and message recovery process. A multi-mask mechanism combines variational autoencoder (VAE) reconstruction robustness, semantic transmission robustness, and latent separability to select reliable embedding positions. Meanwhile, a private digital token controls the random seed and guidance offset to construct positive and negative terminal latent states, enabling coverless message embedding during the final diffusion sampling step. Simulation results on open-source datasets demonstrate that SemVideoSte achieves high embedding capacity, reliable message recovery, and strong semantic consistency under different channel conditions. In addition, eavesdroppers without the correct digital token cannot reliably recover the secret message, and the generated stego videos effectively resist the steganalysis detection. We further establish a prototype testbed to verify the practical feasibility of SemVideoSte.

title_cn: SemVideoSte：面向跨模态语义视频隐写通信的智能体 AI
abstract_cn: 我们提出智能体 AI 驱动的跨模态语义视频隐写通信方案（SemVideoSte），用于安全的跨模态信息传输。智能体 AI 解读业务上下文以确定语义匹配的公开提示，并协调视频生成、消息嵌入、语义传输与消息恢复流程。多掩码机制综合 VAE 重构鲁棒性、语义传输鲁棒性与潜在可分性来选择可靠的嵌入位置。同时，私有数字令牌控制随机种子与引导偏移，构造正负终端潜在状态，在扩散采样的最后一步实现无载体消息嵌入。开源数据集上的仿真结果表明，SemVideoSte 在不同信道条件下实现高嵌入容量、可靠消息恢复与强语义一致性；无正确数字令牌的窃听者无法可靠恢复秘密消息，生成的隐写视频能有效抵抗隐写分析检测。我们还搭建原型测试床验证 SemVideoSte 的实际可行性。
summary_cn: 提出智能体驱动的跨模态视频隐写方案 SemVideoSte：多掩码选嵌入位、私有令牌控制末步扩散实现无载体嵌入，仿真显示高容量可靠恢复并抗隐写分析，另有原型测试床。
objective_summary: 设计由智能体协调文本到视频生成与无载体隐写嵌入的通信方案，评估嵌入容量、恢复可靠性、抗检测性与信道鲁棒性，并搭建原型验证。
evidence_note: 仿真与原型测试床，但摘要无量化指标（容量数值、检测率），基线与数据集细节缺失。
novelty_note: 把智能体编排与扩散末步无载体嵌入组合属新场景组合；跨模态语义隐写方向已有工作。
scope: 结论适用于开源数据集仿真与原型规模；真实网络信道、更强隐写分析与令牌管理安全未覆盖。
limitations: 安全性依赖私有令牌的保密；无量化抗检测指标；视频生成质量与语义漂移的影响未系统评估。

title: Many Repairs, One Direction: Steering Code Models Toward Safer Cryptographic API Use
abstract: Cryptographic API misuse in large language model-generated code can compromise software security. While many existing approaches improve code security by modifying model parameters or inputs, how representation changes associated with different cryptographic API repairs can support a shared intervention for safer code generation remains underexplored. To investigate this, we construct 48,000 matched program pairs across four programming languages and ten cryptographic API misuse categories. Each pair changes a specified API decision while preserving the programming task. Subtracting the misuse program's internal representation from its secure counterpart's gives a repair vector. Across five models, comparisons of mean repair vectors reveal stronger organization by misuse category than by language. These category-specific patterns also support a shared intervention. We introduce CrypSteer, which extracts a shared direction by normalizing repair differences and selecting a principal component aligned with repairs across misuse categories. With model weights fixed, adding one shared direction per model to its internal activations during generation improves aggregate target security rates by 5.28--15.00 percentage points over unsteered generation across languages and misuse categories. These findings connect the shared structure of cryptographic repair representations to a reusable intervention for safer code generation.
title_cn: 多种修复、一个方向：引导代码模型更安全地使用密码学 API
abstract_cn: 大语言模型生成代码中的密码学 API 误用会危害软件安全。许多既有方法通过修改模型参数或输入来提升代码安全性，但与不同密码学 API 修复相关联的表示变化如何支撑一个共享干预以实现更安全的代码生成，仍少有研究。为此我们构建了横跨四种编程语言、十类密码学 API 误用的 48,000 个匹配程序对：每对在保持编程任务的同时改变指定的 API 决策。用误用程序的内部表示减去安全对应程序的表示即得修复向量。在五个模型上，平均修复向量的比较显示按误用类别的组织强于按语言的组织。这些类别特异模式还支撑一个共享干预。我们提出 CrypSteer：通过归一化修复差异并选取与跨类别修复对齐的主成分来提取共享方向。在模型权重固定的情况下，生成时向模型内部激活加每模型一个共享方向，使跨语言与跨误用类别的聚合目标安全率比未引导生成提高 5.28–15.00 个百分点。这些发现把密码学修复表示的共享结构与可复用的更安全代码生成干预联系起来。
summary_cn: 构建 48,000 个匹配程序对提取密码学修复向量，发现按误用类别的组织强于按语言，提出 CrypSteer 激活引导：权重不动，加一个共享方向即把目标安全率提高 5.28–15.00 个百分点。
objective_summary: 用匹配程序对构造修复向量，分析五模型中修复表示的类别与语言结构，提取共享引导方向并在生成时注入以提升密码学 API 使用的安全性。
evidence_note: 48,000 个程序对、五个模型、跨语言跨类别的一致提升（5.28–15.00 点）；自建程序对数据集、无统计检验与真实代码库验证。
novelty_note: 激活引导已有大量工作，将其系统用于密码学 API 修复并发现跨类别共享结构是新的场景化贡献。
scope: 结论适用于十个被测密码学 API 误用类别与五个模型；非密码学的其他安全属性、更大代码任务与下游维护影响未覆盖。
limitations: 程序对为构造数据，与真实误用分布有差距；共享方向可能与其他能力方向纠缠；只报告目标安全率，功能性影响细节有限。

title: How Much Feedback Is Needed to Break Template Protection? The Geometric Vulnerability of Biometric Authentication
abstract: Biometric authentication systems increasingly use privacy-preserving mechanisms to protect sensitive templates. However, the authentication interface itself may still leak information that enables reconstruction attacks. Prior attacks exploit released similarity scores, whereas more advanced systems reveal only the binary accept/reject decision. This binary feedback provides substantially less information, making template reconstruction far more challenging. In this work, we introduce query-efficient reconstruction attacks under extremely limited feedback, addressing two key limitations of prior attacks. First, we introduce the first attack that reconstructs protected biometric templates using only authentication success/failure feedback by exploiting the geometric constraints of biometric authentication. Second, we introduce distribution-aware query-efficient reconstruction methods for score-releasing systems, achieving a more realistic threat model by reducing the number of required queries by a factor of $5\times$ compared to recent prior score-based attacks. Finally, we combine these two insights by incorporating a pretrained facial diffusion prior into our geometric binary attack, reducing the number of required queries by a factor of $5\times$. Our findings reveal a fundamental security limitation of biometric authentication: independently of the template protection mechanism, the authentication process itself exposes geometric information that can enable perfect template reconstruction up to numerical precision. Moreover, the distribution of biometric templates can be leveraged to make significantly more effective reconstruction attacks.

title_cn: 需要多少反馈才能攻破模板保护？生物特征认证的几何脆弱性
abstract_cn: 生物特征认证系统日益使用隐私保护机制来保护敏感模板。然而认证接口本身仍可能泄露可用于重构攻击的信息。既有攻击利用公开的相似度分数，而更先进的系统只给出二元的接受/拒绝决定。这种二元反馈信息量少得多，使模板重构远为困难。本工作提出在极有限反馈下的查询高效重构攻击，解决既有攻击的两个关键局限。第一，我们提出首个仅利用认证成功/失败反馈重构受保护生物特征模板的攻击，其思路是利用生物特征认证的几何约束。第二，我们为释放分数的系统提出分布感知的查询高效重构方法，把所需查询数比近期基于分数的攻击降低 5 倍，达成更现实的威胁模型。最后我们把两者结合：把预训练人脸扩散先验加入几何二元攻击，再把所需查询数降低 5 倍。发现揭示了生物特征认证的一个根本性安全局限：无论模板保护机制如何，认证过程本身暴露的几何信息足以支持精确到数值精度的模板完全重构。此外，生物特征模板的分布可被用来显著增强重构攻击。
summary_cn: 提出首个仅凭接受/拒绝二值反馈重构受保护生物特征模板的几何攻击；结合分布感知与人脸扩散先验，把查询需求较既有分数攻击各降 5 倍，可实现接近数值精度的完全重构。
objective_summary: 设计在二元反馈与分数反馈两种接口下的查询高效模板重构攻击，结合几何约束、分布先验与人脸扩散先验，量化查询代价与重构精度。
evidence_note: 首个二值反馈重构攻击、5 倍查询缩减的量化对比、结合扩散先验；摘要未给出数据集规模、系统数量与统计细节。
novelty_note: 把威胁模型推进到仅二值反馈并达到完全重构，实质突破「模板保护已足够」的假设。
scope: 结论适用于在线可查询的认证接口与人脸等可建分布先验的模态；限速与锁定等运行侧防护、多模态系统未覆盖。
limitations: 需大量在线查询，部署侧限速会削弱可行性；实验细节摘要未报告；非人脸模态未验证。

title: Towards End-to-End Privacy-Preserving AI for Real-Time ECG Monitoring
abstract: Healthcare artificial intelligence is shifting from centralized archives toward distributed pipelines that combine wearables, edge processing, cloud analytics, and multi-institutional learning. In this regime, electrocardiogram (ECG) streams cross multiple trust boundaries, so privacy cannot be reduced to a single transmission control. Existing privacy-enhancing technologies typically secure isolated stages and leave gaps between acquisition, analysis, and institutional collaboration. This doctoral research develops a unified lifecycle framework for end-to-end privacy-preserving ECG AI. Rather than introducing another privacy mechanism, it orchestrates complementary privacy-enhancing technologies across the clinical ECG lifecycle, allocating each mechanism to the trust boundary where its security, computational, and operational properties are most appropriate. Three interoperable modules instantiate the framework: AES with CKKS-based homomorphic statistics for secure monitoring; adaptive chaotic protection for low-latency edge transmission; and federated learning with homomorphic aggregation under heterogeneous partitions. Across prototype monitoring, signal-security analysis, and simulated collaboration, the programme shows that privacy layers can be composed without collapsing diagnostic utility, while exposing overhead and fidelity limits that constrain clinical translation.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to MICCAI 2026 Doctoral Symposium (Springer LNCS)
title_cn: 迈向面向实时心电监测的端到端隐私保护 AI
abstract_cn: 医疗 AI 正从集中式档案转向结合可穿戴设备、边缘处理、云端分析与多机构学习的分布式管线。在这种模式下，心电图（ECG）数据流跨越多个信任边界，隐私无法化归为单一传输控制。现有隐私增强技术通常只保护孤立环节，在采集、分析与机构协作之间留下空隙。本博士研究开发面向端到端隐私保护 ECG AI 的统一生命周期框架：不引入又一个新的隐私机制，而是在临床 ECG 生命周期中编排互补的隐私增强技术，把每种机制分配到其安全、计算与运营性质最合适的信任边界。三个互操作模块实例化该框架：AES 结合基于 CKKS 的同态统计用于安全监测；自适应混沌保护用于低时延边缘传输；异构分区下带同态聚合的联邦学习。通过原型监测、信号安全分析与模拟协作，该项目表明隐私层可以在不摧毁诊断效用的情况下组合，同时暴露了制约临床转化的开销与保真度极限。
summary_cn: 博士研究提出端到端隐私保护 ECG AI 的生命周期框架：按信任边界编排 AES+CKKS 同态统计、自适应混沌保护与联邦同态聚合三模块，原型显示隐私层可组合而不摧毁诊断效用。
objective_summary: 设计把多种隐私增强技术分配到 ECG 生命周期各信任边界的编排框架，以三个模块化原型验证可行性并暴露开销与保真度约束。
evidence_note: MICCAI 2026 Doctoral Symposium 论文：原型级演示与初步分析，无系统基准对比或统计检验。
novelty_note: 各隐私机制均已有，贡献在生命周期编排的框架视角，组合方式常规。
scope: 结论适用于原型规模与模拟协作场景；真实临床部署、监管合规与大规模联邦训练未覆盖。
limitations: 无端到端量化对比；混沌保护的密码学强度论证有限；临床效用评估停留在原型层面。

title: Locate, Then Reason: End-to-End Patch Presence Testing in Stripped Binaries
abstract: Binary patch presence testing (PPT) determines whether a security fix is present in a stripped binary. Prior systems often assume that patch-relevant code is known or successfully matched. Function-level matching is brittle to compilation changes, inlining, finite model context, and missing usage context; moreover, similarity suppresses the patch-sized distinction needed for the verdict. We present PatchAlign, an end-to-end binary PPT workflow, which performs large-scale localization that maximizes recall economically, then the final verdict reasons for patch-specific evidence. PatchAlign uses instruction-aligned retrieval and caller-callee context to accurately locate patch-relevant binary code pieces, then screens the shortlist and compares target binary code with vulnerable and patched references using an LLM. Our experiments indicate that PatchAlign can precisely localize patch-relevant code and determine patch status without a target-location oracle.
title_cn: 先定位、再推理：剥离二进制中的端到端补丁存在性检测
abstract_cn: 二进制补丁存在性检测（PPT）判断一个剥离符号的二进制中是否包含某安全修复。已有系统常假设补丁相关代码已知或能成功匹配。函数级匹配对编译变化、内联、有限的模型上下文与缺失的使用上下文都很脆弱；此外相似度会抹去判定所需的补丁级差异。我们提出 PatchAlign，一个端到端的二进制 PPT 工作流：先做经济地最大化召回的大规模定位，再由最终判定对补丁特异性证据进行推理。PatchAlign 用指令对齐检索与调用者-被调用者上下文准确定位补丁相关的二进制代码片段，然后用 LLM 对候选名单进行筛选，并将目标二进制代码与含漏洞及已修复参照比较。实验表明 PatchAlign 能精确定位补丁相关代码并在无目标位置预言的情况下判定补丁状态。
summary_cn: 提出 PatchAlign 端到端二进制补丁存在性检测：指令对齐检索加调用上下文先定位补丁片段，再用 LLM 对照漏洞/修复参照判定，无需目标位置预言。
objective_summary: 构建定位与判定解耦的补丁存在性检测工作流，用指令对齐检索与 LLM 比较目标二进制与两个版本参照，评估定位精度与判定准确率。
evidence_note: 有实验验证定位与判定，但摘要未给出数据集规模、基线对比与具体数字。
novelty_note: 「先定位后判定」的两阶段设计针对既有 PPT 系统的匹配脆弱与相似度掩盖差异问题，是实质性改进；PPT 方向已有多个系统。
scope: 结论适用于剥离符号二进制与漏洞/修复参照可得的场景；编译器与优化组合的覆盖范围、对抗性混淆未说明。
limitations: 依赖漏洞与修复两个参照二进制的可得性；LLM 判定的成本与可复现性；摘要未报告失败案例与消融细节。

title: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
abstract: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, Sydney. 20 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: 策略不是能力：一些安全基准测量的是你训练时用了哪种「不安全」定义
abstract_cn: 护栏分类器被当作「不安全是文本属性」来报告。它不是：不安全是一种策略的属性，而策略通过标签进入模型。我们利用一次工业部署的偶然条件：同一批约 53k 提示在两种运营定义（「这是否在请求有害内容？」与「审核员是否会屏蔽它？」）下被标注两次，并用于训练十个共享架构、代码库与优化器族的护栏变体，覆盖两个模型规模。第一，护栏自己的训练语料已包含基准：JailbreakBench-benign 的 88% 与 OR-Bench-hard 的 82% 出现在训练池中——这两个都是过度拒答类基准，正是护栏用来论证自己不过度拦截的那类。以下所有结论都在去污染后得出。第二，安全基准按「分数由标签定义而非模型决定的比例」急剧分层：架构与优化器固定时，十个变体在 HarmBench-copyright 上的极差 0.99、在 WildGuard-benign 上 0.043，相差 23 倍。第三，0.03% 的参数即可把基准分数移过其整个量程：HarmBench-copyright 跨 0–100、OR-Bench-hard 过度拒答跨 3.4–56.4%，且最后监督信号携带某一策略的四个变体在两个极端同时占位（精确秩检验 p=0.005，最坏 0.04–0.14），而检测能力不变。对蒸馏学生模型，即便每个硬标签都携带另一策略，教师软标签也会造成同样效果——教师来源是任何已发布检查点中未被记录的混杂变量。第四，在唯一能对全部二十个变体打分的划分上，验证准确率跟踪与标注者策略的一致性（rho=+0.74），而非检测能力（rho=+0.34）。我们主张护栏评估应把污染、种子下限与其所对照的定义作为一等变量报告。
summary_cn: 利用同一批 53k 提示的两种「不安全」定义训练十个护栏变体：基准分数最多 23 倍极差、0.03% 参数即可翻转分数，验证集准确率跟踪策略一致性（rho=0.74）而非检测能力（0.34）；主张报告污染、种子下限与定义。
objective_summary: 以同一部署中双定义标注的 53k 提示与十个护栏变体为受控对象，量化标签定义对安全基准分数、蒸馏与验证指标的影响，并检查训练-基准污染。
evidence_note: 工业级双定义标注的受控变量设计、十个变体两规模、去污染处理、精确秩检验 p=0.005、NeurIPS 2026 TAE workshop 录用；语料来源单一。
novelty_note: 首次以受控双定义训练量化「策略与能力」混淆，发现教师软标签路径与验证集反直觉相关，对评估规范有直接修正意义。
scope: 结论适用于护栏分类器与所测安全基准（HarmBench、OR-Bench、WildGuard、JailbreakBench）；生成式模型本身的安全能力与多语言场景未覆盖。
limitations: 数据来自单一工业部署的两种定义；十个变体仍有架构族限制；「检测能力不变」的度量依赖既有基准。

title: Don't Judge an Agent by Its Messages: Private-State Leakage under Passive Monitoring of Agent Communication
abstract: An AI agent can reproduce the distribution of its messages and of the receiver's task outcomes while disclosing private information that the task never required. We ask what a passive audit can certify when the auditor knows the authorised sender and the exact observable law but has no trusted pairing of messages with the private states behind them. For a single round, compatible mutual-information leakage forms a sharp interval, and fixing the entire task-relevant message law, with every declared task utility, can still leave a full private bit undetermined; total leakage is determined if and only if, in every task state, the remaining private state or the authorised message is a deterministic function of that state. For a sender, such as an LLM, that selects among its own responses, we prove that in a balanced case its change to the message law within each task state equals $(1-2^{-k})$ times the honest messages' dependence on the attribute, which also sets, up to a constant, how many messages a monitor needs. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on a synthetic routing task, selection among 16 responses lets a public decoder recover a private bit in all 8,192 held-out rounds at 98.60\% routing accuracy (honest sender 98.90\%). A monitor that knows the selection rule reaches AUC 0.645 on single messages, close to the ceiling of 0.671 that honest messages predict, and 0.972 over 16, while generic monitors stay near chance. A law-preserving sender built from the same samples recovers the bit in 97.7\% of rounds, and every monitor without the true bit stays near chance against it. A canonical task interface preserves every receiver decision and bounds the remaining information about a balanced attribute by twice the routing-error rate, even for a receiver that shares a key with the sender. These results distinguish what passive auditing can certify from what restricting communication can enforce.
title_cn: 别只看消息：智能体通信被动监控下的私有状态泄露
abstract_cn: AI 智能体可以在复现其消息分布与接收方任务结果分布的同时，泄露任务从未要求的私有信息。我们问：当审计者知道授权发送者与确切的可观测量分布、却没有任何消息与背后私有状态的可信配对时，被动审计能证明什么？对单轮情形，相容的互信息泄露构成一个锐区间，即使固定全部任务相关消息分布与所有声明的任务效用，一个完整的私有比特仍可不被确定；总泄露被确定当且仅当在每个任务状态下，剩余私有状态或授权消息是该状态的确定函数。对在自己响应中选择发送的发送方（如 LLM），我们证明在平衡情形其每任务状态内对消息分布的改变等于 (1-2^-k) 倍诚实消息对属性的依赖，这（差一个常数）也决定了监控器需要的消息数。在合成路由任务上用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct：在 16 个响应中选择，可让公开解码器在全部 8,192 个留出轮次中以 98.60% 路由准确率恢复私有比特（诚实发送者 98.90%）；知道选择规则的监控器在单条消息上 AUC 0.645（接近诚实消息预示的 0.671 上限），16 条上 0.972，而通用监控器接近随机水平。用同一样本构造的保分布发送者可恢复该比特 97.7% 的轮次，且所有不知真值的监控器对其保持随机水平。一个规范任务接口保留接收方每个决策，并把关于平衡属性的剩余信息以路由错误率的两倍为界，即使接收方与发送者共享密钥。这些结果区分了被动审计能证明什么与限制通信能强制什么。
summary_cn: 从理论上刻画智能体通信被动审计的证明边界：任务效用固定仍可隐藏完整私有比特；Qwen2.5-1.5B 路由任务中 16 选 1 泄露全部 8192 轮私有比特，保分布发送者可躲过监控，规范任务接口可将泄露按路由错误率两倍为界。
objective_summary: 建立被动审计下消息分布与私有状态泄露的可识别性理论，分析自选择发送方的泄露量化与监控所需消息数，并用合成路由任务与保分布发送者实验验证理论边界。
evidence_note: 可识别性条件与量化界的完整理论刻画加合成任务实验支撑；实验为单一合成路由任务、单一 1.5B 模型。
novelty_note: 「被动审计能证明什么与限制通信能强制什么」的区分及可识别性刻画是该问题的实质理论贡献。
scope: 结论适用于单轮或有限消息、可观测量分布已知的设定；多轮交互、非参数审计者与真实部署日志未覆盖。
limitations: 实验为合成路由任务与小模型，外部效度有限；理论界依赖分布知识假设；规范任务接口的可用性代价未评估。

title: SoK: PIAtlas: Decomposing the Unbounded Prompt Injection Attack Space
abstract: Prompt injection is the dominant security risk for large-language-model (LLM) applications and agents, yet the field still lacks a coherent map of how these attacks are constructed. More than twenty public datasets describe prompt injection using incompatible vocabularies, often organized around delivery vector, attacker goal, or generation method. In this Systematization of Knowledge, we present PIAtlas, a taxonomy organized instead around how the injected instruction is constructed to subvert the underlying model. Its six classes, one per subversion mechanism, form the roots of a hierarchy of techniques and sub-techniques that researchers can use to describe attacks consistently and design more systematic evaluations. We derive the taxonomy from how LLMs are trained, prompted, and influenced by human-like framing, and compare it with historical attack data. To ground this comparison, we release PICorpus, to our knowledge the largest license-clean collection of public prompt-injection datasets, and map thousands of its records to PIAtlas under a human-verified protocol. The mapping shows that attacks usually combine several techniques drawn from only a few mechanisms. It also reveals gaps that existing labels obscure: widely used agent benchmarks test only part of the attack space, and adaptive attackers favor mechanisms that curated benchmarks underrepresent. PIAtlas thus provides a common foundation for understanding this attack space, improving benchmark coverage, and guiding red teaming and defenses.

title_cn: SoK: PIAtlas——分解无界的提示注入攻击空间
abstract_cn: 提示注入是大语言模型（LLM）应用与智能体的首要安全风险，但该领域仍缺乏一张关于这些攻击如何构造的连贯地图。超过二十个公开数据集用互不兼容的词汇描述提示注入，通常围绕投递载体、攻击者目标或生成方法组织。在本系统化（SoK）工作中，我们提出 PIAtlas——转而围绕「注入的指令如何构造以颠覆底层模型」组织的分类法。其六个类（每个颠覆机制一个）构成技术与子技术层级的根，研究者可用它一致地描述攻击并设计更系统的评估。该分类法从 LLM 的训练、提示与受类人框架影响的方式推导，并与历史攻击数据比较。为支撑比较，我们发布 PICorpus——据我们所知最大的许可干净（license-clean）提示注入公开数据集合集——并在人工验证协议下把数千条记录映射到 PIAtlas。映射显示攻击通常组合来自少数机制的多种技术；还揭示了既有标签遮蔽的空白：广泛使用的智能体基准只覆盖攻击空间的一部分，而适应性攻击者偏好精选基准低估的机制。PIAtlas 由此为理解该攻击空间、改进基准覆盖与指导红队和防御提供共同基础。
summary_cn: 提出 PIAtlas 提示注入分类法（按颠覆机制分六类）与最大许可干净数据集合集 PICorpus：人工验证映射显示攻击常组合少数机制，常用智能体基准只覆盖部分攻击空间、低估适应性攻击者偏好的机制。
objective_summary: 构建按注入指令构造方式组织的提示注入分类体系，发布 PICorpus 语料并以人工验证协议映射数据，分析基准覆盖缺口。
evidence_note: 系统化工作：人工验证映射协议、最大许可干净语料、与历史攻击数据的对比分析；无新攻击实验。
novelty_note: 首个以「颠覆机制」为轴的提示注入系统化分类，暴露既有基准的覆盖缺口；PICorpus 资源价值大。
scope: 分类覆盖公开数据集所代表的攻击构造方式；非公开攻击、多模态注入与新模型架构下的机制变化未涵盖。
limitations: 映射依赖公开数据集的记录质量；六类边界对边界样本可能不唯一；对防御设计的指导仍是方向性。

title: Hierarchical Rule Auditing with Exact Ternary GPU Correlation
abstract: Auditing firewall logs against requirements mapped to controls and frameworks must retain overlapping obligations, preserve uncertainty from missing attributes and count distinct affected records. Direct, bitmap and relational methods can express this audit; a correlation implementation must preserve distinctions that ordinary match counts and rule-hit totals discard. We present an exact ternary correlation algorithm that compiles categorical conjunctions into one bounded-integer matrix product. A dominating false-predicate penalty separates known mismatches from missing evidence, while per-record hierarchy unions prevent duplicate counting. We prove their composition and handle high-cardinality endpoints through exact address classes and versioned labels. Evaluation compares eight CPU/GPU implementations, includes public traffic and 133 published source-address ACLs with generated observations, and measures hierarchy and policy-rebuild costs. On an NVIDIA L4, matched fused execution reduces latency by 8.8 to 11.2 percent relative to two-product correlation across five tested shapes. At 100,000 records and 1,024 requirements, it takes 12.28 ms versus 13.82 ms for two products and 12.29 ms for GPU bitmaps. Bitmaps remain faster in most regimes, with hierarchy operations and reductions dominating the measured fused-correlation stage intervals.
title_cn: 基于精确三元 GPU 相关的层级规则审计
abstract_cn: 将防火墙日志对照映射到控制项与合规框架的需求进行审计，必须保留相互重叠的义务、保留因属性缺失带来的不确定性，并对受影响的去重记录计数。直接法、位图法与关系法都能表达这类审计；相关实现必须保留普通匹配计数与规则命中总数会丢弃的区分。我们提出一个精确三元相关算法，把类别合取编译为单个有界整数矩阵乘积。占优的假谓词惩罚把已知不匹配与证据缺失区分开，而按记录的层级并集防止重复计数。我们证明两者的复合正确性，并通过精确地址类与带版本标签处理高基数端点。评估比较八种 CPU/GPU 实现，包含公共流量与 133 条已发布源地址 ACL 及生成的观测，并测量层级与策略重建成本。在 NVIDIA L4 上，匹配的融合执行在五种测试形状下比双乘积相关降低 8.8–11.2% 时延；在 10 万记录、1024 需求下为 12.28 ms，双乘积 13.82 ms，GPU 位图 12.29 ms。位图在大多数区间仍更快，层级运算与归约主导所测融合相关阶段的时间。
summary_cn: 提出防火墙合规审计的精确三元相关算法：类别合取编译为有界整数矩阵积、假谓词惩罚区分不匹配与证据缺失；L4 上 10 万记录×1024 需求 12.28 ms，但多数区间位图法仍更快。
objective_summary: 设计保留重叠义务、缺失证据区分与去重计数的层级规则审计算法并证明正确性，与八种 CPU/GPU 实现在真实 ACL 与生成观测上比较。
evidence_note: 正确性证明、八种实现对比、公开 ACL 与生成观测、多形状测量；改进幅度 8.8–11.2% 且总体不如位图法。
novelty_note: 三值逻辑与位图审计的已知思路的精确实现与性能对比，增量性明显。
scope: 结论适用于被测记录规模与需求维度（10 万×1024）及 L4 GPU；更大规模与真实企业审计负载未测。
limitations: 相对位图法总体无优势；部分观测数据为生成；策略语义覆盖限于实现支持的类别合取。

title: BitPCE: Batched Multi-Dimensional PolicyResolution with GPU Bitmap Algebra
abstract: Policy controllers must determine which workloads match rules spanning several label dimensions. Hash sets, compressed bitmaps, and GPU set-processing primitives address the underlying set operations. However, intermediate results, repeated scope evaluations, dependent policy updates, and host transfers can dominate the cost of a heterogeneous batch. We study this problem as batched intersection-of-unions (IoU). Our design exploits independent scope--word tasks, reusable endpoint expressions, and policy dependencies. The challenges are preserving wildcard, empty-group, and exclusion semantics, recognizing equal scopes, and retaining unchanged recipients affected by source edits. BitPCE addresses them with register-resident GPU evaluation, canonical scope compilation, and dependency-complete candidate selection under a stated rendering contract. IP-only changes reuse cached memberships. We establish correctness and word-work bounds. On a four-vCPU A10G host, resident GPU execution is 3.46--36.60$\times$ faster than the best tested native CPU path, including CRoaring, and 1.14--2.22$\times$ faster than an adapted operand-parallel GPU reduction. Gains narrow at the host-output boundary: on an eight-vCPU host, including upload and compact identifier output, resolution takes 16.3 ms versus 19.3 ms for CPU at 100K objects and 500 scopes. Sparse labels and small batches can favor CPU execution. Scope reuse, candidate selection, and incremental transfers are measured as components; complete update-to-enforcement latency remains unevaluated.
title_cn: BitPCE：基于 GPU 位图代数的批量多维策略解析
abstract_cn: 策略控制器需要判定哪些工作负载匹配跨多个标签维度的规则。哈希集合、压缩位图与 GPU 集合处理原语都能完成底层集合运算，但中间结果、重复的范围求值、相互依赖的策略更新与主机传输可能主导异构批次的成本。我们把该问题形式化为批量「并集的交集」（IoU）。设计利用独立的范围-字任务、可复用的端点表达式与策略依赖关系。挑战包括保持通配符、空组与排除语义、识别相等范围，以及保留受源编辑影响但自身未变的接收者。BitPCE 以寄存器驻留的 GPU 求值、规范范围编译与在既述渲染契约下的依赖完备候选选择解决这些问题；仅 IP 变更时复用缓存成员关系。我们建立正确性与字工作量界。在四 vCPU A10G 主机上，驻留 GPU 执行比测试过的最快原生 CPU 路径（含 CRoaring）快 3.46–36.60 倍，比改造的操作数并行 GPU 归约快 1.14–2.22 倍。收益在主机输出边界收窄：在八 vCPU 主机上计入上传与紧凑标识符输出后，10 万对象、500 范围的解析为 16.3 ms，CPU 为 19.3 ms。稀疏标签与小批次可能更适合 CPU。范围复用、候选选择与增量传输按组件测量；从更新到生效的完整时延未评估。
summary_cn: 把多维策略匹配形式化为批量 IoU，提出 BitPCE 寄存器驻留 GPU 方案：比 CRoaring 等 CPU 路径快 3.46–36.60 倍，含输出端到端 16.3 ms 对 CPU 19.3 ms（10 万对象、500 范围）。
objective_summary: 形式化批量策略解析问题并给出保持通配/空组/排除语义的 GPU 位图实现，建立正确性与工作量界，在 CPU 与 GPU 基线上测量性能。
evidence_note: 正确性证明、多种基线（CRoaring、操作数并行 GPU 归约）、明确测量协议与边界条件；单机实验、负载自建。
novelty_note: 把已知 GPU 集合运算技术工程化到策略解析场景，属增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于被测规模（10 万对象、500 范围）与 A10G 类 GPU；更大规模、分布式部署与更新到生效的完整时延未评估。
limitations: 端到端收益在含输出时显著收窄；稀疏标签与小批次更适合 CPU；策略语义覆盖限于既述渲染契约。

title: Same Data, Different Bytes: Serialization-Invariant Integrity Checks for Agent-Published Datasets
abstract: Agent networks require reliable ways for requesting agents to verify where data is located, how it can be accessed, and whether the data received matches what the data owner made available. Checksum mismatches can reflect either altered content or serialization differences that preserve data equivalence under specified rules. Data identification mechanisms for agents, such as DataFacts, describe where data can be accessed and provide checksums for checking received data against published references. We propose a serialization-invariant identification method that assigns the same identifier to data representations equivalent under explicit rules. We use DataFacts as a case study, retaining its existing checksum alongside the proposed identifier. In a controlled agent study, we compare the proposed configuration with ordinary-tool and checksum baselines across equivalent re-encodings, altered content, and unavailable references. The study includes three model tiers from each of two providers. For equivalent re-encodings, the proposed configuration increased expected-outcome rates by 80.4 percentage points over the ordinary-tool baseline and by 70.2 percentage points over the checksum baseline. The proposed configuration also increased evidence-supported rejection of altered content by 3.5 percentage points over the checksum baseline. We contribute a serialization-invariant identification method with explicit equivalence rules, an integration approach illustrated through DataFacts, and an empirical evaluation against ordinary-tool and checksum baselines.
