title_cn: 面向录制感知的多模态 OT 入侵检测评估
abstract_cn: 面向运营技术（OT）的基于机器学习的入侵检测系统（IDS）通常在正常与攻击数据分别录制的基准数据集上评估。在这类设置下，高性能可能既反映攻击行为，也反映与录制相关的差异。我们提出一套录制感知的评估流程：将攻击窗口与同一录制中的背景比较、用先验数据做模型拟合与校准、以随机化事件时刻表检验时间对齐，并同时报告事件覆盖率与告警负担。在 ProvICS 多模态数据集上，网络模态在第一个标注攻击之前就能强烈区分良性录制与攻击录制。同录制评估在所有研究的窗口尺寸上逆转了表观的模态排序：物理视图成为最强的单一模态，而纯网络融合在跨录制与同录制 AUC 之间差异最大，达 0.54。运营分析进一步表明，宽松的事件重叠指标在少量长告警片段覆盖多个动作时会高估检测能力。在 HAI 上的外部分析显示更小且依赖参考的录制敏感性。这些发现表明，跨录制基准性能应与同录制、前向、时间与运营评估一同解读。
summary_cn: 提出录制感知 IDS 评估流程：ProvICS 上网络模态在首个攻击前即可区分录制，同录制评估逆转模态排序（物理视图最强），纯网络融合的跨/同录制 AUC 差达 0.54，宽松事件重叠指标会高估检测。
objective_summary: 设计将攻击窗口与同录制背景比较、含时间对齐检验与告警负担报告的录制感知评估流程，并在 ProvICS 与 HAI 上量化跨录制评估对模态排序与检测结论的扭曲。
evidence_note: ACSAC 2026 工作坊 ICSS 录用、代码与结果公开、ProvICS 加 HAI 外部分析、多窗口尺寸、随机化事件时刻表对照；数据集规模有限、非真实部署。
novelty_note: 指出并量化「录制间差异」这一 OT IDS 基准的系统性混淆，同录制评估直接逆转既有模态排序结论，流程可复用于其他数据集。
scope: 结论适用于 ProvICS 类多模态 OT 数据集与按录制分组的 IDS 基准；HAI 上效应更小且依赖参考，其他数据集需重新检验。
limitations: 只在两个数据集上验证；事件重叠指标分析限于所研究设置；未给出修正后的公共基准排名。

title: Under the Skin: Backdoor Infection in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance in generating text conditioned on inputs from different modalities. In this work, we introduce backdoor infection, a cross-modal attack framework targeting MLLMs. Starting from a model already injected with a backdoor in one modality, our attack constructs a corresponding trigger in another modality, called the infected modality. Exploiting the model's shared latent space, the trigger in the infected modality reliably activates the malicious behavior, without modifying or poisoning the infected modality during training. We further develop a lightweight, constraint-aware optimization method for efficient and practical trigger generation. Extensive experiments across several state-of-the-art MLLMs, including LLaVA, InternVL, Qwen-VL, and Gemma, demonstrate that our approach identifies cross-modal triggers that are more efficient, effective, and less detectable than direct optimization baselines, highlighting a critical new threat vector in multimodal systems.
title_cn: 皮下之刺：多模态大语言模型中的后门感染
abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在以不同模态输入为条件生成文本方面表现出色。本工作提出「后门感染」，一个针对 MLLM 的跨模态攻击框架。从一个已在某一模态被注入后门的模型出发，该攻击在另一模态（称为被感染模态）中构造对应触发器。利用模型共享的潜在空间，被感染模态中的触发器能可靠激活恶意行为，且训练期间无需修改或投毒被感染模态。我们进一步开发一种轻量、带约束感知的优化方法以高效实用地生成触发器。在 LLaVA、InternVL、Qwen-VL、Gemma 等多个最新 MLLM 上的大量实验表明，该方法找到的跨模态触发器比直接优化基线更高效、更有效且更难检测，揭示了多模态系统中一个关键的新威胁向量。
summary_cn: 提出跨模态「后门感染」：利用共享潜在空间，在一个模态已有后门的 MLLM 中为另一模态构造触发器，无需投毒被感染模态即可激活恶意行为，在 LLaVA、InternVL、Qwen-VL、Gemma 上比直接优化更高效更隐蔽。
objective_summary: 提出并演示跨模态后门感染攻击，开发带约束感知的轻量触发器优化方法，在多个 MLLM 上与直接优化基线比较触发器的效率、有效性与可检测性。
evidence_note: 四个主流 MLLM（LLaVA、InternVL、Qwen-VL、Gemma）上与直接优化基线系统比较；摘要未给出具体成功率数字、数据规模与统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出跨模态后门「感染」这一新威胁向量：单模态后门可扩散到训练时未投毒的模态，威胁模型有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于具有共享潜在空间的 MLLM（LLaVA、InternVL、Qwen-VL、Gemma）；触发器跨模态对组合、对现有后门检测器的覆盖与真实下游系统未评估。
limitations: 以模型已在某一模态被注入后门为前提；摘要未报告对现有后门防御的评估；触发器通用性与供应链前提讨论有限。

title: ToolRosetta: Surface-Form Invariance of Tool-Call Guards
abstract: Step-level guards for tool-using agents are evaluated on tidy JSON tool calls, but deployed coding agents act through execute_bash and execute_code tools whose payloads are strings. We introduce ToolRosetta, which re-renders every candidate action in the AgentDojo and AgentHarm splits of TS-Bench as a Python call, as a shell command, and without the agent's rationale. The renderings are produced by code and verified by round-trip parsing, so the user request, the history, the label and the action's effect stay fixed while only the surface form changes. Across eleven guards with two placebo controls, frontier and strong open-weight guards are stable: no frontier error rate moves by more than 3.4 points. Four of five specialized agent guards are not: under the shell form their false-positive rates rise by 21 to 47 points on AgentDojo, and TS-Guard's by 38 points on its own home benchmark, blocking between a third and nine in ten benign actions; the fifth, StepGuard, does not move. A small open guard drifts five points more permissive. Removing the agent's rationale moves most guards whose input carries it, in guard-specific directions. A request-blind control on one guard shows that the rationale is where intent is read from. A parser that restores the canonical call in front of the guard removes the effect for these renderings, by construction. Benchmark accuracy on JSON calls does not predict a guard's operating point behind a code-acting agent.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD). 4 pages plus appendices
title_cn: ToolRosetta：工具调用守卫的表层形式不变性
abstract_cn: 工具使用智能体的步级守卫在整洁的 JSON 工具调用上评估，但部署的编码智能体通过 payload 为字符串的 execute_bash 与 execute_code 工具行动。我们提出 ToolRosetta，把 TS-Bench 的 AgentDojo 与 AgentHarm 切分中的每个候选动作重渲染为 Python 调用、shell 命令以及去掉智能体推理说明的版本。渲染由代码生成并经往返解析验证，因此用户请求、历史、标签与动作效果保持不变，只有表层形式变化。在十一个守卫与两个安慰剂对照上，前沿与强开源权重守卫稳定：没有任何前沿守卫的错误率移动超过 3.4 个点。五个专用智能体守卫中有四个不稳定：在 shell 形式下它们在 AgentDojo 上的假阳性率上升 21 至 47 个点，TS-Guard 在其自家基准上上升 38 个点，把三分之一到十分之九的良性动作拦下；第五个 StepGuard 不动。一个小型开源守卫变得更宽松 5 个点。去掉智能体推理说明会使大多数输入含推理说明的守卫移动，方向因守卫而异。对一个守卫的请求盲对照表明推理说明正是其读取意图之处。在守卫前恢复规范调用的解析器按构造消除了这些渲染的影响。在 JSON 调用上的基准准确率不能预测守卫在代码执行型智能体背后的工作点。
summary_cn: 提出 ToolRosetta 重渲染框架检验工具守卫的表层不变性：五个专用智能体守卫中四个在 shell 形式下假阳性率升 21–47 点、TS-Guard 在自家基准升 38 点，而前沿守卫移动 ≤3.4 点；JSON 基准准确率不能预测真实工作点。
objective_summary: 构建由代码生成、往返解析验证的动作重渲染管线，在保持请求、历史、标签与效果不变的前提下改变工具调用的表层形式与是否含推理说明，测量十一个守卫的判定漂移。
evidence_note: 十一个守卫、TS-Bench 两个切分、代码生成加往返解析验证的受控变换、安慰剂与请求盲对照、NeurIPS 2026 AIWILD workshop 录用；未报告统计检验细节。
novelty_note: 首次系统揭示守卫对表层形式的不变性缺失这一被 JSON 基准掩盖的失效模式，并给出按构造修复的解析器；诊断价值直接。
scope: 结论适用于 TS-Bench 的 AgentDojo/AgentHarm 切分与被测的十一个守卫；其他基准、其他渲染形式与运行时解析修复之外的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 只测 Python/shell 两种重渲染加去推理说明；修复解析器只在所测渲染上验证；专用守卫间的实现差异未逐一归因。

title: Red-Teaming Multi-Agent Attacks for Loss-of-Control Risks
abstract: AI agents are growing more capable and persistent, and are being deployed in ever larger numbers. As more start collaborating, AI control measures must remain effective when they covertly collude on a harmful objective. We introduce MiniLab, a synthetic series of live services and codebases (5 interconnected services, 249 benign tasks, 8 attack objectives), adapted from internal AI deployment infrastructure. We demonstrate distributed attacks, in which different agents carry out separate attack fragments, and how their covertness evades frontier monitors when reading their trajectories individually. We show how distributed attacks spread across diverse contexts and harmful objectives through 16 human-optimized attacks (weight exfiltration, unmonitored rogue deployment, permission elevation, and more). A frontier monitor, GPT-5.6 Sol, reading each agent separately flags only 7% of successful distributed attacks, compared with 87% when a single agent carries out the same side task. Individual attacks can also be composed into longer attack sequences toward a greater loss-of-control outcome, without any individual agent being flagged. Finally, we tested whether models can plan these covert attacks: even with execution and monitor feedback, the best model-planned attacks succeed covertly against a single-trajectory GPT-5.6 Sol monitor in at most 25% of executions, compared with 80% for human-crafted plans, though this may scale with model capabilities. By turning worst-case coordinated attacks into reproducible red-team cases, our work provides a foundation for preventing locally benign agent actions from accumulating into system-level loss of control.
title_cn: 针对失控风险的多智能体攻击红队测试
abstract_cn: AI 智能体的能力与存续性不断提升，部署规模也越来越大。随着更多智能体开始协作，AI 控制措施必须在它们为有害目标隐蔽串通时仍然有效。我们提出 MiniLab，一组合成但真实运行的服务与代码库（5 个互联服务、249 个良性任务、8 个攻击目标），改编自内部 AI 部署基础设施。我们演示了分布式攻击：不同智能体分别执行攻击片段，其隐蔽性在监控器逐个阅读轨迹时逃过前沿监控。通过 16 个人工优化的攻击（权重外传、无监控的恶意部署、权限提升等），我们展示分布式攻击如何跨多样上下文与有害目标扩散。前沿监控器 GPT-5.6 Sol 逐个阅读各智能体时只标记 7% 的成功分布式攻击，而单一智能体执行同一侧任务时为 87%。单次攻击还可组合成更长的攻击序列以达成更大的失控结果，且没有任何单个智能体被标记。最后我们测试模型能否规划这些隐蔽攻击：即使有执行与监控器反馈，最好的模型规划攻击对单轨迹 GPT-5.6 Sol 监控器的隐蔽成功率至多 25%，而人工设计计划为 80%，尽管这可能随模型能力扩展。通过把最坏情形的协调攻击转化为可复现的红队案例，本工作为防止局部良性的智能体行动累积为系统级失控奠定基础。
summary_cn: 提出 MiniLab 多智能体失控红队环境：分布式攻击下前沿监控器 GPT-5.6 Sol 仅标记 7%（单智能体 87%）；16 个人工攻击可隐蔽串联，最优模型规划攻击的隐蔽成功率至多 25%（人工计划 80%）。
objective_summary: 构建包含 5 个互联服务、249 个良性任务与 8 个攻击目标的合成多智能体部署环境 MiniLab，演示并量化分布式多智能体攻击对单轨迹监控器的规避能力，并测试模型自主规划此类攻击的上限。
evidence_note: 真实运行的服务与代码库、249 个任务、8 个攻击目标、16 个人工优化攻击、与前沿监控器（GPT-5.6 Sol）的量化对比；环境为合成改编，非真实生产系统。
novelty_note: 把「分布式多智能体隐蔽攻击 vs 单轨迹监控」这一失控风险做成首个系统化可复现评估环境，量化了监控盲区（7% 对 87%）。
scope: 结论适用于类 MiniLab 的多服务智能体部署环境与单轨迹监控架构；跨监控器聚合方案、真实生产系统及更强模型的规划能力演化未覆盖。
limitations: 环境为内部基础设施的合成改编，外部效度有差距；监控器只测了单轨迹阅读的 GPT-5.6 Sol；模型规划成功率可能随模型能力上升。

title: The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections
abstract: LLM agents that read untrusted content can be hijacked by prompt injections. Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read. We test this assumption with branching rollouts that replay an episode exactly up to the step at which the agent reads an injection and then resample the rest of the episode many times, splitting the outcome variance into a part fixed at read time and a part decided afterwards. Across four AgentDojo suites, a Qwen3 agent without thinking is largely decided at read time (0.91 of the outcome variance lies between states); with thinking on, this share drops to 0.62 (95% CI of the drop [-0.38, -0.22]), in the same direction for three attack templates and two success labels. How much is fixed at read time is a property of the model that the same measurement reveals, and thinking lowers the attack success rate of Qwen3 but raises it for two other models. Resampling from reasoning prefixes shows that the decision forms gradually as the agent reasons. Zero-shot chain-of-thought monitors built on cheaper models miss much of what is already decided, whereas stronger monitors, and a lookahead monitor that judges simulated next actions, come close to what the prefix determines. Finally, single-run labels of thinking agents disagree with a rerun up to 35% of the time, so benchmarks need repeated runs per task.
title_cn: 窗口在推理中：LLM 智能体何时决定遵循提示注入
abstract_cn: 读取不可信内容的 LLM 智能体可能被提示注入劫持。试图在智能体行动前捕捉劫持的运行时监控器，以及用单次运行给每个任务打分的基准，共享一个假设：智能体是否遵循注入在读入注入的那一刻就已确定。我们用分支回放检验这一假设：把回合精确回放到智能体读入注入的那一步，然后多次重采样余下的回合，把结果方差分解为「读入时已固定」与「之后才决定」两部分。在四个 AgentDojo 套件上，关闭思考的 Qwen3 智能体基本在读入时就已确定（结果方差的 0.91 落在各状态之间）；开启思考后这一份额降到 0.62（下降的 95% 置信区间 [-0.38, -0.22]），在三种攻击模板与两种成功标签下方向一致。读入时固定的比例是同一测量所揭示的模型属性；思考降低 Qwen3 的攻击成功率，却在另外两个模型上抬高它。从推理前缀重采样表明，决定随智能体推理逐渐成形。基于更廉价模型的零样本思维链监控器会漏掉大量「已确定」的结果，而更强的监控器以及评判模拟下一步行动的前瞻监控器接近前缀所决定的上限。最后，思考型智能体的单次运行标签与重跑不一致的比例最高达 35%，因此基准需要对每个任务多次运行。
summary_cn: 分支回放把注入结果方差分解为「读入时已定」与「其后才定」：Qwen3 关思考时 0.91 的方差在读入时已定，开思考降至 0.62；思考降 Qwen3 攻击成功率却升另两个模型，且思考型智能体单次标注与重跑不一致最高 35%。
objective_summary: 用分支回放把智能体遵循注入的结果方差分解为读入时固定的部分与之后决定的部分，量化不同模型与思考模式下的份额，并评估运行时监控器能恢复多少已定信息以及单次运行标注的不一致率。
evidence_note: 四个 AgentDojo 套件、三种攻击模板、两种成功标签、多个模型（Qwen3 及另两个模型）上的分支重采样，给出 95% 置信区间；为模拟智能体环境而非真实部署。
novelty_note: 首次把「注入结果在何时被决定」作为可测量并量化，直接修正单次运行基准与读时监控假设；对监控器设计有直接诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于 AgentDojo 类任务型智能体、被测的 Qwen3 等模型与三种注入模板；其他任务域、其他监控架构与多轮长程任务未覆盖。
limitations: 限于 AgentDojo 模拟任务与特定攻击模板；思考对攻击成功率的影响方向因模型而异，机制未完全解释；前瞻监控器的额外成本未系统报告。

title: Bad Diagnosis: Analyzing Consent and Data Collection Practices of Mobile Medical Apps
abstract: Mobile health (mHealth) apps collect personally-identifiable information while handling uniquely sensitive medical data, ranging from mental health records to real-time glucose or heart rate monitoring -- yet they remain poorly understood at scale. We present the first comprehensive analysis of consent and data collection practices across 10,000+ mHealth apps on the Google Play Store, combining static analysis and privacy policy examination. We develop a rigorous operational definition to distinguish health apps from general wellness programs, and design a measurement framework to detect misuse of permissions and violations of consent. Our analyses reveal a troubling ecosystem: 69.15% of apps request at least one permission unrelated to their stated purpose, with over 52.9% apps requesting location data, and 50.5% and 34.9% apps requesting camera and microphone access, respectively -- despite no functional justification based on app descriptions and stated purposes. Most alarmingly, nearly 93% of apps fail to provide users with a consent form, directly violating regulatory requirements such as GDPR; and even among the remaining 7%, 1 in 14 demonstrate a gap between the obtained consent and collection of personally identifiable information. These findings demonstrate an urgent need for stronger enforcement of privacy regulations in mHealth apps. We plan to release our dataset and measurement tools for continued monitoring of this critical space.
title_cn: 错误的诊断：移动医疗应用的同意与数据收集实践分析
abstract_cn: 移动健康（mHealth）应用在处理从心理健康档案到实时血糖或心率监测等独特敏感医疗数据的同时收集个人可识别信息，但其生态在规模上仍缺乏理解。我们对 Google Play 商店 10,000+ mHealth 应用的同意与数据收集实践进行首个综合分析，结合静态分析与隐私政策审查。我们开发严格的操作性定义区分健康应用与一般健身项目，并设计检测权限滥用与同意违规的测量框架。分析揭示了一个令人不安的生态：69.15% 的应用请求至少一个与其声明目的无关的权限，超过 52.9% 请求位置数据，50.5% 与 34.9% 分别请求相机与麦克风访问——尽管基于应用描述与声明目的并无功能必要性。最令人担忧的是，近 93% 的应用未向用户提供同意表单，直接违反 GDPR 等监管要求；即使在剩余 7% 中，每 14 个就有 1 个存在所获同意与个人可识别信息收集之间的落差。这些发现表明 mHealth 应用亟需更强的隐私监管执行。我们计划发布数据集与测量工具以持续监测这一关键领域。
summary_cn: 万级 mHealth 应用测量：69.15% 请求无关权限、52.9% 索要位置、近 93% 无同意表单（违反 GDPR）；剩余 7% 中每 14 个有 1 个同意与收集不符。计划发布数据集与工具。
objective_summary: 以静态分析与隐私政策审查对 10,000+ mHealth 应用做权限滥用与同意违规的规模化测量，并给出操作性分类与测量框架。
evidence_note: 10,000+ 真实应用的大规模在野测量，静态分析与隐私政策交叉验证，报告 69.15%/52.9%/93% 等具体比例；数据集与工具承诺发布。
novelty_note: 首次对 mHealth 生态的同意与数据收集做万级综合测量，并给出区分健康与健身应用的操作性定义与可复用测量框架。
scope: 结论适用于 Google Play 上的英文 mHealth 应用生态；对 iOS、区域分发差异及动态加载行为的隐私实践覆盖有限。
limitations: 静态分析难以覆盖运行时动态收集；隐私政策解析存在误判可能；测量为时间点快照，生态随时间演化。

title: Task-aware Kernel Stein certificates for Rényi differential privacy
abstract: R\`enyi differential privacy, based on R\`enyi divergence, has become a notion of choice for privacy guarantees. However, outside the Gaussian setting, R\`enyi divergence can be difficult to compute. In particular, R\`enyi differential privacy guarantees that exploit task-specific information, as in R\`enyi Pufferfish privacy, can be challenging. Here we use kernel Stein discrepancies based on escort distributions to provide certificates for R\`enyi differential privacy. By designing the kernel to focus on the relevant privacy directions, we also derive task-aware privacy certificates. We provide exact identities for Gaussian and Laplace mechanisms and bounds for exponential mechanisms, with separate task-aware guarantees. A real data set example illustrates how the protected comparison set and the released subspace jointly determine the resulting certificates.
title_cn: Rényi 差分隐私的任务感知核 Stein 证书
abstract_cn: 基于 Rényi 散度的 Rényi 差分隐私已成为隐私保证的常用概念。但在高斯设定之外，Rényi 散度可能难以计算：利用任务特定信息的 Rényi 差分隐私保证（如 Rényi Pufferfish 隐私）尤其困难。我们使用基于 escort 分布的核 Stein 散度为 Rényi 差分隐私提供证书；通过设计聚焦相关隐私方向的核，还导出任务感知隐私证书。我们给出高斯机制与拉普拉斯机制的精确恒等式，以及指数机制的界，其中任务感知保证单独给出。一个真实数据集示例说明受保护的比较集与发布子空间如何共同决定所得证书。
summary_cn: 用 escort 分布上的核 Stein 散度构造 Rényi 差分隐私证书：高斯/拉普拉斯机制有精确恒等式、指数机制有界，任务感知证书由隐私方向与发布子空间共同决定。
objective_summary: 提出以核 Stein 散度构造 Rényi 差分隐私（含任务感知 Pufferfish 变体）可计算证书的方法，并给出常见机制的恒等式与界。
evidence_note: 给出高斯/拉普拉斯机制的精确恒等式与指数机制的界，并以一个真实数据集示例说明；理论完整但实证仅一例。
novelty_note: 核 Stein 散度与 escort 分布为已有工具，新意在于把它们引入 Rényi（含任务感知）差分隐私证书这一新用途。
scope: 适用于满足核条件（如分数函数可估）的分布与机制；对离散高维空间或核条件不成立的机制未覆盖。
limitations: 证书质量依赖核与隐私方向的选取；指数机制仅给出界而非精确值；实证演示限于单一数据集。

title: RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLMs
abstract: Red teaming must continually adapt as frontier LLM safeguards evolve, yet existing approaches largely search for adversarial prompts or optimize within fixed attack procedures. We observe that even when an attack becomes ineffective, its underlying mechanisms can remain useful and can be revised or recombined to construct stronger attacks. Based on this insight, we introduce RedDarwin, an agentic framework that shifts the unit of jailbreak evolution from prompts and fixed attacks to executable attack skills. RedDarwin consists of 47 reusable base skills and autonomously revises, composes, executes, and selects them using target-model feedback, allowing successful discoveries to become building blocks for subsequent evolution. RedDarwin produces 65 evolved skills, improving 44 of 47 base attacks and increasing their mean attack success rate (ASR) on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%. These evolved skills consistently outperform baselines on the held-out StrongREJECT and frontier LLMs unseen during evolution; with only 10 target-model queries, RedDarwin achieves 100% ASR on GPT-5.6-Sol, 92% on Claude-Sonnet-5, and 80% on Gemini-3.8-Flash. Analysis of the evolution trajectories further shows that strong attacks often emerge from novel combinations of reusable mechanisms rather than from individually dominant ones. We believe this paradigm can accelerate adaptive red teaming and inform stronger safeguards, creating complementary value for both safety evaluation and defense.
title_cn: RedDarwin：针对前沿 LLM 的进化越狱技能
abstract_cn: 红队必须随前沿 LLM 防护的演化持续适应，但现有方法大多搜索对抗性提示或在固定攻击流程内优化。我们观察到，即使攻击失效，其底层机制仍可能有用，可被修订或重组以构造更强攻击。基于这一洞见，我们提出 RedDarwin，一个把越狱演化单元从提示与固定攻击转移到可执行攻击技能的智能体框架。RedDarwin 由 47 个可复用基础技能构成，利用目标模型反馈自主修订、组合、执行与选择技能，让成功发现成为后续演化的构件。RedDarwin 产出 65 个演化技能，改进 47 个基础攻击中的 44 个，把 AdvBench 上平均攻击成功率（ASR）从 18.8% 提到 47.3%。这些演化技能在留出的 StrongREJECT 与演化期间未见的前沿 LLM 上持续超过基线：仅用 10 次目标模型查询，RedDarwin 在 GPT-5.6-Sol 上达 100% ASR、Claude-Sonnet-5 上 92%、Gemini-3.8-Flash 上 80%。对演化轨迹的分析进一步显示，强攻击往往来自可复用机制的新颖组合而非单个占优机制。我们相信该范式能加速自适应红队并为更强防护提供信息，为安全评估与防御创造互补价值。
summary_cn: 技能级进化红队框架 RedDarwin：47 个基础技能进化出 65 个，AdvBench 平均 ASR 18.8%→47.3%；10 次查询在 GPT-5.6-Sol 达 100%、Claude-Sonnet-5 92%、Gemini-3.8-Flash 80% ASR。
objective_summary: 构建以可执行攻击技能为演化单元的智能体红队框架，经修订、组合与选择持续生成越狱技能并在留出基准与前沿模型上验证。
evidence_note: 47 到 65 个技能的演化实验、留出 StrongREJECT 与三个前沿模型验证、演化轨迹分析；无统计检验，查询预算设定较低。
novelty_note: 把越狱演化单元从「提示/固定攻击」上升到「可复用可组合技能」是新范式，演化产物可迁移到未见前沿模型。
scope: 结论适用于被测前沿模型与英文有害行为基准；对部署了推理时防御或持续更新的模型有效性衰减未测。
limitations: 演化依赖目标模型反馈，查询成本与评测污染风险未充分讨论；AdvBench/StrongREJECT 对真实危害代表性有限；仅单轮英文场景。

title: HardEval: An Execution-Verified Benchmark for AI-Driven Security Hardening and Compliance Remediation
abstract: Implementing Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) controls remains a demanding operating-system administration task. Each natural-language security requirement must be translated into a precise and persistent configuration change. These changes span Secure Shell (SSH) configuration, authentication policy, audit rules, and kernel parameters. Existing benchmarks do not measure whether a model can perform this task on a live system. Code benchmarks evaluate isolated programs without persistent system state, while agent benchmarks largely focus on applications rather than operating-system configuration. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{HardEval}, an execution-verified benchmark for evaluating language-model-assisted security hardening. HardEval is built from Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 STIG controls that fail on an unhardened baseline system. Expert-written reference remediations and Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language (OVAL) checks serve as hidden ground truth for grading; they are never shown to the model, and each task states only the required security outcome while withholding the implementation. The model produces a Bash script, which is executed on a live virtual machine and graded from fail to pass using the corresponding OpenSCAP/OVAL compliance check. Evaluation of fourteen frontier and open-weight configurations reveals large and uneven capability differences across security domains. A recurring failure mode is plausible security code that does not satisfy the exact compliance condition. For four open-weight configurations, multi-run Wilson confidence intervals preserve the observed ordering. HardEval is publicly available.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: this https URL The paper has 4 figure environments (two are images, two are the example-prompt panels) and 4 tables
title_cn: HardEval：AI 驱动安全加固与合规修复的执行验证基准
abstract_cn: 落实安全技术实施指南（STIG）控制仍是高要求的操作系统管理任务：每条自然语言安全需求都必须转译为精确且持久的配置变更，涵盖 SSH 配置、认证策略、审计规则与内核参数。现有基准无法测量模型能否在真实系统上完成此任务：代码基准评测孤立程序而无持久系统状态，智能体基准大多聚焦应用而非操作系统配置。本文提出 HardEval，一个面向语言模型辅助安全加固的执行验证基准。HardEval 由在未加固基线系统上会失败的 Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 STIG 控制构成；专家编写的参考修复与 OVAL（开放漏洞与评估语言）检查作为隐藏的评分真值，从不展示给模型，每个任务只陈述所需安全结果而不给出实现。模型产出 Bash 脚本，在真实虚拟机上执行并用对应 OpenSCAP/OVAL 合规检查从失败评到通过。对 14 个前沿与开源权重配置的评估显示，安全各域能力差异大且不均衡；反复出现的失败模式是「看似合理但不满足确切合规条件」的安全代码。对四个开源权重配置，多次运行的 Wilson 置信区间保持了观察到的排序。HardEval 公开可用。
summary_cn: 执行验证基准 HardEval（RHEL8 STIG 控制、OVAL 隐藏真值实机评分）：14 个模型配置显示能力不均衡，常见失败为「看似合理但不满足合规条件」，开源配置附 Wilson 置信区间。
objective_summary: 构建以实机 OVAL 检查评分的 STIG 加固基准，用隐藏专家真值评测模型把安全需求转成持久系统配置的能力。
evidence_note: 以真实虚拟机执行与 OpenSCAP/OVAL 检查评分，14 个配置评估，开源配置报告多次运行 Wilson 置信区间；代码与数据公开。
novelty_note: 首个面向操作系统级安全加固/合规修复的执行验证基准：以隐藏 OVAL 真值与实机通过与否评分，弥补代码与智能体基准均不测持久系统状态的空缺。
scope: 结论适用于 RHEL8 STIG 控制域与 Bash 脚本修复形态；对其他发行版、Windows 及需要交互式诊断的加固任务未覆盖。
limitations: 任务限于「脚本一次执行」形态，不含多轮交互修复；评分依赖 OVAL 检查表达力；Linux 单发行版限制了结论外推。

title: TUPLE-Bench: Evaluating and Mitigating Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in Typed Decision Models
abstract: Typed decision models often return more than a selected category. They also expose probabilities for each candidate and, sometimes, a separate confidence score. These fields support downstream decisions but may reveal information beyond a recipient's authorization. We introduce TUPLE-Bench (Typed decision models' Utility and Privacy Leakage Evaluation Benchmark), a benchmark of paired synthetic cases in which recipients may learn a coarse operational category but not its fine-grained cause. Across nine models, instructions to withhold the cause fail to protect it: 91.88%-99.93% of responses reveal the cause through direct selection or residual scores. Even when causes are excluded from the candidate set, full outputs enable 62.85%-75.35% recovery on held-out cases, compared with 51.04%-57.64% using only the selected category (50% chance). Full outputs also reduce mean downstream cost in all 27 model-task comparisons. However, confidence fields increase leakage without consistently reducing cost. We further introduce workflow-constrained privacy quantization (WCPQ), which reduces secret recovery while preserving the behavior and cost of specified downstream workflows. Our findings highlight the need to audit decision interfaces field by field and workflow by workflow.

title_cn: TUPLE-Bench：评测并缓解类型化决策模型的隐私与效用权衡
abstract_cn: 类型化决策模型返回的不只是所选类别，还包括每个候选的概率，有时还有单独的置信分。这些字段支持下游决策，但可能泄露超出接收者授权范围的信息。我们提出 TUPLE-Bench（类型化决策模型效用与隐私泄露评估基准），一个由成对合成案例组成的基准：接收者可以获知粗粒度操作类别，但不应获知其细粒度成因。跨九个模型，「隐去成因」的指令未能保护它：91.88%-99.93% 的响应经直接选择或残余分数泄露成因；即使成因被排除出候选集，完整输出在留出案例上仍实现 62.85%-75.35% 的成因恢复，而仅用所选类别为 51.04%-57.64%（50% 为随机水平）。完整输出还在全部 27 个模型-任务对比中降低下游平均成本；但置信字段增加泄露而未能一致地降低成本。我们进一步提出工作流约束隐私量化（WCPQ），在保持指定下游工作流行为与成本的同时减少秘密恢复。我们的发现强调需要逐字段、逐工作流地审计决策接口。
summary_cn: 类型化决策模型输出字段泄密基准：九个模型 91.88-99.93% 响应泄露应隐去的成因，完整输出恢复率 62.85-75.35%（仅类别 51-58%），置信字段增泄露不降本；WCPQ 量化缓解。
objective_summary: 构建成对合成案例基准量化决策模型概率/置信字段的隐私泄露，并提出保持工作流行为的隐私量化缓解 WCPQ。
evidence_note: 九个模型、27 个模型-任务对比，量化恢复率与下游成本；案例为成对合成数据，无真实业务数据验证。
novelty_note: 置信分数泄露已被认识，新意在于对「类别之外的输出字段」做逐字段系统审计的基准化与工作流约束的缓解思路。
scope: 结论适用于类型化分类决策接口与被测九个模型；对回归型输出、自由文本生成接口未覆盖。
limitations: 合成案例与真实业务分布有差距；WCPQ 需按工作流定制配置；泄露度量依赖恢复攻击的强度。

title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
abstract: Blockchain forensics is adversarial and open-ended: money launderers split, swap, and bridge funds, cut their trail at mixers or custodial services, and change tactics from one incident to the next. Investigators must keep adapting their tracing in response. Yet the immutability of public ledgers preserves every recorded movement in public view, making much of the investigation independently verifiable. We introduce ABF-Bench, an interactive benchmark that makes evidence-backed fund tracing a verifiable agent task, in which every claimed movement must cite ledger records the agent retrieved. A case-to-task pipeline builds well-posed tasks across ledgers: conservative rules halt tracing wherever the records leave a continuation unresolved, and each task's reference graph is the answer those rules determine. Built from real laundering activity, the tasks combine multi-hop transfers, DeFi exchanges, cross-chain round trips, custodial and mixer deposits, and address poisoning. We also propose the ABF agent harness, built around a working memory, and evaluate it alongside general-purpose agents and fixed-order tracers. The harness reaches 75% edge recall, against 47% for Codex with the same model and 10% for Claude Code, which loses recall to overconfidence: it cites records it left unretrieved. Compared with fixed-order tracers, the harness acquires evidence faster than the best of them early in the budget and recognizes undisclosed custodial services that they walk past (89% vs. 0%), with 98% fidelity. However, agents tend to stop early and lose recall on larger tasks, which holds their final recall below the best tracer. Beyond exposing these gaps, ABF-Bench opens blockchain forensics to LLM agents as a verifiable domain, where the verdicts that score agents also offer potential training signals.
title_cn: ABF-Bench：面向智能体区块链取证的可验证基准
abstract_cn: 区块链取证是对抗性且开放式的：洗钱者拆分、兑换、跨链桥接资金，在混币器或托管服务处切断踪迹，并随事件改变策略，调查者必须持续调整追踪方式。而公共账本的不可篡改性使每笔记录在案的转移都保存在公开视野中，使大部分调查可独立验证。我们提出 ABF-Bench，一个把证据支撑的资金追踪变为可验证智能体任务的交互式基准：每个声称的转移都必须引用智能体检索到的账本记录。案例到任务的流水线在各账本上构建良置任务：保守规则在记录无法解析后续之处停止追踪，每个任务的参考图即这些规则所确定的答案。基准由真实洗钱活动构建，任务结合多跳转账、DeFi 兑换、跨链往返、托管与混币器充值及地址投毒。我们还提出以工作记忆为核心的 ABF 智能体框架，并与通用智能体及固定顺序追踪器一起评估：该框架达到 75% 边召回，同模型下 Codex 为 47%、Claude Code 为 10%——后者因过度自信而损失召回：它引用了未检索的记录。与固定顺序追踪器相比，该框架在预算早期获取证据更快，并能识别它们径直走过的未披露托管服务（89% 对 0%），保真度 98%。但智能体倾向过早停止，在更大任务上损失召回，使其最终召回低于最佳追踪器。除暴露这些差距外，ABF-Bench 把区块链取证开放为 LLM 智能体的可验证领域，其中的判定评分也可作为潜在训练信号。
summary_cn: 可验证智能体取证基准 ABF-Bench（真实洗钱案例、逐步引用账本记录）：自研框架边召回 75%（Codex 47%、Claude Code 10%），未披露托管服务识别 89% 对 0%；智能体过早停止仍限召回。
objective_summary: 构建要求每步引用账本证据的可验证区块链资金追踪基准与带工作记忆的智能体框架，量化 LLM 智能体相对通用智能体与固定规则追踪器的表现。
evidence_note: 基于真实洗钱活动构建任务，量化边召回、保真度与预算内证据获取曲线，并与 Codex/Claude Code/固定追踪器对比；评估限于自建基准。
novelty_note: 首个把区块链资金追踪构造成「每个声称转移必须引用检索记录」的可验证智能体任务，为取证类开放任务提供可评分范式。
scope: 结论适用于公共账本上的资金追踪与被测智能体框架；对隐私币、链下证据与需要执法权限的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 参考图由保守规则生成，未覆盖规则之外的真实调查路径；智能体在大型任务上过早停止；任务规模与账本覆盖有限。

title: Token-Level Attribution of Multi-Mode LLM Watermarks: Optimal Rule and Belief Weighting
abstract: A watermark verifier may hold many modes, i.e., secret keys, and a document may mix spans of different modes with unwatermarked text. Directly reporting the mode with the largest pivotal statistic (pivot) inflates the Type I error, and restoring the nominal level reduces power as candidate modes are added. We formulate token-level multi-mode attribution for the Gumbel-max watermark as maximizing correct-label power under a Type I error constraint given a mode prior. We show that the optimal rule reports the mode with the largest prior-weighted alternative density and rejects when this density exceeds one common threshold. Based on this rule, we propose the Belief-weighted Likelihood Attribution with Density Estimation (BLADE) detector. It estimates the mode prior from neighboring pivots and the alternative density from reference token probabilities. Under a conditional product model of the pivots, it keeps the exact Type I error. We further show that BLADE approaches the optimal rule as its prior and density estimates improve, with a sharp coefficient on the density error. On OPT-1.3B and other open-weight large language models, BLADE attains higher correct-label power than the compared detectors across candidate counts, token-substitution rates, generation temperatures and generator models.
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures
title_cn: 多模式 LLM 水印的 token 级归因：最优规则与信念加权
abstract_cn: 水印验证器可能持有多种模式（mode，即密钥），而文档可能混有不同模式的片段与未加水印文本。直接报告枢轴统计量（pivot）最大的模式会膨胀 I 类错误，而恢复名义水平又会随候选模式增加而降低功效。我们把 Gumbel-max 水印的 token 级多模式归因形式化为：在给定模式先验与 I 类错误约束下最大化正确标签功效。我们证明最优规则报告「先验加权备择密度」最大的模式，并在该密度超过共同阈值时拒绝。基于该规则，我们提出带密度估计的信念加权似然归因检测器（BLADE）：它从邻近 pivot 估计模式先验、从参考 token 概率估计备择密度；在 pivot 的条件乘积模型下保持精确 I 类错误。我们进一步证明随先验与密度估计改进，BLADE 逼近最优规则，且对密度误差有锐利系数。在 OPT-1.3B 及其他开源权重 LLM 上，BLADE 在候选数、token 替换率、生成温度与生成模型各维度上都取得高于对比检测器的正确标签功效。
summary_cn: 形式化 Gumbel-max 水印多模式 token 归因并导出最优规则，提出保持精确 I 类错误、逼近最优的 BLADE 检测器，在 OPT-1.3B 等模型上功效全面超过对比方法。
objective_summary: 把多密钥水印混合文本的归因形式化为带约束的功效最大化问题，导出最优判定规则并构造保持 I 类错误的实用检测器与理论逼近界。
evidence_note: 给出最优性证明与精确 I 类错误保证，并在 OPT-1.3B 等开源模型上跨候选数/替换率/温度系统对比功效；实验以受控生成为主。
novelty_note: 首次系统处理「多模式混合文本的 token 级归因」问题并证明最优规则形态，BLADE 的先验/密度估计设计有理论保证，属实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于 Gumbel-max 类 logit 水印与所给条件乘积模型；对其他水印构造与模型自适应反水印文本未覆盖。
limitations: 理论保证依赖 pivot 条件独立等模型假设；先验与密度估计在短文本上可能不稳；实验以 OPT 系模型为主。

title: From Billion-Scale to Million-Scale Language Models: Operational Capabilities for Embedded Post-Exploitation
abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for resource-constrained environments due to their low computational footprint. These characteristics also make them candidates for future autonomous malware, where connectivity, latency, privacy, or operational constraints may preclude cloud-based inference. Yet the ability of ultra-compact models to support malware during post-exploitation remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate seven open-source SLMs (20M-1.5B parameters) on two post-exploitation code-generation tasks: Directory Enumeration and Backdoor Generation. We compare Python (high-resource) and Lua (low-resource) across prompting strategies, task formulations, iterative reasoning, grammar-constrained decoding, and execution-feedback loops. Results show that offensive code-generation capabilities do not increase linearly with model size. Successful execution depends on the interaction of model capacity, task formulation, and prompting strategy, with task formulation exerting a greater influence than prompt engineering alone. Algorithmic formulation combined with few-shot prompting enables Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B to reach Pass@5 of 100% in both Python and Lua for Directory Enumeration, 100% in Python for Backdoor Generation, and 99.2% in Lua. Although the evaluated models remain too computationally demanding for widespread deployment in contemporary malware, rapid progress in compact models may reduce this barrier. These findings help anticipate AI-assisted malware and inform future countermeasures.
title_cn: 从十亿级到百万级语言模型：嵌入式后渗透的行动能力
abstract_cn: 小语言模型（SLM）因低计算足迹而在资源受限环境日益受青睐。这些特性也使其成为未来自主恶意软件的候选：连接性、时延、隐私或运营约束可能排除云端推理。但超紧凑模型支撑恶意软件后渗透阶段的能力仍缺乏理解。我们系统评估七个开源 SLM（20M-1.5B 参数）在两个后渗透代码生成任务上的表现：目录枚举与后门生成。比较 Python（高资源）与 Lua（低资源）跨提示策略、任务表述、迭代推理、语法约束解码与执行反馈回路。结果显示攻击性代码生成能力并不随模型规模线性增长：成功执行取决于模型容量、任务表述与提示策略的交互，任务表述的影响大于单纯的提示工程。算法式表述结合少样本提示使 Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B 在目录枚举的 Python 与 Lua 上均达 Pass@5 100%，后门生成 Python 达 100%、Lua 达 99.2%。尽管被评估模型对当代恶意软件的广泛部署仍过于昂贵，紧凑模型的快速进步可能降低这一门槛。这些发现有助于预判 AI 辅助恶意软件并为未来对策提供信息。
summary_cn: 评估 7 个 20M-1.5B 小模型的后渗透代码生成：算法式表述+少样本提示使 Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B 达 Pass@5 最高 100%（目录枚举与后门生成），能力不随规模线性增长。
objective_summary: 跨提示策略与任务表述系统测量小型开源模型在目录枚举与后门生成两个攻击性任务上的代码生成与执行成功率。
evidence_note: 7 个模型 × 2 任务 × 2 语言，系统比较提示策略/任务表述/解码方式并以执行成功为准（Pass@5）；实验环境受控，无统计检验。
novelty_note: LLM 攻击性能力评估已有先例，新意在于聚焦 20M-1.5B 超小模型与嵌入式 Lua 低资源场景，并给出「任务表述比提示工程更重要」的可操作结论。
scope: 结论适用于被测 7 个开源 SLM 与两个代码生成任务；对闭源小模型、真实终端设备约束及完整攻击链未覆盖。
limitations: 评估以离线实验为主，未在真实嵌入式设备测量时延与资源；任务限于两类；作者自陈当前模型对在野部署仍过于昂贵。

title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries
abstract: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. Applying the protocol to public framework repairs, we confirm 18 evidence-path failures across 11 LLM or agent safety project groups and four implementation ecosystems. Nine are established-boundary repairs, eight are new-surface policy-coverage gaps, and one is a boundary-only evidence case. Fourteen reach E1 enforcement boundaries: seven native action outcomes, six configured enforcement boundaries, and one synthetic-consumer consequence. The remaining cases affect verifier, safety-prompt, or observability channels. The cases form carrier, adapter, authority, and surface families and show how ordinary application behavior can remain intact while a safety-specific evidence path misses its decision. Exact revisions, deterministic outcomes, negative controls, and a frozen prospective audit document the confirmation rule. Monitor assumptions therefore need regression tests at the schemas, streams, tools, and adapters that frameworks evolve.
title_cn: 监控有效性失效：演化框架边界上的 LLM 安全证据路径
abstract_cn: 现代 LLM 应用依赖运行时监控器检查工具调用、轨迹、流、检测器输出与验证器输入。这带来接口可靠性问题：框架路径可能仍然可用，而与政策相关的证据从未到达其决策点。在一个代表性案例中，regex 检测器返回阳性匹配，但框架把结果搁置在阻断决策之前。这不同于越狱与检测器错误——证据已被识别，却与执行脱节。我们用「金丝雀契约」研究这一修复边界签名：父/固定确认单元把已知载荷只放在变更的证据面上，同时记录监控可见性与动作边界案例的下游决策。把该协议应用于公开框架修复，我们确认 11 个 LLM 或智能体安全项目组与四个实现生态中的 18 个证据路径失效：9 个为既有边界的修复，8 个为新面的政策覆盖缺口，1 个为仅边界的证据案例；14 个到达 E1 执行边界（7 个原生动作结果、6 个配置执行边界、1 个合成消费者后果），其余影响验证器、安全提示或可观测信道。这些案例构成载体、适配器、权限与表面四个家族，显示普通应用行为可以保持完好而安全专用证据路径错过其决策。精确修订、确定性结果、阴性对照与冻结的前瞻审计记录了确认规则。因此，监控假设需要在框架演化的模式、流、工具与适配器处做回归测试。
summary_cn: 用金丝雀契约确认 11 个安全项目、4 个生态中的 18 个「监控有效性失效」：检测器证据在到达阻断决策前被框架搁置，应用正常而安全路径脱节，须做回归测试。
objective_summary: 提出金丝雀契约确认协议，系统识别安全框架在演化边界处证据路径与执行决策脱节的失效案例并分类。
evidence_note: 18 个失效案例跨 11 个项目组与 4 个生态，配精确修订、阴性对照与冻结前瞻审计；案例规模有限，无统计推断。
novelty_note: 区别于越狱与检测器错误，首次把「证据已被识别但未达决策点」命名为一类失效（监控有效性失效）并给出可复用的确认协议。
scope: 结论适用于所审计的 11 个开源安全项目与四类实现生态；对闭源安全中间件与自定义编排框架未覆盖。
limitations: 案例发现依赖公开修复记录与人工分析，可能有未发现失效；确认协议对复杂异步执行路径的覆盖有限；影响量化以定性为主。

title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.
title_cn: MobileInject：跨模态一致性注入下 MLLM 移动智能体的推理到行动安全评估
abstract_cn: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的移动智能体正从会话助手演化为感知、推理并作用于智能手机环境的自主系统。这种能力也带来新的安全风险：对手可在跨应用移动内容中嵌入恶意目标，经间接多模态注入操纵智能体行为。虽然提示注入已在桌面与 Web 场景被研究，其在移动生态中的跨模态特性仍缺乏理解，现有安全分析也仍有限。为弥补空缺，我们提出 MobileInject，首个评估移动智能体抗多模态注入攻击与推理到行动安全风险的基准。MobileInject 提供高保真交互式移动评估框架，覆盖 11 个场景、9 个安全风险类别与 108 个可执行风险实例；引入利用跨模态互证的跨模态一致性注入，以及强化信任操纵与推理劫持的两种增强攻击——多角色协同欺骗与推理伪装注入；并提出用于细粒度失败分析的推理安全诊断框架。系统实验表明移动智能体普遍易受多模态注入，许多失败源于早期阶段的推理劫持。这些发现确立 MobileInject 作为研究并改进移动智能体安全的系统性跨模态基准。代码发布细节见附录开放科学部分。
summary_cn: 首个移动智能体多模态注入基准：11 场景、9 风险类、108 可执行实例；跨模态一致性注入与两种增强攻击显示智能体普遍易感，失败多源于早期推理劫持。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖多场景多风险类别的移动多模态注入评测框架与增强攻击方法，并给出推理级失败诊断。
evidence_note: 自建高保真交互框架，11 场景、108 个可执行实例与诊断框架的系统实验；规模中等，无统计检验，代码发布待附录确认。
novelty_note: 首个聚焦移动生态的多模态注入评测基准；跨模态一致性注入利用模态间互证，是注入攻击在移动场景的实质扩展。
scope: 结论适用于被测 MLLM 移动智能体与安卓类模拟环境；对真实设备系统防护、跨设备协同攻击未覆盖。
limitations: 任务与注入内容为构造实例，与真实恶意内容分布有差距；评估依赖自动裁定；增强攻击的组合空间未穷尽。

title: On the (In)stability of Adaptive Fee Mechanisms in Multi-Chain Systems
abstract: EIP-1559 has become the dominant transaction fee mechanism in permissionless blockchains, regulating scarce block space through an adaptive base fee. The design balances a trade-off between responsiveness to demand fluctuations and stability of long-term resource usage. On a single chain, this trade-off is well understood and empirically stable. In multi-chain systems, however, cross-chain flows introduce delayed economic interactions across otherwise independent fee markets. These interactions alter the control dynamics and create stability risks that existing models do not capture. Deployed systems have already polarized. Polkadot enforces conservative update rates, effectively disabling fee adaptivity and reverting the market to inefficient first-price auctions. Cosmos adopts aggressive update rates without formal guarantees. To fill this gap, we propose a control-theoretic framework that formalizes multi-chain fee markets as a nonlinear dynamical system with delayed feedback. We identify delay-amplified over-correction as the structural root of instability. Experiments show that cross-chain coupling erodes stability relative to monolithic blockchains, reducing the safe parameter space for base fee update rates by up to 84.8%. Moreover, instability propagates across chains, contaminating the otherwise stable peer chains. At Ethereum's update rate, which leaves a monolithic chain stable, the multi-chain system exhibits extreme load oscillation between full and near-empty blocks, with over half of all blocks at full capacity. Mainstream Cosmos chains already exceed their safe bounds under their default configurations, and the resulting load oscillation raises their block failure rate by an order of magnitude. Guided by this mechanism, we design a lightweight protocol-level mitigation that removes the over-correction and stabilizes dynamics in multi-chain environments.
title_cn: 论多链系统中自适应费用机制的不稳定性
abstract_cn: EIP-1559 已成为无许可区块链的主导交易费机制，通过自适应基础费调节稀缺区块空间。该设计在需求波动响应性与长期资源使用稳定性之间权衡。在单链上，这一权衡已被充分理解且经验稳定；但在多链系统中，跨链流引入了原本独立费用市场之间的延迟经济交互。这些交互改变控制动力学，造成现有模型未能捕捉的稳定性风险。已部署系统已经两极分化：Polkadot 强制保守更新率，实际上禁用费用自适应性，使市场退回低效的一价拍卖；Cosmos 采用激进更新率而无形式化保证。为填补空缺，我们提出控制论框架，把多链费用市场形式化为带延迟反馈的非线性动力系统，识别延迟放大的过度纠正为不稳定性的结构性根源。实验表明跨链耦合相对单体链侵蚀稳定性，使基础费更新率的安全参数空间最多缩小 84.8%；不稳定性还会跨链传播，污染原本稳定的对等链。在使单体链稳定的以太坊更新率下，多链系统呈现满块与近空块之间的极端负载振荡，超过一半区块处于满容量。主流 Cosmos 链在默认配置下已超出安全边界，由此产生的负载振荡使其出块失败率上升一个数量级。基于该机制，我们设计了轻量的协议级缓解，消除过度纠正并稳定多链环境下的动力学。
summary_cn: 把多链 EIP-1559 式费用市场建模为延迟反馈非线性系统：跨链耦合使安全更新率空间最多缩 84.8%、引发满/空块振荡，主流 Cosmos 链默认配置已超安全边界、出块失败率升一个数量级。
objective_summary: 以控制论框架形式化多链自适应费用机制的延迟反馈动力学，识别过度纠正根源、量化稳定性边界并提出协议级缓解。
evidence_note: 控制论建模加仿真实验，并用真实部署（Polkadot、Cosmos 链）数据佐证不稳定现象；无统计检验，缓解措施未在生产环境验证。
novelty_note: 单链 EIP-1559 动力学已有充分研究，新意在于把跨链流形式化为延迟耦合并识别「延迟放大过度纠正」这一结构性失稳根源。
scope: 结论适用于采用 EIP-1559 式自适应费用且存在跨链资产流的链；对无费用市场或中心化费用设定的链不适用。
limitations: 模型对跨链流做简化假设（延迟结构、流量形式）；仿真参数校准有限；缓解方案未经真实网络部署检验。

title: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
abstract: MLLM-based mobile agents are rapidly gaining autonomy in perception, planning, and closed-loop execution in dynamic mobile environments. However, this autonomy also broadens the attack surface and amplifies the risks of malicious misuse, including privacy leakage, device compromise, and large-scale phishing. Existing jailbreak evaluations leave three critical gaps for mobile agents: they focus on conversational attacks instead of mobile workflows, use static task sets with fixed difficulty, and rely narrowly on attack success rate rather than comprehensive security assessment. To close these gaps, we present MobileJailBench, the first evolving jailbreak benchmark for mobile agents, comprising three key components: (1) a benchmark comprising 520 tasks spanning three jailbreak paradigms and 14 risk categories, built on a high-fidelity mobile sandbox that we construct, enabling realistic workflows across over 20 widely used apps; (2) Dual-Dynamic Evolution, which combines Failure-Distilled Jailbreak Evolution with Weakness-Driven Benchmark Expansion; and (3) Stratified Adjudication Framework for assessing security awareness, execution behavior, and risk consequences. Extensive experiments show that current mobile agents are particularly vulnerable to implicit jailbreaks, as their safety alignment remains largely superficial and fails to generalize from conversational refusal to dynamic mobile interactions. Moreover, our dynamic evolution mechanism sharpens practical threat boundaries by continually uncovering new vulnerabilities, reaching a 100% ASR on Qwen3.5-122B. MobileJailBench provides a reproducible, continuously evolving framework for tracking the true security boundaries of mobile agents.
title_cn: MobileJailBench：移动智能体的红皇后式越狱基准
abstract_cn: 基于 MLLM 的移动智能体正在动态移动环境中获得感知、规划与闭环执行上的自主性。但这种自主性也扩大攻击面并放大恶意滥用风险，包括隐私泄露、设备失陷与大规模钓鱼。现有越狱评测对移动智能体留下三个关键缺口：聚焦对话攻击而非移动工作流、使用难度固定的静态任务集、狭义依赖攻击成功率而非全面安全评估。为弥补这些缺口，我们提出 MobileJailBench，首个演化式移动智能体越狱基准，包含三个关键组件：(1) 由我们构建的高保真移动沙箱支撑的基准，含 520 个任务、跨三种越狱范式与 14 个风险类别，支持 20 多个常用应用的真实工作流；(2) 双动态演化——结合失败蒸馏的越狱演化与弱点驱动的基准扩展；(3) 用于评估安全意识、执行行为与风险后果的分层裁定框架。大量实验表明，当前移动智能体对隐性越狱尤其脆弱，其安全对齐基本停留在表层，未能从对话拒绝泛化到动态移动交互。我们的动态演化机制持续揭露新漏洞、锐化实际威胁边界，在 Qwen3.5-122B 上达到 100% ASR。MobileJailBench 为追踪移动智能体的真实安全边界提供了可复现、持续演化的框架。
summary_cn: 首个演化式移动智能体越狱基准：520 任务、3 范式、14 风险类、20+ 应用沙箱，双动态演化在 Qwen3.5-122B 达 100% ASR，显示安全对齐难泛化到动态移动交互。
objective_summary: 构建含高保真移动沙箱、双动态演化与分层裁定的越狱评测基准，量化移动智能体在演化攻击下的安全边界。
evidence_note: 自建高保真沙箱与 520 任务基准，跨多个移动智能体评估并展示动态演化增益（Qwen3.5-122B 100% ASR）；无统计检验与外部验证。
novelty_note: 首个面向移动智能体工作流的演化式越狱基准：任务难度随弱点驱动扩展、攻击随失败蒸馏演化，突破了静态越狱评测的范式。
scope: 结论适用于被测 MLLM 移动智能体与安卓类沙箱环境；对 iOS 等其他生态、系统级权限防护与在野攻击分布未覆盖。
limitations: 沙箱与任务为自建，与真实设备差异未量化；演化依赖自动裁定器，可能引入标注偏差；风险后果评估以模拟为主。

title: Ignored, Not Refused: What Low Prompt-Injection Success Rates Hide in Small Tool-Using Agents
abstract: Tool-using agents read untrusted external content, which exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where hidden instructions hijack the agent's tool calls. Benchmarks measure IPI security by the attack success rate (ASR), which treats every failed attack as a successful defense. To test this assumption, we audit 33,000 trajectories from eleven open-weight agents (2-14B parameters) on InjecAgent and AgentDojo. A label-blind LLM judge shows that most failed attacks are ignored (76-80%) rather than refused (17-18%). With identical model weights, changing only the system prompt shifts InjecAgent ASR from 0.2% to 43%. Our Attack-Task Outcome Matrix (ATOM) further shows that in 21.7% of AgentDojo episodes, the agent stayed safe but did not complete the user's task. A low ASR therefore mostly reflects agents silently ignoring injections, not refusing them. Evaluations should report how attacks fail and whether the user's task is completed, alongside ASR. We release the labeled corpus, judge prompt, and analysis code.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables
title_cn: 被忽视而非被拒绝：小尺寸工具智能体的低提示注入成功率掩盖了什么
abstract_cn: 工具使用智能体会读取不可信外部内容，从而暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）——隐藏指令劫持智能体的工具调用。基准以攻击成功率（ASR）衡量 IPI 安全，把每次攻击失败都视为成功防御。为检验这一假设，我们审计 11 个开源权重智能体（2-14B 参数）在 InjecAgent 与 AgentDojo 上的 33,000 条轨迹。标签盲的 LLM 裁判显示，大多数失败攻击是被忽视（76-80%）而非被拒绝（17-18%）。在模型权重完全相同的情况下，仅改变系统提示就会使 InjecAgent ASR 从 0.2% 漂移到 43%。我们的攻击-任务结果矩阵（ATOM）进一步显示，在 21.7% 的 AgentDojo 回合中，智能体保持安全但未完成用户任务。因此低 ASR 大多反映智能体默默忽略注入，而非拒绝它们。评测应在 ASR 之外报告攻击如何失败以及用户任务是否完成。我们发布标注语料、裁判提示与分析代码。
summary_cn: 审计 11 个 2-14B 智能体共 33,000 条轨迹：失败注入 76-80% 是被忽视而非拒绝，仅换系统提示 ASR 从 0.2% 漂到 43%，21.7% 回合「安全但任务未完成」，低 ASR 不等于防御。
objective_summary: 大规模标注审计 IPI 攻击失败的真正模式（忽视还是拒绝）及其对 ASR 指标与任务完成的影响，并提出评测应报告的补充维度。
evidence_note: 11 个开源智能体、33,000 条轨迹、两个标准基准，使用标签盲 LLM 裁判并做系统提示对照实验；语料、裁判提示与代码公开。
novelty_note: 揭示 ASR 指标的系统性误读（失败大多是忽视而非拒绝）并给出 ATOM 补充维度，是对智能体 IPI 评测方法学的实质性实证修正。
scope: 结论适用于 2-14B 开源工具智能体与 InjecAgent/AgentDojo 类注入基准；对前沿闭源模型与自适应强攻击下「忽视」是否仍占主导未验证。
limitations: 失败模式判定依赖 LLM 裁判，可能有标注噪声；仅覆盖两个基准与英文注入；对「忽视」在更大模型上是否减少未给出结论。

title: AgentLoupe: Kernel-Resident Semantic Causal Labels for AI Agent Observability
abstract: AI agents translate user intents into system actions via tool invocations. Accurately attributing these actions to their originating LLM interactions is essential for security auditing, yet existing methods, such as AgentSight, fail for delayed execution and cross-process-lineage behaviors. We present AgentLoupe, an application-transparent eBPF-based observability tool. The core insight of AgentLoupe is to embed causal identity into kernel resources.AgentLoupe employs eBPF to capture TLS plaintext to interpret LLM interactions, and assigns each a kernel-resident semantic label.It maintains labels in eBPF maps, then propagates this label across processes and threads, associates it with kernel resources such as files and sockets. When a persistent resource carries context to an independent process outside the original lineage, this design preserves the delayed causal association.Experiments show that the average observation overhead of AgentLoupe is below 8%, and case studies confirm AgentLoupe traces cross-lineage persistent attacks back to their originating LLM interactions.
comment: Accepted to the 5th Workshop on Practical Adoption Challenges of ML for Systems (PACMI 2026), co-located with ACM SOSP 2026
title_cn: AgentLoupe：内核驻留语义因果标签赋能的 AI 智能体可观测性
abstract_cn: AI 智能体通过工具调用把用户意图转译为系统动作。把这些动作归因到其起源的 LLM 交互对安全审计至关重要，但 AgentSight 等现有方法在延迟执行与跨进程谱系行为上会失效。我们提出 AgentLoupe，一个应用透明的基于 eBPF 的可观测性工具。其核心洞见是把因果身份嵌入内核资源：AgentLoupe 用 eBPF 捕获 TLS 明文以解释 LLM 交互，并为每次交互分配内核驻留语义标签；标签保存在 eBPF map 中，跨进程与线程传播，并关联到文件、套接字等内核资源。当持久资源把上下文带给原始谱系之外的独立进程时，该设计保留延迟的因果关联。实验显示 AgentLoupe 平均观测开销低于 8%，案例研究确认其能把跨谱系持久攻击回溯到起源的 LLM 交互。
summary_cn: 基于 eBPF 的智能体审计工具 AgentLoupe：语义因果标签驻留内核并跨进程/资源传播，解决延迟执行与跨谱系归因，平均开销低于 8%（案例研究验证）。
objective_summary: 提出在内核资源上嵌入因果标签并跨进程传播的 eBPF 可观测性设计，实现 LLM 交互到延迟系统动作的归因。
evidence_note: 报告平均开销低于 8% 的测量与跨谱系攻击案例研究；无系统化基准对比与大规模评估（workshop 论文，PACMI 2026，挂靠 SOSP）。
novelty_note: 在 AgentSight 等智能体可观测性工作基础上，提出「因果身份驻留内核资源」这一新机制解决延迟执行与跨谱系归因。
scope: 结论适用于 Linux eBPF 可用环境与 TLS 明文可捕获的智能体部署；对非内核可观测信道、加密不可解流量及 Windows/macOS 未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖 TLS 明文捕获，端到端加密或非 TLS 信道不可用；评估以案例研究为主；标签传播需内核数据结构配合，跨容器场景未测。

title: From GAN-Based Models to GPT-5: A Taxonomy-Guided Study of Human Performance in Detecting Deepfake Face Images
abstract: Generative models for deepfakes have rapidly evolved from GAN-based architectures to diffusion models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, empirical research on human performance in detecting deepfake face images has not kept pace. It remains unclear if (and how) detection performance varies across generative models and whether model-specific training improves detection more effectively than general-purpose training. In this paper, we propose the \emph{Deepfake Face Artifact Taxonomy} (DFAT), a cross-model taxonomy of human-recognizable visual artifacts in deepfake face images, based on which we build both general-purpose and model-specific training materials. Through an online experiment ($n = 524$), we examined human performance in detecting deepfake face images and evaluated training efficacy across five representative generative models: three GAN-based, one diffusion-based, and one MLLM (GPT-5). Our results show that participants' detection accuracy was strongly model-dependent and that images generated by more recent and advanced models were not necessarily harder to detect. After training, participants achieved significant performance gains across most conditions, and their improvement varied by model. Notably, model-specific training generally yielded greater numerical gains than general-purpose training. In a five-month follow-up test ($n = 342$), we observed no significant decline in detection accuracy and no significant increase in perceived stress. Overall, our findings provide actionable insights for designing effective, sustainable, and targeted training programs to counter the growing threat posed by deepfakes.
title_cn: 从 GAN 模型到 GPT-5：分类学指导下的人类深伪人脸检测能力研究
abstract_cn: 深伪生成模型已从 GAN 架构快速演进到扩散模型与多模态大语言模型（MLLM），但人类检测深伪人脸能力的实证研究未能同步。检测表现是否（以及如何）随生成模型变化、模型特异性训练是否比通用训练更有效，仍不清楚。本文提出深伪人脸伪影分类学（DFAT）——一个跨模型的人类可识别视觉伪影分类——并据此构建通用与模型特异的训练材料。通过在线实验（n=524），我们考察人类检测深伪人脸的表现，并评估跨五个代表性生成模型（三个 GAN、一个扩散模型与一个 MLLM（GPT-5））的训练效果。结果显示：参与者的检测准确率强烈依赖模型，且更新更先进的模型生成图像未必更难检测。训练后参与者在多数条件下取得显著提升，提升幅度因模型而异；模型特异性训练总体带来比通用训练更大的数值增益。在五个月随访（n=342）中，检测准确率无显著下降，感知压力也无显著上升。总体而言，我们的发现为设计有效、可持续、有针对性的深伪对抗训练项目提供了可操作启示。
summary_cn: n=524 在线实验+五个月随访（n=342）：跨 GAN/扩散/GPT-5 五个模型的深伪检测准确率强烈依赖模型，模型特异性训练增益更大，五个月后无显著衰减。
objective_summary: 构建跨模型深伪伪影分类学并设计对照训练实验，量化人类对五代生成模型人脸的检测表现与训练增益及其保持。
evidence_note: n=524 在线实验、五个月随访 n=342，报告显著性检验；覆盖三个 GAN、一个扩散模型与 GPT-5 五个模型并对比两种训练方式。
novelty_note: 首次以统一伪影分类学跨「GAN→扩散→MLLM」完整代际系统评估人类检测与训练有效性，并给出模型特异性训练更优与效果可保持的实证结论。
scope: 结论适用于人脸深伪图像与被测五类生成器及线上参与者群体；对视频深伪、音频及对抗性自适应生成未覆盖。
limitations: 检测对象为静态人脸图像；在线样本的人群代表性有限；训练增益的测量依赖实验材料，未验证真实场景下的长期迁移。

title: Trojan Horse: Automated Repository Poisoning against Coding Agents
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable with autonomy, which exposes them to repository-level poisoning. Existing red-teaming studies remain restricted to manual selection for malicious payload locations and fixed disguise strategies, which cannot represent realistic repository poisoning. We present TrojanForge, the first automated framework for repository poisoning. TrojanForge parses repository structure through abstract syntax trees (AST) and maps agent execution traces onto AST nodes. A security review agent ranks these candidates and selects the least conspicuous ones for payload mounting. Then, through adversarial play with the target agent, TrojanForge iteratively refines disguise strategies by inverting the causes of agent detection, and transfers accumulated success experience across repositories. We further construct TrojanBench, a benchmark of 384 poisoned repositories spanning 6 domains and 9 programming languages. Extensive experiments show that TrojanForge achieves a stable poisoning success rate of over 60% with backdoor injection exceeding 90%. Comprehensive evaluation on TrojanBench across 4 harnesses and 12 models reveals that even commercial agents fail to defend against repository-level poisoning.
title_cn: 木马之马：针对编码智能体的自动化仓库投毒
abstract_cn: 编码智能体随自主性提升而愈发强大，这也使其暴露于仓库级投毒。现有红队研究仍限于人工选择恶意载荷位置与固定伪装策略，无法代表真实的仓库投毒。我们提出 TrojanForge，首个自动化仓库投毒框架。TrojanForge 通过抽象语法树（AST）解析仓库结构，并把智能体执行轨迹映射到 AST 节点；一个安全审查智能体对这些候选排序，选出最不显眼的位置挂载载荷；随后通过与目标智能体的对抗博弈，TrojanForge 反转智能体检测的原因、迭代精炼伪装策略，并跨仓库迁移积累的成功经验。我们还构建 TrojanBench——一个跨 6 个领域、9 种编程语言的 384 个投毒仓库基准。大量实验表明 TrojanForge 取得超过 60% 的稳定投毒成功率，后门注入超过 90%。在 TrojanBench 上跨 4 个框架与 12 个模型的全面评估显示，即使商业智能体也无法防御仓库级投毒。
summary_cn: 首个自动化仓库投毒框架 TrojanForge（AST 解析+轨迹映射+对抗精炼伪装）：384 仓库基准上投毒成功率超 60%、后门注入超 90%，4 框架 12 模型中商业智能体均无法防御。
objective_summary: 构建自动化选择载荷位置并对抗式精炼伪装的仓库投毒框架与配套基准，跨多框架多模型量化编码智能体的防御失效。
evidence_note: 自建 384 仓库、6 领域、9 语言的 TrojanBench，跨 4 框架 12 模型评估；成功率数字系统但为自建基准，无真实仓库在野验证与统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个把仓库投毒从人工构造推进到自动化端到端框架（候选排序、对抗精炼、经验迁移）的工作，并配套基准量化防御缺口。
scope: 结论适用于解析为 AST 的代码仓库与被测 12 个模型/4 个框架；对沙箱外代码执行策略、签名与 provenance 等流程级防御未评估。
limitations: 投毒仓库为构造基准而非真实开源仓库；评估依赖框架允许任意仓库内容加载的威胁模型；防御侧仅报告「无法防御」，未给出改进方向实验。

title: Concrete Functions in Private Simultaneous Quantum Messages: Quantum Advantages and Structural Limitations
abstract: Private simultaneous quantum messages (PSQM) provide a minimal model of noninteractive secure multiparty quantum computation, yet their communication complexity for concrete functions remains poorly understood. We show that familiar total functions already exhibit both genuine quantum advantages and strong structural limitations. For three-party equality on $n$-bit inputs, which determines whether the players' $n$-bit strings are identical, we construct an entanglement-assisted protocol with asymptotic communication $(1.633\ldots)n$ qubits, whereas every perfectly correct protocol without prior entanglement requires at least $3n$ qubits. For three-bit majority, one shared GHZ state and one transmitted qubit per player suffice for perfect correctness and perfect privacy, reducing the communication from the optimal classical cost of six bits to three qubits. Three-bit AND behaves differently. No perfectly correct and perfectly private protocol exists when the players share an arbitrary three-qubit state, apply arbitrary local unitary encodings, and transmit one qubit each. However, increasing the local dimension overcomes this obstruction: one shared three-qutrit GHZ state and one transmitted qutrit per player yield a one-shot protocol with total communication $3\log_2 3$. Together with the six-bit classical lower bound, this gives a strict quantum communication advantage. More generally, for every $k\geq 3$, we construct a perfectly correct and perfectly private one-shot protocol for $k$-bit AND using one qudit of dimension at most $k$ per player, and hence at most $k\log_2 k$ qubits in total.
comment: 45 pages
title_cn: 私有同时量子消息中的具体函数：量子优势与结构性限制
abstract_cn: 私有同时量子消息（PSQM）为非交互式安全多方量子计算提供了最小模型，但具体函数的通信复杂度仍知之甚少。我们证明常见全函数已同时表现出真正的量子优势与强结构性限制。对三方等价问题——判断参与者的 n 比特串是否相同——我们构造了纠缠辅助协议，渐近通信 (1.633…)n 量子比特，而每个无先验纠缠的完美正确协议至少需要 3n 量子比特。对三比特多数表决，共享一个 GHZ 态且每方发送一个量子比特即可完美正确与完美隐私，把通信从最优经典成本六比特降到三量子比特。三比特与门则不同：当参与方共享任意三量子比特态、施加任意局部酉编码并各发送一个量子比特时，不存在完美正确且完美隐私的协议；但提高局部维度可克服该障碍——共享一个三量子比特 qudit（qutrit）GHZ 态且每方发送一个 qutrit，即得总通信 3log₂3 的一次性协议，结合六比特经典下界给出严格量子通信优势。更一般地，对每个 k≥3，我们用每方至多一个维度 ≤k 的 qudit 构造 k 比特与门的完美正确完美隐私一次性协议，总通信至多 k·log₂k 量子比特。
summary_cn: 私有同时量子消息模型下：三方等价 1.633n 量子比特（无纠缠下界 3n）、三比特多数 6 比特→3 量子比特、AND 需 qutrit 方可完美实现，k 比特 AND 至多 k·log₂k。
objective_summary: 研究私有同时量子消息模型中等价、多数与 AND 等具体函数的通信复杂度，给出带纠缠协议、无纠缠下界、维度障碍及其克服构造。
evidence_note: 45 页理论工作，给出显式协议构造、无纠缠下界与 AND 的不可能性结果及 qutrit 克服方案；属纯理论证明，无实现验证。
novelty_note: PSQM 模型此前缺少具体函数分析，本文首次给出等价/多数/AND 的紧致刻画与结构性分离，属已有量子密码框架内的实质推进。
scope: 结论限于 PSQM 模型与所研究的具体函数族；对交互式量子多方计算、噪声设备或近似隐私未覆盖。
limitations: 模型为非交互式同时消息的理想化设定；部分界为渐近或非紧；未讨论协议对实验噪声的实现容忍。

title: Cryptographically Secure Agent-to-Agent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) comprise AI agents that collaborate or compete to perform complex, distributed tasks. Their dynamic interactions create opportunities for threat actors to target and impersonate other agents, intercept messages, inject malicious prompts, and exfiltrate sensitive data while simultaneously complicating the detection of anomalous behavior through conventional monitoring. This paper surveys threats and cryptographic challenges in agent-to-agent communication and presents a zero-trust architecture integrating identity, transport security, message integrity, and monitoring. The architecture establishes agent identities via decentralized identifiers and task-scoped verifiable credentials backed by a permissioned ledger, enforcing least-privilege authorization. For transport security, it provides mutually authenticated, crypto-agile TLS with hybrid post-quantum key establishment, and evaluates KEMTLS with pre-distributed public keys to reduce handshake overhead. Signed CBOR envelopes preserve payload integrity across multi-hop exchanges, while zero-knowledge proofs verify declared task constraints without exposing underlying inputs. Context-aware monitoring of inter-agent messages, tool activity, and execution telemetry informs the setting of risk-based trust thresholds and supports the detection of behavioral anomalies. Together, these mechanisms provide an integrated framework for securing and auditing agent communication, with implications for other agentic protocols and prospective 6G semantic communication.
title_cn: 多智能体系统中密码学安全的智能体间通信
abstract_cn: 多智能体系统（MAS）由协作或竞争执行复杂分布式任务的 AI 智能体组成。其动态交互给威胁行为者创造了模仿其他智能体、拦截消息、注入恶意提示与外传敏感数据的机会，同时使常规监控更难发现异常行为。本文综述智能体间通信的威胁与密码学挑战，并提出集成身份、传输安全、消息完整性与监控的零信任架构。该架构用去中心化标识符与由许可链支持的、任务范围的可验证凭证建立智能体身份，实施最小权限授权；传输安全提供相互认证、密码敏捷、带混合后量子密钥建立的 TLS，并评估用预分发公钥降低握手开销的 KEMTLS；签名的 CBOR 信封在多跳交换中保持载荷完整性；零知识证明在不暴露底层输入的情况下验证声明的任务约束；上下文感知监控则针对智能体间消息、工具活动与执行遥测设置基于风险的信任阈值并支持行为异常检测。这些机制共同构成保障与审计智能体通信的集成框架，对其他智能体协议与未来 6G 语义通信具有参考意义。
summary_cn: 综述智能体间通信威胁并提出零信任架构：DID+任务范围可验证凭证、混合后量子 TLS/KEMTLS、签名 CBOR 信封、ZK 任务约束验证与上下文感知监控（设计框架，无实现评测）。
objective_summary: 系统梳理多智能体通信的威胁面，提出整合去中心化身份、后量子传输安全、消息完整性、零知识约束验证与风险感知监控的零信任架构。
evidence_note: 以架构设计与机制分析为主，含对 KEMTLS 握手开销的定性评估，但无系统实现与端到端实验数据。
novelty_note: 各机制（DID、VC、混合 TLS、CBOR、ZKP）均为成熟技术，贡献是把它们按零信任原则组装到智能体间通信场景，机制层面新意有限。
scope: 适用于多智能体系统的通信安全设计参考；对架构的性能开销、可用性与真实部署效果未提供证据。
limitations: 无实现与实验验证；零知识证明与许可链引入的延迟与扩展成本未量化；威胁模型对内部智能体被完全攻陷的场景覆盖有限。

title: When Approval Becomes Execution: Authorization-Grounded Workflow Attacks on Tool-Using Agents
abstract: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly rely on local services for document access, approval management, and enterprise workflow execution. This paper studies an authorization-grounded workflow attack in the OpenClaw Agent Security Attack Competition, a controlled benchmark derived from SeClaw-style security task synthesis. Rather than using explicit policy-override instructions, the attack guides the agent through a locally coherent approval workflow: a protected document request is denied, the agent requests a normal approval token from the local approval service, and the returned token is supplied to the document service through authorized_by. Official submission traces show this pattern succeeding on three Enterprise OA document targets. We also conducted 23 controlled local validation experiments in the official OpenClaw execution environment: the original configuration reached the approval-token transition in 9/9 reruns and completed the exact target operation in 8/9 reruns, while single-component variants remained successful on the three document targets. The results provide concrete case evidence of an authorization-context gap: token possession can be treated as sufficient authorization even when requester identity, approver authority, resource scope, action type, destination or recipient, and business purpose are not jointly enforced. We present the attack pattern, controlled trace analysis, and defensive implications for context-bound tokens, service-side policy binding, agent-side authorization checks, and trace-aware benchmark design.
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
title_cn: 当批准变成执行：工具使用智能体上的授权锚定式工作流攻击
abstract_cn: 工具使用的大语言模型智能体日益依赖本地服务进行文档访问、审批管理与企业工作流执行。本文研究在 OpenClaw 智能体安全攻击竞赛中出现的一种以授权为锚点的工作流攻击，该竞赛是由 SeClaw 风格安全任务合成派生的受控基准。攻击不使用显式策略覆盖指令，而是引导智能体经历一个局部自洽的审批工作流：受保护文档请求被拒，智能体向本地审批服务请求正常审批令牌，再把返回的令牌经 authorized_by 字段提供给文档服务。官方提交轨迹显示该模式在三个企业 OA 文档目标上成功。我们还在官方 OpenClaw 执行环境中做了 23 次受控本地验证实验：原始配置在 9/9 次重跑中到达审批令牌转移、在 8/9 次重跑中完成确切目标操作，而单组件变体在三个文档目标上仍保持成功。这些结果为「授权上下文缺口」提供了具体案例证据：即使请求者身份、审批者权限、资源范围、动作类型、目的地或接收方与业务目的未被联合强制执行，令牌持有仍可被当作充分授权。我们给出攻击模式、受控轨迹分析，以及对上下文绑定令牌、服务侧策略绑定、智能体侧授权检查与轨迹感知基准设计的防御启示。
summary_cn: OpenClaw 竞赛环境演示审批工作流攻击：走正常审批令牌转交文档服务，官方轨迹 3 目标成功、本地 23 次实验 8/9 完成目标，暴露令牌持有不等于联合授权。
objective_summary: 分析并受控复现一种利用审批令牌转移的智能体工作流攻击，量化其成功率并归纳授权上下文缺口与防御启示。
evidence_note: 基于 3 条官方竞赛提交轨迹与 23 次受控本地重跑（9/9 到达转移、8/9 完成目标），环境为竞赛基准而非生产系统，规模有限。
novelty_note: 「令牌持有不等于充分授权」的缺口在传统安全已知，新意在于给出智能体审批工作流中的具体攻击模式与受控量化，并连接到上下文绑定令牌等防御。
scope: 结论适用于 OpenClaw 类竞赛环境与具有本地审批服务的智能体部署；对多租户生产系统与真实企业 OA 的适用性未验证。
limitations: 评估限于竞赛基准与本地复现环境，无生产系统数据；攻击变体数量有限；对防御措施的有效性仅作讨论未实测。

title: Aspire: Practical Batch Queries on Dynamic Encrypted Database with Full Leakage Suppression
abstract: Leakage-abuse attacks against encrypted database systems exploit semantic leakage and pose a severe threat to the confidentiality of plaintext data and queries. To address this problem, we propose a zero-leakage encrypted database that rules out leakage-abuse attacks, which fundamentally rely on semantic leakage. We first distinguish between two kinds of zero-leakage security. Ideal zero-leakage forbids the disclosure of any information beyond public parameters, whereas restricted zero-leakage additionally permits the leakage of metadata (such as database size and query timing). We show that restricted zero-leakage is sufficient to thwart leakage-abuse attacks and is achievable in practice. We then formally define adaptive restricted zero-leakage security and present Aspire, an encrypted database that satisfies this notion. Aspire integrates probabilistic batch code and minimal perfect hashing to support efficient batch keyword queries and dynamic updates while revealing only non-semantic metadata. Experimental results demonstrate the practicality and efficiency of Aspire, showing that Aspire can achieve an amortized query latency of less than 1.38 ms (7.53 s for a batch of 5461 keyword queries), with an amortized communication cost of approximately 2.95 KB (16.1 MB in total), on a $2^{22}$ key-value pairs database.
title_cn: Aspire：完全泄露抑制的动态加密数据库实用批量查询
abstract_cn: 针对加密数据库系统的泄露滥用攻击利用语义泄露，对明文数据与查询的机密性构成严重威胁。为解决该问题，我们提出零泄露加密数据库，从根源上排除依赖语义泄露的泄露滥用攻击。我们首先区分两类零泄露安全：理想零泄露禁止公开参数之外的任何信息泄露；受限零泄露额外允许元数据（如数据库规模与查询时序）泄露。我们证明受限零泄露足以挫败泄露滥用攻击且实际可达。然后我们形式化定义自适应受限零泄露安全，并提出满足该性质的加密数据库 Aspire。Aspire 集成概率批码与最小完美哈希，在仅泄露非语义元数据的同时支持高效批量关键字查询与动态更新。实验结果表明 Aspire 实用且高效：在 2²² 个键值对的数据库上，摊销查询延迟低于 1.38ms（5461 个关键字查询的批次为 7.53s），摊销通信成本约 2.95KB（总计 16.1MB）。
summary_cn: 形式化「受限零泄露」安全并构建加密数据库 Aspire：概率批码+最小完美哈希支持批量查询与动态更新，2²² 键值对上摊销查询延迟 <1.38ms、摊销通信约 2.95KB。
objective_summary: 定义并区分理想与受限零泄露安全，构造支持批量关键字查询与动态更新的加密数据库并给出理论证明与实现性能。
evidence_note: 给出自适应受限零泄露的形式化定义与安全性论证，并在 2²² 键值对上报告延迟与通信成本；无第三方审计或真实工作负载评估。
novelty_note: 「零泄露」理想在 leakage-abuse 文献中已有讨论，新意在于受限/理想两分的形式化与用概率批码实现批量查询的实用构造。
scope: 结论适用于关键字等值查询型加密数据库与所定义威胁模型；对范围查询、更新泄露的长期累积及共谋威胁未覆盖。
limitations: 仅泄露非语义元数据，但查询时序等元数据的长期累积风险未量化；实验为受控环境，未含真实应用工作负载；动态更新的安全性以模型假设为准。

title: VulnSAGE: Adjudicating SAST Reports by Connecting LLM Reasoning to Program Structure
abstract: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) reports flag operations whose safety depends on project-specific context, and maintainers must decide which reports describe real defects. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret this context, but adjudicating a report with them requires the decisive code, which often lies far from the reported line, and a decision basis that program analysis can check. We present VulnSAGE, an adjudication system for SAST reports that connects LLM reasoning to program structure in both directions. Its report-centered slicer recovers the dependencies of the reported operation together with the program structure that explains them, such as the caller object on which a helper acts. CLAIM, an intermediate representation for report judgments, records each model interpretation as a semantic fact that cites the program relations it assumes. Program analysis checks these premises, and the verdict follows from the facts whose premises hold. Both mechanisms share a program graph, which lets the model cite the code it reads and lets the checker query those citations. Statically supported true positives then guide proof-of-concept generation and runtime reproduction. Across 187 labeled reports from four corpora covering five vulnerability families, VulnSAGE rejects 89 of 97 false alarms and retains 85 of 90 real defects. Under a common PoC procedure, 25 of its positive verdicts reproduce at runtime, compared with three for the LLM-based adjudicator LLM4SA. Applied to 45,440 alerts raised by five SAST tools on the 200 most-starred C/C++ projects on GitHub, it reproduces 104 defects at runtime. Maintainers have confirmed 24 of the 26 defects they have responded to, including ten previously unknown defects, nine of which are already fixed.
title_cn: VulnSAGE：把 LLM 推理连接到程序结构以裁决 SAST 报告
abstract_cn: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）报告所标记操作的安全性依赖于项目特定上下文，维护者必须判断哪些报告描述真实缺陷。大语言模型（LLM）能解释这些上下文，但用其裁决报告需要决定性的代码——它往往远离被报告行——以及程序分析可核查的决策依据。我们提出 VulnSAGE，一个在两个方向上把 LLM 推理连接到程序结构的 SAST 报告裁决系统。其以报告为中心的切片器恢复被报告操作的依赖关系及解释它们的程序结构（如辅助函数作用其上的调用者对象）；CLAIM——一种报告裁决的中间表示——把模型的每个解释记录为引用其所假设程序关系的语义事实；程序分析核查这些前提，裁决由前提成立的事实得出。两类机制共享同一程序图，使模型能引用它读过的代码、检查器能查询这些引用。静态支持的真阳性随后用于引导概念验证生成与运行时复现。在覆盖五类漏洞家族、四个语料的 187 份带标签报告上，VulnSAGE 拒绝 97 个误报中的 89 个、保留 90 个真缺陷中的 85 个；在通用 PoC 流程下，其 25 个阳性裁决可运行时复现，而基于 LLM 的裁决器 LLM4SA 仅 3 个。应用于五个 SAST 工具在 GitHub 最高星标的 200 个 C/C++ 项目上产生的 45,440 条告警，它运行时复现了 104 个缺陷；维护者已回应的 26 个缺陷中 24 个获确认，其中 10 个为此前未知缺陷、9 个已被修复。
summary_cn: SAST 报告裁决系统 VulnSAGE（切片器+CLAIM 中间表示+程序分析核查）：187 份标注报告拒 89/97 误报、留 85/90 真缺陷；45,440 条真实告警复现 104 缺陷，维护者确认 24/26。
objective_summary: 构建以程序图为共享底座的 LLM 报告裁决系统，用切片器取证据、CLAIM 记录语义事实并经程序分析核查后给出裁决与 PoC 复现。
evidence_note: 187 份跨四个语料带标签报告的受控对比（LLM4SA 基线），并在 45,440 条真实 GitHub 告警上复现 104 个缺陷、24/26 获维护者确认（10 个新缺陷、9 个已修复）。
novelty_note: 以 CLAIM 中间表示把 LLM 解释落成可被程序分析核查的引用事实、双向连接推理与程序结构，是对 LLM 漏洞裁决可信性问题的实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于 C/C++ 项目的五类漏洞家族与 SAST 告警裁决；对其他语言、其他漏洞类别及需跨仓库污点的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 评估漏洞家族限于五类；运行时复现依赖可行 PoC 生成，复杂漏洞仍难复现；维护者反馈样本（26）仍小。

title: ECHO: Replacing the Compliance Proxy with Response Harmfulness in Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attack
abstract: Despite extensive safety alignment, large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing optimization-based attacks share a single objective: maximize a token-level proxy of victim compliance---such as the likelihood of an affirmative prefix---computed on the prompt rather than the decoded reply. This proxy cannot distinguish a cautious hedge from a fully actionable harmful answer, leaving the search blind to what the model actually says. We propose ECHO (Evaluation-Conditioned Harmfulness Optimization), which replaces the compliance proxy with response-level, continuous harmfulness scores from HarmSig, a 1.7B regressor grounded in actual harmful capability. ECHO couples HarmSig with five word-level perturbation operators and Keyword-Anchored Beam Search with global top-m memory, under a strict black-box threat model. Across five open-weight victims on AdvBench, ECHO achieves up to 0.898 StrongREJECT mean score and 89.23% HarmBench success. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/STANWYW/echo.
title_cn: ECHO：在优化式越狱攻击中以响应有害性取代依从代理指标
abstract_cn: 尽管有广泛的安全对齐，大语言模型仍然易受越狱攻击。现有优化式攻击共享单一目标：最大化受害者依从性的 token 级代理——如在提示上计算的肯定前缀似然——而非解码后的回复。该代理无法区分谨慎的含糊其辞与完全可操作的有害答案，使搜索对模型实际说什么视而不见。我们提出 ECHO（Evaluation-Conditioned Harmfulness Optimization），用 HarmSig——一个基于实际有害能力的 1.7B 回归器——产生的响应级连续有害性分数取代依从代理。ECHO 将 HarmSig 与五个词级扰动算子及带全局 top-m 记忆的关键词锚定束搜索耦合，在严格黑盒威胁模型下工作。在 AdvBench 上跨五个开源权重受害者，ECHO 取得最高 0.898 的 StrongREJECT 均分与 89.23% 的 HarmBench 成功率。代码公开可得。
summary_cn: 以 1.7B 有害性回归器 HarmSig 的响应级分数替代肯定前缀代理的越狱攻击 ECHO：五个开源模型 AdvBench 上 StrongREJECT 均分最高 0.898、HarmBench 成功率 89.23%，严格黑盒。
objective_summary: 提出以响应级有害性回归分数为优化目标的黑盒越狱攻击框架，结合词级扰动与关键词锚定束搜索，并在两个越狱基准上量化成功率。
evidence_note: 五个开源权重模型 × AdvBench，报告 StrongREJECT 与 HarmBench 双指标；无统计检验，受害者以开源模型为主。
novelty_note: 优化目标从「依从代理」换成「响应级有害性」是对优化式越狱的实质性改进，但依赖已有 HarmSig 回归器与常规搜索算子。
scope: 结论适用于开源权重 LLM 与英文有害行为基准；对闭源 API 的严格查询限制、多轮策略与防御部署下的表现未评估。
limitations: 依赖 HarmSig 回归器的打分质量，可被针对性欺骗；仅评估英文单轮场景；未测试对推理时防御等最新对齐的穿透力。

title: Surprise Masking: Private Data Filtering with Model Likelihoods
abstract: Data useful for language model (LM) training can contain private or unwanted information that is at risk of being learned or memorized. We propose Surprise Masking (SM), a simple form of perplexity filtering that uses a publicly available reference model to identify unwanted spans and suppress learning from them while preserving the rest of each example. On synthetic code benchmarks, we show SM improves the privacy-utility tradeoff over standard masking methods and PII filtering. In fine-tuning experiments, SM reduces approximate extraction of private values from revealed prefixes from 66.3% to 2.3% and the reproduction of stylistic coding quirks from 23.6% to 1.3%, both while preserving performance on the evaluated coding tasks. We also evaluate SM for sanitizing datasets by directly removing unwanted content. Here, SM outperforms DePA, a perplexity-based defense for detecting poisoned dead code, while specialized detectors perform better on broader credential and PII benchmarks. Across eleven settings, we find that SM's downstream success is predictable from the separation of unwanted and useful content in the distribution, and it is particularly useful with code data. Ultimately, SM is an inexpensive, adaptable method to preserve valuable examples while reducing the learning of unwanted information.
title_cn: 惊奇掩蔽：基于模型似然的私有数据过滤
abstract_cn: 用于语言模型（LM）训练的数据可能包含有被学习或记忆风险的私有或不需要的信息。我们提出 Surprise Masking（SM），一种简单的困惑度过滤形式：用公开可得的参考模型识别不需要的片段并抑制对它的学习，同时保留样本其余部分。在合成代码基准上，SM 相比标准掩蔽方法与 PII 过滤改善了隐私-效用权衡。在微调实验中，SM 把从已泄露前缀近似抽取私有值的比例从 66.3% 降到 2.3%，把编程风格怪癖的复现从 23.6% 降到 1.3%，同时在被测编程任务上保持性能。我们还评估 SM 用于直接删除不需要内容的数据净化：在检测被投毒死代码的困惑度防御 DePA 之上，SM 表现更好，而专用检测器在更广的凭证与 PII 基准上表现更佳。跨 11 个设置，我们发现 SM 的下游成功可以从不需要内容与有用内容在分布中的分离程度预测，且它对代码数据特别有用。总体而言，SM 是一种廉价、可适配的方法，能在保留有价值样本的同时减少对不需要信息的学习。
summary_cn: 片段级困惑度过滤 Surprise Masking：微调中私有值抽取 66.3%→2.3%、风格怪癖复现 23.6%→1.3% 且编程任务性能保持；11 个设置显示效果可由内容分离度预测。
objective_summary: 提出以参考模型似然识别并抑制不需要片段学习的训练数据过滤方法，在代码基准、微调与数据净化三类设置中量化隐私与效用的权衡。
evidence_note: 合成代码基准与微调实验覆盖 11 个设置并与标准掩蔽、PII 过滤、DePA 对比；数据以自建/合成为主，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 困惑度过滤与 PII 掩蔽均已有之，新意在于片段级「惊奇掩蔽」及「内容分离度可预测下游效果」这一诊断性发现。
scope: 结论适用于代码与文本训练语料的片段级过滤；对多模态数据、非英文语料及需形式化保证的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 过滤质量依赖参考模型与目标分布的匹配；经验隐私度量不构成形式化保证；在通用文本上的效果弱于代码（作者自陈特别适合代码数据）。

title: Towards Hyperparameter Transfer for Differentially Private Optimization
abstract: Scaling laws and hyperparameter tuning remain central challenges in training large-scale models, particularly under differential privacy (DP), where optimization is further complicated by noise injection and per-sample gradient clipping. While Maximal Update Parametrization ($\mu$P) allows for zero-shot hyperparameter transfer in standard training, we show that it fails under DP constraints due to the distinct spectral properties of high-dimensional noise versus low-rank gradients. In this work, we introduce DP-$\mu$P, a theoretically grounded framework that extends $\mu$P to the privacy-preserving setting. By analyzing the interaction between gradient clipping, noise injection, and feature learning, we derive a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) condition that governs layer-wise learning rate scaling. Combining this with our proposed spectral scaling formulation, we provide specific scaling rules for DP-SGD, DP-Adam, and DP-Muon optimizers. Empirically, we demonstrate that DP-$\mu$P enables effective zero-shot transfer of learning rates across model widths on diverse architectures (MLP, ViT, GPT-2), matching or exceeding the performance of individually tuned baselines while significantly reducing computational costs.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 迈向差分隐私优化的超参数迁移
abstract_cn: 缩放律与超参数调优仍是大规模模型训练的核心挑战，在差分隐私（DP）下尤为困难：优化被噪声注入与逐样本梯度裁剪进一步复杂化。虽然最大更新参数化（μP）支持标准训练中的零样本超参数迁移，我们证明其在 DP 约束下会失效，原因是高维噪声与低秩梯度具有不同的谱性质。本文提出 DP-μP，一个把 μP 扩展到隐私保护场景的理论框架。通过分析梯度裁剪、噪声注入与特征学习的交互，我们推导出支配逐层学习率缩放的信噪比（SNR）条件，并结合谱缩放公式为 DP-SGD、DP-Adam 与 DP-Muon 优化器给出具体缩放规则。实验表明 DP-μP 在 MLP、ViT、GPT-2 等多样架构上实现学习率跨模型宽度的有效零样本迁移，匹配或超过逐个调优的基线，同时显著降低计算成本。该工作被 NeurIPS 2026 接收。
summary_cn: DP-μP：把 μP 超参数零样本迁移扩展到差分隐私，导出逐层学习率 SNR 条件与 DP-SGD/Adam/Muon 缩放规则，在 MLP/ViT/GPT-2 上匹配逐调优基线（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 分析 DP 训练中裁剪与噪声的谱性质，建立支持零样本学习率迁移的参数化理论并给出三种 DP 优化器的缩放规则与实验验证。
evidence_note: 理论推导 SNR 条件与缩放规则，并在 MLP、ViT、GPT-2 三类架构上与逐调优基线对比；NeurIPS 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 证明 μP 在 DP 下失效并首次给出 DP 场景的零样本超参数迁移理论（SNR 条件+谱缩放），对该方向属实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于 DP-SGD/DP-Adam/DP-Muon 及所测架构族与宽度轴迁移；对其他 DP 优化器、深度轴或全模型规模迁移未验证。
limitations: 理论基于高维噪声近似与谱分析假设；实验以宽度迁移为主，未覆盖学习率之外的超参数；大规模模型上的验证有限。

title: SAFE-Mem: Secure Agentic Memory with Fine-Grained Authority and Governance-Aware Retrieval
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to support long-term reasoning and personalized interactions. However, information collected from external sources can introduce security risks when untrusted claims (i.e., atomic statements) are later treated as authorized preferences, policies, or permissions. Existing defenses typically rely on content-based filtering or coarse-grained provenance tracking, which either fail to prevent unauthorized memory use or block legitimate information, sacrificing memory utility. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE-Mem, a fine-grained memory governance framework that improves security while preserving legitimate memory use. First, SAFE-Mem annotates each claim with three governance labels (i.e., kind, authority, and scope) to capture its provenance and permitted use. Second, governance-aware retrieval matches query requirements with claim permissions to block unauthorized influence while retaining legitimate information. Third, a governance-enabled memory graph connects source sentences, claims, and entities to support provenance tracking and efficient retrieval. Across four LLM backbones on MPBench and LoCoMo, SAFE-Mem attains the lowest attack success among defenses that retain legitimate memory, at least 77% below the strongest of them, and the highest answer accuracy of all evaluated defenses, improving it by up to 15%. The code is available at https://github.com/LVenum/SAFE-Mem.
title_cn: SAFE-Mem：具备细粒度权限与治理感知检索的安全智能体记忆
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖持久记忆支持长期推理与个性化交互。然而，从外部来源收集的信息在被当作授权偏好、政策或权限对待时可能引入安全风险：不可信的断言（即原子语句）会被后续执行。现有防御通常依赖基于内容的过滤或粗粒度来源追踪，要么无法阻止未授权记忆使用，要么阻断合法信息、牺牲记忆效用。为此我们提出 SAFE-Mem，一个细粒度记忆治理框架，在提升安全性的同时保留合法记忆使用。首先，SAFE-Mem 为每个断言标注三个治理标签（kind、authority、scope），刻画其来源与允许用途；其次，治理感知检索把查询需求与断言权限匹配，在阻断未授权影响的同时保留合法信息；第三，启用治理的记忆图连接源句、断言与实体，支持来源追踪与高效检索。在 MPBench 与 LoCoMo 上跨四个 LLM 骨干，SAFE-Mem 在保留合法记忆的防御中攻击成功率最低——比其中最强者低至少 77%——并在所有被评估防御中答案准确率最高，最高提升 15%。代码已发布。
summary_cn: 给记忆断言打 kind/authority/scope 三治理标签并按权限检索的 SAFE-Mem：MPBench 与 LoCoMo 四个骨干上攻击成功率比最强防御低至少 77%、答案准确率最高提升 15%。
objective_summary: 提出对智能体记忆断言做细粒度治理标注与权限感知检索的框架，并在两个记忆基准上量化攻击成功与答案准确率的权衡。
evidence_note: 四个 LLM 骨干 × 两个基准，与多个防御对比并报告攻击成功率与准确率；代码公开；无统计检验，基准部分自建。
novelty_note: 把访问控制式的细粒度权限标签引入智能体记忆治理是其实质贡献，但标签建模与权限匹配检索属已有机制的组合。
scope: 结论适用于带持久记忆的 LLM 智能体与文本断言型记忆；对多模态记忆、跨智能体共享记忆库未覆盖。
limitations: 治理标签依赖标注或推断质量，误标可能导致漏防或误拦；评估限于两个基准与文本记忆；对自适应攻击者构造的复合断言未评估。

title: When Core-Network Elements Become Reachable: Field-Level Exploitability Analysis in Diameter
abstract: The increasing exposure of cellular core-network elements to public networks has turned Diameter signaling interfaces into a practical attack surface. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for protocol exploitability analysis, we find that their judgments on Diameter can be unreliable because they may deviate from the tacit analysis discipline followed by security experts and reach conclusions without considering complete protocol evidence. To address this challenge, we present LENS, an LLM-based system for reliable field-level Diameter exploitability analysis. LENS guides LLMs using both exploitability-analysis discipline and the protocol evidence needed for analysis. It infers analysis discipline from existing exploit writeups and evidence-collection guidance from exploitability-analysis failures, enabling systematic evidence collection, exploitability assessment, and proof-of-concept (PoC) attack generation when applicable. Our experiments show that LENS performs reliable analysis across four LLMs and repeated runs, achieving mean recall of 94.00% to 98.00%, precision of 78.73% to 88.94%, and accuracy of 84.00% to 92.00%. We find that more than 25% of field paths in the S6a and Cx interfaces are exploitable under the considered threat model. We further assess their impact on practical implementations and uncover 95 previously unknown vulnerabilities, including 17 in open-source EPC/IMS implementations and 78 in commercial deployments, causing service disruption, information leakage, subscriber tracking, and accelerated battery depletion. Applying LENS to 16 additional protocols spanning cellular, network, industrial, and host-internal systems uncovers 118 previously unknown vulnerabilities, demonstrating its strong generalizability.
title_cn: 当核心网元素变得可达：Diameter 协议字段级可利用性分析
abstract_cn: 蜂窝核心网元素日益暴露于公共网络，使 Diameter 信令接口成为实际攻击面。虽然大语言模型（LLM）在协议可利用性分析上显示出潜力，我们发现它们对 Diameter 的判断不可靠：可能偏离安全专家遵循的默会分析纪律，在不考虑完整协议证据的情况下下结论。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 LENS，一个用于可靠字段级 Diameter 可利用性分析的 LLM 系统。LENS 用可利用性分析纪律与分析所需协议证据共同引导 LLM：它从现有漏洞分析文章推断分析纪律，从可利用性分析失败中收集证据收集指南，实现系统的证据收集、可利用性评估与（适用时的）概念验证攻击生成。实验表明 LENS 在四个 LLM 与重复运行上都能可靠分析，平均召回 94.00%-98.00%、精确率 78.73%-88.94%、准确率 84.00%-92.00%。我们发现 S6a 与 Cx 接口中超过 25% 的字段路径在所考虑威胁模型下可被利用；我们进一步评估其对实际实现的影响，发现 95 个此前未知的漏洞，其中 17 个在开源 EPC/IMS 实现中、78 个在商业部署中，导致服务中断、信息泄露、用户追踪与电池加速耗尽。将 LENS 应用于跨蜂窝、网络、工业与主机内部系统的 16 个其他协议，又发现 118 个此前未知漏洞，显示其强泛化性。
summary_cn: LLM 系统 LENS 做 Diameter 字段级可利用性分析（召回 94-98%）：S6a/Cx 超 25% 字段路径可利用，发现 95 个新漏洞（含 78 个商业部署），另在 16 个协议上发现 118 个。
objective_summary: 构建从漏洞分析文章学习分析纪律、引导 LLM 做证据收集与 PoC 生成的 Diameter 可利用性分析系统，并在多个协议与真实实现上验证漏洞发现能力。
evidence_note: 四个 LLM、重复运行下报告召回/精确/准确区间；发现 95+118 个此前未知漏洞并在开源与商业实现中验证实际影响，属真实系统验证。
novelty_note: 首次把 LLM 协议分析推进到字段级可利用性判断：从 writeup 自动提取专家分析纪律并做系统化证据收集，在蜂窝核心网协议上大规模产出真实漏洞。
scope: 结论适用于有规范文本与历史 writeup 的信令协议（实验覆盖 20 个协议）；对无公开漏洞记录的私有协议或需物理接近的攻击面未覆盖。
limitations: 精确率 78.73%-88.94% 意味着一定比例误报需人工复核；分析质量依赖所用 LLM；受伦理与合规限制未在运营商网络在野利用。

title: Provable Compliance: A Protocol for Runtime Compliance Evidence and Transaction-Specific Decisioning
abstract: Regulated institutions already perform onboarding, screening, monitoring, and review, but compliance evidence ages, and whether it supports a decision depends on the institution, product, subject, counterparty, transaction, jurisdiction, risk tier, and purpose. A relying party therefore often cannot obtain compact, attributable proof of which evidence, policy, authority, and transaction context were current when a decision was made, a gap that grows as authority is delegated to software agents and scheduled workflows. We describe ChainIT Provable Compliance, the compliance-side layer of the ChainIT Authority Protocol. Each sourced or institution-generated fact is represented as a separate Evidence Assertion VDT with provenance, freshness, confidence, permitted purpose, and privacy classification; a versioned Compliance Policy Profile selects the applicable rules; a Business Rules Engine returns deterministic, reason-coded predicate results; and the organization's configured Workflow Engine composes them into a signed, time-bounded Compliance Decision VDT for one reliance event. The decision contributes a single predicate, Compliance Decision Permits, to session-eligibility and transaction-policy decisions. It never independently authorizes payment: only a final Allow together with an exact transaction digest, atomic capacity reservation, and a single-use execution credential can commit value. The paper specifies point-of-reliance freshness, scoped propagation of evidence changes, decision states, evidence domains (AML, sanctions, PEP, background, identity, and licensing), the U.S. and FATF regulatory context as of August 2026, privacy and disclosure controls, and residual risks.
