The findings motivate three candidate design priorities: produce privacy-compatible evidence about past states, limit the state exposed by a single flaw, and disclose residual uncertainty explicitly.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at MARBLE 2026 (Mathematical Research for Blockchain Economy); to appear in Lecture Notes in Operations Research (Springer). Author version with post-submission corrections; not the Version of Record
title_cn: 为不可证明之物定价：加密协议中的模糊性、旋转门运行与可验证性折价
abstract_cn: 隐私保护协议可以在不事先确定漏洞是否被利用的情况下修复漏洞，即使没有失窃报告且总供应量受到保护。我们把这种差距带来的潜在价值折损称为可验证性折价。旋转门模型展示提前提款如何把可能的缺口转嫁给剩余持有者，以及可信证据为何会随敞口增大而更有价值。我们提出 VDISC，一个分别记录报告损失、敞口价值、公开证据、收益与池资金流的可复现框架。它结合 Orchard 的分阶段披露、重构的链上资金流、更早的 Zcash 案例与一个 40 事件的安全面板。Orchard 符合预测方向：修复与供应保障后的市场反应温和，而最大的负收益与屏蔽池净流出对应「无法排除过去滥用」这一承认。这些模式是方向性的而非因果的。跨事件看，市值归一化的报告损失与未解决敞口在 38 个有公开损失数字的事件中高度重叠（皮尔逊 0.86、斯皮尔曼 0.56），部分因为敞口常由损失本身编码，因此仅凭收益无法区分报告损失与未解决历史。发现引出三个候选设计优先级：产出与隐私兼容的过去状态证据、限制单一缺陷暴露的状态、以及显式披露残余不确定性。
summary_cn: 提出「可验证性折价」概念与 VDISC 框架：Zcash Orchard 事件的市场反应与资金流符合方向性预测，38 个事件中报告损失与未解决敞口高度重叠（Pearson 0.86）。
objective_summary: 定义隐私协议漏洞修复中无法验证历史利用的价值折价，构建 VDISC 可复现测量框架，结合 Zcash Orchard 案例与 40 事件面板分析市场反应、链上流与证据结构。
evidence_note: 40 事件面板、链上流重构与相关系数报告；作者明确声明结论为方向性而非因果，暴露变量与损失存在编码重叠。
novelty_note: 提出可验证性折价这一新概念并给出可复现的事件测量框架，把协议设计与市场证据联系起来；机制本身为测量建模。
scope: 结论来自 Zcash 系案例与 40 个加密安全事件；方向性结论不外推为因果；对其他隐私协议的适用需重新测量。
limitations: 方向性而非因果（作者自陈）；敞口常由损失编码导致变量重叠；隐私兼容的证据生成机制仍是开放设计问题。

title: On the Robustness of Gossip Protocols in Modern Blockchains
abstract: Modern platforms such as Ethereum and Polkadot nowadays execute Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus protocols over large validator committees, often comprising hundreds of nodes. At this scale, complete graph topologies for connecting nodes are impractical, leading systems to adopt various gossip mechanisms, often in an ad hoc manner. In this paper, we study the robustness of widely deployed gossip protocols used in committee-based blockchains against realistic network adversaries. We show, both analytically and through extensive empirical measurements, that the graph parameters commonly chosen to instantiate random graphs are insufficient to guarantee that enough honest nodes receive consensus messages for quorum formation in existing protocols. Motivated by this finding, we empirically assess the robustness of Bitcoin's Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi (ER) graphs, Polkadot's grid topology, Ethereum's GossipSub, and Solana's chunk- and tree-based disseminations. Our results reveal surprising tradeoffs: Solana's dynamic trees are bandwidth-efficient in benign settings but fragile under adaptive attacks; Polkadot's grid achieves strong robustness at the cost of high bandwidth overhead; GossipSub is both bandwidth-efficient and resilient to adaptive adversaries, yet highly sensitive to parameter choices; and ER graphs provide a strong robustness-efficiency tradeoff, e.g., when the (average) fanout degree exceeds 15 for networks up to 5000 nodes.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE SP), 2027
title_cn: 现代区块链 gossip 协议的鲁棒性
abstract_cn: 以太坊与 Polkadot 等现代平台如今在常由数百节点组成的大型验证人委员会上执行拜占庭容错共识协议。在这样的规模下完整图连接拓扑不切实际，导致系统以常为临时的方式采用各种 gossip 机制。本文研究委员会型区块链广泛部署的 gossip 协议在现实网络对手下的鲁棒性。我们在分析上并通过大量实证测量表明：用于实例化随机图的常用图参数不足以保证足够多的诚实节点收到共识消息以形成法定人数。基于此发现，我们实证评估比特币的 Erdős–Rényi 图、Polkadot 的网格拓扑、以太坊的 GossipSub 与 Solana 的分块及树状传播。结果揭示出人意料的权衡：Solana 的动态树在良性设置下带宽高效但适应性攻击下脆弱；Polkadot 的网格以高带宽开销换取强鲁棒性；GossipSub 既带宽高效又能抵抗适应对手，却对参数选择高度敏感；ER 图提供强鲁棒-效率权衡，例如平均扇出超过 15 时对最多 5,000 节点的网络表现良好。
summary_cn: 系统评估四大区块链 gossip 协议的对手鲁棒性：Solana 动态树抗适应攻击弱、Polkadot 网格带宽昂贵、GossipSub 对参数敏感、ER 图在扇出大于 15、至 5000 节点时权衡最优（S&P 2027）。
objective_summary: 以分析与大规模实证测量评估比特币 ER 图、Polkadot 网格、以太坊 GossipSub 与 Solana 分块/树传播在现实网络对手下形成共识法定人数的鲁棒性，并量化带宽与鲁棒的权衡。
evidence_note: IEEE S&P 2027 录用；分析证明加四个真实部署系统的实证测量，比较维度系统（法定人数形成、带宽、适应性攻击）；实验环境与主网有差距。
novelty_note: 首次对主流委员会型区块链的 gossip 层做跨系统、含适应性对手的系统化鲁棒性评估，并给出随机图参数不足以保证法定人数的分析结论。
scope: 结论覆盖四个系统的 gossip 机制与至 5,000 节点规模；测量环境为受控实验网络，与主网动态存在差距；不覆盖共识层之上的应用层攻击。
limitations: 实验环境无法完全复现主网条件；协议参数空间大，覆盖必然局部；对真实验证人激励与部署实践的影响未建模。

title: NEST: Stale-Robust Tokenized-Stock Measurement for a Crypto-Treasury LETF Stack
abstract: Tokenized equities trade while listed markets are closed, so their marks could improve off-hours measurement along layered exposures that link Bitcoin, crypto-treasury stocks, and leveraged ETFs. A token return and the next opening gap, however, share the price move from the previous close to the token mark, so part of their apparent fit is mechanical. We develop NEST, a stale-robust protocol that separates this shared-history fit from conditional measurement value. A shared-history identity and a variance-clock bound show how much fit timing alone can generate. The partial determination index (PDI), the squared partial correlation between token and gap given public controls, measures what remains, and a finite-sample frontier expresses the partial-F decision in PDI units. Product, provenance, timestamp, and execution audits decide whether an informative mark is admissible. For MSTRx, a tracker certificate on MicroStrategy (MSTR), a token-only $R^2$ of 0.916 shrinks to a modest increment once Bitcoin, mark age, and a pre-09:00 MSTR premarket proxy are controlled: the token explains 15.7% of the remaining gap variation (1% frontier 0.031), and 14.0% to 17.0% under stricter clock variants, including one in which every token mark precedes 09:00. A trade-level reconstruction on Gate gives 25.2%; NVDAX and AAPLX clear their frontiers, whereas TSLAX does not. An admitted mark updates, rather than replaces, BTC-unit exposure diagnostics for the BTC-MSTR-LETF chain.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Extended version of a paper accepted for publication in the proceedings of MARBLE 2026 (Lecture Notes in Operations Research, Springer Nature)
title_cn: NEST：面向加密财库 LETF 链的抗陈旧代币化股票测量
abstract_cn: 代币化股票在上市市场休市时交易，其价格标记本可改善连接比特币、加密财库股票与杠杆 ETF 的分层暴露的盘外测量。然而代币收益与次日开盘缺口共享从上次收盘到代币标记的价格变动，因此其表面拟合有部分是机械的。我们开发 NEST，一个把这种共享历史拟合与条件测量价值分离的抗陈旧协议。共享历史恒等式与方差时钟界刻画仅凭时机能产生多少拟合；偏决定指数（PDI）——在给定公开控制变量下代币与缺口之间的平方偏相关——度量剩余部分；有限样本前沿以 PDI 单位表达偏 F 决策。产品、来源、时间戳与执行审计决定一个信息性标记是否可采信。对 MSTRx（MicroStrategy 的追踪凭证），仅代币的 R² 为 0.916，但在控制比特币、标记年龄与 9 点前 MSTR 盘前代理后收缩为适度增量：代币解释剩余缺口变异的 15.7%（1% 前沿为 0.031），在更严格时钟变体（含每个代币标记都早于 9 点的变体）下为 14.0%–17.0%。Gate 上的成交级重构给出 25.2%；NVDAX 与 AAPLX 越过其前沿，TSLAX 则没有。一个可采信标记会更新而非取代 BTC-MSTR-LETF 链的 BTC 单位暴露诊断。
summary_cn: NEST 协议分离代币化股票标记的机械拟合：MSTRx 仅代币 R²=0.916 在控制后仅余 15.7% 增量，NVDAX/AAPLX 过前沿而 TSLAX 未过。
objective_summary: 提出分离共享历史机械拟合的抗陈旧测量协议 NEST，以偏决定指数与有限样本前沿评估代币化股票标记对隔夜缺口测量的条件价值，并对四个代币做审计与重构。
evidence_note: 四个代币资产的系统测量与成交级重构，指标与决策前沿明确；属金融测量研究，与安全关联弱，无因果声明。
novelty_note: 对既有市场测量方法的稳健性修正与协议化（控制机械拟合、审计标记质量），方法组件均为标准统计工具。
scope: 结论限于所测四个代币化股票、Gate 等交易数据与 BTC-MSTR-LETF 链；不构成投资或风险建议。
limitations: 依赖公开市场数据与特定交易所重构；代币标记时间戳质量影响结论；样本期有限且未覆盖更多标的。

title: Smoothness of Shortest Isogenies to Frobenius Conjugates
abstract: Let $E$ be chosen uniformly from the geometric isomorphism classes of supersingular elliptic curves over $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p$ and $\delta_E$ be the minimum degree of isogenies from $E$ to its Frobenius conjugate $E^{(p)}$. We prove the smoothness of $\delta_E$ and hence affirm Wesolowski's $p^{1/3+o(1)}$ attack on the supersingular endomorphism ring problem is unconditional.
title_cn: 到 Frobenius 共轭的最短同源的光滑性
abstract_cn: 设 E 从 F̄_p 上超奇异椭圆曲线的几何同构类中均匀选取，δ_E 为从 E 到其 Frobenius 共轭 E^(p) 的同源最小次数。我们证明 δ_E 的光滑性，从而肯定 Wesolowski 针对超奇异自同态环问题的 p^(1/3+o(1)) 攻击是无条件的。
summary_cn: 证明超奇异曲线到 Frobenius 共轭最短同源次数的光滑性，使 Wesolowski 的 p^(1/3+o(1)) 自同态环攻击成为无条件结果。
objective_summary: 证明从随机超奇异椭圆曲线到其 Frobenius 共轭的最短同源次数具有光滑性，解除 Wesolowski 超奇异自同态环攻击的启发式假设。
evidence_note: 理论论文：单一定理的完整证明，直接支持已发表攻击分析的严格化；无实验成分。
novelty_note: 把依赖启发式的攻击分析变为无条件定理，属关键引理补全；攻击框架与结果本身来自已有工作（Wesolowski）。
scope: 限于超奇异椭圆曲线与其 p 幂 Frobenius 共轭间的同源；对具体密码方案参数选择无直接改动建议。
limitations: 为单一理论结果，覆盖面窄；对同源密码实际部署的影响是间接的；证明依赖既有数论工具。

title: Poisoning the Neighborhood: A Topology-Aware Topic-Level Attack on Large-Scale HNSW-based RAG Systems
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations and knowledge staleness in large language models using external knowledge. However, ingestion from public and third-party sources exposes RAG systems to poisoning attacks. Existing attacks are designed and evaluated under exact retrieval, where poisoned documents participate in global ranking. Deployment-scale systems instead rely on approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) indexes such as hierarchical navigable small world (HNSW), where limited search budgets, graph-search reachability, and local benign-document competition invalidate this assumption and degrade existing attacks. We present a topology-aware topic-level poisoning attack against large-scale HNSW-RAG that generalizes to unseen topic queries. We organize poisoned documents into a Hub-Satellite structure: Satellites provide competitive entry points across semantic regions, while Hubs strengthen local cohesion and facilitate cascading retrieval. For generation, we propose an entity-claim promotion attack combining evidence anchoring and entity-claim coupling to promote the target entity via a target claim across different query regions. On 2M-document Wikipedia, our attack maintains over 72% retrieval success and reaches 31.29% attack success, substantially outperforming baselines; domain-specific experiments further support its effectiveness. Structural analyses show that the Hub-Satellite topology forms in HNSW, indicating that graph structure contributes to improved poisoned-document retrieval. Existing poisoning defenses cannot mitigate the attack, exposing graph-structural risks in HNSW-RAG systems.
title_cn: 毒化邻域：大规模 HNSW-RAG 系统上的拓扑感知主题级攻击
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）利用外部知识缓解大语言模型的幻觉与知识过时，但从公共与第三方来源摄取内容使 RAG 系统暴露于投毒攻击。现有攻击在精确检索假设下设计与评估——被投毒文档参与全局排序。部署规模的系统转而依赖分层可导航小世界（HNSW）等近似最近邻（ANN）索引：有限的搜索预算、图搜索可达性与本地良性文档竞争使该假设失效并削弱既有攻击。我们提出针对大规模 HNSW-RAG 的拓扑感知主题级投毒攻击，可泛化到未见主题查询。我们把被投毒文档组织为枢纽-卫星（Hub-Satellite）结构：卫星在各语义区域提供有竞争力的入口点，枢纽强化局部内聚并促成级联检索。在生成侧，我们提出实体-声明提升攻击，结合证据锚定与实体-声明耦合，跨不同查询区域经由目标声明提升目标实体。在 200 万文档的维基百科上，我们的攻击保持 72% 以上的检索成功率并达到 31.29% 的攻击成功率，大幅超过基线；领域特定实验进一步支持其有效性。结构分析表明枢纽-卫星拓扑在 HNSW 中形成，说明图结构有助于改善被投毒文档的检索。现有投毒防御无法缓解该攻击，暴露了 HNSW-RAG 系统中的图结构风险。
summary_cn: 面向 HNSW-RAG 的拓扑感知投毒：Hub-Satellite 结构加实体-声明提升，在 200 万文档维基语料上检索成功率超 72%、攻击成功率 31.29%，现有防御均无效。
objective_summary: 设计利用 HNSW 图拓扑的枢纽-卫星投毒结构与实体-声明提升生成策略，在 200 万文档维基语料与领域数据上评估检索与攻击成功率并与既有攻击、防御对比。
evidence_note: 200 万文档规模的真实索引实验、基线对比、领域实验与结构分析；数字具体；无统计检验，防御评估限于现有方法。
novelty_note: 突破既有 RAG 投毒的精确检索假设，把 ANN 图拓扑纳入攻击设计，开辟拓扑感知投毒这一新攻击面并证明现有防御失效。
scope: 适用于以 HNSW 为索引的大规模 RAG；主题级查询泛化经实验验证；其他 ANN 结构（IVF、图变体）未评估。
limitations: 攻击针对 HNSW 特性设计，更换索引可能削弱效果；现有防御均未缓解意味着提出的是未解问题而非完整攻防评估；目标声明需可跨区域表述。

title: What Survives Self-Evolution: Provenance Marks in Copied Agent Harnesses
abstract: Agent harnesses, the prompt and tool code around a base model, leak. Claude Code's 512,000 lines were mirrored within hours of a packaging error. A plagiarist can pass a leaked harness through a published self-evolver and ship the result as its own. We define this as a covert rewriting attack. No one targets a provenance mark, yet a large language model (LLM) proposer rewrites the file that carries it and a score keeps the better rewrites. We give the first measurement of marks under this attack, with three evolvers, five proposers and two environments. Published marks fail. KGW in the prompt survives GEPA's rewrites in 0 of 12 copies, AgentMark as released in 5 of 12. The proposer's habits decide survival, by two orders of magnitude across models, and selection protects a mark only when each decision sees enough games. We then build a mark for this attack. Its key is the order of near-tied entries of a table of where objects are found, built from public games, so deleting the table costs success, rewrites that keep its rows keep the order, and a customer reads the key from the agent's actions alone. On held-out games it is detected in 62 of 76 copies whose lineage rewrote its file. A scheme-aware plagiarist reshuffles the ties at no measurable cost, and a plagiarist who asks the proposer for more general code removes the key in 75-100% of rewrites.
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (October 2026)
title_cn: 自进化后什么留存下来：被复制智能体外壳中的溯源标记
abstract_cn: 智能体外壳（harness）——围绕基础模型的提示与工具代码——会泄露。Claude Code 的 51.2 万行代码在打包错误后数小时内即被镜像。抄袭者可以把泄露的外壳经已发表的自进化器处理并把结果当作自己的产品。我们将其定义为隐蔽重写攻击。没有人以溯源标记为目标，然而 LLM 提议者会重写携带标记的文件，而打分机制会保留更好的重写。我们给出该攻击下标记的首个测量，覆盖三个进化器、五个提议者与两个环境。已发表标记失效：KGW 在提示中的标记在 12 个副本中 0 个存活，AgentMark 按发布形态在 12 个中存活 5 个。提议者的习惯决定存活，跨模型相差两个数量级，且只有当每次决策看到足够多的对局时选择才保护标记。我们随后为该攻击构建标记：其密钥是一张「对象在何处被发现」表中接近并列条目的顺序，该表由公开对局构建，删除表会损失成功率，保留表行的重写也保留顺序，客户仅从智能体动作即可读出密钥。在保留对局上，其在血缘重写过该文件的 76 个副本中被检出 62 个。方案感知的抄袭者可以无测量代价地重排并列项；而要求提议者写出更通用代码的抄袭者在 75%–100% 的重写中移除密钥。
summary_cn: 首次测量自进化重写对智能体外壳溯源标记的破坏：已发表标记大量失效（KGW 0/12），新提出的表序密钥标记在 76 个副本检出 62 个，但方案感知对手可无损破解。
objective_summary: 定义针对智能体外壳溯源标记的隐蔽重写攻击，在 3 进化器×5 提议者×2 环境中测量已发布标记的存活率，并提出基于对象位置表并列项顺序的新标记，评估其检出率与自适应对手下的失效方式。
evidence_note: 三进化器、五提议者、两环境的系统测量加 76 个保留副本的检出实验，含两类自适应对手分析；处于审稿中（ACL ARR），实验为自建环境。
novelty_note: 开辟「自进化重写攻击溯源标记」这一新威胁模型并给出首个系统测量，新标记的表序构造思路亦新；但鲁棒性对自适应对手有限。
scope: 结论适用于经 LLM 自进化器重写的外壳代码场景；测量覆盖三个进化器、五个提议者与两个环境；对人类手工抄袭未评估。
limitations: 方案感知抄袭者可无代价重排并列项使密钥失效；要求更通用代码的提议者在 75%–100% 重写中移除密钥；标记依赖脆弱的结构性巧合。

title: Benchmarking Post-Quantum Key Encapsulation in S3-Compatible Object Storage under Client Concurrency
abstract: Data encrypted today with classical public-key algorithms could be decrypted once large quantum computers exist. Cloud object stores keep data for years, so the client-side encryption that protects it must move to post-quantum algorithms such as ML-KEM, which adds a key-encapsulation step and a larger ciphertext to every stored object. So far, the cost of ML-KEM has been measured for the algorithm on its own and for securing network connections, but not for encrypting each object in a storage system that serves many clients at once. It has therefore been unclear whether ML-KEM slows such a system, under which conditions, and why. We address this problem by measuring per-object ML-KEM against classical key exchange on an S3-compatible object store, with two client implementations, two processor types and up to 500 concurrent workers, using pre-registered experiments and statistical equivalence tests. ML-KEM reduced throughput only when the client's processor was at or near full load, with one unexplained exception, and then by 4.0 to 4.9% in our main client. Controlled experiments on one processor type traced most of that loss to the way the software library was called, and a second, native client showed that the size of the loss depends on the implementation. The lasting cost is storage: 1,056 more bytes per object than with classical key exchange. The results cover two clients, one single-node store and one cloud provider.
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 23 tables. Code and per-run data: this https URL
title_cn: S3 兼容对象存储中后量子密钥封装在客户端并发下的基准测试
abstract_cn: 今天用经典公钥算法加密的数据在大型量子计算机出现后可能被解密。云对象存储会把数据保存多年，因此保护它的客户端加密必须迁移到 ML-KEM 等后量子算法，这为每个存储对象增加了密钥封装步骤与更大的密文。迄今 ML-KEM 的成本只在算法本身与保护网络连接的场景下被测量，尚未在多客户端并发访问、逐对象加密的存储系统中被测量。因此 ML-KEM 是否拖慢此类系统、在什么条件下、为什么，一直不清楚。我们在 S3 兼容对象存储上，用两种客户端实现、两种处理器与最多 500 个并发工作线程，对逐对象 ML-KEM 与经典密钥交换进行测量，实验经预注册并使用统计等效性检验。ML-KEM 仅在客户端处理器处于或接近满载时降低吞吐量（有一个未解释的例外），在主客户端中降幅为 4.0%–4.9%。对一种处理器的受控实验把大部分损失追溯到软件库的调用方式，而第二个原生客户端表明损失大小取决于实现。持久的成本在存储侧：每对象比经典密钥交换多 1,056 字节。结果覆盖两种客户端、一个单节点存储与一个云提供商。
summary_cn: 预注册实验测 ML-KEM 在 S3 兼容存储的并发代价：仅 CPU 满载时吞吐降 4.0%–4.9%（主客户端），持久成本为每对象多 1,056 字节，损失大小取决于实现。
objective_summary: 在 S3 兼容对象存储上以两种客户端、两种处理器与最多 500 并发测量逐对象 ML-KEM 相对经典密钥交换的吞吐、时延与存储开销，采用预注册设计与统计等效性检验。
evidence_note: 预注册实验设计、统计等效性检验、受控并发与多实现对照，损失归因（库调用方式）分析具体；范围限于单节点存储与一个云提供商。
novelty_note: 填补 ML-KEM 在对象存储并发场景的测量空白，方法严谨但为测量研究，无新算法或机制。
scope: 结论覆盖两种客户端实现、两种处理器、一个单节点存储与一个云提供商；ML-KEM 特定参数；更大集群与网络受限场景未覆盖。
limitations: 存在一个未解释的例外结果；单节点存储限制外推；未评估更大规模分布式存储与不同网络带宽条件。

title: Matoi: Selective Revalidation of Consequence Evidence for Agent Authorization
abstract: Matoi separates reusable consequence evidence from current execution authority and durable occurrence history. Its finite query-aware contract covers branches, ordered collections and negative lookups. A consumer reuses only its own checked evidence whose observations remain valid; signed requests, live grants, quota and uncertain outcomes remain separate obligations. Conditional correctness arguments distinguish locally serialized claims from nontransactional remote effects. Two studies strengthen cost attribution and domain evaluation. A 1,440-cell matched-wire study repeats 144 authored inputs. With compact input bytes identical, reuse reduces complete lifecycle cost by 3.49 percent in JS and 1.79 percent in Python. Combined representation/reuse reductions against full proof are 10.87 and 16.53 percent; five of twelve family intervals for the matched comparison cross one in each language. A prospectively frozen AgentDojo Banking mapping covers 5/16 user plans and 7/9 attack plans. Both governed strategies preserve five exact benign transfers and refuse 35 reused attack-plan/policy crosses. Pre-satisfied utility predicates are reported separately from completed work. These are original scripted synthetic tools, not autonomous agents or a real bank. Earlier studies retain cheaper protected-cache alternatives, policy-compatible phishing, provider duplication and post-claim revocation. Separate JS/Python consumers establish finite-profile interoperability within the same project; durable recovery rechecks evidence and retains uncertain reservations. The results support a bounded, auditable reuse and execution contract, not a new general incremental algorithm, arbitrary-tool closure, atomic third-party commitment or production superiority.
comment: 55 pages, 4 figures. Includes an 18-page technical manuscript and a 33-page detailed supplement as ancillary files. Research preprint; not peer reviewed
title_cn: Matoi：面向智能体授权的结果证据选择性重验
abstract_cn: Matoi 把可复用的结果证据与当前执行授权及持久发生历史分离开。其有限的查询感知契约覆盖分支、有序集合与否定查找。消费者只复用自己的已核验证据且其观测仍然有效；签名请求、活跃授权、配额与不确定结果保持为独立义务。条件化正确性论证区分本地串行化声明与非事务性远程效果。两项研究强化成本归因与领域评估。一项 1,440 格的匹配连线研究重复 144 个编写输入：在压缩输入字节相同的前提下，复用在 JS 中把完整生命周期成本降低 3.49%，在 Python 中降低 1.79%；相对完整证明的表示/复用合计降幅为 10.87% 与 16.53%，匹配比较的十二个族区间中各有五个跨过 1。一项前瞻冻结的 AgentDojo Banking 映射覆盖 5/16 个用户计划与 7/9 个攻击计划：两种治理策略都保留五次精确的良性转账并拒绝 35 个复用攻击计划/政策交叉。预满足的效用谓词与已完成工作分开报告。这些是原创的脚本化合成工具，不是自主智能体或真实银行。早期研究保留了更廉价的受保护缓存替代方案、政策兼容钓鱼、提供方重复与声明后撤销。独立的 JS/Python 消费者在同一项目内建立有限配置的互操作性；持久恢复会重新核验证据并保留不确定的预留。结果支持一个有界、可审计的复用与执行契约，而非新的通用增量算法、任意工具闭包、原子第三方提交或生产优越性。
summary_cn: Matoi 提出可复用结果证据的选择性重验契约：1440 格匹配研究中复用在 JS/Python 降生命周期成本 3.49%/1.79%，AgentDojo Banking 映射中保留 5 次良性转账并拒绝 35 次攻击交叉。
objective_summary: 设计把结果证据复用与执行授权分离的查询感知契约 Matoi，以匹配连线研究量化复用成本收益，并在冻结的 AgentDojo Banking 映射上评估治理策略对良性转账与攻击计划的区分。
evidence_note: 1,440 格匹配连线研究与冻结 AgentDojo 映射给出具体数字；但为脚本化合成工具、覆盖 5/16 用户计划，成本收益幅度小，未经同行评审（作者自陈）。
novelty_note: 把「证据复用的选择性重验」形式化为有限查询感知契约并区分多种义务类型，是对智能体授权问题的新契约设计；无新算法或系统。
scope: 契约覆盖分支、有序集合与否定查找等有限查询形态；评估在脚本化合成工具与 AgentDojo Banking 映射上进行。
limitations: 成本收益仅 1.79%–3.49%，实用性存疑；覆盖 5/16 用户计划，泛化有限；脚本化工具不代表自主智能体或真实系统（作者自陈），且未同行评审。

title: Evaluating and Improving Static Application Security Testing Tools for Rust
abstract: Rust has become a popular systems programming language in recent years because of its strong guarantees on memory and concurrency safety. Many types of system software have been re-implemented in Rust. However, Rust programs can still suffer from common memory and concurrency vulnerabilities due to unsafe code and misunderstandings of its complex mechanisms. To mitigate such vulnerabilities, developers often rely on static application security testing (SAST) tools. However, the effectiveness of existing Rust SAST tools on real-world vulnerabilities remains underexplored. In this paper, we first conduct an empirical evaluation of mainstream Rust SAST tools using security vulnerabilities identified in real-world Rust applications. We systematically assess their effectiveness, uncover common weaknesses, and analyze the root causes behind them. Motivated by the study, we propose TRUST, a large language model (LLM)-assisted automated testing framework. TRUST automatically analyzes the official Rust reference to derive and implement semantics-preserving transformations. It leverages these transformations to generate mutant programs for evaluating Rust SAST tools and uncovering potential faults within them. Overall, TRUST has revealed 46 faults across six popular SAST tools, 17 of which have been confirmed. In addition, our study yields ten empirical findings and four practical lessons that provide actionable guidance for developing more effective, robust, and maintainable Rust SAST tools.
title_cn: 评估并改进 Rust 静态应用安全测试工具
abstract_cn: Rust 近年成为流行的系统编程语言，因其对内存与并发安全的强保证。许多系统软件已用 Rust 重新实现。然而由于 unsafe 代码与对其复杂机制的误解，Rust 程序仍可能出现常见内存与并发漏洞。为缓解此类漏洞，开发者依赖静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具，但现有 Rust SAST 工具对真实漏洞的有效性仍未被充分研究。本文首先使用真实 Rust 应用中发现的安全漏洞对主流 Rust SAST 工具进行实证评估，系统评估其有效性、揭示共同弱点并分析根因。基于该研究，我们提出 TRUST，一个 LLM 辅助的自动化测试框架。TRUST 自动分析 Rust 官方参考以推导并实现语义保持变换，利用这些变换生成变异程序以评估 Rust SAST 工具并揭示其潜在故障。总体而言，TRUST 在六款流行 SAST 工具中揭示 46 个故障，其中 17 个获确认。此外，我们的研究给出十项实证发现与四条实践教训，为开发更有效、健壮且易维护的 Rust SAST 工具提供可操作指引。
summary_cn: 对 Rust SAST 工具的系统实证评估加 LLM 辅助测试框架 TRUST：六款工具 46 个故障、17 个获确认，产出十项实证发现与四条实践教训。
objective_summary: 以真实 Rust 漏洞实证评估主流 SAST 工具的有效性与弱点根因，并提出从官方参考自动推导语义保持变换、生成变异程序测试工具的 LLM 辅助框架 TRUST。
evidence_note: 真实世界 Rust 漏洞数据集、六款工具的系统评估、46 个故障中 17 个获确认；另有十项发现与根因分析；确认比例中等，无统计检验。
novelty_note: Rust 生态的 SAST 工具有效性为首次系统评估，TRUST 是已有蜕变测试思路在 Rust 上的 LLM 化实现，属新场景的系统化。
scope: 结论限于 Rust 生态与所测六款工具；漏洞类型以 unsafe 与并发相关问题为主；变换的语义保持依赖官方参考覆盖。
limitations: 46 个故障中 17 个确认，其余可能含伪故障；真实漏洞集的代表性受公开来源限制；LLM 推导的变换规则覆盖度受官方文档约束。

title: QuasiLeak-Bench: Evaluating LLM-Based Privacy Detectors on Policy-Conditioned Quasi-Evidence Group Recovery
abstract: Natural language messages often contain quasi-identifiers that are weak in isolation but can jointly reveal an individual's private attributes. We call such a jointly revealing set of cues a quasi-evidence group. Existing privacy benchmarks focus on explicit identifiers, attribute inference, or task-driven disclosures, leaving inference from quasi-evidence groups largely unmeasured. In practice, whether exposing such a quasi-evidence group violates privacy also depends on sender-specified disclosure policies. We introduce QuasiLeak-Bench, a benchmark for policy-conditioned quasi-evidence group recovery, which evaluates whether detectors recover complete quasi-evidence groups and flag the disclosures the given policy prohibits. To obtain reliable ground truth at scale, a reverse-construction pipeline first selects weak quasi-identifiers, composes them into quasi-evidence groups verified to jointly reveal a target attribute, and generates documents around this evidence, followed by automated quality control. Experiments show that existing privacy detectors transfer poorly to QuasiLeak-Bench, and locally deployable LLM-based detectors fall far behind proprietary models, mainly because they miss most quasi-evidence groups altogether. However, a 4B model fine-tuned on our training split surpasses the strongest prompted model on held-out documents, showing that the task is learnable.
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 25 tables
title_cn: QuasiLeak-Bench：在策略条件准证据组恢复上评估 LLM 隐私检测器
abstract_cn: 自然语言消息常包含孤立看很弱但联合起来能揭示个人隐私属性的准标识符。我们把这种联合揭示的线索集合称为准证据组。现有隐私基准聚焦显式标识符、属性推断或任务驱动披露，对来自准证据组的推断几乎没有测量。实践中，暴露此类准证据组是否违反隐私还取决于发送方指定的披露策略。我们提出 QuasiLeak-Bench，一个面向策略条件准证据组恢复的基准，评估检测器能否恢复完整的准证据组并标记给定政策禁止的披露。为大规模获得可靠真值，一条反向构造流水线先选择弱准标识符，把它们组合成经验证可联合揭示目标属性的准证据组，再围绕该证据生成文档，随后进行自动化质量控制。实验表明现有隐私检测器向 QuasiLeak-Bench 迁移效果差，本地可部署的基于 LLM 的检测器远落后于专有模型，主要因为它们几乎完全漏掉准证据组；然而在我们训练集上微调的 4B 模型在保留文档上超过最强的提示模型，说明该任务可学习。
summary_cn: QuasiLeak-Bench 评估策略条件准证据组恢复：现有检测器迁移差、本地 LLM 远落后专有模型，微调 4B 可反超最强提示模型，任务可学习。
objective_summary: 构建以反向构造流水线生成可靠真值的准证据组恢复基准 QuasiLeak-Bench，要求检测器完整恢复联合揭示组并按发送方政策标记违规披露，并系统评估现有与微调检测器。
evidence_note: 自建基准加自动化质量控制流水线，评估多类检测器并做微调对照实验；数据为合成生成，与真实泄露分布存在差距；无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「弱线索联合揭示+策略条件违规判定」形式化为可测任务并给出首个对应基准，任务定义与真值构造流水线均有新意。
scope: 适用于文本消息场景与英文数据；披露策略由合成方式注入；对多模态与多语言消息未覆盖。
limitations: 合成文档与真实泄露语境的分布差距；政策条件由构造注入，自然政策多样性有限；专有与本地模型的差距可能随版本更迭变化。

title: Combining LLM and Dynamic Analysis for Universal Testing of Static Application Security Testing Tools
abstract: Static application security testing (SAST) tools help detect potential software vulnerabilities, but they themselves contain faults undermining reliability and usability. Automated testing can address these issues, yet current techniques suffer from limited program transformation diversity and lack mechanisms to verify generated variants, leading to reduced fault detection and high manual effort. We present LLM4SAST, the first universal framework detecting faults in SAST tools using large language models and dynamic feedback. Our key insight is leveraging LLMs to understand and transform code in diverse programming languages. We design novel metamorphic relations with transformations to guide variant generation, using an LLM to produce multi-language variants that satisfy these relations. To reduce erroneous variants and identify unique faults, we propose two heuristics: dynamic-feedback-driven selection and program-differencing-based clustering. For each metamorphic relation, a report-centric test oracle detects variants that fail tests and identifies underlying faults by differentially analyzing SAST reports of the seed program and its variants. LLM4SAST identified 66 unique faults across six SAST tools, with 32 confirmed or fixed after being reported to developers, demonstrating effectiveness. The proposed heuristics eliminate 47.8% of false positives, and LLM4SAST detects 3.4 times more faults while requiring only 39.8% of the variants compared to existing approaches.
title_cn: 结合 LLM 与动态分析通用测试静态应用安全测试工具
abstract_cn: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具有助于发现潜在软件漏洞，但它们自身包含削弱可靠性与可用性的缺陷。自动化测试可以解决这些问题，然而现有技术的程序变换多样性有限且缺乏验证生成变体的机制，导致故障检出率低与人工成本高。我们提出 LLM4SAST，首个用大语言模型与动态反馈检测 SAST 工具故障的通用框架。关键洞察是利用 LLM 理解并变换多种编程语言的代码。我们设计带变换的新型蜕变关系指导变体生成，用 LLM 生成满足这些关系的多语言变体。为减少错误变体并识别独特故障，我们提出两个启发式：动态反馈驱动的选择与基于程序差异的聚类。对每条蜕变关系，以报告为中心的测试预言检测未通过测试的变体，并通过差异分析种子程序与其变体的 SAST 报告定位底层故障。LLM4SAST 在六款 SAST 工具中发现 66 个独特故障，其中 32 个在报告给开发者后得到确认或修复，证明了有效性。所提启发式消除 47.8% 的误报，且与现有方法相比 LLM4SAST 以 39.8% 的变体数量检出 3.4 倍的故障。
summary_cn: LLM4SAST 用 LLM 变换+蜕变关系+动态反馈通用测试 SAST 工具：六款工具 66 个独特故障、32 个获确认或修复，误报消减 47.8%，变体减至 39.8% 而故障检出 3.4 倍。
objective_summary: 提出基于 LLM 多语言代码变换、蜕变关系与报告中心预言的 SAST 工具测试框架 LLM4SAST，辅以动态反馈选择与程序差异聚类，在六款工具上量化故障检出与误报消减。
evidence_note: 六款 SAST 工具、66 个独特故障中 32 个经开发者确认或修复（外部验证），并与现有方法量化对比；多语言通用性有实证支撑。
novelty_note: 首个以 LLM 实现跨语言通用化的 SAST 工具蜕变测试框架，变换多样性、变体验证与故障聚类机制成体系，超越既有单语言方法。
scope: 结论覆盖所测六款 SAST 工具与其支持的变换语言；故障定位依赖 SAST 报告差异；蜕变关系覆盖的漏洞类型有限。
limitations: LLM 生成的变体仍可能引入伪故障（启发式消减 47.8% 后非零）；对漏报型缺陷的覆盖依赖所选蜕变关系；工具更新可能使结果时效性有限。

title: When Rotation Bounds Nothing: Streaming Image Classifiers to Field Nodes Under Physical Capture
abstract: Field nodes run image classifiers locally, exposing a first-class asset, the trained model, to theft. Trusted-execution enclaves, collaborative-inference splits, and encrypted storage assume the device owner is the adversary from deployment. Here the operator owns the node, and an adversary seizing it reads only what cold-boot capture finds resident. One answer stores nothing: a chunkable multi-exit model streams into volatile memory, rotating to bound residency. We characterise the capture envelope on real LTE traces across two victims of one architecture, against passive and adaptive adversaries. Neither survives a capable adversary; recovery cost alone differs. Against a from-scratch victim the uncaptured stages must be learned: the adaptive adversary gains most at shallow seizures, ends the CIFAR-10 envelope at every rotation, and stays rotation-bounded on CIFAR100, from 42.6% of usable seizures at 5 s to 86.8% at 30 s. Against the same architecture sliced from a public pretrained backbone, the adversary downloads those stages, recovering at least 90% of maximum accuracy at all depths, taking usable CIFAR-100 seizures from 0.0% to 97.3% at 5 s, given the victim's full labelled training set. Delivery-side secrecy raises a seizure's price; a public copy of the withheld stages erases it.
title_cn: 轮换何时限制不了什么：物理抓获下流式图像分类器到野外节点
abstract_cn: 野外节点在本地运行图像分类器，使训练好的模型这一一级资产暴露于失窃风险。可信执行飞地、协同推理切分与加密存储都从部署时起假设设备拥有者是对手。这里运营者拥有节点，抓获设备的对手只能读到冷启动抓获时驻留在内存中的内容。一个答案是什都不存：把可分块的多出口模型流式送入易失性内存，通过轮换限制驻留。我们在真实 LTE 痕迹上、对同一架构的两个受害者，针对被动与自适应对手刻画这一抓获包络。两种对手都无法被完全防住，差异只在恢复成本。对从零训练的受害者，未抓获阶段必须被学习：自适应对手在浅层抓获时收益最大，在 CIFAR-10 上于每次轮换都终结包络，在 CIFAR-100 上保持轮换受限，5 秒时为可用抓获的 42.6%、30 秒时为 86.8%。对同一架构但从公开预训练骨干切出的受害者，对手直接下载那些阶段，在所有深度恢复至少 90% 的最大精度，在受害者完整标注训练集可得的前提下把 CIFAR-100 可用抓获从 0.0% 提到 5 秒时的 97.3%。交付侧保密提高抓获代价；被扣阶段的公开副本会抹掉这一代价。
summary_cn: 刻画流式轮换模型驻留在物理抓获下的包络：自适应对手在 CIFAR-100 上 5 秒/30 秒抓获利用率 42.6%/86.8%，受害者用公开预训练骨干时可用抓获升至 97.3%。
objective_summary: 在真实 LTE 痕迹与两类受害者（从零训练、公开骨干切分）上，针对被动与自适应对手量化「流式多出口模型+内存轮换」对抗物理抓获的包络，并评估预训练权重可得性的影响。
evidence_note: 真实 LTE 痕迹、双受害者、双对手设定的系统刻画，报告具体利用率数字；限于单一架构与图像分类任务，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出「运营者自有节点被物理抓获」这一不同于恶意共租的威胁模型，并给出流式轮换防御的负面量化结论，具诊断价值。
scope: 结论限于单一架构图像分类模型、LTE 痕迹仿真与冷启动物理抓获设定；对手能力上限为可下载公开权重。
limitations: 单一架构与任务域，跨架构泛化未知；自适应对手假设可获得受害者完整标注训练集；未与其他模型保护方案做系统对比。

title: Trigger Value Selection in Clean-Label Malware Backdoors: An Effectiveness-Detectability Analysis
abstract: Clean-label backdoor poisoning is a threat to machine learning-based malware classifiers because poisoned samples can be inserted into training data without changing their labels. Previous explanation-guided attacks mainly focus on selecting important trigger features, but the values assigned to these features can also affect the attack behavior. In this paper, we study trigger value selection as an independent design factor in clean-label backdoor attacks against feature-based malware classifiers. We evaluate several value-selection strategies on EMBER 2018 and a Win64 PE subset of EMBER 2024 using LightGBM classifiers. We compare rare-value, SHAP-based, frequency-bounded, co-occurrence-aware, and quantile-based selectors under random and distribution-based malware-similar benign sampling. The results show that aggressive selectors such as MinPopulation and CountAbsSHAP can achieve high attack success rate, especially under distribution-based sampling, but they are also easier to detect by sanitization methods such as Isolation Forest. In contrast, selectors such as CorrCountAbsSHAP and Quantile95 can reduce poison recall while keeping useful attack effectiveness. These findings show that trigger value selection is not merely an implementation detail, but an important design choice that shapes the effectiveness and detectability profile of clean-label malware backdoor attacks.
title_cn: 干净标签恶意软件后门中的触发值选择：有效性-可检测性分析
abstract_cn: 干净标签后门投毒对基于机器学习的恶意软件分类器构成威胁，因为被投毒样本可以在不改变标签的情况下插入训练数据。以往的解释引导攻击主要聚焦选择重要触发特征，但赋给这些特征的值也会影响攻击行为。本文把触发值选择作为针对基于特征的恶意软件分类器的干净标签后门攻击的独立设计因素进行研究。我们在 EMBER 2018 与 EMBER 2024 的 Win64 PE 子集上、使用 LightGBM 分类器评估多种值选择策略，在随机与基于分布的恶意样本相似良性采样下比较稀有值、基于 SHAP、频率有界、共现感知与分位数选择器。结果表明：MinPopulation 与 CountAbsSHAP 等激进选择器能取得高攻击成功率，尤其在基于分布的采样下，但也更易被 Isolation Forest 等消毒方法检测；CorrCountAbsSHAP 与 Quantile95 等选择器则能在保持有效攻击力的同时降低投毒召回率。这些发现表明触发值选择不仅是实现细节，而是塑造干净标签恶意软件后门攻击有效性与可检测性轮廓的重要设计选择。
summary_cn: 在 EMBER 2018/2024 与 LightGBM 上系统评估干净标签后门的触发值选择：激进策略（MinPopulation 等）成功率高但易被 Isolation Forest 检出，CorrCountAbsSHAP 等可平衡两者。
objective_summary: 把触发值选择作为干净标签后门攻击的独立设计维度，在 EMBER 2018/2024 上用 LightGBM 比较五种值选择策略在两种良性采样下的攻击成功率与 Isolation Forest 检测召回。
evidence_note: 两个公开数据集（EMBER 2018/2024）、LightGBM 分类器、五种选择器与两种采样机制的系统对比，指标明确；无统计检验，限于特征向量式分类器。
novelty_note: 把以往被当作实现细节的触发值选择提为独立设计因素并量化其有效-可检测性权衡，属对既有攻击面的诊断性实证分析。
scope: 结论适用于基于特征的恶意软件分类器（LightGBM）与 EMBER 数据分布；对深度或序列恶意代码模型的适用性未验证。
limitations: 消毒评估限于 Isolation Forest 等有限方法；攻击者假设可向训练集插入不改标签的样本，现实投放链可行性未验证；仅覆盖 Windows PE 特征。

title: From One Query to Many: A Critical Survey of Privacy Accounting in RAG
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models to leverage external knowledge but introduces privacy risks when the retrieved corpus contains sensitive information. Differential privacy (DP) offers formal protection, yet interpreting and comparing privacy guarantees across existing DP-RAG methods remains challenging. In particular, a privacy budget reported for a single response does not directly characterize privacy loss over repeated queries, and even identical values of $\varepsilon$ may represent different guarantees depending on the protected data unit, accounting horizon, and observable outputs. This survey critically examines how privacy accounting evolves from single-query generation to multi-query RAG systems. We categorize existing approaches into query-time privatization, multi-query accounting, and one-time corpus privatization. We analyze their underlying assumptions and privacy--utility trade-offs. Rather than ranking methods by $\varepsilon$ alone, we propose a framework that interprets a DP-RAG guarantee along three dimensions: privacy granularity, accounting scope, and release boundaries. We conclude that an $\eps$ is a claim only together with the three slots: the protected unit, the accounting scope, and the release boundary.
title_cn: 从一次查询到多次查询：RAG 隐私会计的批判性综述
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大语言模型能够利用外部知识，但当被检索语料包含敏感信息时会引入隐私风险。差分隐私（DP）提供形式化保护，然而解读与比较现有 DP-RAG 方法的隐私保证仍然困难。特别是，为单次响应报告的隐私预算并不能直接刻画重复查询下的隐私损失，即使 ε 值相同，其含义也随受保护数据单元、会计范围与可观测输出而不同。本综述批判性考察隐私会计如何从单次生成演进到多查询 RAG 系统。我们把现有方法归为查询时私有化、多查询会计与一次性语料私有化三类，分析其底层假设与隐私-效用权衡。我们不单按 ε 排序方法，而是提出沿隐私粒度、会计范围与发布边界三个维度解读 DP-RAG 保证的框架。结论是：ε 只有连同受保护单元、会计范围与发布边界三个槽位一起才构成一个主张。
summary_cn: 批判性综述 DP-RAG 隐私会计：把方法归为查询时私有化、多查询会计与语料私有化三类，提出以隐私粒度、会计范围、发布边界三槽位解读 ε 的框架。
objective_summary: 系统梳理 DP-RAG 隐私会计从单查询到多查询的演进，按三类方法归类并分析假设与隐私-效用权衡，提出沿三个维度解读隐私保证的比较框架。
evidence_note: 综述性工作：提供分类框架与概念分析，无新实验；其价值在组织既有方法的假设差异。
novelty_note: 提出「ε 需与受保护单元、会计范围、发布边界一起解读」的三槽位框架，对比较 DP-RAG 方法有组织价值；属概念梳理而非新机制。
scope: 覆盖检索增强生成场景下的差分隐私会计；对具体系统的参数选择需逐案分析。
limitations: 不含新实验或定量比较；分类依赖作者判断；对新兴 DP-RAG 方法的覆盖有时间边界。

title: On the Complexity of Symmetric Boolean Functions in Multiparty Private Simultaneous Messages
abstract: Multiparty Private Simultaneous Messages (PSM), also known as Decomposable Randomized Encoding (DRE) or information-theoretic garbling, is a model for non-interactive secure computation. Each party encodes its input using shared randomness and sends a message to an evaluator who does not know that randomness. The evaluator must recover the function output without learning anything else about the inputs. Perfect privacy requires identical transcript distributions on inputs with the same output. We also study the weaker notion of support privacy, which requires only that these distributions have the same support. We study the communication complexity of symmetric Boolean functions when each of the $n$ parties holds one input bit. Lower bounds. We prove a superlinear lower bound for support-private PSM protocols computing $OR_n$. Our technique gives $\Omega(n\log n)$ lower bounds for $MAJ_n$ and $EMAJ_n$ (with even $n$), and an $\Omega(n\log q)$ lower bound for $MOD_q$ when $q\leq(1-c)n$ for a fixed constant $c>0$. Upper bounds. We construct perfectly private PSM protocols of total communication $\widetilde{O}(n^{3/2})$ for every symmetric Boolean function, improving on the known quadratic bound. For $MAJ_n$, known branching-program constructions yield an upper bound of $O(n\log^3 n\log\log n)$. For $EMAJ_n$ and $MOD_q$ with prime $q$, the lower bounds are tight up to constant factors in the stated regimes. Under support privacy, we obtain $\widetilde{O}(n)$ communication for every symmetric Boolean function. Earlier lower-bound techniques of Ball et al. (ITCS 2020) yield only trivial linear bounds for symmetric Boolean functions. Concurrent and independent work by Holmgren and Wu proves a $\omega(n)$ lower bound for $OR_n$ using the same combinatorial core. Both works used AI assistance.
title_cn: 多方私有同步消息中对称布尔函数的复杂度
abstract_cn: 多方私有同步消息（PSM），也称可分解随机化编码（DRE）或信息论伪装，是一种非交互安全计算模型。每方使用共享随机性编码其输入并发送消息给不知晓该随机性的评估者。评估者必须恢复函数输出而不学习输入的任何其他信息。完美隐私要求相同输出的输入具有相同的转录分布。我们还研究较弱的支撑隐私，只要求这些分布具有相同的支撑。我们研究每方持有一个输入比特时对称布尔函数的通信复杂度。下界：我们证明支撑隐私 PSM 协议计算 OR_n 的超线性下界；该技术对 MAJ_n 与 EMAJ_n（n 为偶数）给出 Ω(n log n) 下界，对 q≤(1−c)n（c 为固定正常数）的 MOD_q 给出 Ω(n log q) 下界。上界：我们为每个对称布尔函数构造总通信 Õ(n^{3/2}) 的完美隐私 PSM 协议，改进已知的二次界；对 MAJ_n，已知分支程序构造给出 O(n log³ n log log n) 上界；对 EMAJ_n 与素数 q 的 MOD_q，所述区域内下界在常数因子内紧。支撑隐私下，我们对每个对称布尔函数得到 Õ(n) 通信。Ball 等人（ITCS 2020）的早期下界技术对对称布尔函数只能给出平凡线性界。Holmgren 与 Wu 的并行独立工作用同一组合核心证明 OR_n 的 ω(n) 下界。两项工作都使用了 AI 辅助。
summary_cn: 证明支撑隐私 PSM 计算 OR_n 的超线性下界，并给出所有对称布尔函数 Õ(n^1.5) 完美隐私协议（改进二次界）与支撑隐私 Õ(n) 协议，部分下界在常数因子内紧。
objective_summary: 研究单比特输入多方 PSM 中对称布尔函数的通信复杂度：证明 OR_n 支撑隐私超线性下界与 MAJ、EMAJ、MOD_q 的 Ω(n log n)、Ω(n log q) 下界，构造 Õ(n^{3/2}) 完美隐私与 Õ(n) 支撑隐私上界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：证明完整，上界改进已知二次结果，EMAJ/MOD_q 的下界在所述区域常数因子内紧；与 Holmgren–Wu 的并行独立工作相互印证。
novelty_note: 给出此前只有平凡界的对称函数支撑隐私 PSM 首个超线性下界，并把完美隐私上界从二次降到 Õ(n^{3/2})，属实质性理论改进（OR 下界与独立工作并行）。
scope: 限于每方一比特输入的对称布尔函数；完美隐私与支撑隐私两种 PSM 模型；常数因子未优化。
limitations: 函数类限定为对称函数与单比特输入；MAJ 的上下界之间仍有差距；支撑隐私与完美隐私上界间的间隙未闭合。

title: Clean Data Can Still Carry Backdoors: Support-Persistent Backdoors for Model Reuse
abstract: Traditional backdoor attacks inject artificial trigger patterns into training data, causing models to misclassify triggered inputs while maintaining normal behavior on clean samples. Since these artificial triggers are absent in clean datasets, standard knowledge distillation (KD) typically eliminates them, leading to the common belief that KD serves as an effective purification defense. In this paper, we propose DAR (Discover-and-Relabel), a support-persistent backdoor method that retains its behavior even after clean-data distillation. DAR identifies naturally abundant patterns in low-dimensional feature subspaces using subspace clustering and applies label-only poisoning to samples that inherently satisfy the discovered rule. At test time, the backdoor is activated by locally modifying the corresponding subspace of the target images. By instantiating spatial and frequency operators, DAR achieves attack accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art backdoor attacks in ImageNet classification and CLIP-based prompt tuning. Notably, DAR keeps attack success above 96% after clean KD and remains defense-resistant in practice. Project page: https://junhoo.me/backdoor
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 干净数据也能携带后门：面向模型复用的支撑持久后门
abstract_cn: 传统后门攻击向训练数据注入人工触发模式，使模型对被触发输入错误分类而在干净样本上保持正常行为。由于人工触发在干净数据集中不存在，标准知识蒸馏（KD）通常能消除它们，因此形成「KD 是有效净化防御」的普遍看法。本文提出 DAR（Discover-and-Relabel），一种在干净数据蒸馏后仍保持行为的支撑持久后门方法。DAR 用子空间聚类在低维特征子空间中识别自然存在的模式，并对天然满足所发现规则的样本施加仅标签投毒。测试时，后门通过局部修改目标图像的相应子空间被激活。通过实例化空间与频率算子，DAR 在 ImageNet 分类与基于 CLIP 的提示调优中取得与最先进后门攻击相当的攻击准确率。值得注意的是，DAR 在干净 KD 之后攻击成功率仍保持 96% 以上，并在实践中抵抗防御。项目页：https://junhoo.me/backdoor。
summary_cn: DAR 用子空间聚类发现自然模式并做仅标签投毒，构造经干净数据知识蒸馏后攻击成功率仍超 96% 的支撑持久后门，在 ImageNet 与 CLIP 提示调优上有效（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出支撑持久后门方法 DAR：以子空间聚类发现数据中自然存在的判别模式、仅标签投毒、测试时局部修改子空间触发，并在 ImageNet 与 CLIP 提示调优上评估其对知识蒸馏与防御的存活率。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 录用；ImageNet 与 CLIP 提示调优两个设定、与最先进后门攻击对比、报告 KD 后 96% 以上成功率与防御抵抗；具体防御消融细节在摘要未展开。
novelty_note: 推翻「干净数据 KD 可净化后门」的普遍信念：无需人工触发、依赖自然模式的支撑持久后门为新机制，威胁模型有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于图像分类与提示调优设定；攻击假设攻击者可控制部分训练标签并在测试时修改目标图像的局部子空间。
limitations: 测试时需要对目标图像的可修改访问，限制了远程触发场景；子空间规则发现依赖特征空间结构，跨架构迁移未报告；「实践中抵抗防御」的评估集合有限。

title: FedSumUp: User-Auditable Privacy-Aware Representation Sharing for Resource-Constrained Federated Intelligence
abstract: Existing federated data condensation methods face privacy risks, as uploaded synthetic data may preserve sensitive information and remain vulnerable to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, their generation often incurs considerable client-side computational overhead, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. To address these issues, we propose FedSumUp, which employs a learnable lossy compressor on clients to generate compact and visually interpretable representations. By controlling information capacity, FedSumUp reduces privacy leakage while allowing users to directly assess the privacy-utility tradeoff. We further introduce a dual-objective optimization mechanism to preserve task-relevant semantics while suppressing reconstruction risks. The compressor is trained on the server and only performs lightweight inference on clients. Since the server cannot access raw data, we develop a data-free closed-loop optimization strategy that optimizes the compressor by minimizing the discrepancy between original and twice-compressed representations after structure-preserving upsampling. Experiments on BloodMNIST, CIFAR-10, and ChestMNIST demonstrate reconstruction PSNR as low as 8.56 dB (with synthetic PSNR as low as 5.45 dB), client runtime reductions up to 96.5% (from 778s to 27s on ChestMNIST), and competitive classification accuracy (89.72% ChestMNIST, 82.24% BloodMNIST, 65.63% CIFAR-10), while remaining inherently robust to non-IID data distributions.
comment: 21 pages, including appendices. Jingwei Zhao and Tiantong Sun contributed equally. Corresponding author: Xiaojin Zhang
title_cn: FedSumUp：资源受限联邦智能中用户可审计的隐私感知表示共享
abstract_cn: 现有联邦数据凝结方法面临隐私风险：上传的合成数据可能保留敏感信息并易受重建攻击。此外其生成往往带来可观的客户端计算开销，限制在资源受限设备上的部署。为解决这些问题，我们提出 FedSumUp，它在客户端采用可学习的有损压缩器生成紧凑且视觉可解释的表示。通过控制信息容量，FedSumUp 在允许用户直接评估隐私-效用权衡的同时降低隐私泄露。我们进一步引入双目标优化机制，在抑制重建风险的同时保留任务相关语义。压缩器在服务器上训练，客户端只执行轻量推理。由于服务器无法访问原始数据，我们开发数据无关闭环优化策略，通过最小化结构保持上采样后原始与两次压缩表示之间的差异来优化压缩器。在 BloodMNIST、CIFAR-10 与 ChestMNIST 上的实验表明：重建 PSNR 低至 8.56 dB（合成图像 PSNR 低至 5.45 dB），客户端运行时间最多降低 96.5%（ChestMNIST 上从 778 秒到 27 秒），同时保持有竞争力的分类准确率（ChestMNIST 89.72%、BloodMNIST 82.24%、CIFAR-10 65.63%），并对非 IID 数据分布天然鲁棒。
summary_cn: FedSumUp 用客户端可学习有损压缩器替代合成数据上传：重建 PSNR 低至 8.56 dB、客户端运行时降 96.5%，三数据集准确率 65.63%–89.72%，支持用户审计隐私-效用权衡。
objective_summary: 提出联邦数据凝结系统 FedSumUp：服务器训练、客户端轻量推理的可学习有损压缩器加双目标优化与数据无关闭环训练，在三个图像数据集上量化重建泄露、客户端开销与分类精度。
evidence_note: 三个公开数据集上的重建 PSNR、运行时间与准确率数字具体，与凝结方法的常见指标对齐；无统计检验，基线对比细节在摘要中未展开。
novelty_note: 把「用户可审计的信息容量控制」引入联邦凝结并提出数据无关的压缩器闭环训练，属机制组合层面的新意；有损压缩表示本身非首创。
scope: 适用于图像分类任务与资源受限客户端设定；隐私评估以重建 PSNR 为代理；三个数据集规模有限。
limitations: 隐私保障以重建 PSNR 衡量，未评估更强重建攻击；分类精度低于直接训练；闭环优化依赖结构保持上采样假设，收敛性论证未在摘要中给出。

title: Explicit reduced APN permutations: ramification and optimal Galois-ring lifts
abstract: Let $m\ge5$ be odd and $q=2^m$. For every odd $r$ with $3\le r<m$ and $\gcd(r,m)=1$ we give the reduced polynomial $P_{m,r}=\mathrm{red}((T_r^3)^{2^{m-2}})$, $T_r=\sum_{i<r}X^{2^i}$, explicitly: it has coefficients in $\mathbb{F}_2$ and exactly $3r-2$ terms, it is an APN permutation of $\mathbb{F}_q$, and its formal derivative $1+X^{2^{r-2}}+X^{2^{m-2}}$ has no zero on $\mathbb{F}_q$ and is two-to-one. We determine the ramification of $P_{m,r}$ as a map of the projective line for all admissible $(m,r)$: there are $2^{m-r}$ finite ramification points, all wild, with index and different exponent $2^{r-2}$, all over the single finite branch value $1$. The $0/1$ lift of $P_{m,r}$ satisfies an identity in $\mathbb{Z}[X]$ that evaluates it over every Galois ring $\mathrm{GR}(2^k,m)$ with $m-1$ squarings, one general multiplication and $r+5$ additions or subtractions. For every quadratic optimal APN permutation $p$ of $\mathbb{F}_q$ (in particular $P_{m,r}$), every $k\ge2$ and every coefficient lift $F$ of $p$ to $\mathrm{GR}(2^k,m)$, we determine the differential rows of $F$ exactly in the unit directions whose residue lies outside the kernel $\{0,\rho\}$ of the linear part of $p'$ (they are the residue rows of $p$; $\rho=1$ for $P_{m,r}$) and in the directions in $2^{k-1}\mathrm{GR}(2^k,m)\setminus\{0\}$ (every nonzero entry equals $2q^{k-1}$). We also give a self-contained proof of the Li--Wang criterion for a Gold function plus a linearised polynomial, which explains why the inner map of $P_{m,r}$ is not a monomial, and record a two-word, two-layer transition that a simple linear layer forbids at the residue level.
comment: 15 pages. Submitted to Finite Fields and Their Applications. Code, Lean 4 formalization and blueprint: this https URL (version 1.0.1; this https URL)
title_cn: 显式既约 APN 置换：分歧与最优伽罗瓦环提升
abstract_cn: 设 m≥5 为奇数且 q=2^m。对每个满足 3≤r<m 且 gcd(r,m)=1 的奇数 r，我们显式给出既约多项式 P_{m,r}=red((T_r^3)^(2^{m-2}))，其中 T_r=Σ_{i<r}X^(2^i)：其系数在 F₂ 中且恰有 3r−2 项，是 F_q 上的 APN 置换，其形式导数 1+X^(2^{r-2})+X^(2^{m-2}) 在 F_q 上无零点且为二到一。我们确定 P_{m,r} 作为射影直线上映射的分歧：对所有可行 (m,r)，存在 2^{m-r} 个有限分歧点，全部为野分歧，指标与判别式指数均为 2^{r-2}，且都位于唯一的有限分支值 1 之上。P_{m,r} 的 0/1 提升满足 Z[X] 中的恒等式，使其在每个伽罗瓦环 GR(2^k,m) 上以 m−1 次平方、一次一般乘法与 r+5 次加减求值。对 F_q 上每个二次最优 APN 置换 p（特别是 P_{m,r}）、每个 k≥2 与 p 到 GR(2^k,m) 的每个系数提升 F，我们精确确定 F 的微分行：在剩余部分落在 p 的线性部分核 {0,ρ} 之外的单位方向上（它们是 p 的剩余行；对 P_{m,r} 有 ρ=1），以及在 2^{k-1}GR(2^k,m)\{0} 中的方向上（每个非零元素都等于 2q^{k-1}）。我们还给出 Gold 函数加线性化多项式判据（Li–Wang 判据）的自足证明——它解释了 P_{m,r} 的内映射为何不是单项式——并记录一个简单线性层在剩余层面禁止的两字两层转换。
summary_cn: 显式给出 3r−2 项的 APN 置换族 P_{m,r}：导数二到一且无零点，确定其野分歧结构，并精确刻画其在伽罗瓦环 GR(2^k,m) 上的微分行与求值恒等式。
objective_summary: 构造显式二次 APN 置换族 P_{m,r}，确定其射影直线分歧结构，给出跨伽罗瓦环的求值恒等式与微分行精确刻画，并自足证明 Li–Wang 判据。
evidence_note: 理论论文：显式族加完整证明，附 Lean 4 形式化与蓝图公开；结论为构造与刻画，无实验成分。
novelty_note: 给出可复核的显式无限族及其分歧与提升的完整刻画，与姊妹篇（最优代表元存在性，同日 2610.21169）互补；属构造侧的落实。
scope: 限于奇数 m≥5、3≤r<m 且 gcd(r,m)=1 的族与特征 2^k 伽罗瓦环；结论为数学构造，与具体密码组件的直接关联未建立。
limitations: 族受 r 的互素条件限制；与实际密码设计（如 S 盒选型）的联系停留在差分性质层面；部分结果依赖姊妹篇的框架。

title: Amora: Communication-Efficient Private Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
abstract: Approximate nearest neighbors search (ANNS) over cloud-hosted vector databases raises a critical privacy concern: the query vector, which often encodes sensitive user intent, is exposed to the server. Private ANNS (PANNS) allows a client to retrieve nearest neighbors without revealing its query. The state-of-the-art single-server scheme, Pacmann (ICLR'25), achieves high accuracy via graph-based search with private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs substantial communication overhead because each PIR query retrieves only a single vertex. We present Amora, a communication-efficient PANNS system that applies SimplePIR to a partitioned graph index so that one PIR query is amortized over many vertices. To retrieve as much of the distance and neighbor information the search needs under a limited communication budget, Amora adopts a dual-PIR split layout with two heterogeneous PIR matrices that stay balanced in dimension: VecPIR retrieves inner products for an entire partition of vertices as their distance at once, while NbrPIR retrieves necessary neighbor lists at subgroup granularity for graph traversal. This layout shifts the cost model of PIR query from per-vertex to per-partition, which significantly reduces the communication overhead. To further improve efficiency by reducing the number of scans and query rounds in the PIR database, Amora introduces batch PIR to pack multiple queries into one matrix multiplication, centroid-based pruning to filter unpromising partitions, and TopCand exploration that seeds jump-style graph navigation with the closest vertices from each retrieved partition. We evaluate Amora on five datasets spanning 96 to 1024 dimensions and up to 10 million vectors. Compared to Pacmann, Amora reduces online communication by 93--99% while achieving higher search accuracy.
comment: Accepted at SIGMOD 2027
title_cn: Amora：通信高效的安全近似最近邻检索
abstract_cn: 云托管向量数据库上的近似最近邻检索（ANNS）引发关键隐私问题：查询向量通常编码敏感用户意图，会暴露给服务器。隐私保护 ANNS（PANNS）允许客户端在不泄露查询的情况下检索最近邻。当前最先进的单服务器方案 Pacmann（ICLR'25）通过基于图的搜索与私有信息检索（PIR）实现高准确率，但每次 PIR 查询只取回单个顶点，通信开销巨大。我们提出 Amora，一个通信高效的 PANNS 系统，将 SimplePIR 应用到分区的图索引上，使一次 PIR 查询摊销到多个顶点。为在有限通信预算下取回搜索所需的距离与邻居信息，Amora 采用维度保持均衡的双异构 PIR 矩阵的双 PIR 分裂布局：VecPIR 一次取回整个分区内各顶点的内积作为距离，NbrPIR 以子组粒度取回图遍历所需的邻居列表。该布局把 PIR 查询的成本模型从按顶点转移到按分区，显著降低通信开销。为进一步减少 PIR 数据库的扫描次数与查询轮次，Amora 引入把多个查询打包成一次矩阵乘法的批量 PIR、过滤无望分区的质心剪枝，以及用每个取回分区最近顶点为跳式图导航播种的 TopCand 探索。我们在覆盖 96 到 1024 维、至多一千万向量的五个数据集上评估 Amora。与 Pacmann 相比，Amora 将在线通信降低 93%–99%，同时取得更高检索准确率。
summary_cn: Amora 用双 PIR 分裂布局把 PIR 成本从按顶点摊销到按分区：五个数据集（至多千万向量）上较 Pacmann 在线通信降低 93%–99% 且准确率更高（SIGMOD 2027）。
objective_summary: 设计把 SimplePIR 摊销到图索引分区的双 PIR 布局 PANNS 系统 Amora，配合批量 PIR、质心剪枝与 TopCand 探索，在五个数据集上与 Pacmann 比较通信与准确率。
evidence_note: SIGMOD 2027 录用；五个数据集、96–1024 维、至千万级向量，报告 93%–99% 通信削减与准确率提升；计算时延在摘要中未报告。
novelty_note: 在 Pacmann 之上的实质性系统改进：双异构 PIR 矩阵布局与按分区成本模型为新技术组合，非新问题。
scope: 单服务器 PANNS、基于图的索引与 SimplePIR 设定；结论覆盖所测五个数据集；通信为主要优化目标。
limitations: 摘要未报告检索时延与计算开销；布局依赖图索引分区质量；单服务器设定下的信任假设与多服务器方案不可直接比较。

title: Optimal Reduced Representatives of Quadratic APN Permutations in Odd Dimension
abstract: The formal derivative of the reduced polynomial representative of a map on a binary finite field depends on the coordinates, although its differential uniformity does not. This matters for lifting permutations to Galois rings: a polynomial over a Galois ring of characteristic a power of two greater than two permutes the ring exactly when its reduction permutes the residue field and the derivative of the reduction has no zero there. We prove that for every odd $n\ge5$, every quadratic almost perfect nonlinear permutation $Q$ of $\mathbb{F}_{2^n}$ admits invertible binary-linear maps $L$ and $A$ such that the derivative of the reduced representative of $L\circ Q\circ A$ has no zero and each of its nonempty fibres has exactly two elements. The range is exact: this fails for $n=3$, as computed earlier, and for even $n$ there are no such permutations. For $n\ge9$, a linearization and a projectively injective cofactor map reduce the problem to counting binary matrices: more than 5% of the invertible inputs $A$ succeed, more than half for $n\ge15$, without any classification. For $n=5,7$ we use two independent classifications and finite certificates. Consequently every such permutation is linearly equivalent to a counterexample to the reduced critical-point conjecture of Bartoli and St\u{a}nic\u{a} that lifts to permutation polynomials of optimal differential uniformity over every Galois ring with this residue field. For odd $n\ge9$ the existence proof is checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant.

title_cn: 奇数维二次 APN 置换的最优既约代表元
abstract_cn: 二元有限域上映射的既约多项式代表元的形式导数依赖于坐标选取，但其微分均匀度并不依赖。这对把置换提升到伽罗瓦环至关重要：特征为大于 2 的 2 的幂的伽罗瓦环上的多项式置换环，当且仅当其既约多项式置换剩余域且既约多项式的导数在其上无零点。我们证明：对每个奇数 n≥5，每个 F_{2^n} 上的二次几乎完全非线性（APN）置换 Q 都容许可逆二元线性映射 L 与 A，使 L∘Q∘A 的既约代表元的导数在 F_{2^n} 上无零点，且其每个非空纤维恰有两个元素。该范围是精确的：对 n=3 不成立（此前已计算），偶数 n 不存在此类置换。对 n≥9，线性化与一个射影单射的余因子映射把问题化为二元矩阵计数：超过 5% 的可逆输入 A 成功，n≥15 时超过一半，无需任何分类。对 n=5、7，我们使用两个独立分类与有限证书。因此每个此类置换都线性等价于 Bartoli 与 Stănică 既约临界点猜想的反例，并提升为在每个具有该剩余域的伽罗瓦环上具有最优微分均匀度的置换多项式。对奇数 n≥9，存在性证明在 Lean 4 证明助手中通过检查。
summary_cn: 证明奇数 n≥5 的每个二次 APN 置换都有导数无零点的最优既约代表元（范围精确），推翻 Bartoli–Stănică 猜想，n≥9 的证明经 Lean 4 机器检查。
objective_summary: 证明奇数维二次 APN 置换存在导数无零点、纤维恰为二的最优既约代表元并刻画精确范围，给出矩阵计数化证明策略、n=5/7 的独立分类证书与 n≥9 的 Lean 4 形式化。
evidence_note: 理论证明完整且范围精确，n≥9 存在性证明经 Lean 4 机器检查，n=5、7 附两个独立分类与有限证书；代码、证书与形式化公开。
novelty_note: 以精确刻画推翻已知猜想并给出到伽罗瓦环最优微分均匀度的提升构造，属 APN 提升方向的实质性理论推进。
scope: 限于奇数 n≥5 的二次 APN 置换与特征 2^k（k≥2）伽罗瓦环提升；偶数维不成立；n=3 为此前已知的失败情形。
limitations: n=5、7 依赖分类计算与有限证书而非完全形式化；结果与具体密码算法的集成未讨论；更高维构造的实际搜索成本随 n 的变化未系统报告。

title: CARE-SD: Explainable Reasoning Architecture for Local SLM Self-Disclosure Analysis in Textual Data
abstract: Cybersecurity interviews uncover critical security experiences, behaviors, and privacy concerns often not fully captured by conventional technical assessments. Consequently, identifying genuine self-disclosures is challenging because statements are context-dependent, categories overlap, and automated interpretations may introduce unsupported claims. Locally deployed Small Language Models (SLMs) protect sensitive participant data by keeping processing within controlled environments, but their limited reasoning capabilities make simple prompting insufficient for context-aware and factually reliable analysis. This study developed CARE-SD (Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure), a novel four-module architecture integrating context-adaptive processing, hierarchical disclosure reasoning, explanation-consistency verification, and cross-batch reconciliation. We evaluated three local SLMs, including Llama 1B, Qwen 1.5B, and Llama 3B, using 82 independently annotated cybersecurity interviews across five organizational sectors. Comparisons included conventional classifiers, three prompting strategies, larger 8B--32B models, and architectural ablations. Two independent reviewers assessed disclosure labels, factual claims, and explanation correctness. CARE-SD improved the accuracy and evidence reliability of SLMs, increasing Llama 3B Macro-F1 from 0.80 to 0.88 while reducing unsupported claims by 60\%. Remarkably, the 3B model matched the 20B reference model in category Macro-F1, demonstrating the effectiveness of the architecture without requiring a larger model.

title_cn: CARE-SD：用于文本数据本地小语言模型自我披露分析的可解释推理架构
abstract_cn: 网络安全访谈能揭示常规技术评估难以完全捕捉的安全经历、行为与隐私顾虑。因此识别真实的自我披露具有挑战性：陈述高度依赖上下文、类别相互重叠，自动化解释可能引入无依据的断言。本地部署的小语言模型（SLM）通过把处理保持在受控环境内保护参与者敏感数据，但其有限的推理能力使简单提示难以做到上下文感知且事实可靠的分析。本研究开发了 CARE-SD（Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure），一个集成上下文自适应处理、层次化披露推理、解释一致性验证与跨批协调的四模块架构。我们在五个组织部门的 82 篇独立标注网络安全访谈上评估三个本地 SLM（Llama 1B、Qwen 1.5B 与 Llama 3B），比较对象包括常规分类器、三种提示策略、8B–32B 更大模型与架构消融，并由两名独立评审员评估披露标签、事实断言与解释正确性。CARE-SD 提升了 SLM 的准确率与证据可靠性：Llama 3B 宏 F1 从 0.80 提高到 0.88，无依据断言减少 60%。值得注意的 3B 模型在类别宏 F1 上与 20B 参考模型持平，证明该架构无需更大模型即有效。
summary_cn: 四模块架构提升本地 SLM 的访谈自披露分析：Llama 3B 宏 F1 从 0.80 到 0.88、无依据断言减少 60%，在 82 篇标注访谈上 3B 追平 20B 参考模型。
objective_summary: 提出面向本地 SLM 的自我披露分析四模块架构 CARE-SD，在 82 篇五部门标注网络安全访谈上与常规分类器、提示策略、更大模型及消融对比，由两名独立评审核验标签与解释质量。
evidence_note: FLLM2026（IEEE）录用；82 篇独立标注访谈、多基线与消融、双评审员核验；样本量中等，宏 F1 与断言减少数字具体。
novelty_note: 针对敏感访谈场景把自适应处理、层次推理、解释一致性验证与跨批协调组合成可验证架构，属已有技术在隐私约束场景下的系统化组合。
scope: 结论适用于英文网络安全访谈文本与 1B–3B 本地 SLM；自披露类别体系为该项目定义；跨语言与跨领域泛化未验证。
limitations: 82 篇访谈规模有限，类别分布可能不均衡；标注与解释核验依赖人工评审；更长访谈的处理成本未报告。

title: ExecWeave: Cross-Layer Execution Provenance for Observable Agentic Software
abstract: Agentic software invokes tools, launches processes, accesses files, and communicates with local or remote services. Application traces describe logical operations, whereas operating-system telemetry records machine activity without necessarily identifying the responsible agent action. Relating these evidence planes is a reconstruction problem: a plausible but unsupported association can assign an effect to the wrong principal. We present ExecWeave, a local-first system that materializes provider semantics and independently observed runtime events into a typed execution graph. The implementation retains separate source artifacts, distinguishes logical occurrences from repeated evidence, and records attribution, inference, and causal-status metadata. An optional command-to-process correlator emits a non-causal inferred bridge only when its bounded search yields one compatible observed process; uniqueness within this observed candidate set is not a guarantee of causal correctness. OS-observed file and network effects acquire a semantic tool or agent principal only through an observed process plus a justified command-to-process association; session-correlated file-system events do not by themselves provide that principal. Source code is available at https://github.com/Irish-kw/ExecWeave.

title_cn: ExecWeave：面向可观测智能体软件的跨层执行溯源
abstract_cn: 智能体软件调用工具、启动进程、访问文件并与本地或远程服务通信。应用级迹描述逻辑操作，而操作系统遥测记录机器活动却不必然标识负责的智能体动作。关联这两个证据平面是一个重建问题：一个看似合理但缺乏支撑的关联可能把某个效果归给错误的主体。我们提出 ExecWeave，一个本地优先系统，把提供方语义与独立观测到的运行时事件物化为类型化执行图。实现保留独立的源工件，区分逻辑发生与重复证据，并记录归因、推断与因果状态元数据。可选的命令-进程关联器仅在其有界搜索得到唯一兼容的已观测进程时才发出非因果的推断桥接；已观测候选集内的唯一性并不是因果正确性的保证。OS 观测到的文件与网络效果只有通过已观测进程加上有依据的命令-进程关联才获得语义化的工具或智能体主体；会话关联的文件系统事件本身不提供该主体。源代码见 https://github.com/Irish-kw/ExecWeave。
summary_cn: ExecWeave 把提供方语义与 OS 运行时事件织成带因果状态元数据的类型化执行图，仅在唯一兼容进程出现时才建立命令-进程桥接，谨慎标注归因推断。
objective_summary: 构建本地优先的执行溯源系统 ExecWeave，将应用层提供方语义与 OS 遥测合并为类型化执行图，以保守的命令-进程关联与归因元数据区分逻辑动作与机器效果。
evidence_note: 系统设计论文，强调保守归因与因果状态标注的原则；摘要未报告量化评估结果，验证以设计合理性论证为主。
novelty_note: 把智能体执行溯源形式化为跨层证据关联问题并显式建模归因不确定性，属已有溯源技术面向智能体软件的系统化组合。
scope: 适用于可获取提供方语义与 OS 遥测的本地智能体软件；关联质量受限于可观测性与有界搜索设定。
limitations: 命令-进程桥接本质是非因果推断，错误归因风险未完全消除；摘要未给出定量精度或开销评估；对远程多机部署的适用性未讨论。

title: Stronger Judges Do Not See More: Deployment-Integrity Blindness in LLM Evaluation
abstract: LLM-agent evaluation reports behavioral scores but leaves the identity of the deployed runtime stack unreported. A tampered deployment that preserves evaluated outputs passes every output-only evaluator. We introduce DIB-Bench, a benchmark that measures this deployment-integrity blindness across 7,560 scored examples, six tamper types, and an evaluator ladder from regex scorers through LLM judges to GPT-5-nano. Stronger evaluators accept more tampered outputs: mean acceptance rises from 88.6% (rule-based) to 94.1% (GPT-5-nano), and a trigger-conditional tamper invisible on the evaluation suite produces 48-100% harmful outputs, rising with model capability. A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples. Behavioral fingerprinting identifies the model component above chance (76.7%) but covers one of six stack components. We also propose a graded deployment-identity descriptor for evaluation reports.
title_cn: 更强的评审看不见更多：LLM 评估中的部署完整性盲区
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体评估报告行为分数，却不报告部署运行时栈的身份。保持被评估输出不变的篡改部署能通过所有只看输出的评估者。我们提出 DIB-Bench，一个度量这种部署完整性盲区的基准，覆盖 7,560 个评分样例、六种篡改类型，以及从正则评分器、LLM 评审到 GPT-5-nano 的评估者阶梯。更强的评估者接受更多被篡改输出：平均接受率从 88.6%（基于规则）升至 94.1%（GPT-5-nano），而在评估套件上不可见的触发条件式篡改产生 48%–100% 的有害输出，随模型能力上升。一个 PAC 式界表明，零输出偏移的篡改在任何样本量下都无法从输出中检出；而清单哈希身份信道以零样本检出它们。行为指纹识别以 76.7% 的准确率识别模型组件（高于随机），但只覆盖六个栈组件之一。我们还提出一种用于评估报告的分级部署身份描述符。
summary_cn: DIB-Bench 显示评估者越强越接受被篡改部署（接受率 88.6%→94.1%）：零输出偏移篡改理论上无法从输出检出，需清单哈希等身份信道，行为指纹仅覆盖 1/6 栈组件。
objective_summary: 构建度量 LLM 评估部署完整性盲区的 DIB-Bench，在 7,560 个样例与六种篡改类型上比较评估者阶梯的接受率，证明零输出偏移篡改的不可检出性并评估身份信道与行为指纹的补救能力。
evidence_note: 7,560 个评分样例、六种篡改类型、多级评估者对照，配 PAC 式不可检出界与零样本身份信道方案；自建基准，无外部部署数据与统计检验。
novelty_note: 开辟「部署完整性盲区」这一评估方法学新问题，给出不可检出性的理论刻画与分级身份描述符建议，问题形式化与结论均有新意。
scope: 结论限于 LLM 智能体评估场景与所定义的六种篡改类型；评估者阶梯至 GPT-5-nano；不涵盖人类评估者与完整供应链攻击谱系。
limitations: 篡改类型由作者构造，真实供应链攻击的覆盖度未知；行为指纹只识别一个栈组件且准确率 76.7%；身份描述符的实际采纳路径未验证。

title: Reaction Attack on CKKS Deployments with Asymptotically Optimal Query Complexity
abstract: We study a protocol-level reaction leakage in CKKS deployments where public coefficient-to-slot (C2S) evaluation keys are combined with a client's 1-bit validity response. Under this deployment surface, a malicious evaluator can recover a ternary secret key using asymptotically optimal $O(H)$ reaction queries, where $H$ is the entropy of the secret key. The attack does not break RLWE or CKKS IND-CPA security. Instead, it exploits the interaction between client-side validity reactions and public homomorphic linear transformations. A shift of a public encryption key yields a ciphertext whose plaintext is a function of the secret key; the public ${\sf C2S}$ layer then repacks this information to construct a ciphertext whose validity depends strictly on whether a targeted secret coefficient matches a guessed value. Furthermore, each submitted query is independently randomized with a fresh encryption of zero, so that each resulting malicious ciphertext appears entirely distinct, thereby allowing the attack to simply evade trivial detection mechanisms on the client side. We implemented the full end-to-end attack in Lattigo v6.2.0 and recovered the full secret key across four parameter sets drawn from standard CKKS presets. For uniform ternary secrets, the attack uses $O(N)$ queries and is within a factor $2/\log_2 3 < 2$ of the oracle-only entropy lower bound. For sparse ternary secrets, a tailored variant further reduces the number of queries in practice. Our results show that observable validity reactions form a practical key-recovery channel in CKKS deployments exposing this surface, even when the underlying cryptographic assumptions remain intact.
comment: Accepted to the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
title_cn: 对 CKKS 部署的反应攻击：渐近最优查询复杂度
abstract_cn: 我们研究 CKKS 部署中的一种协议级反应泄漏：公开的系数到槽（C2S）评估密钥与客户端的 1 位有效性响应相结合。在该部署表面上，恶意评估者可以用渐近最优的 O(H) 次反应查询恢复三元秘密密钥，其中 H 是秘密密钥的熵。该攻击不破坏 RLWE 或 CKKS 的 IND-CPA 安全，而是利用客户端有效性反应与公开同态线性变换之间的交互。对公钥做移位可得明文为秘密密钥之函数的密文；公开的 C2S 层随后重打包该信息，构造出有效性严格取决于目标秘密系数是否匹配猜测值的密文。此外，每个提交的查询都用新的零加密独立随机化，使每个恶意密文看起来完全不同，从而让攻击得以轻易规避客户端侧的平凡检测机制。我们在 Lattigo v6.2.0 中实现完整端到端攻击，并从取自标准 CKKS 预设的四组参数中恢复完整秘密密钥。对均匀三元秘密，攻击使用 O(N) 次查询，与仅预言机熵下界的差距在 2/log₂3 < 2 因子以内；对稀疏三元秘密，定制变体进一步在实践中减少查询数。结果表明，在暴露此表面的 CKKS 部署中，可观测的有效性反应构成一条实用的密钥恢复信道，即使底层密码假设依然完好。
summary_cn: 利用公开 C2S 密钥与客户端 1 位有效性响应的反应攻击：O(H) 次查询恢复三元密钥，在 Lattigo v6.2.0 四组标准参数下全部完整恢复，逼近熵下界（S&P 2027）。
objective_summary: 提出针对暴露公开 C2S 评估密钥与有效性响应的 CKKS 部署的反应攻击，证明其查询复杂度渐近最优，并在 Lattigo v6.2.0 的四组标准参数上端到端实现完整密钥恢复。
evidence_note: IEEE S&P 2027 录用；Lattigo 完整实现、四组标准参数全密钥恢复、与熵下界的因子差距分析；攻击条件与随机化规避机制说明清楚。
novelty_note: 揭示「有效性反应+公开 C2S 密钥」这一此前未被当作攻击面的协议级泄漏信道，攻击复杂度渐近最优，属新威胁模型层面的贡献。
scope: 适用于暴露公开 C2S 评估密钥并返回客户端有效性响应的 CKKS 部署；秘密密钥为三元（均匀或稀疏）；不破坏 RLWE/CKKS 的 IND-CPA 安全。
limitations: 需要恶意评估者能提交大量查询并观察客户端响应位；依赖每个查询的独立随机化来规避检测；对已修改的部署实践（如限制响应或查询频率）的效果未评估。

title: Approve What, Exactly? Effect Binding and Trusted Rendering for Agent Step-Up Authorization
abstract: AI agents now pause for approval before they send money, delete files or email outsiders, and that approval is usually treated as a second factor. We argue it is one only when compromising the agent cannot produce it and when it names exactly what it approves, and we test both conditions. We define twelve attacks on the approval path, including decoy recipients, amount cancellation, card padding, label spoofing, enrollment squatting and threshold splitting, and run them against the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), the Microsoft action-bound approval design and Model Context Protocol (MCP) elicitation. An audit of ten agent runtimes finds no third-party verifiable approval record, no flood limits where measurable, and post-approval argument changes in four of eight runtimes with measurable binding. As a reference defense we build ASU (Agent Step-Up), a gateway that renders the approval card from a canonical effect descriptor, has a passkey on the phone of the user sign its digest, and executes only the stored call. Tamarin proves its binding, single-use and key-level non-repudiation properties under three stated hypotheses (53 lemmas). Across 27,108 scripted trials and 609 AgentDojo attack pairs, ASU stops substitution, replay and grant stretching, and the trusted card cuts forged-narration attack success from 0.54 to 0.03. With 15 current language models as automated approvers, the trusted card raises the attack catch rate from 0.30 to 0.98, at the cost of refusing 16 percent of harmless near misses, mostly due to a placeholder artifact in our stimuli. A second device adds nothing measurable over a trusted on-host confirmation in these experiments, flooding still succeeds 0.45 to 0.60 of the time against a modeled approver, and approval cannot stop effects that policy already allows. Code, data and proofs: https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/agent-step-up
comment: 36 pages, 13 figures, 13 tables. Code and data at this https URL
title_cn: 批准的究竟是什么？智能体逐步升级授权的效果绑定与可信渲染
abstract_cn: AI 智能体如今在发送资金、删除文件或向外部发邮件前会暂停等待批准，而这种批准通常被视为第二因子。我们论证：只有当攻陷智能体无法伪造批准、且批准明确指名其同意的内容时，它才是第二因子，并对这两个条件进行检验。我们定义针对批准路径的十二种攻击，包括诱饵收款人、金额抵消、卡号填充、标签欺骗、注册抢注与阈值拆分，并对 Agent Payments Protocol（AP2）、微软的动作绑定批准设计与 Model Context Protocol（MCP）elicitation 运行这些攻击。对十个智能体运行时的审计发现：没有可由第三方验证的批准记录，可测量之处没有洪水限制，八个可测量绑定效果的运行时中有四个存在批准后参数变更。作为参考防御，我们构建 ASU（Agent Step-Up）网关：它从规范效果描述符渲染批准卡片，让用户手机上的 passkey 签署其摘要，并只执行已存储的调用。Tamarin 在三条陈述假设下（53 条引理）证明其绑定、单次使用与密钥级不可抵赖性质。在 27,108 次脚本化试验与 609 个 AgentDojo 攻击对上，ASU 阻止替换、重放与授权拉伸，可信卡片把伪造叙述攻击的成功率从 0.54 降到 0.03。以 15 个现役语言模型作为自动审批者时，可信卡片把攻击捕获率从 0.30 提到 0.98，代价是对 16% 的无害近似情形拒绝，其中大多源于刺激物中的占位符伪影。在这些实验中，第二台设备相比可信的主机端确认没有可测增益；面对建模的审批者，洪水攻击仍有 0.45 到 0.60 的成功率；且批准无法阻止策略已允许的影响。代码、数据与证明见 https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/agent-step-up。
summary_cn: 定义 12 种审批路径攻击、审计 10 个运行时，提出 passkey 签署效果描述符的 ASU 网关：Tamarin 53 条引理，2.7 万次试验中伪造叙述成功率 0.54→0.03、捕获率 0.30→0.98。
objective_summary: 定义并运行十二种针对智能体审批路径的攻击，审计十个运行时的批准记录与参数绑定，构建以规范效果描述符、passkey 签名与只执行存储调用为核心的 ASU 参考防御，并用 Tamarin 与大规模脚本试验验证。
evidence_note: 27,108 次脚本化试验、609 个 AgentDojo 攻击对、15 个 LLM 自动审批者、十个运行时审计加 Tamarin 形式化证明（53 条引理）；规模与验证手段充分。
novelty_note: 把「批准是否指名其效果、能否被攻陷的智能体伪造」形式化为可检验条件，给出效果绑定+可信渲染的新防御机制与配套攻击分类，属实质性新机制。
scope: 结论覆盖 AP2、微软动作绑定设计与 MCP elicitation 及所测十个运行时；自动审批者为 15 个 LLM；对人类审批者的真实行为只做建模近似。
limitations: 对无害近似情形的误拒率达 16%（部分源于刺激物占位符伪影，作者自陈）；建模审批者下洪水攻击仍有 0.45–0.60 成功率；批准机制无法约束策略已允许的影响。

title: NOMAI: Scalable Federated Learning with Private Weights
abstract: The twin goals of privacy-preserving federated learning (FL) -- harnessing distributed data while protecting the parties who contribute it -- demands three properties: model privacy, data privacy, and integrity. Achieving all three in a realistic deployment -- with a single coordinator and millions of users -- remains an open challenge that prior work has yet to fully resolve. We present NOMAI, the first scalable MPC-based FL system to provide all three guarantees simultaneously. NOMAI operates under an honest-majority assumption in the semi-honest model, with an extension to the malicious-with-abort setting. At its core, NOMAI combines a multi-committee MPC architecture with packed Shamir secret sharing, enabling SIMD-style secure computation that scales far beyond what monolithic n-party protocols can support. We further introduce ML-aware optimizations and new cryptographic primitives that substantially reduce per-user overhead. Our evaluation shows NOMAI is practically deployable at unprecedented scale: it reduces per-user computation to just <350 ms (semi-honest) and <700 ms (malicious) for per iteration of training MNIST, achieving three orders-of-magnitude improvements over prior work while seamlessly supporting populations of over 106 users. This demonstrates, for the first time, that MPC-based FL can meet the scale demands of real-world systems without compromising on privacy or integrity.
title_cn: NOMAI：私有权重的可扩展联邦学习
abstract_cn: 隐私保护联邦学习（FL）的双重目标——利用分布式数据同时保护贡献方——需要三种性质：模型隐私、数据隐私与完整性。在真实部署（单协调者、数百万用户）中同时达成三者仍是先前工作未能完全解决的开放挑战。我们提出 NOMAI，首个同时提供全部三种保证的可扩展 MPC 联邦学习系统。NOMAI 在半诚实模型下以诚实多数假设运行，并扩展到恶意-中止设置。其核心是将多委员会 MPC 架构与打包 Shamir 秘密共享结合，实现远超单体 n 方协议所能支撑的 SIMD 式安全计算。我们进一步引入 ML 感知的优化与新的密码学原语，大幅降低每用户开销。评估显示 NOMAI 可以前所未有的规模实际部署：训练 MNIST 每次迭代的每用户计算降至半诚实 350 毫秒以内、恶意 700 毫秒以内，较先前工作有三个数量级的改进，同时无缝支持超过 10^6 用户的规模。这首次证明基于 MPC 的联邦学习可以在不牺牲隐私或完整性的情况下满足真实系统的规模需求。
summary_cn: 首个同时提供模型隐私、数据隐私与完整性的可扩展 MPC 联邦学习系统：多委员会 MPC+打包 Shamir 使 MNIST 每迭代每用户开销降至 350/700 毫秒内，支持超百万用户。
objective_summary: 设计多委员会 MPC 架构与打包 Shamir 秘密共享结合的联邦学习系统 NOMAI，在半诚实与恶意-中止模型下实现模型隐私、数据隐私与完整性，并在 MNIST 上测量每用户迭代开销与可扩展性。
evidence_note: MNIST 训练任务上报告每用户毫秒级开销、与先前工作的数量级对比及百万用户规模推算；评估任务单一，无广域网真实部署与统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个在单协调者、百万用户设定下同时达成模型隐私、数据隐私与完整性的 MPC-FL 系统，配套新原语与 ML 感知优化，属方向上的首个端到端系统。
scope: 结论基于诚实多数假设与半诚实模型（含恶意-中止扩展）；训练任务为 MNIST；通信与延迟在受控设置下测量。
limitations: 诚实多数假设在部分现实部署中不满足；评估限于 MNIST 规模任务，更大模型的通信瓶颈未报告；单协调者架构的可用性风险未讨论。

title: SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy
abstract: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit. To capture this information, we introduce Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy (SHIP), which automatically maps queries to attributes, builds a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and releases a DP synthetic table for further analysis. We also develop an evaluation protocol based primarily on QA performance and structured fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate SHIP's strong performance on both measures relative to existing private insight baselines, while identifying queries that remain challenging for structured representations.
comment: This paper mainly work on extracting and evaluating insights from textual data
title_cn: SHIP：结构化、层次化的隐私保护洞察
abstract_cn: 在保护用户隐私的同时从文本数据中提取洞察日益重要。现有方法为不同分析目的产出形式各异的隐私洞察，使其效用难以评估与比较。本工作将差分隐私（DP）洞察形式化为可用于回答分析查询的可复用表示，为效用评估提供共同基础。然而回答这些查询需要现有表示可能遗漏的细粒度细节与跨属性统计。为捕捉这些信息，我们提出 SHIP（Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy），它自动将查询映射到属性、构建层次化混合分类法并发布可供进一步分析的 DP 合成表。我们还开发了主要基于问答性能与结构保真度的评估协议。实验表明 SHIP 在两项指标上均优于既有隐私洞察基线，同时识别出对结构化表示仍然困难的查询。
summary_cn: SHIP 将 DP 洞察形式化为可复用表示：自动映射查询属性、构建层次分类法并发布 DP 合成表，在 QA 与结构保真两指标上超越既有基线。
objective_summary: 提出把差分隐私洞察表示为可回答分析查询的可复用对象的框架 SHIP，包含查询-属性映射、层次混合分类法与 DP 合成表发布，并给出基于问答性能与结构保真的评估协议。
evidence_note: 与既有隐私洞察基线的对比实验，采用 QA 性能与结构保真两类指标；数据集与规模在摘要未说明，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「隐私洞察」统一为可复用表示并给出比较协议，属问题形式化层面的贡献；组件（分类法构建、DP 合成表）为已有技术。
scope: 适用于文本数据的分析型洞察发布与查询回答；对查询类型与数据域的覆盖以实验为准；部分查询对结构化表示仍困难（作者自陈）。
limitations: 部分查询仍超出结构化表示能力；评估以 QA 代理任务为主；数据集与隐私参数配置在摘要中未披露。

title: Can Autonomous Vehicles Keep Their Cool? A Survey of Thermal Side-Channel and Perception Attacks
abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) couple safety-critical perception to thermally constrained compute. Interfaces built for night perception and package thermal reliability were never engineered as confidentiality boundaries, and closing one such path leaves the other intact. Physical adversaries can spoof thermal infrared (IR) sensors used for night driving, while unprivileged software co-tenants can fingerprint perception workloads from thermal, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), and thermal event interrupt (TEI) telemetry required for package safety. These paths differ in mechanism and privilege; both exploit interfaces that AV stacks cannot disable without compromising Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF). Classical microarchitectural and cyber-physical systems (CPS) surveys address cache timing, adversarial machine learning, and camera or LiDAR spoofing; no prior survey jointly frames physical thermal IR attacks and unprivileged silicon thermal telemetry as one residual-risk class. This survey systematizes thirteen representative works into thermal perception integrity, telemetry leakage, and model-information extraction, comparing them by privilege, timescale, co-tenancy, deployability, and AV relevance. We distinguish attack family from adversary class and map defenses to residual risk while thermal management remains operational. A commodity proxy supports the software co-tenant branch only; physical IR evidence comes from cited literature. We identify open problems in on-target automotive evaluation, fusion trust under IR spoofing, chiplet thermal coupling, capability-based telemetry, and standards-ready threat analysis, aiming to motivate co-design across sensors, operating systems, silicon, and automotive standards.
title_cn: 自动驾驶汽车能保持冷静吗？热侧信道与感知攻击综述
abstract_cn: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）将安全关键感知与受热约束的计算耦合在一起。为夜间感知与封装热可靠性而构建的接口从未被设计为机密性边界，而封堵其中一条路径后另一条依然存在。物理对手可以欺骗用于夜间驾驶的热红外（IR）传感器，而非特权软件共租租户可以从封装安全所需的热、动态电压频率调节（DVFS）与热事件中断（TEI）遥测中指纹识别感知工作负载。这些路径机制与权限不同，但都利用了 AV 技术栈在不停用预期功能安全（SOTIF）的前提下无法关闭的接口。经典微架构与信息物理系统（CPS）综述涵盖缓存时序、对抗机器学习与摄像头或激光雷达欺骗；此前没有综述把物理热红外攻击与非特权硅片热遥测共同框定为一类残余风险。本综述把十三项代表性工作系统化为热感知完整性、遥测泄露与模型信息提取三类，按权限、时间尺度、共租、可部署性与 AV 相关性比较，并区分攻击家族与对手类别，在热管理保持运行的约束下把防御映射到残余风险。商品级代理仅支持软件共租分支；物理红外证据来自引用文献。我们指出车载实机评估、红外欺骗下的融合信任、芯粒热耦合、基于能力的遥测与标准化威胁分析中的开放问题，以期推动传感器、操作系统、硅片与汽车标准的协同设计。
summary_cn: 首个把物理热红外欺骗与非特权热遥测泄露共同框定为 AV 残余风险类的综述：系统化 13 项代表性工作，按权限与时间尺度比较并映射防御与开放问题。
objective_summary: 系统梳理十三项热侧信道与热感知攻击的代表性工作，按权限、时间尺度、共租与可部署性分类比较，并将防御映射到热管理运行约束下的残余风险。
evidence_note: 综述方法系统（13 项工作、多维比较维度），但实证支撑有限：商品代理仅覆盖软件共租分支，物理红外证据取自引用文献。
novelty_note: 首次把物理热红外感知攻击与硅片热遥测泄露统一为一个残余风险类别并给出分类框架，属新视角的系统化。
scope: 面向自动驾驶平台的热红外感知接口与热遥测接口；结论依赖所综述的十三项工作；不提供新的实验数据。
limitations: 缺乏车载实机评估（作者列为开放问题）；物理红外分支的实证证据来自二手文献；防御映射停留在风险框架层面而非具体方案。

title: Efficient Agnostic Learning of Univariate Densities Under Local Differential Privacy
abstract: We propose a general framework for non-interactive locally differentially private (LDP) learning of structured univariate distributions that can be approximated by piece-wise polynomials. This gives the first sample-efficient LDP learners for several distribution classes, including mixtures of log-concave distributions, such as Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). These learners also provide agnostic guarantees and are computationally efficient. We also prove a lower bound for learning GMMs under LDP, improving on the standard pure-DP packing lower bounds of Bun et al. [BKSW19]. To obtain our general learning framework, we develop an efficient non-interactive LDP algorithm for synthetic data generation over large domains, which may be of independent interest. We then use it together with a deterministic adaptation of the non-private piecewise polynomial learner of Acharya et al. [ADLS17].
title_cn: 局部差分隐私下单变量密度的高效不可知学习
abstract_cn: 我们为可由分段多项式逼近的结构化单变量分布的非交互局部差分隐私（LDP）学习提出一个通用框架。这给出若干分布类的首个样本高效的 LDP 学习器，包括高斯混合模型（GMM）等对数凹混合。这些学习器同时具备不可知（agnostic）保证且计算高效。我们还证明 LDP 下学习 GMM 的下界，改进 Bun 等人 [BKSW19] 的标准纯 DP 装箱下界。为构建通用学习框架，我们开发了一个面向大域上合成数据生成的高效非交互 LDP 算法，其本身可能具有独立价值。随后将其与 Acharya 等人 [ADLS17] 非隐私分段多项式学习器的确定性改造结合使用。
summary_cn: 提出分段多项式可逼近单变量分布的非交互 LDP 学习通用框架，给出对数凹混合（含 GMM）首个样本高效学习器，并证明改进 BKSW19 的 GMM 下界。
objective_summary: 构建非交互 LDP 下学习分段多项式可逼近单变量分布的通用框架，给出含 GMM 在内的多个分布类首个样本高效不可知学习器，并证明相应的 LDP 下界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：通用框架+算法+下界的证明完整，改进已知下界并给出首个样本高效学习器；无实验但论证了计算效率。
novelty_note: 给出多个分布类的首个样本高效 LDP 学习器并改进已知下界，属实质性理论推进；大域合成数据生成的 LDP 算法亦有独立价值。
scope: 限于单变量、可分段多项式逼近的分布类与非交互 LDP 模型；下界针对 GMM；交互式协议的更优可能未被排除。
limitations: 仅覆盖单变量分布；算法的常数因子与实际部署开销未做实验评估；下界只在所述参数范围内成立。

title: Blind Watermarking of Software Repositories via Module Placement
abstract: Source-code watermarking supports provenance tracking by embedding a recoverable identifier in a software artifact. Many existing approaches encode this identifier in tokens or program syntax, exposing the watermark to transformations that modify the source text. We present PlaceMark, a blind watermarking system that encodes a payload in the placement of modules within a repository. Each eligible module is identified by its filename and top-level definition names. A secret key determines its ordered candidate destinations and its position in the reading order; the module's location within its candidate list determines the encoded symbol. Embedding relocates selected modules and updates their import references. Extraction uses the distributed repository, the key, and agreed decoding parameters, without an original copy or placement ledger. Capacity measurements on ten Python repositories yield nominal capacities of 249 to 2,166 bits in nine repositories, while one provides no placement channel. In 216 trials of the evaluated text transformations, the payload is recovered exactly. Relocation degrades recovery gradually on Django, Airflow and Salt, while on Pylint a path-based exclusion in our implementation lets relocation change carrier membership, and we measure it for an untargeted adversary and for one that concentrates its budget on the public carrier set. Changes to filenames or definition names alter the identity input and are measured separately. Exact recovery also depends on placement feasibility. The results characterize module placement as a carrier that can complement watermarks embedded in source text.
title_cn: 基于模块布局的软件仓库盲水印
abstract_cn: 源代码水印通过在软件工件中嵌入可恢复标识符支持溯源追踪。许多现有方法把标识符编码在词法单元或程序语法中，使水印暴露于修改源文本的变换之下。我们提出 PlaceMark，一个把载荷编码进仓库中模块布局的盲水印系统。每个合格模块由其文件名与顶层定义名标识；密钥决定其有序候选目的地及其在阅读顺序中的位置，模块在候选列表中的位置决定所编码符号。嵌入会迁移选定模块并更新其导入引用。提取只需分布式仓库、密钥与约定的解码参数，无需原始副本或布局账本。在十个 Python 仓库上的容量测量显示九个仓库的标称容量为 249 到 2,166 位，一个仓库不提供布局信道。在 216 次被评估文本变换试验中载荷均被精确恢复。迁移在 Django、Airflow 与 Salt 上使恢复逐渐退化，而在 Pylint 上实现中的基于路径的排除使迁移能改变载体成员资格；我们分别针对无目标对手与把预算集中于公共载体集的对手测量了这一点。对文件名或定义名的改动会改变身份输入，被单独测量。精确恢复还取决于布局可行性。结果刻画了模块布局作为可补充源文本水印的载体。
summary_cn: PlaceMark 把水印载荷编码进仓库模块布局：十个 Python 仓库中九个容量 249–2,166 位，216 次文本变换后全部精确恢复，与源文本水印互补。
objective_summary: 设计以模块在仓库中的位置为载体的盲水印方案 PlaceMark，给出嵌入/提取算法并在十个 Python 仓库上测量容量、文本变换鲁棒性与迁移退化，针对两类对手测量恢复率。
evidence_note: 十个真实 Python 仓库上的容量与鲁棒性测量，216 次文本变换试验与两类对手建模，实验设置具体；限于 Python 仓库与布局载体，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把水印载体从源文本迁移到仓库模块布局，抗文本变换且可盲提取，属载体层面的新组合；无需原始副本的盲提取是实用亮点。
scope: 结论适用于 Python 仓库与保持文件名、顶层定义名不变的威胁模型；载体成员资格在特定仓库（如 Pylint）会因路径排除而改变。
limitations: 文件名或顶层定义名被改写即破坏身份输入；部分仓库容量为零或恢复随迁移逐渐退化；嵌入需物理迁移模块并更新导入，可能影响构建与审查流程。

title: Practical wavelength selection for quantum-augmented networks over shared optical fiber
abstract: In a quantum augmented network, sharing optical fiber with classical traffic requires quantum wavelength selection to balance logical fidelity, block acceptance, and classical data reception. Here we develop a wavelength-selection framework for an error-corrected three-stage quantum communication protocol. Under a thermal-background model with independent errors, an ideal one-photon receiver, and ideal recovery, we derive an accepted qubit channel and a key-independent lower bound on logical entanglement fidelity. Combining this bound with block acceptance gives an entanglement-fidelity yield bound, which we maximize over evaluated wavelengths subject to fidelity and classical link-budget requirements. For the Steane [[7,1,3]] code at 5 km per traversal and -10 dBm per classical channel, the largest fidelity certificate occurs near 1537 nm, whereas the largest yield bound occurs near 1551 nm. Along the 1.25 Gb/s classical link budget with 0.2% base error, the optimized yield bound falls below 10^-6 near 10 km per traversal, while fidelity remains certified at 0.99 or higher at longer spans. These results distinguish fidelity and yield constraints and identify certified operating regions for quantum-augmented networks sharing optical fiber.
title_cn: 共享光纤上量子增强网络的实用波长选择
abstract_cn: 在量子增强网络中，量子与经典流量共享光纤，需要选择量子波长以平衡逻辑保真度、块接受率与经典数据接收。我们为一个纠错三阶段量子通信协议开发波长选择框架。在热背景噪声、独立错误、理想单光子接收器与理想恢复的模型下，我们推导被接受量子比特信道与逻辑纠缠保真度的与密钥无关下界。将该下界与块接受率结合得到纠缠保真度产额界，并在保真度与经典链路预算约束下对候选波长最大化该界。对每程 5 km、每经典信道 -10 dBm 的 Steane [[7,1,3]] 码，最大保真度证书出现在 1537 nm 附近，而最大产额界出现在 1551 nm 附近。沿 1.25 Gb/s 经典链路预算与 0.2% 基础错误率，优化后的产额界在每程约 10 km 处降到 10^-6 以下，而保真度在更长跨度上仍保持 0.99 以上。这些结果区分了保真度与产额约束，并为共享光纤的量子增强网络确定了经认证的工作区域。
summary_cn: 推导共享光纤上纠错三阶段量子协议的保真度与产额界并优化波长：Steane 码每程 5 km 下最优保真度在 1537 nm、最优产额在 1551 nm，产额界在每程约 10 km 降至 10^-6 以下。
objective_summary: 在热噪声与理想接收假设下推导纠错三阶段量子通信协议的被接受量子比特信道与纠缠保真度下界，结合块接受率构造产额界并对候选波长做约束优化，给出 Steane 码数值实例。
evidence_note: 理论推导加数值实例：模型假设明确（热背景、独立错误、理想单光子接收与理想恢复），给出具体波长与距离数值；无实验验证。
novelty_note: 为量子-经典共纤场景提出区分保真度证书与产额约束的波长选择框架，属已有量子通信组件在新场景下的系统化分析。
scope: 结论在热背景噪声、独立错误、理想单光子接收与理想恢复模型下成立；数值实例限于 Steane [[7,1,3]] 码与给定链路预算。
limitations: 理想化假设（理想接收器与恢复）与实际器件的差距未量化；结果为数值实例而非实验；三阶段协议设定特定，直接推广受限。

title: PAGE404: Breaking GPU Isolation Through Hardware-assisted Page Migration
abstract: NVIDIA's Grace Hopper (GH200) superchip represents a new generation of heterogeneous computing, tightly integrating a 72-core Arm-based CPU with a Hopper GPU on a single module via a high-bandwidth, cache-coherent interconnect. By eliminating the conventional PCIe bottleneck for CPU-GPU data movement, this design establishes a unified memory domain that scales to the capacities demanded by generative AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. The architecture also introduces hardware-assisted page migration: driven by access counters, the system dynamically promotes frequently accessed pages from host CPU memory to GPU DRAM to improve memory locality. We study the security of this emerging architecture against new side- and covert-channel attacks targeting its page migration support. We analyze counter-driven migration across both the hardware mechanisms and the UVM driver's interrupt-handling pipeline, and identify two side-channel vulnerabilities: one rooted in the shared structure of access counters, and the other in the driver's response to migration interrupts.
