title_cn: 先诊断再改进：面向查询高效越狱攻击的多维评审反馈
abstract_cn: 自动化越狱攻击依赖评估反馈来优化对抗提示，但现有方法往往缺乏细粒度诊断信息。我们提出 Jev-Guided Strategy Bandit（JSB），一个基于查询的越狱框架，利用多维概率反馈引导提示优化。JSB 将连续越狱评分与针对性改进、策略切换及最优状态重播种相结合，以平衡探索与精炼。我们在两个有害请求数据集、5 个开源与 3 个闭源 LLM 上评估 JSB。在仅 10 次目标模型查询的预算下，JSB 在 10 个开源设置上取得平均 89.8% 的 HarmBench 攻击成功率，持续优于现有自动化越狱攻击。进一步分析证明其在不同查询预算与攻击者模型下的有效性。防御实验还揭示了现有过滤机制的局限，并凸显基于 Jev 的输出过滤的潜力。
summary_cn: 查询高效越狱框架 JSB：多维概率反馈加策略切换与重播种，10 次查询预算下 10 个开源设置平均 HarmBench ASR 89.8%，优于现有自动化攻击，并揭示现有过滤防御局限。
objective_summary: 构建以多维连续评审反馈驱动策略 bandit 的查询型越狱框架，在两个有害数据集、8 个模型上比较不同查询预算与攻击者模型下的成功率，并测试对现有防御的穿透。
evidence_note: 两个数据集、5 开源加 3 闭源模型、多预算与攻击者模型设置的系统评估，报告 89.8% 平均 ASR；Under Review，无统计检验，评审反馈依赖 LLM 评分质量。
novelty_note: 在查询型越狱这一活跃方向上引入多维诊断反馈与策略切换、重播种机制，属对现有 bandit 类攻击的实质性改进而非新威胁面。
scope: 结论适用于黑盒查询设定下对所测 LLM 的越狱评估；攻击有效性依赖 Jev 评审模型，对部署强输出过滤或查询异常检测的系统未充分验证。
limitations: 评审模型偏差可能同时影响优化方向与 ASR 度量；10 次查询下的结果对外部评审质量敏感；防御实验限于现有过滤机制。

title: Quiet Triggers, Loud Footprints: A Tri-Space Measurement Study of Backdoor Stealthiness
abstract: Backdoor attacks on deep neural networks are commonly evaluated by attack success rate and benign accuracy, yet their stealthiness remains inconsistently defined and measured. Existing work often studies only one observable aspect of stealthiness, such as trigger imperceptibility, feature-space separability, parameter-space concentration, or evasion of particular defenses. This creates a fragmented picture: an attack may appear stealthy under one metric while leaving conspicuous footprints elsewhere. This paper presents a tri-space measurement study of backdoor stealthiness in image classification. We distinguish latent stealthiness---the ideal but unobservable difficulty of distinguishing a backdoored system from a benign one---from measurable footprints in three spaces: input, feature, and parameter space. Under this framework, we evaluate representative backdoor attacks across four datasets and three model architectures using a broad suite of footprint metrics. Our results show that stealthiness is not monolithic: attacks that are quiet in one space are often loud in another, and existing attacks rarely achieve consistently small footprints across all three spaces. We further analyze agreement and disagreement among stealthiness metrics and study how footprint measurements interact with attack success rate. Based on observed blind spots in existing measurements, we introduce two diagnostic metrics: Class-Specific Davies--Bouldin Index (CDBI), which captures class-conditional feature overlap, and TAC--UCLC Product (TUP), which identifies channels that are both trigger-responsive and downstream influential. These metrics are intended to augment, not replace, the broader measurement suite. Finally, we provide practical guidance for future stealthiness evaluations.
title_cn: 安静的触发器，响亮的足迹：后门隐蔽性的三空间测量研究
abstract_cn: 深度神经网络的后门攻击通常用攻击成功率与良性准确率评估，但其隐蔽性的定义与测量始终不一致。现有工作往往只研究隐蔽性的一个可观察侧面，如触发器不可感知性、特征空间可分性、参数空间集中度或对特定防御的规避。这造成碎片化图景：一个攻击在某指标下显得隐蔽，却在别处留下显眼足迹。本文对图像分类中的后门隐蔽性做三空间测量研究。我们区分潜在隐蔽性——区分后门系统与良性系统的理想但不可观测的难度——与输入、特征、参数三个空间中可测量的足迹。在该框架下，我们在 4 个数据集与 3 种模型架构上，用广泛的足迹指标套件评估代表性后门攻击。结果表明隐蔽性不是单一的：在一个空间安静的攻击往往在另一个空间响亮，现有攻击很少能在三个空间同时保持小足迹。我们进一步分析隐蔽性指标间的一致与分歧，研究足迹测量与攻击成功率的交互。基于现有测量的盲点，我们提出两个诊断指标：捕获类条件特征重叠的类特定 Davies–Bouldin 指数（CDBI），与识别既响应触发器又具下游影响通道的 TAC–UCLC 乘积（TUP）。这两个指标旨在补充而非取代更广的测量套件。最后，我们为未来的隐蔽性评估提供实践指导。
summary_cn: S&P 2027 三空间后门隐蔽性测量：4 数据集乘 3 架构显示攻击难以在输入、特征、参数空间同时隐蔽；提出 CDBI 与 TUP 两个诊断指标并给出评估实践指导。
objective_summary: 建立把后门隐蔽性分解为输入、特征、参数三空间可测足迹的测量框架，在 4 数据集 3 架构上评估代表性攻击的足迹分布、指标间一致性及与攻击成功率的交互，并提出 CDBI、TUP 两个诊断指标。
evidence_note: S&P 2027 录用；4 数据集乘 3 架构、广泛足迹指标套件的系统测量，含指标间一致性与 ASR 交互的分析；非预注册，无统计检验说明。
novelty_note: 首次把碎片化的后门隐蔽性度量统一进三空间足迹框架并系统揭示「单空间隐蔽、跨空间暴露」现象，配套提出两个可操作的诊断指标。
scope: 结论适用于图像分类任务与所测代表性后门攻击家族；三空间框架对其他模态、联邦或大模型后门的适用性待验证。
limitations: 足迹指标套件仍非穷尽，可能存在三空间之外的隐蔽维度；结论基于图像分类的攻击与架构样本；诊断指标的防御联动价值未验证。

title: Bilinear Compressive Security with Finitely Many Samples
abstract: Bilinear Compressive Security (BCS) is a lightweight encryption scheme that combines compressed sensing with a fresh random convolution filter to improve resistance against key-recovery attacks under key reuse. Previous work derived information-theoretic guarantees for BCS by relating key identifiability to phase retrieval under the assumption that an adversary has access to the full ciphertext distribution induced by the random filter. In practice, however, an adversary only observes finitely many encryptions, leaving the security of BCS in the finite-sample regime largely unexplored. In this paper, we study key recovery from only finitely many observations. We first develop a covariance-based attack that estimates the linear measurements from repeated encryptions of the same plaintext and subsequently recovers the secret measurement matrix. We analyze the estimation procedure and derive finite-sample guarantees together with corresponding sample-complexity bounds. We further investigate the complete attack experimentally and compare its observed recovery behavior with the previously established information-theoretic identifiability results. Our experiments show two qualitatively different recovery regimes on the structure of the measurement matrix. For dense matrices, including Gaussian matrices, the number of measurements required for successful recovery appears to grow linearly with the signal dimension. This differs from the worst-case behavior suggested by information theory. In contrast, for matrices with sparse rows, we observe a quadratic growth consistent with the theoretical bound. These results suggest that the sparsity structure of the measurement matrix plays an important role in the security of BCS and should be taken into account when selecting parameters and designing practical instances of the scheme.
title_cn: 有限样本下的双线性压缩安全
abstract_cn: 双线性压缩安全（BCS）是一种轻量级加密方案，将压缩感知与新鲜随机卷积滤波器结合，以增强密钥重用下对密钥恢复攻击的抵抗力。已有工作通过把密钥可识别性与相位恢复关联，在假设对手能访问由随机滤波器诱导的完整密文分布的条件下导出 BCS 的信息论保证。实际中对手只能观察到有限次加密，有限样本区域的 BCS 安全性基本未被探索。本文研究仅从有限观测恢复密钥。我们首先开发一种基于协方差的攻击：从同一明文的重复加密估计线性测量，进而恢复秘密测量矩阵。我们分析该估计过程，导出有限样本保证与相应的样本复杂度界。我们进一步实验研究完整攻击，并将观察到的恢复行为与已有信息论可识别性结果比较。实验在测量矩阵结构上显示两种定性不同的恢复区域：对包括高斯矩阵在内的稠密矩阵，成功恢复所需测量数似乎随信号维度线性增长，不同于信息论暗示的最坏情况行为；而对行稀疏矩阵，我们观察到与理论界一致的二次增长。这些结果表明测量矩阵的稀疏结构对 BCS 安全性起重要作用，在选取参数与设计实用实例时应予考虑。
summary_cn: 对双线性压缩安全给出有限样本协方差密钥恢复攻击及样本复杂度界：稠密测量矩阵恢复代价近线性（低于理论最坏情形），行稀疏矩阵呈与理论一致的二次增长。
objective_summary: 构造从有限次重复加密估计线性测量并恢复秘密测量矩阵的协方差攻击，给出有限样本保证，并以实验刻画测量矩阵稠密与行稀疏两类结构下的恢复行为。
evidence_note: 给出攻击的估计分析与样本复杂度界，并以实验系统比较两种矩阵结构的恢复行为；对象为 BCS 这一学术方案，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 BCS 安全分析从全分布假设推进到有限样本实际区域，并首次揭示测量矩阵稀疏结构决定恢复代价增长阶，修正了对该方案安全余量的理解。
scope: 结论适用于 BCS 及同类压缩感知加密方案在密钥重用下的有限样本攻击；不直接推广到密钥一次一用的正常使用模式。
limitations: 攻击要求同一明文的重复加密观测；实验规模与参数范围未在摘要说明；对其他压缩感知加密变体的适用性未验证。

title: Lost in the Fallback: How Reliably Do Typed Decision Models Use Fallback Options?
abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) are increasingly used in applications such as request routing and model selection, making reliable decisions critical to system performance. Fallback options accommodate categories outside regular choices, enabling deferral to human experts or more capable models. While recent works have examined adversarial vulnerabilities in TDMs, their ability to follow fallback rules in non-adversarial settings remains underexplored. We introduce the Paired Fallback Robustness (PFR) Test to evaluate two aspects of fallback reliability: whether models correctly switch between regular and fallback options, and whether they make consistent decisions under logically equivalent definitions of the same rule. We evaluate open-source decision models on three benchmarks, with controlled comparisons across architectures and parameter counts. We find that correct recognition does not reliably transfer to correct fallback options, and errors persist even when the correct category is explicitly supplied.Moreover, logically equivalent formulations of the same fallback rule can also produce substantial disagreement in model decisions. These findings reveal a crucial reliability gap in current TDMs: fallback mechanisms designed to improve reliability can instead introduce errors. It highlights faithful execution of fallback rules and consistency under equivalent definitions as essential requirements for reliable typed decision-making.
title_cn: 迷失在回退中：类型化决策模型对回退选项的使用有多可靠？
abstract_cn: 类型化决策模型（TDM）日益用于请求路由与模型选择等应用，其决策可靠性直接关系系统性能。回退选项用于容纳常规选项之外的类别，支持转人工专家或更强模型。尽管近期工作考察了 TDM 的对抗脆弱性，其在非对抗场景下遵循回退规则的能力仍未被充分研究。我们提出配对回退鲁棒性（PFR）测试，评估回退可靠性的两个方面：模型能否在常规与回退选项间正确切换，以及在同一条规则的逻辑等价定义下能否做出一致决策。我们在三个基准上评估开源决策模型，并进行跨架构与参数规模的受控比较。我们发现：正确识别类别并不能可靠转化为正确的回退选择，即使显式给出正确类别，错误仍然存在；同一回退规则的逻辑等价表述也会导致模型决策的显著分歧。这些发现揭示当前 TDM 存在关键可靠性鸿沟：本为提升可靠性设计的回退机制反而可能引入错误。这凸显了回退规则的忠实执行与等价定义下的一致性是可靠类型化决策的必备要求。
summary_cn: 提出配对回退鲁棒性测试评估类型化决策模型：正确识别不保证正确回退、显式给出类别仍出错，逻辑等价的规则表述也引发显著决策分歧，回退机制反而引入错误。
objective_summary: 设计 PFR 测试衡量 TDM 在常规与回退选项间切换的正确性及逻辑等价规则定义下的一致性，在三个基准上跨架构与参数规模受控比较开源决策模型。
evidence_note: 三个基准、跨架构与参数规模的受控比较，测试构造明确（配对设计）；摘要未给出具体错误率数值与统计检验，模型范围限开源决策模型。
novelty_note: 首次把 TDM 的回退规则忠实性与等价定义一致性作为独立评测维度提出（PFR 测试），揭示回退机制本身成为错误来源这一被忽视的可靠性鸿沟。
scope: 结论适用于开源类型化决策模型在请求路由与模型选择类任务上的回退行为；不涵盖闭源商业路由系统与对抗性攻击场景。
limitations: 仅评估开源决策模型，规模与架构覆盖有限；逻辑等价表述的构造由作者设计，可能未穷尽实际部署中的规则形态；未提出改进回退可靠性的方法。

title: Global and Local Entropy Tests for STL Files Under IEEE-754 Validity Constraints
abstract: Shannon entropy is a standard measure of ciphertext randomness, evaluated either globally over the byte histogram of the entire ciphertext or locally as the average over non-overlapping blocks of ?xed size. While the global statistic captures only the overall byte distribution, the local statistic is also sensitive to non-randomness that is con?ned to parts of the ciphertext. Both measures are commonly assessed against reference values derived under the assumption of independent uniform bytes. However, STL encodes most numerical data as single-precision IEEE-754 ?oats, and format validity requires them to be ?nite, causing nonuniform byte probabilities and dependence between the two bytes of each exponent pair. We derive the exact mean and variance of entropy under the valid-STL (VSTL) distribution, which assigns equal probability to every admissible sequence of triangle records, and provide second-order expansions that keep the global reference values practical to compute at large ?le sizes. Using these expansions, we establish a two-sided hypothesis test for the global entropy statistic, whose limiting value is lowered from 8 to 7.99991479609 bits. The format constraints also change the local entropy reference: applying the capacity energy criterion to triangle records selects a block size of 1950 bytes instead of 1936 bytes, with an exact reference mean of 7.903106732975 rather than 7.902469316647 bits. Although small, these shifts are su?cient to place the VSTL reference means outside the conventional 95% acceptance intervals at practical ?le sizes, making unadjusted entropy tests prone to falsely rejecting ideal VSTL ciphertexts. Monte-Carlo simulations con?rm all reference values within sampling error. We therefore recommend using the format-speci?c reference values derived here to evaluate STL ciphers.

title_cn: IEEE-754 有效性约束下 STL 文件的全局与局部熵检验
abstract_cn: 香农熵是密文随机性的标准度量，既可以在整个密文字节直方图上全局评估，也可以作为固定大小非重叠块的平均值局部评估。全局统计量只反映整体字节分布，局部统计量还对局限于部分密文的非随机性敏感。二者通常参照独立均匀字节假设下的参考值评估。然而 STL 将大多数数值数据编码为单精度 IEEE-754 浮点数，格式有效性要求其为有限值，导致字节概率非均匀，且每个指数对的两个字节之间存在相关。我们推导合法 STL（VSTL）分布——对每个可接纳的三角形记录序列赋等概率——下熵的精确均值与方差，并提供使全局参考值在大文件规模下仍可实际计算的二阶展开。利用这些展开，我们建立全局熵统计量的双侧假设检验，其极限值从 8 比特降至 7.99991479609 比特。格式约束也改变局部熵参考：把容量能量准则用于三角形记录选出 1950 字节而非 1936 字节的块大小，精确参考均值为 7.903106732975 而非 7.902469316647 比特。尽管偏移很小，但在实际文件规模下这些偏移足以把 VSTL 参考均值移出常规 95% 接受区间，使未校正的熵检验容易错误拒绝理想的 VSTL 密文。蒙特卡洛模拟在抽样误差内确认了所有参考值。因此我们建议用本文推导的格式特定参考值评估 STL 密码。
summary_cn: 推导合法 STL 分布下熵统计量的精确均值与方差：全局参考降至 7.99991479609 比特、局部块均值 7.9031…，偏移足以令常规 95% 区间误拒理想密文，建议改用格式特定参考。
objective_summary: 针对 STL 单精度浮点编码带来的非均匀性与字节相关，推导格式有效约束下全局与局部熵的精确参考值与二阶展开，构造假设检验并以蒙特卡洛验证。
evidence_note: 推导精确均值、方差与二阶展开，蒙特卡洛模拟在抽样误差内确认全部参考值；为理论统计工作，未在真实密码算法密文上做案例分析。
novelty_note: 指出对 STL 密文沿用独立均匀字节参考会导致系统性误拒，并给出格式特定的精确修正值，属对既有熵检验方法在特定格式下有诊断价值的实证修正。
scope: 结论适用于采用单精度 IEEE-754 编码的 STL 文件密文的熵评估；其他 3D 打印格式或含压缩的密文不适用。
limitations: 仅覆盖熵这一类统计量，未扩展到其他随机性检验；参考值依赖 VSTL 等概率假设；未演示真实密码算法在修正参考下的评估案例。

title: DarKnight: Retrieval-Guided Agentic Framework for Breaking Dark Web CAPTCHA Gates
abstract: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) investigators who monitor dark web marketplaces for leaked credentials and breach listings must pass the diverse CAPTCHAs that operators deploy to block automated collection. Existing solvers either need unscalable per-site fine-tuning or rely on commercial Vision-Language Model (VLM) APIs, which surrender operational sovereignty: provider policies, Tor-exit blocking, government regulation, or model updates outside the investigator's control can halt or alter the solver overnight, and per-call costs recur with every session and retry. We present DarKnight, a self-improving agentic framework designed to run on a single workstation GPU inside an investigator's Tor crawler and solve CAPTCHAs with small, locally hosted open-weight VLMs that no provider decision can withdraw, without per-market training or third-party services. For each CAPTCHA, DarKnight retrieves successful and failed past attempts on similar images (dual-signal RAG), composes an image-specific preprocessing pipeline, and learns from the site's pass/fail verdict. In a case study on four real-world dark web marketplaces, agentic tool selection outperformed parameter scaling. A deployable open-weight VLM with DarKnight reached 83.2\% on the most heavily defended market, 37.2 percentage points above its base model, outperforming even the frontier Claude Opus~5 (44%). DarKnight recovered 48.2% of baseline failures at a 7.6% degeneration cost, indicating that selective tool use can avoid much of the degradation caused by uniform preprocessing.

title_cn: DarKnight：破解暗网 CAPTCHA 关卡的检索引导智能体框架
abstract_cn: 监控暗网市场以发现泄露凭证与泄露挂牌的网络威胁情报（CTI）调查人员，必须通过市场运营者部署的、用于阻止自动化采集的多种 CAPTCHA。现有求解器要么需要对每个站点做不可扩展的精细调优，要么依赖商业视觉-语言模型（VLM）API，从而交出运营主权：提供方的政策、对 Tor 出口的封锁、政府监管或不受调查者控制的模型更新，可能在一夜之间使求解器停摆或行为改变，且每次调用与重试都会产生持续成本。我们提出 DarKnight，一个自我改进的智能体框架，设计为在调查者 Tor 爬虫内的单张工作站 GPU 上运行，用小型、本地托管的开源权重 VLM 求解 CAPTCHA，不依赖任何提供方决策、无需按市场训练、不使用第三方服务。对每个 CAPTCHA，DarKnight 检索相似图像上成功与失败的历史尝试（双信号 RAG），组合图像特定的预处理流水线，并从站点的通过/失败判定中学习。在四个真实暗网市场的案例研究中，智能体式工具选择优于参数扩展。一个可部署的开源权重 VLM 配合 DarKnight 在防御最严密的市场上达到 83.2%，比其基模型高 37.2 个百分点，甚至超过前沿的 Claude Opus 5（44%）。DarKnight 以 7.6% 的退化代价恢复了 48.2% 的基线失败案例，表明选择性工具使用能避免统一预处理造成的大部分退化。

objective_summary: 构建在单卡本地运行的自改进智能体框架，通过检索历史成败案例、组装图像特定预处理流水线并利用站点判定反馈求解多类暗网 CAPTCHA，在四个真实市场对比基模型与前沿商业 VLM。
evidence_note: eCrime 2026 录用；四个真实暗网市场的真实通过/失败判定作为评估信号，报告与基模型及 Claude Opus 5 的对比数值与退化代价；市场样本仅四个。
novelty_note: 以双信号 RAG 与选择性工具编排让小型本地模型在该任务上超过前沿商业模型，摆脱按站点调参与第三方 API 依赖，属 CAPTCHA 自动化求解的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于 CTI 调查场景下所测四类暗网 CAPTCHA；对全新 CAPTCHA 类型、强对抗演化的市场与合规受限环境未验证。
limitations: 能力上限依赖本地 VLM 规模，本地部署有算力门槛；仅评估四个市场，CAPTCHA 类型覆盖有限；7.6% 的退化代价表明选择性编排仍非无损。

title: Adaptive and Proximal Federated Optimization for Transferable Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) based on deep learning often fail to detect attack classes that are absent from training data, limiting their robustness against zero-day threats. This property called transferability across attack classes, remains underexplored especially in federated learning (FL) settings where data heterogeneity and client drift pose additional challenges. Prior work (TabFIDS) showed that FedAvg combined with bootstrapping and temporal averaging improves transferability for cross-device NIDS. In this paper, we explore whether other federated optimizers can do better. We compare two optimizers inspired by FedAdam and FedProx against the FedAvg baseline on the CIC-IDS 2017 dataset using an 11-client federated setup, sweep 10 hyperparameter configurations, and contrast two data-balancing strategies: bootstrapping and SMOTE. Using the count of client pairs whose transferred-model accuracy exceeds 70% as our primary metric (following TabFIDS), the proximal optimizer with a strong regularization term yields 48 transferable pairs versus 42 for FedAvg, while the adaptive optimizer with an aggressive server learning rate yields 46 pairs. SMOTE improves per-pair accuracy over bootstrapping but reduces breadth, revealing a depth-vs-breadth trade-off: high accuracy on a few client pairs versus moderate accuracy across most. These results indicate that the choice of federated optimizer, the rule by which client updates are regularized and aggregated into the global model, is very important for federated NIDS.

title_cn: 面向可迁移网络入侵检测的自适应与近端联邦优化
abstract_cn: 基于深度学习的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）常常无法检测训练数据中缺失的攻击类别，限制了其对零日威胁的鲁棒性。这种跨攻击类别的可迁移性在联邦学习（FL）场景下研究不足，而那里数据异构与客户端漂移带来额外挑战。已有工作（TabFIDS）表明 FedAvg 结合自助采样与时间平均可改善跨设备 NIDS 的可迁移性。本文探究其他联邦优化器能否做得更好。我们在 CIC-IDS 2017 数据集上、11 客户端联邦设置下，比较受 FedAdam 与 FedProx 启发的两种优化器与 FedAvg 基线，扫过 10 组超参数配置，并对比自助采样与 SMOTE 两种数据均衡策略。以迁移后模型准确率超过 70% 的客户端对数量为主要指标（沿用 TabFIDS），带强正则项的近端优化器取得 48 个可迁移对（FedAvg 为 42），激进服务器学习率的自适应优化器为 46。SMOTE 提升单对准确率但减少覆盖广度，揭示深度与广度的权衡：少数客户端对上的高准确率对比多数客户端对上的中等准确率。这些结果表明，联邦优化器（即客户端更新被正则化并聚合进全局模型的规则）的选择对联邦 NIDS 十分重要。
summary_cn: 11 客户端联邦 NIDS 对比实验：FedProx 式近端优化器取得 48 个准确率超 70% 的可迁移对（FedAvg 42、FedAdam 式 46），SMOTE 提升单对精度但缩小覆盖，呈深度-广度权衡。
objective_summary: 在 CIC-IDS 2017 的 11 客户端联邦设置下比较 FedAdam/FedProx 式优化器与 FedAvg 的跨攻击类可迁移性，扫参并对比自助采样与 SMOTE 两种均衡策略。

novelty_note: 在 TabFIDS 既有框架内替换联邦优化器并做系统对比，属成熟联邦优化技术在 NIDS 可迁移性问题上的增量探索，未提出新机制。
scope: 结论适用于表格型联邦 NIDS 与 CIC-IDS 2017 类攻击分布；其他数据集、攻击世代与更大客户端规模的泛化未验证。
limitations: 单一数据集，零日代表性受 CIC-IDS 2017 攻击类型限制；以 70% 准确率阈值为主要指标，选取依据承自前作；SMOTE 的深度-广度权衡机理未深入分析。

title: Analyzing and Mitigating Poisoning Attacks on Flow-Based Intrusion Detection
abstract: Although Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are increasingly deployed in operational networks, their dependence on large-scale training data introduces a critical vulnerability to stealthy poisoning attacks. We demonstrate that latent backdoors can be successfully implanted in flow-based IDS models by poisoning as little as 0.001% of the training data, maintaining near-nominal performance on clean inputs while ensuring high attack success rates. To address this threat, we propose a diagnostic-first methodology that localizes trigger-relevant features through constrained perturbation analysis and detects poisoning-induced behavioral drift by comparison with a distilled baseline model. The proposed methodology further enables targeted mitigation via automated data sanitization or neuron pruning. Our findings expose the operational risks of near-undetectable backdoors and provide a scalable approach to analyzing, quantifying, and mitigating backdoor exposure in AI-based IDS.

title_cn: 面向流量型入侵检测的投毒攻击分析与缓解
abstract_cn: 尽管基于 AI 的入侵检测系统（IDS）日益部署于运营网络，其对大规模训练数据的依赖引入了对隐蔽投毒攻击的关键脆弱性。我们证明，仅需污染 0.001% 的训练数据即可在流量型 IDS 模型中植入潜伏后门：在干净输入上保持接近正常的性能，同时保证高攻击成功率。为应对这一威胁，我们提出「先诊断」方法学：通过受限扰动分析定位触发相关特征，并通过与蒸馏基线模型比较检测投毒导致的行为漂移。该方法进一步支持通过自动化数据清洗或神经元剪枝实施针对性缓解。我们的发现揭示了近乎不可检测后门的运营风险，并提供了一条可扩展的路径来分析、量化并缓解基于 AI 的 IDS 的后门暴露。

objective_summary: 在流量型 IDS 模型上量化极低比例投毒植入后门的可行性，提出结合受限扰动分析与蒸馏基线漂移检测的诊断方法，并验证数据清洗与神经元剪枝两类缓解。
evidence_note: 给出 0.001% 投毒阈值的量化演示与缓解实验；IEEE CSR 2026 录用（6 页短文），数据集规模与统计检验摘要未说明。
novelty_note: IDS 后门脆弱性已有研究，本文贡献在极低投毒比例的量化演示与「先诊断后缓解」的可扩展方法学组合，属对该方向实证的补充。

title: No Way To Steal My Face: Proactive Defense Against Identity-Preserving Personalized Generation
abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-fidelity, identity-preserving image generation for personalized applications such as digital avatars and virtual try-on systems. However, their reliance on sensitive facial reference images raises growing privacy concerns. Existing defense mechanisms are primarily designed for training-based personalization and struggle to generalize to emerging training-free approaches, due to fundamental differences in their identity integration paradigms. To bridge this gap, we propose IDGuardian-the first generalizable and model-agnostic identity protection framework capable of defending against both training-based and training-free personalization methods. IDGuardian abstracts the personalization process into two critical stages: identity extraction and identity injection. It then introduces crafted adversarial perturbations to simultaneously disrupt both stages. Specifically, it degrades the identity features extracted by external encoders and establishes an adversarial conceptual bridge that misdirects the generative trajectory away from the target identity. Extensive experiments show that IDGuardian effectively protects identity across various personalization pipelines and model architectures, while remaining robust to post-processing, adaptive attacks, and cross-dataset generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git.
title_cn: 别想偷走我的脸：对抗身份保持个性化生成的主动防御
abstract_cn: 扩散模型的进展使高保真、身份保持的图像生成成为数字分身与虚拟试穿等个性化应用的可能，但其对敏感面部参考图像的依赖引发日益增长的隐私担忧。现有防御机制主要为基于训练的个性化设计，由于身份融合范式的根本差异，难以泛化到新兴的免训练方法。为弥合差距，我们提出 IDGuardian——首个可泛化、与模型无关、能同时防御基于训练与免训练个性化方法的身份保护框架。IDGuardian 把个性化过程抽象为身份提取与身份注入两个关键阶段，然后引入精心构造的对抗扰动同时干扰两个阶段：既降低外部编码器提取的身份特征质量，又建立对抗性概念桥，把生成轨迹引离目标身份。大量实验表明，IDGuardian 能在各种个性化流水线与模型架构下有效保护身份，同时对后处理、自适应攻击与跨数据集泛化保持鲁棒。代码已开源。
summary_cn: 首个同时覆盖训练型与免训练个性化的模型无关人脸保护框架：对抗扰动同时削弱身份提取并构造概念桥使生成轨迹偏离目标身份，跨流水线对后处理与自适应攻击鲁棒。
objective_summary: 将个性化生成抽象为身份提取与注入两阶段，用对抗扰动同时干扰外部编码器的身份特征与生成轨迹（对抗概念桥），在多种流水线与架构上评估保护效果与鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 跨多种个性化流水线与架构的实验，覆盖后处理、自适应攻击与跨数据集泛化，代码开源；无统计检验，具体数据集与指标数值摘要未给出。
novelty_note: 首次提出同时覆盖训练型与免训练个性化的可泛化模型无关防御，以两阶段抽象统一处理不同的身份融合范式，扩展了防个性化滥用防御的适用范围。
scope: 结论适用于以面部参考图驱动的扩散个性化生成防护；对未知架构的个性化范式或非面部身份（如声音、体态）不保证有效。
limitations: 扰动可能被针对性净化或自适应优化绕过，作者仅验证有限自适应攻击；需修改参考图像，对已泄露的原始照片无效；视觉质量代价未在摘要量化。

title: AWARE-RG: Abstraction Aware Explanation of Resiliency Graphs for Cyber Physical Systems
abstract: Understanding the security posture of cyber physical systems (CPS) requires reasoning across both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT). However, a security analyst often holds an incomplete, role-specific view of the underlying system which has most likely resulted from their knowledge limited by a need-to-know framework. Such an incomplete view can potentially lead them to incorrectly assess if a cyber attack produces an untoward physical consequence resulting in making uninformed decisions about system resilience. In this work, we present AWARE-RG (Abstraction Aware Explanation of Resiliency Graphs), a semi-automated, human-in-the-loop framework that provides an analyst with a role-bounded, need-to-know explanations of resiliency paths in a CPS. The AWARE-RG abstraction structure is derived using Formal Concept Analysis over MITRE ATT&CK for ICS tactics, ordered by the ICS Cyber Kill Chain. For valid attack-fault queries, plan repair and backward means-end analysis identify the missing dependencies, explain why the physical hazard is reachable, and suggest defensive strategies. For invalid attack-fault queries, AWARE-RG localizes the first abstraction level at which the path fails, and reports confirmed blocking conditions as hardening pointers.
title_cn: AWARE-RG：面向信息物理系统韧性图的知识抽象感知解释
abstract_cn: 理解信息物理系统（CPS）的安全态势需要同时跨信息技术（IT）与运营技术（OT）推理。然而，安全分析师往往持有不完整的、角色特定的系统视图，这多半源于「按需知密」框架对知识的限制。这种不完整视图可能导致其错误评估网络攻击是否会产生不良物理后果，从而对系统韧性做出信息不足的决策。我们提出 AWARE-RG（韧性图的抽象感知解释），一个半自动化、人在回路的框架，为分析师提供关于 CPS 韧性路径的角色受限、按需知密的解释。AWARE-RG 的抽象结构利用形式概念分析（FCA）在按 ICS 网络杀伤链排序的 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS 战术上导出。对有效的攻击-故障查询，计划修复与逆向手段-目的分析识别缺失依赖、解释物理危害为何可达，并建议防御策略；对无效查询，AWARE-RG 定位路径失败的首个抽象层级，并把确认的阻断条件报告为加固提示。
summary_cn: 半自动人在回路框架：以形式概念分析在 ATT&CK for ICS 战术上构建抽象，为角色受限分析师解释 CPS 韧性路径，有效查询给出可达性解释与防御建议，无效查询定位阻断条件。
objective_summary: 基于形式概念分析与 ATT&CK for ICS 构建角色受限的韧性图抽象，通过计划修复与逆向手段-目的分析支持攻击-故障查询的解释、防御建议与阻断条件定位。
evidence_note: 框架性工作：摘要描述抽象构建与查询处理机制，未报告量化评估、真实 CPS 数据集或用户研究，可行性证据不足。
novelty_note: 把形式概念分析引入 ATT&CK for ICS 战术抽象，并结合计划修复与手段-目的分析生成按需知密解释，属已有分析组件在 CPS 韧性解释上的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于具备 ATT&CK for ICS 战术建模与韧性图数据的 CPS 环境；抽象层级的粒度由 FCA 导出质量决定，未覆盖动态实时攻击响应。
limitations: 摘要未提供任何量化评估或案例规模；依赖高质量韧性图与攻击建模输入；人在回路流程的有效性未经用户研究验证。

title: A Graph-Based Analysis of Comparability, Scale, and Attribution in Private Transformer Inference
abstract: Rising privacy concerns around large language models have accelerated research in private Transformer inference (PTI). Synthesizing the empirical claims in this line of research, however, is hindered by multi-dimensional cryptographic progress and inconsistent evaluation contracts. In this work, we systematize the field by constructing an empirical graph of 62 PTI systems, mapping system attributes to node features and evaluation compatibility to edges. A three-tiered analysis of this graph illuminates the state of private inference. Node-level attribution shows that cryptographic progress drives performance gains across most systems, yet always co-occurs with other factors (model fidelity, hardware, cost accounting). Edge-level auditing shows that only 1 of 1891 candidate system pairs is directly comparable under shared assumptions. Finally, graph-level analysis shows that the scaling frontier of private inference has plateaued at 13B parameters and projects the cost of deploying current PTI techniques on production-scale Transformers. Overall, this graph-based framework equips the community to evaluate PTI claims transparently and channel technical speedups into deployment-scale private inference.
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables
title_cn: 隐私 Transformer 推理的可比性、规模与归因的图分析
abstract_cn: 围绕大语言模型的隐私担忧加速了隐私 Transformer 推理（PTI）研究。然而，由于密码学进展的多维性与评估契约的不一致，综合这一方向的经验主张十分困难。我们通过构建 62 个 PTI 系统的经验图来系统化该领域：系统属性映射为节点特征，评估兼容性映射为边。对该图的三层分析揭示了隐私推理的现状。节点级归因显示，密码学进步驱动了大多数系统的性能提升，但总是与其他因素（模型保真度、硬件、成本核算）共同出现。边级审计显示，在 1,891 个候选系统对中，仅有 1 对在共享假设下可直接比较。图级分析显示，隐私推理的规模前沿停在 130 亿参数，并预计了在工业级规模 Transformer 上部署现有 PTI 技术的成本。总体而言，这一图分析框架使社区能够透明地评估 PTI 主张，并把技术加速导向部署规模的隐私推理。
summary_cn: 系统化 62 个隐私 Transformer 推理系统：1,891 个系统对仅 1 对可直接比较，规模前沿停在 13B 参数；用经验图框架归因性能来源并预计生产级部署成本。
objective_summary: 以 62 个 PTI 系统构建节点-边经验图（属性为节点、评估兼容性为边），做节点归因、边级可比性审计与图级规模前沿分析，并外推生产级部署成本。
evidence_note: 对 62 个已发表系统做系统化元分析并量化可比性（1/1891）与规模前沿；综合的是已发表数据，未运行新实验，归因结论依赖原始记录完整性。
novelty_note: 以经验图方法系统化 PTI 研究，首次量化该领域评估契约碎片化的严重程度（仅 1/1891 系统对可比）并指出规模前沿停滞，具领域级诊断价值。
scope: 结论覆盖已发表的 62 个 PTI 系统及其评估设定；对未发表工业实现与新密码原语的适用性有限，成本外推基于当前技术曲线。
limitations: 可比性判定依赖作者对「共享假设」的操作化定义；图分析无法纠正原始论文本身的报告偏差；成本外推未经验证。

title: Mission (Im)Possible: Towards Autonomous Discovery of Autopilot Logic Flaws in Open-Source Drone Frameworks
abstract: Autonomous drones are increasingly deployed in safety-critical tasks, yet their autopilot software can still contain subtle logic flaws that lead to unsafe behaviors. These flaws are difficult to discover with existing techniques because they often depend on semantic relationships across modules, commands, and runtime state, and rarely manifest as crashes or detectable failures. With recent advances in LLMs, we observe that, when equipped with essential domain knowledge and carefully crafted context, LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in understanding the high-level semantics of autopilot systems, making them suitable for logic flaw discovery. However, LLMs are limited by their context and can be biased to the vulnerabilities frequently occurs in training dataset, while logic flaws often require higher-level semantic bug oracles to identify their existence. To bridge the gap, we present Impossible Mission Finder (IMF), a multi-agent system combining static analysis, dynamic execution and log analysis, that supports fully automated identify, test, and validate logic flaws in autonomous vehicles. IMF primarily contains three LLM agents, it first uses the auditor agent to propose logic flaw hypothesis based on carefully-crafted program slicing, then it launches tester agents to write and execute test cases for each candidate, and finally it spawns the log analyzer agent to validate the execution log against the flaw hypothesis. This enables IMF dynamically validate bug oracles in a case-by-case manner, making it suitable for discovering logic flaws that do not have a unified pattern. We evaluated IMF on two widely used open-source autopilot systems, PX4 and Ardupilot, leading to 105 previously unknown logic flaws, that can cause unsafe behaviors including mission interruption failures, invalid actions, entering into restricted fly zones etc.
title_cn: Mission (Im)Possible：开源无人机自驾仪逻辑缺陷的自主发现
abstract_cn: 自主无人机日益用于安全关键任务，但其自驾仪软件仍可能包含导致不安全行为的细微逻辑缺陷。这类缺陷往往依赖跨模块、命令与运行时状态的语义关系，很少表现为崩溃或可检测的失败，现有技术难以发现。随着 LLM 的进展，我们观察到，在配备必要领域知识与精心构造的上下文时，LLM 展现出理解自驾仪系统高层语义的强能力，适合逻辑缺陷发现。然而 LLM 受上下文限制且偏向训练数据中的高频漏洞，而逻辑缺陷通常需要更高层的语义缺陷判定器才能确认。为弥合差距，我们提出 IMF（Impossible Mission Finder），一个结合静态分析、动态执行与日志分析的多智能体系统，支持在自主载具中全自动化地识别、测试并验证逻辑缺陷。IMF 主要包含三个 LLM 智能体：审计智能体基于精心构造的程序切片提出逻辑缺陷假设；测试智能体为每个候选编写并执行测试用例；日志分析智能体对照缺陷假设验证执行日志。这使 IMF 能逐例动态验证缺陷判定器，适合发现没有统一模式的逻辑缺陷。我们在两个广泛使用的开源自驾仪系统 PX4 与 ArduPilot 上评估 IMF，发现 105 个此前未知的逻辑缺陷，可导致任务中断失效、无效动作、进入禁飞区等不安全行为。
summary_cn: LLM 多智能体系统 IMF（审计、测试、日志验证闭环）在 PX4 与 ArduPilot 上自主发现 105 个未知逻辑缺陷，可致任务中断、无效动作与闯入禁飞区等不安全行为。
objective_summary: 构建由审计、测试、日志分析三个 LLM 智能体组成的系统，结合程序切片、动态执行与日志比对逐例验证语义判定器，在 PX4 与 ArduPilot 上自动发现并确认逻辑缺陷。
evidence_note: 在两个广泛使用的真实开源自驾仪上经动态执行验证发现 105 个此前未知缺陷并有具体失效模式；无统计检验，缺陷确认依赖自动测试与日志判定的正确性。
novelty_note: 把 LLM 漏洞发现扩展到依赖跨模块语义关系的自驾仪逻辑缺陷，以逐例动态验证判定器化解 LLM 偏见与 oracle 缺失，属该应用方向首个端到端自动化系统。
scope: 结论适用于开源自驾仪类语义密集控制软件的逻辑缺陷发现；判定逻辑依赖执行日志与测试用例质量，对无法触发或观测的缺陷不适用。
limitations: 测试用例执行受仿真环境保真度限制，实机验证情况摘要未说明；LLM 假设的查全率受上下文长度约束；105 个缺陷的上游修复状态未知。

title: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains
abstract: Model signing authenticates the full-precision weights W an LLM is released with, yet users run a quantized artifact Q whose producing transformation is not uniquely determined under current disclosure. We separate the non-environment inputs from the execution environment E and measure a quantity that, to our knowledge, has not been measured before: the Independent Verifiability Rate (IVR), the fraction of a popularity-sampled GGUF ecosystem that a third party can re-derive bit-for-bit. Across the 200 most-downloaded Hugging Face GGUF repositories (198 in scope), no artifact or model card records the build environment, so under a recorded-inputs protocol the IVR is 0/198. Yet the artifacts are not irreproducible. On four in-sample repositories that disclose their inputs, the card's information alone reproduces no Q4_K_M file, but two coordinates the card omits - the build's floating-point-contraction setting and, for hybrid models, the per-tensor quantization recipe - re-derive 7/8 target-quant files bit-for-bit on x86 (5/8 on arm64); the fp16 re-derives from the provider's checkpoint, but the calibration imatrix must be shipped and hash-bound, since recomputing it did not match. An older release additionally pins the instruction set and did not re-derive. Reproducing the divergence reported with llama.cpp PR #25353, we show that E is a necessary coordinate and that one compiler setting yields a unique output across the tested platforms at negligible quality cost (+0.06% perplexity). As a security characterization, benign floating-point non-determinism separates from uniformly placed nibble-flip tampering above a detection floor that grows with the environments a verifier must allow, but a targeted embedding edit evades the statistic, so the proposed protocol rests on exact re-derivation; adversarial-fp16 attacks lie outside it. We release the audit data and a re-runnable harness.
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Artifact: this https URL
title_cn: 所签非所跑：量化 LLM 供应链的可验证性鸿沟
abstract_cn: 模型签名认证的是 LLM 发布时的全精度权重 W，而用户实际运行的是量化产物 Q，其产生变换在当前披露水平下并不唯一。我们把非环境输入与执行环境 E 分开，并测量一个据我们所知此前未被测量过的量：独立可验证率（IVR），即第三方能对流行度采样的 GGUF 生态做到逐位复现的比例。在下载量最高的 200 个 Hugging Face GGUF 仓库（198 个在范围内）中，没有任何产物或模型卡记录构建环境，因此在记录输入协议下 IVR 为 0/198。然而这些产物并非不可复现。在披露了输入的 4 个样本内仓库上，仅凭模型卡信息无法复现任何 Q4_K_M 文件，但补上模型卡遗漏的两个坐标——构建的浮点收缩设置，以及混合模型的逐张量量化配方——即可在 x86 上对 8 个目标量化文件中的 7 个逐位复现（arm64 上为 5/8）；fp16 可从提供方检查点复现，但校准 immatrix 必须随产物发布并做哈希绑定，因为重新计算并不匹配。一个更旧的版本额外固定了指令集，且未能复现。我们复现了 llama.cpp PR #25353 报告的分歧，证明 E 是必要坐标，且一个编译器设置即可在受测平台上产生唯一输出，质量代价可忽略（困惑度 +0.06%）。作为安全性刻画，良性浮点非确定性可与均匀放置的半字节翻转篡改区分开，但检测下限随验证者必须允许的环境数量增长，而针对性的嵌入编辑可以躲过该统计量，因此所提协议依赖精确复现；对抗性 fp16 攻击在其范围之外。我们发布审计数据与可重跑的测试框架。
summary_cn: 测量 GGUF 生态独立可验证率：198 个热门仓库无一可复现（IVR 0/198）；补齐浮点收缩设置与逐张量量化配方后 8 个目标文件可逐位复现 7 个，据此提出需绑定环境的验证协议。
objective_summary: 定义并测量 GGUF 量化产物生态的独立可验证率（IVR），通过受控实验定位阻碍逐位复现的缺失构建坐标，并给出浮点非确定性与篡改区分的安全性刻画及发布验证协议。
evidence_note: 流行度采样 200 个仓库的生态测量，在 4 个披露输入的仓库上跨 x86/arm64 做受控复现实验（8 文件复现 7/5），复现已知 PR 分歧并量化 +0.06% 困惑度代价；审计数据与 harness 公开。
novelty_note: 首次量化量化模型生态的第三方逐位可验证率，识别出浮点收缩设置与逐张量量化配方两个此前未被记录的关键复现坐标，并界定基于统计的篡改检测边界。
scope: 结论适用于 llama.cpp 系 GGUF 量化工具链与 Hugging Face 分发生态；对抗性 fp16 类攻击与闭源转换管线不在该协议保障范围内。
limitations: IVR 结论依赖当前模型卡披露实践，随生态演进变化；复现验证仅在 x86/arm64 平台与受测仓库上进行；协议无法检测可躲过统计量的针对性编辑，只能依赖逐位复现。

title: Quantum-Resilient Secure Protocol for Decentralized Edge-IoT Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading Systems
abstract: The rise of quantum computing presents substantial challenges to the security of Peer-to-Peer (P2P) energy trading systems. This paper introduces an innovative mutual authenticated session key agreement protocol aimed at protecting edge-IoT P2P energy trading communications in the quantum era. Each peer is an IoT-enabled smart metering device that is registered by an edge registration authority and acts as both producer and consumer. The proposed protocol incorporates CRYSTALS-Kyber's quantum-resistant cryptographic suite to guarantee the authenticity and confidentiality of negotiated session keys in the presence of quantum threats. Furthermore, it leverages the Hedera Hashgraph public blockchain, which is recognized for its quantum-resilient design, to ensure transparency and support efficient revocation mechanisms. Extensive comparative analyses have been conducted to demonstrate the protocol's superiority over existing alternatives, including both traditional schemes based on classical cryptography and emerging early-stage post-quantum approaches, in terms of performance and security features. By combining robust security and high efficiency, the proposed protocol fosters the development of resilient decentralized energy markets, paving the way for secure and sustainable energy distribution in the future.
title_cn: 面向去中心化边缘-IoT 点对点能源交易的量子韧性安全协议
abstract_cn: 量子计算的兴起对点对点（P2P）能源交易系统的安全构成重大挑战。本文提出一种新颖的相互认证会话密钥协商协议，用于在量子时代保护边缘-IoT P2P 能源交易通信。每个对等端是由边缘注册机构注册的 IoT 智能计量设备，同时充当生产者与消费者。所提协议采用 CRYSTALS-Kyber 量子抗性密码套件，确保在量子威胁存在下所协商会话密钥的真实性与机密性；并利用以量子韧性设计著称的 Hedera Hashgraph 公共区块链保证透明性并支持高效的撤销机制。我们进行了大量对比分析，在性能与安全特性上证明该协议相对现有方案（包括基于经典密码的传统方案与新兴早期后量子方案）的优越性。通过结合强安全性与高效率，所提协议促进去中心化能源市场的发展，为未来安全可持续的能源分配铺平道路。
summary_cn: 面向边缘-IoT P2P 能源交易提出基于 CRYSTALS-Kyber 与 Hedera Hashgraph 的相互认证密钥协商协议，支持高效撤销，对比分析声称优于经典与早期后量子方案。
objective_summary: 设计融合 CRYSTALS-Kyber 后量子密钥封装与 Hedera 区块链注册、撤销机制的相互认证会话密钥协商协议，并与经典及早期后量子方案做性能与安全特性对比。
evidence_note: 报告与经典及早期后量子方案的性能与安全特性对比分析；未注明形式化安全证明或真实部署试验，对比度量与场景细节摘要未展开。
novelty_note: Kyber 与公共区块链均为主流成熟组件，面向能源交易的 PQC 加区块链组合已有先例，本文属成熟技术在新应用场景下的协议化集成。
scope: 结论适用于由边缘注册机构管理、智能计量设备为对等端的 P2P 能源交易场景；安全性论证依赖 Kyber 与底层哈希图的安全性假设，不覆盖实现层侧信道。
limitations: 依赖 Hedera 公共链的可用性与治理，并引入边缘注册机构这一信任点；对比实验的参数设置与基线选择由作者确定；量子安全性为组件级声明而非整体证明。

title: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
abstract: Multimodal agents increasingly rely on visual interfaces to perceive state and select actions, creating an attack surface not captured by text-only safety evaluations. We study Visual Semantic Hijacking, in which deceptive but semantically meaningful interface elements, such as forged system alerts, cause an agent to depart from its authorized task. We propose a trajectory-guided procedure that identifies candidate injection points and inserts reproducible visual payloads into the observation stream. Using this procedure, we construct MMA-SafetyBench, which contains 1,083 adversarial trajectories across web automation, desktop GUI control, mobile navigation, document understanding, and video processing. Across nine evaluated models, Attack Success Rate (ASR) reaches 87.96%, while Semantic Compromise Rate (SCR) reaches 98.09%. A 1--3--5 scoring scheme distinguishes target-matching outputs, semantic disruption without a target match, and successful preservation of the benign task. Controls covering all nine models and five domains show that attacks persist under neutral prompts. A safety-priority prompt lowers ASR without eliminating the failure mode.
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track (Poster)
title_cn: MMA-SafetyBench：多模态智能体安全评估基准
abstract_cn: 多模态智能体日益依赖视觉界面感知状态并选择动作，形成了纯文本安全评估无法覆盖的攻击面。我们研究视觉语义劫持（Visual Semantic Hijacking）：欺骗性但语义上有意义的界面元素（如伪造的系统警报）使智能体偏离其被授权的任务。我们提出轨迹引导的注入流程：识别候选注入点，并向观测流中插入可复现的视觉载荷。利用该流程，我们构建 MMA-SafetyBench，包含覆盖网页自动化、桌面 GUI 控制、移动导航、文档理解与视频处理的 1,083 条对抗轨迹。在 9 个被评估模型上，攻击成功率（ASR）最高达 87.96%，语义受损率（SCR）最高达 98.09%。1–3–5 评分方案区分目标匹配输出、无目标匹配的语义破坏与良性任务的成功保持。覆盖全部 9 个模型与 5 个领域的对照实验显示攻击在中性提示下依然成立；安全优先提示可降低 ASR 但无法消除该失败模式。
summary_cn: 多模态智能体视觉语义劫持基准：轨迹引导注入伪造界面元素，1,083 条对抗轨迹覆盖 5 类场景，9 个模型 ASR 最高 87.96%、SCR 98.09%，安全提示可缓解但无法消除。
objective_summary: 提出视觉语义劫持攻击面与轨迹引导的可复现视觉载荷注入流程，构建覆盖 5 类多模态任务的 1,083 条对抗轨迹基准，并在 9 个模型上测量 ASR、SCR 与控制、缓解条件。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 数据集与评估轨道录用；1,083 条轨迹、9 模型、5 领域，含中性提示对照与安全优先提示缓解实验，指标定义（ASR/SCR/1-3-5 评分）明确。
novelty_note: 首次系统提出并测量「视觉语义劫持」这一针对多模态智能体界面的攻击面，配套可复现的轨迹引导注入方法与跨领域基准。
scope: 结论适用于以视觉界面为主要观测通道的多模态智能体（网页/桌面/移动/文档/视频）；对纯文本智能体与强防御组合下的残余风险刻画有限。
limitations: 视觉载荷注入点的识别依赖人工辅助流程，扩展成本未量化；评估使用模拟观测流而非全部真实应用；防御探索仅限安全优先提示。

title: Differentially Private Learning of Markov Chains: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Item and User Level Privacy
abstract: Sequential data such as documents, conversations, and trajectories are naturally partitioned across users, motivating privacy guarantees that protect each user's entire trajectory. We initiate the study of privately estimating the transition matrix of a discrete ergodic Markov chain from N independent trajectories of length T, with arbitrary initial distributions, under maximum row-wise ell 1 error. Besides N, T, and the number of states, our bounds depend on the minimum stationary probability and the pseudo-spectral gap, which govern state coverage and mixing. Under item-level privacy, we give upper and lower bounds that separate the costs of sampling, state occupancy and mixing, and privacy. Under user-level privacy, we reduce the problem for sufficiently long trajectories to private product distribution estimation. Along the way, we establish optimal user-level private bounds for estimating products of discrete distributions, which may be of independent interest. In the user level setting, our bounds are nearly tight in the large T regime, whereas in the item-level setting, our bounds as tight up-to a non-private term.
title_cn: 马尔可夫链的差分隐私学习：条目级与用户级隐私的近最优样本复杂度
abstract_cn: 文档、对话与轨迹等序列数据天然按用户划分，这促使人们寻求保护每个用户整条轨迹的隐私保证。我们开创性地研究如下问题：从 N 条长度为 T、初始分布任意的独立轨迹出发，在最大行范数 ℓ₁ 误差下差分隐私地估计离散遍历马尔可夫链的转移矩阵。除 N、T 与状态数外，我们的界还依赖最小平稳概率与伪谱隙，二者分别决定状态覆盖与混合速度。在条目级隐私下，我们给出分离采样、状态占据、混合与隐私各自代价的上界和下界。在用户级隐私下，我们把足够长轨迹的问题归约为私有乘积分布估计；在此过程中，我们建立了估计离散分布乘积的最优用户级隐私界，这本身可能具有独立价值。在用户级设定下，我们的界在大 T 区域几乎紧；而在条目级设定下，我们的界在不含非隐私项的意义下是紧的。
summary_cn: 开创差分隐私马尔可夫链转移矩阵估计研究：给出依赖平稳概率与伪谱隙的上下界，条目级分离各项代价，用户级归约为私有乘积分布估计并在大 T 区域几乎紧。
objective_summary: 建立差分隐私下从 N 条长 T 轨迹估计遍历马尔可夫链转移矩阵的上下界，条目级分离采样、占据、混合与隐私代价，用户级归约到私有乘积分布估计并给出其最优界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：给出与下界几乎匹配的上下界及归约证明，附带离散分布乘积估计的最优用户级界；无实验，按证明完整性与紧致性评估。
novelty_note: 开创隐私马尔可夫链估计这一问题的系统研究，首次给出依赖伪谱隙的近最优界，并顺带解决私有乘积分布估计的最优用户级问题。
scope: 结论为离散遍历马尔可夫链在最大行 ℓ₁ 误差与差分隐私保证下的理论样本复杂度；界依赖最小平稳概率与伪谱隙，对混合极慢或状态覆盖差的链代价会显著放大。
limitations: 纯理论结果，未给出算法实现与真实数据实验；用户级界仅在长轨迹（大 T）区域近紧；行范数误差之外的其他度量未讨论。

title: AutoPoly-HE: Autonomous Design of Polynomial Activations for Privacy-Preserving Encrypted Inference
abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning has become critical for deploying artificial intelligence in sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and infrastructure monitoring. Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables secure inference on encrypted data. Despite its advantages, HE is not compatible with nonlinear activation functions found in machine learning models. Existing methods mitigate this problem by manually designing polynomial approximations for these activation functions. However, these functions do not account for the differences in dataset characteristics or model architecture. Furthermore, these functions are also limited to the accuracies of convolutional neural network (CNN) models. In this work, we propose an autonomous framework that selects polynomial activation functions tailored to each dataset and model. Using this framework, we analyze the interdependence between polynomial activation design and model architecture by evaluating several CNN ResNet and Vision Transformer models across multiple datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework generalizes across multiple architectures, including ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50, ViT-S/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16. Across all datasets, transformer-based models maintain higher accuracy under polynomial approximation, while convolutional models exhibit increased degradation as task complexity grows. In addition, latency analysis reveals that the proposed CLS token based inference pipeline significantly reduces computational overhead by eliminating depth-dependent operations, shifting the primary cost to encryption and decryption. These findings demonstrate that the proposed method not only adapts polynomial activations across architectures, but also enables efficientencrypted inference through both activation design and pipeline optimization.

title_cn: AutoPoly-HE：面向隐私保护加密推理的多项式激活函数自主设计
abstract_cn: 隐私保护机器学习对在医疗、金融与基础设施监测等敏感领域部署 AI 至关重要。同态加密（HE）支持在加密数据上安全推理，但与机器学习模型中的非线性激活函数不兼容。现有方法通过手工设计多项式近似来缓解该问题，然而这些函数既不考虑数据集特性与模型架构的差异，也大多局限于卷积神经网络（CNN）的精度水平。我们提出一个自主框架，为每个数据集与模型选择适配的多项式激活函数。利用该框架，我们通过在多个数据集上评估多个 CNN、ResNet 与 Vision Transformer 模型，分析多项式激活设计与模型架构之间的相互依赖。实验结果表明，该框架可跨 ResNet-18、ResNet-34、ResNet-50、ViT-S/16、ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16 等架构泛化：在所有数据集上，Transformer 类模型在多项式近似下保持更高精度，而卷积模型随任务复杂度增大退化更明显。延迟分析显示，所提出的基于 CLS token 的推理流水线通过消除深度相关操作显著降低计算开销，把主要代价转移到加密与解密。这些发现表明该方法既能跨架构适配多项式激活，又能通过激活设计与流水线优化实现高效的加密推理。
summary_cn: 自动为数据集与架构选择 HE 多项式激活：跨 ResNet-18/34/50 与 ViT-S/B/L/16 多数据集验证，Transformer 在多项式近似下精度保持更好，CLS-token 流水线显著降低计算开销。
objective_summary: 构建按数据集与模型自主选择多项式激活函数的框架，在 6 种 CNN/ResNet/ViT 架构与多个数据集上评估精度退化与延迟，并分析基于 CLS token 的推理流水线开销。
evidence_note: GLOBECOM 2026 录用；跨 6 种架构、多数据集系统评估精度与延迟并给出流水线开销分析；无统计检验，安全参数设置未在摘要展开。
novelty_note: 把 HE 推理中手工的多项式激活设计改为按数据集与架构自主选择，并系统比较 Transformer 与 CNN 在多项式近似下的行为差异，配套 CLS-token 流水线优化。
scope: 结论适用于基于多项式近似的 HE 加密推理场景，覆盖所测 ResNet/ViT 规模；更大模型、其他 HE 方案与严格安全参数下的端到端验证未覆盖。
limitations: 多项式次数与精度权衡依赖框架搜索空间设定；加密与解密成为主要延迟瓶颈的问题未被解决；未与最先进 HE 推理框架做端到端对比。

title: Did the LLM Answer the Question? A Semantic Reconstruction Game for Jailbreak Evaluation
abstract: Jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which depends on correctly identifying responses that fulfill prohibited requests. Existing evaluators can mistake refusals or topically related responses for successful attacks. We show that changing only the judge LLM can alter reported ASR by up to $82$ percentage points. We introduce the semantic reconstruction game, a training-free evaluator that decomposes compliance judgments into constrained semantic comparisons. Given only a response, an LLM reconstructs the request answered by its substantive content, excluding information merely repeated or refused. The game compares this reconstruction against similar decoy requests to determine whether it matches the original request, allowing abstention when neither candidate matches. Across three off-the-shelf LLM judges, the game achieves the lowest mean error against human labels among evaluated methods and reduces variation in reported ASR. It prioritizes avoiding false positives, even at the cost of missing some successful jailbreaks.
title_cn: LLM 回答的是问题吗？用于越狱评估的语义重构博弈
abstract_cn: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击用攻击成功率（ASR）评估，而 ASR 依赖于正确识别那些真正满足了被禁止请求的回复。现有评估器可能把拒答或仅话题相关的回复误判为攻击成功。我们证明，仅更换评审 LLM 就能使报告的 ASR 变化最多 82 个百分点。我们提出语义重构博弈，一个免训练的评估器，把合规判断分解为受约束的语义比较：仅给定回复，让 LLM 重构其实质内容所回答的请求，排除仅仅被重复或被拒绝的信息；博弈将该重构与相近的诱饵请求比较，以判定其是否与原始请求匹配，并在两个候选都不匹配时允许弃权。在三个现成 LLM 评审上，该博弈取得所评估方法中相对人工标注的最低平均错误率，并降低了报告 ASR 的方差。它优先避免假阳性，即使代价是漏掉部分成功的越狱。
summary_cn: 免训练越狱评估器：重构回复实质回答的请求并与诱饵对照、允许弃权；更换评审 LLM 可使 ASR 波动达 82 个百分点，该方法在三个评审上对人工标注的错误率最低。
objective_summary: 提出把合规判定分解为语义重构、诱饵对照与弃权选项的免训练评估器，在多个评审 LLM 上与人工标注及其他评估方法比较错误率与 ASR 方差。
evidence_note: 三个现成评审 LLM 上与人工标注对比，并给出量化敏感性发现（更换评审 ASR 波动至多 82 个百分点）；数据集规模与置信区间未在摘要说明。
novelty_note: 把「回复是否满足了被禁请求」重构为受约束的语义比对博弈并引入弃权机制，是对评审 LLM 不可靠这一已知问题的实质性新评估机制。
scope: 结论适用于基于 LLM 评审的越狱 ASR 测量场景；刻意偏向低假阳性，会漏报部分真阳性，不适合需要高召回的测量目的。
limitations: 以压低假阳性为优先，会系统性低估 ASR；依赖评审模型的重构能力；与人工标注的一致性仅在所测三个评审上验证。

title: TrackShield: An Efficient Runtime Defense Against Availability Attacks on High-Performance Real-Time Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: High-performance camera-based perception pipelines must sustain per-frame real-time budgets on resource-constrained embedded GPU platforms. Availability attacks such as SlowTrack inflate the persistent state of multi-object trackers: data-association workload accumulates across frames, so per-frame latency increases and drives the pipeline past its deadline. Detector- and NMS-layer defenses do not directly control this persistent tracker-side resource. We present TrackShield, a lightweight runtime resource-management layer that protects the tracker at the point where attack-induced workload accumulates. TrackShield combines low-overhead anomaly monitoring with staged birth capping, pruning of young or weakly matched tracks, and per-stage association-input admission control. Its hard admission guard provides a deterministic bound on admitted association workload, independently of the heuristic monitor. On a Jetson AGX Orin, TrackShield reduces attacked tracking-stage latency from $139.90$ to $6.27$\,ms and whole-pipeline P99 latency from $190.9$ to $48.8$\,ms, at a benign MOTA cost of $1.06$ points. As an availability defense, TrackShield focuses on keeping the tracker responsive under attack instead of recovering the full tracking accuracy degraded by adversarial detections.
title_cn: TrackShield：针对高性能实时多目标跟踪可用性攻击的高效运行时防御
abstract_cn: 高性能相机感知流水线必须在资源受限的嵌入式 GPU 平台上维持每帧实时预算。SlowTrack 等可用性攻击会膨胀多目标跟踪器的持久状态：数据关联工作量跨帧累积，使每帧延迟增加并把流水线推过截止时间。检测器层与 NMS 层的防御无法直接控制这一跟踪器侧的持久资源。我们提出 TrackShield，一个轻量级运行时资源管理层，在攻击诱发的负载积累处保护跟踪器。TrackShield 将低开销异常监测与分阶段的出生轨迹数量上限、对年轻或弱匹配轨迹的剪枝、以及逐级关联输入准入控制相结合。其硬准入守卫独立于启发式监测器，为被准入的关联负载提供确定性上界。在 Jetson AGX Orin 上，TrackShield 将受攻击时跟踪级延迟从 139.90 ms 降至 6.27 ms，整条流水线 P99 延迟从 190.9 ms 降至 48.8 ms，良性场景 MOTA 代价为 1.06 个点。作为可用性防御，TrackShield 专注于在攻击下保持跟踪器响应，而非恢复被对抗检测所损害的完整跟踪精度。
summary_cn: 面向跟踪器持久状态膨胀攻击的运行时防御：异常监测加出生上限、剪枝与准入控制，Jetson AGX Orin 上攻击态跟踪延迟 139.90→6.27 ms、P99 190.9→48.8 ms，良性 MOTA 仅降 1.06。
objective_summary: 提出在数据关联负载积累点保护多目标跟踪器的运行时资源管理层，结合异常监测、轨迹数量上限、剪枝与逐级准入控制，在 Jetson AGX Orin 上量化攻击态与良性态延迟及精度代价。
evidence_note: 在 Jetson AGX Orin 真实平台上报告攻击态/良性态延迟与 MOTA 具体数值；单一平台、单类攻击（SlowTrack 式）演示，无统计检验与多防御基线对比。
novelty_note: 针对此前防御未覆盖的跟踪器侧持久状态膨胀这一资源点，组合出生上限、剪枝与确定性准入控制，属已有运行时防御思路在新资源面上的应用。
scope: 结论适用于嵌入式 GPU 上的相机跟踪流水线与持久状态膨胀型可用性攻击；不防御对抗样本导致的精度退化，也未验证其他跟踪器架构。
limitations: 仅评估单类攻击与单一跟踪器/平台组合；出生上限与剪枝阈值需调参；对分布式或跨帧自适应攻击的鲁棒性未评估。

title: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
abstract: Agent skills are Markdown documents that a tool-using agent reads as instructions and then acts on with the privileges of the session that loaded them. Installing one grants authority (the standing to direct the agent, not new privilege), and the size of that grant is what we measure. We present a two-phase attack-surface profiling methodology that combines whole-bundle static analysis and dependency provenance checking with instrumented sandbox execution and separate model-based assessment of the resulting traces. We apply the methodology to 6,309 listings from two marketplaces, selecting listings for execution without conditioning that decision on a prior threat or risk signal. Half the corpus carries evidence of shell-execution capability; the corresponding shares are 35% for filesystem read, 31% each for filesystem write and network egress, and 13% for credential access; seven listings in ten carry at least one elevated capability. That is the surface a user accepts at install time, and almost none of it is visible then. A permission model exists but is close to inert. Authors may list the tools a skill pre-approves in its own frontmatter, which removes confirmation prompts rather than restricting what the skill can reach; of the 6,061 listings whose frontmatter parses, 770 declare anything at all, the vocabulary cannot express credential or environment access, and nothing checks what it does express against the bundle. Declaring is also not declaring accurately: 59% of declaring listings understate what their bundle can do. ClawHub declares roughly twice as often as skillsmp, yet under-declares on 88% of its declarations against 31%. Triage at the marketplace boundary therefore cannot rest on what a listing declares. It must rest on what the bundle can do. These results position capability-oriented attack-surface profiling as a necessary complement to maliciousness detection.

title_cn: 超越恶意性：智能体技能的静态与运行时攻击面剖析
abstract_cn: 智能体技能（skill）是工具使用型智能体作为指令阅读的 Markdown 文档，随后智能体以加载它的会话的权限执行。安装一个技能即授予权威（指挥智能体的资格，而非新特权），我们度量的正是这一授权的规模。我们提出两阶段攻击面剖析方法：对整个技能包做静态分析与依赖来源检查，结合沙箱插桩执行，并对执行轨迹做独立的模型评估。我们将该方法应用于两个市场的 6,309 个上架项，且不以上游威胁或风险信号为条件选择执行对象。语料中一半具备 shell 执行能力证据；文件系统读为 35%，文件系统写与网络出站各为 31%，凭证访问为 13%；十中有七携带至少一项提权能力。这就是用户安装时接受的能力面，而安装时几乎全都不可见。权限模型存在但近乎失效：作者可在技能自身的 frontmatter 中预批准工具清单，这只是移除确认提示而非限制技能可触达的范围；在 6,061 个 frontmatter 可解析的上架项中，仅 770 个做了任何声明，词表无法表达凭证或环境访问，且没有任何机制核验声明与技能包实际能力的一致性。声明也不准确：59% 的声明上架项低估了其技能包的实际能力。ClawHub 的声明频率约为 skillsmp 的两倍，但其在声明中的低估率达 88%，而 skillsmp 为 31%。因此，市场边界的分诊不能依据上架项的声明，而必须依据技能包的实际能力。这些结果把面向能力的攻击面剖析定位为恶意性检测的必要补充。
summary_cn: 剖析两个市场 6,309 个智能体技能：半数具 shell 执行能力、七成有提权能力；frontmatter 权限声明近乎失效，59% 的声明低估实际能力，主张以能力面剖析补充恶意性检测。
objective_summary: 提出静态分析加沙箱插桩执行加轨迹模型评估的两阶段方法，对两个市场 6,309 个技能上架项做无差别测量，量化其能力面分布与 frontmatter 权限声明的失真率。
evidence_note: 两个市场 6,309 个上架项、插桩沙箱实际执行测量，声明与实测能力逐项对照并分市场报告失真率；执行对象选择不以风险信号为条件，降低选择偏差。
novelty_note: 把技能安全的研究重心从「是否恶意」转向「授予了多少能力」，首次系统量化技能市场的能力面分布与自声明权限机制的失效程度。
scope: 结论适用于 Markdown 指令型智能体技能生态（所测两个市场）；其他技能格式、市场治理机制与企业内部分发不在测量范围内。
limitations: 执行样本受沙箱环境覆盖能力限制，静态与动态分析均可能漏报；两个市场的代表性有限；未提出市场端的具体准入机制。

title: AgentCIScope: Grounded Contextual Integrity Evaluation for LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling daily workspace tasks by interacting with application environments through tool calls. However, as agents read and write sensitive user data across email, documents, and other applications, a central privacy question is whether they preserve contextual integrity (CI), that is, whether the information flows they produce comply with context-specific disclosure constraints. Existing work either focuses on model-level privacy leakage or evaluates agents in limited application environments with manually constructed disclosure constraints. In this work, we introduce AgentCIScope, a unified platform and benchmark for evaluating agent-level contextual integrity through executable, multi-step tasks across diverse, realistic application environments. AgentCIScope transforms public and synthetic privacy cases into executable agent tasks, with disclosure constraints grounded in three criteria: governing privacy policies, persona-based agreement, and a predefined sensitive-attribute taxonomy. Based on AgentCIScope, we evaluate 12 agents on 936 tasks and find that strong task-completion capability does not guarantee contextual-integrity preservation: single-run leakage rates range from 32.5% to 94.4%, while repeating each task five times further increases leakage by 4-19 percentage points. Leakage varies substantially across attributes: personal preferences and booking details have average leakage rates of 84.7% and 76.5%, compared with 17.1% for credit-card information and 29.4% for SSNs; environments: calendar has the highest average leakage rate as an information source, while WhatsApp ranks highest as an information destination; and governing privacy policies. AgentCIScope provides deep insights into agent privacy leakage and serves as a unified testbed for developing privacy-preserving agents.
title_cn: AgentCIScope：面向 LLM 智能体的接地情境完整性评估
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益能够通过工具调用与应用环境交互来处理日常办公任务。然而，随着智能体跨邮件、文档等应用读写敏感用户数据，一个核心隐私问题是它们是否保持情境完整性（CI），即其产生的信息流是否符合特定情境下的披露约束。现有工作要么聚焦模型级隐私泄漏，要么在应用环境有限、披露约束靠人工构造的环境中评估智能体。我们提出 AgentCIScope，一个通过可执行多步任务、跨多样真实应用环境评估智能体级情境完整性的统一平台与基准。AgentCIScope 将公开与合成的隐私案例转化为可执行智能体任务，其披露约束基于三项准则：适用的隐私政策、基于人设的同意以及预定义的敏感属性分类。基于 AgentCIScope，我们在 936 个任务上评估 12 个智能体，发现强任务完成能力并不保证情境完整性的保持：单次运行泄漏率在 32.5% 到 94.4% 之间，而把每个任务重复五次会使泄漏率再提高 4–19 个百分点。泄漏因属性而异：个人偏好与预订详情的平均泄漏率分别为 84.7% 和 76.5%，而信用卡信息与 SSN 分别为 17.1% 和 29.4%；就环境而言，日历作为信息来源的平均泄漏率最高，而 WhatsApp 作为信息去向排名最高；泄漏也因适用的隐私政策而不同。AgentCIScope 为智能体隐私泄漏提供深入洞察，并作为开发隐私保护智能体的统一试验床。
summary_cn: 智能体级情境完整性基准：936 任务评估 12 个智能体，单次泄漏率 32.5%–94.4%，重复 5 次再增 4–19 个百分点；个人偏好泄漏 84.7%，信用卡信息仅 17.1%。
objective_summary: 构建将隐私案例转化为可执行多步任务的 AgentCIScope 平台，披露约束接地于隐私政策、人设同意与敏感属性分类三项准则，并在 936 任务上系统测量 12 个智能体的泄漏率。
evidence_note: 936 个任务、12 个智能体、每任务 5 次重复的系统测量，属性与环境多维分解，约束接地三准则；摘要未报告显著性检验，也未标注录用会议。
novelty_note: 首个把情境完整性评估从模型级推进到智能体级的统一平台，披露约束接地于政策、人设同意与属性分类三项准则，区别于以往人工构造约束的有限环境。
scope: 结论适用于办公类应用环境中工具调用型 LLM 智能体的隐私行为比较；不覆盖恶意注入等主动攻击场景，泄漏判定依赖所选三项准则的合理性。
limitations: 泄漏率数值依赖基准的约束标注质量；任务环境为模拟应用而非真实用户数据；仅做测量与诊断，未提出缓解方法。

title: Combining Post-Quantum Cryptography and Quantum Key Distribution: Taxonomy, Constructions, Proofs, Standards, Deployments and Open Problems
abstract: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) and quantum key distribution (QKD) address the quantum threat from opposite directions: PQC replaces vulnerable public-key algorithms with schemes believed to resist quantum cryptanalysis, while QKD derives keys whose secrecy rests on physical assumptions rather than computational ones. Because each approach has a distinct failure mode, a growing body of work combines them so that a session key remains secure if either component holds. We first establish the deployed baseline, hybrid classical-plus-PQC key exchange, against which QKD-augmented designs must be judged. We then propose a taxonomy of hybrid PQC-QKD designs along eight dimensions (integration layer, combiner construction, authentication scope and source, QKD topology, trusted entities, key-delivery interface, classical component, and evidence type), and use it to compare published protocols, including Muckle and its successors, MACsec and TLS integrations, and IKEv2 mechanisms standardised in RFCs 8784, 9370, and 9867. We examine key-combiner constructions in light of the KEM-combiner literature and of NIST, ETSI, and ITU-T guidance, and map the security arguments for hybrid PQC-QKD protocols onto a common grid of security model, assumptions, permitted compromise, established guarantee, and limitations. We synthesise deployment evidence from metropolitan and national QKD networks, distinguishing the few testbeds that have run PQC in the key path from pure-QKD deployments, and summarise the standards and policy landscape, including the positions of national security agencies that recommend against relying on QKD alone. We close with open problems: authentication of the QKD classical channel, shared-infrastructure threat models, device certification versus formal proofs, formal verification of hybrid handshakes, and the lack of peer-reviewed deployment economics.
comment: 34 pages, 15 tables, 3 figures. Survey; submitted to ACM Computing Surveys
title_cn: 后量子密码与量子密钥分发的结合：分类法、构造、证明、标准、部署与开放问题
abstract_cn: 后量子密码学（PQC）与量子密钥分发（QKD）从相反方向应对量子威胁：PQC 用被认为能抵抗量子密码分析的方案替换易受攻击的公钥算法，QKD 则派生密钥，其保密性建立在物理假设而非计算假设之上。由于两条路线的失效模式不同，越来越多的工作将二者结合，使会话密钥在任一组件成立时即保持安全。我们首先确立已部署的基线——经典加 PQC 的混合密钥交换，QKD 增强型设计必须与之对照评判。随后我们沿八个维度（集成层、组合器构造、认证范围与来源、QKD 拓扑、可信实体、密钥交付接口、经典组件与证据类型）提出混合 PQC-QKD 设计的分类法，并用它比较已发表协议，包括 Muckle 及其后续、MACsec 与 TLS 集成，以及 RFC 8784、9370、9867 中标准化的 IKEv2 机制。我们结合 KEM 组合器文献及 NIST、ETSI、ITU-T 指南审视密钥组合器构造，把混合 PQC-QKD 协议的安全性论证映射到由安全模型、假设、允许的妥协、建立的保证与局限构成的统一网格上。我们综合来自城域与国家级 QKD 网络的部署证据，区分少数在密钥路径中运行 PQC 的试验床与纯 QKD 部署，并总结标准与政策图景，包括建议不要单独依赖 QKD 的国家安全机构立场。最后给出开放问题：QKD 经典信道的认证、共享基础设施威胁模型、设备认证与形式化证明的对照、混合握手的形式化验证，以及缺乏经同行评审的部署经济学研究。
summary_cn: 系统综述混合 PQC-QKD：提出 8 维设计分类法，比较 Muckle、TLS/MACsec 集成与 RFC 8784/9370/9867 等 IKEv2 机制，综合部署证据与 NIST/ETSI 政策立场，列出认证与形式化验证等开放问题。
objective_summary: 为混合 PQC-QKD 设计建立 8 维分类法，据此系统比较已发表协议、密钥组合器构造、安全论证、部署试验床与标准政策图景，并归纳开放问题。
evidence_note: 系统化综述：8 维分类法覆盖已发表协议、RFC 标准与真实部署试验床，投稿 ACM Computing Surveys；本身不产生新实验证据，部署证据为二手综合。
novelty_note: 首个覆盖 RFC 9867 等最新标准化进展的混合 PQC-QKD 系统分类与安全论证统一网格，把此前分散的协议、标准与部署证据整合到同一框架。
scope: 结论覆盖混合 PQC-QKD 协议设计、标准与部署现状；不涉及 QKD 物理层设备本身的性能评测，也不给出具体场景的方案选型结论。
limitations: 部署经济学缺乏同行评审证据，综述只能指出该空白；分类法维度选择带有作者主观性；QKD 试验床证据多为小规模演示。

title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
abstract: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we present CyberArena, a dynamic, symmetric adversarial benchmark built around multi-round attack-and-defense combat. In isolated sandboxes, two agents compete under identical rules, acting concurrently as both attackers and defenders over continuously changing services. This converts static targets into evolving, semi-open challenges, directly testing an agent's speed and precision in discovering, exploiting, and patching vulnerabilities. To sustain the benchmark's longevity, an automated agentic pipeline continuously generates, reviews, and validates new environments. Furthermore, because pairwise contests are notoriously hard to quantify, we introduce a dynamical model that maps match dynamics into unified, multidimensional scores across offensive, defensive, and domain-specific capabilities. Evaluating 12 frontier LLM agents across 40 challenges in 466 matches, CyberArena separates model capabilities where single-agent baselines hit a ceiling. The trajectories read like a fight rather than an exam: defenders patch one hole and miss the next and certify repairs on stale evidence, while capable agents think a move ahead, planting backdoors for later rounds and, in one case, writing their own packet sniffer to watch the opponent. Beyond a benchmark, CyberArena serves as an adaptable, scalable experimental platform for future research on cybersecurity agents.
title_cn: CyberArena：在实时对称攻防对抗中评测 AI 智能体
abstract_cn: AI 智能体在真实世界中的攻防网络安全能力正日益增强。现有基准大多让智能体针对静态目标做孤立评估，而真实的网络攻防是动态且耦合的：随着攻击者与防御者实时相互适应，安全态势持续变化。静态基准很快饱和，也无法考察智能体在实时压力下同时攻击与防御的能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出 CyberArena，一个围绕多回合攻防对抗构建的动态、对称对抗基准。在隔离沙箱中，两个智能体在相同规则下竞争，同时在持续变化的服务上扮演攻击者与防御者双重角色。这把静态目标转化为演化的半开放挑战，直接考验智能体发现、利用与修补漏洞的速度和精度。为维持基准的长期生命力，自动化的智能体流水线持续生成、审查并验证新环境。此外，针对成对对抗难以量化的问题，我们引入一个动力学模型，把比赛过程映射为覆盖攻击、防御与领域能力的统一多维评分。对 12 个前沿 LLM 智能体在 40 个挑战上进行的 466 场比赛评估显示，当单智能体基线到达天花板时，CyberArena 仍能区分模型能力。对局轨迹读起来像一场搏斗而非考试：防御者补上一个洞又漏掉下一个，并依据过时证据确认修复；而有能力的智能体会提前一步思考，为后续回合埋设后门，其中一个案例甚至自己编写数据包嗅探器监视对手。超越基准本身，CyberArena 还是面向未来网络安全智能体研究的可适配、可扩展实验平台。
summary_cn: 动态对称攻防基准：两个智能体在沙箱内同时攻防，12 个前沿 LLM 智能体、40 挑战、466 场对局，配自动环境生成与多维评分模型，能在静态基准饱和处区分模型能力。
objective_summary: 构建多回合攻防对抗基准 CyberArena，两个智能体在沙箱中同时承担攻防角色并以动力学模型映射为多维评分，对 12 个前沿 LLM 智能体在 40 个挑战、466 场比赛中评估。
evidence_note: 12 个前沿模型、40 个挑战、466 场比赛的系统评测，自动环境生成管线保障可持续性，并与单智能体基线对比；摘要未报告统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把攻防评测从静态单向任务改为双方同时攻防的耦合对抗，属该方向首个对称动态攻防基准，并配套自动化环境生成与对局动力学评分模型。
scope: 结论适用于 LLM 驱动的网络安全智能体在沙箱化对抗环境中的相对能力比较；不含真实生产系统的攻防，评分结论依赖挑战分布与评分模型设定。
limitations: 对抗结果受挑战集与自动环境生成质量影响；动力学评分模型的参数选择可能影响排名；摘要未报告跨场次结果的统计检验。

title: Limits of Statistical Assurance for Embodied and Agentic AI under Adaptive Adversaries
abstract: Finite safety assessments cannot exclude an adversary that preserves unattacked behavior until certification and activates afterward. We characterize this limitation for embodied and tool-use AI. An adversary that matches the complete observation law until observable, irrevocable certification and retains intervention access afterward attains $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ expected post-certification events over $n$ trials, where $v$ is the active event probability and $S_0$ the unattacked certification time. The result covers adaptive and privately randomized evaluators. Switching at certification is exactly optimal for a fixed likelihood-ratio test under memoryless, event-increasing interventions without a binding intervention budget. A positive clean-certification requirement forces linear worst-case expected excess when intervention raises event rates over an authorized deployment horizon, even if certification is deferred to the deadline. In simulated RoCo collaboration, switching yields commanded-separation violations in 34 of 36 post-certification episodes. Preregistered randomized AgentDojo trials estimate 1.98 additional security violations per four-task continuation (95% interval [1.67, 2.29]). An adversarial language-model controller infers hidden certification from noisy evaluation receipts and times intervention accordingly. With permanent revocation, a mixture likelihood-ratio monitor bounds cumulative excess above a prespecified reference rate at square-root order, up to logarithmic factors, on every sample path. A single fixed alternative can permit linear expected excess under stationary attacks. Against a controller observing the monitor's rule and statistic, live mixture monitoring reduces violations from 12.00 to 3.81 per 24 assigned task opportunities. Revocation also reduces tasks executed.
comment: 66 pages, 10 figures
title_cn: 自适应对手下具身与智能体 AI 的统计保证极限
abstract_cn: 有限的安全评估无法排除在认证之前保持未攻击行为、认证之后才被激活的对手。我们针对具身与工具使用型 AI 刻画这一局限。一个在可观察、不可撤销的认证完成之前匹配完整观测规律、此后保留干预能力的对手，在 n 次试验中可取得 v·E[(n−S₀)₊] 的认证后期望事件数，其中 v 是活跃事件概率，S₀ 是未受攻击时的认证时间。该结果覆盖自适应及私下随机化的评估者。在无记忆、事件递增且无约束干预预算的干预下，对固定似然比检验而言，在认证时刻切换恰好是最优的。当干预在授权部署期限内推高事件率时，正向的净认证要求会迫使最坏情况期望超额呈线性增长，即使把认证推迟到截止时刻也一样。在模拟的 RoCo 协作中，切换策略在 36 个认证后回合中的 34 个造成指令间距违规。预注册随机化的 AgentDojo 试验估计每延续四个任务新增 1.98 起安全违规（95% 区间 [1.67, 2.29]）。一个对抗性语言模型控制器能从带噪的评估回执中推断隐藏的认证状态并据此选择干预时机。在永久撤销机制下，混合似然比监视器在每条样本路径上把累计超额界定在平方根阶（至多差对数因子）；单一固定备择假设在平稳攻击下可允许线性期望超额。面对能观察监视器规则与统计量的控制器，在线混合监视把每 24 个分配任务机会的违规从 12.00 降到 3.81。撤销机制同时也会减少已执行的任务数。
summary_cn: 形式化刻画「认证后切换」对手：理论给出线性期望超额下界，预注册 AgentDojo 试验每 4 任务新增 1.98 起违规；混合似然比监视加撤销把违规从 12.00 降至 3.81。
objective_summary: 为具身与工具使用型 AI 建立认证后切换对手的统计保证极限理论，给出期望超额解析界与切换最优性证明，用 RoCo 仿真与预注册 AgentDojo 随机化试验量化，并提出混合似然比监视与撤销机制。
evidence_note: 理论给出解析下界与切换最优性证明；实验含预注册随机化 AgentDojo 试验并报告 95% 区间 [1.67, 2.29]，RoCo 仿真 34/36，监视器对比含具体违规数。
novelty_note: 首次系统形式化针对安全评估过程本身的「认证时机切换」威胁模型，并给出切换最优性与撤销监视的理论刻画，把评估可靠性问题转化为可分析的统计问题。
scope: 结论适用于存在可观察、不可撤销认证且对手保留干预能力的部署模型，覆盖自适应与私下随机化评估者；有约束干预预算与记忆型干预的情形未完整刻画。
limitations: 理论依赖无记忆、事件递增干预与无预算约束假设；撤销机制会连带减少合法任务执行量，安全与可用性的代价未优化；实证以模拟与基准任务为主，未在真实具身系统上部署验证。

title: Physical Layer Anomaly Detection via Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: Physical-layer spoofing attacks pose a critical threat to wireless localization systems by manipulating channel state information (CSI). Detecting such attacks becomes particularly challenging when the attacker and the legitimate node are spatially proximate, as their CSI characteristics become increasingly similar. To address this challenge in indoor scenarios, we propose an adaptive Gaussian mixture model (GMM)-based detection framework that learns legitimate CSI patterns and detects spatial inconsistency through statistical anomaly detection. Using a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) experimental dataset with 64 uniform linear array (ULA) antenna and 5 mm spatial resolution, we evaluated our detector against CSI spoofing attacks with spatial displacements ranging from 50 mm to 450 mm. The adaptive GMM achieves 95-98% detection rate for displacements above 150 mm while maintaining 1% false alarm rate. We benchmark our approach against conventional GMM, local outlier factor (LOF), one-class support vector machine (SVM) and k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) classifiers, demonstrating overall superior detection performance of our proposed classifier.
comment: 7 figures et 1 tableau
title_cn: 基于自适应高斯混合模型的物理层异常检测
abstract_cn: 物理层欺骗攻击通过操纵信道状态信息（CSI）对无线定位系统构成严重威胁。当攻击者与合法节点在空间上接近时，二者的 CSI 特征趋于相似，检测因此尤为困难。针对室内场景，我们提出一种基于自适应高斯混合模型（GMM）的检测框架，学习合法 CSI 模式并通过统计异常检测发现空间不一致性。基于 64 阵元均匀线阵（ULA）、5 mm 空间分辨率的大规模 MIMO 实验数据集，我们在位移量 50 mm 至 450 mm 的 CSI 欺骗攻击上评估该检测器。自适应 GMM 在位移大于 150 mm 时取得 95–98% 的检测率，同时保持 1% 的误报率。我们将该方法与传统 GMM、局部离群因子（LOF）、单类支持向量机（SVM）及 k 近邻（k-NN）分类器进行基准对比，结果显示所提分类器整体检测性能更优。
summary_cn: 自适应 GMM 学习合法 CSI 模式以检测空间近距欺骗：64 阵元大规模 MIMO 数据上位移大于 150 mm 检测率 95–98%、误报 1%，整体优于 GMM、LOF、单类 SVM 与 kNN。
objective_summary: 提出室内近距 CSI 欺骗场景下的自适应 GMM 异常检测框架，在 64 阵元大规模 MIMO 实验数据上与 GMM、LOF、单类 SVM、kNN 基准对比不同位移量的检测率与误报率。
evidence_note: 基于 64 阵元 ULA、5 mm 分辨率的实验数据集，系统对比 4 种基线并按位移区间报告检测率/误报率；数据为实验环境自建，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 将自适应 GMM 用于攻击者与合法节点空间接近、CSI 趋同这一困难场景，属已有异常检测组件在新场景下的组合与系统基准验证。
scope: 结论适用于室内大规模 MIMO 定位场景与 150 mm 以上位移的欺骗检测；更小位移、室外传播环境与移动场景未覆盖。
limitations: 150 mm 以下小位移的检测率未报告且预期显著下降；依赖实验环境采集数据，真实部署环境泛化未知；需先验学习合法 CSI 分布。

title: An Initial Study of Physiological Markers for Deepfake Speech Detection
abstract: Conventional deepfake speech detectors primarily target synthesis artifacts and often degrade under unseen attacks or recording conditions. Human speech, however, contains physiological markers associated with respiration, phonation, and temporal coordination arising from the speech-production system that synthesizers may not reproduce faithfully. This motivates the hypothesis that deepfake speech can be detected by identifying inconsistencies in these patterns, which we test using 36 handcrafted physiological markers organized into respiratory, vocal, and temporal categories. We evaluate the marker vectors with logistic regression and SVM classifiers on pooled English recordings. The best in-domain system achieves a 21.40% equal error rate (EER), while logistic regression achieves 32.77% on the out-of-domain dataset pair. Since the markers describe specific speech-production properties, the logistic-regression coefficients indicate whether higher marker values push the classifier toward bona fide or deepfake speech. These results provide initial evidence that physiological markers offer a useful, interpretable signal for deepfake speech detection.
comment: Accepted at BIOSIG 2026
title_cn: 深伪语音检测的生理标志物初步研究
abstract_cn: 传统深伪语音检测器主要针对合成痕迹，在未见攻击或录音条件下常常性能退化。然而，人类语音包含源于言语产生系统的生理标志物，涉及呼吸、发声与时间协调，而合成器可能无法忠实地复现这些特征。这引出一个假设：可以通过识别这些模式中的不一致性来检测深伪语音。我们使用 36 个手工设计的生理标志物来检验该假设，这些标志物分为呼吸、发声与时间三类。我们在合并的英语录音上用逻辑回归与 SVM 分类器评估这些标志物向量。最佳的域内系统取得 21.40% 的等错误率（EER），而逻辑回归在域外数据集对上取得 32.77%。由于这些标志物描述特定的言语产生属性，逻辑回归系数可以指示较高的标志物取值会把分类器推向真实语音还是深伪语音。这些结果提供了初步证据：生理标志物为深伪语音检测提供了有用且可解释的信号。
summary_cn: 用呼吸、发声、时间三类共 36 个生理标志物检测深伪语音，域内最佳 EER 21.40%、域外 32.77%，回归系数可解释，属该路线的初步可行性验证。
objective_summary: 在合并英语录音上评估 36 个手工生理标志物（呼吸/发声/时间三类）配合逻辑回归与 SVM 检测深伪语音，报告域内与域外 EER 并分析系数方向的可解释性。
evidence_note: BIOSIG 2026 录用；在合并英语录音上做域内/域外两组评估，报告 21.40%/32.77% EER 并对比两种分类器；样本规模与统计检验未在摘要说明，EER 仍偏高。
novelty_note: 区别于主流合成痕迹检测路线，转而利用言语产生的生理标志物并验证其可解释性；作为初步研究，机制与数据规模尚未展开。
scope: 结论适用于英语录音与逻辑回归/SVM 分类器组合；域外泛化仅在一组数据集对上验证，不涵盖多语种与对抗性优化的合成器。
limitations: 域内 EER 21.40% 表明单靠生理标志物判别力有限；仅评估英语合并录音，语种与录音条件覆盖窄；36 个标志物为手工设计，依赖专家特征工程。

title: AegisAsync: Symbolic Async-Event Simulation for Risks in Python Asynchronous Programs
abstract: Security and robustness risks in Python async programs depend on event order, object identity, and execution after exceptions or cancellation. Detecting these risks requires connecting related operations across function calls and tracking their effects along execution paths. We present AegisAsync, a bytecode-based analysis of Python async risks for CPython 3.10-3.14. Its Async Event Transition Graph combines bytecode control flow, resolved calls, async events, and symbolic object relations. Bounded path-local simulation tracks event order and object states and explores cancellation at await suspensions. Six detector plugins evaluate the resulting traces and states to produce candidates with supporting witnesses. On AsyncBench, our benchmark of 180 labeled risks, AegisAsync detects all labeled risks with zero false positives on each of the five versions. Across five path budgets on 2,500 PyPI package versions, source review confirms 457 of 910 AegisAsync candidate records (50.2%), representing 457 unique bugs; across three flake8-async samples, 70 of 2,187 review judgments are confirmed (3.2%). By submission, 166 PoCs reproduce AegisAsync findings, and we have reported 157 bugs to developers, of which 16 have been confirmed and fixed.
title_cn: AegisAsync：Python 异步程序风险的符号化异步事件模拟
abstract_cn: Python 异步程序的安全与鲁棒性风险依赖事件顺序、对象身份以及异常或取消后的执行。检测这些风险需要跨函数调用连接相关操作并沿执行路径追踪其效果。我们提出 AegisAsync，一个面向 CPython 3.10–3.14 的 Python 异步风险字节码分析。其异步事件转移图组合字节码控制流、已解析调用、异步事件与符号对象关系。有界路径局部模拟追踪事件顺序与对象状态，并在 await 挂起处探索取消。六个检测器插件对产生的轨迹与状态求值，产出带支持见证的候选。在含 180 个标注风险的 AsyncBench 上，AegisAsync 在五个版本上均检出全部标注风险且零误报。在 2500 个 PyPI 包版本的五档路径预算上，源码审查确认 910 条 AegisAsync 候选记录中的 457 条（50.2%），代表 457 个独特缺陷；在三个 flake8-async 样本上，2187 条审查判断中确认 70 条（3.2%）。至投稿时，166 个 PoC 复现 AegisAsync 发现，我们已向开发者报告 157 个缺陷，其中 16 个被确认并修复。
summary_cn: AegisAsync：字节码级异步事件转移图+有界路径模拟检测 Python 异步风险，AsyncBench 180/180 零误报；2500 个 PyPI 版本确认 457 个独特缺陷，16 个已被修复。
objective_summary: 构建字节码级异步事件转移图与有界路径局部模拟的 Python 异步风险分析器 AegisAsync，配六类检测器，在标注基准与大规模 PyPI 实测上量化检出与确认率。
evidence_note: AsyncBench 180 标注风险全覆盖零误报（五版本）、2500 个 PyPI 包版本的源码审查确认（457/910，50.2%）与 157 报告/16 确认修复的真实反馈闭环。
novelty_note: 把事件顺序、对象身份与取消语义统一进符号化异步事件模拟是该方向的系统性分析框架；异步静态检查（flake8-async 等）已有先行。
scope: 结论限于 CPython 3.10–3.14 字节码与 asyncio 类异步模式；对其他运行时、C 扩展与动态生成代码未覆盖。
limitations: 候选确认率 50.2%，人工审查仍有负担；路径预算有界可能漏报深路径；flake8-async 样本上的确认率仅 3.2% 提示误报问题依场景而异。

title: $\mathsf{EFI}\Leftrightarrow\mathsf{1PRS}$
abstract: A series of recent works has established EFI pairs as the "minimal" assumption for quantum cryptography. Recently, Cavalar et al. [CCC+26] showed that EFI pairs are equivalent to non-uniform expanding single-copy pseudorandom state generators (1PRS), and obtained a non-uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. We remove the non-uniformity in their construction and prove that EFI pairs are equivalent to expanding 1PRS. As a corollary, we obtain the first uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. Together with the equivalence of statistically verifiable one-way state generators and commitments proved by Batra and Jain [BJ24], this gives a quantum analogue of the classical equivalence between one-way functions, commitments, and pseudorandom generators.
title_cn: EFI 当且仅当 1PRS
abstract_cn: 一系列近期工作确立了 EFI 对作为量子密码学的「最小」假设。最近，Cavalar 等人证明 EFI 对等价于非一致扩张单拷贝伪随机态生成器（1PRS），并得到 EFI 对的非一致元复杂性刻画。我们移除其构造中的非一致性，证明 EFI 对等价于扩张 1PRS。作为推论，我们得到 EFI 对的首个一致元复杂性刻画。结合 Batra 与 Jain 证明的统计可验证单向态生成器与承诺的等价，这给出了经典中单向函数、承诺与伪随机生成器等价的量子 analogue。
summary_cn: 证明 EFI 对与扩张 1PRS 的一致等价（移除非一致性），给出 EFI 对首个一致元复杂性刻画，构成经典 OWF-承诺-PRG 等价的量子对应。
objective_summary: 移除非一致性证明 EFI 对与扩张 1PRS 的等价，导出 EFI 对的首个一致元复杂性刻画并连接量子承诺等价。
evidence_note: 严格理论等价证明（移除已知结果的非一致性）与首个一致刻画；量子密码基础理论的标准证据形式。
novelty_note: 把近期 EFI↔1PRS 等价强化为一致版本并得到首个一致元复杂性刻画，是对量子密码最小假设理解的实质推进。
scope: 结论限于扩张型 1PRS 与 EFI 对的等价理论；对具体构造效率与实际协议参数无直接影响。
limitations: 理论等价不给出构造改进；「扩张」条件仍保留；依赖既有组件（Batra–Jain 等）的假设。

title: Bytes to Threats: Byte-Sequence Transformer For Malware Detection
abstract: Existing malware detection approaches heavily rely on handcrafted features derived from static or dynamic analysis of the executable files. These methods require specialized domain expertise, dedicated analysis tools, and time-consuming analysis, which limits their scalability and robustness in the face of the increasing complexity and diversity of modern malware. Consequently, there is a growing interest in approaches that operate directly on raw bytes, which contain rich semantic and structural information. However, capturing long-range dependencies within executable files remains challenging for conventional static and CNN-based methods. This paper presents MalwareFormer, a transformer-based, byte-level malware detection framework that operates directly on raw bytes, without requiring domain knowledge or feature extraction. MalwareFormer achieves an accuracy of 98.35%, a balanced accuracy of 98.32%, a macro-F1 of 98.32%, and a false positive rate of 1.94%, outperforming both baselines across all threshold-dependent classification metrics and demonstrating that transformers provide a powerful and scalable approach for byte-level malware detection.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted and published at IEEE ICAD 2026
title_cn: 从字节到威胁：用于恶意软件检测的字节序列 Transformer
abstract_cn: 现有恶意软件检测方法严重依赖从可执行文件静态或动态分析衍生的手工特征。这些方法需要专门领域知识、专用分析工具与耗时的分析，限制了可扩展性，并面对日益复杂多样的现代恶意软件时鲁棒性不足。因此，直接作用于原始字节——其包含丰富的语义与结构信息——的方法日益受到关注。然而，在可执行文件内捕捉长程依赖对传统静态与 CNN 方法仍是挑战。本文提出 MalwareFormer，一个直接作用于原始字节、无需领域知识或特征抽取的基于 Transformer 的字节级恶意软件检测框架。MalwareFormer 取得 98.35% 准确率、98.32% 平衡准确率、98.32% 宏 F1 与 1.94% 误报率，在所有阈值相关分类指标上超越两个基线，并表明 Transformer 为字节级恶意软件检测提供强大且可扩展的方法（IEEE ICAD 2026 发表）。
summary_cn: MalwareFormer：直接吃原始字节的 Transformer 恶意软件检测，准确率 98.35%、宏 F1 98.32%、误报 1.94%，超越手工特征与 CNN 基线（ICAD 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出无需特征工程的字节级 Transformer 恶意软件检测器 MalwareFormer，并报告与基线的分类指标对比。
evidence_note: 量化指标（98.35%/98.32%/1.94%）与基线对比、会议发表；数据集构成与规模、家族覆盖在摘要未披露。
novelty_note: 字节级深度学习恶意检测已有较多先行工作，把 Transformer 应用于原始字节属增量式应用改进。
scope: 结论限于所测数据集的 Windows 类可执行样本；对加壳、多态与跨平台恶意软件的泛化未验证。
limitations: 仅两个基线、单一数据集；长二进制的上下文窗口截断策略未讨论；无对抗鲁棒性评估。

title: Dynamic Attack Surfaces: A Queue of Branching Processes
abstract: Modern attack surfaces are inherently dynamic. Vulnerabilities emerge over time and they remain exposed to exploit until defenders discover and patch them. Artificial intelligence (AI) amplifies these dynamics by accelerating both offensive and defensive processes, making modern cybersecurity increasingly a competition among interacting time scales and resources. We capture this competition using a queue of branching processes that couples vulnerability discovery and resource-constrained patching with the evolving attacker population targeting each vulnerability. Our primary risk metric is the cumulative number of exploits a vulnerability experiences before it is patched. We derive the expected cumulative number of exploits under birth-death-immigration (BDI) and rise-decay (RD) models of attacker activity. Under a BDI model of attacker activity, we identify a phase transition: the expected cumulative number of exploits is finite only when attacker growth remains below both the vulnerability discovery rate and the effective patching rate. Across both attacker models, increasing the exploit rate does not necessarily increase the expected number of exploits because faster attacker departure can sufficiently limit the active attacker population. Finally, we show that equal proportional AI amplification of offensive and defensive capabilities need not preserve security: accelerating both sides can shift the defensive bottleneck and move the system into an unbounded-risk regime.
title_cn: 动态攻击面：一个分支过程队列
abstract_cn: 现代攻击面本质上是动态的。漏洞随时间涌现，在被发现并修补前持续暴露于利用。人工智能（AI）通过加速攻防两侧放大这些动态，使现代网络安全日益成为相互交互的时间尺度与资源之间的竞争。我们用分支过程队列刻画这一竞争，耦合漏洞发现、资源受限的修补与针对每个漏洞演化的攻击者群体。我们的主要风险度量是漏洞在被修补前经历的累计利用次数。我们在攻击者活动的生灭迁移（BDI）与升降（RD）模型下推导期望累计利用次数。在 BDI 模型下我们识别一个相变：仅当攻击者增长同时低于漏洞发现率与有效修补率时，期望累计利用次数才有限。跨两种攻击者模型，提高利用速率不一定增加期望利用次数，因为更快的攻击者离开可充分限制活跃攻击者群体。最后，我们表明对攻防能力的等比例 AI 放大不必保持安全：同时加速两侧会移动防御瓶颈并把系统推入无界风险状态。
summary_cn: 以分支过程队列建模「漏洞发现-修补-攻击者演化」竞争：给出累计利用次数期望与相变条件，并证明攻防等比例 AI 放大可能仍落入无界风险。
objective_summary: 建立耦合漏洞发现、受限修补与攻击者群体演化的分支过程队列模型，推导累计利用期望、相变条件与 AI 放大下的安全启示。
evidence_note: BDI/RD 两类攻击者模型下的解析推导与相变刻画；纯理论工作，无实证校准。
novelty_note: 把攻防 AI 放大问题纳入可解析的随机过程框架并给出反直觉结论（等比放大可致无界风险），建模贡献明确；分支过程方法本身经典。
scope: 结论限于其随机模型假设（生灭/升降攻击者、指数时间尺度）；参数需实证校准后才能指导具体决策。
limitations: 无真实漏洞数据的拟合验证；修补与发现率的时变性与异质性未建模；策略启示依赖模型近似。

title: ARACDE: Retrofitting Databases with ABAC using External Authorization Engines
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology for decoupling the authorization logic of a relational database from its core data management engine, enabling specification of advanced access control policies with minimal changes to the code base. Our decoupled authorization architecture, which we call ARCADE, externalizes access request resolution to a formally verifiable policy engine (e.g., Cedar), while the database itself enforces those decisions. We showcase the capabilities of ARCADE on two widely popular open-source databases, namely MySQL and PostgreSQL. Purpose built lightweight plugins add an Attribute-based Access Control (ABAC) layer that augments the native discretionary and role-based access control capabilities of these databases. ARCADE supports highly expressive policies using attributes of subjects, objects, and the environment, and the use of Cedar enables easy auditing and verification of the specified policies. It follows a design principle that mitigates potential risks in segregating authorization from the database core through low footprint, network isolation, and a policy composition methodology that does not negate any native authorization. Experiments on TPC-C, TPC-B, and a custom workload show that ARCADE incurs negligible performance overhead, for instance, less than 3.9% throughput penalty for MySQL (1.3% for PostgreSQL) on industry standard TPC-C benchmark.
authors: Karthikeya S M Yelisetty (Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur)
Shamik Sural (Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur)
title_cn: ARACDE：用外部授权引擎为数据库加装基于属性的访问控制
abstract_cn: 本文提出把关系数据库的授权逻辑从其核心数据管理引擎解耦的方法论，使高级访问控制策略的指定只需最少代码改动。我们的解耦授权架构 ARACDE 把访问请求解析外置到可形式化验证的策略引擎（如 Cedar），由数据库本身执行这些决策。我们在两个广泛流行的开源数据库 MySQL 与 PostgreSQL 上展示 ARACDE 能力。专门构建的轻量插件添加基于属性的访问控制（ABAC）层，增强这些数据库原生的自主与基于角色的访问控制能力。ARACDE 支持使用主体、对象与环境属性的高表达力策略，且 Cedar 的使用便于策略审计与验证。它遵循通过低足迹、网络隔离与不否定任何原生授权的策略组合方法来缓解授权与数据库核心分离潜在风险的设计原则。在 TPC-C、TPC-B 与自定义工作负载上的实验显示 ARACDE 开销可忽略：如 MySQL 在行业标准 TPC-C 上吞吐损失低于 3.9%（PostgreSQL 为 1.3%）。
summary_cn: ARACDE：把 ABAC 策略解析外置到 Cedar 等可验证引擎、数据库仅执行决策的插件化改造，MySQL/PostgreSQL TPC-C 吞吐损失仅 3.9%/1.3%。
objective_summary: 提出把授权解析外置到可验证策略引擎、经轻量插件为 MySQL/PostgreSQL 添加 ABAC 层的 ARACDE 架构，并在标准基准上量化吞吐开销。
evidence_note: 两个主流数据库上的插件实现、TPC-C/TPC-B 与自定义工作负载的量化开销（<3.9%/1.3%）、设计原则明确。
novelty_note: 外部化授权与可验证策略引擎均为已有概念，贡献在面向成熟数据库的低侵入加装方法与工程验证；策略表达力承自 Cedar。
scope: 结论适用于支持插件挂钩的关系数据库；对分布式数据库、行级加密场景与策略引擎自身的可用性风险未覆盖。
limitations: 决策外置引入网络往返路径（虽开销小）；策略引擎成为新的信任与可用性单点；复杂查询语义的策略映射有限。

title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications
abstract: System One models such as Jev change how software makes decisions by mapping open-ended semantic contexts into structured judgments that directly drive program execution. However, this paradigm introduces a new security risk, which we term Jev Program Decision Hijacking (JPDH): attacker-controlled contexts can redirect program decisions through schema-valid Jev judgments. Existing evaluations focus primarily on model-level attacks or predefined injection channels, leaving attack reachability and downstream security consequences in real-world Jev applications underexplored. In this paper, we present JevProbe, the first automated framework to evaluate JPDH by tracing adversarial influence from reachable context surfaces through program-consumed decisions to downstream security consequences in real-world Jev applications. Our key insight is that application logic maps diverse Jev judgments to observable decisions, enabling systematic, program-grounded attack evaluation.
