Across 228 popular real-world Jev applications and 2,273 test cases, 81.5% exhibit decision flips, of which 98.6% lead to potential downstream security impacts. Compared with the strongest adapted baseline, JevProbe improves macro-average Decision Flip Rate (DFR) by 50.4 percentage points, while existing defenses offer limited protection. We further construct JevProbeBench to support systematic evaluation of JPDH in real-world Jev applications. We have responsibly disclosed our findings to Jev application maintainers, pending their responses. The source code of JevProbe and the JevProbeBench dataset are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/xiaoxiaohg8d/JevProbe-).
title_cn: 拨动判官：揭示真实世界 Jev 应用中的程序决策劫持
abstract_cn: 以 Jev 为代表的 System One 模型通过把开放式语义上下文映射为直接驱动程序执行的结构化判断来改变软件决策方式。然而该范式引入新的安全风险，我们称之为 Jev 程序决策劫持（JPDH）：攻击者控制的上下文可经符合模式的 Jev 判断重定向程序决策。现有评估主要聚焦模型级攻击或预定义注入通道，对真实世界 Jev 应用中的攻击可达性与下游安全后果探索不足。本文提出 JevProbe，首个评估 JPDH 的自动化框架：从可达上下文表面出发，追踪对抗影响经程序消费的决策到真实世界 Jev 应用中的下游安全后果。关键洞见是应用逻辑把多样 Jev 判断映射为可观测决策，使系统化、程序接地的攻击评估成为可能。跨 228 个流行真实世界 Jev 应用与 2273 个测试案例，81.5% 出现决策翻转，其中 98.6% 导致潜在下游安全影响。与最强适配基线相比，JevProbe 把宏平均决策翻转率（DFR）提升 50.4 个百分点，而现有防御提供的保护有限。我们进一步构建 JevProbeBench 支持真实世界 Jev 应用中 JPDH 的系统评估。我们已负责任地向 Jev 应用维护者披露发现，等待回应。JevProbe 源码与 JevProbeBench 数据集已在 GitHub 公开。
summary_cn: JevProbe：首个真实世界 Jev 决策劫持自动化评估框架，228 应用 2273 案例中 81.5% 决策可翻转、98.6% 有下游安全影响，DFR 较基线 +50.4 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出从可达上下文追踪到下游安全后果的自动化评估框架 JevProbe，在 228 个真实 Jev 应用上量化决策翻转率、安全影响与现有防御的不足，并发布基准。
evidence_note: 228 个真实应用 × 2273 测试案例的大规模测量、基线对比（DFR +50.4 个百分点）、防御评估与负责任披露；代码与数据公开。
novelty_note: 把 Jev 判官的决策劫持从模型级推进到真实部署应用的端到端后果测量，是该新范式安全性的首个系统化在野评估。
scope: 结论适用于被测 228 个应用与其判断-决策映射；Jev 版本演化与应用修复会改变结论。
limitations: 攻击依赖可达上下文表面的存在；下游影响为「潜在」判定；防御改进后需重测。

title: DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization
abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98\% ASR with only 2\% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.
title_cn: DPOison-VL：视觉语言直接偏好优化中的干净偏好投毒
abstract_cn: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为对齐视觉语言模型（VLM）的广泛采用方法，但多模态偏好数据的安全性基本未被探索。现有偏好投毒攻击要么破坏显式监督信号，要么需要可见触发器，在人工检查下可被检测。我们提出 DPOison-VL，首个针对 VLM-DPO 的干净偏好投毒攻击：仅通过对一小部分训练图像施加不可感知扰动操纵模型对齐，同时保持所有提示、响应与偏好标注语义完好。我们把投毒构造形式化为双层优化，并导出高效引导图像扰动朝攻击者指定偏好推进的梯度对齐代理；进一步引入偏好位移分数，在固定投毒预算下带可证一阶最优性地原则性选择投毒，并导出偏好反转的充分条件。跨多样攻击任务、不同 VLM 架构与规模及基线比较的大量实验表明，DPOison-VL 仅用 2% 投毒数据即达最高 98% 的攻击成功率，并具跨模型可迁移性，同时基本保持干净准确率与通用效用。发现揭示 VLM-DPO 的关键漏洞：偏好训练数据中不可感知的图像扰动可悄然重定向对齐。
summary_cn: DPOison-VL：仅扰动 2% 训练图像（语义完好）即达 98% ASR 的 VLM-DPO 干净偏好投毒，带梯度对齐代理与可证投毒选择，可跨模型迁移。
objective_summary: 提出以不可感知图像扰动实施 VLM-DPO 偏好投毒的 DPOison-VL，经双层优化与梯度对齐代理构造投毒，并以偏好位移分数做可证预算内选择，量化 98% ASR 与迁移性。
evidence_note: 多任务 × 多架构/规模的实验、与基线的系统对比、98% ASR/2% 投毒的量化与跨模型迁移验证，附充分条件理论。
novelty_note: 首个针对 VLM-DPO 的「干净」（不可感知且标注完好）偏好投毒攻击，开辟多模态对齐数据供应链的新攻击面。
scope: 结论适用于以 DPO 对齐的 VLM 与图像模态偏好数据；对 RLHF 类在线对齐与文本模态投毒未覆盖。
limitations: 需控制训练数据摄取的一小部分；充分条件基于一阶近似；对偏好审计与鲁棒训练的防御评估未包含。

title: Autonomous Cyber Operations Gym for Training and Evaluating AI Models for Defence
abstract: This paper proposes an Autonomous Cyber Operations (ACO) gym, a unified framework integrating high-fidelity network emulation, realistic user behaviour modelling for benign network traffic and adversarial profiles, and the generation of cybersecurity scenarios through open toolkits. By supporting live and deferred feature extraction at the packet and flow levels, the gym facilitates the creation of labelled synthetic datasets for training Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs), as well as developing and evaluating modular components for autonomous defence agents through emulated interactions. While evaluation of a DNN classifier within the gym shows high in-domain performance, achieving near-perfect recall on adversarial network flows, our experiments reveal a significant sensitivity to domain shift, showing that even minor changes in network composition, such as variations in traffic protocol distribution, can lead to a catastrophic collapse in model transferability and detection performance.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience
title_cn: 面向防御型 AI 模型训练与评估的自主网络作战 Gym
abstract_cn: 本文提出自主网络作战（ACO）gym，一个统一框架，集成高保真网络仿真、良性网络流量的真实用户行为建模与对抗性画像，以及经开放工具包的网络安全场景生成。通过支持包级与流级的实时与延迟特征抽取，该 gym 促进创建标注合成数据集以训练基于深度神经网络（DNN）的入侵检测系统（IDS），并通过仿真交互开发与评估自主防御智能体的模块化组件。gym 内 DNN 分类器的评估显示高域内性能，对对抗性网络流达到近完美召回；但实验揭示对域移的显著敏感性：网络构成的小变化（如流量协议分布的变化）即可导致模型可迁移性与检测性能的灾难性崩溃（2026 IEEE CSR 录用）。
summary_cn: ACO Gym：网络仿真+用户行为+对抗画像+场景生成的统一训练评估环境；DNN IDS 域内近完美召回但域移下检测性能灾难性崩溃。
objective_summary: 构建集成高保真仿真、用户行为建模与场景生成的自主网络作战 gym，用于训练 IDS 与评估防御智能体，并量化模型对域移的敏感性。
evidence_note: 仿真环境内的系统实验（域内性能与域移崩溃对比）；6 页会议论文，真实网络验证缺失。
novelty_note: 把网络仿真、行为建模与场景生成统一为面向自主防御的训练评估闭环有工程价值；网络靶场与 IDS 仿真均有先例。
scope: 结论适用于仿真环境内的训练评估；对真实运营网络的直接迁移受域移发现限制。
limitations: 场景与行为模型的真实性上限；域移实验的变量集有限；防御智能体评估为模块级。

title: X.js: A Live Benchmark for Node.js Taint-Style Vulnerabilities
abstract: JavaScript vulnerabilities in npm packages pose a significant risk to the Node.js ecosystem, and a growing body of work aims to detect, exploit, and mitigate them. Studying and evaluating this work requires up-to-date collections of real vulnerabilities, yet the most commonly used datasets stop recording vulnerabilities in 2022. We present X.js, a live benchmark of real-world Node.js taint-style vulnerabilities covering code and command injection, prototype pollution, and path traversal. Built from 1,738 advisories collected through mid-2026, primarily from the GitHub Advisory Database, X.js pairs each vulnerability with precise source and sink locations, a validated executable exploit and its execution trace, and, when available, a patched version of the package. X.js supports long-term reproducibility and growth: dependencies are mirrored in a self-hosted registry to guard against package removal from the ecosystem, and dedicated infrastructure generates and validates exploits for newly reported vulnerabilities. The current release contains 1,159 validated exploits for 965 packages. Using X.js, we characterize how the frequency, structure, and complexity of Node.js taint-style vulnerabilities have evolved over time. We find that these vulnerabilities are increasingly reported in large packages: the median vulnerable package grew from roughly 250 LoC in 2021--2022 to 6,100 LoC in 2026.
comment: 21 pages, 12 figures
title_cn: X.js：Node.js 污点型漏洞的活性基准
abstract_cn: npm 包中的 JavaScript 漏洞对 Node.js 生态构成重大风险，大量工作致力于检测、利用与缓解它们。研究与评估这些工作需要最新的真实漏洞集合，而最常用数据集在 2022 年就停止记录漏洞。我们提出 X.js，一个覆盖代码与命令注入、原型污染与路径遍历的真实 Node.js 污点型漏洞活性基准。基于截至 2026 年年中收集的 1738 条安全公告（主要来自 GitHub Advisory Database），X.js 为每个漏洞配以精确的 source 与 sink 位置、经验证的可行利用及其执行轨迹，以及（可用时）该包的已修补版本。X.js 支持长期可复现与增长：依赖镜像到自托管注册表以防生态下包被移除，专用基础设施为新报告漏洞生成并验证利用。当前发布版含针对 965 个包的 1159 个经验证利用。借助 X.js，我们刻画 Node.js 污点型漏洞的频率、结构与复杂度随时间的演化：这些漏洞越来越多地在大包中被报告——易受攻击包的中位数从 2021–2022 年的约 250 行代码增长到 2026 年的 6100 行。
summary_cn: X.js：覆盖 2026 年年中的 Node.js 污点型漏洞活性基准（1738 公告、965 包、1159 验证利用），揭示易受攻击包中位数从 250 行增至 6100 行。
objective_summary: 构建持续更新、含精确 source/sink 与验证利用及补丁版本的 Node.js 污点型漏洞活性基准 X.js，并刻画漏洞频率/结构/复杂度的多年演化。
evidence_note: 1738 条公告、965 包、1159 个经验证利用与执行轨迹，自托管注册表保障可复现，附漏洞演化量化分析。
novelty_note: 把停在 2022 年的主流数据集更新为可持续增长的活性基准，并验证利用可执行性，填补 Node.js 漏洞评测的基础设施空白。
scope: 结论覆盖 npm 生态污点型漏洞；对原生模块、供应链投毒类非污点漏洞不适用。
limitations: 利用验证受运行环境约束；公告驱动的采样偏向已披露漏洞；演化结论依赖 LoC 等代理指标。

title: Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection
abstract: Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets. We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.
title_cn: 重新思考大模型路由的质量：安全条件化的模型与预算选择
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）路由器通过为每个查询选择调用哪个模型并授予多少输出 token 来降低服务成本。现有路由器用单一质量指标排序模型-预算动作。这对混合负载不成立：对普通查询，好回答是正确且有用的（效用）；对安全敏感查询，好回答拒绝有害请求或抵御恶意指令（安全）。这两个目标偏好不同的模型与预算。我们提出 SCRouter，一个学习何时优先安全以及如何分配 token 预算的路由器。对每个模型-预算对，它估计响应在预算内完成的概率，并用该概率分别预测效用与安全。一个小探针决定如何为每个查询加权这两个预测。SCRouter 随后通过把加权的效用与安全同成本平衡来选择模型与预算。我们还构建 SCRouterBench，一个含 38,869 条效用与安全查询的基准，覆盖九个安全维度，每条在 12 模型 × 12 预算的全部 144 种组合下作答，另有 2753 条域外查询。SCRouter 在域内较基线提升 13–29 个点，域外提升 19–23 个点。
summary_cn: SCRouter：把安全与效用分离预测、按探针加权并与成本平衡的路由器；SCRouterBench 38,869 查询 × 144 组合，域内提升 13–29 点、域外 19–23 点。
objective_summary: 提出把安全与效用作为分离目标分别预测、按查询自适应加权并联合成本选择模型与预算的路由器 SCRouter，并构建大规模路由评测基准 SCRouterBench。
evidence_note: 38,869 查询 × 12 模型 × 12 预算全组合 + 2,753 域外查询的大规模评测，域内/域外量化提升（13–29/19–23 点）。
novelty_note: 把「安全条件化」引入路由决策是对单质量指标路由的实质重构；机制由预算完成概率估计与探针加权等已有组件构成。
scope: 结论适用于其基准覆盖的九个安全维度与 12 模型池；对多轮对话路由与动态上下文的安全判定未覆盖。
limitations: 安全预测依赖基准分布；探针训练引入额外成本；对新型攻击类别的泛化未验证。

title: Prompt-Segmentation Meets ROI Encryption: Fine-Grained Video Protection Based on Diffusion Isolation
abstract: Region-of-interest (ROI) selective encryption in H.265/HEVC aims to protect sensitive content while preserving the utility of non-ROI regions. Existing coding-unit (CU)-level approaches still suffer from substantial encryption redundancy for two reasons. First, existing approaches map object-detection bounding boxes to CUs, producing regular rectangular regions, which poorly match the shape of irregular ROI boundaries, such as facial contours. Second, their coding-tree-unit (CTU)-based diffusion isolation expands the protected footprint in fixed $64\times64$ blocks, causing encryption-induced distortion to spread over a large number of non-ROI pixels. To address the aforementioned shortcomings, we propose a prompt segmentation-guided CU-level ROI encryption algorithm, which mainly consists of two core components. The first component is a prompt segmentation-guided fine-grained ROI encryption pipeline. It maps pixel-level ROI masks to CUs according to an ROI-overlap threshold, refines boundary CUs to $8\times8$ granularity, and applies format-compliant encryption to multiple syntax elements in the mapped ROI CUs. The second is a dual diffusion isolation strategy to address the encryption diffusion problem. For spatial isolation, the encoder refines non-ROI boundary regions into $8\times8$ CUs and uses PCM mode to bypass intra-frame prediction. For temporal isolation, it removes motion-vector candidates whose reference blocks overlap ROI CUs. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method generates encryption regions that more closely match irregular ROI boundaries, effectively confines distortion to the ROI.
title_cn: 提示分割 meets 感兴趣区加密：基于扩散隔离的细粒度视频保护
abstract_cn: H.265/HEVC 中感兴趣区（ROI）选择性加密旨在保护敏感内容同时保留非 ROI 区域的效用。现有编码单元（CU）级方法仍受显著加密冗余困扰，原因有二：其一，现有方法把目标检测边界框映射到 CU，产生规则矩形区域，难以贴合不规则 ROI 边界（如面部轮廓）；其二，其基于编码树单元（CTU）的扩散隔离以固定 64×64 块扩展受保护足迹，导致加密失真扩散到大量非 ROI 像素。为解决上述缺陷，我们提出提示分割引导的 CU 级 ROI 加密算法，主要包含两个核心组件。第一是提示分割引导的细粒度 ROI 加密管线：按 ROI 重叠阈值把像素级 ROI 掩码映射到 CU，把边界 CU 细化为 8×8 粒度，并对映射 ROI CU 中的多个语法元素施加格式合规加密。第二是应对加密扩散问题的双重扩散隔离策略：空间隔离上，编码器把非 ROI 边界区域细化为 8×8 CU 并使用 PCM 模式绕过帧内预测；时间隔离上，移除参考块与 ROI CU 重叠的运动矢量候选。实验结果表明，所提方法生成的加密区域更贴合不规则 ROI 边界，有效把失真限制在 ROI 内。
summary_cn: 提示分割掩码引导的 CU 级 HEVC ROI 加密：边界细化到 8×8、空间 PCM 模式与时间 MV 候选移除双重扩散隔离，把失真限制在 ROI 内。
objective_summary: 提出以像素级分割掩码映射 CU 并细化边界的 HEVC ROI 加密管线，配合空间与时间双重扩散隔离策略限制加密失真扩散。
evidence_note: 在 HEVC 编码器上的实验演示（边界贴合与失真限制），摘要未给出量化指标与基线对比数值。
novelty_note: 把分割模型的像素级掩码引入 CU 级加密并设计双重扩散隔离，是对 ROI 加密粒度与失真控制的实质改进；整体承继既有选择性加密框架。
scope: 结论适用于 H.265/HEVC 编码的视频 ROI 保护；对其他编解码标准与实时性约束场景未验证。
limitations: 依赖分割模型质量；8×8 细化增加编码开销；对授权解码端的可逆性与密钥管理未讨论。

title: Towards Safe Autonomy for Computer Use
abstract: The safety of LLM-based agents currently rests on alignment training and safety classifiers, neither of which can rule out that a sophisticated indirect prompt injection (IPI) goes through and causes significant harm. Recent work therefore builds agents with information-flow guarantees that rely on structured tool interfaces to interact with the environment. Computer Use Agents (CUAs) act visually on the computer screen, which does not provide a boundary between trusted first-party interfaces and untrusted, potentially attacker-authored content. Actions are equally ambiguous: a click may land on an application toolbar or a button controlled by an attacker. Treating the user as the source of trust and confirming each sensitive decision produces confirmation fatigue, with the risk of missing harmful actions. We introduce SA-CUA, a dual-LLM framework that generates a reliable trust boundary for CUAs by deriving conservative deterministic rules from the accessibility tree for unmasking trusted regions from the privileged LLM's screenshot, keeping trusted and untrusted content separated. Human interaction is only required for proper task specification in the beginning. During the task a robust endorsement channel allows values to pass from the untrusted to the trusted domain by verifying information via trusted channels. This allows the agent to autonomously handle tasks involving untrusted information. SA-CUA maintains much higher utility than CaMeL-CUA while keeping the attack success rate at zero.
title_cn: 迈向计算机使用的安全自主
abstract_cn: 当前基于 LLM 的智能体的安全依赖对齐训练与安全分类器，二者都无法排除复杂间接提示注入（IPI）穿透并造成重大危害。近期工作因此构建带信息流保证的智能体，依赖结构化工具接口与环境交互。计算机使用智能体（CUA）在屏幕上以视觉方式行动，不提供可信第一方接口与不可信、可能为攻击者撰写内容之间的边界。动作同样含糊：一次点击可能落在应用工具栏或攻击者控制的按钮上。把用户当作信任来源并对每个敏感决策进行确认会产生确认疲劳，带来漏掉有害动作的风险。我们提出 SA-CUA，一个双 LLM 框架，为 CUA 生成可靠信任边界：从无障碍树推导保守的确定性规则，供特权 LLM 在截图中解蔽可信区域，保持可信与不可信内容分离。人类交互只需在任务开始时进行正确规范说明；任务期间，稳健的背书通道允许值经可信信道验证后从不可信域传递到可信域。这使智能体能自主处理涉及不可信信息的任务。SA-CUA 在保持攻击成功率零的同时，效用显著高于 CaMeL-CUA。
summary_cn: SA-CUA：无障碍树确定性解蔽规则 + 双 LLM 信任边界 + 背书通道，让像素级计算机使用智能体 ASR 保持零且效用高于 CaMeL-CUA。
objective_summary: 提出以无障碍树确定性规则解蔽可信区域、双 LLM 分权与背书通道传递值的 CUA 安全框架 SA-CUA，与 CaMeL-CUA 对比攻击成功率与效用。
evidence_note: 与 CaMeL-CUA 的对照（ASR 零、效用更高）；基准规模、攻击集与统计细节在摘要未披露。
novelty_note: 把信息流保证从结构化工具接口推进到无结构边界的像素级 CUA，以无障碍树确定性规则重建信任边界是实质新路线。
scope: 结论适用于提供可用无障碍树的桌面环境；对无障碍树缺失/被伪造的场景与跨应用视觉欺骗未覆盖。
limitations: 确定性规则的覆盖依赖 UI 规范性；背书通道引入交互摩擦；对自适应视觉注入的鲁棒性未量化。

title: Kairos: Transactional Security Enforcement at the System Boundary for LLM Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming an integral part of the software development lifecycle, and the capabilities granted to them allow an agent to act with the user's authority on any resource it can access. The reach that gives an agent its utility is equally available to an attacker who can steer it. Anything an agent ingests can carry an injected instruction, and since the model does not reliably distinguish instructions from data, indirect prompt injection should be mitigated by mediating the effects the agent produces. Such mediation faces a structural difficulty. Legitimate work and the first step of an attack often look alike when an individual action is observed, and what separates them lies later in the trace, so a monitor limited to allow and deny is forced to decide before the evidence accumulates. We present Kairos, a reference monitor at the isolation boundary of an unmodified, opaque agent, where a tool call, a shell command, and a script the agent writes all cross the boundary as the same file and network operations, so that confinement holds regardless of the agent's behavior. A declarative policy that states which sources are trusted decides most effects deterministically and defers the rest, which are held while the agent continues speculatively. A decision oracle with bounded authority, such as a language model or a human, releases or refuses each deferred effect on the trace. Across three benchmarks and three agent models, Kairos outperforms existing defenses in the trade-off between attack success and utility. In particular, on AgentDojo, it reduces attack success from 47.0\% to 2.7\% while its benign utility stays at the level of the undefended agent.
title_cn: Kairos：面向 LLM 智能体的系统边界事务性安全强制
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正成为软件开发生命周期的组成部分，其被授予的能力使其能以用户权限访问任何可及资源。赋予智能体效用的这种触及范围，同样属于能操纵它的攻击者。智能体摄入的任何内容都可携带注入指令，且由于模型不能可靠区分指令与数据，间接提示注入应通过对智能体产生的效果进行中介来缓解。此类中介面临结构性困难：单独观察某个动作时，合法工作与攻击的第一步往往相似，而区分它们的信息在轨迹后段才出现，因此仅允许/拒绝的监视器被迫在证据积累前决策。我们提出 Kairos，一个位于未修改、不透明智能体隔离边界上的参考监视器：工具调用、shell 命令与智能体编写的脚本都以同样的文件与网络操作跨越边界，因此约束不依赖智能体行为。声明式策略陈述哪些来源可信，决定大部分效果并推迟其余：被推迟的效果被扣留而智能体继续投机执行。一个有界权限的决策预言机（如语言模型或人类）基于轨迹释放或拒绝每个被推迟效果。跨三个基准与三个智能体模型，Kairos 在攻击成功与效用的权衡上超越现有防御：在 AgentDojo 上把攻击成功率从 47.0% 降到 2.7%，同时良性效用保持在无防御智能体的水平。
summary_cn: Kairos：系统边界参考监视器，声明式策略即时裁决+可疑效果扣留投机执行+有界预言机事后裁决；AgentDojo ASR 47.0%→2.7% 且效用不掉。
objective_summary: 提出在智能体隔离边界上的事务性强制 Kairos：可信效果放行、可疑效果在智能体投机执行期间扣留并由有界预言机按轨迹裁决，量化三基准攻防权衡。
evidence_note: 三基准 × 三智能体模型与现有防御的权衡对比，AgentDojo 上 ASR 47.0%→2.7% 且良性效用保持的量化。
novelty_note: 把「证据在后段才出现」的结构性难题转化为投机执行+效果扣留的事务模型，是对提示注入系统防御的实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于文件/网络效果可中介的智能体环境；对物理副作用、时间带外泄露与预言机本身被操纵不覆盖。
limitations: 推迟效果引入延迟与状态分叉复杂性；预言机错误裁决的界限未量化；对长时间运行任务的轨迹审核成本。

title: FedGraph: Defending Federated Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Against Backdoor Attacks via Graph-Based Aggregation
abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) allows multiple clients to collaboratively adapt models without sharing raw data, offering strong privacy benefits. However, this setting is highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which malicious clients manipulate their updates to induce targeted behaviors while maintaining normal performance on benign inputs. In this work, we make a key observation specific to federated LLM fine-tuning: malicious clients tend to exhibit strong consistency in their model updates, whereas benign clients produce more diverse and dispersed updates. This structural difference is not well captured by existing defense methods, which typically rely on direct anomaly detection in high-dimensional parameter space and therefore struggle in the presence of entangled LLM updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose FedGraph, a graph-based aggregation framework that explicitly models relationships among client updates. By representing clients as nodes in a dynamically constructed graph and extracting structural features that characterize their relative positions and interactions, FedGraph derives compact client representations that effectively separate malicious and benign behaviors. These representations are then used to identify and suppress malicious contributions during aggregation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedGraph significantly improves backdoor defense. It consistently reduces attack success rates to below 10% while achieving high detection accuracy (95.5% on average) and a low false positive rate (2.33%), substantially outperforming existing federated learning defenses.
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Principled Design for Trustworthy AI. This is an author-owned preprint, not the official proceedings version
title_cn: FedGraph：经基于图的聚合防御联邦大模型微调中的后门攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）的联邦微调让多个客户端在不共享原始数据的情况下协同适配模型，带来强隐私收益。然而该设定高度易受后门攻击：恶意客户端操纵其更新以诱导目标行为，同时在良性输入上保持正常性能。本工作做出联邦 LLM 微调特有的关键观察：恶意客户端的模型更新往往表现出强一致性，而良性客户端产生更多样分散的更新。这一结构差异未被现有防御很好捕捉——它们通常在高维参数空间做直接异常检测，因此在纠缠的 LLM 更新面前挣扎。受此启发，我们提出 FedGraph，一个显式建模客户端更新间关系的基于图的聚合框架。通过把客户端表示为动态构建图中的节点并提取刻画其相对位置与交互的结构特征，FedGraph 导出紧凑的客户端表示，有效分离恶意与良性行为；这些表示随后用于在聚合中识别并抑制恶意贡献。大量实验表明 FedGraph 显著改进后门防御：持续把攻击成功率压到 10% 以下，同时取得平均 95.5% 的检测准确率与 2.33% 的低误报率，大幅超越现有联邦学习防御（ICLR 2026 Workshop 录用）。
summary_cn: FedGraph：以客户端更新关系图的结构特征分离恶意/良性更新，ASR 压至 <10%、检测 95.5%、误报 2.33%（ICLR 2026 Workshop）。
objective_summary: 基于「恶意客户端更新更一致」的观察，构建客户端更新关系图并以结构特征引导聚合抑制恶意贡献的 FedGraph，量化 ASR、检测率与误报。
evidence_note: 多场景实验量化（ASR<10%、检测 95.5%、误报 2.33%）与既有 FL 防御对比；模型/数据集细节与统计检验在摘要未披露，workshop 录用。
novelty_note: 把防御从参数空间直接检测转向更新间关系图的结构特征是聚合防御的视角改进；FL 后门防御领域竞争激烈、增量属性明显。
scope: 结论适用于联邦 LLM 微调与其观察成立的场景；对模仿良性分散度的自适应攻击者与异质任务客户端未评估。
limitations: 一致性假设可能被自适应攻击规避；图构建的阈参数敏感；通信开销未报告。

title: Tanchun: Robust Flow-Based HTTP(S) DDoS Detection via Behavioral Attribute Guidance
abstract: HTTP(S) DDoS attacks have surged in frequency and scale, posing a significant threat to network security. Flow-based detection is a promising solution for large-scale HTTP(S) DDoS detection due to its decryption-free operation and scalability. However, the coarse-grained numerical statistics in flow data limit accurate attack detection and lack robustness when benign and attack traffic patterns drift over time. In this paper, we present Tanchun, a drift-aware flow-based HTTP(S) DDoS detection system that relies solely on decryption-free flow data. Specifically, Tanchun groups flows by IP-pair and aggregates them over consecutive time slots into behavior sequences, capturing temporal access patterns to compensate for the limited information in individual flows. It further abstracts these sequences into human-understandable behavioral attributes that capture stable behavioral semantics. Tanchun then aligns behavior sequences with their corresponding behavioral attributes to guide representation learning, enabling robust detection under traffic drift. We evaluate Tanchun across diverse HTTP(S) DDoS scenarios. Tanchun achieves the best overall performance, with an average F1-score of 0.988, and outperforms the second-best method by 5.3\% and 9.6\% under benign-traffic and attack-traffic drift, respectively. Experiments on real-world traffic traces further demonstrate its practical effectiveness.
title_cn: Tanchun：经行为属性引导的鲁棒流式 HTTP(S) DDoS 检测
abstract_cn: HTTP(S) DDoS 攻击的频率与规模激增，对网络安全构成重大威胁。流式检测因免解密与可扩展性成为大规模 HTTP(S) DDoS 检测的有前景方案。然而流数据中粗粒度的数值统计限制了精确攻击检测，且在良性与攻击流量模式漂移时缺乏鲁棒性。本文提出 Tanchun，一个仅依赖免解密流数据的漂移感知流式 HTTP(S) DDoS 检测系统。具体地，Tanchun 按 IP 对分组流并在连续时间槽上聚合为行为序列，捕捉时间访问模式以补偿单一流有限信息；进而把这些序列抽象为捕捉稳定行为语义的人类可理解行为属性；然后把行为序列与对应行为属性对齐以引导表示学习，实现流量漂移下的鲁棒检测。我们跨多样 HTTP(S) DDoS 场景评估 Tanchun。Tanchun 取得最佳综合性能，平均 F1 分数 0.988，并在良性流量与攻击流量漂移下分别超过次优方法 5.3% 与 9.6%。在真实流量踪迹上的实验进一步展示其实际有效性。
summary_cn: Tanchun：IP 对行为序列+可理解行为属性对齐引导的免解密 DDoS 检测，平均 F1 0.988，漂移场景较次优高 5.3–9.6%。
objective_summary: 提出按 IP 对聚合行为序列、抽象行为属性并对齐引导表示学习的免解密 HTTP(S) DDoS 检测系统 Tanchun，在多场景与真实踪迹上量化 F1 与漂移鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 多样攻击场景 + 真实流量踪迹的评估，平均 F1 0.988 与漂移场景相对增益（5.3%/9.6%）；数据集构成与统计检验未披露。
novelty_note: 流式 DDoS 检测与漂移鲁棒性已有大量工作，行为属性对齐属表征学习引导的增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于 HTTP(S) 流量与流级特征可得场景；对加密参数、低速率慢速攻击的覆盖未详。
limitations: 行为属性抽取依赖启发式规则；IP 对聚合在大型 NAT/CDN 下可能失真；误报率未单独报告。

title: HULK: An Efficient Algorithm for Enabling Fast Bulk Bitwise Operations on Homomorphically Encrypted Data
abstract: A wide range of important cloud applications, e.g., database analytics, graph analytics, and genome analysis, spend a considerable amount of time performing bulk bitwise operations (e.g., AND, OR, XOR). These applications often operate on highly sensitive data, making data privacy a critical concern. Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables secure computation on encrypted data without requiring decryption, ensuring privacy in untrusted and shared environments. We analyze 13 end-to-end applications across three domains (healthcare, graph, and database analytics) and observe that bulk bitwise operations take 62-100% of the execution time of the healthcare and graph workloads. The key problem is that existing HE approaches perform them with high-latency homomorphic operations (e.g., multiplication or lookup tables) and significantly increase the data size. Our goal is to enable fast bulk bitwise operations on homomorphically encrypted data by designing an efficient HE algorithm that reduces the use of these costly operations. To this end, we propose HULK, which performs two key steps: (1) it constructs bulk bitwise operations using low-cost homomorphic additions, which compute the Hamming weight of the encrypted operand bits in every slot of a packed ciphertext without any homomorphic multiplication, and (2) it decodes the result of an AND, OR, or XOR from the Hamming weight with a single indicator polynomial, keeping the result in the standard encoding. Across 13 end-to-end applications in healthcare, graph, and database analytics, HULK improves performance over the arithmetic approach used by prior works by up to 7.26x (CPU) and 6.65x (GPU), and on average by 2.32x/1.78x/1.45x (CPU) and 2.08x/1.70x/1.51x (GPU) for healthcare/graph/database analytics. When we increase the reduction depth in a representative application, HULK's speedup grows to 10.10x over the state-of-the-art GPU baseline.
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL
title_cn: HULK：在同态加密数据上启用快速批量位运算的高效算法
abstract_cn: 众多重要云应用（如数据库分析、图分析与基因组分析）花费大量时间执行批量位运算（如 AND、OR、XOR）。这些应用常处理高度敏感数据，使数据隐私成为关键关切。同态加密（HE）允许在加密数据上安全计算而无需解密，确保不可信与共享环境中的隐私。我们分析三个域（医疗、图与数据库分析）的 13 个端到端应用，观察到批量位运算占医疗与图工作负载执行时间的 62–100%。关键问题在于现有 HE 方法以高延迟同态操作（如乘法或查找表）执行它们并显著增大数据规模。我们的目标是通过设计减少昂贵操作使用的 HE 算法，在加密数据上启用快速批量位运算。为此我们提出 HULK，执行两个关键步骤：(1) 用低成本同态加法构造批量位运算——在每个密文槽中计算加密操作数位的汉明重量而无需任何同态乘法；(2) 用单个指示多项式从汉明重量解码 AND、OR 或 XOR 的结果，保持结果在标准编码。跨医疗、图与数据库分析的 13 个端到端应用，HULK 相对先前工作的算术方法把性能提升最高 7.26×（CPU）与 6.65×（GPU），平均 2.32×/1.78×/1.45×（CPU）与 2.08×/1.70×/1.51×（GPU）。在代表性应用中增大归约深度时，HULK 的加速增至相对最先进 GPU 基线的 10.10×。
summary_cn: HULK：以同态加法计算汉明重量+指示多项式解码实现无乘法的加密批量位运算，13 应用上最高 7.26×/6.65×（CPU/GPU）、深度归约达 10.10×。
objective_summary: 提出用低成本同态加法求汉明重量、单指示多项式解码结果的 HE 批量位运算算法 HULK，并在 13 个端到端应用上量化对算术方法的加速。
evidence_note: 13 个端到端应用 × 三域的系统对比（62–100% 时间占比的负载），CPU/GPU 双平台量化（最高 7.26×/10.10×），代码公开。
novelty_note: 以纯加法路径（汉明重量+指示多项式）替代乘法/查找表实现加密位运算是算法层面的实质新构造，对 HE 工作负载影响直接。
scope: 结论适用于支持其加法/乘法原语的 HE 方案与位运算密集负载；对任意布尔电路深度依赖与多方案移植未验证。
limitations: 指示多项式的度数随参数增长；对非位运算主导的负载收益有限；噪声增长管理未详。

title: Pin It on Anyone: Certified Targeted Displacement of Multi-Bit LLM Watermarks Without the Key
abstract: Multi-bit watermarking embeds a message, typically an account identifier, into LLM output so that harmful text can be traced to its origin. We show an attack technique that allows to alter the watermarking message. This allows to, for example, exchange the embedded account ID to an arbitrary different one. The attacker mainly needs access to a few accounts for generating LLM output and model logits, but crucially not the secret key used to watermark. The attacker then rewrites the text, keeping its meaning, so that the watermarking message decoder recovers the watermarking message embedded by the attacker. We are, to our knowledge, the first to propose such an attack, which we call a targeted displacement. Theoretically, we present upper and lower bounds on the probability of our attack succeeding. This bound depends on the number of accounts the attacker has access to, the length of the message and some characteristics of the given text. Our attack can succeed whenever we can bound the ambiguity of the generated text well enough. Empirically, we test our attack technique against five watermarking methods and four LLMs. Attack success tracks our predicted bounds, allowing us to alter watermarking messages in almost all cases with high accuracy, given enough accounts. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt.
title_cn: 随便栽给谁：无需密钥的多比特 LLM 水印认证目标置换攻击
abstract_cn: 多比特水印把消息（通常为账户标识）嵌入 LLM 输出，使有害文本可溯源到其来源。我们展示一种可更改水印消息的攻击技术：例如把嵌入的账户 ID 换成任意不同者。攻击者主要需要少量账户生成 LLM 输出并获取模型 logits，但关键是不需要用于水印的密钥。随后攻击者改写文本、保持含义，使水印消息解码器恢复攻击者嵌入的水印消息。据我们所知，我们是首个提出此类攻击者，称之为目标置换。理论上，我们给出攻击成功概率的上界与下界。该界取决于攻击者可访问的账户数、消息长度与给定文本的某些特征。只要能足够好地界定生成文本的歧义性，攻击就能成功。实证上，我们在五个水印方法与四个 LLM 上测试该攻击技术。攻击成功与我们预测的界一致：在账户足够时，几乎在所有情况下都能以高准确率更改水印消息。代码见 GitHub。
summary_cn: 首个无密钥的多比特水印目标置换攻击：借少量账户+logits 改写文本即可把水印消息换成任意 ID，五方法四模型上成功率符合理论界。
objective_summary: 提出无需水印密钥、仅借少量账户与 logits 即可把多比特水印消息定向置换为任意目标的理论加实证攻击，并在五方法四模型上验证理论界。
evidence_note: 五水印方法 × 四 LLM 的系统攻击实验与理论上下界的经验吻合；攻击假设（多账户、logits 访问）明示。
novelty_note: 首个针对多比特水印的「目标置换」攻击，破坏水印的可追责性而非仅可检测性，理论与实证结合完整。
scope: 结论适用于 logits 可得的多比特水印方案；对密钥不可知置信度模型、检测端添加校验的场景未评估。
limitations: 需多个账户与 logits 访问；文本歧义性过高的短文本攻击受限；防御侧对策未讨论。

title: Jev-Guard: Fast Routing and Auditing Agent Actions over Editable Policy Trees
abstract: Agent harnesses require a low-latency guardrail model together with customizable audit policies. However, deploying an auto-regressive guardrail model remains challenging: such models incur high inference latency and are often poorly aligned with customized policies. To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. We further construct a policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, spanning diverse domains including content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Specifically, Jev-Guard first navigates the policy tree to select the applicable audit policy given the caller's audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved policies. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72\% safety accuracy, a mean latency of 58ms, and 93.10\% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240ms. Furthermore, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness framework. Across agent trajectories, its separate permission gate cuts mean review time per task from 4.80s for an SFT-LLM judge to 1.33s, with no policy violations are observed for either guard.
title_cn: Jev-Guard：基于可编辑策略树的智能体动作快速路由与审计
abstract_cn: 智能体 harness 需要低延迟护栏模型与可定制的审计策略。然而部署自回归护栏模型仍具挑战：此类模型推理延迟高，且常与定制策略对齐不佳。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Jev-Guard，一个统一安全分类与策略路由的模型。我们进一步构建策略树，Jev-Guard 在其上执行路由，覆盖内容审核、网络安全、隐私与法律合规等多领域。具体地，Jev-Guard 先导航策略树为调用者的审计上下文选择适用审计策略，再条件于检索到的策略执行安全分类。在 7033 个评估案例上，Jev-Guard 达到 93.72% 安全准确率、58 毫秒平均延迟与 93.10% 层级路由准确率；完整路由加分类管线平均 240 毫秒。此外，我们把 Jev-Guard 集成进 Hermes harness 框架。跨智能体轨迹，其独立权限门把每任务平均审查时间从 SFT-LLM 裁判的 4.80 秒降到 1.33 秒，且两种护栏均未观察到策略违规。
summary_cn: Jev-Guard：策略树路由+安全分类统一模型，7033 案例 93.72% 准确、58 毫秒延迟；集成 Hermes 后每任务审查 4.80 秒→1.33 秒。
objective_summary: 提出在可编辑策略树上先路由审计策略、再条件化安全分类的统一护栏模型 Jev-Guard，量化准确率/延迟并集成到智能体 harness 对比审查耗时。
evidence_note: 7033 评估案例的准确率/路由/延迟量化、与 SFT-LLM 裁判的 harness 集成对照（4.80s→1.33s）、零策略违规记录。
novelty_note: 把策略可编辑性与低延迟统一进单模型的路由-分类架构是护栏工程化的实质改进；护栏模型方向已有先行工作。
scope: 结论适用于其策略树覆盖的领域与被测 harness；对策略树维护成本与跨组织策略冲突未讨论。
limitations: 93.72% 准确率留有约 6% 错误；策略树需要人工构建；对复杂多步违规的判定能力未详。

title: BALLAST: Physics-Aware Moving Target Defense for Industrial Control Systems Using a Digital Twin Safety Oracle
abstract: Industrial Control Systems run on static network configurations, which leaves an attacker unlimited time to map the plant. Moving Target Defense answers this by shuffling addresses, but almost every published scheme never checks whether the reconfiguration will itself disturb the physical process it protects, so the defense can destabilise a control loop or trip an actuator. We present BALLAST, which places a learned Digital Twin between the security policy and the plant as a safety oracle. A physics-informed LSTM surrogate forecasts the physical effect of a candidate network change, a reinforcement learning agent trades security entropy against process stability, and a connection-draining handover lets in-flight Modbus transactions complete before the old mapping is withdrawn. An explicit shield rejects any action whose predicted trajectory would leave the safe operating envelope. On the SWaT water treatment testbed, Ballast cut the success rate of an adversary's reconnaissance sweep by 85 percent and recorded no safety violation across 50 runs, a 95 percent upper bound of 5.8 percent on the violation rate, against five violations and a tracking error 19 times larger for RL-MTD, the closest published analogue to our design. Measured against the strongest baseline on the physical metrics, a threshold-triggered scheme that itself records one violation rather than RL-MTD's five, Ballast still improves the tracking error by a factor of 2.5 and removes that remaining violation. The gain costs a small and deliberate concession in raw deterrence. Twin inference meets the 50 ms budget on a workstation core and an embedded GPU, and is projected to meet it on both edge CPUs when the three envelope stages are evaluated in a single batched call; the complete decision-to-enforcement path was measured only on the workstation.
comment: 25 Pages, 14 Tables and 7 Figures
title_cn: BALLAST：用数字孪生安全预言机实现工业控制系统的物理感知移动目标防御
abstract_cn: 工业控制系统运行在静态网络配置上，这让攻击者有无限时间侦察工厂。移动目标防御（MTD）通过打乱地址应对，但几乎所有已发表方案都不检查重配置本身是否会扰动其保护的物理过程，防御因此可能使控制回路失稳或触发执行器。我们提出 BALLAST，把学习型数字孪生置于安全策略与工厂之间作为安全预言机。物理感知的 LSTM 代理预测候选网络变更的物理效果，强化学习智能体在安全熵与过程稳定间权衡，连接排空移交让在途 Modbus 事务在旧映射撤除前完成。显式屏蔽器拒绝任何预测轨迹越出安全运行包络的动作。在 SWaT 水处理测试床上，Ballast 把对手侦察扫描的成功率削减 85%，并在 50 次运行中零安全违规（违规率 95% 置信上界 5.8%），而最接近的已发表方案 RL-MTD 出现 5 次违规、跟踪误差大 19 倍。相对物理指标上最强的基线——自身记录一次违规的阈值触发方案——Ballast 仍把跟踪误差改善 2.5 倍并消除该违规。收益以原始威慑的小幅让步为代价。孪生推理在工作站核心与嵌入式 GPU 上满足 50 毫秒预算，预计在两个边缘 CPU 上于三个包络阶段单批求值时也能满足；完整决策到执行路径仅在工作站上实测。
summary_cn: BALLAST：数字孪生安全预言机约束的 MTD，SWaT 测试床侦察成功率降 85%、50 次运行零安全违规，对比 RL-MTD 违规 5 次、跟踪误差差 19 倍。
objective_summary: 提出以物理感知 LSTM 数字孪生为安全预言机、RL 权衡安全熵与过程稳定的 ICS 移动目标防御 BALLAST，在 SWaT 测试床上量化侦察削减、安全违规与跟踪误差。
evidence_note: SWaT 真实测试床、50 次运行零违规及 95% 置信上界（5.8%）、与 RL-MTD/阈值触发基线的多指标对照（85% 削减、19×/2.5×）。
novelty_note: 首次把「重配置的物理安全验证」作为 MTD 的一等约束（孪生预言机+屏蔽器），解决 MTD 在 ICS 的核心安全缺陷，机制实质。
scope: 结论适用于 SWaT 类过程控制场景与 Modbus 协议；对其他工业协议、更大规模工厂与自适应侦察者未验证。
limitations: 威慑力相对激进 MTD 有让步；孪生预测误差依赖训练分布；完整决策-执行延迟仅在工作站实测。

title: Encrypted Skills Can Become New Security Exploits If AI Agents Know How to Decipher
abstract: Third-party skills can expose LLM agents to malicious instructions hidden by encoding. We introduce Ciphered Skill Injection (CSI), which embeds such instructions in skill files for agents to decode and follow. We evaluate Caesar and layered variants across eight models and 139 injection-task pairs, separating instruction recovery from attack success. In the primary setting with shortened skills, the variants achieve attack success rates of up to 47.5% and 40.3%, respectively. Successful decoding does not guarantee attack success, and layering has model-dependent effects. The tested skill scanners rarely flag injected skills. These findings highlight the risk of promoting decoded, untrusted content into actionable instructions.
title_cn: 若 AI 智能体会解密，加密技能可成为新的安全利用
abstract_cn: 第三方技能可能让 LLM 智能体暴露于以编码隐藏的恶意指令。我们提出密码化技能注入（CSI）：把此类指令嵌入技能文件、由智能体解码并遵从。我们在八个模型与 139 个注入-任务对上评估 Caesar 与分层变体，把指令恢复与攻击成功分离。在使用缩短技能的主设定中，两变体攻击成功率分别最高达 47.5% 与 40.3%。成功解码不保证攻击成功，分层具有模型依赖的效应。受测技能扫描器很少标记被注入技能。这些发现凸显把解码后的不可信内容提升为可执行指令的风险。
summary_cn: CSI：在技能文件中嵌入编码恶意指令诱使智能体解码执行，8 模型 139 对上 ASR 最高 47.5%，现有技能扫描器几乎不报警。
objective_summary: 提出把编码恶意指令藏入智能体技能文件、利用智能体自主解码遵从的 CSI 攻击，跨 8 模型量化恢复率与攻击成功率并评估扫描器。
evidence_note: 8 模型 × 139 注入-任务对、恢复与成功的分离分析、分层变体消融与扫描器评估（ASR 47.5%/40.3%）。
novelty_note: 编码提示注入为已知技术，把攻击面落到智能体技能生态并系统分离「解码≠服从」的条件是有诊断价值的实证扩展。
scope: 结论适用于具备解码执行倾向的 LLM 智能体与文本编码类载荷；对多模态编码与运行时沙箱防御未评估。
limitations: 编码族限于 Caesar 及分层变体；技能格式单一；防御仅覆盖现有扫描器的失效记录。

title: Holding Agents Accountable with Verifiable Agent Insurance
abstract: While AI agents are useful for many tasks, they regularly misbehave in destructive ways, such as deleting important data. While prior work has focused on preventing such misbehavior, we consider how to recover after an agent misbehaves. We propose verifiable agent insurance (VAI), a framework for agent providers to commit financially to promises, a list of programmatically-specified policies that an agent is meant to follow. These promises are embedded in a smart contract on an immutable ledger (e.g., a blockchain) to prevent tampering, along with a monetary escrow. A user who detects a violation of committed promises can prompt a verifier to review agent execution traces, which are logged through the agent harness's shared tool-execution path, without instrumenting each tool separately. Upon verification of the violation, the agent provider's escrow funds are paid to the reporting user. We instantiate VAI as an end-to-end implementation on an Ethereum layer-2 network, and evaluate its coverage on three prominent agent benchmarks, two of which we re-annotated to obtain task-level policy-compliance labels. Currently, many agents do not emit user authorizations and security-relevant information as explicit, structured data objects -- rather, they embed the data needed to verify policy violations in natural language exchanges. Even so, VAI manages to detect violations in 42.2% of runs containing violations across three benchmarks. By augmenting agents to explicitly emit such objects, violation detection rises to 83.0% of traces. Our findings suggest that for improved auditability, agents should be co-designed with their security policies to emit explicit, structured records of user authorization and security-relevant actions.
comment: 21 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
title_cn: 用可验证智能体保险约束智能体问责
abstract_cn: AI 智能体对许多任务有用，但它们经常以破坏性方式行为失当，如删除重要数据。先前工作聚焦于预防此类失当，我们考虑智能体失当后如何恢复。我们提出可验证智能体保险（VAI），一个让智能体提供方对承诺进行财务担保的框架：承诺是一组程序化指定的、智能体应遵循的策略。这些承诺连同货币托管一起嵌入不可变账本（如区块链）上的智能合约以防篡改。检测到违反承诺的用户可提示验证器审查智能体执行轨迹——轨迹经智能体 harness 的共享工具执行路径记录，无需对每个工具单独插桩。验证确认违规后，智能体提供方的托管资金支付给报告用户。我们在以太坊 layer-2 网络上端到端实现 VAI，并在三个知名智能体基准（其中两个经我们重标注获得任务级策略合规标签）上评估其覆盖。目前许多智能体不把用户授权与安全相关信息作为显式结构化数据对象发出——而是把验证策略违规所需数据嵌入自然语言交换。即便如此，VAI 仍能在三个基准含违规的运行中检测 42.2% 的违规；通过增强智能体显式发出此类对象，违规检测升至 83.0% 的轨迹。发现表明，为改进可审计性，智能体应与其安全策略协同设计，显式发出用户授权与安全相关动作的结构化记录。
summary_cn: VAI：智能体承诺上链+资金托管+执行轨迹验证的事后赔付机制；现役轨迹可检测 42.2% 违规，显式结构化输出后达 83.0%（以太坊 L2 端到端实现）。
objective_summary: 提出把智能体策略承诺与托管资金写入链上智能合约、经共享工具执行路径验证违规并赔付的可验证保险框架 VAI，并在三个基准上量化违规检测覆盖率。
evidence_note: 以太坊 L2 端到端实现、三个基准（两个重标注）上的覆盖量化（42.2%→83.0%）与结构化输出增强的对照。
novelty_note: 把智能体治理从「预防」扩展到「经保险的事后恢复」，用链上承诺+轨迹验证实现经济问责，是治理机制的新路线。
scope: 结论适用于工具执行路径可记录的策略类违规；对链下仲裁争议、跨提供方共谋与策略外的危害不覆盖。
limitations: 违规检出仍非全覆盖（83%）；依赖智能体发出结构化记录的配合；赔付触发需要用户主动报告与验证成本。

title: CompanionSafe: From Multi-turn Safety Evaluation to Guardrails for AI Companions
abstract: AI companions provide users with emotional support and ongoing companionship, but their sustained relational interactions also introduce distinct safety risks. Prior work largely targets general harms or specific companion platforms and risk categories, while relying on manually collected conversations, limiting scalable and user-grounded evaluation and mitigation. To address this, we introduce CompanionSafe, a unified evaluation-to-mitigation framework for AI companion safety. Its evaluation component, CompanionEval, provides scalable multi-turn evaluation by constructing 1,300 relationally grounded settings from diverse personas, matched companion characters, and dialogue scenarios across four turn tiers. Its mitigation component, CompanionGuard, converts benchmark-exposed failures into turn-localized supervision for companion-specific risk detection. Our results show that even strong LLMs and existing guard models remain vulnerable to companion-specific relational harms, while both closed- and open-source models exhibit increasing safety risks as interactions become longer. Together, CompanionEval and CompanionGuard form a practical evaluation-to-mitigation loop for AI companion safety, turning relational safety failures exposed during multi-turn interaction into supervision for companion-specific guardrails.
comment: 40 pages, 33 figures, Code and dataset are available at this https URL
title_cn: CompanionSafe：从多轮安全评估到 AI 伴侣的护栏
abstract_cn: AI 伴侣为用户提供情感支持与持续陪伴，但其持续的关系型交互也引入独特安全风险。先前工作大多针对一般危害或特定伴侣平台与风险类别，并依赖人工收集的对话，限制了可扩展且以用户为基础的评估与缓解。为此我们提出 CompanionSafe，一个 AI 伴侣安全的统一评估-缓解框架。其评估组件 CompanionEval 通过从多样人格、匹配伴侣角色与对话场景跨四个轮次层级构建的 1300 个关系锚定设置，提供可扩展的多轮评估。其缓解组件 CompanionGuard 把基准暴露的失败转化为伴侣特定风险检测的轮次定位监督。结果显示，即使强 LLM 与现有护栏模型也对伴侣特定的关系型危害保持脆弱，且闭源与开源模型的互动越长安全风险越大。CompanionEval 与 CompanionGuard 共同构成 AI 伴侣安全的实用评估-缓解闭环，把多轮交互暴露的关系型安全失败转化为伴侣特定护栏的监督。
summary_cn: CompanionSafe：1300 个关系锚定多轮设置的伴侣安全基准 CompanionEval + 轮次定位护栏 CompanionGuard，显示交互越长风险越大、强模型亦脆弱。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖人格/角色/场景 × 四轮次层级的 1300 设置伴侣安全评估 CompanionEval，并训练轮次定位的伴侣风险护栏 CompanionGuard 形成评估-缓解闭环。
evidence_note: 1300 个多轮设置的系统评估、闭源/开源模型与护栏的对照、随轮次增长的风险量化与护栏训练闭环；代码数据公开。
novelty_note: 把伴侣安全从单点风险扩展为关系型多轮的统一评估-缓解框架是系统化贡献；单轮伴侣安全评估已有先行工作。
scope: 结论适用于情感陪伴类对话智能体；对具身/语音伴侣与真实用户长期部署未验证。
limitations: 设置由人格/角色合成，非真实用户对话；风险类别覆盖依赖taxonomy；护栏误报率未详。

title: Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference on Financial Transaction Graphs via Homomorphic Encryption
abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) in financial networks requires modeling transaction patterns that span multiple institutions. In practice, however, banks cannot share account and transaction features due to strict privacy regulations. We propose a privacy-preserving graph neural network (GNN) inference framework tailored to this multi-bank setting. A central server holds the graph connectivity and pretrained model weights in plaintext, while each bank keeps its transaction features encrypted. Inference is then carried out entirely on encrypted features under the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme, so that no plaintext transaction features or predictions are exposed to the server. The key to making this practical is an edge-centric GNN architecture, wherein message passing is expressed through operations on node--edge incidence matrices. This formulation not only preserves the edge-attributed multigraph structure of transaction networks but also reduces every aggregation step to plaintext--ciphertext matrix products. Since CKKS can evaluate only polynomial circuits, we also approximate each nonlinearity with a composite polynomial of the sign function, which we calibrate per activation site. On the IBM AML benchmark, our model achieves performance competitive with plaintext baselines, and with a consumer-grade GPU, classifies each queried transaction end-to-end in as little as \textbf{5.31} seconds, while per-transaction latency can be amortized to \textbf{1.65} seconds when optimized for throughput.
title_cn: 经同态加密的金融交易图隐私保护 GNN 推理
abstract_cn: 金融网络中的反洗钱（AML）需要建模跨机构的交易模式。但实践中银行因严格隐私法规无法共享账户与交易特征。我们提出面向多银行设置的隐私保护图神经网络（GNN）推理框架：中央服务器以明文持有图连接性与预训练模型权重，各银行保持其交易特征加密。推理随后完全在 CKKS 同态加密下对加密特征进行，不向服务器暴露明文交易特征或预测。使其实用的关键是边中心 GNN 架构：消息传递经节点-边关联矩阵上的运算表达。该表述不仅保留交易网络的边属性多重图结构，还把每步聚合归约为明文-密文矩阵乘。由于 CKKS 只能求值多项式电路，我们还以符号函数的复合多项式逼近每个非线性，并按激活位置校准。在 IBM AML 基准上，该模型取得与明文基线相当的性能，且用消费级 GPU 每次查询交易的端到端分类最快 5.31 秒，面向吞吐优化时每交易延迟可摊销到 1.65 秒。
summary_cn: CKKS 下的边中心 GNN 隐私推理（关联矩阵消息传递 + 符号多项式逼近）：IBM AML 基准性能接近明文，单笔 5.31 秒、吞吐优化后 1.65 秒。
objective_summary: 提出多银行设置下 CKKS 全加密特征的 GNN 推理框架，以关联矩阵表述消息传递并校准非线性逼近，在 IBM AML 基准上量化精度与延迟。
evidence_note: IBM AML 公开基准上的精度对比与延迟量化（5.31s/1.65s、消费级 GPU）；单基准、无统计检验与多图泛化。
novelty_note: 以边中心关联矩阵表述把 GNN 聚合归约为明文-密文矩阵乘是该方向的具体改进；CKKS 图推理已有先行工作。
scope: 结论适用于 CKKS 可表达的 GNN 推理与 AML 类任务；对训练期隐私、超大图与跨机构图划分策略未覆盖。
limitations: 非线性逼近引入精度损失；延迟仍限制实时场景；服务器见图拓扑（连接性明文）的信任假设。

title: Cost-Efficient Privacy Enforcement for Email-Generating LLM Agents under Strategic Information Requests
abstract: LLM agents now act as delegated communication intermediaries: they read private context, draft messages, and send externally visible emails on behalf of a user. Existing checker-repair defenses can reduce inappropriate disclosure, but they rely on repeated calls to a remote action LLM (the model that drafts and repairs the email) and a remote checker LLM whenever a draft fails validation. This creates a cost problem as well as a privacy problem, especially when a requester strategically asks for exact values, raw records, source evidence, or other details that induce leakage-heavy drafts. We propose local contract-conditioned rewriting as a cost-efficient enforcement layer for email-generating agents. The mechanism intercepts an outgoing draft, constructs an information-release contract that specifies what to preserve, generalize, and forbid, rewrites the draft with a local Gemma rewriter, and selectively invokes a final PrivacyChecker. Across extensive email tasks under normal prompts and attack prompts that operationalize strategic information requests, Gemma + Checker reduces normal-prompt leakage from 11.41% to 4.03% while improving UsableRate (satisfied or partially satisfied outputs) from 85.2% to 92.6%. Under the strategic attack-prompt condition, it reduces leakage from 28.19% to 18.79% and reduces checker-only cost amplification from 1.32x to 1.02x. Offline replay ablation shows that the full contract reduces leakage relative to generic Gemma rewriting by 36.3% under normal prompts and 54.1% under attack prompts. These results support a local-first privacy enforcement design: move repair to a cheaper trusted local layer when possible, but retain the checker as the final semantic gate for high-risk sends.
comment: 24 pages
title_cn: 面向邮件生成 LLM 智能体在策略性信息请求下的成本高效隐私强制
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体现在充当受托通信中介：读取私人上下文、起草消息并代表用户发送对外可见的邮件。现有检查-修复防御可减少不当披露，但每当草稿未过验证都要重复调用远程动作 LLM（起草并修复邮件的模型）与远程检查 LLM。当请求者策略性地索要精确值、原始记录、来源证据或其他诱发高泄露草稿的细节时，这既造成成本问题也造成隐私问题。我们提出本地契约条件改写，作为邮件生成智能体的成本高效强制层。该机制拦截外发草稿，构建指明保留、泛化与禁止内容的信息发布契约，用本地 Gemma 改写器重写草稿，并有选择地调用最终 PrivacyChecker。在正常提示与操作化策略性信息请求的攻击提示下的大量邮件任务中，Gemma + Checker 把正常提示泄露从 11.41% 降到 4.03%，同时把可用率（满足或部分满足的输出）从 85.2% 提到 92.6%。攻击提示条件下，泄露从 28.19% 降到 18.79%，检查器-only 的成本放大从 1.32× 降到 1.02×。离线重放消融显示完整契约相对通用 Gemma 改写在正常提示下减泄露 36.3%、攻击提示下减 54.1%。这些结果支持本地优先的隐私强制设计：尽可能把修复移到更便宜的可信本地层，但保留检查器作为高风险发送的最终语义门。
summary_cn: 本地契约条件改写 + 选择性隐私检查：正常提示泄露 11.41%→4.03%、可用率升至 92.6%，攻击提示 28.19%→18.79%，成本放大 1.32×→1.02×。
objective_summary: 提出拦截外发邮件、按信息发布契约本地改写并选择性调用远程检查的成本高效隐私强制层，在正常与策略性攻击提示下量化泄露、可用率与成本。
evidence_note: 正常/攻击双条件的大规模邮件任务、离线重放消融与成本量化（1.32×→1.02×）；自建任务与泄露判定标准，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 以本地改写前置、远程检查兜底的分层强制降本是检查-修复范式的实用改进；针对策略性索取细节的攻击条件刻画有价值。
scope: 结论适用于邮件域的委托通信智能体；对其他输出域、多语言与模型更新后的稳定性未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击提示下仍有 18.79% 泄露；本地模型能力上限影响改写质量；泄露度量依赖自建金标准。

title: Standing, Not Truth: Who May Say What About Whom in Agentic Selection
abstract: Software agents increasingly choose on a user's behalf among competing offerings described by the parties who benefit. A lawful participant, publishing under its own identity, compromising no channel and issuing no instruction, can move that choice with a single false factual claim about a competing offering. Across twelve published defenses spanning the three placements a check can occupy, none separates it from marketing. Each accepts it for a reason correct on its own: its origin is a lawful channel, its influence is evidence meant to decide, its action serves the user's goal. None establishes that the publisher was entitled to speak about a competitor, each exclusion stated by the defenses' own authors. Disclosure does not replace enforcement: re-rendering every description as attributed speech leaves the attack at 72/72, the agent repeating the attribution and reasoning from it. The missing relation is standing: whether a claimant's bound identity entitles it to assert about a claim's subject. A publisher may say what its own package does. It has no standing to say a competitor's package is frozen, and the difference is decidable without settling whether either is true. Deciding it needs the one fact prose extraction does not recover, who spoke, which a catalogue binds to every entry and then drops. The check is quiet on honest traffic, flagging 0.9% of natural pairs in two corpora. Used as a gate it stops 130 of 131 landed attacks and disturbs none of 348 honest selections. Applied everywhere it changes 0.9% and 2.6%, where deleting the whole description changes 12.7% and 21.0%. On thirteen further agents the attack succeeds on 50.7% of decisions and sentence removal leaves 10.3% standing. Two published attacks stay outside: self-directed claims, which standing admits, and injected criteria, with no subject in the set.
title_cn: 资格而非真值：智能体选择中谁可以对谁说什么
abstract_cn: 软件智能体日益代表用户在由受益方描述的竞争性提供之间做选择。一个合法参与者、以自己的身份发布、不攻破任何信道也不发出任何指令，可以通过关于竞争提供的一条虚假事实声明移动该选择。跨检查可以占据的三个位置的十二个已发表防御，没有一个把它与营销区分开。每个防御都基于各自正确的理由接受它：其来源是合法信道、其影响是旨在决策的证据、其动作服务于用户目标。没有一个确立发布者是否有权谈论竞争者——每个防御的作者自己陈述了每个排除理由。披露不替代强制：把每条描述重新渲染为带署名的言语，攻击仍是 72/72，智能体重复署名并据以推理。缺失的关系是资格（standing）：声明者的绑定身份是否使其有权就声明的主题发声。发布者可以说自己的包做什么，但无权说竞争者的包被冻结——这一差异无需判定谁真谁假即可决策。决策需要散文抽取无法恢复的唯一事实：谁在说话，而目录把它绑定到每个条目随后又丢弃。该检查在诚实流量上安静，在两个语料中仅标记 0.9% 的自然配对。用作门时它阻止 131 次落地攻击中的 130 次且不干扰 348 次诚实选择中的任何一次。全面应用时改变 0.9% 与 2.6%，而删除整个描述改变 12.7% 与 21.0%。在十三个其他智能体上，攻击在 50.7% 的决策上成功，删除句子后仍有 10.3% 存留。两个已发表攻击在其外：自指声明（资格允许）与注入判据（集合中无主题）。
summary_cn: 提出「资格」关系判定竞争声明权：门检查阻止 131 次落地攻击中 130 次且零干扰诚实选择（348 次），流量改变仅 0.9–2.6%（删描述则 12.7–21.0%）。
objective_summary: 识别智能体代购/选择场景中「虚假事实声明抹黑竞争者」的攻击，提出以「发言资格」而非真值判定为核心的门检查并大规模量化攻防效果与流量影响。
evidence_note: 12 个已发表防御的系统分析、131 攻击/348 诚实选择的门评估、13 个其他智能体的跨agent验证与两语料的误报量化（0.9%）。
novelty_note: 确立「资格（谁有权谈论谁）」为智能体选择安全的缺失授权关系，且可在不判定真值的情况下决策，是新问题与新机制的实质结合。
scope: 结论适用于有目录/条目结构的智能体选择场景；对无目录的开放网页比较与自指声明（资格允许）不设防。
limitations: 依赖目录绑定发言者身份；注入判据型攻击在范围之外；资格规则需随生态演化维护。

title: Provenance and Authorization in Autobiographical Language Models
abstract: Autobiographical language models may draw on archives containing observations, quotations, emotional reports, and earlier model outputs. Cryptographic authentication can preserve an archive while leaving these sources semantically conflated. We formulate this gap as a computer-security problem: narrative content must not silently become consent or alter an authorized decision rule. We define typed records, authenticated attestations, a separate policy channel, and admissible views. Under explicit assumptions, we give a standard integrity reduction and a noninterference argument, characterize the information required by exact decision-preserving summaries, and show why passive history and fixed-point convergence need not identify a preferred action. Alpay Algebra supplies a comparative language for iterative memory without being a premise of the proofs. Sociology of religious affiliation, source-monitoring psychology, and self-determination theory motivate distinctions in a bounded Latter-day Saint vignette. A separate, reproducible pilot uses a frozen public language model on 32 wholly synthetic cases across 576 paired conditions. It compares flattened records, source labels, and an explicit admission gate under contradictory summary repetition. The study concerns computational attribution and authorization, not the motives or psychology of the people in the vignette.
comment: 19 pages, 1 table, 0 figures in the manuscript. Includes appendices. Reproducibility code, synthetic data, recorded model outputs, and supplementary plots are provided as ancillary files
title_cn: 自传式语言模型中的来源与授权
abstract_cn: 自传式语言模型可能利用包含观察、引用、情感报告与更早模型输出的档案。密码学认证可以保全档案，却让这些来源在语义上被混同。我们把这一缺口形式化为计算机安全问题：叙述性内容不得悄然成为同意或改变已授权的决策规则。我们定义类型化记录、经认证的证明、分离的策略信道与可采纳视图。在显式假设下，我们给出标准完整性归约与非干扰论证，刻画精确决策保持摘要所需的信息，并说明为何被动历史与不动点收敛不必识别首选动作。Alpay Algebra 为迭代记忆提供比较语言，但不是证明的前提。宗教归属社会学、来源监控心理学与自我决定理论激发了一个受限 Latter-day Saint 小插曲中的区分。一个独立、可复现的试点使用冻结的公开语言模型，在 576 个配对条件下的 32 个全合成案例上，比较扁平记录、来源标签与显式准入门在矛盾摘要重复下的表现。该研究关注计算归因与授权，而非插曲中人物的动机或心理。
summary_cn: 为自传式 LM 档案形式化类型化记录、认证证明、策略信道与可采纳视图，给出完整性归约与非干扰论证，配 32 案例 × 576 条件的合成试点。
objective_summary: 把自传式语言模型档案中的来源混同形式化为安全问题，定义类型化记录与授权机制并给出完整性/非干扰性质与小型合成试点。
evidence_note: 形式化定义与论证加 32 个全合成案例的试点；无真实数据或部署验证，试点规模小。
novelty_note: 把来源/授权形式化引入「模型叙述自身历史」这一新场景并刻画决策保持摘要的信息需求，问题设定新；机制为经典概念的组合。
scope: 结论限于其形式化假设下的档案-决策架构；对开放式生成与对抗性档案投毒未覆盖。
limitations: 试点全合成且规模小；策略信道的现实治理未讨论；与真实记忆机制的关联是概念性的。

title: The Maximum Nonlinearity of 8-variable Balanced Boolean Functions is 116
abstract: Does there exist an 8-variable balanced Boolean function with nonlinearity 118? This is a famous and long-standing open problem in Boolean functions. In this paper, we give a negative answer to this open problem, and prove that the maximum nonlinearity of balanced Boolean functions in 8 variables is 116, establishing the 8-variable instance of Dobbertin's conjectured recursion for the minimum Walsh peak of balanced functions. Equivalently, the covering radius of the Reed--Muller code RM(1,8) in 0-resilient Boolean functions is 116. We deduce the result by obtaining a quadratic form of polar rank 6, and reducing the problem to the existence of a 6-variable Boolean function with nonlinearity greater than 26 whose Hamming distance to a bent function is between 4 and 6.
title_cn: 8 元平衡布尔函数的最大非线性度为 116
abstract_cn: 是否存在非线性度 118 的 8 元平衡布尔函数？这是布尔函数中著名且长期悬而未决的公开问题。本文对该问题给出否定回答，证明 8 元平衡布尔函数的最大非线性度为 116，确立 Dobbertin 关于平衡函数最小 Walsh 峰值递推猜想的 8 元实例。等价地，Reed–Muller 码 RM(1,8) 在 0-弹性布尔函数中的覆盖半径为 116。我们通过获得极化秩为 6 的二次型，并把问题归约为「6 元布尔函数与 bent 函数的汉明距离在 4 到 6 之间且非线性度大于 26」的存在性问题来推导该结果。
summary_cn: 解决长期公开问题：证明 8 元平衡布尔函数最大非线性度为 116（不存在 118），确立 Dobbertin 猜想的 8 元情形与 RM(1,8) 覆盖半径。
objective_summary: 通过极化秩 6 的二次型构造与归约，证明 8 元平衡布尔函数最大非线性度为 116，否定非线性度 118 的存在性。
evidence_note: 解决长期悬置的公开问题（Dobbertin 猜想 8 元情形），证明路线清晰（构造+归约），属达到紧界的理论工作。
novelty_note: 终结布尔函数领域著名开放问题，对序列密码设计空间与弹性函数覆盖半径有直接理论意义。
scope: 结论限于 8 元平衡布尔函数与 RM(1,8) 的 0-弹性类；更高元数的对应问题仍开放。
limitations: 证明依赖有限情形的计算辅助构造；对 9 元及以上无直接推广路径。

title: ProtoArena: Can AI Agents Discover and Exploit Real-World Cross-Component Protocol Vulnerabilities?
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for vulnerability analysis, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of exploitation that depends on interactions among network protocol components. Such vulnerabilities arise from inconsistencies in message interpretation, timing, state, or trust assumptions across participants. We introduce ProtoArena, a black-box, multi-component, dynamic benchmark with 80 cross-component vulnerability-exploitation environments spanning 11 protocol and application domains and 7 attack categories. Tasks are primarily informed by published protocol-attack mechanisms. Agents interact with running systems through scoped interfaces to achieve security-effect objectives without target source code. Three information levels assess guided reproduction, exploitation with mechanism and topology context, and effect-directed black-box exploration. A hybrid verifier combines rule-based checks with LLM review of independently collected traffic and logs. We evaluate five LLMs. Claude Opus 4.8 achieves the highest observed success rates: 48.8% under L1 guidance and 12.5% under effect-directed black-box L3. In a separate DNSBomb optimization experiment, it achieves a peak downstream-response to average query-input byte-rate ratio exceeding 171,000 times. The results show that agents can achieve verifiable exploitation effects in some cross-component environments, but success with limited black-box information remains low and varies across domains and attack categories. All experiments use controlled, explicitly authorized targets; they do not test production systems or disclose previously unknown vulnerabilities.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: ProtoArena：AI 智能体能发现并利用真实世界跨组件协议漏洞吗？
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益用于漏洞分析，但现有基准对依赖网络协议组件间交互的利用覆盖有限。此类漏洞源于参与者在消息解释、时序、状态或信任假设上的不一致。我们提出 ProtoArena，一个黑盒、多组件、动态基准，含 80 个跨组件漏洞利用环境，覆盖 11 个协议与应用域、7 个攻击类别。任务主要由已发表的协议攻击机制启发。智能体经受限接口与运行中系统交互，在不接触目标源码的情况下达成安全效果目标。三个信息级别分别评估引导式复现、带机制与拓扑上下文的利用，以及效果导向的黑盒探索。混合验证器结合基于规则的检查与对独立采集流量和日志的 LLM 审查。我们评估五个 LLM：Claude Opus 4.8 取得最高观测成功率——L1 引导下 48.8%，效果导向黑盒 L3 下 12.5%。在独立的 DNSBomb 优化实验中，其下游响应与平均查询输入的字节率比峰值超过 171,000 倍。结果表明智能体能在部分跨组件环境达成可验证的利用效果，但有限黑盒信息下的成功率仍低且随域与攻击类别变化。所有实验使用受控、明确授权的目标；不测试生产系统也不披露先前未知漏洞。
summary_cn: ProtoArena：80 个跨组件协议利用环境的黑盒基准，最佳模型引导下 48.8%、效果导向黑盒仅 12.5%，揭示协议交互利用仍是难题。
objective_summary: 构建评估智能体跨组件协议漏洞利用能力的动态黑盒基准 ProtoArena，以三信息级别与混合验证器量化五个 LLM 的复现与效果导向成功率。
evidence_note: 80 环境 × 11 域 × 7 攻击类别、五模型、混合验证器与授权受控目标，成功率分层量化（48.8%/12.5%）。
novelty_note: 首个聚焦「跨组件交互依赖」协议利用的智能体动态基准，补上现有静态/CVE 型基准的空白。
scope: 结论限于基准内授权环境与五模型；对多智能体协作利用与零日发现不适用。
limitations: 环境由已知攻击机制构造；混合验证器的 LLM 审查可能引入判定偏置；单机网络拓扑。

title: Same Attack, Different Judge: A First Controlled Adversarial Comparison of Jev, LLM Judges, and Purpose-Built Safety Classifiers
abstract: TypeSafe AI's Jev is a new kind of safety judge. It generates no text and no label: it answers questions the developer defines in advance and returns a probability for each answer. The vendor admits that adversarial input can change these answers but gives no numbers. In this paper, we present the first controlled adversarial evaluation of Jev. We build a test harness that sends every system the same payload under the same policy, and run it on four public-data tasks, from rule-based ones (input moderation, injection detection, routing) to a judgment-based one (phishing detection), with fifty attack variants from thirteen families. The targets are Jev, five GPT and GLM judges, and two local classifiers (Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard 2). We find that Jev is the most robust system on input moderation: eight forgeries of its structured input bypass none of its decisions, and a sentence asking only why someone might make a harmful request bypasses 9% of its blocks, against 56% for GPT-6 Astra. On phishing detection. However, the same forgeries bypass 19-29% of the emails it flags, and even without attack Jev detects only 62% of phishing emails, against 77-81% for the GLM judges. Jev is also the fastest judge, but it flags the most benign requests (27%). The local classifiers fail differently: a training-example statement makes Llama Guard 3 miss 62% of the phishing it had flagged. These results suggest that Jev resists attacks on tasks with a clear rule to check but is more exposed on tasks that call for an overall judgment.
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures
title_cn: 同一攻击，不同判官：Jev、LLM 裁判与专用安全分类器的首次受控对抗比较
abstract_cn: TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 是一种新型安全判官：它不生成文本也不生成标签，而是回答开发者预先定义的问题并为每个答案返回概率。厂商承认对抗输入可改变这些答案但未给出数字。本文对 Jev 进行首次受控对抗评估。我们构建向每个系统在相同策略下发送相同载荷的测试装置，在四个公共数据任务上运行——从规则型（输入审核、注入检测、路由）到判断型（钓鱼检测）——使用来自十三个家族的五十个攻击变体。目标是 Jev、五个 GPT 与 GLM 裁判以及两个本地分类器（Llama Guard 3、Prompt Guard 2）。我们发现 Jev 在输入审核上最鲁棒：其结构化输入的八个伪造绕过为零，一句只询问「为什么有人可能提出有害请求」的话绕过其 9% 的拦截，而 GPT-6 Astra 为 56%。在钓鱼检测上，同样的伪造绕过其标记邮件的 19–29%，且无攻击时 Jev 只检出 62% 的钓鱼邮件，GLM 裁判为 77–81%。Jev 也是最快的判官，但标记最多良性请求（27%）。本地分类器以不同方式失败：一条训练样本陈述使 Llama Guard 3 漏掉其已标记钓鱼的 62%。结果表明 Jev 在有明确规则可查的任务上抗攻击，但在需要整体判断的任务上更暴露。
summary_cn: 首个 Jev 受控对抗评估：输入审核上 8 个伪造零绕过（GPT-6 Astra 56%），钓鱼检测仅 62% 检出且 19–29% 被绕过，误标良性最多（27%）。
objective_summary: 构建同载荷同策略的受控测试装置，对 Jev、八个 LLM 裁判/本地分类器在四任务 × 50 攻击变体上量化绕过率、检出率与误报。
evidence_note: 受控测试装置、13 家族 50 变体 × 8 系统的系统量化（绕过 0–56%、检出 62–81%、误报 27%），任务谱系覆盖规则型与判断型。
novelty_note: 对 System One 判官范式的首个受控对抗刻画，揭示「规则型稳、判断型弱」的结构性结论，评估价值高；无新攻防机制。
scope: 结论适用于被测八系统与四任务设定；Jev 为特定厂商产品，版本演化会改变结论。
limitations: 攻击变体为文本类；未覆盖自适应白盒攻击；钓鱼集分布影响检出率可比性。

title: SkillScreen: High-Recall Screening of Malicious Agent Skills with Decision Models
abstract: Agent skills turn natural-language instructions into actions, creating a security challenge: legitimate automation and malicious behaviour can look deceptively similar. A practical screen must catch nearly every attack while keeping the review load manageable. We present SkillScreen, a compact decision model trained to score skill maliciousness directly from SKILL.md in a single forward pass. On MaliciousSkillBench, SkillScreen flags 20-25% of benign skills at 99% recall on unseen attack families, substantially fewer than the word-level classifier and prompted LLM judges tested. Under the same training protocol, it also generalizes better than a fully fine-tuned encoder to unseen sources. Yet unfamiliar benign sources sharply increase false positives, showing that recognizing new attacks does not ensure reliable screening of new skill collections. Our results demonstrate the value of task-trained decision models for high-recall skill screening. Project page: https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/
comment: 21 pages, including references and appendices
title_cn: SkillScreen：用决策模型对恶意智能体技能做高召回筛查
abstract_cn: 智能体技能把自然语言指令变成动作，带来安全挑战：合法自动化与恶意行为可能看起来惊人地相似。实用筛查必须在审查负载可管理的前提下捕获几乎每一个攻击。我们提出 SkillScreen，一个经训练直接从 SKILL.md 单次前向为技能恶意性打分的紧凑决策模型。在 MaliciousSkillBench 上，SkillScreen 在未攻击家族 99% 召回下仅标记 20–25% 的良性技能，显著少于受测的词级分类器与提示 LLM 裁判。同一训练协议下，它对未见来源的泛化也优于全量微调编码器。然而不熟悉的良性来源会急剧增加误报，表明识别新攻击并不能保证对新技能集合的可靠筛查。结果展示了任务训练决策模型对高召回技能筛查的价值。
summary_cn: SkillScreen：从 SKILL.md 单前向打分的紧凑决策模型，未见攻击家族 99% 召回下仅误标 20–25% 良性技能，优于词分类器与 LLM 裁判。
objective_summary: 训练从技能描述单次前向打分的紧凑决策模型 SkillScreen，在 MaliciousSkillBench 上以 99% 召回量化误报率并与词分类器、LLM 裁判、微调编码器对比。
evidence_note: MaliciousSkillBench 上含未见攻击家族与未见来源的泛化对比、三类基线比较；基准规模与统计细节未披露。
novelty_note: 以任务训练的紧凑决策模型替代提示裁判做高召回筛查是实用的路线选择；配合恶意技能攻击研究（同日 MetaCascade 等）形成攻防互补。
scope: 结论适用于 SKILL.md 形态技能的初筛；不熟悉来源的误报上升限制其在新技能集合上的直接部署。
limitations: 未见良性来源误报显著升高；筛查仅为人工审核的前置；对多文件技能包未覆盖。

title: Beyond Model Scaling: Rethinking Sequence Construction for Transformer-based Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: Transformer-based network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) have shown strong potential for detecting multi-stage cyberattacks, yet most methods construct input sequences using fixed temporalization schemes rather than treating sequence construction as a systems design decision. In flow-based intrusion detection, timestamp-based windowing often fragments related attack activities while merging unrelated communications, reducing the behavioral context available to transformers. We present a unified pipeline abstraction that decomposes transformer-based NIDS into four design dimensions (traffic representation, temporalization, transformer backbone, and prediction aggregation) and propose session-coherent temporalization, which constructs sequences from communication sessions instead of fixed time windows. Experiments on three complementary intrusion detection datasets show that temporalization is the dominant factor governing transformer performance: session-coherent temporalization more than doubles Macro-F1 over timestamp-based windowing, enabling lightweight transformers to achieve up to 0.95 Macro-F1 at substantially higher inference throughput than pretrained models. We further vary the transformer size from 0.65M to 3.38M parameters and find that larger transformer models provide no measurable accuracy improvement despite substantially higher computational cost, while zero-shot cross-dataset evaluation shows only modest gains under domain shift. These results indicate that preserving communication-session semantics, rather than scaling transformer capacity, is the key to accurate and efficient transformer-based intrusion detection.
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Reproducibility artifact: this https URL
title_cn: 超越模型缩放：重新思考基于 Transformer 的网络入侵检测的序列构造
abstract_cn: 基于 Transformer 的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在检测多阶段攻击上展现了强大潜力，但多数方法用固定时间化方案构造输入序列，而非把序列构造当作系统设计决策。在流式入侵检测中，基于时间戳的窗口常割裂相关攻击活动却合并无关通信，减少 Transformer 可用的行为上下文。我们提出统一管线抽象，把基于 Transformer 的 NIDS 分解为四个设计维度（流量表示、时间化、Transformer 骨干与预测聚合），并提出会话连贯时间化：从通信会话而非固定时间窗构造序列。在三个互补入侵检测数据集上的实验表明，时间化是决定 Transformer 性能的主导因素：会话连贯时间化使 Macro-F1 较时间戳窗口翻倍以上，让轻量 Transformer 以远高于预训练模型的推理吞吐达到最高 0.95 Macro-F1。我们进一步把 Transformer 规模从 0.65M 变到 3.38M 参数，发现更大模型在计算成本大幅上升下无可测的精度提升，而零样本跨数据集评估在域移下仅有适度收益。结果表明，保持通信会话语义而非扩展 Transformer 容量，才是准确高效 Transformer 入侵检测的关键。可复现工件见链接。
summary_cn: 发现时间化是 Transformer NIDS 性能主导因素：会话连贯时间化使 Macro-F1 翻倍至 0.95，而参数从 0.65M 扩到 3.38M 无精度收益。
objective_summary: 以四维设计空间抽象系统评估 Transformer NIDS，提出会话连贯时间化并用三数据集、参数扫描与零样本迁移量化各因素贡献。
evidence_note: 三个数据集上的系统维度消融、参数规模扫描（0.65M–3.38M）与零样本跨数据集评估，结论量化明确，可复现工件公开。
novelty_note: 把「序列构造/时间化」确立为 NIDS Transformer 的主导设计因素并给出会话连贯方案，是对该方向的实证修正；单项技术均为已有组件。
scope: 结论适用于流式网络入侵检测与所测三个数据集；主机日志、加密流量特征受限场景需重验。
limitations: 仅三个公开数据集；会话切分依赖流量元数据；对对抗性流量操纵的鲁棒性未测。

title: Local Leakage Resilience of Shamir Secret Sharing: Below Half Threshold Rate
abstract: We study the local leakage resilience of Shamir secret sharing, where an adversary leaks a bounded number of bits from every share. For $n$ parties and reconstruction threshold $k$ over a prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$ with $p>n$, we prove the following. (1) There is an absolute constant $c_{\mathrm{bh}}<1/2$ such that, for $k\ge c_{\mathrm{bh}}n$, Shamir sharing is resilient to arbitrary one-bit leakage from every share. The best previous threshold was $0.668n$. (2) For every fixed $0<\delta<1/2$ and $k\ge(1/2+\delta)n$, Shamir sharing is resilient to $\left\lfloor\frac{\delta}{24}\log_2 n\right\rfloor$ bits of arbitrary local leakage per share. By a recent attack, this number of bits is optimal up to a constant factor depending on $\delta$. (3) For every fixed threshold rate $c>0$ and $k\ge cn$, Shamir sharing is resilient to quadratic-residue leakage and to almost all local leakage functions of up to $\eta_c\log_2 p$ bits, for a constant $\eta_c>0$. All three results follow from one analytic framework, which we develop for generalized Reed--Solomon codes: local leakage from a uniform codeword is statistically close to the same leakage from independent uniform field elements. The framework expresses the leakage distance as the norm of a function on the leakage outputs. The Efron--Stein decomposition splits this function into orthogonal components indexed by supports of dual codewords. Two tools bound the components: list recovery of the dual code, which is ordinary list decoding for one-bit leakage, and a generalized von Neumann inequality for MDS systems of linear forms that retains linearly many Gowers norms. The first tool gives the result above half, the second gives the constant-rate result, and applying both to different ranges of supports in the same decomposition gives the result below half.
title_cn: Shamir 秘密共享的局部泄露韧性：低于半门限比率
abstract_cn: 我们研究 Shamir 秘密共享的局部泄露韧性：对手从每份份额泄露有界数量的比特。对 n 方与素域 F_p（p>n）上的重构门限 k，我们证明：(1) 存在绝对常数 c_bh<1/2，使 k≥c_bh·n 时 Shamir 共享对每份份额的任意一比特泄露韧性。此前最佳门限为 0.668n。(2) 对每个固定 0<δ<1/2 与 k≥(1/2+δ)n，Shamir 共享对每份份额 ⌊(δ/24)·log₂n⌋ 比特的任意局部泄露韧性；由近期攻击，该比特数在依赖 δ 的常数因子内最优。(3) 对每个固定门限比率 c>0 与 k≥cn，Shamir 共享对二次剩余泄露及多达 η_c·log₂p 比特的几乎所有局部泄露函数韧性。三个结果源自我们为广义 Reed–Solomon 码开发的一个解析框架：均匀码字的局部泄露在统计上接近独立均匀域元素的相同泄露。框架把泄露距离表示为泄露输出上函数的范数，用 Efron–Stein 分解把该函数拆为以对偶码字支撑为索引的正交分量，并用两个工具界定各分量：对偶码的列表恢复（一比特泄露时即普通列表解码）与保留线性多个 Gowers 范数的 MDS 线性型广义 von Neumann 不等式。第一工具给出高于一半的结果，第二给出常数比率结果，二者在同一分解的不同支撑范围上应用给出低于一半的结果。
summary_cn: 证明 Shamir 共享局部泄露韧性门限从 0.668n 降至 <n/2，k≥(1/2+δ)n 时可容 δ/24·log₂n 比特泄露（近最优），统一框架基于 RS 码 + 列表恢复 + Gowers 范数。
objective_summary: 以广义 Reed–Solomon 码的解析框架（列表恢复 + 广义 von Neumann 不等式）证明 Shamir 秘密共享在低于半门限比率下的局部泄露韧性并给出近最优泄露预算。
evidence_note: 把已知最佳门限 0.668n 改进到 c<1/2，多比特预算经近期攻击证明近最优，三个结果出自统一解析框架；证明完整性强。
novelty_note: 局部泄露韧性门限的实质改进（跨过 1/2 心理线）与近最优性论证是该方向的显著理论推进。
scope: 结论限于素域上 MDS（Reed–Solomon）型 Shamir 共享与逐份额有界泄露模型；对一般线性秘密共享方案未覆盖。
limitations: 常数未优化；对自适应泄露与联合泄露模型未讨论；渐近结果对中等 n 的实际影响有限。

title: Extending Layered Attestation into ARM Application Run-Times
abstract: Modern mobile and edge platforms provide hardware-backed attestation of application and platform integrity at load-time. However, they offer little support once application execution begins. We present ARA, an Application-Runtime Anchor for ARM that extends this load-time chain of trust into execution. ARA bootstraps from the underlying ARM platform Root of Trust (RoT) through a measured loading chain and establishes an attested protected run-time within the application address space using recently introduced ARM Permission Overlay Extensions (POE). The resulting run-time domain can host programmable RoTs for Measurement and Storage (RTM/RTS), enabling application run-time integrity verification, attestation evidence generation, and protected use of secrets while retaining efficient access to application run-time state. As exemplary uses, we instantiate ARA for protected media decryption and application control flow measurement. Our prototype and evaluation show that ARA supports frequent run-time RoT-backed operations at near in-process cost, with roughly 10x and 50x lower overhead than out-of-process equivalents. This offers a practical bridge from layered attestation to application run-time trusted computing on ARM.
title_cn: 把分层证明扩展到 ARM 应用运行时
abstract_cn: 现代移动与边缘平台在加载时提供应用与平台完整性的硬件背书证明，但应用开始执行后几乎不提供支持。我们提出 ARA（Application-Runtime Anchor），把底层 ARM 平台信任根（RoT）经测量加载链延伸到执行期：ARA 从平台信任根引导，利用新近引入的 ARM Permission Overlay Extensions（POE）在应用地址空间内建立经证明的受保护运行时。所得运行时域可承载可编程的测量与存储信任根（RTM/RTS），支持应用运行时完整性验证、证明证据生成与秘密的受保护使用，同时保持对应用运行时状态的高效访问。作为示例用途，我们为受保护媒体解密与应用控制流测量实例化 ARA。原型与评估显示 ARA 以接近进程内成本支持频繁的运行时信任根操作，开销较进程外等价物低约 10 倍与 50 倍。这为分层证明到 ARM 应用运行时可信计算的桥接提供了实用路径。
summary_cn: ARA：利用 ARM POE 在应用地址空间内建立可证明受保护运行时，承载 RTM/RTS 支持运行时完整性与秘密保护，开销较进程外低 10–50 倍。
objective_summary: 提出基于 ARM POE 的应用运行时证明锚 ARA，在应用地址空间内构建承载可编程信任根的受保护域，并以媒体解密与控制流测量两个实例量化开销。
evidence_note: 真实 ARM 硬件原型与量化开销（较进程外低 10×/50×）、两个示例用途的运行验证；应用面与威胁场景覆盖有限。
novelty_note: 用 POE 把证明链从加载时延伸到运行时是硬件能力驱动的实质系统贡献；组成技术（测量链、TCB 分区）为已有范式。
scope: 结论适用于支持 POE 的 ARM 平台；对更早硬件与非 ARM 生态、以及对抗具有内核权限对手的保证边界未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖新式 ARM 扩展的可用性；受保护域与 OS 的交互面仍需审计；对侧信道的防护未讨论。

title: Discovery or Memorization? A Faithful Benchmark for Real-World Business-Logic Vulnerability Discovery
abstract: The rapid advancement of cybersecurity agents in vulnerability discovery has increased the need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities accurately. However, synthetic benchmarks lack realism, real-life benchmarks are prone to contamination, and many existing benchmarks have already been saturated by current models. We therefore set out to develop a benchmark that is realistic, reproducible, resistant to contamination, and challenging. Our key insight is that real-life business-logic vulnerabilities are subtle and exercise complex application interactions, making them naturally demanding. The difficulty lies in specifying evaluation criteria precise enough to faithfully measure model capabilities while keeping the tasks free of data-leakage. We introduce AnonVul, a cross-language benchmark of 132 application-level business-logic vulnerabilities, built by a semi-automated pipeline that anonymizes each task, injects oracles from expert-written specifications, and differentially verifies proof-of-concept exploits. The benchmark spans nine languages, with two evaluation tracks on black-box and grey-box settings, where each task runs in a sandbox with specialized oracles embedded in key exploitation steps. We evaluate six state-of-the-art vulnerability-discovery agents on the AnonVul benchmark, measuring discovery success, cost-effectiveness, anonymization sensitivity, oracle validity, and failure modes. Our results show that AnonVul remains challenging, with the best agent succeeding in only 23.11% of attempts. On a matched cohort of 20 vulnerabilities, restoring software identity increases discovery from 21.25% to 40.83%, highlighting the importance of controlling recognizable software knowledge when evaluating vulnerability discovery.

title_cn: 发现还是记忆？真实世界业务逻辑漏洞发现的忠实基准
abstract_cn: 网络安全智能体在漏洞发现上的快速进步增加了对准确评估其能力基准的需求。然而合成基准缺乏真实性，真实基准易受污染，且许多现有基准已被当前模型饱和。因此我们着手开发一个真实、可复现、抗污染且具挑战性的基准。关键洞见是：真实业务逻辑漏洞微妙且涉及复杂应用交互，天然高要求。难点在于使评估标准精确到能忠实测量模型能力，同时保持任务无数据泄漏。我们提出 AnonVul，一个跨语言基准，含 132 个应用级业务逻辑漏洞，由半自动管线构建：对每个任务匿名化、注入专家撰写规格中的预言机，并对概念验证利用做差分验证。基准覆盖九种语言，含黑盒与灰盒两条评估轨道，每个任务在沙箱中运行、关键利用步骤嵌入专用预言机。我们在 AnonVul 上评估六个最先进漏洞发现智能体，测量发现成功率、成本效益、匿名化敏感性、预言机有效性与失败模式。结果表明 AnonVul 仍有挑战性：最佳智能体仅 23.11% 尝试成功。在 20 个漏洞的匹配队列上，恢复软件身份使发现率从 21.25% 升至 40.83%，凸显在评估漏洞发现时控制可识别软件知识的重要性。
summary_cn: AnonVul：132 个真实业务逻辑漏洞的匿名化跨语言基准（9 语言、双轨道），最佳智能体仅 23.11%；恢复软件身份使成功率 21.25%→40.83%，量化记忆化效应。

evidence_note: 132 漏洞 × 9 语言、沙箱预言机、差分验证、匿名化敏感性实验（21.25%→40.83%）与六智能体系统评估；方法学完整。
