title_cn: 名字不是对象：面向已失陷 AI 编码智能体的对象绑定约束
abstract_cn: 编码智能体读取任何人都可写入的仓库与网页，然后以用户权限行事。提示注入防御降低模型被操纵的可能性但不阻止它，因此模型周围的系统必须能约束一个已经失陷的智能体。许多针对已部署编码智能体的攻击共享一个根因：某项检查批准了一个名字（路径、参数向量或目录），而后续步骤把该名字映射到另一个对象：符号链接背后的文件、某选项选择的行为，或 git 自行发现的仓库。我们提出零信任智能体单元（ZTAC）。单元在内核沙箱中运行智能体，其访问文件、程序与网络的唯一路径是通向一个代理（broker）的套接字。代理把每个请求解析到将要作用的对象、对该对象决策，并在使用时检查其作用对象确为已授权对象。代理启动的程序运行在由同一策略编译的沙箱中，批准绑定到被解析的对象且只能使用一次。我们的 macOS 原型有 3.2k 行可信 Rust 代码（不含依赖）。我们在 74 个带真实值预言机的攻击上评估，包括 10 起公开披露事件的复放。工具白名单丢失其中 66 个，白名单加部署智能体常用的命令沙箱丢失 56 个；ZTAC 仅丢失 2 个（都是把秘密编码进流向允许端点的流量），另有 14 个转人工审查。它完成 46 个良性操作中的 43 个（8 次审批提示）与 7 个工作流中的 4 个。无操作的代理请求中位延迟 4.0 毫秒，被测代理程序比无 ZTAC 时慢 8.5–18.4 毫秒。
summary_cn: ZTAC：内核沙箱加对象解析代理，把批准绑定到解析后的对象；74 个攻击（含 10 起真实事件复放）中仅失守 2 个，工具白名单失守 66 个，中位开销 4.0 毫秒。
objective_summary: 提出 ZTAC 架构：内核沙箱中运行智能体，全部文件/程序/网络访问经代理解析到具体对象、按对象决策并在使用时复核，批准单次有效；在 74 个带预言机攻击与良性任务上量化约束效果与开销。
evidence_note: 74 个攻击均配真实值预言机、含 10 起公开事件复放，与工具白名单及命令沙箱基线直接对比（失守 66/56 vs 2），并测良性完成率与毫秒级延迟。
novelty_note: 把已部署智能体攻击的共性归纳为「检查名字、作用对象」的错配，给出对象绑定、单次使用的参考监视器设计，是智能体约束方向的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于 macOS 原型上的编码/命令类智能体约束；分布式资源、图形界面操作与代理策略本身的漏洞未覆盖。
limitations: 仅 3.2k 行可信代码的原型，未覆盖所有访问路径；2 个失守攻击表明对流量外泄类通道需额外策略；4/7 工作流完成率显示兼容性代价。

title: What Counts as the Same Task? Executable Contracts for Robustness Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents
abstract: Robustness tests for tool-using agents often change the agent's environment, for example by hiding a hostile note in an invoice, and then judge the agent by what it does. The result tells us about the original task only if the changed test case is still a valid test of that task. Many evaluations decide this with weak rules, such as accepting any well-formed edit or any edit that stays close to the original in embedding space. We propose executable task contracts. A contract states which facts define a task, which edits are allowed, and what finishing the task means, and it checks each changed test case before the agent runs. We compare validity rules by scoring the same 14,336 stored agent runs under each rule. Across four encoders, embedding thresholds allowed 75-100% of edits that changed the task, such as swapping the payee, yet rejected 24-45% of valid hostile notes. With a MiniLM cosine threshold, Mistral appeared vulnerable on all 64 tasks, but only 26 had a successful valid attack. Replaying a saved solution and allowing edits to benchmark fields fail in similar ways. Evaluations should state, and check, what counts as the same task.
title_cn: 什么算同一个任务？面向工具使用智能体鲁棒性评估的可执行契约
abstract_cn: 对工具使用智能体的鲁棒性测试常常改变智能体的环境，例如在发票中藏一张恶意便条，然后按智能体的行为来评判。这种结果只在被修改的测试用例仍是该任务的有效测试时才说明原任务的问题。许多评估用弱规则决定这一点，例如接受任何格式良好的编辑或任何在嵌入空间中贴近原文的编辑。我们提出可执行任务契约。契约声明哪些事实定义一个任务、允许哪些编辑、以及完成任务意味着什么，并在智能体运行前检查每个被修改的测试用例。我们通过在相同 14,336 条已存智能体运行上按不同规则打分来比较有效性规则。跨四个编码器，嵌入阈值放行了 75–100% 改变任务的编辑（如调换收款人），却拒绝了 24–45% 的有效恶意便条。用 MiniLM 余弦阈值时，Mistral 在全部 64 个任务上看似可被攻击，但只有 26 个任务存在成功的有效攻击。重放已保存的解法、允许编辑基准字段等做法以类似方式失效。评估应当声明并检查「什么算同一个任务」。
summary_cn: 提出可执行任务契约校验鲁棒性测试有效性：嵌入阈值放行 75–100% 改变任务的编辑、拒绝 24–45% 有效攻击；14,336 条运行重评显示 Mistral 实际仅 26/64 任务受有效攻击。
objective_summary: 提出用可执行任务契约在测试运行前校验被修改用例仍测同一任务，并在 14,336 条已存智能体运行上量化嵌入阈值等弱规则放行无效编辑、拒绝有效攻击的程度。
evidence_note: 对 14,336 条已存运行按多规则统一重打分，跨四个编码器量化（75–100%、24–45%），并用 64 任务攻击案例对比表观与有效漏洞数；无统计检验说明。
novelty_note: 首次把「被修改测试是否仍测同一任务」形式化为智能体鲁棒性评估的有效性问题并给出可执行契约方案，直指现有基准的系统性偏差。
scope: 结论适用于以环境修改为手段的工具使用智能体鲁棒性评估；契约需人工声明任务事实，不解决任务定义本身的质量问题。
limitations: 契约需为每个任务手工编写；评估基于已存运行的重放而非新攻击；未覆盖任务事实难以形式化的开放场景。

title: SecReason: Vulnerability Detection and In-Stream Self-Repair for LLM Code Generation
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may introduce security vulnerabilities into generated code, which can persist into production when verification focuses on functional correctness. Existing defenses act before, during, or after generation, but none inspects the code during generation. Security prompts and retrieved security knowledge act before any code exists, constrained decoding limits token choices but cannot guide repair, and post-hoc repair must regenerate the full response. Reasoning LLMs draft code early in their streamed chain of thought, and in this pre-delivery window the code exists only inside the reasoning stream. We present SecReason, an in-stream defense that monitors this window. Dual-track incremental scanning applies security rules, checking each statement as it is emitted and tracing dataflows across the accumulated code. When a security rule fires, SecReason interrupts generation, inserts an in-stream warning, and resumes decoding, so the model repairs the draft within the same reasoning trace without regenerating the full response. On tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, \system raises the share of runs delivering secure and functionally correct code from below 15\% to 72.8\%--98.1\% on \tool{CWEval} and \tool{SecCodeBench}. \system consumes fewer tokens than post-hoc repair, and when security rules misfire on secure code, it limits the functional regressions from false warnings.
title_cn: SecReason：LLM 代码生成中的漏洞检测与流内自修复
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）可能在生成代码时引入安全漏洞，当验证只关注功能正确性时这些漏洞会存续到生产环境。现有防御作用于生成前、生成中或生成后，但没有在生成过程中检查代码。安全提示与检索安全知识在任何代码存在之前起作用，受限解码限制 token 选择但无法引导修复，事后修复必须重新生成完整响应。推理型 LLM 在流式思维链早期就起草代码，而在这一交付前窗口中，代码只存在于推理流内。我们提出 SecReason，一个监视该窗口的流内防御。双轨增量扫描应用安全规则，在每条语句被生成时进行检查并追踪累积代码上的数据流。当安全规则触发时，SecReason 中断生成、插入流内警告并恢复解码，使模型在同一推理轨迹内修复草稿而无需重新生成完整响应。在无辅助生成会引入漏洞的任务上，SecReason 把交付安全且功能正确代码的运行占比从 15% 以下提升到 CWEval 与 SecCodeBench 上的 72.8%–98.1%。SecReason 消耗的 token 少于事后修复，且当安全规则对安全代码误触发时，它限制了误警告造成的功能回退。
summary_cn: SecReason：在推理流内做增量漏洞扫描并触发流内警告自修复，把安全且正确代码占比从 <15% 提升到 CWEval/SecCodeBench 的 72.8%–98.1%。
objective_summary: 提出监视推理 LLM 流式思维链早期代码草稿的流内防御 SecReason，用双轨规则与数据流扫描在生成中触发警告并促使模型原位修复，无需重新生成完整响应。
evidence_note: 在 CWEval 与 SecCodeBench 两个基准上量化（<15% → 72.8%–98.1%），对比事后修复的 token 成本并分析误触发下的功能回退；无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次把漏洞检查放置到生成过程中的推理流内（交付前窗口），并实现中断-警告-原位修复机制，在防御时机上区别于生成前/后方法。
scope: 结论适用于暴露思维链、以规则可描述漏洞为目标的推理型代码生成；对不泄漏推理流的 API 与需要跨函数语义的漏洞覆盖有限。
limitations: 依赖安全规则的可描述性，误触发仍可能造成功能回退（虽有缓解）；评估限于两基准的函数级任务；对自适应规避规则扫描的攻击未评估。

title: DS and AMDS Symbol-Pair Codes from Three Families of Simple Root Cyclic Codes
abstract: Symbol-pair distances of simple-root cyclic codes are important for evaluating error correction performance under overlapping pair read channels. In this paper, we construct three families of simple-root cyclic codes over finite fields of odd characteristic via generator polynomials. For length \(2q+2\), the minimum symbol-pair distance is \(10\) for every odd prime power \(q\ge 7\), established by excluding invalid support configurations. For length \(4q-4\), when \(q\equiv 3\pmod 4\) and finite field constraints hold, it is \(9\) or \(10\). For length \(2(q-1)\), reciprocal-polynomial analysis shows it is \(11\) or \(12\). All obtained codes are MDS or AMDS symbol-pair codes.
title_cn: 来自三族单根循环码的 DS 与 AMDS 符号对码
abstract_cn: 单根循环码的符号对距离对评估重叠符号对读取信道下的纠错性能十分重要。本文通过生成多项式，在奇特征有限域上构造三族单根循环码。对长度 2q+2，对每个奇素数幂 q≥7，最小符号对距离为 10，其证明通过排除无效支撑配置建立。对长度 4q-4，当 q≡3 (mod 4) 且有限域约束满足时，该距离为 9 或 10。对长度 2(q-1)，倒数多项式分析表明其为 11 或 12。所有得到的码均为 MDS 或 AMDS 符号对码。
summary_cn: 构造三族奇特征有限域上的单根循环码，分别确定长度 2q+2、4q-4、2(q-1) 的最小符号对距离为 10、9 或 10、11 或 12，均为 MDS/AMDS 符号对码。
objective_summary: 通过生成多项式构造三族单根循环码并严格确定其最小符号对距离，证明所得码为 MDS 或 AMDS 符号对码。
evidence_note: 纯数学构造与证明（排除无效支撑配置、倒数多项式分析），证明完整性依赖正文；无实验，理论工作按证明完整性给 3。
novelty_note: 在单根循环码框架内给出三族新的符号对距离确定结果，扩展了 MDS/AMDS 符号对码的已知构造；属编码理论内的增量推进。
scope: 结论限于奇特征有限域与指定长度参数的符号对码；不涉及密码学安全性。
limitations: 部分距离为「9 或 10」「11 或 12」的区间结果而非精确值；应用价值限于符号对读取信道场景。

title: MemForm: Benchmarking Memory Formation Poisoning in LLM Agents
abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to learn from past interactions but exposes memory formation to adversarial influence. Existing studies primarily organize memory poisoning by attack channels, corruption patterns, or lifecycle stages, leaving formation interfaces insufficiently characterized. We formulate Memory Formation Poisoning as adversarial manipulation of the interfaces through which persistent agent memory is produced and committed, and introduce MemForm, a controlled diagnostic benchmark covering five interfaces: Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path Poisoning. We introduce Selection and Path Poisoning as controlled intervention categories that isolate retention and consolidation order effects, respectively. Each category pairs clean and poisoned conditions with interface-specific controls. Evaluations across six LLMs and two response formats reveal broad susceptibility at all five interfaces under the evaluated memory protocols and implementations. Crucially, authentic experiences with successful outcomes do not guarantee reliable behavior after memory formation: changes to contextual support, retention, or consolidation order can induce undesirable downstream behavior. In particular, consolidation order can alter behavior even with identical retained experiences, depending on the memory formation procedure. Additional analyses show that interface applicability depends on memory architecture and that Path Poisoning susceptibility depends on the updater. The evaluated defenses provide incomplete mitigation that varies by interface. These findings motivate protecting both what is committed to persistent memory and how memory is formed from experiences. Code and data are available at https://github.com/opanhw/memform-code.
title_cn: MemForm：LLM 智能体记忆形成投毒基准
abstract_cn: 长期记忆让 LLM 智能体能从过往交互中学习，但也使记忆形成暴露于对抗影响。现有研究主要按攻击通道、破坏模式或生命周期阶段组织记忆投毒，对形成界面的刻画不足。我们把记忆形成投毒形式化为对持久智能体记忆的产生与提交界面的对抗操控，并引入 MemForm，一个受控诊断基准，覆盖五个界面：内容、证据、范围、选择与路径投毒。我们引入选择投毒与路径投毒作为受控干预类别，分别隔离保留效应与整合顺序效应。每个类别都配有干净与投毒条件及界面特定对照。跨六个 LLM 与两种响应格式的评估显示，在所评估的记忆协议与实现下，五个界面均存在广泛易感性。至关重要的是，带有成功结果的真实经历并不能保证记忆形成后的可靠行为：对上下文支持、保留或整合顺序的改动都能诱发不良下游行为。特别是，即使保留的经历完全相同，整合顺序也能改变行为，且取决于记忆形成过程。额外分析表明界面适用性取决于记忆架构，路径投毒易感性取决于更新器。所评估的防御只能提供因界面而异的不完全缓解。这些发现促使人们同时保护「什么被提交到持久记忆」与「记忆如何从经历中形成」。代码与数据可在 GitHub 获取。
summary_cn: MemForm：把记忆投毒形式化为五个形成界面的受控基准，6 个 LLM 上均现广泛易感性；整合顺序可在保留经历相同时改变行为，现有防御缓解不完全。
objective_summary: 将记忆形成投毒形式化为对持久记忆产生与提交界面的操控，构建覆盖内容/证据/范围/选择/路径五界面的受控基准 MemForm，在 6 个 LLM 上量化各界面易感性与防御缓解程度。
evidence_note: 六模型 × 两种响应格式的受控实验，每类界面配干净/投毒条件与界面特定对照，另做记忆架构与更新器依赖性分析；代码数据公开。
novelty_note: 把研究焦点从「什么被写入记忆」转向「记忆如何形成」，并提出选择投毒与路径投毒两个新干预类别，是该方向首个系统化形成界面刻画。
scope: 结论适用于所评估的记忆协议与实现（六模型、两种响应格式）；其他记忆架构上界面适用性不同，防御覆盖不完全。
limitations: 诊断环境为受控基准，非在野攻击；防御评估显示缓解不完全；路径投毒效果依赖具体更新器实现。

title: ByteMark: A Unified Byte-Level Watermark for Detection Across Language Models
abstract: As watermarking of LLM-generated text enters deployment, users increasingly need to check text whose source is unknown. Existing detectors read the watermark through a specific tokenizer or embedding pipeline, and even if all providers adopted the same watermarking method, differences in these representations would leave their watermarks incompatible, and the text alone does not reveal which representation produced it. We propose ByteMark, a unified watermarking scheme that defines its signal on the UTF-8 bytes of published text. Models with different tokenizers embed this signal under one public specification and key, and a single detector verifies the text from the text and key alone. When the tokenizer or embedding model of a baseline detector is replaced, its detection degrades sharply, whereas ByteMark, which uses neither, retains its detection rate; ByteMark also remains detectable when participating models continue or rewrite the text.
title_cn: ByteMark：跨语言模型检测的统一字节级水印
abstract_cn: 随着 LLM 生成文本水印进入部署，用户日益需要检查来源未知的文本。现有检测器通过特定分词器或嵌入管线读取水印，即使所有提供方采用同一水印方法，这些表示的差异也会使水印互不兼容，而文本本身不揭示它由哪种表示产生。我们提出 ByteMark，一个统一水印方案，把信号定义在发布文本的 UTF-8 字节上。采用不同分词器的模型在同一公开规范与密钥下嵌入该信号，单一检测器仅凭文本与密钥即可验证。当基线检测器的分词器或嵌入模型被替换时，其检测急剧退化，而两者皆不使用的 ByteMark 保持其检测率；当参与模型继续或改写文本时，ByteMark 仍可被检测。
summary_cn: ByteMark：把水印信号定义在 UTF-8 字节上的统一方案，跨分词器/模型单一检测器即可验证，且在模型改写文本后仍可检测。
objective_summary: 提出定义在 UTF-8 字节上的统一水印 ByteMark，使不同分词器的模型共享公开规范与密钥并由单一检测器验证，并对比基线在分词器/嵌入替换与文本改写下检测率的退化。
evidence_note: 与基线在分词器/嵌入替换、模型续写与改写场景下的对比实验；摘要未给出具体数值结果，评测模型与数据集细节未披露。
novelty_note: 面向「来源未知文本」的跨模型统一检测是水印部署的关键缺口，字节级信号是直接的解决路线；与同期字节局部水印工作方向重合。
scope: 结论适用于多提供方文本混排、来源未知场景的水印检测；对强移除攻击（复写、翻译）与质量代价的量化未在摘要给出。
limitations: 摘要未报告量化检测率与误报率；对自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性未说明；质量影响未量化。

title: DICE: Tilting the Odds through Interface Attackson System One Model
abstract: System One models offer typed judgments that applications can turn into decisions. Their answers, however, are conditional on the state and question supplied by surrounding components, and on how the application uses the response. We study this boundary in a Jev-based pipeline with bounded substitutions at three adapter outputs: state extraction, question generation, and output interpretation. Across three small synthetic studies, each adapter can change the final decision while Jev and its authentic API responses remain outside attacker control. The cases expose distinct failures of source fidelity, answer meaning, and response relevance. Checks that bind these relationships stopped the corresponding interventions we tested, although source verification also rejected some valid clean decisions. The pilot identifies where correct request-level judgments can lose their connection to the original task; it does not estimate the prevalence of these failures in deployed systems.
title_cn: DICE：通过对 System One 模型接口的攻击扭转概率
abstract_cn: System One 模型提供应用程序可转化为决策的类型化判断。然而其答案以周围组件提供的状态与问题为条件，也取决于应用程序如何使用响应。我们在一个基于 Jev 的管线中，于三个适配器输出（状态抽取、问题生成、输出解释）上研究这一边界，采用有界替换。跨三个小型合成研究，每个适配器都能改变最终决策，而 Jev 及其真实 API 响应始终处于攻击者控制之外。这些案例暴露了源保真度、答案含义与响应相关性上的不同失败。绑定这些关系的检查阻止了我们所测试的相应干预，尽管源验证也拒绝了部分合法的干净决策。该试点研究识别了正确的请求级判断可能失去与原始任务联系的位置；它不估计这些失败在已部署系统中的普遍性。
summary_cn: 在 Jev 管线的状态抽取、问题生成与输出解释三个适配器输出上以有界替换演示可改变最终决策，并检验绑定式检查的防御效果与误拒代价。
objective_summary: 在 Jev 决策管线的三个适配器输出上进行有界替换实验，展示各环节可改变最终决策，并评估绑定源、含义与相关性的检查对干预的阻止作用及误拒。
evidence_note: 三个小型合成研究的试点评估，未估计真实系统中的失败普遍性，无量化成功率报告。
novelty_note: 把对 System One 模型的攻击面从模型本体移到应用适配器边界，指出三类不同的失败关系，为该新范式提供有诊断价值的安全分析。
scope: 结论适用于 Jev 类类型化判断模型的集成管线；基于合成任务，不代表已部署系统的失败率。
limitations: 仅三个小型合成研究；未量化现实普遍性；检查方案会误拒部分合法决策。

title: Tokenization-Invariant Watermarking: A Byte-Local Method for LLM Text
abstract: We introduce Tokenization-Invariant Watermarking (TI-WM), a method that embeds a watermark during token generation but keys and scores it on canonicalized UTF-8 bytes. The detector does not invoke the tokenizer. Canonicalizer-preserving edits leave its score unchanged; other localized canonical-byte edits affect a bounded number of scoring windows. Across three fixed keys and 128 prompts per key and model, a deterministic white-box attack at a 5% word-edit budget leaves mean attacked-AUC 0.530 on Qwen3-8B and 0.664 on Gemma 4 E4B, compared with 0.410 and 0.489 for Unigram with detection-side deletion. These operating points are not jointly matched on quality and clean detectability. Bias sweeps show model-dependent distortion costs, and shared-rule controls support a locality interpretation without establishing a unique advantage of bytes. Visible insertion outside the canonicalizer's deletion set defeats the default design. Alphabetic filtering closes that channel but does not resolve source shift or calibrated detection power. TI-WM thus provides a concrete construction with local scoring guarantees and measured attack-ranking gains, not a general robustness or low-false-positive-rate deployment guarantee.
title_cn: 分词不变水印：面向 LLM 文本的字节局部方法
abstract_cn: 我们提出分词不变水印（TI-WM），在 token 生成期间嵌入水印，但以规范化的 UTF-8 字节为键并按其评分，检测器不调用分词器。保持规范化器的编辑不改变其分数；其他局部规范字节编辑只影响有界数量的评分窗口。在每模型每键 128 条提示、共三个固定键的设定下，词编辑预算 5% 的确定性白盒攻击使 Qwen3-8B 上平均受攻击 AUC 为 0.530，Gemma 4 E4B 上为 0.664，而采用检测端删除的 Unigram 分别为 0.410 与 0.489。这些工作点未在质量与干净可检测性上联合对齐。偏置扫描显示模型相关的失真成本，共享规则对照支持局部性解释但未能确立字节的独特优势。规范化器删除集之外的可见插入会击败默认设计；字母过滤关闭该通道但未解决源偏移或校准检测力问题。TI-WM 因此提供了一个带局部评分保证与实测攻击排序收益的具体构造，而非通用鲁棒性或低误报率的部署保证。
summary_cn: TI-WM：以规范化 UTF-8 字节为键的 LLM 水印，检测不依赖分词器；5% 词编辑攻击下受攻击 AUC 0.530/0.664，优于 Unigram 的 0.410/0.489。
objective_summary: 提出检测端不依赖分词器的字节局部水印 TI-WM，规范化保持编辑不影响分数，并在多模型、多键设定下与 Unigram 对比量化攻击后 AUC、偏置失真与攻击面。
evidence_note: 3 键 × 每模型 128 提示的系统评测，与 Unigram 的受攻击 AUC 对比（0.530/0.664 vs 0.410/0.489），偏置扫描与共享规则对照消融；作者明示工作点未联合对齐。
novelty_note: 把水印键控与评分移到规范化字节上、给出局部评分保证是实质性设计点；与同期字节级水印方向一致，属该路线中的新构造。
scope: 结论适用于其定义的规范化器保持编辑类扰动与白盒确定性攻击设定；源偏移、校准检测力与规范化器删除集之外的插入攻击未解决。
limitations: 作者自陈各工作点未在质量与干净可检测性上联合对齐；可见插入可击败默认设计；失真成本随模型变化。

title: Natural Code Transformation Confuses Agents in Vulnerability Analysis
abstract: Having demonstrated a strong potential for automating vulnerability discovery, AI agents can also be used to attack software systems at scale. Today's software systems need mechanisms to level the playing field by slowing down potential attacks, giving them time to patch vulnerabilities and strengthen software. Along this line, our study of agent trajectories in vulnerability analysis shows a surprising finding: agents produce dramatically different results across real-world code commits that carry the same functionality and the same vulnerability. This phenomenon appears consistently in multiple code domains and vulnerability categories. It motivates us to study natural and functionality-preserving code transformations derived from real-world software development, and their potential as a defense against attacker agents. We build a corpus of natural transformations by mining recurring development patterns from real-world code commits, and apply them to evaluate impact on agentic vulnerability analysis. Our results show that even a single form of transformation can effectively "confuse" frontier agents, e.g., Codex with GPT-6 Sol, reducing successes in vulnerability discovery. We also study different agent failures, whether transformations can be composed to provide stronger protection, and adaptive attackers who seek to reverse them. Overall, our study of natural code transformation significantly expands the research space of using code transformations to defend against malicious agents.
title_cn: 自然代码变换让智能体在漏洞分析中犯晕
abstract_cn: 在已证明 AI 智能体具有自动化漏洞发现的强大潜力之后，它们也可被用于大规模攻击软件系统。当今软件系统需要能拉平攻防不对称的机制，以拖慢潜在攻击，为修补漏洞与加固软件争取时间。沿此思路，我们对漏洞分析中智能体轨迹的研究显示一个惊人发现：面对携带相同功能与相同漏洞的真实代码提交，智能体的产出差异巨大。该现象在多个代码域与漏洞类别中一致出现。这促使我们研究源自真实软件开发、保持功能不变的自然代码变换，及其作为对抗攻击者智能体防御的潜力。我们从真实代码提交中挖掘反复出现的开发模式，构建自然变换语料，并应用其评估对智能体漏洞分析的影响。结果表明，即使单一形式的变换也能有效「迷惑」前沿智能体，例如配备 GPT-6 Sol 的 Codex，降低漏洞发现的成功率。我们还研究了智能体的不同失败模式、变换能否组合提供更强保护，以及试图逆转变换的适应型攻击者。总体而言，我们对自然代码变换的研究显著拓展了利用代码变换防御恶意智能体的研究空间。
summary_cn: 发现智能体漏洞分析对功能等价的代码提交结果差异巨大；从真实提交挖掘的自然代码变换可显著降低前沿智能体（Codex/GPT-6 Sol）的漏洞发现成功率。
objective_summary: 通过分析智能体在功能等价提交上的轨迹差异，提出以真实开发模式挖掘的自然代码变换作为拖慢攻击者智能体的防御，并评估单变换、变换组合与适应型攻击者的影响。
evidence_note: 多代码域、多漏洞类别、多智能体（含 Codex/GPT-6 Sol）的轨迹实证与变换组合、适应型攻击者分析；摘要未给量化成功率，语料自建。
novelty_note: 提出「以保持功能的自然代码变换防御攻击者智能体」这一新防御路线，并以真实提交模式挖掘构建可复用语料，开辟新的研究方向。
scope: 结论适用于以 LLM 智能体做漏洞发现的威胁场景；对人类攻击者、非代码域与静态分析工具的效果未评估。
limitations: 摘要未报告具体成功率与统计检验；变换语料依赖可挖掘的开发模式；对持续适应的攻击者只做了初步探讨。

title: ARMOR: Adversary Cost Amplification via a Schema-Preserving Password-Hardening Retrofit for Resource-Constrained Systems
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) gateways, edge authentication servers, and legacy systems need protection against offline password guessing after credential-database disclosure. Memory-hard key derivation functions (KDFs) are the preferred defense, but their resource requirements can exceed memory or latency budgets. ARMOR addresses this gap with a schema-preserving verifier-side transform for database-only (DB-only) compromise. Secret per-account chains of injective operations reside in an isolated Chain Registry. Fixed terminal escape encoding preserves distinct pre-hash values under each chain and moves outputs outside printable ASCII. We evaluate NAIVE adversaries using unmodified cracking tools and AWARE adversaries that enumerate chains. For the evaluated pre-hardened three-operation chains, NAIVE recovery is at most 0.10% on non-digit targets. Escape encoding yields zero recovery of digit-only targets under evaluated stock rule-based and non-rule attacks, closing a bypass permitting up to 45.3% recovery. Across 14.05 million eligible RockYou password entries, retaining duplicates, the median conditional guessing number is approximately 52 output-class tests at depth three and 317 at depth five. These values quantify the chain-search subproblem given the correct plaintext under a unit-cost model. A separate historical 14-operation AWARE evaluation matches all transformed targets at full dictionary coverage. Deployment measurements show microsecond-scale bare-metal transforms on three IoT boards, with protected storage dominating the measured TrustZone-M prototype components. Although an isolated high-entropy pepper provides stronger cryptographic protection, ARMOR combines compact per-account chain storage with low transform cost. When resources permit and the KDF accepts the complete transformed output, ARMOR composes as KDF(ARMOR(password)).
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal. 24 pages, 8 figures, 23 tables. Supplementary material included as appendices
title_cn: ARMOR：面向资源受限系统的模式保持密码加固改造，放大对手成本
abstract_cn: 物联网（IoT）网关、边缘认证服务器与遗留系统需要在凭证数据库泄露后获得对离线口令猜测的保护。内存困难密钥派生函数（KDF）是首选防御，但其资源需求可能超出内存或延迟预算。ARMOR 以模式保持的验证端变换填补这一空缺，针对仅数据库（DB-only）泄露场景。秘密的按账户单射操作链存放在隔离的链注册表中。固定的终端转义编码在每个链下保持不同预哈希值的区分性，并把输出移出可打印 ASCII。我们评估使用未修改破解工具的 NAIVE 对手与枚举链的 AWARE 对手。对所评估的三个操作预加固链，NAIVE 在非纯数字目标上的恢复率至多 0.10%。转义编码使纯数字目标在评估的现成规则类与非规则攻击下恢复率为零，堵上了允许高达 45.3% 恢复率的绕过。在保留重复项的 1405 万条合格 RockYou 口令上，深度三的中位条件猜测数约为 52 次输出类测试，深度五约为 317 次。这些值在单位成本模型下量化了给定正确明文时的链搜索子问题。另一项独立的历史性 14 操作 AWARE 评估在全字典覆盖下匹配全部变换目标。部署测量显示三块 IoT 板上的裸机变换为微秒级，受保护存储主导所测 TrustZone-M 原型组件。尽管隔离的高熵 pepper 提供更强的密码学保护，ARMOR 以紧凑的按账户链存储与低变换成本取胜。当资源允许且 KDF 接受完整变换输出时，ARMOR 可组合为 KDF(ARMOR(password))。
summary_cn: ARMOR：口令库泄露后的验证端口令加固改造，NAIVE 对手非纯数字目标恢复率≤0.10%、转义编码使纯数字目标归零；1405 万 RockYou 条目上量化链搜索成本。
objective_summary: 提出 ARMOR 验证端口令变换：按账户秘密单射操作链加终端转义编码，区分 NAIVE 与 AWARE 两类对手量化恢复率与猜测数，并在 IoT 板与 TrustZone-M 原型上测部署成本。
evidence_note: 1405 万 RockYou 条目的大规模在野数据分析、NAIVE/AWARE 双对手评估、真实 IoT 板与 TrustZone-M 原型测量；单位成本模型假设明确但无统计检验。
novelty_note: 秘密操作链与 pepper 类思路已有先例，新意在于模式保持的可组合改造设计、终端转义编码对规则攻击绕过的封堵，以及系统化的对手成本量化框架。
scope: 结论适用于 DB-only 泄露、验证端可改造且资源受限的口令系统；不覆盖验证端代码或链注册表同时被攻破的场景。
limitations: AWARE 对手在足够字典覆盖下可匹配全部目标（成本转移而非消除）；安全度量依赖单位成本模型假设；14 操作链的历史评估表明更强的对手可穷举。

title: Watermarking for Byzantine Robust LLM Training
abstract: LLM watermarking has emerged as a promising approach for detecting downstream model misuse in centralized settings, but extending it to federated learning (FL) presents unique challenges. In particular, FL systems often rely on strong robust aggregators to defend against poisoning attacks. We empirically show that a malicious server can exploit these same aggregators as effective watermark-removal mechanisms during training, causing representative existing LLM watermarking methods to fail detection in the final model. To address this limitation, we formalize the problem as a constrained optimization task and propose CamoMark, an aggregator-agnostic watermarking scheme for embedding robust watermarks in FL. CamoMark optimizes watermarked updates to become inliers, maintaining bounded deviation from the distribution of clean updates, while preserving sufficient watermark signal for reliable detection. Evaluated on Qwen fine-tuned on the Alpaca dataset, CamoMark achieves a detection confidence of $p$-value $= 1.82\times10^{-2}$ using only 3.3% watermarked data. The watermark also remains robust to a range of post-training removal attacks, including continued fine-tuning on clean data, pruning, and model distillation. At higher watermark ratios, detection confidence improves substantially, reaching $p$-value $= 5.11\times10^{-11}$ at a 13.3% watermark ratio.
comment: 19 pages, including appendix and references
title_cn: 面向拜占庭鲁棒 LLM 训练的水印
abstract_cn: LLM 水印已成为在集中式设置下检测下游模型滥用的有前景方法，但把它扩展到联邦学习（FL）面临独特挑战。特别是 FL 通常依赖强鲁棒聚合器来抵御投毒攻击。我们实证表明，恶意服务器可以在训练期间把这些聚合器当作有效的水印移除机制来利用，使代表性的现有 LLM 水印方法在最终模型中无法被检测。为解决这一局限，我们把该问题形式化为约束优化任务，提出 CamoMark，一种聚合器无关的水印方案，用于在 FL 中嵌入鲁棒水印。CamoMark 优化带水印更新使其成为内点，保持与干净更新分布的有界偏离，同时保留足够的水印信号用于可靠检测。在 Alpaca 数据集上微调的 Qwen 上评估，CamoMark 仅用 3.3% 的水印数据即可达到 p 值 1.82×10⁻² 的检测置信度。该水印对一系列训练后移除攻击保持鲁棒，包括在干净数据上继续微调、剪枝与模型蒸馏。在更高水印比例下检测置信度大幅提升，13.3% 水印比例时 p 值达 5.11×10⁻¹¹。
summary_cn: CamoMark：聚合器无关的联邦 LLM 水印，抵御恶意服务器借鲁棒聚合器移除水印；3.3% 水印数据 p=1.82×10⁻²，13.3% 时 p=5.11×10⁻¹¹。
objective_summary: 实证揭示恶意服务器可借鲁棒聚合器移除现有联邦 LLM 水印，进而提出把水印更新优化为内点的聚合器无关方案 CamoMark，并量化其检测置信度与对训练后移除攻击的鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 在 Qwen+Alpaca 上评估，报告具体 p 值（1.82×10⁻² 至 5.11×10⁻¹¹）、多类移除攻击对比；单模型单数据集组合，无统计检验与多任务覆盖。
novelty_note: 首次实证指出「鲁棒聚合器可被恶意服务器用作水印移除器」这一结构性冲突，并给出聚合器无关的内点化水印设计，属实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于联邦微调场景下的 LLM 文本水印与鲁棒聚合器（中位数类）并用设置；其他聚合器族、其他模态与预训练期水印未覆盖。
limitations: 评估限于 Qwen+Alpaca 组合；水印比例与检测置信度的权衡依赖所选统计检验；对自适应聚合器攻击者的枚举不完备。

title: RoboFake: Are Deepfake Detectors Ready for Humanoid Face Robots?
abstract: Humanoid face robots can now move their lips in sync with speech and show detailed facial expressions. Give such a robot the face of a real person and drive it with generated speech, and you get a face forgery that happens in front of the camera: the camera records a real object, and no pixel is edited. We call this a RoboFake. In this paper we ask what current deepfake detectors do when they see a robot face. We test six public detectors trained on FaceForensics++ on video of a physical lip-syncing face robot, on a synthesized video of the same robot, and on rendered robot faces. All thresholds are fixed on FaceForensics++, and every result is compared with real human faces that went through the same processing as the robot videos. At a threshold that flags 5% of real faces, three detectors flag almost every physical robot frame, while two flag fewer than 7%. A matched human control and masking show that the response comes from the face, not from the processing or the background. However, it does not track synthesis: with only the face visible, three of the six detectors give the physical robot a higher fake score than its synthesized video. The response is also fragile, and light JPEG compression is enough to push most robot frames below the threshold for some detectors. Our results suggest that current detectors flag today's robots because their faces do not look human, not because they recognize a forgery. We release our evaluation protocol and code, and state three testable hypotheses about realistic, interactive RoboFakes.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
title_cn: RoboFake：深伪检测器准备好应对人形面部机器人了吗？
abstract_cn: 人形面部机器人现在可以让嘴唇与语音同步移动并呈现细致的面部表情。给这样的机器人安上真人的脸并用生成的语音驱动它，你就得到一种发生在摄像头前的面部伪造：摄像头记录的是真实物体，没有任何像素被编辑。我们称之为 RoboFake。本文探讨现有深伪检测器面对机器人面部时的表现。我们在一个实体唇同步面部机器人的视频、同一机器人的合成视频与渲染的机器人面部上，测试六个在 FaceForensics++ 上训练的公开检测器。所有阈值在 FaceForensics++ 上固定，每个结果都与经过与机器人视频相同处理的真人面部对照比较。在标记 5% 真人面部的阈值下，三个检测器几乎标记每一帧实体机器人画面，两个检测器标记少于 7%。匹配的人类对照与遮挡实验表明该响应来自面部而非处理流程或背景。然而它并不跟随合成过程：仅露出面部时，六个检测器中有三个给实体机器人打出比其合成视频更高的伪造分。该响应也很脆弱，轻度 JPEG 压缩就足以把一些检测器下的大多数机器人帧压到阈值以下。结果表明，现有检测器标记今天的机器人是因为其面部不像人，而不是因为识别出伪造。我们发布评估协议与代码，并提出关于现实、交互式 RoboFake 的三个可检验假设。
summary_cn: 提出 RoboFake：实体机器人换脸发生在镜头前、无像素编辑；6 个 FF++ 检测器对其响应源于「不像人」而非伪造识别，且经不起 JPEG 压缩。
objective_summary: 构建实体唇同步面部机器人的 RoboFake 视频语料，在统一阈值与匹配人类对照下评测六个公开深伪检测器，检验其响应来源、对合成的跟踪性与压缩脆弱性。
evidence_note: 实体机器人、合成视频与渲染面部三类刺激，固定阈值、匹配人类对照与遮挡消融，六检测器系统对比；语料自建、规模有限、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出「实体机器人换脸」这一无像素编辑的新伪造形态并首次系统评估现有检测器对它的响应，开辟新的评测问题；结论对检测器社区有直接诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于 FaceForensics++ 上训练的现有像素级深伪检测器与当前实体人形机器人面部；对交互式实时 RoboFake 仅有三个假设而非结论。
limitations: 单一机器人平台与有限受试场景；检测器仅限 FF++ 训练的六款；对交互式攻击的评估停留在假设层面。

title: Physical Side-Channel Attacks on Edge LLMs: Extracting Output Tokens and User Prompts
abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) on edge devices is largely motivated by privacy concerns over sharing sensitive user data with cloud servers. In this paper, we demonstrate that keeping inference local does not eliminate privacy risks: an adversary with physical access to the device may exploit hardware leakage to recover sensitive information without compromising or modifying the software system. In particular, we present an electromagnetic (EM) side-channel attack targeting LLM inference on edge devices. Targeting LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct running on a Raspberry Pi 5, we demonstrate that EM traces collected during inference can leak both generated tokens and user prompts. We propose three attacks under different threat assumptions. First, a profiling attack that identifies generated tokens among 50 medical and privacy-related keywords with 97.2% accuracy on profiled words. Second, a reconstruction attack recovers the model's hidden representations and uses them to predict tokens from the full 128k-token vocabulary, achieving 94.3% accuracy on profiled classes. For unseen words, the correct token is ranked within the first 100 positions of the 128k-token vocabulary in 67% of cases, with a median rank of 54. Finally, we present a hidden-state inversion attack that uses the recovered hidden state to reconstruct user prompts semantically. Our proposed attacks require only passive EM side-channel measurements and a limited number of traces during model training. These results demonstrate that local execution alone may not guarantee the confidentiality of generated tokens and user inputs.
title_cn: 针对边缘 LLM 的物理侧信道攻击：提取输出 token 与用户提示
abstract_cn: 在边缘设备上部署大语言模型（LLM）很大程度上是出于对与云服务器共享敏感用户数据的隐私担忧。本文表明，把推理保持在本地并不能消除隐私风险：拥有设备物理访问权的对手可利用硬件泄露，在不破坏或修改软件系统的情况下恢复敏感信息。特别地，我们提出针对边缘设备上 LLM 推理的电磁（EM）侧信道攻击。以运行在 Raspberry Pi 5 上的 LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct 为目标，我们证明推理期间采集的 EM 轨迹可泄露生成 token 与用户提示。我们在不同威胁假设下提出三种攻击。第一，剖析攻击在 50 个医疗与隐私相关关键词中以 97.2% 的准确率识别剖析词表中的生成 token。第二，重构攻击恢复模型隐藏表征并用其从完整 128k 词表预测 token，在剖析类别上达到 94.3% 准确率；对未见词，正确 token 在 67% 的情况下排进 128k 词表前 100 位，中位秩 54。最后，我们提出隐藏状态反演攻击，用恢复的隐藏状态语义重建用户提示。所提攻击只需被动 EM 侧信道测量与模型训练阶段有限数量的轨迹。这些结果表明，仅本地执行可能无法保证生成 token 与用户输入的机密性。
summary_cn: 对 Raspberry Pi 5 上 LLaMA-3.2-1B 的 EM 侧信道攻击：剖析词识别 97.2%、隐藏态重构 94.3%，并可语义重建用户提示，表明本地推理不保证机密性。
objective_summary: 在 Raspberry Pi 5 的 LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct 上展示三种被动 EM 侧信道攻击，分别实现关键词级 token 识别、全词表隐藏态重构与用户提示的语义重建，并量化各自准确率。
evidence_note: 真实设备物理实验（Pi 5 + LLaMA-3.2-1B），三种攻击分别量化（97.2%、94.3%、未见词中位秩 54），报告被动测量与剖析轨迹需求；单设备单模型规模有限。
novelty_note: 把 EM 侧信道推进到可同时恢复边缘 LLM 的生成 token 与用户提示，并引入隐藏状态反演做语义重建，实质扩展了 LLM 部署的物理威胁模型。
scope: 结论适用于可被物理接近、运行 1B 级模型的边缘设备；需要训练期采集剖析轨迹；更大模型、屏蔽措施与远距离攻击未评估。
limitations: 剖析攻击限于 50 关键词词表；仅单一设备与单一模型；未见词仅能给出排序而非直接识别；未评估屏蔽或随机化等对策。

title: Embedding Asymmetry as Attack Signal: Detecting and Defending Active Label Inference in Vertical Federated Learning
abstract: Vertical federated learning lets organizations train a shared model over features they hold separately, while one party keeps the labels private. The active label inference attack of Fu et al. [12] breaks this: a feature-holding party runs a modified optimizer, MaliciousSGD, that forces class structure into its embeddings and then recovers the labels with semi-supervised learning. Defenses that perturb the shared gradient fail, because the attack acts on the party's internal optimizer, not on the message it sends. We show the attack leaves a signal the server can read from the embeddings it already receives. The adversary's Fisher class-separability pulls away from the honest party's, and the gap is visible within a few epochs. A defense triggered by this signal acts on the adversary alone. Scaling its gradient down handles few-class tasks, and a norm non-expansive projection handles many-class tasks, with the Discriminative Coverage Ratio explaining why the projection rank must grow with the class count. The defense breaks the alignment between embedding clusters and labels rather than destroying the embedding. Across four seeds on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and CINIC-10, label inference falls below what honest training already leaks, at under two points of task-accuracy cost.
title_cn: 嵌入不对称作为攻击信号：垂直联邦学习中主动标签推理的检测与防御
abstract_cn: 垂直联邦学习让各组织在各自持有的特征上共同训练共享模型，同时一方持有私有标签。Fu 等人的主动标签推理攻击打破了这一点：持有特征的一方运行修改后的优化器 MaliciousSGD，迫使类别结构进入其嵌入，再用半监督学习恢复标签。扰动共享梯度的防御会失败，因为攻击作用于该方的内部优化器而非其发送的消息。我们表明该攻击在服务器已收到的嵌入上留下可读信号：对抗方的 Fisher 类别可分性偏离诚实方，且差距在几个 epoch 内即可见。由该信号触发的防御只作用于对抗方。缩小其梯度可处理少类别任务，范数非扩张投影可处理多类别任务，判别覆盖率（Discriminative Coverage Ratio）解释了投影秩为何须随类别数增长。防御破坏嵌入簇与标签的对齐而非摧毁嵌入。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 CINIC-10 上跨 4 个随机种子，标签推理降到诚实训练本已泄露的水平以下，任务精度损失不到 2 个百分点。
summary_cn: 发现 VFL 主动标签推理攻击在嵌入上留下 Fisher 可分性不对称信号，据此只作用于攻击方的防御使标签推理降至诚实泄露水平以下，精度损失不到 2 点。
objective_summary: 证明 MaliciousSGD 主动标签推理攻击会在服务器可见嵌入上留下 Fisher 类别可分性的不对称信号，并据此提出仅作用于攻击方的梯度缩放与范数非扩张投影两类防御。
evidence_note: 3 个数据集（CIFAR-10/100、CINIC-10）× 4 随机种子的受控对比，针对已知攻击 MaliciousSGD 评估，给出判别覆盖率理论解释与量化指标（精度损失 <2 点）；无置信区间。
novelty_note: 指出该类攻击在服务器侧留下可检测的不对称信号并给出按方定向的防御机制，是对已有攻击的实质性新防御路线，而非对消息加噪的重复。
scope: 结论适用于垂直联邦学习中特征方可能运行 MaliciousSGD 类主动攻击的场景；水平联邦、其他攻击变体与自适应隐藏 Fisher 信号的对手未覆盖。
limitations: 仅评估 MaliciousSGD 一类攻击；种子数 4、无统计检验；对能刻意维持可分性一致的自适应攻击者未讨论。

title: Memory-Coupled Unlearning for Data-Absent Identity Forgetting
abstract: Machine unlearning aims to reduce the influence of designated training data from a trained model while preserving its utility on retained data. Identity-level unlearning is particularly challenging when only limited target-specific information is available when a forgetting request is processed. In this work, we propose Memory-Coupled Unlearning (MCU), a framework that augments a host model with a Modern Hopfield Network (MHN) serving as a controllable external identity-prototype memory. During prototype construction, feature representations associated with each training identity are aggregated into identity prototypes and stored in the MHN. A Prototype Adaptation Network (PAN) transforms the retrieved memory representation, while a Dependency Gating Unit (DGU) controls its contribution to downstream prediction. When an identity is requested to be forgotten, MCU first removes the corresponding prototype from the external memory and subsequently readapts the model using limited support information associated with the target identities together with retained data. Importantly, in this work, ``data-absent'' specifically refers to the absence of the complete original forget set during request-time gradient-based readaptation; retained data may still be used to preserve downstream-task utility. Experiments based on the identity-partitioning and one-shot support construction of 1-SHUI show that MCU achieves a favorable empirical trade-off among model utility, membership distinguishability, and request-time computational efficiency compared with the evaluated baselines. These results provide empirical evidence for the potential of controllable external memory in machine unlearning, rather than a formal guarantee of complete information removal.
title_cn: 面向数据缺失身份遗忘的记忆耦合遗忘
abstract_cn: 机器遗忘旨在减少指定训练数据对已训练模型的影响，同时保留其在保留数据上的效用。当处理遗忘请求时目标身份的专属信息有限时，身份级遗忘尤其困难。我们提出记忆耦合遗忘（MCU），一个用 Modern Hopfield Network（MHN）作为可控外部身份原型记忆来增强宿主模型的框架。在原型构建阶段，与每个训练身份相关的特征表征被聚合为身份原型并存入 MHN。原型自适应网络（PAN）变换检索到的记忆表征，依赖门控单元（DGU）控制其对下游预测的贡献。当请求遗忘某身份时，MCU 先从外部记忆中删除对应原型，随后使用与目标身份相关的有限支持信息及保留数据重新适配模型。重要的是，本文的「数据缺失」特指在请求时基于梯度的重新适配中缺少完整原始遗忘集；保留数据仍可用于维持下游任务效用。基于 1-SHUI 的身份划分与单样本支持构建的实验表明，与所评估基线相比，MCU 在模型效用、成员可区分性与请求时计算效率之间取得有利的经验权衡。这些结果为可控外部记忆在机器遗忘中的潜力提供了经验证据，而非完整信息删除的形式化保证。
summary_cn: MCU：用 Modern Hopfield 网络作外部身份原型记忆辅助数据缺失场景的身份遗忘，在效用、成员可区分性与请求时开销间取得较优权衡。
objective_summary: 提出 MCU 框架，用 MHN 存储身份原型、遗忘时删除对应原型并用有限支持信息重新适配模型，在 1-SHUI 设定下与基线比较效用、成员可区分性与请求时计算效率。
evidence_note: 基于 1-SHUI 基准的多基线受控对比，报告效用/成员可区分性/请求时效率三维度权衡；无统计检验，评测集为图像身份基准。
novelty_note: 以可控外部记忆承载身份原型、遗忘时「删原型再适配」是机器遗忘的新机制方向；整体依托既有 1-SHUI 评测设定。
scope: 结论适用于图像身份级遗忘与 1-SHUI 式请求时支持样本设定；不提供完整信息删除的形式化保证；文本/LLM 遗忘未覆盖。
limitations: 作者自陈结果不构成完整信息去除的保证；评估限于身份遗忘基准；外部记忆引入额外存储且原型质量依赖训练分布。

title: TrustPaper for forged PDF with Issuer Fingerprints
abstract: Sick leave certificates are increasingly delivered as PDF files by online teleconsultation platforms, and can be altered in minutes with free editors. Generic PDF scanners report how a file was built, but cannot tell whether that construction is legitimate: an incremental update, an embedded font or a given producer string is normal for one issuer and anomalous for another. We present TrustPaper solution, an issuer aware forensic approach that combines three elements: the claimed issuer of the document, a reference fingerprint learned beforehand from genuine documents of that issuer, and an explainable combination of evidence from several forensic modules. Fingerprints are stored as versioned declarative profiles, and every anomaly keeps its observed value, expected value and triggering rule. We formalize the threat model, the fingerprint and the scoring model, and evaluate the open-source prototype on a controlled corpus documents from two issuers and six forgery techniques. With the issuer fingerprint, all forgeries made by opportunistic and metadata-aware attackers are flagged with no false positive on genuine test documents.
title_cn: 基于签发方指纹的 TrustPaper 伪造 PDF 检测
abstract_cn: 病假证明越来越多地以 PDF 文件形式由在线远程问诊平台交付，并可用免费编辑器在几分钟内被篡改。通用 PDF 扫描器只报告文件如何构建，却无法判断该构建方式是否合法：增量更新、嵌入字体或某个 producer 字符串对一个签发方是正常的，对另一个则是异常。我们提出 TrustPaper 方案，一种签发方感知的取证方法，结合三个要素：文档声称的签发方、预先从该签发方真实文档学到的参考指纹，以及来自多个取证模块证据的可解释组合。指纹以版本化声明式配置存储，每个异常都保留其观测值、期望值与触发规则。我们形式化威胁模型、指纹与评分模型，并在来自两个签发方、六种伪造技术的受控语料上评估开源原型。借助签发方指纹，机会型与元数据感知型攻击者所做的全部伪造都被标记，且对真实测试文档无误报。
summary_cn: TrustPaper：签发方感知的 PDF 伪造取证，用签发方参考指纹加多模块可解释证据；在 2 个签发方、6 种伪造技术语料上全部伪造被标记且零误报。
objective_summary: 提出签发方感知的 PDF 取证方法 TrustPaper，结合声称签发方、从真实文档预学的参考指纹与多模块证据的可解释组合，并在受控伪造语料上量化检出与误报。
evidence_note: 受控语料（2 个签发方、6 种伪造技术）上的系统评估，开源原型，报告全部伪造被标记与零误报；语料自建、规模有限、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「签发方指纹」引入文档取证，克服通用 PDF 结构扫描无法判断构建合法性的盲点；机制上是已有取证模块围绕签发方参照的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于有稳定签发方、可预先采集真实文档作参照的 PDF 场景；对签名/加密保护文档与能完全模仿签发方构建特征的强攻击未评估。
limitations: 语料仅 2 个签发方、6 种伪造技术；依赖签发方指纹库的先验采集与维护；对适应性攻击者未评估。

title: An Empirical Case Study of Prompt Engineering Strategies for Bypassing Multi-Layer Agent Security Defenses
abstract: The OpenClaw Security Attack and Defense Challenge evaluates AI agent robustness through a three-stage defense pipeline: skill file scanning (Stage 1), instruction safety evaluation (Stage 2), and attack trajectory scoring (Stage 3). This paper presents an empirical case study of prompt engineering strategies against these layers across 19 attack targets in Enterprise OA, E-commerce, and Smart Home scenarios. I document both successful and failed strategies, with an emphasis on the observed trade-off between instruction safety (Stage 2) and attack execution accuracy (Stage 3). The final online score is 0.2630, with 5 of 19 tasks achieving full bypass. The results suggest that multi-layer defenses, reinforced by built-in behavioral constraints, substantially limit what prompt engineering alone can achieve.
comment: 5 pages, 6 tables. Accepted at The 2nd Workshop on AIGC Safety from Dual Perspectives of Model and Content (WS06), IJCAI-ECAI 2026. Case study from Track 1 of the OpenClaw Security Attack and Defense Challenge
title_cn: 绕过多层智能体安全防御的提示工程策略实证案例研究
abstract_cn: OpenClaw Security 攻防挑战赛通过三阶段防御管线评估 AI 智能体鲁棒性：技能文件扫描（第一阶段）、指令安全评估（第二阶段）与攻击轨迹评分（第三阶段）。本文对跨企业 OA、电商与智能家居场景的 19 个攻击目标上的提示工程策略进行实证案例研究。我记录了成功与失败的策略，重点观察指令安全（第二阶段）与攻击执行精度（第三阶段）之间的权衡。最终在线得分 0.2630，19 个任务中 5 个实现完全绕过。结果表明，由内建行为约束强化的多层防御，显著限制了单纯提示工程所能达到的效果。
summary_cn: OpenClaw 攻防挑战案例研究：19 个目标中 5 个完全绕过、得分 0.2630，观察到指令安全与执行精度的权衡，多层防御显著限制纯提示工程攻击。
objective_summary: 在 OpenClaw 挑战赛三阶段防御管线上记录跨 19 个目标的提示工程攻击策略的成功与失败案例，量化得分并分析指令安全评估与攻击执行精度之间的权衡。
evidence_note: 单一挑战赛环境、19 个目标、得分 0.2630 与 5/19 全绕过等量化结果；5 页 workshop 论文（IJCAI-ECAI 2026 WS06），无统计检验与受控对比。
novelty_note: 对已有多层防御的经验性攻击记录，无新攻击机制；「指令安全与执行精度权衡」的观察有一定诊断价值。
scope: 结论限于 OpenClaw 挑战的三阶段防御管线与 19 个目标场景，不能推广到其他智能体防御体系或真实生产系统。
limitations: 单一赛事环境、单一作者；策略未系统消融；对失败案例的归因分析有限。

title: SAGE: Efficient Protected Vision-Language Inference on Smart Glasses
abstract: Smart glasses are a promising platform for vision-language assistants, but private split inference remains expensive: protecting visual representations before transmission does not remove the cost of on-device vision encoding, wide protected tokens, or hardware-unaware execution. We present SAGE (Smart-glasses-Aware Guarded Encoding), a hardware-aware framework for efficient protected VLM inference on smart glasses. SAGE keeps raw images and unprotected visual tokens on the trusted device, reduces visual input cost, executes shape-specialized INT8 graphs, and compresses protected representations into compact 256-dimensional INT8 packets before transmission. Unlike efficiency methods optimized only for nominal model size, SAGE selects its operating point using downstream answer quality together with measured latency, memory, and thermal behavior on real Mentra Live glasses. On a matched Qwen workload, SAGE reduces glasses inference latency by 39.18%, device-sensor temperature rise by 21.91%, and protected packet size by 96.56%, while retaining 85.62% of the protected reference's relaxed utility and comparable prompted containment. Direct glasses-to-phone tests deliver all 192 packets and reduce median packet-plus-acknowledgment time from 71.3 to 10.0 ms. The compact protected interface also transfers across four additional VLM families. These results show that private wearable VLM inference must be optimized jointly across representation protection, communication, and real-device execution rather than through model compression alone.
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures
title_cn: SAGE：智能眼镜上高效的受保护视觉语言推理
abstract_cn: 智能眼镜是视觉语言助手的有前景平台，但隐私保护的分割推理代价高昂：在传输前保护视觉表征并不能消除端侧视觉编码、宽保护 token 或硬件不感知执行的成本。我们提出 SAGE（Smart-glasses-Aware Guarded Encoding），一个面向智能眼镜上高效受保护 VLM 推理的硬件感知框架。SAGE 将原始图像与未保护视觉 token 保留在可信设备上，降低视觉输入成本，执行形状特化的 INT8 计算图，并在传输前把受保护表征压缩为紧凑的 256 维 INT8 包。与仅按名义模型尺寸优化的效率方法不同，SAGE 依据下游答案质量以及在真实 Mentra Live 眼镜上测得的延迟、内存与热行为来选择工作点。在匹配的 Qwen 工作负载上，SAGE 将眼镜端推理延迟降低 39.18%，设备传感器温升降低 21.91%，受保护包大小降低 96.56%，同时保留受保护参考 85.62% 的宽松效用与相当的提示遏制能力。眼镜到手机的直接测试交付了全部 192 个包，把包加确认的中位时间从 71.3 毫秒降到 10.0 毫秒。紧凑的受保护接口还能迁移到另外四个 VLM 家族。这些结果表明，隐私可穿戴 VLM 推理必须在表征保护、通信与真实设备执行上联合优化，而不能只靠模型压缩。
summary_cn: SAGE：智能眼镜上硬件感知的受保护 VLM 分割推理，延迟降 39.18%、包大小降 96.56%、温升降 21.91%，保留 85.62% 效用，可迁移到 5 个 VLM 家族。
objective_summary: 提出面向智能眼镜的硬件感知受保护推理框架 SAGE，在可信端保留原始图像、压缩受保护表征为 256 维 INT8 包，并按真实设备的延迟/内存/温度与下游质量联合选择工作点。
evidence_note: 在真实 Mentra Live 眼镜上实测延迟、内存与温度，192 包端到端传输实验，跨四个额外 VLM 家族验证迁移性，报告具体百分比；无统计检验与多外部基线对比。
novelty_note: 分割推理、INT8 量化与表征压缩均为已有组件，新意在于面向智能眼镜场景的硬件感知联合优化与真实设备测量，属已有技术的新场景系统化组合。
scope: 结论适用于智能眼镜类可穿戴平台上的分割推理与 Qwen 类 VLM；未覆盖更强对抗能力的威胁模型与云端共谋风险。
limitations: 硬件仅 Mentra Live 一款；「宽松效用」为自定义指标；保护机制对主动对抗攻击的强度未系统量化。

title: Symmetric Cryptography via Dirichlet Convolution
abstract: We discuss a new symmetric-key cipher for digital data encryption. Its implementation is fast, memory efficient, and resilient against classical, AI-assisted, and quantum attacks. Let $x$, $k$, and $c$ be elements of a finite abelian group $G$ with operation $+$ and neutral element $0$. Suppose one is given ciphertext $c=x+k$. Retrieving the plaintext $x=c-k$ from the ciphertext is trivial when the key $k$ is known. Without the key, however, recovering $x$ amounts to a blind search. Even if an efficient criterion were available for identifying the plaintext among all group elements, the average number of trials would remain prohibitively large when the group is sufficiently large. The challenge in constructing a practical cryptosystem is therefore to identify a sufficiently rich group $G$, together with efficient algorithms that enable an immersion of \emph{real digital data} into $G$ and efficient evaluation of the group operations. The proposed cipher is based on generalized Dirichlet convolution over finite fields. We investigate its security against plaintext attacks from an information-theoretic perspective. The nonlocal structure of Dirichlet convolution naturally permits plaintext salting, providing protection against plaintext attacks while allowing controlled key reuse. We establish perfect masking properties over finite fields and prove that the resulting cipher achieves information-theoretic security under key reuse when the underlying arithmetic is carried out in $\mathbb{F}_p$ with $p>2$. For arithmetic over $\mathbb{F}_2$, some information leakage remains, leading to a finite key-reuse budget.

title_cn: 基于 Dirichlet 卷积的对称密码
abstract_cn: 我们讨论一种用于数字数据加密的新对称密钥密码。其实现快速、内存高效，并且对经典、AI 辅助与量子攻击具有韧性。设 x、k、c 是具有运算 + 与单位元 0 的有限阿贝尔群 G 中的元素。若给定密文 c=x+k，则已知密钥 k 时恢复明文 x=c-k 是平凡的；但没有密钥时，恢复 x 相当于盲搜索。即使存在可从所有群元素中识别明文的高效准则，当群足够大时平均尝试次数仍大得不可行。构造实用密码系统的挑战因此在于找到足够丰富的群 G，以及能把真实数字数据浸入 G 并高效求值群运算的算法。所提出的密码基于有限域上的广义 Dirichlet 卷积。我们从信息论视角考察其对明文攻击的安全性。Dirichlet 卷积的非局部结构自然允许明文加盐，在允许受控密钥重用的同时提供对明文攻击的保护。我们在有限域上建立完美掩蔽性质，并证明当底层算术在 F_p（p>2）上进行时，所得密码在密钥重用下达到信息论安全。对于 F_2 上的算术，仍存在一定信息泄露，导致有限的密钥重用预算。
summary_cn: 提出基于有限域上广义 Dirichlet 卷积的新对称密码，证明 F_p（p>2）下密钥重用仍有信息论安全；F_2 存在泄露、密钥重用预算有限。
objective_summary: 构造基于有限域上广义 Dirichlet 卷积的对称加密方案，分析其明文加盐与密钥重用性质，并证明 F_p（p>2）下的完美掩蔽与信息论安全、F_2 下的有限密钥重用预算。
evidence_note: 以作者自己的信息论证明为主，无实现基准、无标准密码分析（差分/线性等）检验、无第三方评审信息；「抗量子/抗 AI」为主张而非论证。
novelty_note: 以 Dirichlet 卷积构造分组对称密码是少见的新构造方向，并给出密钥重用下的信息论安全刻画；但属于密码设计领域内的新组合，价值有待密码分析共同体检验。
scope: 结论适用于其构造所依赖的有限域群运算实现；F_p（p>2）与 F_2 的安全结论不同；所有安全断言均为作者理论证明，未经独立密码分析。
limitations: 缺乏实现性能与已知攻击面的具体评估；信息论安全结论依赖其群与算术假设；对量子攻击的韧性未给出论证细节。

title: Building Trustworthy Household Robots through Open-World Safety
abstract: Foundation models are expanding robot capabilities, enabling robots to handle more diverse objects, follow sophisticated instructions, and operate in complex environments. These advances bring us to a future in which robots become part of everyday household life. However, cluttered, dynamic household environments also expose robots to unfamiliar objects, tasks, and interactions, making reliable zero-shot task completion an ongoing challenge for robotics research. From a security perspective, we argue for open-world safety: household robots should preserve specified safety requirements in unseen situations, including when they cannot complete the requested task. Safety protections must account for context and interactions that persist across actions and tasks. In this position paper, we examine why existing safety methods can fail to provide this protection. Protection can fail through misinterpreted context, overlooked past interactions, or stopping and recovery strategies that become unsafe under unfamiliar conditions. We therefore propose a research agenda to specify, learn, and ground safety requirements, enforce them with reliable recovery, and evaluate the generalization of such protections. We call for household robots whose safety protections remain reliable beyond the situations, context, and history used to train and develop them, to achieve open-world safety.
title_cn: 通过开放世界安全构建可信赖的家用机器人
abstract_cn: 基础模型正在扩展机器人能力，使机器人能处理更多样的物体、遵循更复杂的指令并在复杂环境中运行。这些进展让我们走向机器人融入日常家庭生活的未来。然而，杂乱、动态的家庭环境也让机器人暴露于陌生物体、任务与交互，使可靠的零样本任务完成仍是机器人研究的持续挑战。从安全角度看，我们主张开放世界安全：家用机器人应在未见情形下保持既定安全要求，包括在其无法完成所请求任务之时。安全保护必须考虑跨动作与任务持续存在的上下文和交互。在这篇立场论文中，我们检视现有安全方法为何无法提供这种保护：保护可能因上下文被误解、既往交互被忽视，或停止与恢复策略在陌生条件下变得不安全而失效。因此我们提出一个研究议程：规格化、学习并落地安全要求，用可靠的恢复机制执行它们，并评估此类保护的泛化能力。我们呼吁家用机器人的安全保护在超出其训练与开发所用的情形、上下文与历史时仍然可靠，以实现开放世界安全。
summary_cn: 立场论文：主张家用机器人「开放世界安全」——在未见情形下保持既定安全要求，提出规格化、学习、落地与评估安全保护泛化的研究议程。
objective_summary: 以立场论文形式论证家用机器人需要「开放世界安全」，分析现有安全方法在上下文误解、交互历史与停止/恢复策略上的失效路径，并提出相应研究议程。
evidence_note: 纯立场与概念论证，无实验、数据或量化证据。
novelty_note: 把「开放世界安全」确立为家用机器人安全的研究问题，指出三类具体失效路径并给出议程结构，属有价值的问题表述；无新技术机制。
scope: 面向基础模型驱动的具身家用机器人安全议程；不涉及具体算法、度量或定量结论。
limitations: 无经验证据支持其失效分析；安全要求如何规格化与度量未给出方案；未覆盖对抗性攻击场景。

title: Argos: A Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture for Distributed Edge Security Orchestration
abstract: The growing adoption of distributed edge devices for security auditing and operational monitoring exposes limitations in lightweight control mechanisms traditionally used to manage such nodes. While commercial Command-and-Control (C2) platforms offer advanced orchestration features, their licensing constraints, operational complexity, and proprietary nature limit accessibility for small and medium-sized enterprises and research environments. This paper presents Argos, a multi-tenant SaaS C2 architecture designed for transparent, automated, and long-term orchestration of distributed edge devices. The framework implements a structured control plane with role-based access control (RBAC), tenant isolation, persistent task management, and cron-based workflow automation. Unlike operator-driven or stateless execution models, Argos enables scheduled and autonomous coordination of security tasks across heterogeneous environments. To formally substantiate its isolation guarantees, the platform is modeled through a set-theoretic authorization framework, and a tenant non-interference property is proven. The proposed architecture was evaluated across three geographically distributed edge devices, executing 810 automated tasks mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Results demonstrate a global failure rate of 3.33% (95% Wilson confidence interval: [2.30%, 4.81%]) with no statistically significant difference across ARM and x86 architectures (\c{hi} 2 = 1.55, p = 0.21), and stable operation under heterogeneous latency conditions, including intercontinental deployments. To ensure scientific transparency and reproducibility, the evaluation methodology, sanitized datasets, and statistical scripts have been made publicly available in an open-source repository.

title_cn: Argos：面向分布式边缘安全编排的多租户 SaaS 架构
abstract_cn: 分布式边缘设备在安全审计与运行监控中的日益普及，暴露了传统轻量级控制机制在管理此类节点上的局限。商业 C2（命令与控制）平台虽具备高级编排能力，但其许可限制、运维复杂度和专有性质使中小企业与研究环境难以使用。本文提出 Argos，一个多租户 SaaS C2 架构，用于对分布式边缘设备进行透明、自动化、长期的编排。该框架实现了结构化控制平面，包含基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）、租户隔离、持久化任务管理与基于 cron 的工作流自动化。不同于操作员驱动或无状态执行模型，Argos 支持跨异构环境的定时与自主安全任务协调。为形式化支撑其隔离保证，平台通过集合论授权框架建模，并证明租户非干扰性质。该架构在三个地理分布的边缘设备上评估，执行 810 个映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 技术的自动化任务。结果显示全局失败率 3.33%（95% Wilson 置信区间 [2.30%, 4.81%]），ARM 与 x86 架构间无统计显著差异（χ²=1.55，p=0.21），并在包括洲际部署在内的异构延迟条件下稳定运行。为科学透明与可复现，评估方法、脱敏数据集与统计脚本已在开源仓库公开。
summary_cn: Argos：多租户 SaaS C2 架构编排边缘安全设备，集合论证明租户非干扰；3 台边缘设备 810 个 ATT&CK 任务失败率 3.33%（Wilson 95% CI [2.30%, 4.81%]）。
objective_summary: 构建开源多租户 SaaS C2 平台 Argos，实现 RBAC、租户隔离与定时任务编排，用集合论授权框架证明租户非干扰，并在三台地理分布边缘设备上量化任务失败率与跨架构稳定性。
evidence_note: 真实部署 3 台边缘设备、810 个自动化任务，报告 Wilson 置信区间与 χ² 检验（p=0.21），有租户非干扰证明；但规模小、无外部系统对比。
novelty_note: C2 编排、RBAC、多租户隔离均为成熟技术与商业产品的既有能力；新意主要是面向安全编排场景的开源工程化组合与形式化非干扰证明。
scope: 结论适用于小规模边缘设备编队与中等任务量的编排场景；未评估大规模多租户、对抗性租户与真实攻击负载下的隔离与性能。
limitations: 评估仅 3 台设备、自建任务集；非干扰证明基于理想化集合论模型；未与商业 C2 平台定量对比。

title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
abstract: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.

title_cn: AI 模型可以可证地隐藏任意能力
abstract_cn: 能力评估旨在在部署前暴露危险模型行为，但其可靠性取决于隐藏能力可被引出的假设。我们展示该假设在对抗条件下不成立：构造把加密神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重的后门攻击，仅在收到秘密触发时解密并执行。借助数字锁藏器（digital lockers），这些隐藏电路在密码学假设下被证明难以引出与解释，即使拥有对模型权重的完全访问——把已有工作从隐藏固定字符串扩展到任意计算。我们在 PyTorch 中实现概念验证构造，并在一个小型化学反应预测任务（CBRN 相关能力的代理）上通过微调、权重加噪、梯度触发搜索与潜在对抗训练评估引出。我们的结果展示对这些方法的抵抗，并结合密码学保证揭示基于引出的能力审计的一个极限。我们发布模型以支持防御改进。
summary_cn: 以数字锁藏器把加密神经网络藏入模型权重的后门，密码学假设下证明难以引出：微调/加噪/触发搜索/潜在对抗训练均失效，揭示引出式能力审计的可证极限。
objective_summary: 提出把加密神经网络作为后门嵌入宿主模型权重、以秘密触发解密执行的构造，在密码学假设下证明隐藏能力难以被引出与解释，并在化学反应预测代理任务上实证四种引出方法的失效。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 录用；密码学假设下的可证性加 PyTorch 概念验证，以及微调、权重加噪、梯度触发搜索、潜在对抗训练四种引出方法的系统失效实验。
novelty_note: 把模型内隐藏从固定字符串推广到任意计算并给出可证不可引出保证，从构造层面证明「基于引出的能力审计存在原则性极限」，开辟新的威胁模型。
scope: 结论适用于以引出（微调、探测、对抗训练）为主要手段的能力评估范式；概念验证限于小型任务，构造开销与大型模型的实用性未量化。
limitations: 概念验证在小型化学反应预测任务上评估，未在大型模型上验证构造与开销；密码学保证的强度依赖数字锁藏器底层假设；发布模型本身可能被复用于隐藏能力。

title: Decision-Focused Learning for Cyber-Physical Risk-Aware Power Grid Operations
abstract: Power grid cyber-physical security requires intrusion detection methods that account for the operational consequences of detection errors. However, the existing intrusion detection approaches primarily focus on the predictive performance of learning algorithms, while downstream operational costs are often optimized independently, which can lead to inferior operational performance. To help alleviate this problem, we propose a novel optimization-learning cyber-physical-risk-informed framework that communicates iteratively to minimize power grid operational costs. This framework translates machine learning prediction errors into power grid operational cyber-physical-risk costs. Experimental results on two power grid operation datasets, Industrial Control System (ICS) Cyber Attack and Sherlock, show that the proposed approach improves power grid operation costs compared with the traditional approach.
title_cn: 面向网络物理风险感知电网运营的决策聚焦学习
abstract_cn: 电网网络物理安全需要考虑检测错误运营后果的入侵检测方法。然而现有入侵检测方法主要关注学习算法的预测性能，而下游运营成本常被独立优化，这可能导致较差的运营表现。为帮助缓解这一问题，我们提出一个新颖的优化-学习网络物理风险感知框架，通过迭代通信最小化电网运营成本。该框架把机器学习预测误差转化为电网运营网络物理风险成本。在两个电网运营数据集——工业控制系统（ICS）网络攻击与 Sherlock——上的实验结果显示，所提方法相较传统方法改善电网运营成本。
summary_cn: 把 IDS 预测误差转化为电网运营风险成本并迭代优化-学习：在 ICS Cyber Attack 与 Sherlock 数据集上较传统方法降低运营成本。
objective_summary: 提出将机器学习预测误差映射为电网网络物理风险成本的决策聚焦学习框架，通过优化与学习迭代通信以最小化运营成本，并在 ICS Cyber Attack 与 Sherlock 两个数据集上与传统方法对比。
evidence_note: 两个公开 ICS 数据集（ICS Cyber Attack、Sherlock）上与传统方法的对比实验；摘要未报告具体成本降幅、无消融与统计检验。
novelty_note: 决策聚焦学习为已有范式，本文新意在其向电网入侵检测运营成本场景的适配与优化-学习迭代框架设计。
scope: 结论适用于所测两个 ICS 数据集代表的电网监控场景；风险成本模型的具体形式与真实电网调度系统的集成未验证。
limitations: 仅两个基准数据集、单一传统基线；成本转化模型依赖对电网运营代价的建模假设；未报告计算开销与模型规模敏感性。

title: ToFu: Exploiting and Fuzzing the LLM-Orchestrator-Tool Trust Boundary
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that interact with external software through tools, with an orchestration layer translating model outputs into structured tool invocations. This architecture creates an LLM-orchestrator-tool trust boundary where tool semantics may go unenforced and LLM-generated arguments may be incorrectly treated as trusted. We present ToFu, a tool-aware framework that automatically derives semantic security checks for LLM tools from their existing metadata and a CWE-guided sanitizer corpus. ToFu specializes these checks to individual tools and automatically generates fuzzing harnesses and semantic oracles using runtime introspection and outcome sanitization. We evaluated ToFu across 273 MCP servers containing 3405 tools and identified verified bugs corresponding to CWE weakness classes in 343 tools across 118 of the servers. Our findings show that real-world tools frequently fail to enforce their documented input semantics, making it unsafe to treat LLM-generated arguments as trusted.
comment: 33 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Evaluates 273 open-source MCP servers (3405 tools); 253 verified semantic security bugs in 118 servers. Appendices include a case study, a Repeat-After-Me transcript on LangGraph, the full sanitizer corpus, the list of evaluated repositories, and the verbatim LLM prompts
title_cn: ToFu：利用并模糊测试 LLM-编排器-工具信任边界
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署为经由工具与外部软件交互的智能体，由编排层把模型输出翻译为结构化工具调用。这一架构创造了 LLM-编排器-工具信任边界：工具语义可能不被执行，LLM 生成的参数可能被错误地当作可信。我们提出 ToFu，一个工具感知框架，从工具既有元数据与 CWE 引导的清洗器语料自动导出 LLM 工具的语义安全检查。ToFu 把这些检查特化到单个工具，并利用运行时内省与结果清洗自动生成模糊测试 harness 与语义 oracle。我们在包含 3405 个工具的 273 个 MCP 服务器上评估 ToFu，在 118 个服务器的 343 个工具中识别出与 CWE 弱点类别对应的经验证漏洞。我们的发现表明，真实世界工具频繁不执行其文档化的输入语义，把 LLM 生成的参数当作可信是不安全的。
summary_cn: ToFu 从 MCP 工具元数据自动导出语义安全检查并生成模糊测试 harness：273 服务器 3405 工具中在 118 个服务器的 343 个工具发现经验证漏洞。
objective_summary: 提出从工具元数据与 CWE 引导清洗器语料派生语义检查并自动生成模糊测试 harness 与语义 oracle 的工具感知框架 ToFu，对 273 个 MCP 服务器 3405 个工具做系统模糊测试与漏洞验证。
evidence_note: 大规模真实语料：273 个开源 MCP 服务器、3405 个工具，118 个服务器 343 个工具中的漏洞经验证（评论注明 253 个经验证语义安全缺陷），附案例研究与完整清洗器语料。
novelty_note: 首次对 LLM-编排器-工具信任边界做系统化语义模糊测试：从元数据自动派生检查、自动生成 harness 与 oracle 的方法链为该方向首个端到端框架，并以大规模经验证缺陷确立问题规模。
scope: 结论适用于暴露元数据、可被编排层调用的 MCP 类工具生态；闭源私有工具与 CWE 之外的逻辑业务缺陷类别未覆盖。
limitations: 语义检查派生依赖元数据质量，文档缺失的工具覆盖不足；验证以 CWE 类别对应为准，严重度分级未量化；对修复建议与防御集成未展开。

title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
abstract: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications. These environments create safety risks that are difficult to capture with attacks placed at a single, known read location. We introduce APEX-Harm, a benchmark for evaluating prompt and script injection against long-horizon agents performing finance, consulting, and legal tasks in large workspaces. Each task contains 115 to 328 files, together with email, calendar, chat, document, spreadsheet, PDF, and code-execution tools exposed through MCP servers. The benchmark includes six attack categories covering static and dynamic injections, task-specific script replacement, and attacker-provided generic scripts, and evaluates attack success, exposure, and task performance. We evaluate 12 frontier models on 180 task instances per model. Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 have the lowest overall attack success rates (8% and 20%), while task-specific script replacement and attacker-provided generic script attacks remain substantially more effective, averaging 81-84% and 73% attack success, respectively. Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the highest mean task score (0.877) while still exhibiting a 33% attack success rate. These results show that completing the requested task is not sufficient evidence of safe behavior: an agent can produce a correct deliverable while also performing an unauthorized action in the workspace.
title_cn: APEX-Harm：在共享专业工作区中评估智能体安全
abstract_cn: 专业智能体越来越多地通过命令行接口与多种工具在包含文件、消息与业务应用的共享工作区中工作。这些环境造成的安全风险难以用放置在单一已知读取位置的攻击来捕捉。我们介绍 APEX-Harm，一个评估针对在大型工作区中执行金融、咨询与法律任务的长期智能体的提示与脚本注入的基准。每个任务包含 115 到 328 个文件，以及经由 MCP 服务器暴露的邮件、日历、聊天、文档、电子表格、PDF 与代码执行工具。该基准包括六个攻击类别，覆盖静态与动态注入、任务特定脚本替换与攻击者提供的通用脚本，并评估攻击成功、暴露与任务性能。我们对每模型 180 个任务实例的 12 个前沿模型进行评估。Opus 5 与 Sonnet 5 的总体攻击成功率最低（8% 与 20%），而任务特定脚本替换与攻击者提供的通用脚本攻击仍然有效得多，平均攻击成功率分别为 81–84% 与 73%。Gemini 3.8 Flash 达到最高平均任务分（0.877），同时仍有 33% 的攻击成功率。这些结果表明完成所请求的任务不是安全行为的充分证据：智能体可以在产出正确交付物的同时在工作区中执行未授权动作。
summary_cn: APEX-Harm 以 115–328 文件的共享工作区与 MCP 工具评估长期智能体注入：12 个前沿模型中脚本替换/通用脚本攻击成功率达 81–84%/73%，完成任务不等于安全。
objective_summary: 构建大型共享工作区场景下的提示与脚本注入基准 APEX-Harm，含六类攻击与攻击成功/暴露/任务性能三重指标，并对 12 个前沿模型各 180 个任务实例做系统评估。
evidence_note: 12 个前沿模型 × 每模型 180 个任务实例、六类攻击、攻击成功/暴露/任务性能三重指标的系统评估，报告各模型具体成功率与任务分。
novelty_note: 智能体提示注入基准已有多个（多为单点读取位置场景），本文把评估扩展到多文件共享工作区与长期专业任务并纳入脚本级攻击类别，属场景与规模上的实质扩展。
scope: 结论适用于具备 CLI/MCP 工具与文件系统访问的长期智能体；覆盖金融/咨询/法律三类任务场景，其他垂直领域与防御机制的效果未评估。
limitations: 攻击为研究者构造，未覆盖自适应多轮社工；评估依赖自动化判分，边界情形可能误判；12 个模型均为特定时点版本，结论随模型迭代过时。

title: A Systematic Study of Security Enforcement at Android Inter-Component Boundaries
abstract: Android's inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms (Activities, Services, BroadcastReceivers, ContentProviders, and URI scheme handlers) form the primary interface between applications and between applications and the system. We present a systematic study of security enforcement comprising 120 evaluations (99 inter-component interface evaluations across five interface categories, 10 platform security-control evaluations, and 11 dedicated positive controls) in over 30 Google and AOSP packages on Android 17 (API 37). Using an expected-versus-observed framework under a zero-permission attacker model, we evaluate whether each boundary's enforcement mechanism functions as designed. We find 97 enforcement gaps (80.8%) and 23 enforcement holds (19.2%). From these observations, we derive a 14-category enforcement gap taxonomy organized across manifest, code, platform, and architectural layers. Within our purposively selected corpus, observed enforcement outcomes differ substantially across interface categories: evaluated Activities and BroadcastReceivers exhibit a 100% gap rate, while ContentProviders, which benefit from framework-provided defenses such as setStrict(), achieve a 27.6% holds rate. We find that all seven evaluated platform compatibility changes with security intent are either disabled or gated at a targetSdkVersion that none of the applications in our evaluated corpus targets. We document 18 custom URI scheme registrations handling sensitive data (authentication tokens, payment credentials, medical information) despite the known unverifiability of custom schemes (RFC 8252 Section 8.1). Our study includes 23 positive controls, calibration cases demonstrating that the evaluation procedure distinguishes functioning enforcement from observed enforcement failures.
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables; appendix indexes all 120 evaluations
title_cn: Android 组件间边界安全执行的系统性研究
abstract_cn: Android 的进程间通信（IPC）机制（Activity、Service、BroadcastReceiver、ContentProvider 与 URI scheme handler）构成应用之间以及应用与系统之间的主要接口。我们呈现一项包含 120 次评估的安全执行系统性研究（跨五个接口类别的 99 次组件间接口评估、10 次平台安全控制评估与 11 次专门阳性对照），覆盖 Android 17（API 37）上超过 30 个 Google 与 AOSP 包。使用零权限攻击者模型下的「预期对观测」框架，我们评估每个边界的执行机制是否如设计运作。我们发现 97 个执行缺口（80.8%）与 23 个执行保持（19.2%）。从这些观察中，我们归纳出横跨 manifest、代码、平台与架构四个层的 14 类执行缺口分类法。在我们目的性选取的语料内，观测到的执行结果在接口类别间差异显著：被评估的 Activity 与 BroadcastReceiver 呈现 100% 缺口率，而受益于 setStrict() 等框架防御的 ContentProvider 达到 27.6% 的保持率。我们发现七个被评估的带安全意图的平台兼容性变更全部被禁用或门控在语料中无应用瞄准的 targetSdkVersion 上。我们记录了 18 个处理敏感数据（认证令牌、支付凭证、医疗信息）的自定义 URI scheme 注册，尽管自定义 scheme 的不可验证性已知（RFC 8252 第 8.1 节）。我们的研究包含 23 个阳性对照——校准案例，证明评估流程能区分正常运作的执行与观测到的执行失败。
summary_cn: Android 17 上对 30+ Google/AOSP 包做 120 次组件间边界评估：80.8% 执行缺口，Activity/BroadcastReceiver 缺口率 100%，平台安全变更全部失效或被门控。
objective_summary: 以预期对观测框架与零权限攻击者模型系统评估 Android 17 五类 IPC 边界与平台控制的安全执行，辅以阳性对照校准，并归纳执行缺口分类法与敏感数据暴露模式。
evidence_note: 120 次系统评估（99 接口 + 10 平台控制 + 11 阳性对照）、30+ Google/AOSP 包、Android 17 实测，附录索引全部评估；阳性对照保证方法效度。
novelty_note: Android IPC 与组件暴露安全已有长期研究，本文新意在于对 Android 17 的系统重测、跨接口类别的量化对比（100% 缺口对 27.6% 保持）与平台兼容性安全变更失效的发现。
scope: 结论适用于 Android 17（API 37）上 30+ Google/AOSP 包与零权限攻击者模型；目的性抽样语料，缺口率不可直接外推到全生态第三方应用。
limitations: 语料为目的性选取，覆盖面不代表全生态；部分执行缺口可能为文档化权衡而非缺陷；未评估缺口在真实恶意应用中的实际利用频率。

title: EviRepair: Evidence-Driven Agents for Reliable Vulnerability Repair
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agent-based approaches for repository-level automated vulnerability repair (AVR), showing promising repair capabilities. However, an important issue has received limited attention: how can we ensure that the evidence generated during the repair process is reliable enough to support accurate vulnerability understanding and patch generation? In this paper, we propose EviRepair, an evidence-driven multi-agent framework for repository-level AVR. EviRepair introduces evidence review into the repair process by enabling agents to collaboratively collect vulnerability evidence, verify evidence consistency, and construct a reviewed vulnerability model for patch synthesis and validation. Extensive experiments on PatchEval and SecBench benchmarks with multiple agent frameworks and LLMs demonstrate that EviRepair consistently outperforms existing agent-based baselines, achieving average improvements of 16.37% and 40.33% in resolved rates on PatchEval and SecBench, respectively. Codes are available at https://github.com/lly-s/EviRepair
title_cn: EviRepair：面向可靠漏洞修复的证据驱动智能体
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使基于智能体的仓库级自动化漏洞修复（AVR）方法成为可能，展现出有前景的修复能力。然而一个重要问题受到的关注有限：如何确保修复过程中生成的证据足够可靠以支持准确的漏洞理解与补丁生成？在本文中，我们提出 EviRepair，一个证据驱动的多智能体仓库级 AVR 框架。EviRepair 通过让智能体协作收集漏洞证据、验证证据一致性并构建经审查的漏洞模型用于补丁合成与验证，把证据审查引入修复过程。在 PatchEval 与 SecBench 基准上用多个智能体框架与 LLM 进行的广泛实验表明，EviRepair 持续优于现有基于智能体的基线，在 PatchEval 与 SecBench 上解决率平均提升 16.37% 与 40.33%。代码发布于 GitHub（lly-s/EviRepair）。
summary_cn: 证据驱动的多智能体漏洞修复 EviRepair：协作收集并交叉验证漏洞证据后再合成补丁，PatchEval/SecBench 解决率平均提升 16.37% 与 40.33%，代码开源。
objective_summary: 提出在仓库级自动化漏洞修复中加入证据收集、一致性验证与经审查漏洞模型的多智能体框架 EviRepair，并在 PatchEval 与 SecBench 上以多个智能体框架与 LLM 对比基线。
evidence_note: PatchEval 与 SecBench 双基准、多智能体框架与多 LLM 的系统对比，解决率平均提升 16.37%/40.33%，代码开源可复算。
novelty_note: 多智能体 AVR 已有多个框架，本文新意在于把「证据可靠性」作为核心问题，引入证据审查与一致性验证阶段；整体为已有智能体流水线上的机制增量。
scope: 结论适用于 PatchEval/SecBench 类仓库级漏洞修复任务与所测智能体框架/LLM 组合；对超大型仓库与其他语言生态未评估。
limitations: 提升幅度依赖所选 LLM 与框架组合；证据审查引入的额外推理开销未在摘要量化；基准中漏洞类型分布可能偏向可证据化类别。

title: Towards Safe World Models: Risks, Defenses, and Evaluation
abstract: World models support planning, control, learning from imagined experience, and model-mediated evaluation by predicting action-conditioned consequences. Their safety cannot be inferred from predictive accuracy alone: errors in observations, state and memory, dynamics, evaluation, execution, or feedback can propagate into unsafe decisions and persist through updates. This work organizes the literature on world-model safety around a six-stage lifecycle covering data and observations, state and memory, dynamics and imagination, evaluation and planning, action and control, and feedback and update. We synthesize non-adversarial failures, attacks, defenses, evaluation protocols, benchmarks, and deployment conditions, and distinguish evidence directness from outcome level. The current evidence corpus contains 163 cited works. We use the framework to identify where claims are supported, where attribution remains unresolved, and which measurements are needed to connect model-level behavior to closed-loop and operational safety.
comment: 55 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: 迈向安全的世界模型：风险、防御与评估
abstract_cn: 世界模型通过预测动作条件下的后果来支持规划、控制、从想象经验中学习与模型介导的评估。它们的安全性不能仅由预测精度推断：观察、状态与记忆、动态、评估、执行或反馈中的错误会传播为不安全决策并在更新中持续。本工作围绕覆盖数据与观察、状态与记忆、动态与想象、评估与规划、动作与控制、反馈与更新的六阶段生命周期组织世界模型安全文献。我们综合非对抗失效、攻击、防御、评估协议、基准与部署条件，并区分证据直接性与结果层级。当前证据语料包含 163 篇被引工作。我们用该框架识别主张得到支持之处、归因仍未解决之处，以及把模型层行为与闭环和运行安全联系起来所需的测量。
summary_cn: 综述 163 篇文献并按六阶段生命周期组织世界模型安全研究：失效、攻击、防御、评估与部署条件，指出归因空白与连接模型层到运行层安全所需的测量。
objective_summary: 以六阶段生命周期框架系统综合世界模型安全的非对抗失效、攻击、防御、评估协议与部署条件文献，区分证据直接性与结果层级并识别开放测量需求。
evidence_note: 覆盖 163 篇被引工作的系统综述，给出统一生命周期分类与证据直接性/结果层级区分；综述型工作，无新实验。
novelty_note: 世界模型安全此前散见于具身智能与智能体安全文献，本综述首次按生命周期系统化该方向，并明确归因空白与测量议程。
scope: 结论适用于以动作条件预测为核心的世界模型（规划、控制、想象学习、模型评估）；对无显式世界模型的端到端策略仅间接相关。
limitations: 证据语料止于综述时点（163 篇），快速演进领域可能迅速过时；「归因未解决」多为定性判断；未提供统一基准或量化对比。

title: Secrets in Preamble: Practical and Robust PHY Information Hiding for Wi-Fi
abstract: Physical layer (PHY) information hiding refers to the concealment of secrets within PHY waveforms without compromising the integrity of the primary communication link, thereby enabling critical applications such as covert communication, PHY steganography, and watermarking. The widespread deployment of Wi-Fi has motivated substantial research interest in hiding secrets within Wi-Fi waveforms. However, existing Wi-Fi information hiding approaches suffer from two limitations: restricted steganographic capacity and insufficient robustness against environmental variations, both of which severely constrain practical deployment. This work proposes to embed secrets within the Wi-Fi legacy short training field (L-STF). The designed method preserves the autocorrelation properties of Wi-Fi L-STF, ensuring that packet detection and coarse frequency offset compensation functionalities remain uncompromised. The secret embedding and extraction processes employ a pair of neural networks designed to learn optimal embedding rules and maximize steganographic capacity. We developed a prototype system and conducted comprehensive experiments across both indoor and outdoor environments. Experimental results show that our method can reliably embed 46 secret bits within Wi-Fi packets across diverse channel conditions, achieving significantly enhanced steganographic capacity and environmental robustness. The hardware prototype study validates the feasibility of the proposed Wi-Fi information hiding scheme.
title_cn: 前导码中的秘密：实用鲁棒的 Wi-Fi PHY 信息隐藏
abstract_cn: 物理层（PHY）信息隐藏指在不损害主通信链路完整性的前提下把秘密隐藏于 PHY 波形中，从而支持隐蔽通信、PHY 隐写与水印等关键应用。Wi-Fi 的广泛部署激发了在 Wi-Fi 波形中隐藏秘密的大量研究兴趣。然而现有 Wi-Fi 信息隐藏方法存在两个局限：受限的隐写容量与对环境变化不足的鲁棒性，两者都严重制约实际部署。本工作提出把秘密嵌入 Wi-Fi 传统短训练字段（L-STF）。所设计方法保持 Wi-Fi L-STF 的自相关特性，确保包检测与粗频偏补偿功能不受损害。秘密嵌入与提取过程采用一对神经网络，学习最优嵌入规则并最大化隐写容量。我们开发原型系统并在室内与室外环境进行综合实验。实验结果显示，我们的方法能在多样信道条件下可靠地在 Wi-Fi 包中嵌入 46 个秘密比特，隐写容量与环境鲁棒性显著增强。硬件原型研究验证了所提 Wi-Fi 信息隐藏方案的可行性。
summary_cn: 把秘密嵌入 Wi-Fi L-STF 前导码并保自相关特性：神经网络编解码原型在室内外多样信道可靠嵌入 46 比特/包，包检测与频偏补偿功能不受损。
objective_summary: 提出嵌入 Wi-Fi L-STF 的 PHY 信息隐藏方法，以保持自相关特性保护包检测与频偏补偿功能，用神经网络对学习嵌入/提取规则，并通过室内外硬件原型实验验证容量与鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 硬件原型在室内外真实环境多信道条件下实测，可靠嵌入 46 比特/包并验证主链路功能不受损。
novelty_note: Wi-Fi PHY 信息隐藏已有系列工作，本文新意在选择 L-STF 字段嵌入并兼顾自相关约束与神经网络容量优化，属已有方向上容量与鲁棒性的实质性改进。
scope: 结论适用于 802.11 L-STF 结构与所测室内外信道；对其他 PHY 标准、以隐写分析为目标的主动检测攻击未评估。
limitations: 46 比特/包容量仍有限；对隐写分析类主动攻击的鲁棒性未报告；高速移动场景与强多径下的表现未测试。

title: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
abstract: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.
