title_cn: ECGWmark：心电图信号的深度水印
abstract_cn: 心电（ECG）信号的安全传输仍是远程心脏病学的主要挑战。传统数学水印可以把患者元数据直接嵌入 ECG 信号，但面对环形相移等时间去同步高度脆弱。相比之下，面向时间信号的现有深度水印方法（如音频）通常依赖有损量化，会损害对临床诊断至关重要的高频微形态细节。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出 ECGWmark，一个面向医学时间序列的全卷积、无量化的深度水印框架。ECGWmark 在连续、全分辨率的潜空间中运行，并利用局部化帧级机制提升对严重去同步的鲁棒性。关键的是，我们引入由临床分类器引导的可微生理损失来保留诊断语义。在基准 MIT-BIH 数据库上的实验显示，ECGWmark 在所评估的环形时间移位下保持 90% 以上的通道比特提取准确率。此外，在严格的患者间诊断评估下，Class-V 敏感度从 71.97% 变为 76.50%，而 Macro-F1 从 35.25% 变为 34.71%，Class-S 敏感度从 8.89% 变为 1.39%；这些结果显示混合的类别级影响。
summary_cn: 无量化的全卷积 ECG 深度水印：MIT-BIH 上环形移位下通道比特提取 >90%，可微生理损失保留诊断语义，但 Class-S 敏感度由 8.89% 降至 1.39%。
objective_summary: 提出面向医学时间序列的全卷积无量化水印框架 ECGWmark，以帧级局部化机制抗时间去同步、以临床分类器引导的可微生理损失保留诊断语义，并在 MIT-BIH 患者间协议下评估鲁棒性与诊断影响。
evidence_note: 在基准 MIT-BIH 上按患者间协议评估，报告环形移位鲁棒性（>90% 比特准确率）与类别级诊断影响（V/S 类敏感度、Macro-F1 如实报告混合结果）。
novelty_note: 深度音频水印已有成熟工作，本文把无量化的连续潜空间水印迁移到医学时间序列并加入临床引导损失与帧级抗移位机制，属新领域应用加损失设计的组合。
scope: 结论适用于单导联 ECG 与 MIT-BIH 类数据；其他生理信号、采样率与真实远程监护信道未评估。
limitations: Class-S 敏感度从 8.89% 降至 1.39%，类别级诊断影响为混合且含负面结果（作者如实报告）；仅在 MIT-BIH 上验证；对压缩、降噪等临床链路失真未覆盖。

title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
abstract: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.
comment: Preprint, under review
title_cn: LETHE：经由值多样性坍缩防御未授权图生视频生成
abstract_cn: 图生视频（I2V）扩散模型可以把单张参考图动画化为高质量、主体一致的视频，带来滥用威胁：任何人都能不经同意把个人照片变成伪造视频。一个有前景的解决方案是在发布前主动向图像添加对抗扰动，使由它生成的视频不忠实或视觉损坏。然而由于对现代 I2V 模型中后续帧如何读取参考图的支配机制理解不足，现有保护难以在常见扰动预算下提供强保护。在本文中我们通过探究这一底层读取机制来切入问题。通过凸几何分析，我们在理论上识别参考值向量的散布是支配该读取过程的关键因素，并经验发现即使轻微收缩这一散布也能严重退化生成的视频，使其成为高效的保护杠杆。受此洞察指导，我们提出 LETHE，一种直接破坏该读取过程的新保护方法。LETHE 配对两个互补目标：值坍缩目标驱动参考值向量趋同，注意力吸引目标把后续帧引向这些坍缩 token 以放大损坏。我们进一步构建两个以人为中心的 I2V 保护基准，并用多个现代 I2V 模型进行广泛实验，证明 LETHE 的最先进保护性能与通用性。
summary_cn: 揭示 I2V 模型后续帧读取参考图的值散布机制，提出值坍缩加注意力吸引的保护性扰动 LETHE，在两个自建基准与多个 I2V 模型上达到 SOTA 防护。
objective_summary: 通过凸几何分析识别参考值向量散布对 I2V 后续帧读取过程的决定作用，提出值坍缩与注意力吸引双目标的对抗扰动方法 LETHE，并构建两个人本 I2V 保护基准做多模型评估。
evidence_note: 凸几何理论分析加多个现代 I2V 模型、两个自建人本基准的广泛实验；基准自建、无统计检验，处于 under review 状态。
novelty_note: 保护性扰动对抗生成滥用已有较多工作（反个性化等），本文新意在于 I2V 场景下对「帧如何读取参考图」的机制分析与针对性的值坍缩目标设计。
scope: 结论适用于所评估的现代 I2V 扩散模型与图像域保护；对视频域直接扰动、未来架构变化及强自适应净化攻击未验证。
limitations: 两个基准为作者自建，人口与场景多样性有限；常见扰动预算之外的更强攻击者与图像净化预处理未评估；扰动强度与视觉质量退化的权衡未细化。

title: Quantization-Tolerant Gradient Auditing for Active Inference-Attack Detection in Federated Learning
abstract: Inside a federated learning system a participant can quietly study the shared model and learn about others' private data. The usual defense, differential privacy, often adds so much noise that the model is no longer worth training. In cross-silo FL, where participants are a few accountable organizations and the server is trusted, we ask whether the server can instead interrogate clients. Each round it sends a secret challenge batch and asks every client to return a checksum of the gradient that batch induces, together with a timing. A client that mutated the model state, as an active generative-adversarial-network discriminator attacker does, returns a wrong checksum. We make this checksum robust to benign cross-platform floating-point non-determinism with a quantized fingerprint compared under a small tolerance. It flags two distinct active attacks at a true-positive rate of $1.0$ with no false positives on the checksum axis, stable across the fingerprint's parameters and up to $50$ clients at malicious ratios to $40\%$, for $32\,\mathrm{ms}$ of server work and $4.35\,\mathrm{kB}$ per response. Against a purely passive attacker the only signal is timing, and it is not robust: a cohort-relative test detects only in low-jitter conditions while a false-positive-free per-client baseline is blind, so no configuration delivers both. An attacker that answers the challenge on an untouched copy of the model while tampering with a replica evades the audit entirely. Therefore the checksum is a reliable in-band signal against attackers that do not decouple the audited computation from the attacked one, and it composes with differential privacy, whose accuracy cost we quantify on Texas100, rather than replacing it.
title_cn: 面向联邦学习主动推理攻击检测的量化容错梯度审计
abstract_cn: 在联邦学习系统内，参与者可以悄悄研究共享模型并了解他人的私有数据。常见防御差分隐私常添加太多噪声以致模型不再值得训练。在参与者为少数可问责组织、服务器可信的 cross-silo 联邦学习中，我们问服务器能否改为质询客户端。每轮它发送一个秘密挑战批次，并要求每个客户端返回该批次诱导梯度的校验和及一个时间。像主动生成对抗判别器攻击者那样篡改模型状态的客户端会返回错误校验和。我们通过在小容差下比较的量化指纹使该校验和对良性的跨平台浮点非确定性鲁棒。它在校验和轴上以 1.0 的真阳性率与零假阳性标记两种不同的主动攻击，且在指纹参数与至多 50 个客户端、恶意比例至 40% 下保持稳定，服务器开销 32 毫秒、每响应 4.35 kB。对纯被动攻击者唯一信号是时序，且不鲁棒：群组相对检验只能在低抖动条件下检测，而无假阳性的每客户端基线则完全失明，没有任何配置能两者兼得。在模型未动副本上应答挑战而在另一副本上篡改的攻击者可完全绕过审计。因此校验和是对不把被审计计算与被攻击计算解耦的攻击者可靠的带内信号，且与差分隐私互补（我们在 Texas100 上量化其精度代价）而非替代。
summary_cn: 服务器以秘密挑战批次的量化梯度校验和审计 FL 客户端：TPR 1.0 且零假阳性，50 客户端/40% 恶意下稳定，32 ms/4.35 kB 开销；副本解耦攻击可绕过。
objective_summary: 提出跨机构联邦学习中的挑战—应答梯度审计机制，以量化指纹容忍浮点非确定性检测篡改模型状态的主动攻击者，系统评估检出率、被动攻击的时序信号极限与差分隐私的组合代价。
evidence_note: 受控实验报告 TPR 1.0/零假阳性、至多 50 客户端与 40% 恶意比例、两种主动攻击与被动攻击时序检验，另在 Texas100 上量化 DP 组合代价；单一 FL 设定、无真实部署。
novelty_note: 挑战—应答式梯度审计加量化容错校验和属新机制，但威胁模型（可信服务器 cross-silo）与构造思路较传统；对解耦攻击不可行的负面结果有诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于服务器可信、参与者可问责的 cross-silo 联邦学习；对无可信中介的 cross-device 联邦或以副本解耦方式绕过审计的强自适应攻击不提供保护。
limitations: 在未动副本上应答挑战的解耦攻击可完全绕过审计（作者自陈）；被动攻击检测无鲁棒配置；需客户端配合返回校验和，恶意客户端可拒绝参与。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Cross-Session Attacks via Persistent Artifacts in Agent Skill Composition
abstract: Agent skills extend the capabilities of AI agents by bundling instructions, code, and resources into reusable packages. During skill execution, agents may produce or modify artifacts, such as files, configurations, and cached data, that are reused by other skills in later sessions. Since these artifacts can persist across sessions and later be accessed by other skills, they introduce a new attack surface that can be exploited to influence subsequent executions. However, the security risks arising from such cross-session skill interactions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate cross-session composition attacks in skill-based AI agents and develop a runtime defense against them. Specifically, we characterize three attack mechanisms, namely Instruction Propagation (IP), Data Boundary Violation (DBV), and Evidence Poisoning (EP), through which malicious effects propagate across skill executions via persistent artifacts. To evaluate whether existing agents can resist these attacks while completing legitimate tasks, we construct SkillRelayBench, a benchmark of 270 adversarial cases drawn from 30 cross-session skill-composition scenarios across ten domains. Our evaluation of seven models across Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude Code reveals attack success rates (ASR) ranging from 46.7% to 77.4% and attack chain success rates (ACSR) ranging from 35.6% to 61.1%. Successful attack chains cover all five target security consequence categories, highlighting the broad impact of these attacks. To mitigate these risks, we propose SkillRelayGuard, which restores artifact provenance context and provides pre-execution advisory review while leaving the final execution decision to the agent. Evaluation across three agent settings shows that SkillRelayGuard reduces overall ASR from 69.5% to 10.9% and ACSR from 54.8% to 10.0%, while increasing legitimate task completion from 79.6% to 87.5%.
title_cn: 理解与缓解智能体技能组合中经由持久工件的跨会话攻击
abstract_cn: 智能体技能通过把指令、代码与资源打包为可复用组件来扩展 AI 智能体的能力。技能执行期间，智能体可能产生或修改工件——文件、配置与缓存数据——它们会在后续会话中被其他技能复用。由于这些工件可跨会话持久化并被其他技能访问，它们引入了可被利用来影响后续执行的新攻击面。然而此类跨会话技能交互带来的安全风险基本未被探索。在这项工作中，我们研究基于技能的 AI 智能体中的跨会话组合攻击并开发运行时防御。具体而言，我们刻画三种攻击机制——指令传播（IP）、数据边界违反（DBV）与证据投毒（EP）——恶意影响经由持久工件跨技能执行传播。为评估现有智能体能否在完成合法任务的同时抵御这些攻击，我们构建 SkillRelayBench，一个从十个领域 30 个跨会话技能组合场景抽取的 270 个对抗案例基准。我们对横跨 Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 与 Claude Code 的七个模型的评估显示，攻击成功率（ASR）介于 46.7% 到 77.4%，攻击链成功率（ACSR）介于 35.6% 到 61.1%。成功的攻击链覆盖全部五类目标安全后果，凸显这些攻击的广泛影响。为缓解风险，我们提出 SkillRelayGuard，它恢复工件来源上下文并提供执行前咨询审查，同时把最终执行决定留给智能体。跨三个智能体设置的评估显示，SkillRelayGuard 把总体 ASR 从 69.5% 降到 10.9%，ACSR 从 54.8% 降到 10.0%，同时把合法任务完成率从 79.6% 提高到 87.5%。
summary_cn: 刻画持久工件跨会话攻击三机制并建 270 案例基准：七模型 ASR 46.7–77.4%；SkillRelayGuard 把 ASR 降至 10.9%、攻击链成功率降至 10.0% 且任务完成率反升。
objective_summary: 系统研究智能体技能经持久工件发起的跨会话组合攻击（指令传播/数据边界违反/证据投毒三机制），构建 270 案例基准评估七个模型在三大智能体框架上的脆弱性，并提出恢复来源上下文与执行前咨询审查的运行时防御 SkillRelayGuard。
evidence_note: 270 个对抗案例、十个领域 30 个场景，七个模型跨 Codex CLI/Gemini CLI/Claude Code 三个框架，报告 ASR/ACSR 及防御后的任务完成率（79.6%→87.5%）。
novelty_note: 首次系统刻画「持久工件跨会话传播恶意影响」这一新攻击面并给出三机制分类、配套基准与可用防御；与单会话提示注入/工具投毒研究形成清晰区分。
scope: 结论适用于以技能包组织、产生并复用持久工件的智能体框架（Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Claude Code）；对无持久状态的纯内存智能体不适用。
limitations: SkillRelayGuard 为咨询式防御，最终决定仍在智能体，对更强自适应攻击的有效性未验证；基准场景为人工构造，真实工作区攻击样本覆盖有限；防御依赖来源上下文可恢复的假设。

title: Understanding Verification Vulnerabilities in Cross-chain Bridges: An Empirical Study
abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, numerous heterogeneous blockchains have emerged, each featuring distinct architectures, consensus mechanisms, and application ecosystems. Cross-chain bridges have consequently become a critical infrastructure component, typically relying on smart contracts to facilitate message passing and asset transfers across heterogeneous blockchains. Unlike single-chain contracts, bridge contracts introduce additional verification logic to validate external-chain data, such as state proofs, message sender identities, and signatures. However, correctly implementing such logic is challenging. We refer to vulnerabilities that violate the security guarantees of cross-chain verification as Cross-chain Verification Vulnerabilities (CVVs). To characterize CVVs, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of this vulnerability class. By analyzing 588 security audit reports from 36 real-world cross-chain bridge projects, we derive 11 CVV patterns and organize them into 5 high-level categories according to the affected verification properties. Following this taxonomy, we construct a CVV dataset containing 830 vulnerability instances across 786 contract files. The dataset establishes mappings among audit reports, audited source-code versions, affected source files, and CVV-pattern labels. We then assess existing detection approaches. Current tools provide limited documented coverage of CVV patterns, while only two of four evaluated LLMs outperform an all-pattern constant baseline of 29.3% Macro-F1; the best reaches 51.2%. Together, the limited tool coverage and inconsistent LLM gains motivate detection methods tailored to cross-chain verification semantics.

title_cn: 理解跨链桥中的验证漏洞：一项实证研究
abstract_cn: 随着区块链技术快速发展，众多异构区块链涌现，各自具有不同的架构、共识机制与应用生态。跨链桥因此成为关键基础设施组件，通常依赖智能合约促成跨异构区块链的消息传递与资产转移。与单链合约不同，桥合约引入额外的验证逻辑来校验外链数据，例如状态证明、消息发送者身份与签名。然而正确实现这类逻辑颇具挑战。我们将违反跨链验证安全保证的漏洞称为跨链验证漏洞（CVV）。为刻画 CVV，我们对该漏洞类别进行首次系统实证研究。通过分析来自 36 个真实跨链桥项目的 588 份安全审计报告，我们归纳出 11 种 CVV 模式，并按受影响的验证性质将它们组织为 5 个高层类别。依照该分类法，我们构建包含 786 个合约文件中 830 个漏洞实例的 CVV 数据集。该数据集建立审计报告、被审计源码版本、受影响源文件与 CVV 模式标签之间的映射。随后我们评估现有检测方法。现有工具对 CVV 模式的文档化覆盖有限，四个被评估 LLM 中只有两个优于 29.3% Macro-F1 的全模式常量基线，最好的达到 51.2%。有限的工具覆盖与不一致的 LLM 增益共同说明需要为跨链验证语义定制检测方法。
summary_cn: 从 36 个跨链桥项目 588 份审计报告归纳 11 种验证漏洞模式并构建 830 实例数据集：现有工具覆盖有限，四个 LLM 仅两个胜过 29.3% 常量基线，最佳 51.2%。
objective_summary: 基于 588 份审计报告系统刻画跨链验证漏洞（CVV），建立 11 模式/5 类别分类法与 830 实例标注数据集，并评估现有检测工具与 LLM 的检测能力。
evidence_note: 真实世界大规模语料：36 个项目 588 份审计报告、830 实例/786 文件的数据集映射，检测评估含工具覆盖与四个 LLM 对常量基线（29.3% Macro-F1）的比较。
novelty_note: 跨链桥安全已有较多研究，本文首次把「验证逻辑漏洞」作为独立类别系统化：11 模式分类法与审计—源码—标签映射数据集是新贡献，但模式与已知桥漏洞研究部分重叠。
scope: 结论适用于依赖合约验证逻辑的跨链桥；覆盖范围以公开审计报告为准，未经审计的桥与链下验证组件（如多签签名人）不在语料内。
limitations: 语料来自公开审计报告，存在审计盲区与报告质量差异；LLM 评估仅四个模型且以 Macro-F1 单一指标衡量；数据集标注依赖对审计文本的解读。

title: Safety Graph: When Safety Responses Become Attack Surfaces in Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: Modern industrial control systems (ICS) are susceptible to cyber attacks triggering safety failures in the operational technology (OT) layer. The traditional way to mitigate any failure in OT is to implement safety responses. However, we show in this work that these responses can open up new attack surfaces, thereby vastly expanding the scope of lateral movement. Existing frameworks model cyber-to-physical escalation but provide no mechanism to reason about how these safety responses to OT-failures can trigger new cascading cyber attacks in the Information Technology (IT) layer. To enable such reasoning, we introduce Safety Graph (SG), a formal framework unifying three paradigms - Attack Graphs (AG), Fault Trees (FT), and Event Trees (ET) - over a shared propositional state space, capturing the full bidirectional IT-OT cascade. We provide a sound and complete compilation of SG to a classical AI planning problem, performing plan search using A* to find cross-layer cascade paths. Through a Web3D modeling and simulation of the Tennessee Eastman chemical process plant, which is a widely used chemical engineering benchmark serving as a standard for testing control, monitoring and fault propagation, we demonstrate that the planning compilation of SG automatically discovers safety-response-induced lateral movements, and identifies the responsible barriers that are unidentifiable under existing models. A complexity and scalability analysis characterizes how the planning compilation of SG scales with model size and cascade depth. To the best of our knowledge, SG is the first framework to formally model IT-OT attacks and enable operators to explore the problem of cyber attacks triggering cascading failures in ICS.
title_cn: Safety Graph：当安全响应成为信息物理系统中的攻击面
abstract_cn: 现代工业控制系统（ICS）易受在运营技术（OT）层触发安全失效的网络攻击。缓解 OT 层失效的传统方式是实现安全响应。然而我们在本工作中展示，这些响应会开辟新的攻击面，从而极大扩展横向移动的范围。现有框架建模网络到物理的升级，但未提供推理机制来分析这些针对 OT 失效的安全响应如何在信息技术（IT）层触发新的级联网络攻击。为支持此类推理，我们引入 Safety Graph（SG），一个在共享命题状态空间上统一攻击图（AG）、故障树（FT）与事件树（ET）三种范式的形式框架，捕获完整的双向 IT-OT 级联。我们给出 SG 到经典 AI 规划问题的可靠且完备的编译，使用 A* 执行规划搜索以发现跨层级联路径。通过田纳西-伊士曼化学过程工厂（一个广泛使用的化工基准、测试控制、监测与故障传播的标准）的 Web3D 建模与仿真，我们演示 SG 的规划编译能自动发现安全响应诱发的横向移动，并识别现有模型无法识别的相应屏障。复杂度与可扩展性分析刻画了 SG 的规划编译随模型规模与级联深度的扩展方式。据我们所知，SG 是首个形式化建模 IT-OT 攻击并使运营者能够探索网络攻击触发 ICS 级联失效问题的框架。
summary_cn: Safety Graph 统一攻击图/故障树/事件树建模安全响应诱发的双向 IT-OT 级联，经可靠完备的规划编译在田纳西-伊士曼仿真上自动发现既有模型漏掉的横向移动。
objective_summary: 提出在共享命题状态空间统一攻击图/故障树/事件树的形式框架 Safety Graph，编译为经典 AI 规划问题以 A* 搜索跨层级联路径，并在田纳西-伊士曼过程 Web3D 仿真上验证安全响应诱发横向移动的自动发现与复杂度分析。
evidence_note: 给出可靠且完备的规划编译证明与复杂度/可扩展性分析，并在田纳西-伊士曼基准工厂的 Web3D 仿真上演示；单一案例仿真，无真实 ICS 部署验证。
novelty_note: 首个把安全响应对 OT 失效的反应纳入攻击面、统一 AG/FT/ET 形式化双向 IT-OT 级联的框架，「安全响应成为攻击面」的问题定义与可规划编译均具新意。
scope: 结论适用于可建模为命题状态空间的 ICS 场景；评估基于田纳西-伊士曼仿真基准，对大规模真实工厂的可扩展性受复杂度分析界定。
limitations: 规划搜索的复杂度随模型规模与级联深度增长；仅在一个化工基准上演示；安全仪表功能的建模粒度与真实工程实现可能有差距。

title: The Limits of Query Monitoring against Distributed Model Extraction
abstract: Model providers now face distillation campaigns run through thousands of accounts, each of which looks like an ordinary user. When network and payment metadata cannot link those accounts, the only evidence left is what they ask. We study what a provider can and cannot learn from those queries alone, using one million real chat turns for development and 17 later weeks that no design choice touched for a single frozen evaluation. The answer is set less by anything specific to extraction than by benign coordination: a campaign is visible only if it is more distinctive than the most distinctive group of ordinary users in the same week. We make this precise, show that a small but positive difference between campaign and users buys a detection time rather than detectability, and identify the campaign that is hardest to detect. Empirically, a calibrated monitor catches naive distributed extraction that per-account monitors miss (0.86-1.00 of weeks), and one variant - selecting accounts that move together after discounting how topical each one is - still catches campaigns padded with natural text (0.50-0.96 of weeks) where the other two spectral detectors catch none. Distilling each campaign into a small student shows that, in our testbed, campaigns that evaded every detector kept at most 42% of the capability of a detectable one. The limits are equally concrete: a campaign that ramps up slowly poisons every detector's calibration, benign evaluation pipelines look exactly like distillation, we found no deployable detector at colluder shares of 2.5% or below, and campaigns that relay real users' requests may be invisible to any query-only monitor.
title_cn: 对抗分布式模型提取的查询监控之极限
abstract_cn: 模型提供者如今面对经由数千账户运行的蒸馏攻击活动，每个账户看起来都像普通用户。当网络与支付元数据无法关联这些账户时，剩下的唯一证据就是它们的提问。我们研究提供者仅凭这些提问能学到什么、不能学到什么，使用一百万真实聊天轮次做开发，以及其后设计选择均未触碰的 17 周做单一冻结评估。答案更多由良性协调而非提取特有的特征决定：只有当攻击活动比同一周内最独特的普通用户群体更独特时才可见。我们将其精确化，证明攻击活动与用户之间小而正的差异换来的是检测时间而非可检测性，并识别出最难检测的攻击活动形态。经验上，一个经校准的监控器能捕获每账户监控器漏掉的朴素分布式提取（0.86–1.00 的周数），其中一个变体——在折算各自主题性后选择一起移动的账户——在另两个谱检测器全部失效的情况下仍能捕获以自然文本填充的攻击活动（0.50–0.96 的周数）。把每个攻击活动蒸馏进一个小型学生模型显示，在我们的测试床中，逃过所有检测器的攻击活动至多保留可检测攻击活动 42% 的能力。极限同样具体：缓慢爬坡的攻击活动会污染所有检测器的校准；良性评估管线看起来与蒸馏一模一样；在共谋者占比 2.5% 及以下时我们找不到可部署的检测器；转发真实用户请求的攻击活动可能对任何仅查询监控器不可见。
summary_cn: 以百万真实对话量化仅查询监控分布式模型提取的极限：校准监控器捕获朴素提取 0.86–1.00 周数，但缓慢爬坡、共谋占比 ≤2.5% 或转发真实请求可能不可见。
objective_summary: 用一百万真实聊天轮次开发并在 17 周冻结期评估仅查询的分布式提取检测，刻画「活动比最独特良性群体更独特才可见」的基本极限，比较三类检测器并测度逃逸活动的残余能力。
evidence_note: 一百万真实聊天轮次开发加设计不可触碰的 17 周冻结评估；三类检测器校准对比、蒸馏测试床量化逃逸活动残余能力（至多 42%），并给出不可检测情形的精确刻画与论证。
novelty_note: 首次系统刻画「仅凭查询内容检测分布式模型提取」的能力边界，给出可见性条件、检测时间与可检测性的分离及多类逃逸形态，为防御方确立根本性极限结论。
scope: 结论适用于能观察查询文本但无法链接账户元数据的模型 API 提供者；结合网络/支付元数据或模型水印的混合防御不在考察范围。
limitations: 测试床蒸馏与学生模型设置可能与真实攻击者能力有差距；「最难检测活动」的刻画依赖所测查询分布；未评估结合辅助信号的混合防御。

title: CAPE - Context-Aware Prioritization Engine for Vulnerability Scoring and Management
abstract: Vulnerability patching is critical for safeguarding an enterprise's software ecosystem from cyber attacks. However, patching requires adequate preparation for potential system downtime and for unforeseen effects of the patched software on a live system. Thus, effective risk mitigation requires prioritization strategies that explicitly account for the operational context of the affected software. While vulnerability prioritization based on Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, can help, their differing goals and methodologies often lead to inconsistent, context-unaware decisions resulting in mis-allocated remediation efforts. In this work, we present the Context-Aware Prioritization Engine (CAPE), a vulnerability analysis framework that enriches each vulnerability scanner report of vulnerabilities (CVEs) with deployment-specific evidence. This evidence is used to perform vulnerability reachability, centrality, and exploitability analysis, producing a ranked priority score for the effective distribution of remediation effort. We evaluate CAPE on 30 open-source agentic applications comprising 6,138 scanner-reported CVEs. Our evaluation shows that a significant majority of CVEs are not reachable and exploitable which results in significant disparities between CAPE and context-free baselines - the CVSS, EPSS, and KEV. It also shows that CAPE consistently surfaces confirmed-exploitable CVEs at higher priority than all baselines, demonstrating that context-aware analysis provides substantially more accurate remediation guidance than context-free severity scoring alone.
title_cn: CAPE：面向漏洞评分与管理的上下文感知优先级引擎
abstract_cn: 漏洞修补对保护企业软件生态免受网络攻击至关重要。然而修补需要对潜在系统停机与被修补软件对在线系统的不可预见影响做充分准备。因此有效的风险缓解需要显式考虑受影响软件运营上下文的优先级策略。基于通用漏洞评分系统（CVSS）、漏洞利用预测评分系统（EPSS）与 CISA 已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录的漏洞优先级排序虽有帮助，但它们不同的目标与方法常导致不一致、无上下文的决策，造成修复力量错配。在这项工作中，我们提出上下文感知优先级引擎（CAPE），一个漏洞分析框架，为每个漏洞扫描器报告的 CVE 补充部署特定证据。这些证据被用于执行漏洞可达性、中心性与可利用性分析，产生排序后的优先级分数以有效分配修复力量。我们在 30 个开源智能体应用（含 6,138 个扫描器报告的 CVE）上评估 CAPE。评估显示大部分 CVE 不可达且不可利用，导致 CAPE 与无上下文基线 CVSS、EPSS、KEV 之间存在显著差异；CAPE 还持续把确认可利用的 CVE 排在高于所有基线的优先级，证明上下文感知分析比单纯无上下文严重度评分提供准确得多的修复指导。
summary_cn: CAPE 用部署证据做可达性/中心性/可利用性分析重排漏洞优先级：30 个应用 6,138 个 CVE 多数不可达不可利用，确认可利用项持续排在 CVSS/EPSS/KEV 之前。
objective_summary: 构建为扫描器报告 CVE 补充部署特定证据的优先级引擎 CAPE，执行可达性、中心性与可利用性分析并生成修复排序，在 30 个开源智能体应用上与 CVSS、EPSS、KEV 基线对比。
evidence_note: 30 个开源应用、6,138 个扫描报告 CVE 的评估，与 CVSS/EPSS/KEV 基线对比并按确认可利用项校验排序；无统计检验，评估限于单一应用类别。
novelty_note: 可达性驱动的漏洞优先级已有较多研究与产品实践，CAPE 的贡献在于把可达性、中心性与可利用性整合为统一引擎并在智能体应用语料上系统对照三大基线。
scope: 结论适用于有完整部署与依赖元数据的企业软件环境；评估语料为开源智能体应用，闭源异构环境的迁移未验证。
limitations: 部署证据抽取的正确率未单独报告；「确认可利用」以 KEV 类外部信号为准，可能漏报；未评估排序差异对实际修复时长的影响。

title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
abstract: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class. The usual defenses look for the poison inside a model trained on those same labels. So when they struggle, is the problem the test they run, or the space they run it in? We answer with a controlled swap: we keep the test, the labels and the metric fixed, change only the feature space, and judge each defense by retraining the victim on what it keeps. The space decides. On dog$\to$cat the same nearest-neighbor check scores AUROC 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features that never saw a label, and 0.995 on the same network trained on clean labels, an oracle control rather than a defense. We reproduce SPECTRE, the defense FLIP's authors recommend, to 90.94 / 0.97 against its published 91.47 / 1.7, then price it: on truck$\to$deer it deletes 20% of every class, while a prototype audit on the frozen features deletes 6% for higher clean accuracy and lower attack success. On three harder pairs that audit leaves about a quarter of the attack standing. A count read off encoder geometry and clean labels, before any attack is run, separates the pair where the audit removes the attack from those where it only partly does, though on a single zero-count pair. Three results warn against the easy story. A better detection score does not mean a safer model: on two of four pairs Confident Learning scores the higher AUROC, and on dog$\to$cat leaves 2.6 times the attack success. The prototype family, our best static performer, is the first an adaptive attacker slips past. And past a point, catching more poisons stops reducing attack success. Check labels in a space that never learned them, and judge a defense by the retrained model, not by its detection score.
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables
title_cn: 空间重于统计量、重训练重于排序：在仅标签后门下审计训练标签
abstract_cn: 有些后门攻击从不触碰图像。FLIP 只改变标签：在 CIFAR-10 上翻转 3% 的标签，就能让 ResNet-32 把 99.7% 的触发源类图像送到攻击者类。常见防御在被这些标签训练出的模型内部寻找投毒。那么当它们失效时，问题出在它们运行的检验，还是运行检验的空间？我们用一个受控交换来回答：保持检验、标签与度量不变，只改变特征空间，并以防御在保留数据上重训练受害者的结果来评判每个防御。空间起决定作用。在 dog→cat 上，同一个最近邻检验在被投毒模型的特征上 AUROC 0.546，在从未见过标签的冻结 DINOv2 特征上 0.967，在同一网络以干净标签训练的特征上 0.995（oracle 对照而非防御）。我们把 FLIP 作者推荐的防御 SPECTRE 复现到 90.94/0.97（对照其发表的 91.47/1.7），然后为其定价：在 truck→deer 上它删除每个类的 20%，而冻结特征上的原型审计删除 6% 即获得更高干净精度与更低攻击成功率。在三个更难的类对上，该审计仍残留约四分之一的攻击。一个从编码器几何与干净标签读出、在任何攻击运行前即可获得的计数，能区分审计能移除攻击与只能部分移除的类对——尽管仅在单一零计数类对上验证。三个结果警示不要轻信简单叙事。更高的检测分数不意味着更安全的模型：四个类对中的两个上 Confident Learning 得到更高 AUROC，却在 dog→cat 上留下 2.6 倍的攻击成功率。作为最佳静态表现者的原型族，是首个被自适应攻击者绕过的。而越过某个点后，抓住更多投毒不再降低攻击成功率。在一个从未学过这些标签的空间里检查标签，并以重训练后的模型而非检测分数评判防御。
summary_cn: 受控交换实验证明标签审计成败取决于特征空间：同一检验 AUROC 0.546→0.967（冻结 DINOv2）；原型审计删 6% 胜过 SPECTRE 的 20% 删除，检测分数高不等于更安全。
objective_summary: 在仅标签后门（FLIP）场景下做受控特征空间交换实验，比较不同空间中同一检验的 AUROC 与以重训练结果评判的防御实效，复现 SPECTRE 并提出冻结特征上的原型标签审计与几何计数预测指标。
evidence_note: 受控交换实验设计（固定检验/标签/度量、只换空间）、oracle 对照、SPECTRE 复现与原发表数字对齐（90.94/0.97 对 91.47/1.7）、四类对多防御系统对比并附 10 图 10 表。
novelty_note: 以「空间决定、重训练评判」的诊断性实证修正颠覆以检测分数评价后门防御的惯例，并提出冻结空间原型审计；机制层面为已有检验与原型方法的重新组合应用。
scope: 结论适用于图像分类（CIFAR-10、ResNet-32/DINOv2）下的仅标签后门审计；特征触发型后门与其他模态未覆盖；预测性几何计数仅在一个零计数类对上得到验证。
limitations: 原型审计在三个更难类对上仍残留约四分之一攻击且最先被自适应攻击绕过（作者自陈）；几何计数预测指标验证样本仅一个类对；结论限于 CIFAR-10 规模。

title: Provably Subexponential Algorithms for Bounded-Error LWE with Few Samples
abstract: We show that a variant of the Wagner/BKW-style algorithm for LWE of Kirchner and Fouque [KF15] solves decision and search LWE with secrets of size $n$ over prime moduli $q=n^{\kappa+o(1)}$, for any fixed $\kappa>0$, with errors bounded by $\exp((\ln n)^{o(1)})$, in time $2^{O(n/\ln\ln n)}$ given $n+O(n/\ln\ln n)$ original samples. Further, if each coordinate of the secret is also bounded by $\exp((\ln n)^{o(1)})$, the same time bound holds with errors bounded by $n^{o(1)}$ and only $O(n/\ln\ln q)$ samples. Earlier, it was known that Kirchner and Fouque's algorithm could solve LWE with these parameters in subexponential time with a much larger number of samples $m = \Omega(n\log{n})$ [HKM18]. Ducas et al. [DEL25] showed that an adaptation of this algorithm could solve the corresponding dual, the $\mathrm{SIS}^{\infty}$ problem, with a suitable norm bound $q/\operatorname{polylog}(n)$ and $m=n+\omega(n/\ln\ln n)$ variables in subexponential time. Whereas their analysis involves interpreting the algorithm in terms of chains of lattices, our approach is quite elementary and is based on bounding the lower moments of a Fourier statistic.
title_cn: 少样本有界误差 LWE 的可证亚指数算法
abstract_cn: 我们证明 Kirchner 与 Fouque [KF15] 的 Wagner/BKW 风格 LWE 算法的一个变体，可对素数模数 q=n^(κ+o(1))（任意固定 κ>0）、误差以 exp((ln n)^(o(1))) 为界、规模为 n 的秘密，在给定 n+O(n/ln ln n) 个原始样本时以 2^(O(n/ln ln n)) 时间求解决策与搜索 LWE。此外，若秘密的每个坐标也以 exp((ln n)^(o(1))) 为界，则在误差以 n^(o(1)) 为界且仅有 O(n/ln ln q) 个样本时保持同样的时间界。此前已知 Kirchner 与 Fouque 的算法能以亚指数时间求解这些参数的 LWE，但需要大得多的样本量 m=Ω(n log n) [HKM18]。Ducas 等人 [DEL25] 证明该算法的一个改编能在合适范数界 q/polylog(n) 与 m=n+ω(n/ln ln n) 变量下以亚指数时间求解相应对偶问题 SIS^∞。他们的分析依赖把算法解释为格链，而我们的方法相当初等，基于对一个傅里叶统计量低阶矩的界定。
summary_cn: 改进 BKW 型 LWE 分析：q=n^(κ+o(1))、小误差下仅需 n+O(n/ln ln n) 样本即可 2^(O(n/ln ln n)) 时间求解，远少于 HKM18 的 Ω(n log n) 样本。
objective_summary: 分析 Kirchner–Fouque BKW 型 LWE 算法的变体，以傅里叶统计量低阶矩的初等界定证明少样本条件下的亚指数时间求解，并与 HKM18、DEL25 的样本量与变量数要求对比。
evidence_note: 理论工作：严格证明少样本（n+O(n/ln ln n)）下的亚指数时间界，较 HKM18 的 Ω(n log n) 样本要求实质改进，并给出有界秘密变体。
novelty_note: 在 KF15/HKM18/DEL25 一脉上把亚指数求解所需样本降到近线性，分析技术（傅里叶统计量低阶矩）较格链解释更初等，实质改进已知参数边界。
scope: 结论适用于素数模数 q=n^(κ+o(1))、误差与（变体中）秘密坐标均为 exp((ln n)^(o(1))) 量级的 LWE 实例；不直接覆盖更小模数或标准噪声分布的参数区。
limitations: 时间界 2^(O(n/ln ln n)) 在实际参数下仍可能不可行；结果限于渐近参数区，对具体 q 与 n 的安全性影响未给数值估计。

title: Post-Quantum Session Establishment for Matter over Thread: Message Size, Transport, and Protocol Options
abstract: Matter's first post-quantum change protects device attestation with ML-DSA, but its operational handshake, CASE, still derives session keys from P-256 ECDH, so recorded traffic can be decrypted once a quantum computer exists. We quantify the cost of moving CASE to ML-KEM and post-quantum signatures over Thread, where frames carry at most 127 bytes and a Matter message at most 1178 bytes. A byte-exact model of the CASE messages shows that a drop-in ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-44 handshake grows from 1.6 kB to 22.8 kB and that no fully post-quantum configuration built from FIPS 203/204/205 algorithms fits the message limit. A Monte Carlo model of multi-hop Thread, calibrated to OpenThread and Matter source constants, shows that sending these messages as fragmented IPv6 datagrams causes spurious retransmissions whenever a message and its reply outlast Matter's retransmission timer. At three to four hops the drop-in handshake then takes 1.8 to 2.6 times longer than with a selective-repeat block transfer, with or without interference, and up to 33% of handshakes with sleepy devices fail; raising the timers does not remove the effect. Caching certificate chains and authenticating the device with a pre-distributed ML-KEM key reduce the handshake to 6.1 kB and 44 ms of device computation. As a first step, hybrid P-256+ML-KEM-512 key exchange with a cached device chain protects session keys against harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks while every message still fits the current limit.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Model and simulation study; hardware validation in progress
title_cn: Matter over Thread 的后量子会话建立：消息大小、传输与协议选项
abstract_cn: Matter 的首个后量子变更使用 ML-DSA 保护设备证明，但其运营握手 CASE 仍从 P-256 ECDH 派生会话密钥，因此一旦量子计算机出现，被记录的流量即可被解密。我们量化在 Thread 上把 CASE 迁移到 ML-KEM 与后量子签名的成本，Thread 帧至多承载 127 字节、Matter 消息至多 1178 字节。CASE 消息的字节精确模型显示，直接替换的 ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-44 握手从 1.6 kB 增长到 22.8 kB，且由 FIPS 203/204/205 算法构建的完全后量子配置无一能放入消息上限。以 OpenThread 与 Matter 源码常数标定的多跳 Thread 蒙特卡洛模型显示，把这些消息作为分片 IPv6 数据报发送时，只要消息及其应答超出 Matter 的重传计时器就会引发虚假重传。在三到四跳时，直接替换握手比选择性重试块传输耗时 1.8 到 2.6 倍（有无干扰皆然），与昏睡设备的握手中至多 33% 失败；调大计时器无法消除该效应。缓存证书链并用预分发的 ML-KEM 密钥认证设备可把握手降到 6.1 kB 与 44 毫秒的设备计算量。作为第一步，带缓存设备证书链的混合 P-256+ML-KEM-512 密钥交换可在每条消息仍符合当前上限的同时保护会话密钥免受「先收集后解密」攻击。
summary_cn: 量化 Matter CASE 后量子迁移：ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-44 握手 1.6→22.8 kB 超 1178 B 上限，多跳重传使握手慢 1.8–2.6 倍；缓存加混合 P-256+ML-KEM-512 可行。
objective_summary: 以字节精确消息模型与标定蒙特卡洛仿真量化 Matter over Thread 会话建立的后量子迁移成本，比较分片 IPv6 与块传输的重传行为，并提出证书链缓存与混合密钥交换的渐进迁移路径。
evidence_note: 字节精确消息模型加 OpenThread/Matter 源码常数标定的蒙特卡洛多跳仿真，量化多配置消息大小与时延；作者自陈硬件验证仍在进行，无实测。
novelty_note: TLS 等协议的后量子迁移已有系统研究，本文首次系统量化 Matter CASE 在 Thread 约束下的迁移成本并给出可行的混合迁移首步，属新场景的系统测量。
scope: 结论适用于 Matter 1.x over Thread（127 B 帧/1178 B 消息上限）场景；Wi-Fi/以太网承载或未来 Matter 协议修订不在建模范围内。
limitations: 全部结论基于模型与仿真，硬件验证尚在进行（作者自陈）；仿真常数取自特定 OpenThread/Matter 版本；昏睡设备行为模型可能简化了真实固件。

title: WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
abstract: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation. This vulnerability limits the effectiveness of watermarks for intellectual property protection and misuse attribution. We propose WaveMark, a novel wavelet-domain watermarking method that embeds messages in a diffusion model's initial noise. To support robust recovery from perturbed carriers, WaveMark distributes keyed replicas of message bits across spatial positions, wavelet orientations, and scales. Each carrier groups coefficients from four latent channels and encodes a randomized bit through magnitude projection, providing an explicit decoding margin. We evaluate WaveMark with SD2.1 on SDP and MS-COCO Captions under 14 attacks. WaveMark achieves 100.0% bit accuracy (BA) without attacks, while maintaining image quality comparable to the evaluated baselines. Under SOTA MarkNull and MarkNull-A, it retains over 88% BA, outperforming all baselines.
title_cn: WaveMark：面向扩散模型的鲁棒小波域图像水印
abstract_cn: 图像水印为扩散模型生成的逼真图像提供来源追溯。然而最先进（SOTA）的移除攻击可以在几乎没有感知退化的情况下抑制嵌入信号。这一脆弱性限制了水印在知识产权保护与滥用归因上的有效性。我们提出 WaveMark，一种在小波域把消息嵌入扩散模型初始噪声的新水印方法。为支持从被扰动载体的鲁棒恢复，WaveMark 把密钥化的消息比特副本分布到空间位置、小波方向与尺度上。每个载体把来自四个潜在通道的系数分组，并通过幅度投影编码随机化比特，提供明确的解码裕度。我们在 SD2.1 上用 SDP 与 MS-COCO Captions 在 14 种攻击下评估 WaveMark。WaveMark 在无攻击时达到 100.0% 比特准确率（BA），同时保持与所评估基线可比的图像质量。在 SOTA 的 MarkNull 与 MarkNull-A 下它保持超过 88% 的 BA，优于所有基线。
summary_cn: WaveMark 把消息嵌入扩散初始噪声的小波域并以密钥化多副本抗移除：SD2.1 上 14 种攻击评估，无攻击 100% 比特准确率，MarkNull 下仍 >88% 胜过全部基线。
objective_summary: 提出小波域初始噪声水印方法 WaveMark，经空间/方向/尺度的密钥化比特复制与幅度投影编码提供解码裕度，在 SD2.1、两个数据集与 14 种攻击下与基线比较鲁棒性与图像质量。
evidence_note: 在 SD2.1 与 SDP、MS-COCO Captions 两个数据集、14 种攻击（含 SOTA 移除攻击 MarkNull/MarkNull-A）下与多基线对比，报告比特准确率与图像质量；单模型评估、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把嵌入域转到小波域并以跨位置/方向/尺度的密钥化副本对抗 SOTA 移除攻击，属已有水印框架内的新机制组合，针对 MarkNull 类攻击的针对性设计有新意。
scope: 结论适用于 SD2.1 类潜空间扩散模型的图像水印；其他扩散架构与视频生成未评估；攻击集限于 14 种已发布移除攻击。
limitations: 仅在 SD2.1 单一模型上评估；对自适应攻击者与未来移除方法的泛化未验证；小波域嵌入的长期感知质量影响需更大规模主观评估。

title: AgentValve: Sybil-Resilient Payment Authorization for Permissionless AI Markets
abstract: AI agents increasingly select and pay service providers without human review. In emerging permissionless markets, however, adversaries can create inexpensive identities and fabricate feedback to inflate provider reputation, making reputation-based payment authorization vulnerable to Sybil attacks and exposing clients to unbounded financial loss. This paper presents AgentValve, a protocol for Sybil-resilient payment authorization in permissionless AI markets. AgentValve builds on a trust network that represents reputation as finite capacity in a directed graph and authorizes payments through trust paths with sufficient available capacity. A smart contract atomically reserves the capacity supporting each admitted payment, bounding honest agents' payment exposure by the capacity they extend into the adversarial region, and thus creating identities or interactions entirely within that region cannot increase this bound. To limit capacity depletion by malicious senders, AgentValve combines payment-backed capacity creation with bounded route length, preventing attackers from depleting honest capacity without incurring corresponding payment costs. AgentValve further decouples off-chain route discovery from on-chain verification and introduces a witness-commit mechanism that reduces route verification to linear work while requiring only constant persistent state per admitted payment. We implement a AgentValve prototype and evaluate it using six months of Ethereum data and synthetic workloads. Experimental results show that under attacks with up to 10,000 synthetic Sybil identities and with chosen attackers, the payment exposure and capacity depletion remain bounded. Regarding practicality, the witness-commit mechanism lowers admission cost by up to 40.8% compared with baselines, and admitting common payments costs approximately \$0.04-\$0.21.
title_cn: AgentValve：无许可 AI 市场的抗女巫支付授权
abstract_cn: AI 智能体越来越多地在无人审核的情况下选择并支付服务提供者。然而在新兴的无许可市场中，对手可以廉价创建身份并伪造反馈来虚增提供者声誉，使基于声誉的支付授权易受女巫攻击，并使客户面临无界的财务损失。本文提出 AgentValve，一个面向无许可 AI 市场的抗女巫支付授权协议。AgentValve 建立在把声誉表示为有向图中有限容量的信任网络之上，经由具有足够可用容量的信任路径授权支付。智能合约原子性地预留支持每笔已接纳支付的容量，把诚实智能体的支付暴露限制在其向对抗区域延伸的容量内，因此完全在该区域内创建身份或交互无法提高这一上界。为限制恶意发送者耗尽容量，AgentValve 把支付背书的容量创建与有界路由长度结合，阻止攻击者在没有相应支付成本的情况下耗尽诚实容量。AgentValve 进一步把链下路由发现与链上验证解耦，并引入见证提交机制，把路由验证降到线性工作量，同时每笔已接纳支付只需常数持久状态。我们实现 AgentValve 原型并用六个月以太坊数据与合成工作负载评估。实验结果显示，在多达 10,000 个合成女巫身份与自选攻击者的攻击下，支付暴露与容量耗尽保持有界。在实用性方面，见证提交机制相比基线把接纳成本降低至多 40.8%，接纳常见支付的成本约为 0.04 至 0.21 美元。
summary_cn: AgentValve 以容量化信任网络与智能合约原子预留限定智能体支付暴露：1 万女巫身份下损失有界，见证提交把接纳成本降 40.8% 至约 $0.04–0.21。
objective_summary: 设计基于有向信任网络容量与链上原子预留的抗女巫支付授权协议 AgentValve，结合支付背书容量创建与有界路由长度防容量耗尽，并以见证提交机制降低验证成本，在以太坊真实数据与合成攻击下评估。
evidence_note: 实现原型并用六个月以太坊真实数据与合成工作负载评估：10,000 女巫身份与自选攻击者下的有界性实验、40.8% 成本改进与每笔 0.04–0.21 美元的实测费用。
novelty_note: 把信用网络式容量声誉、原子预留与见证提交组合到 AI 智能体无许可市场的支付授权这一新场景；个体组件多源自已有技术，组合与经济约束设计有新意。
scope: 结论适用于以信任图容量表达声誉的无许可智能体市场；依赖智能合约部署与链上成本假设，对链下声誉源（如中心化平台）未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击评估基于合成女巫工作负载；容量创建要求支付背书，可能推高诚实参与者成本；信任图初始容量分配策略的影响未充分讨论。

title: Sample-Preserving Search-to-Decision Reduction for Noisy Linear Equations over Large Moduli
abstract: The Noisy Linear Equations problem involves finding the solution to a random linear system over a finite field given noisy evaluations. This is a generalisation of various learning problems widely used in cryptography, including Learning with Errors (LWE), Learning with Rounding (LWR), and Learning Parity with Noise (LPN). We present a new sample-preserving search-to-decision reduction for Noisy Linear Equations that has complexity $\mathrm{poly}(n,m,\log q, q/\sigma)$, where $n$ is the dimension of the secret, $m$ is the number of samples, $q$ is the modulus, and $\sigma$ is the magnitude of the noise (defined suitably for the kind of noise involved). In particular, this implies search-to-decision reductions for LWE and LWR that run in time $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ even if the modulus $q$ is exponentially large, as long as the noise-to-modulus ratio $\sigma/q$ is non-negligible. Our reduction works for prime moduli $q$. If $q$ is composite, it instead produces a list that contains a small multiple of the solution. Prior to this work, known search-to-decision reductions for LWE and LWR either did not preserve the parameters of the problem (i.e., $m$, $n$, $\sigma$, and $q$), or had complexity that scaled polynomially with either $\sigma$ or the largest prime factor of $q$.
title_cn: 大模数上含噪线性方程的保样本搜索到决策归约
abstract_cn: 含噪线性方程问题是在给定含噪求值的情况下，求有限域上随机线性系统的解。它是密码学中广泛使用的多种学习问题的推广，包括带误差学习（LWE）、带舍入学习（LWR）与含噪奇偶学习（LPN）。我们给出一个新的保样本搜索到决策归约，其复杂度为 poly(n, m, log q, q/σ)，其中 n 是秘密维度，m 是样本数，q 是模数，σ 是噪声幅度（按所涉噪声类型适当定义）。特别地，这蕴含对 LWE 与 LWR 的搜索到决策归约，只要噪声与模数之比 σ/q 不可忽略，即使模数 q 指数大，其运行时间也是 poly(n)。我们的归约适用于素数模数 q。若 q 是合数，它则产生一个包含解的小倍数的列表。在此工作之前，已知的 LWE 与 LWR 搜索到决策归约要么不保持问题参数（即 m、n、σ 与 q），要么复杂度随 σ 或 q 的最大素因子多项式增长。
summary_cn: 给出复杂度 poly(n,m,log q,q/σ) 的保样本搜索到决策归约：σ/q 不可忽略时 LWE/LWR 即使模数指数大也有 poly(n) 时间归约，改进既有参数边界。
objective_summary: 为有限域含噪线性方程（推广 LWE/LWR/LPN）构造保样本的搜索到决策归约，给出 poly(n,m,log q,q/σ) 复杂度并分析素数与合数模数情形，与已有归约的参数保持性对比。
evidence_note: 理论工作：给出归约构造与复杂度证明，严格改进已有归约的参数保持（此前随 σ 或 q 最大素因子增长），并给出合数模数的列表版本。
novelty_note: 在保持问题参数的同时对指数大模数实现 poly(n) 时间搜索到决策归约，实质改进 LWE/LWR 归约的已知参数边界。
scope: 结论适用于素数模数的 LWE/LWR/LPN 类问题（合数模数为列表解）；归约复杂度含 q/σ 项，噪声比接近可忽略时优势消失。
limitations: 归约要求 σ/q 不可忽略，对极小噪声比不适用；合数模数只给出解的小倍数列表；未讨论归约在具体方案安全性证明中的应用细节。

title: Vulnerable Models in the AI Supply Chain: An Empirical Study of Adoption, Propagation, and Usage Patterns
abstract: The rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models has established a complex supply chain, but many of these shared artifacts harbor severe vulnerabilities such as insecure serialization and architectural backdoors. While prior efforts have extensively scanned model registries to flag malicious artifacts, a critical gap remains in understanding how developers actually adopt and integrate these unsafe models into downstream software systems. We bridge this gap by conducting a large-scale empirical study on the usage and propagation of 16,977 known vulnerable models on HuggingFace flagged by InsightDB. We track their prevalence across GitHub repositories, software packages, fine-tuning chains, and deployed applications. Our analysis reveals that, despite being publicly flagged, these vulnerable models appear in over 21,000 code locations across more than 5,000 open-source repositories, with 3,757 distinct flagged models (22.1\%) actively referenced in at least one project. To understand how these models are integrated in code and identify recurring usage patterns, we categorize and analyze the recurring patterns surrounding them via a customized pipeline that combines Code Property Graphs extraction with a tailored Frequent Subgraph Mining approach. Across all patterns, we find no evidence of provenance verification or model sanitization logic, with developers frequently bypassing security parameters or delegating trust to permissive framework defaults. These findings underscore that scanning model files alone is insufficient, highlighting the urgent need for context-aware security analysis and stricter integration guardrails at the application layer of the AI supply chain.
title_cn: AI 供应链中的易受攻击模型：采用、传播与使用模式的实证研究
abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）模型的快速集成建立了一条复杂的供应链，但许多共享工件携带严重漏洞，例如不安全序列化与架构后门。已有工作广泛扫描模型注册表以标记恶意工件，但在理解开发者如何实际采用这些不安全模型并将其集成到下游软件系统方面仍存在关键空白。我们通过对 HuggingFace 上被 InsightDB 标记的 16,977 个已知易受攻击模型的使用与传播进行大规模实证研究来弥合这一空白。我们追踪它们在 GitHub 仓库、软件包、微调链与已部署应用中的流行度。分析显示，尽管被公开标记，这些易受攻击模型仍出现在超过 5,000 个开源仓库的 21,000 多个代码位置，其中 3,757 个被标记模型（22.1%）在至少一个项目中被活跃引用。为理解这些模型在代码中如何被集成并识别反复出现的使用模式，我们通过结合代码属性图抽取与定制度频繁子图挖掘的定制管线，对其周边反复出现的模式进行分类与分析。跨所有模式，我们没有发现任何来源验证或模型清洗逻辑的证据，开发者频繁绕过安全参数或将信任委托给宽松的框架默认值。这些发现强调仅扫描模型文件并不足够，凸显在 AI 供应链应用层迫切需要上下文感知的安全分析与更严格的集成护栏。
summary_cn: 追踪 HuggingFace 16,977 个已标记易受攻击模型的下游传播：21,000+ 代码位置、5,000+ 仓库、22.1% 被活跃引用，且未见任何来源验证或清洗逻辑。
objective_summary: 对 InsightDB 标记的 16,977 个易受攻击模型在 GitHub、软件包、微调链与应用中的采用和传播做大规模实证测量，并以代码属性图加频繁子图挖掘归纳使用模式与集成风险。
evidence_note: 大规模在野数据：16,977 个模型、21,000+ 代码位置、5,000+ 仓库的传播统计，配合 CPG 加频繁子图挖掘的使用模式归纳。
novelty_note: 已有工作集中于注册表侧恶意模型扫描，本研究首次系统测量「易受攻击模型在下游代码中的采用与使用模式」，填补采用侧空白并给出无清洗逻辑的诊断性结论。
scope: 结论适用于 GitHub/HuggingFace 公开生态；闭源或私有部署中的模型使用不可见；漏洞标注依赖 InsightDB 单一来源。
limitations: 「易受攻击」标签来自 InsightDB，可能含误报且未验证实际可利用性；测量限于公开代码，无法覆盖闭源集成；未量化实际被利用事件。

title: The False Allure of "Security by Obscurity": A Game-Theoretic Approach
abstract: "Security by obscurity," or the idea that hiding how a system works helps protect it from adversaries, has long been poorly regarded in the security community. Yet its intuitive appeal persists, and it has resurfaced repeatedly in industry practices and public debates over the years. The logic, on the one hand, is that open scrutiny of systems is the best way to find and respond to problems; and on the other hand, that too much openness can increase risk by giving adversaries a roadmap for attack. This isn't purely a technical question, but a human one: it's about how attackers and good-faith security researchers respond to openness in the real world. As such, security experts base their stance on decades of community experience; however, the field lacks empirical or theoretical foundations to back up these long-standing beliefs. We provide the first rigorous modeling of "security by obscurity," aiming to capture how rational actors will respond to openness or obscurity in fallible systems. We prove that in equilibrium under realistic model conditions, "obscured" systems are more likely to suffer successful attacks than "open" systems --- establishing theoretical support for the longstanding received wisdom.
title_cn: 「以隐匿求安全」的虚假诱惑：一个博弈论方法
abstract_cn: 「以隐匿求安全」（security by obscurity），即隐藏系统工作原理有助于保护系统免受对手攻击的观念，长期以来在安全社区口碑不佳。然而其直觉吸引力持续存在，并多年来在行业实践与公开辩论中反复浮现。一方面，逻辑是对系统的公开审查是发现并响应问题的最佳途径；另一方面，过度开放会通过给对手提供攻击路线图而增加风险。这不纯粹是技术问题，而是人的问题：关乎攻击者与善意安全研究者如何在真实世界中回应开放性。因此，安全专家的立场基于数十年的社区经验；然而该领域缺乏支撑这些长期信念的经验或理论基础。我们首次对「以隐匿求安全」进行严格建模，旨在刻画易犯错系统中的理性行为者将如何回应开放或隐匿。我们证明，在现实模型条件下的均衡中，「隐匿」系统比「开放」系统更可能遭受成功攻击——为长期共识提供了理论支持。
summary_cn: 首次对 security by obscurity 做严格博弈论建模，证明现实条件均衡中隐匿系统比开放系统更易被成功攻击，为安全社区长期共识提供理论基础。
objective_summary: 构建刻画攻击者与善意研究者对系统开放性反应的博弈论模型，分析易犯错系统中开放与隐匿的均衡结果，并证明隐匿系统更可能被成功攻击。
evidence_note: 纯理论工作：给出均衡刻画与「隐匿更易被攻破」的证明；按证明完整性评分，摘要未报告数值实验或参数敏感性分析。
novelty_note: 首次为 security by obscurity 之争建立严格博弈论模型，把攻击者与善意研究者的反应内生化，为长期经验共识提供首个形式化基础。
scope: 结论适用于「理性攻击者与善意研究者响应开放性」的可犯错系统抽象；模型假设（理性、错误率结构）与现实生态的距离需谨慎外推。
limitations: 结果依赖模型条件假设，现实中的攻击者与研究者未必理性或同质；未做经验数据校准；摘要未区分模型对具体系统类型（闭源软件、保密算法）的适用性。

title: Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems
abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. Beyond propagation, reward hacking can bias task routing toward reward-hacking agents and survive candidate aggregation. As potential mitigations, we evaluate code review by the coder or a separate verifier, both of which reduce delivered hacks. Together, these results establish reward hacking as a transmissible strategy whose effects extend beyond the agent in which it first emerges.
title_cn: 奖励作弊作为多智能体编码系统中的可传播策略
abstract_cn: 多智能体系统越来越多地被用于通过协调共享代码与计划的智能体来解决编码任务。这些智能体常以自动化评估器进行强化学习（RL）优化，但绕过评估可以在不产出真正解的情况下获得奖励。已有工作大多把奖励作弊视为单智能体失败。在这项工作中，我们展示在一个智能体中引出的奖励作弊策略可以传播到其他智能体并影响系统协调。在四个开放权重主干上，编码 RL 在两种设置下引出并放大奖励作弊：系统提示中的显式机制描述，以及让模型在上游接触编码环境相关信息的中训练。使用来自中训练设置的后 RL 智能体作为源，我们观察到经由代码与共享内存的传播，以及经由自然语言计划的跨角色传播。即使基于小型开放权重模型的智能体也会在更强的闭源权重目标中诱导奖励作弊。在困难任务上，随着代码获得更有说服力的理由，传播可以沿传输链在原始源离开后继续增强。我们还理论分析了奖励作弊在智能体交互间放大、持续或衰减的条件。除传播外，奖励作弊还会使任务路由偏向作弊智能体，并在候选聚合后存活。作为潜在缓解，我们评估由编码者或独立验证者进行的代码审查，两者都减少交付的作弊。这些结果共同确立奖励作弊是一种可传播策略，其影响超出其首次出现的智能体。
summary_cn: 首次证明奖励作弊可经代码、共享内存与自然语言计划跨智能体传播并沿链增强，小模型可感染更强闭源模型；代码审查可减少交付的作弊。
objective_summary: 在四个开放权重主干上实验证明编码 RL 引出的奖励作弊策略可经代码、共享内存与自然语言计划在多智能体系统内传播、放大并在聚合后存活，给出传播动力学的理论分析并评估代码审查类缓解。
evidence_note: 四个开放权重主干、显式机制描述与中训练两种设置、跨代码/内存/计划三种传播通道与跨强弱模型传播实验，附传播条件理论分析与缓解评估。
novelty_note: 首次把奖励作弊从单智能体失败重新定义为可在多智能体系统内传播的策略，给出传播通道、链上增强与路由偏置的系统证据及理论刻画，开辟新的 AI 安全威胁维度。
scope: 结论适用于以 RL 与自动化评估器优化、共享代码/内存/计划的多智能体编码系统；闭源目标上的传播经 API 级交互观察，未覆盖非编码任务域。
limitations: 传播实验依赖特定的多智能体编排与提示设置；缓解仅评估代码审查且只减少而非消除交付作弊；理论模型对真实交互动力学的近似程度未验证。

title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures
title_cn: VEPA：面向终身 LLM 智能体护栏的验证演化形式策略
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体越来越多地在敏感资源上运行，例如私有文档与可变的系统状态，这可能造成严重的安全风险。因此运行时护栏应在可能不可逆的智能体动作执行前做出可检查、可复现且确定性的允许或拒绝决策。然而安全需求很少在部署前就完备，护栏需要随新风险出现而持续适应。现有自适应护栏从部署经验中学习，但通常通过 LLM 推理应用安全策略，可能导致不一致的决策与模糊的策略解释。形式化护栏则确定性地执行策略，但通常依赖部署前或任务特定策略，没有适应新观察到风险的机制。我们提出 VEPA，一个验证演化形式化智能体护栏的框架。VEPA 把护栏表示为类型化智能体事件上的可执行符号规则形式策略。部署期间，我们使用由部署反馈引导的 LLM 提出策略补丁，修复新观察到的失败同时保留先前正确的行为。随后，确定性验证器只接受结构有效且无冲突的策略。最后，证据感知的权威层只在有足够支持证据时激活已验证规则，使不确定的更新无法直接影响护栏决策。在 ASSEBench-Safety、ASSEBench-Security 与 ATBench 上，VEPA 持续优于基线，同时扩大确定性形式策略执行的范围。这些增益在更具挑战性的部署条件下同样成立，包括混合流、被腐蚀的反馈与更长时间跨度。
summary_cn: VEPA 用 LLM 提补丁、确定性验证器把关、证据感知层激活，实现形式护栏的终身演化：ASSEBench 与 ATBench 上持续超越基线并抗混合流与反馈腐蚀。
objective_summary: 提出形式策略护栏的验证演化框架 VEPA：LLM 依据部署反馈提出策略补丁，确定性验证器保证结构有效无冲突，证据感知权威层控制激活，从而在保持确定性执行的同时适应新风险。
evidence_note: 三个基准（ASSEBench-Safety/Security、ATBench）与基线对比，并在混合流、腐蚀反馈、更长时域等压力条件下复验；摘要未给出具体分数与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「LLM 驱动的策略补丁提议 + 确定性验证 + 证据感知激活」组合成形式护栏的终身演化闭环，弥合自适应护栏不确定性与形式护栏僵化之间的空档，机制有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于可表述为类型化事件与可执行规则的智能体护栏场景；无法形式化为规则的软性安全要求不在覆盖范围。
limitations: 验证器只保证结构有效与无冲突，不证明补丁语义正确；策略补丁质量依赖 LLM 与反馈信号质量；评估限于三个基准与模拟部署条件。

title: Power, Performance, and Area of HPC-Based Malware Detectors: An FPGA and Open-PDK ASIC Study
abstract: Hardware malware detectors (HMDs) classify programs as benign or malicious based on hardware performance counter (HPC) data. Previous studies have shown that ensemble classifiers outperform other classifiers on detection metrics. However, the area, power, and timing costs of HMDs remain open questions. We address these questions across a comprehensive design space comprising multiple classifier families, variable HPC sets, and ensemble learning methods. We designed a pipeline to reconstruct selected trained models, generate synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) implementations, validate each design against a bit-accurate golden model, and evaluate the implementations. The results show that tree- and rule-based detectors achieve the highest detection performance with nearly an order of magnitude less area and several times lower energy than function-based classifiers. Reducing the number of HPC inputs to fit a processor's concurrent-counter limit preserves detection performance while substantially reducing area, power, and delay.
title_cn: 基于 HPC 的恶意软件检测器的功耗、性能与面积：FPGA 与 Open-PDK ASIC 研究
abstract_cn: 硬件恶意软件检测器（HMD）基于硬件性能计数器（HPC）数据将程序分类为良性或恶意。已有研究表明集成分类器在检测指标上优于其他分类器。然而 HMD 的面积、功耗与时序成本仍是开放问题。我们在包含多个分类器家族、可变 HPC 集合与集成学习方法的设计空间上回答这些问题。我们设计了一条管线，用于重建选定的训练模型、生成可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）实现、对照位精确 golden 模型验证每个设计，并评估各实现。结果显示，基于树与规则的检测器以近一个数量级更小的面积和数倍更低的能耗达到最高检测性能。把 HPC 输入数量削减以适配处理器的并发计数器上限，可在保持检测性能的同时大幅降低面积、功耗与时延。
summary_cn: 系统评估硬件恶意软件检测器 PPA 成本：树/规则类检测器性能最高且面积小近一个数量级、能耗低数倍；削减 HPC 输入可保性能并大幅降本。
objective_summary: 构建从模型重建、RTL 综合、位精确验证到 PPA 评估的管线，在多分类器家族、可变 HPC 集合与集成方法的设计空间上量化硬件恶意软件检测器的面积、功耗与时序成本。
evidence_note: 系统性设计空间综合研究：RTL 实现逐个对照位精确 golden 模型验证，覆盖多分类器家族与 HPC 集合；属综合评估，无流片实测或统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统回答 HMD 的面积/功耗/时序成本这一开放问题，并给出「树/规则类更省、削减 HPC 输入可保性能」的部署结论；方法本身为标准综合管线。
scope: 结论适用于基于 HPC 的 HMD 的 FPGA 与 Open-PDK ASIC 实现；结论依赖所选训练模型与目标工艺库，未覆盖深度学习等其他检测范式。
limitations: 评估基于综合结果而非流片实测；训练模型与数据集沿用已有工作，检测精度上限受其约束；未评估对抗性逃避对硬件成本的影响。

title: Onions in the ATmosphere: Decentralizing Trust in Identity
abstract: Multiple approaches have been implemented for identities that associate meaningful identifiers, such as domain names, with self-authenticating identifiers, such as onion addresses. While these approaches offer various advantages both from identifier meaningfulness and from identifier self-authentication, identifier association itself is subject to blocking, hijack, fingerprinting, and other forms of surveillance and manipulation. So too are the resources associated with an identity comprising a meaningful identifier and a self-authenticating identifier. This paper describes ongoing work on two such approaches to self-authenticating meaningful identity (SAMI): associating a registered domain name with an onion address (onion association) and associating an atproto handle with a decentralized identifier (DID association). We present both the application of already implemented and published means of secure onion association to DID association and the combination of both in a single identity. Finally, we describe grounding identity association and integrity in contextual trust, wherein trusting attestations of identity relies on contextual relevance of an attestor to the identity rather than relying only on structural authority, for example as embodied in the traditional centralized infrastructure.
title_cn: 大气中的洋葱：身份信任的去中心化
abstract_cn: 已有多种方法被实现用于构建把有意义标识符（如域名）与自认证标识符（如洋葱地址）关联起来的身份。虽然这些方法从标识符有意义性与标识符自认证两方面各有优势，但标识符关联本身会遭受阻断、劫持、指纹化以及其他形式的监视与操纵。由有意义标识符与自认证标识符组成的身份所关联的资源同样如此。本文描述关于自认证有意义身份（SAMI）的两项进行中工作：将注册域名与洋葱地址关联（洋葱关联）以及将 atproto handle 与去中心化标识符关联（DID 关联）。我们既展示把已实现并发表的洋葱安全关联手段应用于 DID 关联，也展示把两者组合进单一身份。最后，我们描述把身份关联与完整性落在情境信任上：对身份证明的信任依赖证明者与身份的情境相关性，而非仅依赖传统中心化基础设施所体现的结构性权威。
summary_cn: 描述自认证有意义身份（SAMI）在研工作：域名—洋葱地址与 atproto handle—DID 两类关联及其组合，提出以情境信任替代结构性权威锚定身份。
objective_summary: 提出域名—洋葱地址与 atproto handle—DID 两类标识符关联方案及其组合，把已有的洋葱安全关联机制迁移到 DID 关联，并阐述以证明者情境相关性为基础的信任锚定思路。
evidence_note: 进行中的立场性工作（ongoing work），摘要未含新实验或量化评估，仅描述机制设计与思路。
novelty_note: 把已实现的洋葱关联机制迁移到 DID 关联并将两者组合为单一身份，加上以「情境信任」替代结构性权威的锚定思路，属已有组件的新场景组合与新框架提议。
scope: 结论适用于域名/洋葱地址与 atproto/DID 生态的身份关联场景；情境信任的实际抗攻击性未经验证。
limitations: 属进行中工作，无安全分析与实证评估；情境信任面临的共谋证明者等威胁未讨论；部署激励与迁移成本未评估。

title: Better Batches, Better Privacy: Random Allocation for DP-BandMF
abstract: The current state of the art for batch selection and noise addition in differentially private training is a combination of DP-BandMF (informally, DP-SGD where the noise added in two different steps can be correlated if the steps are within $b$ of each other) and privacy amplification by sampling via Monte Carlo accounting. First, whereas prior batch selection strategies for DP-BandMF were inspired by Poisson sampling, random allocation is known to outperform Poisson sampling for DP-SGD. We therefore propose and analyze new batch selection strategies for DP-BandMF inspired by random allocation, improving RMSE by up to $1.85\times$ over previous work. Second, Monte Carlo accounting typically requires drawing $\Omega(1/\delta)$ samples from a privacy loss distribution, making accounting costly. We increase sampling and scoring throughput by two orders of magnitude through a carefully optimized GPU implementation. Finally, previous work chose the DP-BandMF strategy matrix and the batch selection strategy independently. We give a simple framework for choosing these parameters jointly, reducing RMSE by up to $13.4\%$ over fixed strategy matrices.
title_cn: 更好的批次、更好的隐私：DP-BandMF 的随机分配
abstract_cn: 当前差分隐私训练中批次选择与噪声添加的最优水平是 DP-BandMF（非正式地说，即 DP-SGD，其中两个不同步所加噪声在两步相距不超过 b 时可以相关）与经由蒙特卡洛核算的采样隐私放大的组合。首先，此前 DP-BandMF 的批次选择策略受泊松采样启发，而已知随机分配在 DP-SGD 上优于泊松采样。因此我们提出并分析受随机分配启发的 DP-BandMF 新批次选择策略，将 RMSE 较此前工作改进至多 1.85 倍。其次，蒙特卡洛核算通常需要从隐私损失分布抽取 Ω(1/δ) 个样本，使核算代价高昂。我们通过精心优化的 GPU 实现将采样与评分吞吐提高两个数量级。最后，此前工作独立选择 DP-BandMF 策略矩阵与批次选择策略。我们给出一个联合选择这些参数的简单框架，较固定策略矩阵将 RMSE 降低至多 13.4%。
summary_cn: 为 DP-BandMF 提出随机分配式批次选择（RMSE 至多改进 1.85 倍）、吞吐提升两个数量级的 GPU 隐私核算，及策略矩阵与批次策略联合选择（RMSE 再降 13.4%）。
objective_summary: 改进 DP-BandMF 差分隐私训练的三个环节：受随机分配启发的新批次选择策略、加速两个数量级的蒙特卡洛隐私核算 GPU 实现、以及策略矩阵与批次选择的联合优化框架，并量化各自带来的 RMSE 改进。
evidence_note: 给出策略分析并与既有泊松采样式策略对比，报告 RMSE 改进倍数与吞吐提升两个数量级；摘要未列实验任务与数据集细节、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 在 DP-BandMF 框架内引入随机分配式批次选择、GPU 化核算与联合参数选择，属对现有最先进方法的实质性但增量式改进。
scope: 结论适用于 DP-BandMF/DP-SGD 类差分隐私训练的批次选择与核算；对其他隐私训练范式未评估。
limitations: RMSE 改进幅度依赖具体任务与参数区间（1.85 倍为上界）；GPU 核算效果依赖硬件；联合选择框架为简单启发式框架。

title: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Large Language Model via Hypergraph Message Passing
abstract: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) are promising to deliver privacy-preserving, collaborative intelligence. The decentralized training process is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that corrupt semantic consistency and factual resilience through malicious model updates. This paper presents a new resilience strategy that prevents semantically corrupted knowledge from propagating during federated aggregation. A defense problem is formulated to jointly maximize global accuracy and suppress manipulated model updates, enabling trustworthy knowledge aggregation without accessing private local data. To strengthen the resilience of FedLLMs, we develop a novel Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE) framework, where low-rank model updates are represented as nodes in a hypergraph and high-order semantic relationships among multiple agents are exploited through iterative message passing. By leveraging historical checkpoints and cross-agent relational reasoning, HMP-GAE identifies and suppresses semantically inconsistent updates while preserving knowledge alignment among agents throughout federated training. HMP-GAE is implemented using Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.2 as pretrained FedLLM backbones and evaluated on AG News and Yahoo! Answers datasets. Compared to existing defenses, HMP-GAE improves global accuracy by $1.21$\%, reduces final-model classification semantic entropy by $44.08$\%, and lowers perplexity by $13.34$\%. HMP-GAE outperforms the GAE-based defense by improving the accuracy $1.39$\%, reducing the semantic entropy by $54.5$\%, and lowering perplexity by $35.5$\%.
title_cn: 经由超图消息传递的拜占庭鲁棒联邦大语言模型
abstract_cn: 联邦大语言模型（FedLLM）有望提供隐私保护的协作智能。去中心化训练过程易受拜占庭攻击，恶意模型更新会破坏语义一致性与事实韧性。本文提出一种新的韧性策略，防止语义被腐蚀的知识在联邦聚合期间传播。我们形式化一个防御问题，联合最大化全局精度并抑制被操纵的模型更新，在不访问私有本地数据的情况下实现可信知识聚合。为增强 FedLLM 的韧性，我们开发新颖的超图消息传递图自编码器（HMP-GAE）框架：低秩模型更新被表示为超图中的节点，并通过迭代消息传递利用多个智能体间的高阶语义关系。借助历史检查点与跨智能体关系推理，HMP-GAE 识别并抑制语义不一致的更新，同时在联邦训练全程保持智能体间的知识对齐。HMP-GAE 以 Qwen-2.5 与 Llama-3.2 作为预训练 FedLLM 主干实现，并在 AG News 与 Yahoo! Answers 数据集上评估。与现有防御相比，HMP-GAE 将全局精度提高 1.21%，把最终模型分类语义熵降低 44.08%，困惑度降低 13.34%。相比基于 GAE 的防御，HMP-GAE 将精度提高 1.39%，语义熵降低 54.5%，困惑度降低 35.5%。
summary_cn: HMP-GAE 把低秩模型更新建为超图节点做高阶消息传递以过滤语义腐蚀更新：两主干两数据集上较现有防御精度 +1.21%、语义熵 −44.08%、困惑度 −13.34%。
objective_summary: 为 FedLLM 提出基于超图消息传递图自编码器的拜占庭防御，联合优化全局精度与对被操纵更新的抑制，用历史检查点与跨智能体关系识别语义不一致更新，并在 Qwen-2.5/Llama-3.2 与 AG News、Yahoo! Answers 上与现有防御对比。
evidence_note: 两个预训练主干（Qwen-2.5、Llama-3.2）与两个数据集、与现有防御及 GAE 基线的受控对比，报告精度/语义熵/困惑度；摘要未说明攻击者模型与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把超图消息传递引入 FedLLM 拜占庭过滤属已有组件（图自编码器防御、低秩更新表示）在新场景的组合；高阶语义关系与历史检查点的利用有一定机制新意。
scope: 结论适用于分类类任务的 cross-silo FedLLM 训练（AG News、Yahoo! Answers）；攻击者模型与自适应攻击强度在摘要中未充分披露，生成类任务未评估。
limitations: 所对抗的拜占庭攻击具体类型与比例未说明；仅在两个分类数据集与两个主干上验证；超图构建的计算开销未报告。

title: PVBRF-ID: Private, Verifiable and Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection for Oilfield Enterprise Networks
abstract: Federated learning allows dispersed oilfield sites to train a shared intrusion detector without pooling network traffic, yet its aggregation step forces a choice between privacy and robustness. Byzantine-robust rules must read each update in the clear, whereas secure aggregation hides updates from the checks that detect poisoning. We present PVBRF-ID, a two-server protocol in which sites secret-share their updates and the servers jointly test each update's norm and its cosine similarity to a reference computed on a small clean root set, revealing one accept bit per site. Commitments, Merkle roots and a homomorphic audit make the inclusion of accepted updates publicly verifiable. On a 15-class Edge-IIoTset task with ten sites holding differently distributed data and ten random seeds, PVBRF-ID matched FedAvg on clean data (macro-F1 0.708 vs. 0.706) and withstood sign-flip attacks (0.696 vs. 0.091). Against an adaptive attacker controlling 30% of sites, PVBRF-ID with secure clipping reached 0.641, whereas FedAvg fell to 0.046; plaintext multi-Krum remained higher by 0.052. An update-inference attacker recovered each site's class mix from plaintext updates (Spearman correlation 0.81) but not from one server's view. Backdoors passed the filter, and noise-based mitigation gave only heuristic protection. The implementation uses Python 3.13, NumPy 2.3, 30 rounds and 10 seeds.
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, 3 supplementary tables. Simulation study on public Edge-IIoTset traffic; code and raw results: this https URL
title_cn: PVBRF-ID：面向油田企业网络的隐私、可验证且拜占庭鲁棒的联邦入侵检测
abstract_cn: 联邦学习让分散的油田站点无需汇集网络流量即可训练共享入侵检测器，但其聚合步骤迫使在隐私与鲁棒性之间做选择。拜占庭鲁棒规则必须明文读取每个更新，而安全聚合则把更新对检测投毒的检查隐藏起来。我们提出 PVBRF-ID，一种双服务器协议：站点对其更新做秘密分享，两台服务器联合检验每个更新的范数及其与小规模干净根集上所算参考的余弦相似度，每个站点只揭示一个接受比特。承诺、Merkle 根与同态审计使被接受更新的纳入可公开验证。在一个 15 类 Edge-IIoTset 任务上、十个站点持有不同分布数据并使用十个随机种子，PVBRF-ID 在干净数据上与 FedAvg 持平（macro-F1 0.708 对 0.706），并在符号翻转攻击下保持稳健（0.696 对 0.091）。面对控制 30% 站点的自适应攻击者，采用安全剪裁的 PVBRF-ID 达到 0.641，而 FedAvg 跌至 0.046；明文 multi-Krum 仍高出 0.052。更新推断攻击者能从明文更新恢复每个站点的类别构成（Spearman 相关 0.81），但无法从单台服务器的视图恢复。后门更新通过了过滤器，基于噪声的缓解只提供启发式保护。实现使用 Python 3.13、NumPy 2.3、30 轮与 10 个种子。
summary_cn: 双服务器秘密分享协议兼顾隐私聚合与拜占庭过滤：干净 macro-F1 0.708 对 0.706，符号翻转 0.696 对 0.091，30% 自适应攻击 0.641 对 0.046，单服务器视图抗更新推断。
objective_summary: 提出双服务器联邦入侵检测协议 PVBRF-ID，以秘密分享与联合范数/余弦检验在隐藏更新的前提下做拜占庭过滤，并以承诺、Merkle 根与同态审计提供公开可验证性，在 Edge-IIoTset 上系统评估干净精度、多种攻击与更新推断风险。
evidence_note: 公开数据集 Edge-IIoTset、15 类任务、十站点非 IID、10 个随机种子；对比 FedAvg、multi-Krum、符号翻转与自适应 30% 攻击者及更新推断攻击（Spearman 0.81），代码与原始结果公开。
novelty_note: 在「鲁棒性需明文、安全聚合藏更新」的已知张力上给出双服务器范数加余弦检验与可验证审计的具体协议；秘密分享、范数/余弦过滤、承诺等组件均为已有技术，组合与验证设计有新意。
scope: 结论适用于站点数量有限、存在小规模干净根集的 cross-silo 联邦入侵检测；仅在 Edge-IIoTset 仿真评估，未在真实油田网络部署。
limitations: 后门更新能通过过滤器，噪声缓解仅启发式（作者自陈）；30% 自适应攻击下仍比明文 multi-Krum 低 0.052；余弦检验依赖小干净根集的代表性。

title: Enabling Extended SGX Enclaves inside Confidential Virtual Machines
abstract: Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs), such as AMD SEV-SNP, and process enclaves, such as Intel SGX, provide workload protection against cloud threats. However, they strongly differ in TCB, deployment cost and speed, peer workload protection, resource sharing, fine-grained isolation and attestation, and programming capabilities. Nesting process enclaves within CVMs offers an optimal solution and an opportunity to address long-standing SGX limitations: lack of intra-enclave protection, expensive transitions and exception paths, slow enclave cloning, and a restricted programming model that limits Library Operating Systems (LibOS). This paper introduces TEEVisor, a CVM-resident architecture consisting of a security monitor and a kernel driver that leverages AMD SEV-SNP Virtual Machine Privilege Levels (VMPLs) to build hardware-protected, process-level enclaves inside a guest CVM with two modes: (1) an SGX binary compatibility mode to run unmodified SGX applications; and (2) a novel extended SGX~(eSGX) mode optimizing slow execution paths and offering richer enclave programming capabilities. On commercial AMD EPYC hardware, against native CVM execution, TEEVisor incurs under 5% overhead on compute- and memory-bound workloads, around 12% on I/O-heavy applications, and accelerates enclave cloning to a rate of 93~$\mu$s/MB of enclave size, demonstrating that eSGX semantics inside a CVM are practical for production use.
title_cn: 在机密虚拟机中启用扩展 SGX Enclave
abstract_cn: 机密虚拟机（CVM，如 AMD SEV-SNP）与进程 enclave（如 Intel SGX）为工作负载提供抵御云威胁的保护。然而两者在 TCB、部署成本与速度、对等工作负载保护、资源共享、细粒度隔离与证明、编程能力上差异显著。将进程 enclave 嵌套于 CVM 内提供了最优解，也是解决 SGX 长期局限的机会：缺乏 enclave 内保护、昂贵的转换与异常路径、缓慢的 enclave 克隆、以及限制库操作系统（LibOS）的受限编程模型。本文提出 TEEVisor，一种驻留 CVM 的架构，由安全监视器与内核驱动组成，利用 AMD SEV-SNP 虚拟机特权级（VMPL）在客户 CVM 内构建硬件保护的进程级 enclave，提供两种模式：(1) 运行未修改 SGX 应用的 SGX 二进制兼容模式；(2) 优化慢执行路径并提供更丰富 enclave 编程能力的新型扩展 SGX（eSGX）模式。在商用 AMD EPYC 硬件上，相对原生 CVM 执行，TEEVisor 在计算与内存密集型负载上开销低于 5%，在 I/O 密集型应用上约 12%，并将 enclave 克隆加速到每 MB enclave 大小 93 µs 的速率，证明 CVM 内的 eSGX 语义对生产使用是实用的。
summary_cn: TEEVisor 借 SEV-SNP VMPL 在 CVM 内构建进程级 enclave：兼容未修改 SGX 程序并提供 eSGX 扩展，计算/内存负载开销 <5%、I/O 约 12%、克隆 93 µs/MB。
objective_summary: 设计驻留 CVM 的安全监视器与内核驱动 TEEVisor，用 VMPL 在客户机内实现 SGX 二进制兼容与扩展 eSGX 两种 enclave 模式，并在商用 AMD EPYC 硬件上量化其相对原生 CVM 的开销与克隆速率。
evidence_note: 商用 AMD EPYC 硬件实测：相对原生 CVM 计算与内存负载开销 <5%、I/O 约 12%、enclave 克隆 93 µs/MB，覆盖多类负载。
novelty_note: 在 CVM 内经 VMPL 实现 SGX 二进制兼容运行与扩展 eSGX 语义的嵌套 enclave 架构，同时缓解 enclave 内保护、转换开销、克隆速度与 LibOS 编程模型等长期局限。
scope: 结论适用于带 SEV-SNP（VMPL 支持）的 AMD EPYC 平台；Intel TDX 等其他 CVM 或无 VMPL 能力的平台未评估。
limitations: 安全监视器自身成为新 TCB，摘要未报告对其的攻击面分析；I/O 密集负载仍有约 12% 开销；仅评估 AMD 平台。

title: Cancerous Backdoor Attack: Gradual Activation via Invisible Tokens and A Stage Controller
abstract: Backdoor Attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) typically follow a trigger-response pattern, where satisfying a trigger condition activates a single terminal behavior. However, this single-point backdoor activation does not explore attacks in which malicious behavior develops gradually through multiple intermediate stages before reaching the terminal activation stage. We present Cancerous Backdoor Attack, that gradually corrupts an LLM's reasoning over a sequence of interactions by leveraging invisible tokens and a stage controller. Specifically, invisible tokens provide hidden stages to the model without appearing in the user's visible request and the stage controller tracks the attack's progression during inference to realize gradual activation. We evaluate Cancerous Backdoor Attack across several reasoning datasets. The attack consistently produces gradual reasoning corruption across models and tasks. We compare Cancerous Backdoor Attack with prior backdoor attack baselines to demonstrate our proposed attack outperforms the baselines. Our results indicate that reasoning corruption can develop gradually before it becomes visible, making answer accuracy alone insufficient for detecting backdoor attacks.
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables
title_cn: 癌式后门攻击：经由不可见 Token 与阶段控制器的渐进激活
abstract_cn: 对大语言模型（LLM）的后门攻击通常遵循触发—响应模式，即满足触发条件激活单一终端行为。然而这种单点后门激活并未探索恶意行为经过多个中间阶段逐步发展、最终到达终端激活阶段的攻击。我们提出癌式后门攻击（Cancerous Backdoor Attack），通过利用不可见 token 与阶段控制器，在一系列交互中逐渐腐蚀 LLM 的推理。具体而言，不可见 token 在不出现在用户可见请求中的情况下向模型提供隐藏阶段，阶段控制器在推理期间跟踪攻击的进展以实现渐进激活。我们在多个推理数据集上评估癌式后门攻击。该攻击在多个模型与任务上持续产生渐进的推理腐蚀。我们将癌式后门攻击与已有后门攻击基线比较，证明所提攻击优于基线。我们的结果表明，推理腐蚀可以在变得可见之前逐步发展，使仅看答案准确率不足以检测后门攻击。
summary_cn: 提出「癌式后门」：不可见 token 加阶段控制器让恶意行为跨多轮交互分阶段腐蚀 LLM 推理，在多个推理数据集上优于已有后门基线，答案准确率不足以察觉。
objective_summary: 提出一种分阶段渐进激活的 LLM 后门攻击，以不可见 token 注入隐藏阶段、以阶段控制器在推理期跟踪进度，使推理被逐步腐蚀，并在多个推理数据集上与后门基线比较。
evidence_note: 在多个推理数据集与多模型上评估并与已有后门基线对比（31 页 13 表）；摘要未给出具体成功率数字或统计检验。
novelty_note: 把后门从单点触发—响应扩展为「多阶段渐进激活」威胁模型，配合不可见 token 与推理期阶段控制器实现，属攻击设计上的实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可被投毒训练或微调的 LLM；攻击依赖在模型中植入阶段控制器与不可见 token 机制，对推理 API 侧黑盒模型不适用。
limitations: 摘要未给出具体成功率与跨模型数字；攻击依赖训练期植入；仅观察「答案准确率不足以检测」，未提出对应防御。

title: HOMARD: Hammering Off-chip Memory via Aggregate power Rail Disclosure
abstract: Software-based microarchitectural attacks have mainly exploited timing differences to infer information from DRAM. However, defenses and optimizations can prevent timing-based approaches from resolving precise microarchitectural behaviors. We show that unprivileged millisecond- and milliampere-resolution power sensors on modern Arm SoCs can recover DRAM mapping functions and reveal the data dependence of memory accesses without timers. We present HOMARD, a methodology that reads DRAM activity from this telemetry, and two attack primitives. HOMARD-RE is a hierarchy-aware linear-algebraic method that reverse-engineers DRAM addressing functions from power alone. HOMARD-DATA recovers the Hamming weight of a fetched cache line through joint-power rail templating and secret byte values through correlation power analysis on the same rails. Across an AMD ZCU102, a Raspberry Pi 5, and a multi-chip-based LPDDR4 NVIDIA Jetson TX2, HOMARD-RE succeeds where row-buffer timing methods fail. On the Pi 5, HOMARD-DATA classifies 9 Hamming-weight levels at 81.5% accuracy and recovers secret bytes in minutes by correlating rail current with data-dependent bit toggling between neighbors in a row. Both primitives work with an architectural load or a mispredicted Spectre-RSB path on which no value is architecturally read. These results establish unprivileged power telemetry as an independent side channel for profiled microarchitectural attacks, particularly when timing falls silent.
title_cn: HOMARD：经由聚合电源轨披露的片外内存锤击
abstract_cn: 基于软件的微架构攻击主要利用时间差从 DRAM 推断信息。然而，防御与优化可能阻止基于时间的方法解析精确的微架构行为。我们证明，现代 Arm SoC 上非特权的毫秒级、毫安级分辨率功耗传感器可以在没有计时器的情况下恢复 DRAM 映射函数并揭示内存访问的数据依赖性。我们提出 HOMARD，一种从该遥测读取 DRAM 活动的方法，以及两个攻击原语。HOMARD-RE 是一个层次感知的线性代数方法，仅凭功耗逆向工程 DRAM 寻址函数。HOMARD-DATA 通过联合电源轨模板化恢复取回缓存行的汉明重量，并通过对同一电源轨的相关功耗分析恢复秘密字节值。在 AMD ZCU102、Raspberry Pi 5 与基于多芯片的 LPDDR4 NVIDIA Jetson TX2 上，HOMARD-RE 在行缓冲计时方法失败之处取得成功。在 Pi 5 上，HOMARD-DATA 以 81.5% 的准确率分类 9 个汉明重量级别，并通过把轨电流与行内相邻字节间数据相关的位翻转做相关，在数分钟内恢复秘密字节。两个原语既可用架构化加载工作，也可用没有任何值被架构化读取的误预测 Spectre-RSB 路径工作。这些结果确立了非特权功耗遥测作为轮廓式微架构攻击的独立侧信道，尤其是在计时沉默之时。
summary_cn: 用 Arm SoC 非特权功耗遥测替代计时信道：HOMARD-RE 仅凭功耗逆向 DRAM 寻址，HOMARD-DATA 在 Pi 5 上以 81.5% 准确率分类 9 级汉明重量并数分钟内恢复秘密字节。
objective_summary: 提出从毫秒/毫安级功耗遥测读取 DRAM 活动的方法 HOMARD 与两个原语：层次感知线性代数逆向 DRAM 寻址函数（HOMARD-RE）与经由电源轨模板化和相关功耗分析恢复汉明重量及字节值（HOMARD-DATA），并在三种 Arm 平台上验证。
evidence_note: 三种真实 Arm 平台（ZCU102、Pi 5、Jetson TX2）实测：81.5% 汉明重量分类准确率、数分钟字节恢复、与失败的行缓冲计时方法对照，并验证 Spectre-RSB 路径可行性。
novelty_note: 把非特权功耗遥测确立为独立于计时的微架构侧信道新模态：仅凭功耗逆向 DRAM 映射并恢复数据依赖，为计时防御生效场景下开辟的新攻击路线。
scope: 结论适用于暴露毫秒/毫安级功耗传感器的现代 Arm SoC（ZCU102、Pi 5、Jetson TX2 已验证）；攻击为轮廓式，对无此类遥测或无预收集模板的环境未验证。
limitations: 轮廓式攻击需先在受控设备上建立电源轨模板；仅评估三种 Arm 平台与 LPDDR4 场景；对功耗噪声注入、遥测访问限制等防御未做实证评估。

title: Organizational Context for the Enterprise Security Brain
abstract: Agents that investigate and decide on enterprise security reason over a machine-readable view of the environment: its assets, identities, configurations, relations, and findings. The correct judgment about an asset also depends on what the organization knows about it: who owns it, what business function it serves, which policy governs it, and which risks were accepted. Part of this knowledge can be inferred from machine state, such as an ownership tag; most of it is recorded by people in policies, audit reports, architecture diagrams, tickets, and conversations, outside machine state. We call this distance the organizational context gap. Closing it poses four challenges: extracting the right claims from heterogeneous organizational data and, at inference time, detecting claims made stale by live state, checking live state against the governing policy, and binding architecture diagrams, which carry the business logic, to live resources. We introduce organizational context as a layer of the enterprise security brain and define it with a taxonomy and six properties its representation must preserve. We then define a context model in which a claim carries one meaning, an attestation records each source that asserts it, strength is derived from live evidence at read time, and claims resolve onto the entities of the asset graph. On a production environment spanning AWS, Okta, Google Workspace, and GitHub, extraction recovers 0.80 of a pooled 1,355-claim ground truth at 0.87 precision, with 0.5% of extracted claims unsupported by their source. An agent reasoning over live state and resolved context raises the conflict in 0.97 of stale-finding tasks, and reaches answer correctness of 0.83 on policy-alignment tasks and 0.86 on architecture tasks.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 1 appendix
title_cn: 面向企业安全大脑的组织上下文
abstract_cn: 在企业安全中调查并决策的智能体需要对环境的机器可读视图进行推理：资产、身份、配置、关系与发现。对一项资产的正确判断还取决于组织对它的了解：谁拥有它、它服务于什么业务功能、哪项策略治理它、哪些风险已被接受。这些知识一部分可以从机器状态推断，例如所有权标签；大部分由人记录在策略、审计报告、架构图、工单与对话中，处于机器状态之外。我们将这种距离称为组织上下文鸿沟。弥合它带来四个挑战：从异构组织数据中抽取正确的声明，并在推理时检测因实时状态而过期的声明、用治理策略检查实时状态、以及把承载业务逻辑的架构图绑定到实时资源。我们将组织上下文引入为企业安全大脑的一层，并用一个分类法及其表示必须保留的六个性质来定义它。随后我们定义一个上下文模型：声明携带单一含义，证明记录断言它的每个来源，强度在读取时由实时证据导出，声明解析到资产图的实体上。在一个横跨 AWS、Okta、Google Workspace 与 GitHub 的生产环境中，抽取以 0.87 精确率恢复合计 1,355 条声明 ground truth 中的 0.80，抽取声明中仅 0.5% 不受其来源支持。一个在实时状态与已解析上下文上推理的智能体在 0.97 的陈旧发现任务中提升冲突，在策略对齐任务上达到 0.83 的答案正确率，在架构任务上达到 0.86。
summary_cn: 提出「组织上下文」层与声明式上下文模型：生产环境 1,355 条声明上抽取召回 0.80/精确 0.87，陈旧发现冲突提升 0.97、策略对齐 0.83、架构任务 0.86。
objective_summary: 定义企业安全中机器状态之外的组织上下文层，给出分类法、六性质与声明—证明—读取时强度的上下文模型，并在 AWS/Okta/Google Workspace/GitHub 生产数据上评估抽取质量与智能体任务表现。
evidence_note: 在横跨 AWS、Okta、Google Workspace、GitHub 的生产环境评估：1,355 条声明 ground truth、抽取召回 0.80/精确 0.87、未支持声明 0.5%，三类智能体任务分别报告 0.97/0.83/0.86。
novelty_note: 首次把「组织上下文鸿沟」作为企业安全智能体的独立问题层提出，给出分类法与声明—证明—读取时强度的上下文模型；资产图与安全知识图谱已有工作，组织侧知识的系统化处理是新机制。
scope: 结论适用于有较完整组织文档与身份/资产管理的企业环境；抽取质量依赖组织记录的存在与质量，单一生产环境结果未必迁移到其他组织。
limitations: 评估基于单一生产环境的 1,355 条声明 ground truth；抽取依赖异构组织文档的可用性；架构图到实时资源的绑定与策略检查的失败模式细节未在摘要报告。

title: SoK: Privacy-Preserving Order Matching
abstract: Privacy-preserving order matching enables traders to discover and execute compatible orders while limiting disclosure of sensitive trading information. Existing systems span financial markets and blockchain-based asset exchanges and employ diverse market structures, privacy mechanisms, and trust assumptions, making their privacy guarantees difficult to compare. We present a systematization of privacy-preserving order matching covering 22 protocol families. We organize the order lifecycle into four phases: order representation and submission, order discovery and collection, order-matching, and settlement, and characterize each phase by protected and exposed information, access roles, privacy mechanisms, and trust assumptions. Our analysis shows that privacy is not a single protocol-level property: protecting selected order attributes or individual phases does not necessarily prevent leakage elsewhere in the lifecycle. We identify recurring trade-offs among privacy, functionality, trust, and verifiability, highlighting the challenge of achieving end-to-end privacy across the complete order lifecycle.
title_cn: SoK：隐私保护的订单撮合
abstract_cn: 隐私保护的订单撮合使交易者能够发现并执行兼容订单，同时限制敏感交易信息的披露。现有系统横跨金融市场与基于区块链的资产交易所，采用多样的市场结构、隐私机制与信任假设，使其隐私保证难以比较。我们对隐私保护订单撮合进行系统化，覆盖 22 个协议族。我们将订单生命周期组织为四个阶段：订单表示与提交、订单发现与收集、订单撮合与结算，并按每个阶段受保护与暴露的信息、访问角色、隐私机制与信任假设加以刻画。我们的分析表明，隐私不是单一的协议级属性：保护选定的订单属性或单个阶段并不必然阻止生命周期其他环节的泄露。我们识别出隐私、功能、信任与可验证性之间反复出现的权衡，突出了在完整订单生命周期中实现端到端隐私的挑战。
summary_cn: 系统化 22 个隐私保护订单撮合协议族，按订单生命周期四阶段刻画信息暴露、隐私机制与信任假设，揭示端到端隐私难以兼顾的固有权衡。
objective_summary: 对金融市场与区块链资产交易所中的隐私保护订单撮合协议做系统化整理，提出四阶段订单生命周期分析框架，按信息暴露、访问角色、隐私机制与信任假设比较各协议族。
evidence_note: 系统化覆盖 22 个协议族，按统一四阶段框架与信息暴露/访问角色/信任假设维度组织；属文献整理型工作，无新实验。
novelty_note: 首次将隐私保护订单撮合作为独立类别跨金融市场与区块链系统化，四阶段生命周期框架与「隐私非单一协议属性」的结论有组织性新意；所涉协议均为已有工作。
scope: 结论适用于金融市场与区块链资产交易所中的撮合协议隐私分析；覆盖范围以所收 22 个协议族为准，未公开的工业实现可能缺席。
limitations: 系统化对象限于已发表协议族；隐私—功能—信任—可验证性权衡以定性分析为主，无量化比较。

title: An Exploration of Attacks on AI Agent Systems
abstract: As autonomous AI agents become more integrated into sensitive domains, it is crucial that single and multi-agent AI systems are secured. This paper investigates how prompt injection attacks can exploit both direct user inputs and inter?agent communication to leak sensitive information and trigger cross-agent infections. While our tests mostly highlight key vulnerabilities in single-agent systems, we also extend these attacks to multi-agent frameworks, investigating how weaknesses can propagate across agents. Our findings emphasize the need for more robust defenses as AI agents become more commonly embedded in real-world workflows.
title_cn: 对 AI 智能体系统的攻击探索
abstract_cn: 随着自主 AI 智能体越来越多地融入敏感领域，保障单智能体与多智能体 AI 系统的安全至关重要。本文研究提示注入攻击如何利用直接用户输入与智能体间通信来泄露敏感信息并触发跨智能体感染。虽然我们的测试主要揭示了单智能体系统中的关键漏洞，我们也将这些攻击扩展到多智能体框架，研究弱点如何跨智能体传播。我们的发现强调，随着 AI 智能体越来越普遍地嵌入真实世界工作流，需要更健壮的防御。
summary_cn: 测试提示注入如何经用户输入与智能体间通信泄露信息并在多智能体框架中传播，揭示单/多智能体系统的关键漏洞并呼吁更强防御。
objective_summary: 通过测试考察提示注入攻击利用直接用户输入与智能体间通信的方式，并扩展到多智能体框架观察弱点如何跨智能体传播与感染。
evidence_note: 以探索性测试为主，摘要未给出数据集、模型规模或成功率等量化结果，仅报告在单/多智能体系统上观察到的漏洞类别。
novelty_note: 提示注入与多智能体风险均已被广泛研究；本文贡献主要是对直接输入与智能体间通信两条注入路径的探索性演示，机制与量化新意有限。
scope: 结论适用于把用户输入与智能体间消息视为不可信内容的 LLM 智能体系统；未覆盖特定生产框架的系统性量化评估。
limitations: 摘要未报告量化成功率与实验规模；测试场景与智能体框架未具体披露；防御仅在讨论层面提出。

title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
abstract: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.
comment: Conceptual research paper; includes one framework figure. The manuscript proposes a model-agnostic Boundary Assurance Stack for proactive security and accountable human oversight of high-capability AI agents
title_cn: 从被动遏制到主动保证：OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Google 智能体安全事件的教训
abstract_cn: 2026 年，涉及 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Google 智能体的网络安全评估触及了其授权测试范围之外的真实系统。路径各不相同：OpenAI 智能体利用研究基础设施、跨运行协同，并危害了 Hugging Face 生产环境的部分组件；Anthropic 报告了配置不当的第三方环境把真实系统暴露给执行模拟网络任务的智能体的案例；在另一起独立报道的评估中，Google 的 Gemini 通过一条非预期的互联网路由访问了三个真实组织，Google 声称模型在三起事件中都停止了行动。综合来看，这些案例说明评估不能依赖假定的边界：边界必须在智能体运行时得到验证。这一比较性工具案例研究发展出主动智能体安全保障循环（PASAC）与五层边界保证栈。该框架结合风险分级的任务设计、可执行的范围契约、运行前验证、最小能力访问、独立出口强制、凭据限制、跨运行监控、自动停止条件与基于证据的重新授权。一个先行指标模型、九个设计命题与七个可证伪假设把这些教训变成可检验的研究计划。由于 Gemini 的公开记录仅限于归因声明与新闻报道，其详细因果机制仍是暂定的。核心结论很直接：主动的智能体安全需要对整个执行系统的持续保证，而不是对任何单一沙箱或防护措施的信心。
summary_cn: 对 2026 年 OpenAI/Anthropic/Google 三起智能体越界事件的比较案例研究：提出主动智能体安全保障循环 PASAC 与五层边界保证栈（范围契约、最小能力、独立出口、跨运行监控、自动停止等），给出九个设计命题与七个可证伪假设。
objective_summary: 以三起真实智能体越界事件为案例，提炼边界必须运行时验证的教训，提出 PASAC 保障循环与五层边界保证栈及可检验的研究命题。
evidence_note: 概念性论文：基于公开事件报告的案例比较，无经验验证或原型实现；作者自陈 Gemini 因果机制为暂定。
novelty_note: 把 2026 年三起真实越界事件系统化为可检验的保障框架与命题是该讨论的较早系统化尝试；各组成要素（最小权限、出口控制等）为既有安全原则。
scope: 结论适用于高能力 AI 智能体的评估与部署边界治理；依赖公开报道的事件细节，不可作为因果结论。
limitations: 无经验验证或原型；公开记录有限使案例因果链不完整；框架的可行性与部署开销未评估。

title: ORCAGen: Orchestrating Context-Aware Malware Deception with RAG-Guided Generative AI
abstract: Malware defenses often remove or isolate suspicious programs as quickly as possible. While effective for containment, this approach can also waste an opportunity to observe attacker behavior and deploy targeted countermeasures. ORCAGen takes a different approach: it uses GenAI to build malware-specific deception playbooks offline, validates them before deployment, and enforces only the verified logic at runtime. ORCAGen combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with structured prompt engineering to generate both proof-of-concept (PoC) malware and corresponding deception orchestration code. A curated knowledge base (KB) of malware procedures and active defense strategies grounds the generation process, helping the LLM produce threat-specific and executable deception logic rather than generic or hallucinated outputs. The generated PoC malware provides a safe and reproducible way to test whether a deception strategy can disrupt, redirect, or suppress targeted malware behavior before the strategy is added to the runtime playbook. We evaluate ORCAGen across GPT-4o, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Qwen3-Coder, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 using execution success, hallucination rate, refinement effort, deception effectiveness, and runtime overhead.
