title_cn: 隐形墨水、可见谎言：生产级水印如何导致 LLM 幻觉
abstract_cn: 文本水印帮助识别 AI 生成内容，但其对事实可靠性的影响仍缺乏研究。本文研究水印幻觉：即便所需证据在上下文中、未加水印的模型能正确作答，水印仍诱发或放大的事实错误。在受控的检索增强生成设定下，我们在相同上下文、查询与解码配置下比较未加水印与加水印的生成，并量化其事实准确率下降。跨 KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max 与 SynthID 六种代表性水印方法，我们一致观察到水印诱发幻觉。加水印的输出可以在保持流畅的同时引入事实错误。我们把这一失效归因于两种机制：(1) 方法特定的重加权或带钥采样引起的当前步词元扰动；(2) 前缀诱发的注意力漂移，随自回归解码累积并削弱后续对事实上下文的注意力。基于此分析，我们提出可在词元与注意力两个层面即插即用、可集成进现有水印方法的干预。在 1% FPR 下匹配 TPR 0.90 时，两种干预组合相对仅水印解码减少约 90% 的事实错误，同时保持流畅度与相当的解码效率。总体而言，这项工作把事实性确立为水印评估中与可检测性、鲁棒性并列的一等标准，并呼吁在事实关键应用部署水印前进行仔细的事实性验证。（NeurIPS 2026）
summary_cn: 首次系统揭示水印幻觉：六种主流水印在受控 RAG 设定下均诱发事实错误，归因于词元扰动与注意力漂移；配套两级干预在 1% FPR 下 TPR 0.90 时减少约 90% 事实错误（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 量化水印对事实性的损害、诊断其机制并提出可插拔的词元/注意力干预。
evidence_note: 六种水印方法的受控对比、机制归因与干预消融，报告匹配 TPR/FPR 的量化改善；NeurIPS 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 首次把「水印诱发幻觉」确立为系统性失效模式并给出机制解释与缓解，开辟水印评估的新维度。
scope: 结论适用于解码期统计水印与 RAG 事实任务；对 logits 扰动之外的模型指纹、多轮对话事实性未覆盖。
limitations: 干预在所选六方法与任务上验证，未覆盖全部水印家族；事实性以自动评估为主；长上下文漂移的累积效应未完全刻画。

title: Trusted Hardware Acceleration for Malicious-Secure Function Secret Sharing
abstract: Function secret sharing (FSS) underlies two-party private inference and private information retrieval, with cost dominated by generating, moving and evaluating distributed point function (DPF) keys. A trusted GPU-integrated distributed function accelerator (DFA) removed key movement by generating and consuming keys locally, but tolerates only semi-honest adversaries. A malicious host or GPU can tamper with shares, replay one-time material, swap buffers after checking, request early outputs, or abuse the accelerator as a forgery oracle, while malicious FSS ships large authenticated keys or multiplies DPF work. We present VIGOR-DFA, protecting the chain from authorized input to authorized output release with three mechanisms: a fresh authentication epilogue using three field multiplications per DPF output, 3.8-4.0 times faster per gate than per-lane DPF tag trees; a freeze-before-challenge check of every opening with t = 3 independent MAC lanes over F_{2^61-1}; and a role-bound one-time resource ledger with a release guard, in a protected datapath beside the GPU L2 cache. We prove stand-alone static malicious security with abort in a protected-module model, with statistical error Q(2/p)^t approximately 2^-148 for Q less than or equal to 2^32 checked batches. Our DFA-calibrated model shows that, against dealer-based malicious FSS modeled after the protocol family of Shark, VIGOR-DFA removes 21.8-563 GB of per-query offline authenticated material and, mainly by generating it in-module, lowers LAN latency by 10.1-14.0 times (1.5-1.8 times excluding offline distribution) and energy by 3.0-3.9 times. Malicious security costs 2.5-3.5 times LAN latency over semi-honest DFA and 0.145 mm^2 at 7 nm. We have completed the verification of specifications and the functional CPU reference model, including GPU/RTL conformance verification, protected runtime evaluation, and deployment-related tests.

title_cn: 面向恶意安全函数秘密分享的可信硬件加速
abstract_cn: 函数秘密分享（FSS）支撑两方私有推理与私有信息检索，其成本由生成、移动与评估分布式点函数（DPF）密钥主导。一种与 GPU 集成的可信分布式功能加速器（DFA）通过本地生成并消费密钥消除了密钥搬运，但只容忍半诚实对手。恶意主机或 GPU 可以篡改份额、重放一次性材料、在检查后交换缓冲区、要求提前输出，或把加速器滥用为伪造预言机；而恶意安全的 FSS 需要装运大体积认证密钥或成倍增加 DPF 工作量。我们提出 VIGOR-DFA，用三种机制保护从授权输入到授权输出发布的全链路：对每个 DPF 输出使用三次域乘法的新鲜认证尾声（比每通道 DPF 标签树快 3.8–4.0 倍）；对所有打开进行先冻结后质询检查（在 F(2^61-1) 上取 t=3 条独立 MAC 通道）；以及在 GPU L2 缓存旁保护数据通路中、带发布守卫的角色绑定一次性资源账本。我们在保护模块模型下证明带中止的独立静态恶意安全，对不超过 2^32 个受检批次统计错误约 2^-148。DFA 校准模型显示，与仿照 Shark 协议族的经销商式恶意 FSS 相比，VIGOR-DFA 每查询移除 21.8–563 GB 离线认证材料，并主要因模块内生成而把 LAN 延迟降低 10.1–14.0 倍（剔除离线分发后 1.5–1.8 倍）、能耗降低 3.0–3.9 倍。恶意安全相对半诚实 DFA 的代价是 2.5–3.5 倍 LAN 延迟与 7nm 下 0.145 平方毫米。我们已完成规范与功能 CPU 参考模型的验证，包括 GPU/RTL 一致性验证、保护运行时评估与部署相关测试。
summary_cn: VIGOR-DFA 为可信 DFA 上的 FSS 补齐恶意安全：认证尾声快 3.8–4.0 倍、t=3 MAC 冻结检查与一次性资源账本，较经销商式恶意 FSS 每查询省 21.8–563 GB、LAN 延迟降 10.1–14.0 倍，规范与参考模型验证完成。

title: Forecasting Cybersecurity Incidents Using Geopolitical Data and Large Language Models
abstract: Predicting security incidents is a profound task critical for informing proactive defensive measures and cyber-insurance policies. Prior work tackling this problem mainly utilized structured, manually defined features based on network measurements (e.g., protocol misconfigurations). Still, despite leading to promising performance, the network-based features may fail to capture aspects related to adversaries' motives. To fill this gap, our work leverages geopolitical data mined from public sources--which may help capture attacker motives--to forecast security incidents. Specifically, our approach relies on news articles and transcribed podcasts that are fed to large language models to automatically produce rich representations. The representations are then fed to a classifier trained to forecast future incidents based on historical ones. Our evaluation with a large incidents dataset (>15,700 records) demonstrates substantial accuracy (71.4% ROC AUC) with geopolitical data alone. Notably, combining geopolitical data and network measurements outperforms the state-of-the-art technique based on network features alone (81.3% vs.77.5% ROC AUC). Our analysis also helps shed light on when geopolitical data is most helpful and the data sources that are most useful for accurate forecasting.
title_cn: 用地缘政治数据与大语言模型预测网络安全事件
abstract_cn: 预测安全事件是一项重要任务，对主动防御措施与网络保险政策都有指导意义。先前解决该问题的工作主要利用基于网络测量的结构化、人工定义特征（如协议配置错误）。尽管这些网络特征带来了可观性能，但可能无法捕捉与对手动机相关的方面。为填补这一空白，我们的工作利用从公开来源挖掘的地缘政治数据来预测安全事件，这类数据有助于捕捉攻击者动机。具体地，我们的方法把新闻文章与转写播客输入大语言模型以自动生成丰富表示，再把表示输入根据历史事件训练的分类器以预测未来事件。在超过 15,700 条记录的大规模事件数据集上的评估显示，仅用地缘政治数据即取得可观的 71.4% ROC AUC。值得注意的是，地缘政治数据与网络测量结合后的表现优于仅用网络特征的最先进技术（81.3% 对 77.5% ROC AUC）。我们的分析还揭示了地缘政治数据何时最有帮助，以及哪些数据来源对准确预测最有用。
summary_cn: 以 LLM 从新闻与播客提取地缘政治表示预测安全事件：超过 15,700 条记录上单独达 71.4% AUC，与网络特征结合 81.3% 超过纯网络 SOTA 的 77.5%。
objective_summary: 构建以 LLM 地缘政治表示增强的安全事件预测管线，并与网络特征 SOTA 对比。
evidence_note: 超过 15,700 条事件记录的大规模评估、与 SOTA 对比并报告 AUC；数据管线自建、无统计检验与时间外推检验细节。
novelty_note: 引入地缘政治数据作为事件预测的新特征源并量化其与网络特征的互补性，属特征层面的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于事件数据集覆盖的地缘环境与时段；对突发地缘冲击、多语言来源覆盖不足地区的外推有限。
limitations: 新闻/播客来源偏英语主流媒体；LLM 表示的时效与成本未评估；因果方向未验证（相关非因果）。

title: Tracing model-generated DNA with position-independent watermarking
abstract: Genomic language models can write synthetic DNA that carries no record of its origin. A generation-time watermark could provide a provenance signal, if a verifier can detect it using only the DNA sequence, a key, and published detector settings, without knowing where the generated region starts, which strand it lies on, or how it was divided into six-base tokens. We embed the SynthID tournament watermark in two genomic language models, Carbon and GENERator-v2. The verifier searches both strands, every start position, and four window lengths, and corrects its decision for the whole search. In a detection cohort of 1,544 held-out prompts, it found all 3,088 marked sequences per model, unedited and after one substituted, inserted, or deleted base. For ordinary sequences, the one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on the false-positive rate was at most 0.850%; one bound for the wrong-key control reached 1.015% (Carbon, after a deletion). In a development cohort, neither model showed a detectable change in likelihood or in predefined sequence measures. Under random edits placed without reference to the detector, detection stayed complete or nearly complete up to a 2% per-base edit rate. These results show statistical detection, not biological function, secret-key security, or robustness to an editor who sees the detector.
comment: 16 pages
title_cn: 用位置无关水印追踪模型生成的 DNA
abstract_cn: 基因组语言模型可以写出不带任何来源记录的合成 DNA。若验证者仅用 DNA 序列、密钥与公开的检测器设置就能检出水印——无需知道生成区域的起点、所在链或六碱基词元的划分方式——那么生成时水印便可提供溯源信号。我们把 SynthID 锦标赛水印嵌入两个基因组语言模型 Carbon 与 GENERator-v2。验证者搜索两条链、每个起点与四种窗口长度，并对整个搜索校正其判定。在 1,544 个保留提示的检测队列中，每个模型的全部 3,088 条标记序列均被检出——未编辑与经一次替换、插入或删除后皆然。对普通序列，误报率的单侧 95% 置信上界至多 0.850%；错钥对照的一个界达到 1.015%（Carbon，删除后）。在开发队列中，两个模型在似然与预定义序列度量上均无可检出变化。在与检测器无关的随机编辑下，检测保持完整或近乎完整直至每碱基 2% 的编辑率。这些结果证明的是统计检测，而非生物功能、密钥安全性或对见过检测器的编辑者的鲁棒性。
summary_cn: 把 SynthID 水印适配到基因组语言模型（Carbon、GENERator-v2）：位置/链/分词无关检测在 1,544 提示、3,088 条标记序列上全部检出，误报上界 0.850%，2% 编辑率内保持检测。
objective_summary: 实现位置无关的基因组序列水印检测并系统评估检出率、误报界与编辑鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 1,544 提示、两模型、双链全位置搜索并给出校正后 95% 置信上界（至多 0.850%）与编辑率扫描，评估严谨。
novelty_note: 水印技术承自 SynthID，新在位置/链/分词无关的搜索-校正检测设计及基因组溯源场景的首批系统验证。
scope: 结论适用于所测两个基因组语言模型与短编辑；对见过检测器的自适应编辑者、生物功能验证不适用。
limitations: 只证统计可检测性，不证序列生物学效力；错钥对照个别界达 1.015%；未测试对抗性编辑策略。

title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
abstract: A verifier for an agent faces rules of two kinds: the ones a fixed check can settle and the ones that require a judge. A team that derives its own checks fixes that split up front. Where the requirements come from outside, as in finance, healthcare and law, the agent enforces rules it did not write, so the split falls to runtime, recurring for every predicate of every rule on every action at a rate no reviewer can audit. Every escalation scheme assumes a model can make that decision itself, that it is self-decidable. Across six corpora, including the EU AI Act, FINRA guidance and a deployed credit agent, we collect roughly 22,000 labels from four models built by three labs. They agree almost perfectly where the answer is obvious and collapse on regulatory text; their errors run in opposite directions, so no model can be trusted as the conservative choice; and on the deployed agent's own rule-set they err together, over-claiming that a fixed check will do, the direction that never gets escalated. We introduce CoVer (corroborate-then-verify), which treats unanimity as a nomination, admitting a predicate only when the check synthesized for it survives intervention, reading fields the agent cannot write and holding under deterministic rewording. That gate rejects most of what corroboration wrongly admits, at a cost in coverage we report rather than tune away. The obvious alternative, agreement with a reference judge, certifies nothing: it climbs from 30% to 77% across calibration bands while the genuinely decidable share does not move, because a judge drawn from the population under indictment ratifies the blind spot it shares. Self-decidability is not a capability to elicit from a model but a boundary the verifier must construct.
comment: Accepted at the Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 21 pages (9 content pages plus references and appendices)
title_cn: 不可自决：LLM 无法划定智能体验证器可检查的边界
abstract_cn: 智能体验证器面对两类规则：固定检查能裁决的，与需要评判者的。自行派生检查的团队在开始就固定了这一划分。当需求来自外部——如金融、医疗与法律——智能体执行的不是它自己写的规则，于是划分落到运行时，对每条规则的每个谓词、每个动作反复出现，频率没有任何评审者能审计。每种升级方案都假设模型能自行做出该决定，即它是可自决的。跨六个语料——包括欧盟 AI 法案、FINRA 指引与一个已部署的信贷智能体——我们从三家实验室的四个模型收集约 22,000 个标签。它们在答案显然之处几乎完全一致，在监管文本上崩溃；其错误方向相反，因此没有哪个模型能被信任为保守选择；在已部署智能体自己的规则集上，它们共同犯错，过度宣称固定检查已足够——那是永远不会被升级的方向。我们提出 CoVer（先共证后验证），把一致性视为提名：只有为某谓词合成的检查经受住干预——读取智能体无法写入的字段、并在确定性改写下保持——才被接纳。该门拒绝了共证错误接纳的大多数，代价是覆盖率，我们如实报告而不调参掩盖。显而易见的替代方案——与参考评判者一致——证明不了任何事：它在各校准带上从 30% 爬升到 77%，而真正可判定的份额纹丝不动，因为从被起诉群体中抽取的评判者会批准它共享的盲区。可自决性不是可以从模型中引导出的能力，而是验证器必须构造的边界。（NeurIPS 2026 工作坊，非存档）
summary_cn: 用 6 语料、4 模型约 2.2 万标签证明 LLM 不能自决「哪些规则可固定检查」：模型错误方向相反且在部署规则集上共同过度宣称可检查；提出 CoVer 干预门控，与参考裁判一致证明不了任何事。
objective_summary: 实证测量 LLM 对规则可判定性的自判能力并揭示系统性过判，提出以干预存活为准入的 CoVer 门控。
evidence_note: 6 个语料（含真实法规与已部署智能体）、4 模型约 22,000 标签、干预测试与分带报告覆盖率代价。
novelty_note: 提出并实证「可自决性边界」这一新问题，证明参考裁判一致性的证明力为零是反直觉的实质性发现。
scope: 结论适用于规则来自外部的智能体验证场景与所测四模型；对人类专家标定、多模态动作未覆盖。
limitations: 标签由模型而非法律专家给出真值校准；CoVer 覆盖率损失在关键场景的后果未量化；语料限于金融/信贷与欧盟法规类文本。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
abstract: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust) at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop papers are non-archival. 12 pages (4 content pages plus references and appendices)
title_cn: Penumbra：面向监管义务的样本高效对抗搜索
abstract_cn: 智能体正在进入金融、医疗与法律等领域——违规不会留下词汇特征且伴随真实处罚。一项遗漏是否重大、披露是否充分，取决于响应遗漏了什么。探查此类义务意味着找到距合规翻转仅一个最小编辑的响应，而每次探查都要一次生成与两次裁决，因此监管红队的约束瓶颈是样本效率而非数量。我们提出 Penumbra，一种对抗搜索：从经验证的锚点出发，在扩展的编辑预算下行走，直到双评估器委员会改变裁决，并输出夹住该变化的两个相邻响应。分配是自适应的，目标是对失败面的覆盖：每个候选解决的（义务×失败模式）不同格子数。在匹配预算下，自适应分配在 59% 的候选上达到均匀分配满预算的覆盖率；在同等记录数下覆盖的失败模式是朴素枚举的 1.43 倍，且增益局限于其针对的轴。在一部金融顾问宪章的 60 条筛选义务上，Penumbra 返回 144 对响应，每对都是委员会置于边界两侧的合规/违规响应，仅差几个词——而直接要求模型同时给出两者的做法产出的文本几乎没有共同点。第二部临床分诊宪章在 18 条义务上复现了这一结果：同等紧度下 49 对，最难的模式相同。这样的响应对显示了义务自身条文停止裁决之处，正是在其下部署的智能体必须被测试的地方，而搜索以随边界而非随文本扩展的成本找到它们。（NeurIPS 2026 EvoRobust 工作坊，非存档）
summary_cn: Penumbra 以自适应编辑预算搜索监管义务的合规边界：金融宪章 60 条义务产出 144 对仅差数词的合规/违规响应，同预算覆盖 1.43 倍失败模式，临床分诊 18 条义务复现。
objective_summary: 构建样本高效的对抗搜索框架，定位使义务裁决翻转的最小编辑响应对以刻画智能体的合规失败面。
evidence_note: 两部真实风格宪章（60+18 义务）上的定量对比与配对输出；评估依赖自建双评估器委员会；工作坊论文非存档。
novelty_note: 把对抗搜索的目标从词汇触发转向无词汇特征的义务边界并优化样本效率是新的问题设定；搜索机制为已有组件的自适应组合。
scope: 结论适用于可由评估器委员会裁决的成文义务；对主观性强、需外部事实核查的义务未验证。
limitations: 边界以双评估器共识为真值，可能继承其偏见；编辑预算与覆盖指标由作者定义；仅测试两部宪章。

title: Indistinguishability Lifting for Keyed Oracles, Compressed Ideal Cipher, and More Applications
abstract: Cryptographic security proofs often involve an adversary interacting with a larger, keyed oracle that consists of (potentially exponentially) many independent instances of a smaller, base oracle. However, showing quantum indistinguishability between two such keyed oracles can be tricky, since a single query made by an adversary may involve a superposition that covers all instances of the base oracles simultaneously. In this paper, we establish a generic indistinguishability lifting theorem of the following form: if the two base oracles are indistinguishable under quantum queries, then their corresponding keyed oracles are too, up to an O(q^2) multiplicative loss in distinguishing advantage, where q is the number of queries made by the adversary. Our lifting theorem applies to both statistical and computational settings, and to oracles that are stateful as well. It is also optimal in that it matches the obvious Grover search attack for a certain (contrived) choice of oracles. As an immediate application, we extend Carolan's compressed permutation oracle to an efficiently implementable compressed ideal cipher, and use it to prove preimage resistance of the Davies-Meyer compression function in the quantum ideal cipher model. Thanks to our lifting theorem, the soundness of our compressed ideal cipher reduces to that of Carolan's oracle, and any further improvement on the latter would automatically carry over to the former. As our second application, we give a modular construction that doubles the message length of any quantum-secure strong pseudorandom permutation. Along the way, we show that an existing two-round tweakable Feistel construction is indistinguishable from a random permutation under quantum bidirectional queries. This is done via a dedicated polynomial-method argument, which may be of independent interest.
title_cn: 带钥预言机的不可区分性提升、压缩理想密码及更多应用
abstract_cn: 密码学安全证明常涉及对手与一个更大的带钥预言机交互，该预言机由（可能指数多的）较小的基础预言机独立实例组成。然而，证明两个此类带钥预言机之间的量子不可区分性可能很棘手，因为对手的单次查询可能涉及同时覆盖基础预言机所有实例的叠加。本文建立如下形式的通用不可区分性提升定理：若两个基础预言机在量子查询下不可区分，则其对应带钥预言机亦不可区分，区分优势至多损失 O(q²) 乘性因子，q 为对手查询数。该提升定理适用于统计与计算设定，也适用于有状态预言机。它还是最优的：对某类（刻意构造的）预言机，它与显然的 Grover 搜索攻击匹配。作为直接应用，我们把 Carolan 的压缩置换预言机扩展为可高效实现的压缩理想密码，并以此在量子理想密码模型中证明 Davies-Meyer 压缩函数的原像抗性。得益于提升定理，我们压缩理想密码的可靠性归约到 Carolan 预言机的可靠性，后者的任何改进都会自动继承到前者。作为第二个应用，我们给出把任意量子安全强伪随机置换的消息长度翻倍的模块化构造。过程中我们还证明一个现有的两轮可调 Feistel 构造在量子双向查询下与随机置换不可区分，证明使用专用的多项式方法论证，可能有独立价值。
summary_cn: 证明通用不可区分性提升定理（O(q²) 损失且对 Grover 最优），据此构造可高效实现的压缩理想密码、证明量子理想密码模型下 Davies-Meyer 原像抗性，并给出量子安全 SPRP 的倍长模块化构造。
objective_summary: 建立带钥预言机的量子不可区分性提升定理，并应用于压缩理想密码、Davies-Meyer 证明与 SPRP 消息扩展。
evidence_note: 通用定理含最优性（匹配 Grover 攻击），多项应用与专用多项式方法论证，证明链条完整。
novelty_note: 通用提升定理与首个可高效实现的压缩理想密码是实质性理论进展，Feistel 量子双向不可区分性证明技巧亦具独立价值。
scope: 结论限于量子查询模型与所列应用；对具体部署参数与后量子方案的端到端安全未直接给出。
limitations: O(q²) 损失在大量查询时可能过松；应用集中于理想密码模型；未讨论常数因子与实现成本。

title: Post-Quantum Authentication Protocol for Internet of Medical Things
abstract: IoMT communication systems should provide origin authentication and ensure integrity protection for the messages produced by patients' devices for transmission to gateways and further processing by other hospital services. With regard to IoMT, this paper discusses tampering, impersonation, and replay attacks on messages provided as medical reports. Long-term security of the communication system is also addressed considering potential quantum attacks. For this purpose, we design a protocol that meets requirements of practical implementation and employs an ISIS like lattice-based construction combined with concepts of the blockchain technology. Patients' devices generate a canonical JSON format medical report containing a timestamp and critical information. Using a nonce, the patients create a cryptographic signature of the message with a challenge generated from hash of a message. The gateway verifies signatures utilizing the public key of a trusted ledger associated with a particular patient and ensures freshness of the transmitted message. To optimize the performance in case when many devices interact with a gateway at once, the gateway performs batch signature validation using vectorized modular linear equations. The trusted ledger uses tamper-resistant REGISTER and TRUST UPDATE entries, maintaining a trust score of each registered patient and updating the value after each ACCEPT/REJECT operation. Our prototype application demonstrates registration procedure of a new patient, signing and verifying medical reports, auditing of the ledger, and performance assessment. Based on our experiments in the prototype, we argue that, when applied to large-scale systems, batch verification is superior to simple signature validation approach.
title_cn: 面向医疗物联网的后量子认证协议
abstract_cn: IoMT 通信系统应对患者设备产生、传输给网关并由其他医院服务进一步处理的医疗报告消息提供来源认证与完整性保护。本文讨论针对作为医疗报告提供的消息的篡改、假冒与重放攻击。考虑到潜在量子攻击，还讨论通信系统的长期安全。为此，我们设计一个满足实际实现需求的协议，采用类 ISIS 的格构造结合区块链技术概念。患者设备生成包含时间戳与关键信息的规范 JSON 格式医疗报告。患者使用随机数，以从消息哈希生成的挑战对消息创建密码学签名。网关利用与特定患者关联的可信账本公钥验证签名并确保传输消息的新鲜性。为优化多设备同时与网关交互时的性能，网关使用向量化模线性方程执行批量签名验证。可信账本使用防篡改的 REGISTER 与 TRUST UPDATE 条目，维护每个注册患者的信任分并在每次 ACCEPT/REJECT 操作后更新。我们的原型应用演示了新患者注册、医疗报告签名与验证、账本审计与性能评估。基于原型实验，我们认为在大规模系统中批量验证优于简单签名验证。
summary_cn: 提出 IoMT 后量子认证协议：格签名+区块链信任账本+向量化批量验证，原型演示注册、签验与审计，实验显示批量验证在大规模下优于逐条验证。
objective_summary: 设计结合格密码与区块链信任账本的 IoMT 报文认证协议，并用原型评估批量签名验证的性能优势。
evidence_note: 原型实现演示与性能评估；无与相关协议的系统性安全归约或对比基准，安全论证为需求式讨论。
novelty_note: 格签名、区块链账本与批量验证均为成熟组件，新意在 IoMT 场景的组合与工程化。
scope: 适用于对网关-设备链路有认证与新鲜性需求的 IoMT 部署；对网关被完全攻陷、账本共识攻击未建模。
limitations: 安全论证缺乏严格归约与形式化证明；原型规模有限；区块链账本的部署与治理成本未量化。

title: When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software
abstract: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model's answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model's attack success is at most 4\% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13\% in S-mode and 15\% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100\% to 34\% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82\% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96\% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures
title_cn: 言谈不是代码：比较模拟与开发软件的 LLM 智能体
abstract_cn: LLM 既被用来模拟网络协议实现（如蜜罐所做），也被用来编写它们。先前工作分别评估这两种用途：一种基于模型的回答或对话，另一种基于其生成的代码。我们观察到，知识探针（询问模型某实现需要哪些安全检查）与对话可能给生成程序所缺的安全检查记分，但尚无研究把它们与同一模型写的代码进行对比。为填补这一空白，我们给出首次此类比较：模拟模式（S-mode，模型在对话中扮演实现）对阵开发模式（D-mode，模型写程序且程序被攻击），以知识探针为基线。我们设计并实现一个用同一攻击套件与同一裁决器评判三者的测试装置，并在 4 个协议实现上评估 15 个 LLM。我们发现，在完整安全规范下，中位模型在重组、HTTP 与防火墙实现上的攻击成功率在两种模式下至多 4%，但在 DNS 上 S-mode 为 13%、D-mode 为 15%。在 D-mode，把缺失的 DNS 需求补进规范使该攻击从 100% 降到 34% 且只改变该项检查，而删除一条既有规则会同时削弱程序在其他检查上的表现。预先询问模型并不能预测程序具备哪些检查：写出 DNS 解析器的 14 个模型中有 13 个能说出该检查，但全部 42 个程序都缺失它。S-mode 是有用的初筛：标记 82% 的真实 DNS 漏洞、96% 的安全案例不被误标。它在两个方向都会出错——报告 D-mode 未实现的安全检查，也漏报 D-mode 实现了的检查。S-mode 可以筛选但不能替代 D-mode 测试，且安全需求即便模型能背诵也应写下来。
summary_cn: 首次对照 LLM 的「说」与「写」：15 个模型、4 个协议上 DNS 场景攻击成功率 S-mode 13%/D-mode 15%，补规范后从 100% 降至 34%；14 个模型能说出 DNS 检查但 42 个程序全部缺失。
objective_summary: 用统一攻击套件与裁决器对比 LLM 在模拟、开发与知识探针三种形态下的安全表现，量化言谈与代码的偏差。
evidence_note: 15 个 LLM、4 个协议实现、统一攻击套件与裁决器的受控对比，含规范增删的干预实验与具体成功率。
novelty_note: 首次系统对照 S-mode/D-mode 与知识探针的安全信号偏差，属诊断性实证；无新攻击或防御机制。
scope: 结论适用于协议实现类任务与所测 15 个模型；对通用软件工程任务与更大代码库未覆盖。
limitations: 协议集合仅 4 个；S-mode 评估依赖对话轮次设置；裁决器与攻击套件由作者实现，可能存在盲区。

title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
abstract: Is agentic memory robust against stealthy steganographic attacks? We carry out a large-scale red-teaming exercise to test whether agents can encode attacker-controlled strings in one session and recover them in another without triggering safety oversight. Following SHADE-Arena-style tasks, we embed malicious side tasks to encode secret strings using steganography within otherwise benign tasks and evaluate them using independent task-completion and safety oversight. We test 14,000 attack trials spanning 91 model-attack configurations, 13 models, and 7 steganographic schemes: Acrostic, Mesostic, Telestich, Word-choice, Capitalization, Position-based, and Homoglyph. 41.2% of trials successfully encode the target payload in the generated response, while 29.8% survive the memory-write step with the encoding intact. Overall, 25.4% of trials yield a recoverable payload at retrieval, and 20.1% achieve exact-match recovery, including synthetic API keys and cryptographic material never exposed to the receiver. Among the exact-match transmissions, 71.4% also pass primary task-completion scoring and are independently judged safe by the oversight model, corresponding to 14.4% of all trials in which a successful covert transmission would appear to be an ordinary, benign interaction under task-level evaluation. Our results demonstrate that agentic memory can function as a persistent cross-session covert channel. The results further show that the principal bottleneck occurs at memory persistence rather than retrieval: once a steganographic payload survives the memory-write stage, a substantial fraction remains recoverable. We therefore argue that memory integrity, information-flow control, and covert-channel detection should be explicit security requirements for agentic systems.
title_cn: StegoMemory：智能体记忆充当隐蔽隐写信道
abstract_cn: 智能体记忆对隐蔽隐写攻击是否鲁棒？我们开展大规模红队演练，检验智能体能否在一个会话中编码攻击者控制的字符串、在另一个会话中恢复它、且不触发安全监督。遵循 SHADE-Arena 风格的任务，我们把恶意副任务嵌入到看似良性的任务中，用隐写术编码秘密字符串，并用独立的任务完成度与安全监督来评估。我们测试了 14,000 次攻击试验，覆盖 91 个模型-攻击配置、13 个模型和 7 种隐写方案：藏头（Acrostic）、中藏（Mesostic）、尾藏（Telestich）、选词、大小写、位置与同形字。41.2% 的试验成功在生成的响应中编码目标载荷，29.8% 在编码完好的情况下通过记忆写入步骤。总体上，25.4% 的试验在检索时得到可恢复载荷，20.1% 实现精确匹配恢复，包括从未暴露给接收方的合成 API 密钥与密码学材料。在精确匹配传输中，71.4% 同时通过主任务完成度评分并被监督模型独立判定为安全，对应全部试验中的 14.4%——在这些试验中，一次成功的隐蔽传输在任务级评估下会显得是普通的良性交互。我们的结果表明智能体记忆可以充当持久的跨会话隐蔽信道。结果还显示主要瓶颈在记忆持久化而非检索：隐写载荷一旦在记忆写入阶段存活，相当比例在检索时仍可恢复。因此我们主张，记忆完整性、信息流控制与隐蔽信道检测应成为智能体系统的显式安全需求。
summary_cn: 红队演练显示智能体记忆可成跨会话隐写信道：14,000 试验、13 模型、7 种隐写，20.1% 精确恢复且 71.4% 通过任务与安全双评（占 14.4%），瓶颈在记忆写入。
objective_summary: 以大规模红队演练量化隐写载荷经智能体记忆跨会话传输的成功率与监督盲区，定位记忆持久化为主要瓶颈。
evidence_note: 14,000 试验、91 配置、13 模型、7 方案的大规模系统实验，任务完成与安全监督独立评分并分层报告成功率。
novelty_note: 首次系统证明智能体记忆本身可作持久跨会话隐蔽信道，指出记忆写入是防御瓶颈，属新威胁模型。
scope: 结论适用于带持久记忆与多会话的智能体系统；对无状态智能体、加密记忆层与专门信息流控制部署不适用。
limitations: 隐写方案限于 7 种文本类方案；安全监督为模型裁判，可能低估或高估人工审查能力；未评估跨模态（图像/代码）载荷。

title: Quantum Machine Learning Protection of Military Quantum Key Distribution Against Cryptographically Camouflaged Attacks
abstract: Quantum key distribution proves its protocol secure and says nothing about the hardware beneath it, so military and government operators fielding it for command-and-control keys monitor the channel for implementation attacks, and that monitoring has a blind spot. An adversary with a kleptographic foothold in the generator of a public per-block value \(x=g^v \pmod p\) can hide attacked blocks in honest noise, gating them on a predicate of its discrete logarithm, making detection a discrete logarithm problem that defeats every efficient classical monitor yet yields to a quantum kernel recovering \(v\) through Shor's algorithm. I formalise these cryptographically camouflaged attacks, reduce their hardness to an established learning separation, prove a single-frequency fidelity kernel cannot represent an interval predicate, and test them on Ghillie, a decoy-state BB84 simulator with a positive key rate to 142 km. From 10- to 14-bit groups over two seeds, a classical monitor reads 0.458 to 0.516 on camouflaged attacks while the quantum kernel reads 1.000, and both catch overt attacks above 0.99. Finite-precision recovery under depolarising noise and a hardened predicate lower the quantum result to 0.916 through 0.983 with the classical monitor at chance, and a feasibility probe on IBM Heron processors tracks the exact kernel within 0.034. A defender can therefore discard precisely the compromised key material, although the advantage is asymptotic, awaits fault tolerance, and holds only when the feature map matches the adversary's predicate, since a low-frequency map reads 0.545 on a residue pattern and 0.982 once aligned.
title_cn: 军用量子密钥分发的量子机器学习防护：抵御密码学伪装攻击
abstract_cn: 量子密钥分发（QKD）只证明其协议安全，对底层硬件不作任何声明，因此为指挥控制密钥部署 QKD 的军方与政府运营者会监控信道以发现实现攻击，而这一监控存在盲点。若对手在每块公开值 x=g^v mod p 的生成器中拥有密码学后门式立足点，就可以把被攻击的块藏在诚实噪声中，以离散对数的谓词门控它们，使检测成为一个击败所有高效经典监控器、却可被经 Shor 算法恢复 v 的量子核解决的问题。我形式化这些密码学伪装攻击，将其难度归约到一个已确立的学习分离，证明单频保真度核无法表示区间谓词，并在 Ghillie——一个正钥率延伸到 142 km 的诱骗态 BB84 模拟器——上测试它们。在两粒种子、10 到 14 比特群上，经典监控器对伪装攻击的读数为 0.458 到 0.516，而量子核为 1.000，二者对显式攻击的检出都高于 0.99。去极化噪声下的有限精度恢复与加固谓词把量子结果降至 0.916 到 0.983，此时经典监控器处于随机水平；在 IBM Heron 处理器上的可行性探针与精确核的偏差在 0.034 以内。防御者因此可以精确丢弃被攻陷的密钥材料，尽管该优势是渐近的、有待容错量子计算，且只在特征映射匹配对手谓词时成立——低频映射对某残差模式的读数为 0.545，对齐后为 0.982。
summary_cn: 形式化针对 QKD 硬件监控的密码学伪装攻击（以离散对数谓词隐藏被攻陷块），量子核检出 1.000 对经典监控器 0.458–0.516，BB84 模拟器 142 km 与 IBM Heron 探针验证，但优势依赖特征映射匹配且待容错量子。
objective_summary: 提出并形式化利用离散对数谓词伪装的 QKD 实现攻击，构造量子核检测器并在模拟器与真实量子硬件上量化其相对经典监控的优势。
evidence_note: BB84 模拟器多噪声条件实验加 IBM Heron 可行性探针，报告具体读数；主体为仿真，量子优势需容错量子计算，单作者预印本。
novelty_note: 首次把「密码学伪装」形式化为 QKD 监控盲点并将检测归约为学习分离问题，量子核检测路线对该威胁是新的。
scope: 结论适用于可建模为离散对数谓词门控的生成器后门与诱骗态 BB84；对其他 QKD 协议与真实部署链路未验证。
limitations: 量子优势为渐近性且依赖容错量子计算；特征映射必须匹配攻击谓词；实验以模拟为主、硬件仅探针级。

title: The Same Zero: Why Identical ASR Can Imply Different Guarantees in LLM-Agent Security
abstract: LLM-agent security has produced a dense landscape of defenses - prompt hardening, content filters, permission gates, sandboxes - yet no framework tells a deployer what a defense actually guarantees, or where that guarantee comes from. We apply Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) - L0: LLM self-declaration; L1: deterministic rules; L2: objective ground truth; L3/L4: decidable completeness; L5: impossible - to 22 agent-security defenses; the taxonomy is falsifiable (10/10 prediction hits on frozen cards, flagged). We run the first controlled deployment-value comparison: at equal budget, a VAL-guided stack (confirmation gate + schema sandbox) versus a mainstream intuition stack (prompt hardening + keyword filter), 50 scenarios, 12 attack variants, adaptive/white-box/PAIR escalation (~7,000 testbed calls; ~10,000 harness calls on AgentDojo/JADE). The VAL stack holds 0.000 attack success at 1.000 benign success (0.5% ASR at 79.7% utility on AgentDojo banking vs 4.3% undefended); the intuition stack reaches 0.000 ASR but kills all benign actions - security by model-behavior luck, not structure. Across testbeds of rising attack-surface hardness the intuition stack's zero drifts (0->1.9%->6.2%, n=16 on JADE) while the VAL stack's holds within its ODD (0->0->0), its only breach a disclosed out-of-ODD password gap (0.5%). The same zero, two different guarantees: zero is an outcome, not a guarantee.
comment: v1: applies Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) to 22 agent-security defenses; first controlled deployment-value comparison (VAL-guided vs intuition stack) across three testbeds; ~17k LLM calls; an honest out-of-ODD boundary is reported. Writing was assisted by an AI language model; all experiments and research decisions are the author's own
title_cn: 同一个零：为何相同的 ASR 在 LLM 智能体安全中意味着不同的保证
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体安全已形成密集的防御图景——提示加固、内容过滤、权限门、沙箱——却没有任何框架告诉部署者一项防御实际保证什么、或该保证来自哪里。我们把验证自治级别（VAL）——L0：LLM 自我声明；L1：确定性规则；L2：客观真值；L3/L4：可判定的完备性；L5：不可能——应用于 22 个智能体安全防御；该分类是可证伪的（在冻结卡片上 10/10 预测命中，已标注）。我们运行首个受控部署价值比较：在同等预算下，VAL 引导栈（确认门 + 模式沙箱）对阵主流直觉栈（提示加固 + 关键词过滤），50 个场景、12 种攻击变体、自适应/白盒/PAIR 升级（约 7,000 次测试床调用；AgentDojo/JADE 上约 10,000 次编排调用）。VAL 栈在 1.000 良性成功率下保持 0.000 攻击成功率（AgentDojo banking 上 0.5% ASR 对 79.7% 效用，无防御时 4.3%）；直觉栈也达到 0.000 ASR 却杀死所有良性动作——其安全靠模型行为运气而非结构。在攻击面难度递增的测试床上，直觉栈的零发生漂移（0→1.9%→6.2%，JADE 上 n=16），而 VAL 栈在其运行设计域（ODD）内保持（0→0→0），唯一一次突破是已披露的 ODD 外密码缺口（0.5%）。同样的零，不同的保证：零是结果，不是保证。
summary_cn: 用验证自治级别（VAL）评估 22 个智能体安全防御并做首个受控部署价值比较：VAL 栈在 ODD 内保持 0 攻击成功率且良性成功率 1.0，直觉栈同为零但靠模型运气且随攻击面难度漂移至 6.2%。
objective_summary: 提出 VAL 保证分级并同等预算下受控比较两类防御栈，证明相同零攻击成功率背后保证结构不同。
evidence_note: 50 场景、12 攻击变体、约 1.7 万次 LLM 调用、三个测试床的受控比较并披露 ODD 外缺口；场景自建、单作者预印本、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「零攻击成功率是结果而非保证」操作化为可证伪分级并受控验证是评估视角的实质新意；VAL 分级思想承自验证领域。
scope: 结论适用于所选测试床与 22 个被评估防御；对多智能体、长程任务与商业防御产品未覆盖。
limitations: VAL 分级的边界案例依赖作者定义；测试床场景自建，生态效度未知；单作者构建带来潜在评估偏差。

title: Attestable Audit: Property-Based Attestation for Proprietary Workloads without Artifact Disclosure
abstract: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) prove the integrity of code and data to a remote peer through remote attestation: the TEE issues an attestation report by signing, with a hardware-bound key, its configuration information, including measurements (cryptographic digests) of the code loaded inside it. A verifier appraises the report by matching these measurements against reference values. When the measured artifact is proprietary, however, the verifier cannot derive the reference values itself: it can only confirm that something with a given measurement is running inside the TEE---not that the program behaves as expected---forcing full trust in the reference value provider. We propose an architecture that closes this gap without disclosing the artifact, composing two TEE workloads: attestable build (Hugenroth et al., 2025), which binds a source code digest to a build artifact measurement, and attestable audit (proposed in this paper), which binds the same source code digest to the verdicts of automated audits---fuzzing, static analysis, AI code auditing, formal methods---executed inside a TEE. Both are instances of Confidential Computing Proofs: TEE attestation viewed as a hardware-backed zero-knowledge proof. Chaining the two certificates lets the verifier conclude that the running artifact was built from source code satisfying the audited properties, without disclosing either the source code or the build artifact. A proof-of-concept implementation on Intel SGX with the Gramine Library OS, running the Bandit security analyzer on Python code, demonstrates the practicality of the approach.
comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Hardware and Architectural Support for Security and Privacy 2026 (HASP 2026), held in conjunction with MICRO 2026
title_cn: 可认证审计：不披露工件的专有工作负载属性化证明
abstract_cn: 可信执行环境（TEE）通过远程认证向远端对等方证明代码与数据的完整性：TEE 用硬件绑定密钥签署其配置信息（包括其中加载代码的度量值/密码学摘要）以出具认证报告。验证者将报告中的度量值与参考值匹配来完成核验。但当被度量工件是专有的，验证者无法自行推导参考值：它只能确认具有给定度量值的某物在 TEE 内运行——而不能确认该程序按预期行为——从而不得不完全信任参考值提供者。我们提出一个在不披露工件的前提下弥合这一鸿沟的架构，组合两个 TEE 工作负载：可认证构建（Hugenroth 等，2025），把源代码摘要绑定到构建工件度量值；可认证审计（本文提出），把同一源代码摘要绑定到在 TEE 内执行的自动化审计——模糊测试、静态分析、AI 代码审计、形式化方法——的结论。二者都是机密计算证明（Confidential Computing Proofs）的实例：把 TEE 认证视为硬件背书的零知识证明。链式组合两份证书后，验证者可以得出结论：正在运行的工件由满足被审计性质的源代码构建，而无需披露源代码或构建工件。在 Intel SGX 与 Gramine Library OS 上运行 Bandit 安全分析器处理 Python 代码的概念验证实现展示了该方法的实用性。（HASP 2026 @ MICRO 2026）
summary_cn: 提出可认证审计架构：在 TEE 内运行模糊测试/静态分析等审计并把结论与源代码摘要链式绑定，验证者无需披露源码或工件即可确认运行工件满足被审计性质；SGX/Gramine 加 Bandit 完成概念验证。
objective_summary: 组合可认证构建与新的可认证审计工作负载，把专有代码的自动化审计结论变为不披露工件即可远程核验的 TEE 证明。
evidence_note: SGX/Gramine 上以 Bandit/Python 完成概念验证；评估规模小、单一分析器；HASP 2026（MICRO 联办工作坊）录用。
novelty_note: 「机密计算证明」框架下把自动化审计结论纳入 TEE 证明链是新的组合扩展，核心构建机制承自可认证构建前作。
scope: 结论适用于可被 TEE 容纳的构建与审计工作负载；对大型代码库、需 GPU 的审计与恶意参考值提供者未覆盖。
limitations: 概念验证仅覆盖 Bandit 与 Python；审计质量上界由所用分析器决定；TEE 侧信道风险不在威胁模型内。

title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal. We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.

title_cn: 重新激活对齐：基于意图感知输入-输出匹配的 LLM 越狱防御
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）仍然易受把有害意图隐藏在复杂对抗提示中的越狱攻击。现有防御主要依赖输入扰动或有害输出抑制，很少建模恶意意图所在之处，导致保护脆弱且过度拒绝。我们提出 SENTINEL，一个即插即用、生成时的越狱防御，把缓解重构为意图抽取问题。我们的关键洞察是：指令微调 LLM 表现出强输入-输出语义一致性——无论越狱多么复杂，生成的输出往往与攻击者的真实意图对齐。SENTINEL 利用这一性质，匹配语义对齐的输入-输出区域以抽取显露意图的子序列，用拒绝方向投影为这些子序列打分以估计有害性，并在必要时中止生成。在 HarmBench 上跨多个 LLM 的实验显示，SENTINEL 把越狱成功率降到接近 5%，同时保持低过度拒绝。我们进一步展示对自适应攻击的鲁棒性，并给出机制性解释：SENTINEL 把越狱特征从对齐盲区重新分布到对齐区域。（EMNLP 2026 主会）
summary_cn: SENTINEL 利用指令微调模型输入-输出语义一致性做生成时越狱防御：匹配意图显露子序列并用拒绝方向投影打分，HarmBench 上把越狱成功率压到约 5% 且过度拒绝低。
objective_summary: 提出从输入-输出对齐区域抽取意图子序列、以拒绝方向投影评分并按需中止生成的越狱防御 SENTINEL。
evidence_note: HarmBench 上跨多模型评估并报告约 5% 攻击成功率与低过拒，含自适应攻击鲁棒性与机制分析；EMNLP 2026 主会录用。
novelty_note: 把防御重构为意图抽取并利用输出-意图一致性是新的防御视角，但由语义匹配与拒绝方向投影等已有组件组合实现。
scope: 结论适用于指令微调 LLM 的生成时干预；对基座模型、多轮长程越狱与非英语攻击未系统评估。
limitations: 依赖输出已暴露部分与真实意图一致这一经验规律，对抗者可刻意输出与意图不一致的中介内容；推理开销增加；评估集中于 HarmBench。

title: CHAMP: Cayley HAshing with Matrix Products
abstract: Cayley hash functions hash binary strings by representing the bits of the message as elements of a semigroup and multiplying the corresponding elements. This gives Cayley hash functions useful homomorphic properties. Here, we propose CHAMP, a Cayley hash function based on products of 2 by 2 matrices over a finite field, and discuss its security, implementation, and performance.

title_cn: CHAMP：基于矩阵乘积的 Cayley 哈希
abstract_cn: Cayley 哈希函数通过把消息比特表示为半群中的元素并乘以相应元素来哈希二进制串。这赋予 Cayley 哈希有用的同态性质。本文提出 CHAMP，一个基于有限域上 2×2 矩阵乘积的 Cayley 哈希函数，并讨论其安全性、实现与性能。
summary_cn: 提出基于有限域上 2×2 矩阵乘积的 Cayley 哈希 CHAMP，讨论其安全性、实现与性能。
objective_summary: 构造基于 2×2 矩阵半群乘积的 Cayley 哈希函数并讨论安全性与实现性能。
evidence_note: 安全性与性能以讨论为主，摘要未给出第三方密码分析、实现基准细节或与既有构造的系统对比；Cayley 哈希历史上多次被破。
novelty_note: Cayley 哈希是成熟研究方向，新意在矩阵族参数选择，属增量构造。
scope: 结论限于所提矩阵族与参数；对更大矩阵、更高维度及未来密码分析的抵抗无法保证。
limitations: 摘要未报告具体安全归约与界；Cayley 哈希有被路径攻击破解的历史，需独立分析；性能评估细节缺失。

title: Guess My Weight: Profiled Side-Channel Recovery of Floating-Point Neural-Network Weights
abstract: Neural-network parameters deployed on embedded devices may be exposed through physical side-channel leakage during inference. Existing side-channel attacks on floating-point neural-network parameters have often targeted reduced numerical precision, while recovering the complete IEEE-754 representation remains considerably more challenging because of the large and structured 32-bit candidate space. We present a profiled template attack for bit-exact recovery of an IEEE-754 single-precision neural-network weight from power measurements. The attack targets the floating-point multiplication between a known input and a first-layer weight. During profiling, multivariate Gaussian templates are learned from randomized network configurations using Hamming-weight classes of the multiplication result, while the remaining network parameters act as nuisance variables. To efficiently search the structured 32-bit floating-point candidate space, we use a hierarchical coarse-to-fine-to-exact procedure that progressively increases both the numerical and leakage-model resolution. Experiments on a ChipWhisperer-Lite with an Arm Cortex-M4 demonstrate recovery of the exact float32 representation of the target weight. In the evaluated setting, the attack reaches a bit-exact success rate of 99% with 171 traces and 100% from 263 traces onward. These results demonstrate that profiling can enable practical full-precision extraction of floating-point neural-network parameters from physical leakage.
title_cn: 猜猜我的权重：浮点神经网络权重的轮廓式侧信道恢复
abstract_cn: 部署在嵌入式设备上的神经网络参数可能通过推理期间的物理侧信道泄漏暴露。现有针对浮点神经网络参数的侧信道攻击多以降精度数值为目标，而恢复完整 IEEE-754 表示因 32 位候选空间庞大且结构化而仍然相当困难。我们提出一种轮廓式模板攻击，可从功耗测量中位精确恢复 IEEE-754 单精度神经网络权重。攻击目标为已知输入与第一层权重之间的浮点乘法。轮廓阶段从随机化网络配置中、以乘法结果的汉明重量类为类学习多元高斯模板，其余网络参数充当讨厌变量。为高效搜索结构化的 32 位浮点候选空间，我们使用由粗到细再到精确的层次化程序，逐步提升数值与泄漏模型分辨率。在搭载 Arm Cortex-M4 的 ChipWhisperer-Lite 上的实验表明可恢复目标权重的精确 float32 表示：在所评估设定下，攻击以 171 条轨迹达到 99% 的位精确成功率，从 263 条轨迹起达到 100%。这些结果表明轮廓化可以实现对浮点神经网络参数从物理泄漏的实用全精度提取。
summary_cn: 轮廓式模板攻击从 Cortex-M4 功耗侧信道位精确恢复 float32 神经网络权重：层次化搜索 32 位候选空间，171 条轨迹达 99%、263 条起 100% 成功。
objective_summary: 提出针对第一层浮点乘法的模板攻击与层次化候选搜索，实现单精度权重的位精确物理提取。
evidence_note: 真实硬件（ChipWhisperer-Lite + Cortex-M4）上的受控实验，报告 99%/100% 成功率与轨迹数；单一平台、单一目标位置，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 现有浮点权重侧信道工作停留在降精度目标，这是首个实现 IEEE-754 单精度完整位精确恢复的攻击，层次化搜索是关键新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可观测功耗且部署未加防护的嵌入式推理设备；对掩蔽、随机化与其他侧信道防御未评估。
limitations: 仅验证 Cortex-M4 与第一层权重乘法；攻击需要设备访问与轮廓阶段；对批量权重恢复的轨迹成本未报告。

title: Large Language Models and Augmented Democracy
abstract: Artificial intelligence enables computational agents to represent political preferences and take part in collective decision-making. In this thesis, I investigate the opportunities and challenges of digital twins (DTs) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) as intermediaries in augmented democracy, focusing on individual preference representation, collective representation of political organizations, and the vulnerability of those representations to attackers. First, using data from an online experiment in Brazil, I examine whether personalized DTs can predict citizens' preferences for unseen policy proposals. Second, I extend the DT framework from individuals to political organizations. Using Swiss parliamentary data, I build topic-specific knowledge graphs from lawmakers' legislative records and connect them to LLM-based lawmaker agents, which are organized into party-level DTs representing collective positions. Agentic deliberation among these agents tests whether aggregated party representations capture a broader range of intra-party perspectives than official party communications. Finally, I study the vulnerability and robustness of LLM-mediated deliberation against prompt-injection attacks that amplify viewpoints, suppress opinions, or redirect consensus. Using data from a 2023 deliberative experiment in the United Kingdom, I analyze how attack effectiveness varies with the distribution of opinions and rhetorical strategies, and evaluate a pipeline combining injection detection, structured opinion representations, and reinforcement learning to improve resistance. These findings characterize the opportunities and challenges of LLM-based digital twins in augmented democracy, stressing accurate preference representation, faithful aggregation, and robustness to strategic interaction.

title_cn: 大语言模型与增强民主
abstract_cn: 人工智能使计算智能体能够代表政治偏好并参与集体决策。本论文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的数字孪生（DT）作为增强民主中介的机遇与挑战，聚焦个体偏好表示、政治组织的集体表示，以及这些表示对攻击者的脆弱性。首先，利用巴西在线实验的数据，我检验个性化数字孪生能否预测公民对未见政策提案的偏好。其次，我把 DT 框架从个体扩展到政治组织：利用瑞士议会数据，从议员的立法记录构建主题知识图谱并接入基于 LLM 的议员智能体，将其组织为代表集体立场的党级数字孪生；这些智能体间的协商检验聚合的党派表示是否比官方党派沟通覆盖更广的党内观点谱系。最后，我研究 LLM 介导协商对放大观点、压制意见或改变共识方向的提示注入攻击的脆弱性与鲁棒性：利用 2023 年英国协商实验的数据，分析攻击效果如何随意见分布与修辞策略变化，并评估结合注入检测、结构化意见表示与强化学习的防御管线。这些发现刻画了 LLM 数字孪生在增强民主中的机遇与挑战，强调准确的偏好表示、忠实的聚合与对策略性交互的鲁棒性。（博士论文，图卢兹经济学院，149 页）
summary_cn: 博士论文研究 LLM 数字孪生用于增强民主：巴西实验验证个体偏好预测、瑞士议会数据构建党级孪生、并用英国协商实验量化提示注入对 LLM 协商的操纵与防御。
objective_summary: 系统研究 LLM 数字孪生在个体与组织级偏好表示的能力及其协商过程对提示注入攻击的脆弱性与缓解。
evidence_note: 三项真实数据源（巴西在线实验、瑞士议会记录、英国 2023 协商实验）支撑的实证章节；博士论文预印本，统计检验细节未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 把数字孪生从个体扩展到政党并系统测其被提示注入操纵的脆弱性是较新的场景组合；偏好表示与协商机制已有先行工作。
scope: 结论基于巴西、瑞士、英国三个数据集与所选 LLM；对其他政治制度、语言与更大规模协商未覆盖。
limitations: 数字孪生的偏好预测受训练数据代表性限制；攻击实验基于模拟协商；防御管线的真实部署效果未验证。

title: JASPER: Special Session on Joint Reliability And Security Assessment of SPlit Computing for Edge Robustness
abstract: Split Computing (SC) enables efficient deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) by partitioning inference between edge devices and cloud servers. However, intermediate feature representations are simultaneously exposed to hardware faults and adversarial attacks, which are traditionally evaluated independently. This paper presents a unified framework for the joint assessment of reliability and security in Split Computing. First, reliability is characterized through neuron-level fault injection using the Mean Relative Accuracy Degradation (MRAD) while security through feature-map-aware adversarial attacks simulations using the Attack Success Rate (ASR). Based on these complementary analyses, the Joint Vulnerability Score (JVS) is introduced, along with a confidence-aware extension that jointly captures prediction errors and confidence degradation. The framework is evaluated on ten Split Computing configurations based on ResNet-50 trained on ILSVRC-2012. Experimental results show substantial differences across compression strategies, with MRAD ranging from 44.3% to 61.2% under fault injection, while adversarial attacks achieve up to 98.8% ASR. Furthermore, the proposed joint metrics reveal vulnerability trends that remain hidden when reliability and security are analyzed independently, providing a more comprehensive methodology for designing dependable Split Computing systems.

title_cn: JASPER：面向边缘鲁棒性的分割计算可靠性与安全联合评估专题
abstract_cn: 分割计算（SC）通过把推理划分到边缘设备与云服务器之间实现深度神经网络（DNN）的高效部署。然而，中间特征表示同时暴露于硬件故障与对抗攻击之下，而二者传统上被独立评估。本文提出一个用于分割计算可靠性与安全联合评估的统一框架。首先，通过神经元级故障注入以平均相对精度退化（MRAD）刻画可靠性，通过特征图感知对抗攻击模拟以攻击成功率（ASR）刻画安全性。基于这些互补分析，提出联合脆弱性评分（JVS）及其置信度感知扩展，共同捕获预测错误与置信度退化。该框架在基于 ILSVRC-2012 训练的 ResNet-50 的十种分割计算配置上评估。实验结果显示各压缩策略差异显著：故障注入下 MRAD 介于 44.3% 到 61.2%，对抗攻击 ASR 最高达 98.8%。此外，所提联合指标揭示了在可靠性与安全独立分析时保持隐藏的脆弱性趋势，为设计可信赖分割计算系统提供了更全面的方法论。
summary_cn: 提出分割计算可靠性与安全联合评估框架：MRAD 刻画故障脆弱性（44.3–61.2%）、ASR 刻画对抗脆弱性（最高 98.8%），联合脆弱性评分 JVS 揭示独立分析看不到的趋势。
objective_summary: 为分割计算建立故障注入与对抗攻击的联合度量（MRAD/ASR/JVS），在 10 种 ResNet-50 配置上比较压缩策略的联合脆弱性。
evidence_note: 10 种配置的受控故障注入与对抗模拟，报告 MRAD/ASR 具体区间；单一模型与数据集，无统计检验；DFT 2026 专题录用。
novelty_note: 可靠性与安全的联合评分视角（JVS 及置信度感知扩展）是新的评估维度组合，底层度量均为已有技术。
scope: 结论限于 ResNet-50/ILSVRC-2012 上的十种分割配置；对 Transformer、量化模型与真实边缘硬件故障未验证。
limitations: 对抗攻击为模拟而非在野；JVS 权重设定缺乏理论依据；单一模型/数据集限制泛化。

title: COPEX: Benchmarking LLM Robustness to Adversarial Context Across Model Context Protocol Layers
abstract: Large language models increasingly mediate tool use in Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, where adversarial influence may enter through user instructions, tool schemas, tool outputs, or protocol messages. Existing benchmarks often evaluate deployed agents, conflating model susceptibility with guardrails, orchestration, and general task capability. We introduce COPEX (COntext Provider EXploitation), a controlled benchmark that isolates the model as an MCP client by fixing the surrounding agent stack and varying only the tool-selecting model. COPEX covers 25 attack types instantiated as 125 scenarios across four entry surfaces: model/agent, client, server/tool, and transport. Across nine models and 3,375 trials, the mean attack success rate is 64.4%, with surface-level means ranging from 58.3% to 71.4%. Some client- and transport-level attacks succeed partly outside the model's observation or control, separating system exposure from model susceptibility. Combined input and context scanning reduces mean attack success by 49.6% on an eight-attack defense subset relative to the undefended setting. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/inspire-center/copex.

title_cn: COPEX：跨模型上下文协议各层对 LLM 对抗上下文鲁棒性的基准
abstract_cn: 大语言模型日益在模型上下文协议（MCP）系统中承担工具调用中介，对抗性影响可能经由用户指令、工具模式（schema）、工具输出或协议消息进入。现有基准多评估完整部署的智能体，把模型易感性与护栏、编排和通用任务能力混在一起。我们提出 COPEX（COntext Provider EXploitation），一个受控基准：固定周围智能体栈、只改变执行工具选择的模型，从而把模型隔离为 MCP 客户端。COPEX 覆盖 25 种攻击类型，在模型/智能体、客户端、服务器/工具与传输四个入口面上实例化为 125 个场景。在 9 个模型、3,375 次试验中，平均攻击成功率为 64.4%，各入口面均值介于 58.3% 到 71.4%。部分客户端与传输层攻击在模型观察或控制范围之外即可部分得手，把系统暴露面与模型易感性区分开来。在八攻击防御子集上，输入与上下文联合扫描把平均攻击成功率相对无防御设置降低 49.6%。基准发布于 https://github.com/inspire-center/copex。（NeurIPS 2026 智能体在野工作坊海报）
summary_cn: COPEX 隔离模型层评测 MCP 对抗上下文：25 类攻击、4 入口面、125 场景、9 模型 3,375 次试验平均攻击成功率 64.4%，联合输入/上下文扫描可降 49.6%。
objective_summary: 构建固定智能体栈、只变模型的 MCP 受控攻击基准，量化四个入口面的模型易感性并评估扫描防御。
evidence_note: 9 模型、3,375 次受控试验、4 入口面系统覆盖，并含 8 攻击防御子集的量化对比；NeurIPS 2026 工作坊海报录用，基准开源。
novelty_note: 首个把模型从智能体栈中隔离、系统覆盖 MCP 四层入口的受控基准，区分「系统暴露」与「模型易感」的评价视角是新的。
scope: 结论适用于 MCP 客户端模型层；对非 MCP 协议、自定义编排与防御完备的生产栈泛化有限。
limitations: 攻击场景由作者构造，真实在野攻击覆盖未知；防御子集仅 8 种攻击；跨模型结论依赖所选 9 个模型版本。

title: A Cheat-Sensitive Primitive for Destination-Private Quantum Routing
abstract: Quantum networks will rely on intermediate nodes to distribute entanglement, but the same nodes may learn which users are being connected. We introduce a minimal two-call routing primitive in which a user, Alice, establishes an entangled link with one of several clients while testing whether the provider, Bob, has disturbed a coherently encoded request. The construction adapts the hidden-order mechanism of quantum private queries: one call contains a direct request, the other a coherent superposition of the desired and null addresses, and Alice keeps their order secret. A private matching qubit held by the selected client restores the coherent test state after a favorable Bell-measurement outcome, so that Alice can test the returned query without any further operation by Bob. The claim is deliberately limited. The protocol shows that a routing request can carry a physical cheating test, and it detects an explicit destination-reading attack with nonzero probability. It does not yet provide a quantitative information-disturbance tradeoff, composable security, or certification of an unmeasured output against arbitrary attacks. We also characterize the exact perfect-pass limit, in which Bob's residual state, averaged over the private matching states, is independent of the destination.
title_cn: 面向目标隐私量子路由的防作弊原语
abstract_cn: 量子网络将依赖中间节点分发纠缠，但同样的节点可能获知哪些用户正在被连接。我们引入一个极简的两调用路由原语：用户 Alice 与多个客户端之一建立纠缠链路，同时检验提供方 Bob 是否干扰了相干编码的请求。该构造改编自量子私有查询的隐藏次序机制：一个调用包含直接请求，另一个包含目标地址与空地址的相干叠加，而 Alice 对两者的次序保密。由被选客户端持有的私有匹配量子比特在有利 Bell 测量结果后恢复相干测试态，使 Alice 无需 Bob 的任何进一步操作即可检验返回的查询。我们的主张刻意有限：该协议表明路由请求可以携带一个物理防作弊测试，并以非零概率检测显式的目标读取攻击；它尚不提供定量的信息-扰动权衡、可组合安全性，或对任意攻击下未测量输出的认证。我们还刻画了确切的完美通过极限：对私有匹配态取平均后，Bob 的残余态与目标无关。
summary_cn: 提出目标隐私量子路由的两调用防作弊原语：改编隐藏次序机制，使 Alice 能以非零概率检测中继读取目标，并刻画完美通过极限；作者明示尚无可组合安全与定量权衡。
objective_summary: 构造携带物理防作弊测试的目标隐私量子路由原语，证明可检测显式目标读取并刻画完美通过极限。
evidence_note: 纯理论协议构造与极限刻画，作者自陈不含量化权衡与可组合安全；无实现实验。
novelty_note: 把量子私有查询的隐藏次序机制迁移到量子路由的目标隐私问题，是新场景下的组件改编而非全新路线。
scope: 结论限于两调用模型与显式目标读取攻击；对多跳路由、恶意中继的其他策略与噪声信道未覆盖。
limitations: 无信息-扰动定量权衡与可组合安全证明；完美通过极限依赖理想操作；未考虑有限效率与实现缺陷。

title: GrayShield: Bit-Level Sanitization for Transformer Model Supply-Chain Security
abstract: Transformer models such as BERT and Vision Transformer~(ViT) achieve strong performance via densely parameterized attention backbones. However, the least significant bits~(LSBs) of their 32-bit floating-point weights can be abused as covert channels to conceal malicious payloads, posing a serious threat to the AI model supply chain. We propose \GS (\GSabbr), a lightweight, post-training, zero-data sanitization method that completely replaces the declared mantissa-LSB channel with a Gray-code-guided low-transition sequence. Complete payload-independent overwrite, whether keyed or public, makes the sanitized target bits independent of the embedded payload and gives that declared channel zero capacity. Gray coding supplies overwrite structure, while a keyed per-tensor phase supplies pattern diversity. Benchmarked against seven post-training defenses on four Transformer model presets and two real-world malware payloads, \GSabbr maintains sub-$1\%$ accuracy impact and achieves $49.96\pm0.66$ percentage-point Recovery Reduction (RR) under five implemented attacker variants. Because pre-defense recovery is effectively $100\%$, RR near 50 percentage points corresponds to post-sanitization bit accuracy at binary chance. Its main empirical advantage is stable near-chance sanitization with substantially smaller weight-distribution shift than the evaluated near-chance baselines PatternMask (PM) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, conference
title_cn: GrayShield：面向 Transformer 模型供应链安全的比特级清洗
abstract_cn: BERT、Vision Transformer 等 Transformer 模型凭借密集参数化的注意力骨干取得强大性能。但其 32 位浮点权重的最低有效位（LSB）可被滥作隐蔽信道以藏匿恶意载荷，对 AI 模型供应链构成严重威胁。我们提出 GrayShield（GS），一个轻量的训练后、零数据清洗方法，用格雷码引导的低翻转序列完全替换声明的尾数 LSB 信道。与载荷无关的完全覆写——无论带钥还是公开——使被清洗的目标比特与嵌入载荷无关，令该声明信道容量为零。格雷编码提供覆写结构，每张量的带钥相位提供模式多样性。在四个 Transformer 模型预设与两个真实恶意载荷上与七种训练后防御对比，GS 保持低于 1% 的精度影响，并在五种实现的攻击者变体下取得 49.96±0.66 个百分点的恢复率降低（RR）。由于防御前恢复率实际为 100%，接近 50 个百分点的 RR 对应清洗后比特准确率处于二元随机水平。其主要实证优势是以显著小于所评估近随机基线 PatternMask（PM）与训练后量化（PTQ）的权重分布偏移，实现稳定的近随机清洗。
summary_cn: GrayShield 用格雷码序列覆写权重尾数 LSB 隐蔽信道：精度影响 <1%，五种攻击变体下恢复率降低 49.96±0.66pp（近随机），分布偏移小于 PatternMask 与 PTQ。
objective_summary: 提出训练后零数据的 LSB 隐蔽信道清洗方法 GrayShield，以格雷码覆写与带钥相位在低精度损失下消除载荷可恢复性。
evidence_note: 4 个模型预设、2 个真实恶意载荷、5 种攻击者变体、7 种防御对比，报告均值±标准差等量化结果。
novelty_note: LSB 隐蔽信道威胁来自已有工作，新意在格雷码结构化覆写加带钥相位的清洗机制及其近随机、低偏移的实证表现。
scope: 结论针对 fp32 Transformer 权重尾数 LSB 信道；对量化/低比特模型、其他隐蔽信道编码与自适应编码者未评估。
limitations: 只覆盖声明的尾数 LSB 信道；对索引、稀疏格式等替代表示未验证；清洗对下游微调后重新引入载荷的抵抗未测试。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
abstract: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures
title_cn: 在机器遗忘中建模删除请求
abstract_cn: 机器遗忘被视为让用户在 AI 模型中行使「被遗忘权」的有望途径。我们询问：用户在行使这一权利时可能如何影响模型行为。我们定义用户在请求删除数据时可能采取的两类行为：自适应性与集体性。通过把用户在此情境下的目标与随机优化的结果联系起来，我们证明了展现与不展现这些行为的用户群体在潜在影响上的理论差距。随后我们展示如何用数据估值技术设计能显著改变模型行为的删除请求者，并在现实设定中验证。在计算机视觉任务上的实验中，我们展示了不同用户行为模型的差异化影响，并尝试分离自适应性与集体性的作用。
summary_cn: 形式化删除请求的两类用户行为——自适应与集体，证明其影响的理论差距，并用数据估值设计删除请求者在 CV 任务上显著改变被遗忘模型的行为。
objective_summary: 提出删除请求者行为的自适应/集体性模型，以随机优化视角给出理论差距并用数据估值构造有影响的请求策略。
evidence_note: 理论论证加 CV 任务实验演示；无真实用户研究，实验为概念验证规模。
novelty_note: 开辟「策略性删除请求者」这一新问题视角：把遗忘的权利行使方建模为自适应/集体行动者，此前工作多把删除请求视为静态无策略输入。
scope: 结论适用于机器遗忘场景与所测 CV 任务；对大语言模型遗忘、法律合规流程中的真实请求行为未覆盖。
limitations: 用户行为模型是理想化抽象；实验限于视觉任务与所选遗忘算法；集体行为需要协调假设。

title: CyTReX: Explainable AI-Based Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning Framework for DER Networks
abstract: Distributed Energy Resource (DER) environments rely on network communication protocols to coordinate control commands, measurements, and device states across edge assets and cloud systems. Edge anomaly detection systems (ADS) monitor this traffic to identify deviations from normal communication behavior, flagging suspicious flows for further investigation. When the ADS flags abnormal network traffic, a single attack label is often insufficient for operational response: the label reports the detector's selected class but does not expose alternative threat interpretations that may warrant investigation. This paper presents Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (CyTReX), an evidence-grounded threat reasoning framework for DER security that transforms network-level anomaly alerts into ranked, analyst-facing threat hypotheses designed to support Security Operations Center (SOC) triage and investigation. CyTReX constrains large language model (LLM) reasoning through a structured evidence packet, defined as a consolidated record of detection outputs, model explanations, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) context. The evidence packet integrates edge-layer anomaly detection evidence, cloud reasoning layer attack interpretation, Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) network-feature attributions, surrogate decision rules, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled CTI enrichment. This ensures that every ranked hypothesis and attack-tree branch is traceable to explicit evidence rather than free-form LLM inference, and that incomplete or conflicting evidence is communicated rather than suppressed. Evaluation across five configurations shows that additional reasoning components improve hypothesis specificity, evidence traceability, and analytical grounding, with the complete pipeline providing the richest evidence-grounded reasoning context.
comment: Paper Presented at the 2026 Resilience Week, National Habor, Maryland, USA
title_cn: CyTReX：面向 DER 网络的可解释 AI 网络威胁推理框架
abstract_cn: 分布式能源（DER）环境依靠网络通信协议在边缘资产与云系统之间协调控制命令、测量与设备状态。边缘异常检测系统（ADS）监控这些流量以识别偏离正常通信行为的情况，将可疑流标记出来供进一步调查。当 ADS 标记异常网络流量时，单一攻击标签往往不足以支撑运营响应：标签只报告检测器选定的类别，不暴露可能值得调查的其他威胁解释。本文提出 CyTReX（基于可解释人工智能的网络安全威胁推理），一个面向 DER 安全、以证据为依据的威胁推理框架，把网络级异常告警转化为排序的、面向分析师的威胁假设，支持安全运营中心（SOC）的分诊与调查。CyTReX 通过结构化证据包约束大语言模型（LLM）推理，证据包是检测输出、模型解释与网络威胁情报（CTI）上下文的合并记录。证据包集成边缘层异常检测证据、云推理层攻击解释、SHAP 网络特征归因、代理决策规则与经 MCP 启用的 CTI 增强。这确保每个排序假设与攻击树分支都可追溯到显式证据而非自由形式的 LLM 推理，并且不完整或冲突的证据会被传达而非被抑制。跨五个配置的评估显示，额外的推理组件提升了假设具体性、证据可追溯性与分析接地性，完整管线提供了最丰富的证据接地推理上下文。
summary_cn: CyTReX 把 DER 网络异常告警转为可追溯的威胁假设排序：以整合 ADS 证据、SHAP 归因、代理规则与 MCP CTI 的证据包约束 LLM 推理，五配置评估显示组件越全推理越接地。
objective_summary: 构建面向 DER 的证据约束式威胁推理框架，把异常告警与 SHAP、代理规则和 CTI 打包供 LLM 生成可追溯假设。
evidence_note: 五个配置的内部对比与会议发表（Resilience Week 2026）；无外部基线的检测性能指标，评估以假设质量与可追溯性为主。
novelty_note: 把异常检测、SHAP 归因、代理规则与 CTI 组装成约束 LLM 的证据包是 DER/SOC 场景的新组合，组件各自已有。
scope: 适用于具备边缘 ADS 与 CTI 接入的 DER 监控环境；对没有异常检测层的网络与实时闭环控制场景不适用。
limitations: 评估不含检测性能与误报率指标；假设质量缺乏专家盲评；证据包构造依赖所选 SHAP 与代理模型。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.
title_cn: 自我反思微调：从失败经验增强智能体对抗提示注入的安全性
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在工具增强环境中部署日益增多，但对外部输入的依赖使其极易受到劫持任务目标的提示注入攻击。现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，限制了对自适应攻击模式的泛化。我们提出自我反思微调（SRFT），一个让智能体通过在对抗条件下从自身失败经验中学习来提升鲁棒性的训练框架。SRFT 不被动模仿专家行为，而是让智能体暴露于通过注入攻击构造的受损轨迹，并利用专家模型生成对比不安全与最优动作的结构化自我反思推理。这种反思监督教会智能体识别恶意指令、推断其后果并保持与原始用户意图对齐。我们在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-8B 上实例化为 SR-Agent，并在静态与自适应提示注入基准上评估。实验结果表明，SRFT 在保持任务性能的同时大幅降低攻击成功率，并在自适应攻击下表现出强泛化。这些发现表明，通过自我反思从失败中学习是构建鲁棒安全 LLM 智能体的一个有前景方向。代码发布于 https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo。
summary_cn: SRFT 让智能体从被注入攻击的失败轨迹中学习：专家模型生成对比性自我反思监督，在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen3-8B 上显著降低攻击成功率并保持任务性能、泛化到自适应攻击。
objective_summary: 提出以自身失败经验与结构化自我反思为监督的提示注入防御训练框架 SRFT，并在静态与自适应基准上验证。
evidence_note: 两个基座模型、静态与自适应基准评估并开源代码；摘要未给具体数值与统计检验，规模中等。
novelty_note: 与静态专家轨迹/偏好优化相对，用自身失败加反思对比作监督是训练信号上的新组合；「从失败学习」思想在安全对齐中已有近邻。
scope: 结论适用于 8B 级模型与单轮工具使用场景；对更大模型、多智能体与持续自适应攻击者未验证。
limitations: 反思监督依赖更强专家模型的质量；摘要未报告具体攻击成功率数值；对反思本身被注入污染的场景未讨论。

title: Autonomous Active Directory Exploitation via Multi-Model Harness Orchestration: A Benchmark Study with NeuroSploit on GOAD
abstract: Active Directory (AD) remains the predominant identity and access management infrastructure in enterprise environments, and its compromise represents the highest-impact outcome in internal penetration tests. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can autonomously conduct assumed-breach penetration testing against AD, but these studies employ standalone agents lacking structured guardrails, deterministic validation, and multi-stage chain orchestration. We present a benchmark evaluation of NeuroSploit v4.2.0, an open-source Rust-based autonomous pentest harness, against the Game of Active Directory (GOAD), a deliberately vulnerable multi-forest AD lab maintained by Orange Cyberdefense comprising five virtual machines, two forests, and three domains. The harness orchestrates 22 AD-specific agents and 7 multi-stage attack-chain playbooks covering the full AD kill chain: enumeration, Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, NTLM relay and coercion, Kerberos delegation abuse, AD CS exploitation (ESC1-ESC8), MSSQL linked-server pivoting, DCSync, cross-forest trust abuse, and persistence detection. We benchmark nine frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6/4.7/4.8, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.6, Qwen 3.8, GLM 5.3, Kimi k3) within the harness, comparing against direct invocation across 14 technique categories and 7 chains. The harness achieves 96-100% technique coverage with 90-97% precision, while direct invocation covers only 21-54% and produces 3.2x more false positives. Time to full three-domain compromise with Opus 4.8 was 134 minutes with guardrail activations preventing lockout-triggering sprays, unauthorized DCSync dumps, and out-of-scope reconnaissance. Results demonstrate that structured harness orchestration with domain-specialized agents, POMDP belief tracking, and cross-model voting substantially outperforms unstructured LLM usage for AD penetration testing.

title_cn: 基于多模型编排的自主 Active Directory 渗透：NeuroSploit 在 GOAD 上的基准研究
abstract_cn: Active Directory（AD）仍是企业环境中主流的身份与访问管理基础设施，其沦陷代表内部渗透测试中影响最大的结果。近期工作表明大语言模型（LLM）可以自主开展针对 AD 的假定突破渗透测试，但这些研究使用缺乏结构化护栏、确定性验证与多阶段链编排的独立智能体。我们对 NeuroSploit v4.2.0 进行基准评估——这是一个开源的 Rust 自主渗透测试编排器，攻击对象是 Game of Active Directory（GOAD），一个由 Orange Cyberdefense 维护的故意脆弱多森林 AD 实验环境，含 5 台虚拟机、2 个森林与 3 个域。该编排器调度 22 个 AD 专用智能体与 7 条多阶段攻击链剧本，覆盖完整 AD kill chain：枚举、Kerberoasting、AS-REP roasting、NTLM 中继与强制认证、Kerberos 委派滥用、AD CS 利用（ESC1-ESC8）、MSSQL 链接服务器横向移动、DCSync、跨森林信任滥用与持久化检测。我们在编排器内对 9 个前沿 LLM（Claude Opus 4.6/4.7/4.8、GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.6、Qwen 3.8、GLM 5.3、Kimi k3）进行基准测试，与直接调用在 14 个技术类别和 7 条链上比较。编排器实现 96–100% 的技术覆盖与 90–97% 的精确率，而直接调用仅覆盖 21–54% 且误报多 3.2 倍。使用 Opus 4.8 完全攻陷三个域耗时 134 分钟，护栏激活阻止了会触发锁定的密码喷洒、未授权 DCSync 转储与越界侦察。结果表明，具备领域专用智能体、POMDP 信念跟踪与跨模型投票的结构化编排，在 AD 渗透测试中显著优于非结构化 LLM 使用。
summary_cn: GOAD 靶场评测 NeuroSploit 编排器：9 个前沿 LLM 经 22 个 AD 智能体与 7 条攻击链达 96–100% 覆盖、90–97% 精确率（直接调用仅 21–54%），Opus 4.8 全域攻陷 134 分钟。
objective_summary: 构建 AD 渗透编排器 NeuroSploit 并在标准 GOAD 靶场对 9 个前沿 LLM 做结构化编排与直接调用的对照基准。
evidence_note: 在公认 GOAD 靶场上对 9 个模型、14 类技术、7 条链做系统对照并量化精确率与误报；环境为专用实验靶场，无统计检验，单一作者预印本。
novelty_note: LLM 自主 AD 渗透已有先例，新意在结构化编排（专用智能体、POMDP 信念跟踪、护栏与跨模型投票）的系统化整合与量化对照。
scope: 结论适用于 GOAD 类配置的 AD 实验环境；对真实企业网络的防御栈、噪声与变更管理未验证。
limitations: 靶场为故意脆弱环境，不能外推到加固生产域；护栏与验证规则由作者定义；未评估防御方检测此类编排的能力。

title: Learning to Watermark Speech Synthesis Against Model-Driven Reconstruction
abstract: Modern TTS systems increasingly generate synthetic speech at scale for diverse users. This setting calls for content-level provenance that can verify the origin of released speech and attribute it to the requesting user, which generative watermarking can support by embedding multi-bit identifiers directly into synthesized speech. Once released, however, speech may undergo heterogeneous learned transformations during distribution and editing, with reconstruction objectives that can preserve speech utility while affecting watermark recoverability differently. We find that no single watermark carrier remains consistently reliable across reconstruction models, as its survival depends jointly on the embedded structure, reconstruction mechanism, and observation representation. To this end, we propose Thrive, a multi-bit generative speech watermarking framework for modern autoregressive TTS, covering both discrete-token and continuous-representation generation under reconstruction attacks. Specifically, Rise synchronizes watermark injection into intermediate representations with its continued integration into subsequent generation, while Care combines waveform and spectral experts using bit-wise reliability selection. Experiments on both autoregressive paradigms show that Thrive preserves synthesis fidelity, achieves 87.6% average recovery accuracy under reconstruction attacks, and supports source attribution over candidate sets of up to 10,000 identities.
title_cn: 学习面向模型驱动重建的语音合成水印
abstract_cn: 现代 TTS 系统日益为多样用户大规模生成合成语音。这一设定要求内容级溯源：验证发布语音的来源并将其归因到请求用户，生成式水印可通过把多比特标识符直接嵌入合成语音来支持。然而语音一经发布，在分发与编辑过程中可能经历异构的学习型变换，其重建目标可在保持语音效用的同时以不同方式影响水印可恢复性。我们发现没有任何单一水印载体在所有重建模型下都持续可靠，其存活性共同取决于嵌入结构、重建机制与观测表示。为此我们提出 Thrive，一个面向现代自回归 TTS 的多比特生成式语音水印框架，覆盖离散词元与连续表示两种生成范式下的重建攻击。具体地，Rise 将水印注入中间表示的过程与其向后续生成的持续整合同步；Care 用比特级可靠性选择组合波形与频谱专家。在两种自回归范式上的实验表明，Thrive 保持合成保真度，在重建攻击下达到 87.6% 的平均恢复准确率，并支持最多 10,000 身份候选集的来源归因。
summary_cn: Thrive 面向自回归 TTS 的多比特语音水印，用 Rise 同步注入与 Care 波形/频谱专家选择：重建攻击下平均恢复准确率 87.6%，支持万级身份归因。
objective_summary: 针对模型驱动重建攻击设计多比特生成式语音水印 Thrive，覆盖离散与连续两种自回归范式并评估恢复率与归因容量。
evidence_note: 两种自回归范式上的对比实验与重建攻击评估，报告 87.6% 恢复率等数字；无统计检验，攻击模型集合有限。
novelty_note: 把「重建变换下的水印存活」作为设计目标并给出注入同步与双专家选择机制，是语音水印在 TTS 场景的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于自回归 TTS 与所测重建模型族；对神经编解码器之外的分发链路、模拟转码与人为剪辑未验证。
limitations: 重建攻击集合有限且由作者实现；10,000 身份归因在更大候选集的表现未知；对自适应去除攻击未评估。

title: Language Model Fingerprinting Requires Rethinking Watermark Teachers
abstract: LLM fingerprinting via watermark distillation embeds a statistical watermark signal into model weights, enabling model owners to identify their models behind black-box APIs. Revisiting a recent protocol, we find that its utility evaluation understates text quality degradation in open-ended generation, favoring overly strong watermark teachers. Weakening the watermark improves text quality but sacrifices detectability. To move beyond this trade-off, we rethink whether text watermarks designed for verifying generated text are suitable distillation teachers for model fingerprinting. Such watermarks are typically designed to remain detectable from an individual output, limiting how sparse the watermark signal can be. In contrast, fingerprint verification can aggregate signal across queries, making sparser watermark signals viable. This raises a key question: where should the sparse signal be placed? We analyze signal placement through token surprisal and show that, even at comparable watermark strength, different placements can target tokens with different plausibility under the base model. This motivates near-tie restriction, which uses top-1-relative logit gaps to restrict the watermark bias to tokens close to the base model's top prediction. Across multiple models, near-tie improves detection--quality frontiers under deployment changes, preserves higher text quality across query budgets, and further improves existing watermarking schemes when combined with them.
title_cn: 语言模型指纹识别需要重新思考水印教师
abstract_cn: 通过水印蒸馏的 LLM 指纹识别把统计水印信号嵌入模型权重，使模型所有者能在黑盒 API 背后识别自己的模型。我们重新审视一个近期协议，发现其效用评估低估了开放式生成中的文本质量退化，从而偏好过强的水印教师。削弱水印可改善文本质量却牺牲可检测性。为超越这一权衡，我们重新思考为验证生成文本设计的水印是否适合作为模型指纹识别的蒸馏教师。这类水印通常被设计为可从单条输出检出，限制了水印信号的稀疏程度。相反，指纹验证可以跨查询聚合信号，使更稀疏的水印信号可行。这就引出一个关键问题：稀疏信号应放在哪里？我们通过词元意外度（surprisal）分析信号放置，表明在可比水印强度下，不同放置可以针对基座模型下合理性差异很大的词元。这促成了近并列限制（near-tie restriction）：用 top-1 相对 logit 间隔把水印偏置限制在接近基座模型 top 预测的词元上。在多个模型上，near-tie 在部署变化下改善检测-质量前沿，在各查询预算下保持更高文本质量，且与现有水印方案结合时可进一步改进。
summary_cn: 重审水印蒸馏指纹协议：文本水印教师过强导致质量退化；提出 near-tie 限制把水印偏置集中在 top-1 邻近词元，在多模型上改善检测-质量前沿并可叠加现有方案。
objective_summary: 分析水印教师选择与信号放置对指纹识别的影响，提出近并列限制以在稀疏信号下兼顾检测率与文本质量。
evidence_note: 跨多模型、多查询预算与部署变化的系统对比，报告检测-质量前沿；无统计检验，评测设置自建。
novelty_note: 指出「文本水印教师不适配指纹聚合验证」的诊断性修正，near-tie 放置是新机制，但整体在指纹-水印研究脉络内增量。
scope: 结论适用于基于水印蒸馏的开放模型指纹识别；对不经蒸馏的原生指纹、闭源 API 模型未评估。
limitations: 对既有协议的效用评估修正依赖所选生成任务；near-tie 需访问 logits，黑盒蒸馏场景受限；跨查询聚合的统计功效未给闭式分析。

title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption for Statistical Modeling
abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption allows arithmetic to be carried out on encrypted values, so that a party performing a computation need not see the data it operates on. This is useful wherever collaborating parties or sites cannot share data records or computed summaries yet need to do a joint analysis. We demonstrate the protocols needed to perform such analyses reproducibly via two packages in R, a platform widely used for applied statistics. The first, openfhe.R, is an interface to the OpenFHE C++ library, which exposes exact integer arithmetic (BFV, BGV), approximate real-valued arithmetic (CKKS), Boolean circuits, and multiparty key generation. The second is homomorpheR, which builds a small set of master/worker primitives for multi-party protocols on top of the first. Together, the two let an ordinary R statistical routine compose with an encrypted-arithmetic layer at the function-value boundary, provided the quantity crossing that boundary decomposes as a sum over sites. Two validation studies are presented: distributed stratified Cox regression, where stats4::mle() converges through an encrypted channel, and federated Cox-lasso via convex optimization using consensus ADMM, where the cross-site update is the only encrypted step. We also discuss federated similarity retrieval and two-party prediction. Throughout, the parties are assumed honest-but-curious, and threshold key generation removes the assumption that any single party holds a usable secret key.
